/-- `{c ≤ f}` is measurable: it is `⋂ₙ {c − 1/(n+1) < f}`. -/
theorem ge (hf : Measurable S f) (c : R) : S.M (fun x => c ≤ f x) :=
  S.congr (S.iInter _ fun n => hf (c - 1 / ((n : R) + 1))) fun x => by
    constructor
    · intro h; apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hn
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small (by grind : (0 : R) < c - f x)
      have := h N; have := hN N (Nat.le_refl N); grind
    · intro h n; have := eps_pos n; grind

/-- Type renaming of a term substitution. -/
theorem tyRename_subst (t : Term) :
    ∀ ξ σ, tyRename ξ (subst σ t) = subst (tyRename ξ ∘ σ) (tyRename ξ t) := by
  induction t with
  | var n => intros; rfl
  | app t u iht ihu => intros; simp only [subst, tyRename, iht, ihu]

    intro ξ σ

    congr 2

/-- Covers can be translated. -/
theorem coverSum_translate {A : R → Prop} {s : R} (r : R) (h : CoverSum A s) :

  obtain ⟨lo, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h

/-- For continuous `f` on `[a, b]`, `∫ₐᵇ f` is its Riemann integral. -/
theorem hasIntegral_integral {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) : HasIntegral f a b (integral f a b) := by

Foundations.Sets.pigeonhole_nat:
/-- **Pigeonhole principle (arithmetic form).** If `f` sends each of `0, …, n` to a
number below `n`, two of them collide. -/
theorem pigeonhole_nat : ∀ n (f : Nat → Nat), (∀ i, i < n + 1 → f i < n) →
    ∃ i j, i < j ∧ j < n + 1 ∧ f i = f j := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro f hf; exact absurd (hf 0 (Nat.zero_lt_one)) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f hf
    -- either something collides with the last pigeon `n + 1` ...
    by_cases hc : ∃ i, i < n + 1 ∧ f i = f (n + 1)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := hc
      exact ⟨i, n + 1, hi, Nat.lt_succ_self _, he⟩
    · -- ... or we move the pigeons in hole `n` to the last pigeon's hole and recurse
      have hne : ∀ i, i < n + 1 → f i ≠ f (n + 1) := fun i hi he => hc ⟨i, hi, he⟩
      let g : Nat → Nat := fun i => if f i = n then f (n + 1) else f i
      have hg : ∀ i, i < n + 1 → g i < n := by
        intro i hi
        have h1 := hf i (by omega)
        have h2 := hf (n + 1) (by omega)
        have h3 := hne i hi
        simp only [g]
        split <;> omega
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ := ih g hg
      simp only [g] at he
      by_cases hi' : f i = n <;> by_cases hj' : f j = n <;> simp only [hi', hj', ↓reduceIte] at he
      · exact ⟨i, j, hij, by omega, by rw [hi', hj']⟩
      · exact absurd he.symm (hne j (by omega))
      · exact absurd he (hne i (by omega))
      · exact ⟨i, j, hij, by omega, he⟩
Foundations.Algebra.GaussInt.exists_roun:
/-- Rounding: for `N > 0` there is `q` with `-N ≤ 2(x - qN) < N`. -/
theorem exists_round (x N : Int) (hN : 0 < N) : ∃ q : Int, -N ≤ 2 * (x - q * N) ∧ 2 * (x - q * N) < N := by
  refine ⟨(2 * x + N) / (2 * N), ?_⟩
  have h1 := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (2 * x + N) (2 * N)
  have h2 := Int.emod_nonneg (2 * x + N) (b := 2 * N) (by omega)
  have h3 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (2 * x + N) (b := 2 * N) (by omega)
  have e : 2 * N * ((2 * x + N) / (2 * N)) = 2 * ((2 * x + N) / (2 * N) * N) := by
    rw [Int.mul_comm ((2 * x + N) / (2 * N)) N, Int.mul_assoc]
  rw [e] at h1
  constructor <;> omega
Foundations.Logic.Computability.unpair:
/-- Inverse of Cantor's pairing, computed by walking along the diagonals:
the successor of `⟨a, b + 1⟩` is `⟨a + 1, b⟩`, and the successor of `⟨a, 0⟩` is
`⟨0, a + 1⟩`. -/
def unpair : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (0, 0)
  | n + 1 =>
      let p := unpair n
      if p.2 = 0 then (0, p.1 + 1) else (p.1 + 1, p.2 - 1)

/-- Sums of continuous functions are continuous. -/
theorem continuousAt_add {f g : R → R} {x : R} (hf : R.ContinuousAt f x) (hg : R.ContinuousAt g x) :
    R.ContinuousAt (fun y => f y + g y) x := by
  have := continuousAt_sub hf (continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) hg)
  intro ε hε; obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := this ε hε
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k : abs ((f y - (0 - g y)) - (f x - (0 - g x))) < ε := h y hy
  show abs (f y + g y - (f x + g x)) < ε
  rw [show f y + g y - (f x + g x) = (f y - (0 - g y)) - (f x - (0 - g x)) by grind]
  exact k

/-- **κ + κ = κ.** For every infinite type `α`, `α ⊕ α ≃ α`. -/
theorem add_self_equinum {α : Type u} (h : IsInfinite α) : Equinum (α ⊕ α) α := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := nat_le_of_isInfinite h
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _⟩ := mul_self_equinum h
  let F : α ⊕ α → α := fun
    | .inl a => m (a, e 0)
    | .inr a => m (a, e 1)
  have hF : Function.Injective F := by
    intro s t hst
    cases s <;> cases t <;> simp only [F] at hst <;> have := hm hst <;>
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
    · rw [this.1]
    · exact absurd (he this.2) (by omega)
    · exact absurd (he this.2) (by omega)
    · rw [this.1]
  exact schroeder_bernstein (f := F) (g := Sum.inl) hF (fun a b h => Sum.inl.inj h)
Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.unionPSq:
/-- The union of a non-empty chain of partial squarings is a partial squaring. -/
def unionPSq (C : PSq e → Prop) (hC : Zorn.IsChain Le C) (W₀ : PSq e) (hW₀ : C W₀) : PSq e where
  dom x := ∃ W, C W ∧ W.dom x
  rel p c := ∃ W, C W ∧ W.rel p c
  rel_dom p c := by
    rintro ⟨W, hW, h⟩
    have := W.rel_dom p c h
    exact ⟨⟨W, hW, this.1⟩, ⟨W, hW, this.2.1⟩, ⟨W, hW, this.2.2⟩⟩
  func p c c' := by
    rintro ⟨W, hW, h⟩ ⟨V, hV, h'⟩
    rcases hC W V hW hV with hle | hle
    · exact V.func _ _ _ (hle.2 _ _ h) h'
    · exact W.func _ _ _ h (hle.2 _ _ h')
  inj p p' c := by
    rintro ⟨W, hW, h⟩ ⟨V, hV, h'⟩
    rcases hC W V hW hV with hle | hle
    · exact V.inj _ _ _ (hle.2 _ _ h) h'
    · exact W.inj _ _ _ h (hle.2 _ _ h')
  total x y := by
    rintro ⟨W, hW, hx⟩ ⟨V, hV, hy⟩
    rcases hC W V hW hV with hle | hle
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := V.total x y (hle.1 x hx) hy
      exact ⟨c, V, hV, hc⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := W.total x y hx (hle.1 y hy)
      exact ⟨c, W, hW, hc⟩
  base n := ⟨W₀, hW₀, W₀.base n⟩

/-- **Irrationality of √3.** No rational number squares to `3`. -/
theorem sqrt_three_irrational : ¬ ∃ q : Q, q * q = 3 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  induction q using Q.ind with | h n d hd => ?_
  simp only [Q.mk_mul, Q.ofNat_def, Q.mk_eq_mk] at hq

Foundations.Topology.Cantor.three_val:
/-- Self-similarity: `3 · val b = d₀ + val (b ∘ succ)`. -/
theorem three_val (b : Nat → Bool) :
    3 * val b = (if b 0 then 2 else 0) + val (fun k => b (k + 1)) := by
  have h1 := hasSum_succ_iff.2 (hasSum_val b)
  have h2 := (hasSum_val (fun k => b (k + 1))).const_mul (1 / 3)
  have e : ∀ k, 1 / 3 * term (fun k => b (k + 1)) k = term b (k + 1) := fun k => by
    unfold term; rw [pow_succ' (1 / 3 : R) (k + 1)]; grind
  have := h1.unique (h2.congr e)
  have e0 : term b 0 = (if b 0 then 2 else 0) * (1 / 3) := by
    unfold term; rw [pow_succ']; show _ * (1 * _) = _; grind
  rw [e0] at this
  split at this <;> split <;> grind

/-- **Every root is listed.** If `β` lists five distinct roots of `x⁵ - 6x + 3` in `ℂ`, every

theorem quintic_root_enum {β : Fin 5 → ℂ} (hinj : ∀ i j, β i = β j → i = j)

  let L := (FiniteType.elems : List (Fin 5)).map β

  have hwL : w ∉ L := fun h => by
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := List.mem_map.1 h; exact hno ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hf0 : quinticPoly ℂ ≠ 0 := fun h => by
    have := natDegree_quinticPoly (R := ℂ) C.isField.1; rw [h] at this
    unfold natDegree at this; rw [len_eq_zero.2 rfl] at this; exact absurd this (by decide)
  have := card_roots_le_natDegree C.isDomain hf0 (w :: L) (List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨hwL, hL⟩)
    (fun a ha => by
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact hw
      · obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 h; exact hroot i)
  rw [natDegree_quinticPoly C.isField.1, List.length_cons, List.length_map] at this
  have hc : (FiniteType.elems : List (Fin 5)).length = 5 := FiniteType.card_fin 5
  omega

Foundations.Algebra.intReduce:
/-- **Reduction modulo `n`** as a ring homomorphism `ℤ → Fin n`. -/
def intReduce : RingHom Int (Fin n) where
  toFun a := ⟨(a % (n : Int)).toNat, by
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    have h0 := Int.emod_nonneg a (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    have h1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos a (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    omega⟩
  map_add a b := by
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    apply Fin.ext
    show ((a + b) % (n : Int)).toNat = (((a % (n : Int)).toNat + (b % (n : Int)).toNat) % n)
    apply nat_eq_of_intCast_eq
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (a + b) (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    have h2 := Int.emod_nonneg a (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    have h3 := Int.emod_nonneg b (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1, Int.natCast_emod, Int.natCast_add, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h2,
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg h3, ← Int.add_emod]
  map_mul a b := by
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    apply Fin.ext
    show ((a * b) % (n : Int)).toNat = (((a % (n : Int)).toNat * (b % (n : Int)).toNat) % n)
    apply nat_eq_of_intCast_eq
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (a * b) (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    have h2 := Int.emod_nonneg a (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    have h3 := Int.emod_nonneg b (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1, Int.natCast_emod, Int.natCast_mul, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h2,
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg h3, ← Int.mul_emod]
  map_one := by
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    apply Fin.ext
    show ((1 : Int) % (n : Int)).toNat = (Fin.ofNat n 1).val
    rw [fin_ofNat_val]
    apply nat_eq_of_intCast_eq
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg 1 (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1, Int.natCast_emod]; rfl

satisfied when the bound variable is given the value of `t`. -/

Foundations.Logic.Sequent.right_nd:
/-- The right rules are valid in natural deduction: if `T ⊢ ¬A` and every premise
extension of `T` is contradictory, then so is `T`. -/
theorem right_nd {A : Formula} {ps} (h : rightPremises A = some ps) {T : Theory}
    (hA : T ⊢ neg A) (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, ext T p ⊢ bot) : T ⊢ bot := by
  cases A <;> simp [rightPremises] at h <;> subst h
  case imp A B =>
    have h₁ := hp ([A], [B]) (by simp)
    have : Theory.insert T A ⊢ B :=
      Derives.raa (h₁.weaken (by intro ψ; simp [ext, Theory.insert]; grind))
    exact Derives.negE hA (Derives.impI this)
  case conj A B =>
    have h₁ := hp ([], [A]) (by simp)
    have h₂ := hp ([], [B]) (by simp)
    have hA' : T ⊢ A := Derives.raa (h₁.weaken (by intro ψ; simp [ext, Theory.insert]; grind))
    have hB' : T ⊢ B := Derives.raa (h₂.weaken (by intro ψ; simp [ext, Theory.insert]; grind))
    exact Derives.negE hA (Derives.conjI hA' hB')
  case disj A B =>
    have h₁ := hp ([], [A, B]) (by simp)
    have hB : Theory.insert T (neg A) ⊢ B :=
      Derives.raa (h₁.weaken (by intro ψ; simp [ext, Theory.insert]; grind))
    have hAB : T ⊢ disj A B :=
      Derives.byCases (Derives.disjI₁ (Derives.assume _ _)) (Derives.disjI₂ hB)
    exact Derives.negE hA hAB

/-- A number divisible by every `k` with `0 < k ≤ L`. -/
theorem exists_common_multiple (L : N.Dom) :
    ∃ d₀ : N.Dom, ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ L → ∃ t, d₀ + 1 = k * t := by
  refine induction (P := fun L _ => ∃ d₀ : N.Dom, ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ L → ∃ t, d₀ + 1 = k * t)
    (by dfn) (fun _ => 0) ⟨0, fun k hk hk0 => ?_⟩ ?_ L
  · exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le' hk hk0) (lt_irrefl' 0)
  · rintro x ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩
    refine ⟨d₀ * (x + 1) + x, fun k hk hkx => ?_⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hkx with rfl | h
    · exact ⟨d₀ + 1, by grind⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd₀ k hk (lt_succ_iff'.1 h)
      exact ⟨t * (x + 1), by grind⟩

Foundations.Logic.Sequent.search_sound:
/-- **Soundness of proof search.** A successful search produces a cut-free derivation. -/
theorem search_sound : ∀ (n : Nat) (Γ Δ L R : List Formula),
    search n Γ Δ L R = true → CutFree (Γ ++ L) (Δ ++ R)
  | 0, _, _, _, _, h => by simp [search] at h
  | n + 1, A :: Γ, Δ, L, R, h => by
      cases hA : leftPremises A with
      | some ps =>
          simp only [search, hA, List.all_eq_true] at h
          refine CutFree.left (A := A) (by simp) hA (fun p hp => ?_)
          exact (search_sound n _ _ L R (h p hp)).weaken (by grind) (by grind)
      | none =>
          simp only [search, hA] at h
          exact (search_sound n Γ Δ (A :: L) R h).weaken (by grind) (by grind)
  | n + 1, [], A :: Δ, L, R, h => by
      cases hA : rightPremises A with
      | some ps =>
          simp only [search, hA, List.all_eq_true] at h
          refine CutFree.right (A := A) (by simp) hA (fun p hp => ?_)
          exact (search_sound n _ _ L R (h p hp)).weaken (by grind) (by grind)
      | none =>
          simp only [search, hA] at h
          exact (search_sound n [] Δ L (A :: R) h).weaken (by grind) (by grind)
  | n + 1, [], [], L, R, h => by
      simp only [search, List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨A, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
      exact CutFree.ax (A := A) (by simpa using h₁) (by simpa using h₂)

/-- **One root brings all the others.** If a stable field `gen ℚ m` contains one root `β` of
`x⁵ - 6x + 3`, it contains the whole splitting field `L`. -/
theorem L_le_of_root_mem {m : List ℂ} (hst : Stable (gen Qc m)) {β : ℂ}
    (hβ : eval β (quinticPoly ℂ) = 0) (hβM : β ∈ gen Qc m) : L.le (gen Qc m) := by
  apply L_le (le_gen Qc m)
  intro j
  have halg := quintic_isAlgebraic Qc hβ
  obtain ⟨σ₀, _, hσ₀, _⟩ := extend C.isField Qc β halg Qc.incl (qβ j)
    (fun q hq => minpoly_roots hβ (qβ_spec.2.1 j) q hq)
  have hFM : (adjoin C.isField Qc β halg).le (gen Qc m) :=
    adjoin_le _ _ _ _ (le_gen Qc m) hβM
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := extend_to m (le_adjoin _ _ _ _) hFM σ₀
  have := hst τ ⟨β, hβM⟩
  rw [show τ.toFun ⟨β, hβM⟩ = qβ j from (hτ ⟨β, mem_adjoin_self _ _ _ _⟩).trans hσ₀] at this
  exact this
Foundations.Algebra.Group.mul_inv_cancel:
/-- **Right inverses.** In a group the left inverse `a⁻¹` is also a right inverse:
`a * a⁻¹ = 1`. This follows from the one-sided axioms. -/
theorem mul_inv_cancel (a : G) : a * a⁻¹ = 1 := by
  apply eq_one_of_mul_self
  calc a * a⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) = a * (a⁻¹ * a * a⁻¹) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = a * a⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]

    (h₀ : t₀.eval M E = numM M a) (h₁ : t₁.eval M E = numM M b) :
    (fun k => ([t₀, t₁].getD k zero).eval M E) = fun k => numM M (penv a b k) := by
  funext k
  match k with

  | 1 => simpa [penv] using h₁
  | k + 2 => simp [penv]; rfl
Foundations.Logic.FO.fin_eventually:
/-- A monotone property holding eventually at each of finitely many indices holds
eventually at all of them simultaneously. -/
theorem fin_eventually {n : Nat} (P : Fin n → Nat → Prop)
    (h : ∀ i, ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → P i x) : ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → ∀ i, P i x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ _ i => i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := ih (fun i => P i.succ) (fun i => h i.succ)
      obtain ⟨k₀, h₀⟩ := h 0
      refine ⟨max k₀ k₁, fun x hx i => ?_⟩
      cases i using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact h₀ x (by omega)
      | succ i => exact h₁ x (by omega) i

Foundations.Categories.types_boolean:
/-- **The topos of types is Boolean**: `Ω` is the coproduct `1 + 1`, with `true` and
`false` as the two injections. The copairing `[f, g]` sends a proposition to `f` if it
holds and to `g` otherwise — a definition by cases that needs excluded middle. -/
noncomputable def types_boolean :
    IsCoproduct (C := Type) PUnit PUnit (Topos.Ω : Type) Topos.truth typesFalse where
  desc f g := fun p => @ite _ p (Classical.propDecidable p) (f PUnit.unit) (g PUnit.unit)
  fac₁ f g := funext fun u => by
    cases u; exact @ite_eq_left _ (Classical.propDecidable True) trivial _ _ _
  fac₂ f g := funext fun u => by
    cases u; exact @ite_eq_right _ (Classical.propDecidable False) id _ _ _
  uniq f g h h₁ h₂ := funext fun p => by
    rcases Classical.em p with hp | hp
    · rw [@ite_eq_left _ (Classical.propDecidable p) hp, eq_true hp]
      exact congrFun h₁ PUnit.unit
    · rw [@ite_eq_right _ (Classical.propDecidable p) hp, eq_false hp]
      exact congrFun h₂ PUnit.unit

/-- The absolute value is multiplicative. -/
theorem abs_mul (x y : K) : abs (x * y) = abs x * abs y := by
  rcases abs_cases x with ⟨hx, ex⟩ | ⟨hx, ex⟩ <;> rcases abs_cases y with ⟨hy, ey⟩ | ⟨hy, ey⟩ <;>
    rcases abs_cases (x * y) with ⟨hxy, exy⟩ | ⟨hxy, exy⟩ <;> rw [ex, ey, exy]
  all_goals first
    | grind
    | (have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hx hy; grind)
    | (have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hx (by grind : 0 ≤ -y); grind)
    | (have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ -x) hy; grind)
    | (have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ -x) (by grind : 0 ≤ -y); grind)
    | (have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : 0 < -x) (by grind : 0 < -y); grind)

Foundations.Algebra.primeSubfield:
/-- **The prime field** `{0, 1, 2·1, …}` of a finite field of characteristic `p`. -/
def primeSubfield : Subfield F where
  carrier x := ∃ k, x = ncast k
  zero_mem := ⟨0, rfl⟩
  one_mem := ⟨1, rfl⟩
  add_mem := fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨a + b, by rw [ha, hb, ncast_add]⟩
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨(p - 1) * k, ?_⟩
    rw [ncast_mul, ncast_pred hp, hk]; grind
  mul_mem := fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨a * b, by rw [ha, hb, ncast_mul]⟩
  inv_mem := by
    intro x hxP hx0
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hxm⟩ := exists_rpow_eq_one hF hx0
    have hpow : ∀ n, ∃ k, rpow x n = ncast k := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hxP
        exact ⟨k * j, by show rpow x n * x = _; rw [hk, hj, ncast_mul]⟩
    refine ⟨rpow x (m - 1), hpow (m - 1), ?_⟩
    have := rpow_add x (m - 1) 1
    rw [show m - 1 + 1 = m by omega, hxm] at this
    have e : rpow x 1 = x := by show 1 * x = x; exact Ring.one_mul x
    rw [e] at this
    rw [CommRing.mul_comm]; exact this.symm

  intro hall

  -- every element has a position in the list: an injection into `Fin l.length`
  have hpos : ∀ a, ∃ i : Fin l.length, l[i] = a := fun a => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 (hmem a)
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, he⟩
  refine h ⟨l.length, fun a => Classical.choose (hpos a), fun a b hab => ?_⟩
  have ha := Classical.choose_spec (hpos a)
  have hb := Classical.choose_spec (hpos b)
  simp only at hab
  rw [← ha, ← hb, hab]

Foundations.Topology.Topology.metric:
/-- **The metric topology** of a metric space: the open sets in the ε-ball sense. -/
def metric (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] : Topology X where
  IsOpen := Foundations.Topology.IsOpen
  isOpen_univ := fun _ _ => ⟨1, by grind, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  isOpen_inter U V hU hV x hx := by
    obtain ⟨ε₁, h₁, k₁⟩ := hU x hx.1
    obtain ⟨ε₂, h₂, k₂⟩ := hV x hx.2
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, e1, e2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun y hy => ⟨k₁ y (by grind), k₂ y (by grind)⟩⟩
  isOpen_sUnion S hS x := fun ⟨U, hU, hx⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, k⟩ := hS U hU x hx
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun y hy => ⟨U, hU, k y hy⟩⟩

theorem sum_sq_eq_zero {u v : K} (h : u * u + v * v = 0) : u = 0 ∧ v = 0 := by
  have hu := sq_nonneg' u
  have hv := sq_nonneg' v
  have hu' : u * u = 0 := by grind
  have hv' : v * v = 0 := by grind
  exact ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Std.le_of_lt (div_pos (show (0 : R) < 1 by grind) hc))

Foundations.Logic.Computability.derivabl:
/-- **Soundness of trees.** The root of a valid tree is derivable. -/
theorem derivable_of_tvalid : ∀ t, tvalid step t = 1 → Derivable step (troot t) := by
  intro t
  induction t using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ t ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := (tvalid_iff step t).1 ht
      refine .intro _ (snd (fst t)) (decList (fst (snd t))) (fun y hy => ?_)
        (by rw [encList_decList]; exact h₁)
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hy
      have hlen : (decList (fst (snd t))).length = llen (fst (snd t)) := by
        conv => rhs; rw [← encList_decList (fst (snd t))]
        rw [llen_encList]
      have hi' : i < llen (snd (snd t)) := by omega
      obtain ⟨h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := h₃ i hi'
      have := ih _ h₄ h₅
      rw [h₆] at this
      have e : lnth (fst (snd t)) i = (decList (fst (snd t)))[i] := by
        conv => lhs; rw [← encList_decList (fst (snd t))]
        rw [lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem']
      rwa [e] at this

  have h := M.additive (fun _ _ => False) (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (fun _ _ _ _ h => h.elim)

    funext fun _ => propext ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h, fun h => h.elim⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.betaF_fresh:
/-- `betaF` has free variables among `0, 1, 2, 3`. -/
theorem betaF_fresh : ∀ n, 4 ≤ n → betaF.Fresh n := by
  intro n hn
  have hD : ∀ m, 5 ≤ m → betaDiv.Fresh m := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [betaDiv, fresh_add, fresh_mul, fresh_succ, fresh_var, fresh_zero, true_and]; omega
  simp only [betaF, Formula.Fresh, fresh_add, fresh_mul, fresh_var]
  refine ⟨?_, fresh_substL ltF_fresh (by simp) ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨by omega, ⟨by omega, hD _ (by omega)⟩, by omega⟩
  intro t ht
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht

  · exact hD _ (by omega)

Foundations.Topology.bound_on:
/-- A function continuous on `[a, b]` is bounded there. -/
theorem bound_on {u : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hu : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt u x) : ∃ M, ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → abs (u x) ≤ M := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, -, -, h₁⟩ := extreme_value hab hu
  obtain ⟨c₂, -, -, h₂⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => 0 - u x) hab
    fun x h1 h2 => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) (hu x h1 h2)
  refine ⟨abs (u c₁) + abs (0 - u c₂), fun x h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ x h1 h2; have k2 := h₂ x h1 h2
  have := le_abs (u c₁); have := le_abs (0 - u c₂)
  have := abs_nonneg (u c₁); have := abs_nonneg (0 - u c₂)
  exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.Extends:
/-- `W ≤ V`: `V` **extends** `W` as an end-extension — `W` is an initial segment of `V`.

is inserted below old points). -/

/-- Riemann sums over a concatenation add. -/
theorem rsum_append (f : R → R) {a b : R} {l₁ : List (R × R)} (l₂ : List (R × R))
    (h₁ : IsTagged a l₁ b) : rsum f a (l₁ ++ l₂) = rsum f a l₁ + rsum f b l₂ := by
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil => have : a = b := h₁; subst this; show rsum f a l₂ = 0 + rsum f a l₂; grind
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    show f t * (x - a) + rsum f x (l ++ l₂) = f t * (x - a) + rsum f x l + rsum f b l₂
    rw [ih h₁.2.2]; grind

quotient set. -/

  left_inv x := M.toSet_injective (Classical.choose_spec (M.toSet_surj (M.toSet_mem x)))

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.B_eq:
/-- From the Basel computation: `Bₙ = Aₙ ((π/2)²/3 − Hₙ/2)`. -/
theorem B_eq (n : Nat) : B n = A n * (hpi * hpi / 3 - H n / 2) := by
  have h := partial_sum n
  rw [B_zero, A_zero] at h
  have hp := hpi_pos
  have ha := A_pos n
  have e : hpi * hpi * hpi / 3 / hpi = hpi * hpi / 3 := by grind
  rw [e] at h
  unfold H
  rw [h]
  have : B n / A n * A n = B n := by grind
  grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasSum_geometric:
/-- **Geometric series.** For `|r| < 1`, `Σ rⁿ = 1 / (1 − r)`. -/
theorem hasSum_geometric {r : R} (hr : abs r < 1) : HasSum (fun n => r ^ n) (1 / (1 - r)) := by
  have hr' := abs_lt.1 hr
  have hne : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by grind
  have hsum : ∀ n : Nat, fsum (fun k => r ^ k) n = (1 - r ^ n) * (1 / (1 - r)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => show (0 : R) = (1 - 1) * (1 / (1 - r)); grind
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [fsum_succ, ih, pow_succ']
      have e : (1 - r) * (1 / (1 - r)) = 1 := by grind
      grind
  have hz : Tendsto (fun n => abs (r ^ n)) 0 := by
    have := tendsto_pow_zero (abs_nonneg r) hr
    exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => (abs_pow r n).symm
  have hz' : Tendsto (fun n => r ^ n) 0 := tendsto_of_abs_le hz fun n => by
    rw [show r ^ n - 0 = r ^ n by grind]; exact Std.le_refl _
  have := (Tendsto.sub (tendsto_const 1) hz').const_mul (1 / (1 - r))
  rw [show 1 / (1 - r) * (1 - 0) = 1 / (1 - r) by grind] at this
  refine this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => ?_
  show 1 / (1 - r) * (1 - r ^ n) = fsum (fun k => r ^ k) n
  rw [hsum]; grind

theorem sameCut_neg (hF : Archimedean F) (hG : Archimedean G) {a : F} {b : G}
    (h : SameCut a b) : SameCut (-a) (-b) := fun q => by
  have := sameCut_upper hF hG h (-q)

Foundations.Algebra.involution_fixed_mod:
/-- **Parity principle.** An involution `f` of a finite set `α` has as many fixed points as
`α` has elements, modulo `2`. -/
theorem involution_fixed_mod_two {α : Type u} [FiniteType α] (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) :
    count (fun x => f x = x) % 2 = card α % 2 := by
  letI := involutionAction f hf
  have h := MulAction.count_fixed_mod (G := ZMod 2) (X := α) isPrime_two (k := 1)
    (by rw [ZMod.card])
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  apply count_congr
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx k
    show (if (ZMod.val k).val = 0 then x else f x) = x
    split
    · rfl
    · exact hx
  · intro hx
    have := hx (ZMod.of ⟨1, by decide⟩)
    exact this

  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)

  | n + 1, k + 1, h => coeff_geom_list n k (by omega)

/-- **Strict monotonicity test.** A function with positive derivative on `[a, b]` is strictly
increasing there. -/
theorem strictMono_of_deriv_pos {f f' : R → R} {a b : R}
    (hd : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hpos : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → 0 < f' x)
    {x y : R} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) (hyb : y ≤ b) : f x < f y := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := mean_value hxy
    (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t (by grind) (by grind)).continuousAt)
    (fun t h1 h2 => hd t (by grind) (by grind))
  have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (hpos c (by grind) (by grind)) (by grind : (0 : R) < y - x)
  grind

    coeff (p * q) n = rsum (fun k => coeff p k * coeff q (n - k)) (n + 1) := by

Foundations.Logic.Sequent.search_complet:
/-- **Completeness of proof search.** If `Γ ++ L ⊢ Δ ++ R` is valid (with `L, R`
fully processed) and the fuel exceeds the weight of `Γ, Δ`, the search succeeds. -/
theorem search_complete : ∀ (n : Nat) (Γ Δ L R : List Formula),
    weight Γ + weight Δ < n → (∀ A ∈ L, leftPremises A = none) →
    (∀ A ∈ R, rightPremises A = none) → Valid (Γ ++ L) (Δ ++ R) →
    search n Γ Δ L R = true
  | 0, _, _, _, _, hw, _, _, _ => by omega
  | n + 1, A :: Γ, Δ, L, R, hw, hL, hR, hv => by
      rw [weight_cons] at hw
      cases hA : leftPremises A with
      | some ps =>
          simp only [search, hA, List.all_eq_true]
          intro p hp
          have := weight_left hA hp
          refine search_complete n _ _ L R ?_ hL hR ?_
          · rw [weight_append, weight_append]; omega
          · intro v hv'
            by_cases hq : ∃ B ∈ p.2, B.eval v = true
            · obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hq
              exact ⟨B, by simp [hB], hBv⟩
            · have hAv : A.eval v = true := (left_sem hA v).2
                ⟨p, hp, fun B hB => hv' B (by simp [hB]), fun B hB => by
                  simpa using fun h => hq ⟨B, hB, h⟩⟩
              obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hv v (by
                intro C hC
                simp only [List.cons_append, List.mem_cons] at hC
                rcases hC with rfl | hC
                · exact hAv
                · exact hv' C (by simp at hC ⊢; grind))
              exact ⟨B, by simp at hB ⊢; grind, hBv⟩
      | none =>
          simp only [search, hA]
          refine search_complete n Γ Δ (A :: L) R (by omega) ?_ hR ?_
          · intro B hB
            rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
            · exact hA
            · exact hL B hB
          · intro v hv'
            exact hv v (fun C hC => hv' C (by simp at hC ⊢; grind))
  | n + 1, [], A :: Δ, L, R, hw, hL, hR, hv => by
      rw [weight_cons] at hw
      simp only [weight, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil] at hw
      cases hA : rightPremises A with
      | some ps =>
          simp only [search, hA, List.all_eq_true]
          intro p hp
          have := weight_right hA hp
          refine search_complete n _ _ L R ?_ hL hR ?_
          · rw [weight_append]; simp only [weight] at this ⊢; omega
          · intro v hv'
            by_cases hq : ∃ B ∈ p.2, B.eval v = true
            · obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hq
              exact ⟨B, by simp [hB], hBv⟩
            · have hAv : A.eval v = false := (right_sem hA v).2
                ⟨p, hp, fun B hB => hv' B (by simp [hB]), fun B hB => by
                  simpa using fun h => hq ⟨B, hB, h⟩⟩
              obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hv v (fun C hC => hv' C (by simp at hC ⊢; grind))
              simp only [List.cons_append, List.mem_cons] at hB
              rcases hB with rfl | hB
              · simp [hAv] at hBv
              · exact ⟨B, by simp at hB ⊢; grind, hBv⟩
      | none =>
          simp only [search, hA]
          refine search_complete n [] Δ L (A :: R) (by simp only [weight, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil] at *; omega) hL ?_ ?_
          · intro B hB
            rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
            · exact hA
            · exact hR B hB
          · intro v hv'
            obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hv v hv'
            exact ⟨B, by simp at hB ⊢; grind, hBv⟩
  | n + 1, [], [], L, R, _, hL, hR, hv => by
      simp only [search, List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      -- the countervaluation: make exactly the atoms of `L` true
      let v : Valuation := fun k => decide (var k ∈ L)
      obtain ⟨B, hB, hBv⟩ := hv v (by
        intro C hC
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := eq_var_of_left_none (hL C (by simpa using hC))
        simpa [v, eval] using hC)
      have hB' : B ∈ R := by simpa using hB
      rcases eq_of_right_none (hR B hB') with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp [eval] at hBv
      · exact ⟨var k, by simpa [v, eval] using hBv, hB'⟩

/-- `monusCode` computes truncated subtraction `b - a`. -/
theorem eval_monus (b : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : ∀ a, Eval monusCode (a :: b :: xs) (b - a)
  | 0 => by
      have := Eval.prec_zero (f := .proj 0)
        (g := .comp predCode (vec1 (.proj 1))) (xs := b :: xs) (n := b) .proj
      simpa using this
  | a + 1 => by
      have := Eval.prec_succ (eval_monus b xs a)
        (eval_comp1 (g := .proj 1) (xs := a :: (b - a) :: b :: xs) .proj (eval_pred [] (b - a)))
      rw [show b - (a + 1) = b - a - 1 by omega]
      simpa using this

/-- **Chebyshev's inequality.** For `ε > 0`, `P(|X − E X| ≥ ε) ≤ Var X / ε²`. -/
theorem chebyshev (X : α → R) {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    P.prob (fun x => ε ≤ OF.abs (X x - P.E X)) ≤ P.Var X / (ε * ε) := by
  have hm := P.markov (X := fun x => (X x - P.E X) * (X x - P.E X)) (fun x _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
    (a := ε * ε) (by have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hε hε; grind)
  refine Std.le_trans (P.prob_mono fun x hx => ?_) hm
  exact sq_le_sq_of_le_abs (Std.le_of_lt hε) hx

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.continu:
/-- **Differentiable functions are continuous.** -/
theorem HasDerivAt.continuousAt {f : R → R} {d x : R} (h : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    ContinuousAt f x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := h.lipschitz
  have hd := abs_nonneg d
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < abs d + 1))
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ y (by grind)
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show abs (y - x) < δ from hy)
    (by grind : 0 < abs d + 1)
  have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ2 (by grind : 0 ≤ abs d + 1)
  have e : (abs d + 1) * (ε / (abs d + 1)) = ε := by grind
  grind

Foundations.Bridges.nat_bridges_coherent:
/-- **Coherence of the natural-number bridges.** The triangle `N → ω → Nat`
commutes with Part II's direct translation `N → Nat`, in both directions: going
from the Peano numbers to the von Neumann numbers and on to Lean's numbers is the
same function as Part II's `toNat`, and the inverse composite is `ofNat`. -/
theorem nat_bridges_coherent :
    (peanoOmega.trans omegaNat).toFun = peanoNat.toFun ∧
    (peanoOmega.trans omegaNat).invFun = peanoNat.invFun := by
  constructor
  · funext n
    show Omega.toNat (peanoToOmega n) = N.toNat n
    rw [peanoToOmega_eq, Omega.toNat_toOmega]
  · funext n
    show N.ofNat (Omega.toNat (toOmega n)) = N.ofNat n
    rw [Omega.toNat_toOmega]

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.ldr:
/-- Iterated tail is computable. -/
theorem ldrop {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => Computability.ldrop (f n) (g n) := by
  have := Comp.natRec hf (Comp.ltail (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id))) hg
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  generalize g n = k
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [Computability.natRec, snd_pair, ih, Computability.ldrop]
Foundations.Topology.CFun.bounded:
/-- Two continuous functions on `[a, b]` differ by a bounded amount. -/
theorem bounded (f g : CFun a b) : ∃ M, ∀ x, abs (f.1 x - g.1 x) ≤ M := by
  have hab := LeFact.le (a := a) (b := b)
  have hc : ∀ x, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => f.1 x - g.1 x) x := fun x =>
    continuousAt_sub (f.2.2 x) (g.2.2 x)
  obtain ⟨c₁, -, -, h₁⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => f.1 x - g.1 x) hab fun x _ _ => hc x
  obtain ⟨c₂, -, -, h₂⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => 0 - (f.1 x - g.1 x)) hab
    fun x _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) (hc x)
  refine ⟨abs (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁) + abs (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂)), fun x => ?_⟩
  have m := clamp_mem hab x
  have k1 := h₁ _ m.1 m.2
  have k2 := h₂ _ m.1 m.2
  rw [f.2.1, g.2.1] at k1 k2
  have := le_abs (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁); have := le_abs (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂))
  have := abs_nonneg (f.1 c₁ - g.1 c₁); have := abs_nonneg (0 - (f.1 c₂ - g.1 c₂))
  exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.size_subst:
/-- Substitution does not change the size of a formula. -/
theorem size_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (σ : Nat → Term L), (φ.subst σ).size = φ.size
  | bot, _ => rfl
  | eq _ _, _ => rfl
  | rel _ _, _ => rfl
  | imp φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ, size_subst ψ]
  | all φ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ]
  | ex φ, σ => by simp [subst, size, size_subst φ]
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.sem_subst:
/-- **The substitution lemma: substitution is composition**,
`⟦t[σ]⟧ = ⟦σ⟧ ≫ ⟦t⟧`. -/
theorem sem_subst {Γ Δ : List FTy} {A : FTy} (t : Tm Γ A) (σ : Sub Γ Δ) :
    semTm ι (subst σ t) = semSub ι σ ≫ semTm ι t := by
  induction t generalizing Δ with
  | var v => exact semVar_sub ι σ v
  | lam t ih =>
    show curry _ = _ ≫ curry _
    rw [ih σ.lift, semSub_lift_aux ι σ _ rfl (fun v => sem_weaken ι (σ v)), curry_natural]
  | app t u iht ihu =>
    show pair _ _ ≫ eval = _ ≫ pair _ _ ≫ eval
    rw [iht σ, ihu σ, ← assoc, comp_pair]
  | pair a b iha ihb =>
    show pair _ _ = _ ≫ pair _ _
    rw [iha σ, ihb σ, comp_pair]
  | fst t ih =>
    show _ ≫ fst = _ ≫ _ ≫ fst
    rw [ih σ, assoc]
  | snd t ih =>
    show _ ≫ snd = _ ≫ _ ≫ snd
    rw [ih σ, assoc]
Foundations.Logic.Sequent.LK:
/-- **The sequent calculus LK.** `LK Γ Δ` holds when `Γ ⊢ Δ` is derivable with the
identity axiom, the logical rules, the structural rule (weakening, which also
absorbs exchange and contraction since sequents are compared by `⊆`), and **cut**. -/
inductive LK : List Formula → List Formula → Prop where
  /-- Identity: `Γ ⊢ Δ` whenever some formula occurs on both sides. -/
  | ax {Γ Δ : List Formula} {A : Formula} : A ∈ Γ → A ∈ Δ → LK Γ Δ
  /-- The left rule for a formula `A` occurring in the antecedent. -/
  | left {Γ Δ : List Formula} {A : Formula} {ps : List (List Formula × List Formula)} :
      A ∈ Γ → leftPremises A = some ps → (∀ p ∈ ps, LK (p.1 ++ Γ) (p.2 ++ Δ)) → LK Γ Δ
  /-- The right rule for a formula `A` occurring in the succedent. -/
  | right {Γ Δ : List Formula} {A : Formula} {ps : List (List Formula × List Formula)} :
      A ∈ Δ → rightPremises A = some ps → (∀ p ∈ ps, LK (p.1 ++ Γ) (p.2 ++ Δ)) → LK Γ Δ
  /-- Structural rule: weakening (and, implicitly, exchange and contraction). -/
  | weak {Γ Δ Γ' Δ' : List Formula} : LK Γ Δ → Γ ⊆ Γ' → Δ ⊆ Δ' → LK Γ' Δ'
  /-- **Cut**: from `Γ ⊢ A, Δ` and `A, Γ ⊢ Δ` infer `Γ ⊢ Δ`. -/
  | cut {Γ Δ : List Formula} (A : Formula) : LK Γ (A :: Δ) → LK (A :: Γ) Δ → LK Γ Δ
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.exists_:
/-- Approximating a square from below by squares of rationals: if `0 < z` and `0 ≤ q < z²`
then some rational `r` with `0 ≤ r < z` has `q < r²`. -/
theorem exists_rat_sq_between {K : Type} [Field K] [LE K] [LT K] [Std.IsLinearOrder K]
    [Std.LawfulOrderLT K] [OrderedRing K] (hA : Archimedean K) {z : K} (hz : 0 < z) {q : Q}
    (_hq0 : (0 : K) ≤ ofRat q) (hq : ofRat q < z * z) :
    ∃ r : Q, (0 : K) < ofRat r ∧ ofRat r < z ∧ ofRat (K := K) q < ofRat r * ofRat r := by
  let δ := z * z - ofRat q
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by grind
  have h2z : 0 < 2 * z := by grind
  have hε : 0 < δ / (2 * z) := div_pos hδ h2z
  let t := z - δ / (2 * z)
  have hr : ∃ r : Q, t < ofRat r ∧ 0 < ofRat (K := K) r ∧ ofRat r < z := by
    by_cases ht : t ≤ z / 2
    · obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_between hA (by grind : z / 2 < z)
      exact ⟨r, by grind, by grind, h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_between hA (by grind : t < z)
      exact ⟨r, h1, by grind, h2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := hr
  refine ⟨r, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have k1 : (z - ofRat r) * (z + ofRat r) < (z - ofRat r) * (2 * z) :=
    OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind) (by grind)
  have k2 : (z - ofRat r) * (2 * z) < (δ / (2 * z)) * (2 * z) :=
    OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by grind) h2z
  have k3 : (δ / (2 * z)) * (2 * z) = δ := by grind
  grind

/-- `C(2n, n) ≤ (2n)^π(2n)`: every prime power in `C(2n, n)` is at most `2n`. -/
theorem centralBinom_le_pow_primeCount {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    centralBinom n ≤ (2 * n) ^ primeCount (2 * n) := by
  unfold primeCount
  rw [← bprod_const]
  apply le_bprod_of_pow_dvd _ _ (centralBinom_pos n)
  · intro i; split <;> omega
  · intro p e hp hpe
    simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos e with he | he
    · subst he; simp; omega
    · exact pow_dvd_centralBinom_le hp he hpe
  · intro p hp hpC
    have := prime_dvd_centralBinom_le hp hpC; omega

Foundations.Topology.Leibniz.leibniz:
/-- **The Leibniz series** (Mādhava, Gregory, Leibniz).
`1 − 1/3 + 1/5 − 1/7 + ⋯ = π/4`. -/
theorem leibniz : HasSum (fun k => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1)) (pi / 4) := by
  have hab : (0 : R) ≤ 1 := by grind
  -- `|S_N − π/4| ≤ 1/(2N+1)`.
  have hb : ∀ N : Nat, abs (S N - qpi) ≤ 1 / (2 * (N : R) + 1) := fun N => by
    have hfI := hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_f x
    have hpI := hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_p N x
    have hD := hfI.add (hpI.const_mul (-1))
    have hwI := hasIntegral_integral hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_pow (2 * N) x
    rw [integral_pow (2 * N) hab, one_pow, show (0 : R) ^ (2 * N + 1) = 0 by rw [pow_succ']; grind,
      show ((2 * N : Nat) : R) = 2 * (N : R) by grind] at hwI
    -- `|f − p_N| = t^{2N} f ≤ t^{2N}`.
    have hpt : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → abs (f t + -1 * p N t) ≤ t ^ (2 * N) := fun t h0 _ => by
      have h1 := p_mul N t
      have h2 := f_mul t
      have hfb := f_bounds t
      have e : f t + -1 * p N t = (-1 : R) ^ N * t ^ (2 * N) * f t := by
        have : p N t = p N t * ((1 + t * t) * f t) := by grind
        rw [this]
        generalize (1 + t * t) * f t = one at *
        grind
      rw [e, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, show abs (-1 : R) = 1 by
          rw [R.abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)], one_pow,
        abs_of_nonneg (pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg h0 _), abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hfb.1)]
      have := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg h0 (2 * N)
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfb.2 this
      grind
    have up := HasIntegral.mono hab hD hwI fun t h0 h1 => (abs_le.1 (hpt t h0 h1)).2
    have lo := HasIntegral.mono hab (hwI.const_mul (-1)) hD fun t h0 h1 => by
      have := (abs_le.1 (hpt t h0 h1)).1; show -1 * t ^ (2 * N) ≤ _; grind
    rw [integral_f, integral_p] at up lo
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := eps_small hε
  refine ⟨M, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  have k := hM N hN
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have k2 := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : (0 : R) < (N : R) + 1)
    (by grind : (N : R) + 1 ≤ 2 * (N : R) + 1)
  have := hb N
  show abs (S N - pi / 4) < ε
  rw [show pi / 4 = qpi by unfold qpi hpi; grind]
  grind

/-- Strictly increasing index sequences preserve `<`. -/
theorem strictMono_lt {φ : Nat → Nat} (hφ : ∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) {a b : Nat} (h : a < b) :
    φ a < φ b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => omega
  | succ b ih =>
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · rw [hab]; exact hφ b
    · have := ih (by omega); have := hφ b; omega

    ∀ n : Nat, σ.toFun (ncast n) = ncast n

Foundations.Numbers.R.sin_add_int_mul_pi:
/-- Shifting by an integer multiple of `π` preserves the zeros of sine. -/
theorem sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero (x : R) (k : Int) : sin (x + (k : R) * pi) = 0 ↔ sin x = 0 := by
  have hnat : ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x : R, sin (x + (n : R) * pi) = 0 ↔ sin x = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro x; rw [show x + ((0 : Nat) : R) * pi = x by grind]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      rw [show x + ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi = x + (n : R) * pi + pi by grind, sin_add_pi, ← ih x]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> grind
  cases k with
  | ofNat n =>
    have : ((Int.ofNat n : Int) : R) = (n : R) := Ring.intCast_natCast n
    rw [this]; exact hnat n x
  | negSucc n =>
    have e : ((Int.negSucc n : Int) : R) = -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) := by
      rw [Int.negSucc_eq, Ring.intCast_neg]
      have : (((n : Int) + 1 : Int) : R) = (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int) : R) := rfl
      rw [this, Ring.intCast_natCast]
    rw [e]
    have := hnat (n + 1) (x + -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi)
    rw [show x + -((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi + ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * pi = x by grind] at this
    exact this.symm

/-- If `c` does not halt on `x`, then `rho a c x` halts on no unary input. -/
theorem rho_of_not_halts {a c : Code} {x : Nat} (hc : ¬ Halts c [x]) (y n : Nat) :
    ¬ Eval (rho a c x) [y] n := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨v₀, v₁, h₀, -, -⟩ := eval_comp2_inv h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hcu⟩ := eval_comp1_inv h₀
  have : u = x := Eval.det hu (eval_const _ x)
  subst this
  exact hc ⟨v₀, hcu⟩
Foundations.Algebra.factorization_unique:
/-- **Uniqueness of factorisation.** In an integral domain in which every irreducible element
is prime — for instance any principal ideal domain — two factorisations into irreducibles of
associated elements agree up to order and units: if `∏ L = u · ∏ M` with `u` a unit, then for
every `x`, `L` and `M` contain equally many factors associated to `x`. -/
theorem factorization_unique (hD : IsDomain R) (hprime : ∀ p : R, Irreducible p → IsPrimeElt p) :
    ∀ (L M : List R) (u : R), (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) → (∀ q, q ∈ M → Irreducible q) →
      IsUnit u → lprod L = u * lprod M → ∀ x, countAssoc x L = countAssoc x M := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro M u _ hM hu h x
    cases M with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons q M =>
      exfalso
      apply (hM q List.mem_cons_self).2.1
      apply IsUnit.of_dvd ⟨1, Ring.mul_one 1⟩
      exact ⟨u * lprod M, by
        show (1 : R) = q * (u * lprod M)
        rw [show (1 : R) = lprod [] from rfl, h]
        show u * (q * lprod M) = _
        ac_rfl⟩
  | cons p L ih =>
    intro M u hL hM hu h x
    have hp := hprime p (hL p List.mem_cons_self)
    -- `p` divides `∏ M`, hence some `q ∈ M`, to which it is associated.
    have hdvd : Divides p (lprod M) := by
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
      exact ⟨v * lprod L, by
        calc lprod M = (u * v) * lprod M := by rw [hv, Ring.one_mul]
          _ = v * (u * lprod M) := by ac_rfl
          _ = v * (p * lprod L) := by rw [← h]; rfl
          _ = p * (v * lprod L) := by ac_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqM, hpq⟩ := hp.dvd_lprod M hdvd
    have hassoc := (hM q hqM).associated_of_dvd hp.2.1 hpq
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩ := hassoc
    obtain ⟨M₁, M₂, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hqM
    have hperm : (M₁ ++ q :: M₂).Perm (q :: (M₁ ++ M₂)) := List.perm_middle
    -- Cancel `p`.
    have h' : lprod L = (u * c) * lprod (M₁ ++ M₂) := by
      apply hD.mul_left_cancel hp.1
      calc p * lprod L = lprod (p :: L) := rfl
        _ = u * lprod (q :: (M₁ ++ M₂)) := by rw [h, lprod_perm hperm]
        _ = p * (u * c * lprod (M₁ ++ M₂)) := by
            show u * (q * _) = _; rw [hcq]; ac_rfl
    have hM' : ∀ r, r ∈ M₁ ++ M₂ → Irreducible r := by
      intro r hr
      apply hM r
      rw [List.mem_append] at hr ⊢
      rcases hr with hr | hr
      · exact Or.inl hr
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem q hr)
    have ihx := ih (M₁ ++ M₂) (u * c) (fun r hr => hL r (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hr)) hM'
      (hu.mul hc) h' x
    rw [countAssoc_perm x hperm, countAssoc_cons, countAssoc_cons, ihx]
    congr 1
    classical
    have : Associated x p ↔ Associated x q :=
      ⟨fun h1 => h1.trans ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩, fun h1 => h1.trans (Associated.symm ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩)⟩
    simp only [this]

Foundations.Algebra.dvd_count_of_saturat:
/-- **The tiling argument.** If a set `P` is a union of left cosets of `H` (i.e. closed under
right multiplication by elements of `H`), then `|H|` divides `|P|`. We peel off one coset
at a time: removing a coset from such a set leaves such a set, with `|H|` fewer elements. -/
theorem dvd_count_of_saturated (H : Subgroup G) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (P : G → Prop), count P = n →
      (∀ a h, P a → h ∈ H → P (a * h)) → count (· ∈ H) ∣ n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro P hn hsat
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · rw [h0]; exact Nat.dvd_zero _
    · have hpos : 0 < count P := by omega
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := count_pos.1 hpos
      -- The coset `gH` lies inside `P`.
      have hsub : ∀ x, leftCoset g H x → P x := by
        intro x hx
        have := hsat g _ hg hx
        rwa [mul_inv_cancel_left] at this
      -- Split `P` into the coset `gH` and the rest.
      have hsplit := count_split P (leftCoset g H)
      have hC : count (fun x => P x ∧ leftCoset g H x) = count (· ∈ H) := by
        rw [← count_leftCoset g H]
        exact count_congr fun x => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hsub x h, h⟩⟩
      have hHpos : 0 < count (· ∈ H) := count_pos.2 ⟨1, H.one_mem⟩
      -- The rest is again a union of cosets.
      have hsat' : ∀ a h, (P a ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H a) → h ∈ H →
          (P (a * h) ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H (a * h)) := by
        intro a h ⟨hPa, hna⟩ hh
        refine ⟨hsat a h hPa hh, fun hc => hna ?_⟩
        show g⁻¹ * a ∈ H
        have : g⁻¹ * a = (g⁻¹ * (a * h)) * h⁻¹ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_right]
        rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem hc (H.inv_mem hh)
      have hrest := ih (count fun x => P x ∧ ¬ leftCoset g H x) (by omega) _ rfl hsat'
      rw [← hn, hsplit, hC]
      exact Nat.dvd_add (Nat.dvd_refl _) hrest
Foundations.Topology.IsPolyFn:
/-- The **polynomial functions** `ℝ → ℝ`: generated from the constants and `x ↦ x` by sums and
products. -/
inductive IsPolyFn : (R → R) → Prop
  /-- Constants are polynomials. -/
  | const (c : R) : IsPolyFn (fun _ => c)
  /-- The identity is a polynomial. -/
  | id : IsPolyFn (fun x => x)
  /-- Sums of polynomials are polynomials. -/
  | add {p q : R → R} : IsPolyFn p → IsPolyFn q → IsPolyFn (fun x => p x + q x)
  /-- Products of polynomials are polynomials. -/
  | mul {p q : R → R} : IsPolyFn p → IsPolyFn q → IsPolyFn (fun x => p x * q x)

Foundations.Numbers.R.archimedean:
/-- **Archimedean property of ℝ.** Every real number is smaller than some natural number. -/
theorem archimedean (x : R) : ∃ n : Nat, x < (n : R) := by
  induction x using ind with | h a => ?_
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hB'⟩ := a.bounded
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Q.archimedean B
  refine ⟨n, n - B, by grind, 0, fun k _ => ?_⟩
  have := (abs_lt.1 (hB' k))
  show (n : Q) - B ≤ (n : Q) + -a k
  grind

Foundations.Types.STLC.subst:
/-- Simultaneous substitution. -/
def subst (σ : Nat → Term) : Term → Term
  | var n => σ n
  | app t u => app (subst σ t) (subst σ u)
  | lam t => lam (subst (up σ) t)
  | pair a b => pair (subst σ a) (subst σ b)
  | fst t => fst (subst σ t)
  | snd t => snd (subst σ t)
  | inl t => inl (subst σ t)
  | inr t => inr (subst σ t)
  | case t u₁ u₂ => case (subst σ t) (subst (up σ) u₁) (subst (up σ) u₂)
  | .absurd t => .absurd (subst σ t)

/-- The lists of formulas are cumulative. -/
theorem formsUpTo_succ {φ : Formula L} : ∀ {k}, φ ∈ formsUpTo L k → φ ∈ formsUpTo L (k + 1)
  | 0, h => by simp [formsUpTo] at h
  | k + 1, h => by

/-- The counit, packaged as a natural isomorphism `G ⋙ F ≅ 𝟭`. -/
def counitIso (e : Equivalence C D) : NatIso (e.inverse.comp e.functor) (Functor.id D) where
  hom := ⟨fun Y => (e.counit Y).hom, fun g => e.counit_nat g⟩
  inv := ⟨fun Y => (e.counit Y).inv, fun {Y Y'} g => by
    show g ≫ (e.counit Y').inv = (e.counit Y).inv ≫ e.functor.map (e.inverse.map g)
    rw [← Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc (e.counit Y) (g ≫ _), ← assoc (e.counit Y).hom,
      ← e.counit_nat g, assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, comp_id]⟩
  hom_inv_id Y := (e.counit Y).hom_inv_id
  inv_hom_id Y := (e.counit Y).inv_hom_id

/-- **Glivenko, as an equivalence.** A formula is classically provable (from no
hypotheses) if and only if its double negation is intuitionistically provable. -/
theorem classical_iff_nn_intuitionistic (φ : Logic.Formula) :
    Logic.Derives Logic.Theory.empty φ ↔ ND [] (nn (toIntuitionistic φ)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact glivenko (Γ := []) (h.weaken (Logic.Theory.empty_subset _))
  · intro h
    have := intuitionistic_to_classical h
    simp only [List.map_nil, toClassical, toClassical_toIntuitionistic] at this

Foundations.NumberTheory.exists_prime_mo:
/-- **Infinitely many primes ≡ 1 (mod 4).** For every `N` there is a prime `p ≥ N` with
`p ≡ 1 (mod 4)`. Proof: any prime factor `q` of `(2·N!)² + 1` is odd and larger than `N`, and
`−1` is a square modulo `q`; by the first supplement to quadratic reciprocity
(`neg_one_qr_iff`, Part IV), `q ≡ 1 (mod 4)`. -/
theorem exists_prime_mod_four_eq_one (N : Nat) : ∃ p, N ≤ p ∧ Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 1 := by
  have hf := fact_pos N
  let x := 2 * fact N
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqM⟩ := exists_prime_dvd (n := x * x + 1) (by
    have : 1 ≤ x * x := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    omega)
  have hq2 := hq.1
  -- `q` is odd, since `x² + 1` is odd.
  have hqodd : q % 2 = 1 := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hev
    have h2q : 2 ∣ q := by omega
    have h2M := Nat.dvd_trans h2q hqM
    have : 2 ∣ x * x := Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_mul_right 2 (fact N)) x
    have := eq_one_of_dvd_succ this h2M
    omega
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hq, ?_⟩
  · apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hlt
    have h1 : q ∣ x * x := Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd
      (Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd (dvd_fact (by omega) (by omega)) 2) x
    have := eq_one_of_dvd_succ h1 hqM
    omega
  · exact (Foundations.Algebra.neg_one_qr_iff (p := q) hq hqodd).1 (neg_one_isQR_of_dvd hq2 hqM)
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_exp_eq:
/-- **`exp` takes every positive value.** -/
theorem exists_exp_eq {y : R} (hy : 0 < y) : ∃ x, exp x = y := by
  have hc : ∀ x, ContinuousAt exp x := fun x => (hasDerivAt_exp x).continuousAt
  -- First for `y ≥ 1`, by the intermediate value theorem on `[0, y]`.
  have big : ∀ y : R, 1 ≤ y → ∃ x, exp x = y := fun y hy1 => by
    obtain ⟨x, -, -, hx⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := exp) (a := 0) (b := y) (v := y)
      (by grind) (fun x _ _ => hc x) (by rw [exp_zero]; exact hy1)
      (by have := one_add_le_exp (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ y); grind)
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases (by grind : 1 ≤ y ∨ y < 1) with h | h
  · exact big y h
  · -- For `0 < y < 1` use `exp (−x) = 1 / exp x`.
    have hinv : 1 ≤ 1 / y := by
      have := one_div_le_one_div hy (Std.le_of_lt h); grind
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := big (1 / y) hinv
    refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
    have := exp_mul_exp_neg x
    rw [hx] at this
    grind

  cases n with
  | zero => exact numeral_fresh _ _
  | succ m =>

      subst hm
      refine Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn' => ?_
      cases n with

Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.PWO:
/-- A **partial well-ordering** of `α`: a strict order `lt` on a part `dom` of `α`
that is total there and in which every non-empty part of `dom` has a minimal
element. -/
structure PWO (α : Type u) where
  /-- The part of `α` that is ordered. -/
  dom : α → Prop
  /-- The strict order. -/
  lt : α → α → Prop
  /-- The order only relates elements of the domain. -/
  lt_dom : ∀ x y, lt x y → dom x ∧ dom y
  /-- Irreflexivity. -/
  irrefl : ∀ x, ¬ lt x x
  /-- Transitivity. -/
  trans : ∀ x y z, lt x y → lt y z → lt x z
  /-- Totality on the domain. -/
  total : ∀ x y, dom x → dom y → lt x y ∨ x = y ∨ lt y x
  /-- Well-foundedness: every non-empty part of the domain has a minimal element. -/
  wf : ∀ S : α → Prop, (∃ x, S x ∧ dom x) → ∃ m, S m ∧ dom m ∧ ∀ y, S y → dom y → ¬ lt y m

/-- **Division of `x⁵ - 6x + 3` by `x - r`**: `f = (x - r) Q + f(r)`. -/
theorem quinticPoly_factor (r : A) :
    quinticPoly A = linC r * quinticQuot r + Polynomial.C (eval r (quinticPoly A)) := by
  apply ext; intro n
  rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_sum, eval_quinticPoly, coeff_quinticPoly, coeff_C]
  unfold linC quinticQuot
  match n with
  | 0 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | 1 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | 2 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | 3 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | 4 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | 5 => simp only [rsum, coeff_mk, Nat.sub_self, PolyList.coeff, quinticCoeffs]; grind
  | n + 6 =>
    rw [rsum_zero, ite_false_of (by omega)]
    · show (Int.cast (0 : Int) : A) = 0 + 0; rw [icast_zero', Ring.add_zero]
    · intro k hk
      rw [coeff_mk, coeff_mk]
      by_cases h2 : 2 ≤ k
      · rw [PolyList.coeff_of_length_le _ k (by simp; omega), Ring.zero_mul]
      · rw [PolyList.coeff_of_length_le _ (n + 6 - k) (by simp; omega), Ring.mul_zero]
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.eventually_:
/-- Every formula has only finitely many free variables: all large `x` are fresh. -/
theorem eventually_fresh : ∀ φ : Formula L, ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → φ.Fresh x
  | bot => ⟨0, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  | eq t s => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := t.eventually_fresh
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := s.eventually_fresh
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂, fun x hx => ⟨h₁ x (by omega), h₂ x (by omega)⟩⟩
  | rel _ ts => fin_eventually (fun i x => (ts i).Fresh x) (fun i => (ts i).eventually_fresh)
  | imp φ ψ | conj φ ψ | disj φ ψ => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := eventually_fresh ψ
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂, fun x hx => ⟨h₁ x (by omega), h₂ x (by omega)⟩⟩
  | all φ | ex φ => by
      obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      exact ⟨k, fun x hx => h (x + 1) (by omega)⟩

Foundations.Logic.Derives.toHilbert:
/-- **From natural deduction to Hilbert.** Every natural-deduction derivation can be
translated into a Hilbert-style derivation. -/
theorem Derives.toHilbert {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) : Γ ⊢ₕ φ := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact .hyp hφ
  | impI _ ih => exact HDerives.deduction ih
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .mp ih₁ ih₂
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .mp (.mp (.ax (.conjI _ _)) ih₁) ih₂
  | conjE₁ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.conjE₁ _ _)) ih
  | conjE₂ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.conjE₂ _ _)) ih
  | disjI₁ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.disjI₁ _ _)) ih
  | disjI₂ _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.disjI₂ _ _)) ih
  | disjE _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      exact .mp (.mp (.mp (.ax (.disjE _ _ _)) (HDerives.deduction ih₂))
        (HDerives.deduction ih₃)) ih₁
  | botE _ ih => exact HDerives.botE ih
  | raa _ ih => exact .mp (.ax (.dne _)) (HDerives.deduction ih)
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.linte:
/-- **Monotonicity of the integral.** If `0 ≤ f ≤ g`, `f` is measurable and `g` integrable, then
`f` is integrable and `∫ f ≤ ∫ g`. -/
theorem lintegral_mono {f g : α → R} (hg : LIntegrable m g) (hf : Measurable S f)
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hfg : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    LIntegrable m f ∧ lintegral m f ≤ lintegral m g := by
  have h : ∀ l, IsSimple S l → Below l f → sint m l ≤ lintegral m g := fun l hl hb =>
    le_lintegral m hg.bdd hl fun p hp x hx => Std.le_trans (hb p hp x hx) (hfg x)
  exact ⟨⟨hf, hf0, _, h⟩, lintegral_le m h⟩

Foundations.Sets.countable_sigma:
/-- **A countable union of countable types is countable.** If the index type `ι`
is countable and every `β i` is countable, then the (disjoint) union
`Σ i, β i` is countable. Uses choice to pick an injection for every `i` at once. -/
theorem countable_sigma {ι : Type _} {β : ι → Type _} (hι : Countable ι)
    (hβ : ∀ i, Countable (β i)) : Countable (Σ i, β i) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hι
  let f : ∀ i, β i → Nat := fun i => Classical.choose (hβ i)
  have hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f i) := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hβ i)
  refine ⟨fun p => cantorPair (e p.1, f p.1 p.2), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  have h' := cantorPair_injective h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h'
  obtain ⟨hij, hbc⟩ := h'
  have hij' : i = j := he hij
  subst hij'
  rw [hf i hbc]

Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.succ_mul':
/-- `(x + 1) · y = x · y + y`. -/
theorem succ_mul' (x y : N.Dom) : (x + 1) * y = x * y + y := by
  refine induction (P := fun y e => (e 0 + 1) * y = e 0 * y + y) (by dfn) (fun _ => x) ?_ ?_ y
  · show (x + 1) * 0 = x * 0 + 0; rw [mul_zero', mul_zero', add_zero']
  · intro y ih; show (x + 1) * (y + 1) = x * (y + 1) + (y + 1)
    rw [mul_succ', mul_succ', ih]
    calc x * y + y + (x + 1) = x * y + (y + x) + 1 := by rw [add_succ', add_assoc' (x * y) y x]
      _ = x * y + (x + y) + 1 := by rw [add_comm' y x]
      _ = x * y + x + (y + 1) := by rw [add_succ' (x * y + x) y, add_assoc' (x * y) x y]

/-- The inverse functor built from a fully faithful, essentially surjective functor:

/-- **ℝ is uncountable** (third proof, via Baire): no sequence `s` lists all real numbers. -/
theorem real_uncountable_baire (s : Nat → R) : ∃ x, ∀ n, x ≠ s n := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
  apply real_not_meagre (F := fun n x => x = s n)
  · intro n
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ⟨abs (x - s n), ?_, fun y hy h' => ?_⟩, fun x ε hε => ?_⟩
    · rcases abs_cases (x - s n) with h | h <;> grind
    · rw [h'] at hy; have : dist x (s n) = abs (x - s n) := rfl; grind
    · by_cases hx : x = s n
      · exact ⟨x + ε / 2, by
          show abs (x - (x + ε / 2)) < ε
          rw [show x - (x + ε / 2) = -(ε / 2) by grind, R.abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]; grind,
          by grind⟩
      · exact ⟨x, by rw [dist_self]; exact hε, hx⟩
  · intro x
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hx
    exact h ⟨x, fun n e => hx ⟨n, e⟩⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.toGroup:
/-- A subgroup is itself a group under the inherited operations. -/
instance toGroup (H : Subgroup G) : Group H where
  mul a b := ⟨a.1 * b.1, H.mul_mem a.2 b.2⟩
  one := ⟨1, H.one_mem⟩
  inv a := ⟨a.1⁻¹, H.inv_mem a.2⟩
  mul_assoc a b c := Subtype.ext (Group.mul_assoc a.1 b.1 c.1)

/-- **Additivity over intervals.** `∫ₐᶜ f = ∫ₐᵇ f + ∫ᵇᶜ f` (when all three integrals exist and
`a ≤ b ≤ c`). -/
theorem HasIntegral.add_interval {f : R → R} {a b c I J K : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) (hJ : HasIntegral f b c J) (hK : HasIntegral f a c K) :
    K = I + J := by
  apply eq_of_abs_lt_all
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hI.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hJ.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h₃⟩ := hK.2 (ε / 3) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₄, hδ₄, h₄1, h₄2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₄ hδ₃
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁, hm₁⟩ := exists_tagged hab hδ
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂, hm₂⟩ := exists_tagged hbc hδ
  have k1 := abs_lt.1 (h₁ l₁ hl₁ (hm₁.mono (by grind)))
  have k2 := abs_lt.1 (h₂ l₂ hl₂ (hm₂.mono (by grind)))
  have k3 := abs_lt.1 (h₃ (l₁ ++ l₂) (hl₁.append hl₂) ((MeshLt.append hl₁ hm₁ hm₂).mono hδ2))
  rw [rsum_append f l₂ hl₁] at k3
  exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.consistent_henkinAd:
/-- Adding an acceptable formula together with its witness preserves consistency. -/
theorem consistent_henkinAdd {A : List (Formula L)} {ψ : Formula L}
    (h : Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A)))) :
    Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (henkinAdd hΓ₀ A ψ ++ A))) := by
  -- `Γ₀ ∪ (ψ :: A)` written as an insertion
  have eqv : (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A))).Subset (insert (union Γ₀ (ofList A)) ψ) := by
    rintro χ (h | h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  have eqv' : (insert (union Γ₀ (ofList A)) ψ).Subset (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A))) := by
    rintro χ (rfl | h | h)
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
  rcases witnesses_cases hΓ₀ A ψ with hw | ⟨φ, rfl, hw⟩
  · intro hb
    refine h (hb.weaken ?_)
    rintro χ (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · simp only [henkinAdd, hw, ofList, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h
      exact Or.inr h
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨hfΓ, hfA⟩ := freshVar_spec hΓ₀ A (ex φ)
    let x := freshVar hΓ₀ A (ex φ)
    refine h (Proves.witness (Δ := union Γ₀ (ofList (ex φ :: A))) (x := x) ?_ ?_
      (Proves.hyp (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..))) (hb.weaken ?_))
    · rintro χ (h | h)
      · exact hfΓ χ h
      · exact hfA χ h
    · exact hfA _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    · rintro χ (h | h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · simp only [henkinAdd, hw, ofList, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons] at h
        rcases h with rfl | rfl | h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))

/-- The defining properties of the dimension of a finite-dimensional space. -/
theorem dim_spec (hF : IsField K) (hfin : FinDim K V) :
    (∃ u : Fin (dim K V) → V, LinIndep K u) ∧ ¬ ∃ u : Fin (dim K V + 1) → V, LinIndep K u := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, w', hw⟩ := hfin
  have h : ∃ n, ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → V, LinIndep K u :=
    ⟨m, fun ⟨u, hu⟩ => by
      have := steinitz hF u w' hu (fun i => hw (u i))
      rw [card_fin, card_fin] at this; omega⟩
  have hd : dim K V = Classical.choose (FiniteType.exists_least _ h) := by
    unfold dim; simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
  have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (FiniteType.exists_least _ h)
  rw [← hd] at hspec
  refine ⟨?_, hspec.1⟩
  rcases hk : dim K V with _ | k
  · exact ⟨fun i => absurd i.isLt (Nat.not_lt_zero _), linIndep_empty _⟩
  · have := hspec.2 k (by omega)
    exact Classical.byContradiction fun hno => this hno

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.subst_congr:
/-- Substitutions agreeing away from a fresh variable act identically on a formula. -/
theorem subst_congr_fresh : ∀ (φ : Formula L) {x : Nat} {σ τ : Nat → Term L},
    (∀ n, n ≠ x → σ n = τ n) → φ.Fresh x → φ.subst σ = φ.subst τ
  | bot, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | eq t s, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, Term.subst_congr_fresh h t hf.1, Term.subst_congr_fresh h s hf.2]
  | rel R ts, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr; funext i; exact Term.subst_congr_fresh h (ts i) (hf i)
  | imp φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | conj φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | disj φ ψ, _, _, _, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst, subst_congr_fresh φ h hf.1, subst_congr_fresh ψ h hf.2]
  | all φ, x, σ, τ, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr 1
      refine subst_congr_fresh φ (x := x + 1) (fun n hn => ?_) hf
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => simp only [Subst.lift]; rw [h n (by omega)]
  | ex φ, x, σ, τ, h, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr 1
      refine subst_congr_fresh φ (x := x + 1) (fun n hn => ?_) hf
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => simp only [Subst.lift]; rw [h n (by omega)]

Foundations.Logic.FO.henkin_lindenbaum:
/-- **Henkin–Lindenbaum lemma.** If the base theory has a fresh supply of variables
and is consistent together with the finite list `A₀`, then it extends (together with
`A₀`) to a maximal consistent Henkin theory. -/
theorem henkin_lindenbaum (hc : Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList A₀))) :
    Γ₀.Subset (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) ∧ (∀ χ ∈ A₀, henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀ χ) ∧
      MaximalHenkin (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) := by
  have cons_stage : ∀ n, Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n))) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hc
    | succ n ih => exact consistent_extendH hΓ₀ _ _ ih
  have hcons : Consistent (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) := by
    intro hb
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := Proves.finite_premises hb (Subset.refl _)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := henkinStage_finite hΓ₀ A₀ l hl
    exact cons_stage n (hd.weaken (union_mono (Subset.refl _) hn))
  -- inclusion of a stage-relative theory in the limit
  have into : ∀ {n : Nat} {A' : List (Formula L)} (ψ : Formula L),
      (∀ χ ∈ A', χ ∈ henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) →
      (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A'))).Subset (insert (henkinLimit hΓ₀ A₀) ψ) := by
    intro n A' ψ hA' χ hχ
    rcases hχ with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n, hA' χ h⟩)
  refine ⟨fun χ h => Or.inl h, fun χ h => Or.inr ⟨0, h⟩, hcons, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ψ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo ψ
    obtain ⟨A', hA', h⟩ := extendH_decides hΓ₀ (formsUpTo L n) (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) ψ hn
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨n + 1, h ψ (List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩)
    · exact Or.inr fun hc' => h fun hb => hc' (hb.weaken (into (n := n + 1) ψ hA'))
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo (ex φ)
    obtain ⟨A', hA', h⟩ :=
      extendH_decides hΓ₀ (formsUpTo L n) (henkinStage hΓ₀ A₀ n) (ex φ) hn
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨.var (freshVar hΓ₀ A' (ex φ)), Or.inr ⟨n + 1, h _ (by simp [henkinAdd, witnesses])⟩⟩
    · refine absurd ?_ h
      intro hb
      refine hcons ((hb.weaken (into (n := n + 1) _ hA')).weaken ?_)
      rintro χ (rfl | h)
      · exact hφ
      · exact h

Foundations.Types.STLC.ND:
/-- **Natural deduction** for intuitionistic propositional logic: `ND Γ A` means
`A` is derivable from the hypotheses `Γ`. -/
inductive ND : List Formula → Formula → Prop
  /-- Use a hypothesis. -/
  | hyp {Γ : List Formula} {n : Nat} {A : Formula} : Γ[n]? = some A → ND Γ A
  /-- `→`-introduction (discharging a hypothesis). -/
  | impI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND (A :: Γ) B → ND Γ (.arr A B)
  /-- `→`-elimination (modus ponens). -/
  | impE {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.arr A B) → ND Γ A → ND Γ B
  /-- `∧`-introduction. -/
  | andI {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ A → ND Γ B → ND Γ (.prod A B)
  /-- `∧`-elimination, left. -/
  | andE₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.prod A B) → ND Γ A
  /-- `∧`-elimination, right. -/
  | andE₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ (.prod A B) → ND Γ B
  /-- `∨`-introduction, left. -/
  | orI₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ A → ND Γ (.sum A B)
  /-- `∨`-introduction, right. -/
  | orI₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : ND Γ B → ND Γ (.sum A B)
  /-- `∨`-elimination (proof by cases). -/
  | orE {Γ : List Formula} {A B C : Formula} :
      ND Γ (.sum A B) → ND (A :: Γ) C → ND (B :: Γ) C → ND Γ C
  /-- `⊥`-elimination (ex falso quodlibet). -/
  | botE {Γ : List Formula} {C : Formula} : ND Γ .bot → ND Γ C

/-- **Galois's criterion for `x⁵ - 6x + 3`.** If some root of `x⁵ - 6x + 3` is expressible by
radicals over `ℚ`, then the Galois group `Aut(L/ℚ)` of its splitting field is solvable. -/
theorem galois_criterion {β : ℂ} (hβ : eval β (quinticPoly ℂ) = 0)
    (hrad : ExpressibleByRadicals β) : IsSolvable (FieldAut Qc L) := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hβl⟩ := hrad
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hst, hle⟩ := exists_stable_kummer hl

/-- **Extension to `ℚ(x₁, …, xₘ)` from an intermediate field.** If `ℚ ⊆ F ⊆ gen ℚ m`, every
ring homomorphism `F → ℂ` extends to `gen ℚ m → ℂ`: indeed `gen ℚ m ⊆ gen F m`. -/
theorem extend_to {F : Subfield ℂ} (m : List ℂ) (hQF : Qc.le F) (hFM : F.le (gen Qc m))
    (σ : RingHom F ℂ) :
    ∃ τ : RingHom (gen Qc m) ℂ, ∀ y : F, τ.toFun ⟨y.1, hFM _ y.2⟩ = σ.toFun y := by
  obtain ⟨τ', hτ'⟩ := extend_gen F σ m
  exact ⟨τ'.comp (Subfield.inclusion (gen_mono_base hQF m)), fun y => hτ' y⟩

Foundations.Algebra.no_int_trisect_aux:
/-- `a³ - 3 a c² - c³ = 0` has no integer solution with `c ≠ 0` (descent). -/
theorem no_int_trisect_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (a c : Int), c.natAbs = n → c ≠ 0 →
    a * a * a - 3 * a * (c * c) - c * c * c ≠ 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro a c hn hc h
    rcases Int.emod_two_eq a with ha | ha <;> rcases Int.emod_two_eq c with hc2 | hc2
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have hl : l ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hc; rw [h]; rfl
      have : k * k * k - 3 * k * (l * l) - l * l * l = 0 := by grind
      exact ih l.natAbs (by omega) k l rfl hl this
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l + 1 := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k) * (2 * k) * (2 * k) - 3 * (2 * k) * ((2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1)) -
          (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k - 3 * k * (4 * l * l + 4 * l + 1) - (4 * l * l * l + 6 * l * l + 3 * l)) - 1 := by
        grind
      omega
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * ((2 * l) * (2 * l)) -
          (2 * l) * (2 * l) * (2 * l) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k + 6 * k * k + 3 * k - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * l * l) - 4 * l * l * l) + 1 := by
        grind
      omega
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨a / 2, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, c = 2 * l + 1 := ⟨c / 2, by omega⟩
      have : (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * ((2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1)) -
          (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) * (2 * l + 1) =
          2 * (4 * k * k * k + 6 * k * k + 3 * k - 3 * (2 * k + 1) * (2 * l * l + 2 * l) - 3 * k
            - (4 * l * l * l + 6 * l * l + 3 * l) - 1) + 1 := by
        grind
      omega

/-- Squares are monotone on the non-negatives. -/
theorem mul_self_le_mul_self {a b : R} (h0 : 0 ≤ a) (h : a ≤ b) : a * a ≤ b * b := by
  have h₁ := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h h0

/-- The doubling homomorphism is injective. -/
theorem double_injective : ∀ a b, double a = double b → a = b := by
  intro a b h
  have h' : 2 * val a = 2 * val b := h
  show val a = val b
  omega

/-- The image of a natural number `n + 1` in `ℂ` is non-zero. -/
theorem C.ncast_succ_ne_zero (n : Nat) : (ncast (n + 1) : C) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [C.ncast_eq]; intro h
  have : ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) = 0 := congrArg C.re h
  have : (0 : R) < ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) := by grind

Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.coe_pow:
/-- Powers in a subgroup are powers in the group. -/
theorem Subgroup.coe_pow {G : Type u} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (g : H) :
    ∀ n : Nat, (g ^ n).1 = g.1 ^ n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    show (g ^ n * g).1 = g.1 ^ n * g.1
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_pow H g n]

  intro k
  refine ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨ψ, _, rfl⟩

/-- Only `⟨0, 0⟩` is `0`. -/

Foundations.Bridges.qToSet_le:
/-- The comparison map preserves and reflects the order. -/
theorem qToSet_le (x y : Q) : x ≤ y ↔ qle (qToSet x) (qToSet y) := by
  induction x using Q.ind with
  | _ a b hb =>
  induction y using Q.ind with
  | _ c d hd =>
  refine (QModel.liftRel_enc qleP (fun p q => p.num * q.den ≤ q.num * p.den) ?_ ?_
    ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩).symm
  · intro p p' q q' h₁ h₂
    have e := (Q.mk_eq_mk (hb := p.den_pos) (hd := p'.den_pos)).2 h₁
    have e' := (Q.mk_eq_mk (hb := q.den_pos) (hd := q'.den_pos)).2 h₂
    have := Q.mk_le p.num p.den q.num q.den p.den_pos q.den_pos
    rw [e, e', Q.mk_le] at this
    exact this.symm
  · intro p q
    simp only [QModel, qleP, fracEnc, pfst_kpair, psnd_kpair, natZ_den, ← intToSet_mul,
      intToSet_le]
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.mul_assoc:
/-- **Associativity** of multiplication. -/
theorem mul_assoc (p q r : List R) : Eqv (mul (mul p q) r) (mul p (mul q r)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    show coeff (mul (add (smul a q) (0 :: mul p q)) r) n = _
    rw [mul_add_left, coeff_add, smul_mul, coeff_smul, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons,
      zero_mul, zero_add]
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k]
Foundations.Types.Lambda.subst_iterApp:
/-- Substitution distributes over iterated application. -/
theorem subst_iterApp (σ : Nat → Term) (f a : Term) (n : Nat) :
    subst σ (iterApp f a n) = iterApp (subst σ f) (subst σ a) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [iterApp, subst, ih]

/-- Weakening under the first hypothesis. -/
theorem ND.wk₁ {Γ : List Ty} {A C : Ty} (B : Ty) (h : ND (C :: Γ) A) : ND (C :: B :: Γ) A :=
  ND.mono h fun D hD => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hD with rfl | hD
    · exact List.mem_cons_self
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hD)
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.segment_const:
/-- (A4) **Segment construction** in the Klein model. -/
theorem segment_construction (q a b c : KPt) : ∃ x, KBet q a x ∧ KCong a x b c := by
  have hK := one_le_inv b.2 c.2
  by_cases hqa : q = a
  · subst hqa
    obtain ⟨σ, _, hin, hinv⟩ := exists_on_ray (u := ⟨1, 0⟩) q.2 (by unfold n2; grind) hK
    exact ⟨⟨_, hin⟩, ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩, hinv⟩
  · have hu : 0 < n2 ⟨a.1.x - q.1.x, a.1.y - q.1.y⟩ := by
      have := Pt.d2_pos (fun h => hqa (Subtype.ext h.symm) : a.1 ≠ q.1)
      unfold Pt.d2 at this; unfold n2; grind
    obtain ⟨σ, σ0, hin, hinv⟩ := exists_on_ray a.2 hu hK
    obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := 1) (v := 1 + σ) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
    have : 1 + σ ≠ 0 := by grind
    refine ⟨⟨_, hin⟩, ⟨1 / (1 + σ), t0, t1, ?_, ?_⟩, hinv⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> grind
Foundations.Bridges.qToSet_mem_cutToSet:
/-- A rational lies in `cutToSet C` exactly when it lies in the lower part of `C`. -/
theorem qToSet_mem_cutToSet {C : Cut} {q : Q} : qToSet q ∈ cutToSet C ↔ C.lower q := by
  simp only [cutToSet, mem_sep]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, q', hq', hl⟩
    rw [← qToSet_injective hq']
    exact hl
  · intro h
    exact ⟨qToSet_mem q, q, rfl, h⟩

Foundations.Categories.MonHom:
/-- A **monoid homomorphism**. -/
structure MonHom (M : Type u) (N : Type u) [Monoid' M] [Monoid' N] where
  /-- The underlying function. -/
  toFun : M → N
  /-- The unit is preserved. -/

Foundations.Categories.Algebra:
/-- An **Eilenberg–Moore algebra** of a monad: an object `A` with a structure map
`a : T A ⟶ A` ("evaluate a formal expression") compatible with unit and multiplication. -/
structure Algebra where
  /-- The carrier. -/
  A : C
  /-- The structure map. -/
  a : M.T.obj A ⟶ A
  /-- Evaluating a generator gives the generator. -/
  unit : M.η A ≫ a = 𝟙 A
  /-- Evaluating in two stages is evaluating the flattened expression. -/
  assoc : M.T.map a ≫ a = M.μ A ≫ a
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.pp_no:
/-- The positive part is non-negative. -/
theorem pp_nonneg (x : R) : 0 ≤ pp x := by unfold pp; split <;> grind
Foundations.NumberTheory.chebyshev_bound:
/-- **Chebyshev's bounds.** For every `m ≥ 6`,
`⌊m/2⌋ · log 2 ≤ π(m) · log m ≤ m · log 1024`.
So `π(m)` is of order `m / log m`: bounded above and below by constant multiples of it. -/
theorem chebyshev_bounds {m : Nat} (hm : 6 ≤ m) :
    ((m / 2 : Nat) : R) * R.log 2 ≤ (primeCount m : R) * R.log m ∧
      (primeCount m : R) * R.log m ≤ (m : R) * R.log 1024 := by
  constructor
  · have := log_ineq_of_pow_le (by omega) (by omega) (chebyshev_lower hm)
    exact this
  · have := log_ineq_of_pow_le (by omega) (by omega) (chebyshev_upper (n := m) (by omega))
    exact this
Foundations.Combinatorics.InfTree:
/-- A tree is **infinite**: it has nodes at every depth. -/
def InfTree (T : List Nat → Prop) : Prop := ∀ n, ∃ l, T l ∧ l.length = n
Foundations.Numbers.R.inv_inv:
/-- Inversion is an involution: `(x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x`. -/
theorem inv_inv (x : R) : x⁻¹⁻¹ = x := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero, inv_zero]
  · have h1 := mul_inv_cancel hx
    have hx' : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h2 := mul_inv_cancel hx'
    calc x⁻¹⁻¹ = (x * x⁻¹) * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [h1, one_mul]
      _ = x * (x⁻¹ * x⁻¹⁻¹) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = x := by rw [h2, mul_one]
Foundations.Types.STLC.Term:
/-- **Terms** of the simply typed λ-calculus (untyped syntax, de Bruijn indices). -/
inductive Term where
  /-- Variable. -/
  | var (n : Nat)
  /-- Application `t u`. -/
  | app (t u : Term)
  /-- Abstraction `λ. t` (binds variable `0` in `t`). -/
  | lam (t : Term)
  /-- Pair `⟨a, b⟩`. -/
  | pair (a b : Term)
  /-- First projection. -/
  | fst (t : Term)
  /-- Second projection. -/
  | snd (t : Term)
  /-- Left injection. -/
  | inl (t : Term)
  /-- Right injection. -/
  | inr (t : Term)
  /-- Case analysis `case t of inl ⇒ u₁ | inr ⇒ u₂` (each branch binds variable `0`). -/
  | case (t u₁ u₂ : Term)
  /-- Ex falso: from a term of the empty type, anything. -/
  | absurd (t : Term)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.evalList_:
/-- A list with zero coefficients evaluates to `0`. -/
theorem evalList_of_eqv_nil (x : R) {p : List R} (h : Eqv p []) : evalList x p = 0 := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    show a + x * evalList x p = 0
    rw [show a = 0 from h 0, ih (fun k => h (k + 1)), mul_zero, add_zero]
Foundations.Combinatorics.hall:
/-- **Hall's marriage theorem.** Let `A₀, …, A_{N−1}` be subsets of `{0, …, M−1}` such
that every subfamily `I` has at least `|I|` elements in its union. Then there is a
system of distinct representatives: an injective choice `f(i) ∈ Aᵢ`. -/
theorem hall (A : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (hHall : ∀ I : Nat → Prop, cnt I N ≤ cnt (union N A I) M) :
    ∃ f : Nat → Nat, (∀ i, i < N → f i < M ∧ A i (f i)) ∧
      ∀ i j, i < N → j < N → i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j := by
  obtain ⟨f, h₁, h₂⟩ := hall_aux N M _ (fun _ => True) A rfl fun I _ => hHall I
  exact ⟨f, fun i hi => h₁ i hi trivial, fun i j hi hj hij => h₂ i j hi hj trivial trivial hij⟩
Foundations.Types.Lambda.HasNF:

def HasNF (t : Term) : Prop := ∃ n, Red t n ∧ Normal n
Foundations.Algebra.geom_identity:
/-- The geometric sum `1 + x + ⋯ + x^{n-1}` evaluated at `x`, times `x - 1`, is `xⁿ - 1`. -/
theorem geom_identity (x : R) : ∀ n : Nat,
    (x + -1) * evalList x (List.replicate n 1) = rpow x n + -1
  | 0 => by show (x + -1) * 0 = 1 + -1; grind
  | n + 1 => by
    have ih := geom_identity x n
    show (x + -1) * (1 + x * evalList x (List.replicate n 1)) = rpow x n * x + -1
    grind
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.bernoull:
/-- **A Bernoulli trial** with success probability `p ∈ [0, 1]`. -/
noncomputable def bernoulli (p : R) (h₀ : 0 ≤ p) (h₁ : p ≤ 1) : FinProb Bool where
  pts := [true, false]
  w := fun b => if b then p else 1 - p
  w_nonneg := fun b => by cases b <;> simp <;> grind
  sum_one := by simp [sumL]; grind

Foundations.Types.Lambda.Par.triangle:
/-- **The triangle property** (Takahashi): every parallel step from `t` can be
completed, by another parallel step, to the complete development `cd t`. -/
theorem Par.triangle {t u : Term} (h : Par t u) : Par u (cd t) := by
  induction h with
  | var n => exact Par.var n
  | lam _ ih => exact Par.lam ih
  | @app t t' u u' ht _ iht ihu =>
    cases t with
    | lam s =>
      obtain ⟨s', rfl, _⟩ := ht.lam_inv
      cases iht with
      | lam hs => exact Par.beta hs ihu
    | var n => exact Par.app iht ihu
    | app a b => exact Par.app iht ihu
  | beta _ _ iht ihu => exact Par.inst iht ihu
