Foundations.Sets.cantorPair_surjective:
/-- Cantor's pairing function is surjective: every number codes some pair. -/
theorem cantorPair_surjective : Function.Surjective cantorPair := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨m, n⟩, hk⟩ := ih
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      -- end of a diagonal: jump to the start of the next one
      refine ⟨(n + 1, 0), ?_⟩
      simp only [cantorPair, Nat.zero_add] at hk
      simp only [cantorPair, Nat.add_zero, tri]
      omega
    | succ m =>
      -- move one step along the diagonal
      refine ⟨(m, n + 1), ?_⟩
      simp only [cantorPair] at hk ⊢
      rw [show m + (n + 1) = m + 1 + n by omega]
      omega

/-- **Limit of a sum** is the sum of the limits. -/
theorem Tendsto.add {a b : Nat → R} {L M : R} (ha : Tendsto a L) (hb : Tendsto b M) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a n + b n) (L + M) := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := ha (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hb (ε / 2) (by grind)
  refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ n (by omega)
  have k2 := h₂ n (by omega)
  have k3 := abs_add (a n - L) (b n - M)
  rw [show a n - L + (b n - M) = a n + b n - (L + M) by grind] at k3
  grind

/-- Points of `S` have all coordinates at most `p`. -/
theorem InS.bound (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {x y z : Nat} (h : InS p (x, y, z)) :
    x < p + 1 ∧ y < p + 1 ∧ z < p + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨_, hy, hz, _, _⟩ := h.facts hp h4
  unfold InS at h; simp only at h
  have h1 := Nat.le_mul_self x
  have h2 : y ≤ y * z := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right y hz
  have h3 : z ≤ y * z := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left z hy

  omega
Foundations.Logic.FO.exists_ccode:
/-- **Decoding contexts.** A number all of whose entries are formula codes is the code
of a context. -/
theorem exists_ccode (c : Nat) (h : ∀ i, i < llen c → isFormulaC (lnth c i) = 1) :
    ∃ Δ : List (Formula Arith), ccode Δ = c := by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, encList l = c := ⟨_, encList_decList c⟩
  rw [llen_encList] at h
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons x l ih =>
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff x).1 (by simpa [lnth] using h 0 (by simp))
      obtain ⟨Δ, hΔ⟩ := ih fun i hi => by
        have := h (i + 1) (by simp; omega)
        simpa [lnth] using this
      refine ⟨φ :: Δ, ?_⟩
      simp only [ccode, List.map_cons] at hΔ ⊢
      show pair (fcode φ) (encList (Δ.map fcode)) + 1 = pair x (encList l) + 1

Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.mul:
/-- **Product rule** (Leibniz). `(f g)' = f' g + f g'`. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.mul {f g : R → R} {a b x : R} (hf : HasDerivAt f a x) (hg : HasDerivAt g b x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => f y * g y) (a * g x + f x * b) x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hε₁c⟩ := exists_mul_le (g x) (by grind : 0 < ε / 3)
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hε₂c⟩ := exists_mul_le (f x) (by grind : 0 < ε / 3)
  have ha := abs_nonneg a
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := exists_mul_le (abs a + 1) (by grind : 0 < ε / 3)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ abs a + 1)] at hηc
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf ε₁ hε₁
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg ε₂ hε₂
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h₃⟩ := hf.lipschitz
  obtain ⟨δ₄, hδ₄, h₄⟩ := hg.continuousAt η hη
  obtain ⟨δ₅, hδ₅, h₅1, h₅2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨δ₆, hδ₆, h₆1, h₆2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₃ hδ₄
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₅ hδ₆
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have t1 := abs_mul_bound (h₁ y (by grind)) hε₁c
  have t3 := abs_mul_bound (h₂ y (by grind)) hε₂c
  have t2 : abs ((f y - f x) * (g y - g x)) ≤ ε / 3 * abs (y - x) := by
    have k := abs_mul_le (h₃ y (by grind)) (Std.le_of_lt (h₄ y (by grind)))
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hηc (abs_nonneg (y - x))
    grind
  have s1 := abs_add (g x * (f y - f x - a * (y - x)) + (f y - f x) * (g y - g x))
    (f x * (g y - g x - b * (y - x)))
  have s2 := abs_add (g x * (f y - f x - a * (y - x))) ((f y - f x) * (g y - g x))
  rw [show g x * (f y - f x - a * (y - x)) + (f y - f x) * (g y - g x) +
    f x * (g y - g x - b * (y - x)) = f y * g y - f x * g x - (a * g x + f x * b) * (y - x)
    by grind] at s1
  grind
Foundations.Logic.Computability.derivabl:
/-- **Completeness of the rule system**: every true evaluation judgement is derivable. -/
theorem derivable_of_eval {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {n : Nat} (h : Eval c xs n) :
    Derivable evalRule (judg (encode c) (encList xs) n) := by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact .intro _ 0 [] (by simp) (by simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode])
  | succ => exact .intro _ 0 [] (by simp) (by simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, lhead_encList])
  | proj => exact .intro _ 0 [] (by simp) (by simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, lnth_encList])
  | @comp k f gs xs n vs _ _ ihg ihf =>
      refine .intro _ (encList (List.ofFn vs))
        (List.ofFn (fun i => judg (encode (gs i)) (encList xs) (vs i)) ++
          [judg (encode f) (encList (List.ofFn vs)) n]) ?_ ?_
      · intro y hy
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_ofFn, List.mem_singleton] at hy
        rcases hy with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl
        · exact ihg i
        · exact ihf
      · simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, llen_encList, lnth_encList, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, ballLt_iff]
        intro i hi
        rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hi)]
        simp [hi]
  | @prec_zero f g xs n _ ih =>
      refine .intro _ 0 [judg (encode f) (encList xs) n] (by simpa using ih) ?_
      simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, lnth_encList]
  | @prec_succ f g m xs r n _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      refine .intro _ r [judg (encode (.prec f g)) (encList (m :: xs)) r,
        judg (encode g) (encList (m :: r :: xs)) n] (by simp; exact ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩) ?_
      simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, lnth_encList]
  | @mu f xs n ks _ _ ih₀ ihlt =>
      refine .intro _ (encList (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => ks i))
        (judg (encode f) (encList (n :: xs)) 0 ::
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => judg (encode f) (encList (i.val :: xs)) (ks i + 1))) ?_ ?_
      · intro y hy
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_ofFn] at hy
        rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
        · exact ih₀
        · exact ihlt i i.isLt
      · simp [evalRule, evalStep, judg, encode, lnth_encList, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, ballLt_iff]
        intro i hi
        simp [hi]

/-- `¬¬` and implication introduction: from `A ⊢ ¬¬B` infer `¬¬(A → B)`. -/
theorem nn_impI {Γ : List Ty} {A B : Ty} (h : ND (A :: Γ) (nn B)) : ND Γ (nn (.arr A B)) := by
  -- Under `k : ¬(A → B)` we get `¬B` (from `B` build `A → B`).
  have notB : ND (Types.STLC.neg (.arr A B) :: Γ) (Types.STLC.neg B) :=
    ND.impI (ND.impE ND.h1 (ND.impI ND.h1))
  refine ND.impI (ND.impE ND.h0 (ND.impI (ND.botE ?_)))
  exact ND.impE (ND.wk₁ _ h) (ND.wk _ notB)

/-- The **counit** `ε_Y : F (G Y) ⟶ Y`, the transpose of `𝟙 (G Y)`. -/
def counit : NatTrans (G.comp F) (Functor.id D) where
  app Y := (adj.homEquiv (G.obj Y) Y).invFun (𝟙 (G.obj Y))
  naturality {X Y} h := by
    change F.map (G.map h) ≫ (adj.homEquiv (G.obj Y) Y).invFun (𝟙 (G.obj Y)) =
      (adj.homEquiv (G.obj X) X).invFun (𝟙 (G.obj X)) ≫ h
    rw [← adj.inv_natural_left, ← adj.inv_natural_right, comp_id, id_comp]

Foundations.NumberTheory.vp_centralBinom:
/-- `vₚ(C(2n, n)) + 2 · (Legendre sum of n) = Legendre sum of 2n`, for `2n < pᴷ`. -/
theorem vp_centralBinom {p n K : Nat} (hp : Prime p) (hK : 2 * n < p ^ K) :
    vp p (centralBinom n) + 2 * legendreSum p n K = legendreSum p (2 * n) K := by
  have h := centralBinom_mul_fact n
  have hc := centralBinom_pos n
  have hf := fact_pos n
  rw [← legendre hp _ K hK, ← legendre hp n K (by omega), ← h,
    vp_mul hp (Nat.mul_pos hc hf) hf, vp_mul hp hc hf]
  omega
Foundations.Logic.Computability.Code:
/-- **Codes of partial recursive functions.** Finite descriptions of algorithms
built from zero, successor and projections by composition, primitive recursion and
minimisation (unbounded search). -/
inductive Code : Type where
  /-- The constant function `0`. -/
  | zero : Code
  /-- The successor of the first argument. -/
  | succ : Code
  /-- The `i`-th argument (counting from `0`). -/
  | proj (i : Nat) : Code
  /-- Composition: `comp f gs (x⃗) = f(gs 0 (x⃗), …, gs (k-1) (x⃗))`. -/
  | comp {k : Nat} (f : Code) (gs : Fin k → Code) : Code
  /-- Primitive recursion on the first argument. -/
  | prec (f g : Code) : Code
  /-- Minimisation: the least `n` such that `f(n, x⃗) = 0`. -/
  | mu (f : Code) : Code

/-- A **natural isomorphism**: natural transformations both ways, inverse to each other. -/
structure NatIso {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) where
  /-- The forward transformation. -/
  hom : NatTrans F G
  /-- The backward transformation. -/
  inv : NatTrans G F
  /-- Forward then backward is the identity, componentwise. -/
  hom_inv_id : ∀ X, hom.app X ≫ inv.app X = 𝟙 (F.obj X)
  /-- Backward then forward is the identity, componentwise. -/
  inv_hom_id : ∀ X, inv.app X ≫ hom.app X = 𝟙 (G.obj X)

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_of_quad:
/-- A quadratic error bound gives a derivative: if `|f y − f x − d (y − x)| ≤ C |y − x|²` for
`|y − x| ≤ 1`, then `f' (x) = d`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_of_quadratic {f : R → R} {d x C : R} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ y, abs (y - x) ≤ 1 → abs (f y - f x - d * (y - x)) ≤ C * (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x))) :
    HasDerivAt f d x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both (by grind : (0 : R) < 1)
    (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < C + 1))
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k := h y (by grind)
  have hk := abs_nonneg (y - x)
  -- `|y − x| · C ≤ ε`.
  have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hy) (by grind : 0 ≤ C + 1)
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ2 (by grind : 0 ≤ C + 1)
  have e : (C + 1) * (ε / (C + 1)) = ε := by grind
  have k3 : abs (y - x) * C ≤ ε := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hk hC
    grind
  have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k3 hk
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.ringHom_fix_ratField:
/-- **Ring homomorphisms fix the prime field.** A ring homomorphism `τ : L → L` of a subfield
containing `ℚ` fixes every rational number. -/
theorem ringHom_fix_ratField {Ω : Type u} [CommRing Ω] (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hc : CharZero Ω)
    {L : Subfield Ω} (τ : RingHom L L) (x : L) (hx : x.1 ∈ ratField hΩ hc) : τ.toFun x = x := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := hx
  have hbL : (Int.cast b : L) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hb; apply hc
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [Subfield.coe_intCast] at this; exact this
  have e : x * Int.cast b = Int.cast a := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [Subfield.coe_mul, Subfield.coe_intCast, Subfield.coe_intCast]; exact hab)
  have e' : τ.toFun x * Int.cast b = Int.cast a := by
    rw [← RingHom.map_intCast τ b, ← τ.map_mul, e, RingHom.map_intCast]
  have hD := (L.isField hΩ).isDomain
  have : (τ.toFun x + -x) * Int.cast b = 0 := by grind
  rcases hD.2 _ _ this with h | h
  · grind
  · exact absurd h hbL
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Measu:
/-- **Pointwise limits of measurable functions are measurable.**
`{c < f} = ⋃ₘ ⋃_N ⋂_{n ≥ N} {c + 1/(m+1) < fₙ}`. -/
theorem of_tendsto {F : Nat → α → R} (hF : ∀ n, Measurable S (F n))
    (hlim : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => F n x) (f x)) : Measurable S f := fun c =>
  S.congr (S.iUnion _ fun m => S.iUnion _ fun N => S.iInter _ fun j =>
      hF (N + j) (c + 1 / ((m : R) + 1))) fun x => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, N, h⟩
      have := le_of_tendsto ((hlim x).shift N) fun j => Std.le_of_lt (h j)
      have := eps_pos m; grind
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := eps_small (by grind : (0 : R) < (f x - c) / 2)
      have hm := hm m (Nat.le_refl m)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hlim x ((f x - c) / 2) (by grind)
      refine ⟨m, N, fun j => ?_⟩
      have := abs_lt.1 (hN (N + j) (by omega)); grind
Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.nested:
/-- The intervals are nested: for `N ≤ m`, `[lₘ, uₘ] ⊆ [l_N, u_N]`. -/
theorem nested {N m : Nat} (h : N ≤ m) :
    lo P l u N ≤ lo P l u m ∧ hi P l u m ≤ hi P l u N := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = N + k := ⟨m - N, by omega⟩
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨Q.le_refl _, Q.le_refl _⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    have := ih (by omega)
    have := lo_le_succ hl hu hlu (N + k)
    have := hi_succ_le hl hu hlu (N + k)
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
    grind

Foundations.Algebra.all_c3_of_one:
/-- **All 3-cycles are conjugate in `A₅`.** A subset of `S₅` closed under conjugation by even
permutations that contains one 3-cycle contains them all. -/
theorem all_c3_of_one (N : Subgroup (Perm (Fin 5)))
    (hnorm : ∀ g, g ∈ alternating 5 → ∀ x, x ∈ N → g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ N)
    {u v w : Fin 5} (huv : u ≠ v) (hvw : v ≠ w) (huw : u ≠ w) (h : c3 u v w ∈ N) :
    ∀ σ, IsC3 σ → σ ∈ N := by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_even_move3 huv hvw huw
  have h012 : c3 0 1 2 ∈ N := by
    have := hnorm π hπ _ h
    rwa [conj_c3, h1, h2, h3] at this
  intro σ ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, hσ⟩
  obtain ⟨π', hπ', h1', h2', h3'⟩ := exists_even_move3 hab hbc hac
  have := hnorm π'⁻¹ ((alternating 5).inv_mem hπ') _ h012
  rw [conj_c3] at this
  have e1 : π'⁻¹ 0 = a := by rw [← h1']; exact π'.left_inv a
  have e2 : π'⁻¹ 1 = b := by rw [← h2']; exact π'.left_inv b
  have e3 : π'⁻¹ 2 = c := by rw [← h3']; exact π'.left_inv c
  rw [e1, e2, e3] at this
  rw [hσ]; exact this

Foundations.Algebra.intQuotientIso:
/-- **`ℤ ⧸ (n) ≃+* Fin n`.** The quotient of the integers by the principal ideal `(n)` is
isomorphic to the ring of residues modulo `n` — justifying the model of `ℤ/nℤ` used
throughout. -/
noncomputable def intQuotientIso : QuotientRing (Ideal.span (n : Int)) ≃+* Fin n :=
  QuotientRing.isoOfSurjective (intReduce n)
    (by
      intro a
      have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
      have h0 := Int.emod_nonneg a (b := (n : Int)) (by omega)
      show (∃ r, a = r * (n : Int)) ↔ (⟨(a % (n : Int)).toNat, _⟩ : Fin n) = Fin.ofNat n 0
      rw [Fin.ext_iff, fin_ofNat_val, Nat.zero_mod]
      show (∃ r, a = r * (n : Int)) ↔ (a % (n : Int)).toNat = 0
      constructor
      · intro ⟨r, hr⟩
        have : a % (n : Int) = 0 := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd ⟨r, by rw [hr, Int.mul_comm]⟩
        rw [this]; rfl
      · intro h
        have h' : a % (n : Int) = 0 := by omega
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h'
        exact ⟨c, by rw [hc, Int.mul_comm]⟩)
    (fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨(k : Int), by
      apply Fin.ext
      show ((k : Int) % (n : Int)).toNat = k
      rw [← Int.natCast_emod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk]; rfl⟩)

/-- Cantor's enumeration of pairs of natural numbers, diagonal by diagonal:
`(0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (0,2), (1,1), (2,0), …`. -/

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.segment_construc:
/-- (A4) **Segment construction** holds in `K²` whenever non-negative elements of `K`
have square roots. -/
theorem segment_construction_of_sqrt (hsq : ∀ z : K, 0 ≤ z → ∃ r, 0 ≤ r ∧ r * r = z)
    (q a b c : Pt K) : ∃ x, Bet q a x ∧ Cong a x b c := by
  by_cases hqa : q = a
  · subst hqa
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := hsq (d2 b c) (d2_nonneg b c)
    refine ⟨⟨q.x + r, q.y⟩, ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩, ?_⟩
    unfold Cong; rw [← hr]; unfold d2; dsimp only; grind
  · have hE := d2_pos hqa
    have hz : 0 ≤ d2 b c / d2 q a := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (d2_nonneg b c)
        (by have := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hE; grind)
    obtain ⟨k, k0, hk⟩ := hsq _ hz
    obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := 1) (v := 1 + k) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
    have hk1 : 1 + k ≠ 0 := by grind
    have hE' : d2 q a ≠ 0 := by grind
    refine ⟨⟨a.x + k * (a.x - q.x), a.y + k * (a.y - q.y)⟩, ⟨1 / (1 + k), t0, t1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only; grind
    · dsimp only; grind
    · unfold Cong
      have e : d2 a ⟨a.x + k * (a.x - q.x), a.y + k * (a.y - q.y)⟩ = k * k * d2 q a := by
        unfold d2; dsimp only; grind
      rw [e, hk]
      grind

/-- `triCode` computes the triangular numbers. -/
theorem eval_tri (xs : List Nat) : ∀ s, Eval triCode (s :: xs) (tri s)
  | 0 => Eval.prec_zero .zero
  | s + 1 => by
      have := Eval.prec_succ (eval_tri xs s)
        (eval_comp2 (xs := s :: tri s :: xs) .proj (eval_comp1 .proj .succ)
          (eval_add (s + 1) [] (tri s)))
      simpa [tri, Nat.add_assoc] using this
Foundations.Categories.Algebra.category:
/-- **The Eilenberg–Moore category** of algebras of a monad. -/
instance Algebra.category : Category.{v} (Algebra M) where
  Hom X Y := AlgHom M X Y
  id X := ⟨𝟙 X.A, by rw [M.T.map_id, id_comp, comp_id]⟩
  comp g h := ⟨g.f ≫ h.f, by
    rw [M.T.map_comp, Category.assoc, h.comm, ← Category.assoc, g.comm, Category.assoc]⟩
  id_comp _ := AlgHom.ext M (id_comp _)
  comp_id _ := AlgHom.ext M (comp_id _)
  assoc _ _ _ := AlgHom.ext M (Category.assoc _ _ _)

Foundations.Logic.HAxiom.toND:
/-- Every Hilbert axiom is derivable in natural deduction (from any premises). -/
theorem HAxiom.toND {φ : Formula} (h : HAxiom φ) (Γ : Theory) : Γ ⊢ φ := by
  cases h with
  | k φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.impI ((Derives.assume _ _).weaken₁ _))
  | s φ ψ χ =>
      refine Derives.impI (Derives.impI (Derives.impI ?_))
      have hφ : insert (insert (insert Γ (imp φ (imp ψ χ))) (imp φ ψ)) φ ⊢ φ := Derives.assume _ _
      have h₁ := ((Derives.assume Γ (imp φ (imp ψ χ))).weaken₁ (imp φ ψ)).weaken₁ φ
      have h₂ := (Derives.assume (insert Γ (imp φ (imp ψ χ))) (imp φ ψ)).weaken₁ φ
      exact Derives.impE (Derives.impE h₁ hφ) (Derives.impE h₂ hφ)
  | dne φ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.dne (Derives.assume _ _))
  | conjE₁ φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.conjE₁ (Derives.assume _ _))
  | conjE₂ φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.conjE₂ (Derives.assume _ _))
  | conjI φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.impI (Derives.conjI ((Derives.assume _ _).weaken₁ _) (Derives.assume _ _)))
  | disjI₁ φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.disjI₁ (Derives.assume _ _))
  | disjI₂ φ ψ => exact Derives.impI (Derives.disjI₂ (Derives.assume _ _))
  | disjE φ ψ χ =>
      refine Derives.impI (Derives.impI (Derives.impI (Derives.disjE (Derives.assume _ _) ?_ ?_)))
      · exact Derives.impE ((((Derives.assume _ _).weaken₁ _).weaken₁ _).weaken₁ _) (Derives.assume _ _)
      · exact Derives.impE (((Derives.assume _ _).weaken₁ _).weaken₁ _) (Derives.assume _ _)

Foundations.Numbers.R.rsum_const_mul:
/-- Riemann sums commute with constant multiples. -/
theorem rsum_const_mul (c : R) (f : R → R) (a : R) (l : List (R × R)) :
    rsum (fun y => c * f y) a l = c * rsum f a l := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => show (0 : R) = c * 0; grind
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    show c * f t * (x - a) + rsum (fun y => c * f y) x l = c * (f t * (x - a) + rsum f x l)
    rw [ih]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.gsum_binomial:
/-- **The binomial theorem for exponential terms.** If `e x 0 = 1` and
`(n + 1) · e x (n+1) = x · e x n` (as for `e x n = xⁿ/n!`), then
`Σ_{i ≤ n} e a i · e b (n − i) = e (a + b) n`. -/
theorem gsum_binomial (e : α → Nat → α) (he0 : ∀ x, e x 0 = 1)
    (hes : ∀ (x : α) (n : Nat), ((n : α) + 1) * e x (n + 1) = x * e x n) (hn : ∀ n : Nat, (n : α) + 1 ≠ 0)
    (a b : α) (n : Nat) :
    gsum (fun i => e a i * e b (n - i)) (n + 1) = e (a + b) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show 0 + e a 0 * e b (0 - 0) = e (a + b) 0
    rw [Nat.sub_self, he0, he0, he0]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    -- `(n + 2) Sₙ₊₁ = a Sₙ + b Sₙ`, split according to `n + 1 = i + (n + 1 − i)`.
    have hX : gsum (fun i => (i : α) * (e a i * e b (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1 + 1) =
        a * gsum (fun i => e a i * e b (n - i)) (n + 1) := by
      rw [gsum_succ', ← gsum_mul_left]
      have : ((0 : Nat) : α) = 0 := Semiring.natCast_zero
      rw [this]
      have : gsum (fun k => ((k + 1 : Nat) : α) * (e a (k + 1) * e b (n + 1 - (k + 1)))) (n + 1) =
          gsum (fun k => a * (e a k * e b (n - k))) (n + 1) := gsum_congr fun k _ => by
        rw [show n + 1 - (k + 1) = n - k by omega, Semiring.natCast_succ]
        have := hes a k; grind
      rw [this]; grind
    have hY : gsum (fun i => ((n + 1 - i : Nat) : α) * (e a i * e b (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1 + 1) =
        b * gsum (fun i => e a i * e b (n - i)) (n + 1) := by
      rw [gsum_succ, ← gsum_mul_left, Nat.sub_self]
      have : ((0 : Nat) : α) = 0 := Semiring.natCast_zero
      rw [this]
      have : gsum (fun i => ((n + 1 - i : Nat) : α) * (e a i * e b (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1) =
          gsum (fun k => b * (e a k * e b (n - k))) (n + 1) := gsum_congr fun k hk => by
        rw [show n + 1 - k = (n - k) + 1 by omega, Semiring.natCast_succ]
        have := hes b (n - k); grind
      rw [this]; grind
    have h3 : ((n + 1 : Nat) : α) = (n : α) + 1 := Semiring.natCast_succ n
    have hsum : ((n + 1 : Nat) : α) * gsum (fun i => e a i * e b (n + 1 - i)) (n + 1 + 1) =
        gsum (fun i => (i : α) * (e a i * e b (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1 + 1) +
        gsum (fun i => ((n + 1 - i : Nat) : α) * (e a i * e b (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1 + 1) := by
      rw [← gsum_add, ← gsum_mul_left]
      apply gsum_congr
      intro i hi
      have : ((n + 1 - i : Nat) : α) + (i : α) = ((n + 1 : Nat) : α) := by
        rw [← Semiring.natCast_add, show n + 1 - i + i = n + 1 by omega]
      clear hX hY ih hes he0 hn
      generalize e a i * e b (n + 1 - i) = T
      generalize ((n + 1 - i : Nat) : α) = u at this ⊢
      generalize ((i : Nat) : α) = v at this ⊢
      generalize ((n + 1 : Nat) : α) = w at this ⊢
      grind
    rw [hX, hY, ih, h3] at hsum
    have h1 := hes (a + b) n
    have hne := hn n
    -- Cancel the non-zero factor `n + 1`.
    have hinv := Field.mul_inv_cancel hne
    generalize gsum (fun i => e a i * e b (n + 1 - i)) (n + 1 + 1) = S at hsum ⊢
    generalize e (a + b) (n + 1) = E at h1 ⊢
    have : ((n : α) + 1)⁻¹ * (((n : α) + 1) * S) = ((n : α) + 1)⁻¹ * (((n : α) + 1) * E) := by
      rw [hsum, h1]; grind
    grind

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.level:
/-- The levels of `f`: pieces `{jδ ≤ f < (j+1)δ}` for `j < K` and `{Kδ ≤ f}`, each recorded with
its lower value `jδ` and upper value `(j+1)δ`. -/
noncomputable def levels (f : α → R) (δ : R) (K : Nat) : List (R × R × (α → Prop)) :=
  (List.range K).map (fun (j : Nat) => ((j : R) * δ, ((j : R) + 1) * δ,
    fun x => (j : R) * δ ≤ f x ∧ f x < ((j : R) + 1) * δ)) ++
  [((K : R) * δ, ((K : R) + 1) * δ, fun x => (K : R) * δ ≤ f x)]
Foundations.Logic.Computability.exists_l:
/-- Choosing a list of witnesses, one for each member of a list. -/
theorem exists_list_witness {P : Nat → Nat → Prop} :
    ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ y ∈ l, ∃ t, P y t) →
      ∃ ts : List Nat, ts.length = l.length ∧ ∀ i (h : i < l.length) (h' : i < ts.length),
        P l[i] ts[i]
  | [], _ => ⟨[], rfl, fun i h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | y :: l, h => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h y (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      obtain ⟨ts, hlen, hts⟩ := exists_list_witness l fun z hz => h z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
      refine ⟨t :: ts, by simp [hlen], fun i hi hi' => ?_⟩
      cases i with
      | zero => exact ht
      | succ i => exact hts i (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hi')

Foundations.Algebra.c3_inv:
/-- The inverse of `(a b c)` is `(a c b)`. -/
theorem c3_inv {n : Nat} {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    (c3 a b c)⁻¹ = c3 a c b := by
  have := Ne.symm hab; have := Ne.symm hac; have := Ne.symm hbc
  apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one
  apply ext; intro x
  simp only [mul_apply, one_apply, c3_apply hab hbc hac, c3_apply hac (Ne.symm hbc) hab]
  by_cases h1 : x = a
  · subst h1; simp [*]
  · by_cases h2 : x = b
    · subst h2; simp [*]
    · by_cases h3 : x = c
      · subst h3; simp [*]
      · simp [h1, h2, h3]

Foundations.NumberTheory.chebyshev_upper:
/-- **Chebyshev's upper bound** (elementary form). For `n ≥ 1`: `n^π(n) ≤ 1024ⁿ`, i.e.
`π(n) ≤ 10 log 2 · n / log n`. (Apply the previous bound with `k = ⌊√n⌋`.) -/
theorem chebyshev_upper {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : n ^ primeCount n ≤ 1024 ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_sqrt n
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
    omega
  -- `k^(k+1) ≤ 4ⁿ`, since `k < 2ᵏ` and `k(k+1) ≤ 2n`.
  have hkk : k ^ (k + 1) ≤ 4 ^ n := by
    have h1 : k ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.le_of_lt (lt_pow_self (by omega) k)
    have h2 : k * (k + 1) ≤ 2 * n := by
      have : k * (k + 1) = k * k + k := by grind
      have : k ≤ k * k := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k hk
      omega
    calc k ^ (k + 1) ≤ (2 ^ k) ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h1 _
      _ = 2 ^ (k * (k + 1)) := by rw [← Nat.pow_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) h2
      _ = 4 ^ n := by rw [Nat.pow_mul]
  have hkp : k ^ primeCount n ≤ 16 ^ n :=
    calc k ^ primeCount n ≤ k ^ (k + 1) * 4 ^ n := pow_primeCount_le k n hk
      _ ≤ 4 ^ n * 4 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hkk
      _ = 16 ^ n := by rw [← Nat.mul_pow]
  -- `n ≤ 4k²`, since `n < (k+1)² ≤ (2k)²`.
  have hn4 : n ≤ 4 * (k * k) := by
    have : (k + 1) * (k + 1) ≤ (2 * k) * (2 * k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    have : (2 * k) * (2 * k) = 4 * (k * k) := by grind
    omega
  have hpi := primeCount_le n
  calc n ^ primeCount n ≤ (4 * (k * k)) ^ primeCount n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn4 _
    _ = 4 ^ primeCount n * (k ^ primeCount n * k ^ primeCount n) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_pow]
    _ ≤ 4 ^ n * (16 ^ n * 16 ^ n) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hpi) (Nat.mul_le_mul hkp hkp)
    _ = 1024 ^ n := by rw [← Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.mul_pow]

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.stewart:
/-- Stewart's relation for a point `b = a + t (c − a)`:
`|bd|² = (1−t)|ad|² + t|cd|² − t(1−t)|ac|²`. -/
theorem stewart {a b c d : Pt K} {t : K} (hx : b.x - a.x = t * (c.x - a.x))
    (hy : b.y - a.y = t * (c.y - a.y)) :
    d2 b d = (1 - t) * d2 a d + t * d2 c d - t * (1 - t) * d2 a c := by
  have ex : b.x = a.x + t * (c.x - a.x) := by grind
  have ey : b.y = a.y + t * (c.y - a.y) := by grind
  unfold d2; rw [ex, ey]; grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.cos_two_neg:
/-- **`cos 2 < 0`.** The series gives `cos 2 = 1 − 2 + 2/3 − ⋯`; the terms from the sixth on add
up to at most `8/45`, so `cos 2 ≤ −1/3 + 8/45 < 0`. -/
theorem cos_two_neg : cos 2 < 0 := by
  have hc : ∀ n, abs (cosCoeff n) ≤ 1 := fun n => (abs_coeff_le n).1
  have hs := (hasSum_shift_iff (a := pterm cosCoeff 2) 6).2 (hasSum_pser hc 2)
  -- The first six terms: `1 + 0 − 2 + 0 + 2/3 + 0 = −1/3`.
  have h6 : fsum (pterm cosCoeff 2) 6 = -1 / 3 := by
    simp only [fsum_succ, fsum_zero, pterm, expTerm]
    rw [show cosCoeff 0 = 1 from rfl, show cosCoeff 1 = -0 from rfl,
      show cosCoeff 2 = -1 from rfl, show cosCoeff 3 = - -0 from rfl,
      show cosCoeff 4 = - -1 from rfl, show cosCoeff 5 = - - -0 from rfl,
      show fact 0 = 1 from rfl, show fact 1 = 1 from rfl, show fact 2 = 2 from rfl,
      show fact 3 = 6 from rfl, show fact 4 = 24 from rfl, show fact 5 = 120 from rfl]
    grind
  -- The tail is dominated by `(4/45) · (1/2)ᵏ`.
  have hdom : ∀ k, abs (pterm cosCoeff 2 (6 + k)) ≤ 4 / 45 * (1 / 2) ^ k := fun k => by
    refine Std.le_trans (abs_pterm_le hc 2 (6 + k)) ?_
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 2)]
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      unfold expTerm; rw [show fact (6 + 0) = 720 from rfl]
      show (2 : R) ^ 6 / ((720 : Nat) : R) ≤ 4 / 45 * 1; grind
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, expTerm_succ, pow_succ']
      have hk : (0 : R) ≤ ((6 + k : Nat) : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
      have hle : 2 / (((6 + k : Nat) : R) + 1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : (0 : R) < 4) (by
          have := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le (R := R) 6 (6 + k) (by omega)
          grind : (4 : R) ≤ ((6 + k : Nat) : R) + 1)
        have e : 2 / (((6 + k : Nat) : R) + 1) = 2 * (1 / (((6 + k : Nat) : R) + 1)) := by grind
        grind
      have h0 := expTerm_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 2) (6 + k)
      have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih
        (Std.le_of_lt (div_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < 2) (by grind : (0 : R) < ((6 + k : Nat) : R) + 1)))
      have hp : (0 : R) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ k := Std.le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (by
        rw [abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 / 2)]; exact Std.le_refl _)
      have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle
        (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 4 / 45) hp)
      grind
  have hgeo := (hasSum_geometric (r := 1 / 2) (by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 / 2)]; grind)).const_mul (4 / 45)
  have := abs_hasSum_le hdom hs hgeo
  rw [h6] at this
  have := (abs_le.1 this).2
  show pser cosCoeff 2 < 0
  grind

/-- **The s-m-n theorem** (Kleene 1938). Fixing the first argument of a two-argument

/-- `unpair` really inverts `pair`: `⟨fst n, snd n⟩ = n`. -/
theorem pair_fst_snd : ∀ n, pair (fst n) (snd n) = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      have ih := pair_fst_snd n
      simp only [fst, snd] at ih ⊢
      rw [unpair]
      generalize unpair n = p at ih ⊢
      obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
      simp only at ih ⊢
      by_cases h : b = 0
      · subst h
        simp only [↓reduceIte, pair, Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero, tri] at ih ⊢
        omega
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] -- the step `⟨a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨a + 1, b - 1⟩`
        simp only [pair] at ih ⊢
        rw [show a + 1 + (b - 1) = a + b by omega]
        omega

Foundations.Sets.mul_self_equinum_of_nat:
/-- Squaring absorbs, in the form needed: if `ℕ` embeds in `α`, then `α × α ≃ α`. -/
theorem mul_self_equinum_of_nat_le {α : Type u} (h : CardLE Nat α) : Equinum (α × α) α := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_maximal he
  rcases card_comparable {x // M.dom x} {x // ¬ M.dom x} with ⟨g, hg⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · exact (not_maximal M g he hg hM).elim
  · -- all of `α` fits into `A ⊕ A`, hence into `A`
    classical
    let j : α → {x // M.dom x} := fun x =>
      if hx : M.dom x then sigma M (.inl ⟨x, hx⟩) else sigma M (.inr (k ⟨x, hx⟩))
    have hj : Function.Injective j := by
      intro x y hxy
      have hs := sigma_injective M he
      by_cases ax : M.dom x <;> by_cases ay : M.dom y <;>
        simp only [j, ax, ay, ↓reduceDIte] at hxy <;> have := hs hxy
      · simp only [Sum.inl.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at this; exact this
      · cases this
      · cases this
      · simp only [Sum.inr.injEq] at this
        have := hk this
        simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
        exact this
    let F : α × α → α := fun p => (mu M (j p.1, j p.2)).1
    have hF : Function.Injective F := by
      intro p q hpq
      have := mu_injective M (Subtype.ext hpq)
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
      exact Prod.ext (hj this.1) (hj this.2)
    exact schroeder_bernstein (f := F) (g := fun a => (a, a)) hF
      (fun a b h => (Prod.mk.inj h).1)

Foundations.Numbers.R.tendsto_exp_remain:
/-- The remainder of the Cauchy product of two exponential series tends to `0`:
`Tₙ(α, β) = Pₙ(α) Pₙ(β) − Pₙ(α + β) → exp α · exp β − exp (α + β) = 0`. -/
theorem tendsto_exp_remainder (α β : R) :
    Tendsto (fun N => gsum (fun i => expTerm α i * gsum (fun k => expTerm β (N - i + k)) i) N) 0 := by
  have h := ((hasSum_exp α : Tendsto _ _).mul (hasSum_exp β : Tendsto _ _)).sub
    (hasSum_exp (α + β) : Tendsto _ _)
  rw [← exp_add, show exp (α + β) - exp (α + β) = 0 by grind] at h
  refine h.congr_eventually 0 fun N _ => ?_
  have := gsum_exp_mul (α := R) expTerm expTerm_zero expTerm_rec
    (fun n => by have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg; grind) α β N
  rw [gsum_eq_fsum, gsum_eq_fsum, gsum_eq_fsum] at this
  show fsum (expTerm α) N * fsum (expTerm β) N - fsum (expTerm (α + β)) N = _
  rw [this]; grind
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.basel:
/-- **The Basel problem** (Mengoli 1650, Euler 1734/35). `Σ_{n ≥ 1} 1/n² = π²/6`. -/
theorem basel : HasSum (fun k => 1 / (((k : R) + 1) * ((k : R) + 1))) (pi * pi / 6) := by
  have h0 : 2 * (B 0 / A 0) = pi * pi / 6 := by
    rw [B_zero, A_zero]; have := hpi_pos; unfold hpi at *; grind
  intro ε hε
  have hp := hpi_pos
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := eps_small (div_pos hε (OrderedRing.mul_pos hp hp))
  refine ⟨M, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  rw [partial_sum, h0]
  have hb := B_le N
  have hb0 := B_nonneg N
  have ha := A_pos N
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have k := hM N hN
  -- `0 ≤ 2 B_N/A_N ≤ (π/2)²/(N+1) < ε`.
  have q1 : 0 ≤ B N / A N := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hb0
      (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 ha))
  have q2 : 2 * (B N / A N) ≤ hpi * hpi * (1 / ((N : R) + 1)) := by
    have h2 : (2 * (N : R) + 2) ≠ 0 := by grind
    have t0 : B N ≤ hpi * hpi / (2 * (N : R) + 2) * A N := by
      have : hpi * hpi * (A N / (2 * (N : R) + 2)) = hpi * hpi / (2 * (N : R) + 2) * A N := by
        rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
      rw [← this]; exact hb
    have t1 : B N / A N ≤ hpi * hpi / (2 * (N : R) + 2) := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
      have := (Field.IsOrdered.lt_mul_inv_iff_mul_lt (hpi * hpi / (2 * (N : R) + 2)) (B N) ha).1
        (by grind)
      grind
    have t2 : 2 * (1 / (2 * (N : R) + 2)) = 1 / ((N : R) + 1) := by
      rw [show 2 * (1 / (2 * (N : R) + 2)) = 2 / (2 * (N : R) + 2) by
        rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind]
      exact div_eq_div_of h2 (by grind) (by grind)
    have t3 : hpi * hpi / (2 * (N : R) + 2) = hpi * hpi * (1 / (2 * (N : R) + 2)) := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    rw [t3] at t1
    rw [← t2]
    grind
  have q3 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left k (OrderedRing.mul_pos hp hp)
  have e : hpi * hpi * (ε / (hpi * hpi)) = ε := by
    have := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show hpi * hpi ≠ 0 by have := OrderedRing.mul_pos hp hp; grind)
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
  exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

Foundations.Categories.IsEqualizer:
/-- `e : E ⟶ X` is an **equaliser** of `f, g : X ⟶ Y`: `e ≫ f = e ≫ g`, and every arrow
equalising `f` and `g` factors uniquely through `e`. -/
structure IsEqualizer {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) (E : C) (e : E ⟶ X) where
  /-- `e` equalises `f` and `g`. -/
  w : e ≫ f = e ≫ g
  /-- The factorisation of an equalising arrow. -/
  lift : {W : C} → (k : W ⟶ X) → k ≫ f = k ≫ g → (W ⟶ E)
  /-- The factorisation is a factorisation. -/
  fac : ∀ {W : C} (k : W ⟶ X) (hk : k ≫ f = k ≫ g), lift k hk ≫ e = k
  /-- The factorisation is unique. -/
  uniq : ∀ {W : C} (k : W ⟶ X) (hk : k ≫ f = k ≫ g) (h : W ⟶ E), h ≫ e = k → h = lift k hk

    ∃ φ : Nat → Nat, (∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k)) L := by
  refine ⟨chooseSubseq a L h, fun k => (chooseSubseq_spec a L h k).2, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small hε
  exact ⟨N, fun k hk => by have := (chooseSubseq_spec a L h k).1; have := hN k hk; grind⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.proves_of_derivable:
/-- **Soundness of the rule system.** Every derivable judgement is the code of a
correct derivability statement `Ctx k Δ ⊢₁ φ`. -/
theorem proves_of_derivable {x : Nat} (h : Derivable paRule x) :
    ∃ k Δ φ, x = pj k (ccode Δ) (fcode φ) ∧ Ctx k Δ ⊢₁ φ := by
  induction h with
  | intro x w l hl hstep ih =>
    -- decode the conclusion
    obtain ⟨k, D, F, rfl⟩ : ∃ k D F, x = pj k D F :=
      ⟨fst x, fst (snd x), snd (snd x), by simp [pj, pair_fst_snd]⟩
    simp only [paRule, paStep, Bool.and_eq_true] at hstep
    obtain ⟨hwf, hrule⟩ := hstep
    simp only [wfC, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ballLt_iff, qF, qD, pj, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hwf
    obtain ⟨Φ, rfl⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff F).1 hwf.1
    obtain ⟨Δ, rfl⟩ := exists_ccode D fun i hi => by simpa using hwf.2 i hi
    refine ⟨k, Δ, Φ, rfl, ?_⟩
    -- premises
    have prem : ∀ i, i < llen (encList l) → ∀ K D F, lnth (encList l) i = pj K D F →
        ∃ Δ' φ', D = ccode Δ' ∧ F = fcode φ' ∧ Ctx K Δ' ⊢₁ φ' := by
      intro i hi K D F he
      rw [llen_encList] at hi
      obtain ⟨k', Δ', φ', e, hd⟩ := ih _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
      rw [lnth_encList, getD_eq_getElem' _ _ hi, e] at he
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := pj_inj he
      exact ⟨Δ', φ', rfl, rfl, hd⟩
    rw [ruleC_iff] at hrule
    simp only [rC0, rC1, rC2, rC3, rC4, rC5, rC6, rC7, rC8, rC9, rC10, rC11, rC12, rC13, rC14,
      rC15, rC16, rC17, qtag, qdat, qjs, qprem, qk, qD, qF, pj, fst_pair, snd_pair,
      Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hrule
    rcases hrule with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · -- assumption
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hi⟩, he⟩ := h
      rw [llen_ccode] at hi
      rw [lnth_ccode _ _ hi] at he
      exact Proves.hyp (Or.inr (fcode_inj he ▸ List.getElem_mem hi))
    · -- axiom
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, h₁⟩, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 h₁
      obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 h₂
      rw [← hψ, shiftNC_fcode] at h₃
      rw [← hψ, ← hχ, isPAC_iff] at h₄
      exact Proves.hyp (Or.inl ⟨ψ, (PA_iff ψ).2 (h₄.imp id fun e => ⟨χ, e⟩), (fcode_inj h₃).symm⟩)
    · -- →I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_imp ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair, lcons_ccode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ', φ', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.impI (hd.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k A Δ))
    · -- →E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, A, e₁, e₂, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [e₂] at hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₃, e₄, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₁
      rw [← fcode_imp] at e₄
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₀
      exact Proves.impE hd₀ hd₁
    · -- ∧I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp₀ hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, B', e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      exact Proves.conjI hd₀ hd₁
    · -- ∧E₁
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 3)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂.2.1] at hd
      exact Proves.conjE₁ hd
    · -- ∧E₂
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_conj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 3)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂.2.2] at hd
      exact Proves.conjE₂ hd
    · -- ∨I₁
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.disjI₁ hd
    · -- ∨I₂
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, B', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.disjI₂ hd
    · -- ∨E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩, hp₂⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_disj (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 4)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      obtain ⟨-, e₂⟩ := e₂
      rw [e₂] at hp₁ hp₂
      simp only [fst_pair, snd_pair, lcons_ccode] at hp₁ hp₂
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, φ₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₂, φ₂, e₅, e₆, hd₂⟩ := prem 2 hl _ _ _ hp₂
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₅, ← fcode_inj e₆] at hd₂
      exact Proves.disjE hd₀ (hd₁.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k A Δ)) (hd₂.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k B Δ))
    · -- ⊥E
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj (e₂.symm.trans fcode_bot.symm).symm] at hd
      exact Proves.botE hd
    · -- RAA
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hp⟩ := h
      rw [← fcode_neg, lcons_ccode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj (e₂.symm.trans fcode_bot.symm).symm] at hd
      exact Proves.raa (hd.weaken (ctx_cons_sub k _ Δ))
    · -- ∀I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hs⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_all ht
      have hs := (shiftedC_iff (Δ := Δ) (by simp only [qD, fst_pair, snd_pair])).1 hs
      rw [hs] at hp
      simp only [fcode, snd_pair] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, A', e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.allI (hd.weaken (ctx_shift_sub k Δ))
    · -- ∀E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hp⟩, hi⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC ht
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_all (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 5)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [e₂.2, ← hT, instC_fcode] at hi
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd
      rw [← fcode_inj hi]
      exact Proves.allE T hd
    · -- ∃I
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, ht⟩, hT⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_ex ht
      obtain ⟨T, hT'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hT
      rw [← hT'] at hp
      simp only [fcode, snd_pair, instC_fcode] at hp
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd⟩ := prem 0 hl _ _ _ hp
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd
      exact Proves.exI T hd
    · -- ∃E
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hs⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩ := h
      have hs := (shiftedC_iff (Δ := Δ) (by simp only [qD, fst_pair, snd_pair])).1 hs
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_ex (by rw [← e₂]; simp : fst (fcode C) = 6)
      simp only [fcode, pair_eq_pair] at e₂
      rw [e₂.2, hs, lcons_ccode, shiftC_fcode] at hp₁
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, φ₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      refine Proves.exE hd₀ (hd₁.weaken ?_)
      exact Subset.trans (ctx_cons_sub (k + 1) A _)
        (insert_mono (ctx_shift_sub k Δ) A)
    · -- reflexivity
      obtain ⟨⟨-, ht⟩, he⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨t, s, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_eq ht
      simp only [fcode, fst_pair, snd_pair] at he
      rw [tcode_inj he]
      exact Proves.refl s
    · -- Leibniz's law
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨-, hl⟩, hA⟩, hS⟩, hT⟩, hp₀⟩, hp₁⟩, hi⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨A, hA'⟩ := (isFormulaC_iff _).1 hA
      obtain ⟨S, hS'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hS
      obtain ⟨T, hT'⟩ := tcode_of_isTermC hT
      rw [← pair_fst_snd (snd (snd w)), ← hS', ← hT', ← fcode_eq] at hp₀
      rw [← hA', ← hS', instC_fcode] at hp₁
      rw [← hA', ← hT', instC_fcode] at hi
      obtain ⟨Δ₀, C₀, e₁, e₂, hd₀⟩ := prem 0 (by omega) _ _ _ hp₀
      obtain ⟨Δ₁, C₁, e₃, e₄, hd₁⟩ := prem 1 hl _ _ _ hp₁
      rw [← ccode_inj e₁, ← fcode_inj e₂] at hd₀
      rw [← ccode_inj e₃, ← fcode_inj e₄] at hd₁
      rw [← fcode_inj hi]
      exact Proves.subst hd₀ hd₁

Foundations.Numbers.zToQ_embedding:
/-- **ℤ embeds in ℚ.** `zToQ` is injective and preserves `0`, `1`, `+`, `×` and `≤`. -/
theorem zToQ_embedding :
    zToQ 0 = 0 ∧ zToQ 1 = 1 ∧ (∀ x y, zToQ (x + y) = zToQ x + zToQ y) ∧
    (∀ x y, zToQ (x * y) = zToQ x * zToQ y) ∧ (∀ x y, x ≤ y ↔ zToQ x ≤ zToQ y) ∧
    (∀ x y, zToQ x = zToQ y → x = y) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun x y => ?_, fun x y => ?_, fun x y => ?_, fun x y h => ?_⟩
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_add, Q.mk_eq_mk, Z.toInt_add]; omega
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_mul, Q.mk_eq_mk, Z.toInt_mul]; omega
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_le, Z.toInt_le]; omega
  · simp only [zToQ, Q.mk_eq_mk] at h; exact Z.toInt_inj (by omega)

theorem natDegree_eq_of {p : Polynomial R} {n : Nat} (h1 : DegLT p (n + 1)) (h2 : coeff p n ≠ 0) :
    natDegree p = n := by
  have hle := len_le h1
  have hge : n + 1 ≤ len p := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => h2 (degLT_len p n (by omega))
  unfold natDegree; omega

/-- Linearity: `∫ (f + g) = ∫ f + ∫ g` for continuous `f`, `g`. -/
theorem integral_add' {f g : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ∀ x, R.ContinuousAt f x)
    (hg : ∀ x, R.ContinuousAt g x) :
    integral (fun x => f x + g x) a b = integral f a b + integral g a b :=

Foundations.Algebra.autOfRingHom:
/-- **An automorphism from an endomorphism.** A ring homomorphism `τ : L → L` fixing `K`, with
`[L : K]` finite, is an element of `Aut(L/K)`. -/
noncomputable def autOfRingHom {K L : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L) (hfin : FiniteExt K L hKL)
    (τ : RingHom L L) (hfix : ∀ x : L, x.1 ∈ K → τ.toFun x = x) : FieldAut K L where
  toFun := τ.toFun
  invFun y := Classical.choose (ringHom_surjective_of_finite hΩ hKL hfin τ hfix y)
  left_inv x := RingHom.injective_of_isField (L.isField hΩ) (L.isField hΩ).1 τ
    (Classical.choose_spec (ringHom_surjective_of_finite hΩ hKL hfin τ hfix (τ.toFun x)))
  right_inv y := Classical.choose_spec (ringHom_surjective_of_finite hΩ hKL hfin τ hfix y)
  map_add := τ.map_add
  map_mul := τ.map_mul
  fix := hfix

Foundations.Algebra.MulAction:
/-- **Group action.** An action of the group `G` on a type `X` is an operation
`g • x` such that `1 • x = x` and `(g * h) • x = g • (h • x)`. -/
class MulAction (G : Type u) [Group G] (X : Type v) extends SMul G X where
  /-- The identity acts trivially. -/
  one_smul : ∀ x : X, (1 : G) • x = x
  /-- Acting by a product is acting successively. -/
  mul_smul : ∀ (g h : G) (x : X), (g * h) • x = g • (h • x)
Foundations.Logic.FO.mle_succ_numM_iff:
/-- Below a numeral, strictly: `S x ≤ n̄` iff `x = ī` with `i < n`. -/
theorem mle_succ_numM_iff (x : M.Dom) (n : Nat) :
    mle M (ms M x) (numM M n) ↔ ∃ i, i < n ∧ x = numM M i := by
  rw [mle_numM_iff hM]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => exact absurd h (hM.succ_ne_zero _)
    | succ i => exact ⟨i, by omega, hM.succ_inj _ _ h⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i + 1, by omega, rfl⟩

Foundations.Combinatorics.nodup_map_of_i:
/-- Mapping an injective function preserves the absence of duplicates. -/
theorem nodup_map_of_inj {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b) :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, l.Nodup → (l.map f).Nodup
  | [], _ => List.nodup_nil
  | a :: l, h => by
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at h
      rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons]
      refine ⟨fun hm => ?_, nodup_map_of_inj hf h.2⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hm
      exact h.1 (hf _ _ he ▸ hb)

/-- The partition points increase: a tagged partition of `[a, b]` has `a ≤ b`. -/
theorem IsTagged.le {a b : R} {l : List (R × R)} (h : IsTagged a l b) : a ≤ b := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => have : a = b := h; grind
  | cons p l ih => obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p; obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h; have := ih h3; grind
Foundations.NumberTheory.legendreSum_suc:
/-- How the Legendre sum changes from `n` to `n + 1`: by `min K (vₚ(n+1))`, the number of
`k ≤ K` with `pᵏ ∣ n + 1`. -/
theorem legendreSum_succ {p : Nat} (hp : 1 < p) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ K, legendreSum p (n + 1) K = legendreSum p n K + min K (vp p (n + 1)) := by
  intro K
  induction K with
  | zero => simp [legendreSum]
  | succ K ih =>
    simp only [legendreSum]
    rw [succ_div_eq (Nat.pow_pos (by omega)), ih]
    have hiff := pow_dvd_iff_le_vp (e := K + 1) hp (show 0 < n + 1 by omega)
    by_cases h : p ^ (K + 1) ∣ n + 1
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; have := hiff.1 h; omega
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; have := mt hiff.2 h; omega
Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.unionPWO:
/-- The union of a chain of partial well-orderings is a partial well-ordering. -/
noncomputable def unionPWO : PWO α where
  dom := unionDom C
  lt := unionLt C
  lt_dom := fun _ _ ⟨W, hW, h⟩ =>
    ⟨⟨W, hW, (W.lt_dom _ _ h).1⟩, ⟨W, hW, (W.lt_dom _ _ h).2⟩⟩
  irrefl := fun x ⟨W, _, h⟩ => W.irrefl x h
  trans := fun x y z ⟨W, hW, hxy⟩ ⟨V, hV, hyz⟩ => by
    have hy : V.dom y := (V.lt_dom y z hyz).1
    have hxy' : V.lt x y := (unionLt_iff C hC hV hy).1 ⟨W, hW, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨V, hV, V.trans x y z hxy' hyz⟩
  total := fun x y ⟨W, hW, hx⟩ ⟨V, hV, hy⟩ => by
    rcases hC W V hW hV with h | h
    · rcases V.total x y (h.1 x hx) hy with h' | h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl ⟨V, hV, h'⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨V, hV, h'⟩)
    · rcases W.total x y hx (h.1 y hy) with h' | h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl ⟨W, hW, h'⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨W, hW, h'⟩)
  wf := fun S ⟨x, hSx, W, hW, hx⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨m, hSm, hm, hmin⟩ := W.wf S ⟨x, hSx, hx⟩
    refine ⟨m, hSm, ⟨W, hW, hm⟩, fun y hSy _ hym => ?_⟩
    have hym' : W.lt y m := (unionLt_iff C hC hW hm).1 hym
    exact hmin y hSy (W.lt_dom y m hym').1 hym'
Foundations.Algebra.tower_mono:
/-- The tower increases. -/
theorem tower_mono {m : Nat} : ∀ n, m ≤ n → (tower m).le (tower n)
  | 0, h => by rw [Nat.le_zero.1 h]; exact le_refl _
  | n + 1, h => by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with h' | h'
    · exact le_trans (tower_mono n (by omega)) (tower_le_succ n)
    · rw [h']; exact le_refl _

Foundations.Algebra.zagier_mem:
/-- Zagier's map preserves the set `S`. -/
theorem zagier_mem {t : Nat × Nat × Nat} (h : InS p t) : InS p (zagier t) := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  unfold InS at h ⊢
  simp only at h
  unfold zagier
  simp only
  by_cases h1 : x + z < y
  · rw [ite_true_of h1]
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, y = x + z + w := ⟨y - x - z, by omega⟩
    simp only
    rw [show x + z + w - x - z = w by omega]
    grind
  · rw [ite_false_of h1]
    by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
    · rw [ite_true_of h2]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, x + b = 2 * y := ⟨2 * y - x, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, y + c = x + z := ⟨x + z - y, by omega⟩
      simp only
      rw [show 2 * y - x = b by omega, show x + z - y = c by omega]
      grind
    · rw [ite_false_of h2]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, x = 2 * y + b := ⟨x - 2 * y, by omega⟩
      simp only
      rw [show x - 2 * y = b by omega, show x + z - y = y + b + z by omega]
      subst hb
      grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_gr:
/-- **Definability of partial recursive functions.** The graph formula `gr c a` is
true in `ℕ` under an environment `e` exactly when `c`, run on the inputs
`e 1, …, e a`, outputs `e 0`. -/
theorem sat_gr : ∀ (c : Code) (a : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat),
    Sat stdModel e (gr c a) ↔ Eval c (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)) (e 0)
  | .zero, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, eval_zero, Term.eval]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .zero, fun h => Eval.det h .zero⟩
  | .succ, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, eval_succ, Term.eval]
      have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)).headD 0 =
          (if a = 0 then zero else v 1).eval stdModel e := by
        cases a with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ a => simp [List.ofFn_succ]; rfl
      rw [← this]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .succ, fun h => Eval.det h .succ⟩
  | .proj i, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, Term.eval]
      have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)).getD i 0 =
          (if i < a then v (i + 1) else zero).eval stdModel e := by
        by_cases h : i < a
        · simp [h, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]; rfl
        · simp [h, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rw [← this]
      exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; exact .proj, fun h => Eval.det h .proj⟩
  | @Code.comp k f gs, a, e => by
      simp only [gr, sat_exN, Sat, sat_conjL, List.mem_ofFn, forall_exists_index,
        forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval, Env.cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e', he', hg, hf⟩
        have h0 : e' k = e 0 := by simpa using he' 0
        have hxs : (List.ofFn fun j : Fin a => e' (j + 1 + k)) = List.ofFn fun j : Fin a => e (j + 1) :=
          by congr 1; funext j; exact he' _
        refine .comp (fun i => e' i) (fun i => ?_) ?_
        · have := hg i; rwa [hxs] at this
        · rwa [h0] at hf
      · intro h
        cases h with
        | comp vs hg hf =>
            refine ⟨fun n => if hn : n < k then vs ⟨n, hn⟩ else e (n - k), fun n => ?_, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
            · have : ¬ (n + k < k) := by omega
              simp [this]
            · simp only [Fin.is_lt, dite_true, show ∀ j : Nat, ¬ (j + 1 + k < k) from fun j => by omega,
                dite_false, show ∀ j : Nat, j + 1 + k - k = j + 1 from fun j => by omega]
              exact hg i
            · simp only [Fin.is_lt, dite_true, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false, Nat.sub_self]
              exact hf
  | .prec f g, 0, e => by
      simp only [gr, Sat, List.ofFn_zero, false_iff]
      intro h; cases h
  | .prec f g, a + 1, e => by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, eval_prec_iff_beta]
      simp only [gr, Sat, sat_substL, sat_betaF, sat_ltF, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval,
        Env.cons, List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ, eval_zero, eval_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, List.ofFn_succ]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨A, B, ⟨⟨r₀, hr₀, hf⟩, hs⟩, hy⟩
        refine ⟨A, B, by rw [← hr₀]; exact hf, fun j hj => ?_, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨u, w, ⟨hu, hw⟩, hg⟩ := hs j hj
        rw [← hu, ← hw]; exact hg
      · rintro ⟨A, B, hf, hs, hy⟩
        exact ⟨A, B, ⟨⟨_, rfl, hf⟩, fun j hj => ⟨_, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hs j hj⟩⟩, hy⟩
  | .mu f, a, e => by
      rw [eval_mu_iff]
      simp only [gr, Sat, sat_ltF_substL, sat_subst_cons, sat_gr, Term.eval, Env.cons, eval_zero,
        List.ofFn_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
      rfl
Foundations.Algebra.dedup:
/-- Remove repetitions from a list (keeping the last occurrence), deciding equality
classically. -/
noncomputable def dedup : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | a :: l => by
    classical
    exact if a ∈ dedup l then dedup l else a :: dedup l
Foundations.Categories.doubleNegation:
/-- **Double negation is a Lawvere–Tierney topology** on the topos of types. The logical
content is intuitionistically valid: `¬¬True`, `¬¬¬¬p ↔ ¬¬p` and `¬¬(p ∧ q) ↔ ¬¬p ∧ ¬¬q`
need no excluded middle (the axiom check still lists `Classical.choice`, inherited from
the construction of the topos structure on types). -/
def doubleNegation : LTTopology Type where
  j := fun p => ¬¬p
  truth_j := funext fun _ => propext ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ h => h trivial⟩
  idem := funext fun p => propext ⟨fun h hp => h fun hnn => hnn hp, fun h hn => hn h⟩
  and_j := funext fun ⟨p, q⟩ => by
    show (¬¬(Topos.and : Prop × Prop ⟶ Prop) (p, q)) =
      (Topos.and : Prop × Prop ⟶ Prop) (¬¬p, ¬¬q)
    rw [types_and, types_and]
    exact propext ⟨fun h => ⟨fun hp => h fun hpq => hp hpq.1, fun hq => h fun hpq => hq hpq.2⟩,
      fun ⟨hp, hq⟩ hpq => hp fun p' => hq fun q' => hpq ⟨p', q'⟩⟩
Foundations.Categories.expFunctor:
/-- The functor `A → −` on types (exponentiation). -/
def expFunctor (A : Type u) : Type u ⥤ Type u where
  obj Y := A → Y
  map f := fun g a => f (g a)
  map_id _ := rfl
  map_comp _ _ := rfl

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.step_:
/-- On a piece of a disjoint step function, its value is the coefficient of that piece. -/
theorem step_eval {l : List (R × (α → Prop))} (hd : DisjOn Prod.snd l) {p : R × (α → Prop)}
    (hp : p ∈ l) {x : α} (hx : p.2 x) : step l x = p.1 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd hp List.not_mem_nil
  | cons q l ih =>
    have hd' := List.pairwise_cons.1 hd
    show q.1 * ind q.2 x + step l x = p.1
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hp with rfl | hp
    · have : step l x = 0 := step_eval_zero fun r hr hr' => hd'.1 r hr x hx hr'
      rw [ind_pos hx, this]; grind
    · have : ¬ q.2 x := fun hq => hd'.1 p hp x hq hx
      rw [ind_neg this, ih hd'.2 hp]; grind
where
  /-- Off all pieces, a step function vanishes. -/
  step_eval_zero {l : List (R × (α → Prop))} {x : α} (h : ∀ p ∈ l, ¬ p.2 x) : step l x = 0 := by
    induction l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons q l ih =>
      show q.1 * ind q.2 x + step l x = 0
      rw [ind_neg (h q List.mem_cons_self), ih fun r hr => h r (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr)]; grind

/-- The identity substitution does nothing. -/

  induction t with
  | var n => rfl
  | app t u iht ihu => simp only [subst, iht, ihu]
  | lam t ih => simp only [subst, up_var, ih]
  | tlam t ih =>
    have : (fun n => tyRename Nat.succ (var n)) = var := rfl
    simp only [subst, this, ih]
  | tapp t B ih => simp only [subst, ih]
Foundations.Types.STLC.inl_red:
/-- **Left injections of reducible terms are reducible.** -/
theorem inl_red {A B : Ty} {a : Term} (ha : RED A a) : RED (.sum A B) (inl a) := by
  refine ⟨SN.map_of_inv inl inl_inv ((cr A).1 _ ha), fun a' h => ?_, fun b h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a'', he, hr⟩ := red_inv inl inl_inv h
    cases he
    exact red_red ha hr
  · obtain ⟨a'', he, _⟩ := red_inv inl inl_inv h
    cases he

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.outer:
/-- If `V` were measurable, each translate `V + r (mod 1)` would have the outer measure of `V`. -/
theorem outer_shift (hV : LebesgueMeasurable V) {r : R} (hr : I r) :
    outer (shift V r) = outer V := by
  have hVI : ∀ x, V x → I x := fun x h => h.1
  have hP1 : LebesgueMeasurable (fun x => V (x - r)) := hV.translate r
  -- Split `shift V r` along the first translate.
  have s1 := hP1.split (T := shift V r) (a := 0) (b := 1) fun x h => ⟨h.1.1, Std.le_of_lt h.1.2⟩
  have e1 : outer (fun x => shift V r x ∧ V (x - r)) = outer (fun x => V (x - r) ∧ I x) :=
    outer_congr fun x => by unfold shift; grind
  have e2 : outer (fun x => shift V r x ∧ ¬ V (x - r)) = outer (fun x => I x ∧ V (x - r + 1)) :=
    outer_congr fun x => ⟨fun ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩ => ⟨h1, h2.resolve_left h3⟩,
      fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, Or.inr h2⟩, fun h3 => by
        have := hVI _ h2; have := hVI _ h3; unfold I at *; grind⟩⟩
  -- Split the first translate along `[0, 1)`.
  have s2 := measurable_I.split (T := fun x => V (x - r)) (a := 0) (b := 2) fun x h => by
    have := hVI _ h; unfold I at *; unfold Icc; grind
  -- The part of the first translate beyond `1` is a translate of the second piece.
  have e3 : outer (fun x => V (x - r) ∧ ¬ I x) = outer (fun x => I x ∧ V (x - r + 1)) := by
    rw [← outer_translate (fun x => V (x - r) ∧ ¬ I x) (-1)]
    exact outer_congr fun x => by
      rw [show x - -1 - r = x - r + 1 by grind]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩; have := hVI _ h1; unfold I at *; grind
      · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩; have := hVI _ h2; unfold I at *; grind
  rw [s1, e1, e2, ← e3, ← s2, outer_translate]

Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.acc_of_halt:
/-- **Σ₁-completeness for the axiom clause.** If the proof search halts on `x`, then
`N` thinks so too. -/

Foundations.Algebra.finite_field_card:
/-- **Finite fields have prime-power order.** Every finite field has `pⁿ` elements, where the
prime `p` is its characteristic and `n` is its dimension over the prime field. -/
theorem finite_field_card : ∃ p n, IsPrime p ∧ card F = p ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := exists_char (F := F)
  have hpr := char_prime hF hp hmin
  let P := primeSubfield hF hp
  let T := topSubfield hF
  have hPT : P.le T := fun _ _ => trivial
  let V := T.over P hPT
  have hFP := P.isField hF
  -- `F` is finite-dimensional over `P`: the family of all elements spans.
  have hspan : Spans P (fun y : F => (⟨y, trivial⟩ : V)) := by
    intro x
    classical
    refine ⟨fun i => if i = x.1 then 1 else 0, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_isum]
    rw [isum_single _ x.1 (fun i hi => by
      show (if i = x.1 then (1 : P) else 0).1 * i = 0
      rw [ite_false_of hi]; exact Ring.zero_mul i)]
    show x.1 = (if x.1 = x.1 then (1 : P) else 0).1 * x.1
    rw [ite_true_of rfl]; exact (Ring.one_mul x.1).symm
  have hfin : FinDim P V := finDim_of_spans hspan
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis hFP hfin
  -- Coordinates with respect to the basis identify `F` with `Pⁿ`.
  let Φ : (Fin (dim P V) → P) → V := fun c => isum (fun i => c i • b i)
  have hinj : ∀ c d, Φ c = Φ d → c = d := by
    intro c d h
    have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp only [Φ, coe_isum] at h'
    have hz := hb.1 (fun i => c i + -d i) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      show isum (fun i => (c i + -d i).1 * (b i).1) = 0
      have e : (fun i => (c i + -d i).1 * (b i).1) =
          fun i => (c i • b i).1 + -(d i • b i).1 := by
        funext i; show ((c i).1 + -(d i).1) * (b i).1 = (c i).1 * (b i).1 + -((d i).1 * (b i).1)
        grind
      rw [e, isum_add, isum_neg, h']
      exact Ring.add_neg_cancel _)
    funext i
    apply Subtype.ext
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (hz i)
    show (c i).1 = (d i).1
    have e : (c i).1 + -(d i).1 = 0 := this
    grind
  have hsurj : ∀ v, ∃ c, Φ c = v := fun v => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb.2 v; exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩
  have h1 := count_comp_bij Φ hinj hsurj (fun _ => True)
  rw [count_true, count_true, card_tuple, card_primeSubfield hF hp hmin] at h1
  have h2 := count_comp_bij (fun v : V => v.1) (fun a b h => Subtype.ext h)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨y, trivial⟩, rfl⟩) (fun _ => True)
  rw [count_true, count_true] at h2
  exact ⟨p, dim P V, hpr, by rw [← h2, ← h1]⟩
Foundations.Topology.Cantor.val_injectiv:
/-- **Distinct digit sequences give distinct points.** -/
theorem val_injective : ∀ k (b b' : Nat → Bool), b k ≠ b' k → val b ≠ val b' := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro b b' hne; exact val_ne_of_head hne
  | succ k ih =>
    intro b b' hne he
    by_cases h0 : b 0 = b' 0
    · apply ih (fun j => b (j + 1)) (fun j => b' (j + 1)) hne
      have h := three_val b; have h' := three_val b'
      rw [h0] at h; grind
    · exact val_ne_of_head h0 he

Foundations.Numbers.C.nrm_pow_le:
/-- Powers and `‖·‖`: `‖zⁿ‖ ≤ ‖z‖ⁿ`. -/
theorem nrm_pow_le (z : C) (n : Nat) : nrm (z ^ n) ≤ nrm z ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show nrm 1 ≤ 1; unfold nrm; rw [one_re, one_im, R.abs_zero, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    show nrm (z ^ n * z) ≤ nrm z ^ n * nrm z
    have := nrm_mul (z ^ n) z
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (nrm_nonneg z)
    grind
Foundations.Numbers.OrderedFieldIso:
/-- An isomorphism of ordered fields: a bijection preserving addition, multiplication and
order. -/
structure OrderedFieldIso (F G : Type) [Add F] [Mul F] [LE F] [Add G] [Mul G] [LE G] where
  /-- The forward map. -/
  toFun : F → G
  /-- The inverse map. -/
  invFun : G → F
  /-- `invFun` undoes `toFun`. -/
  left_inv : ∀ x, invFun (toFun x) = x
  /-- `toFun` undoes `invFun`. -/
  right_inv : ∀ y, toFun (invFun y) = y
  /-- Addition is preserved. -/
  map_add : ∀ x y, toFun (x + y) = toFun x + toFun y
  /-- Multiplication is preserved. -/
  map_mul : ∀ x y, toFun (x * y) = toFun x * toFun y
  /-- Order is preserved and reflected. -/
  map_le : ∀ x y, x ≤ y ↔ toFun x ≤ toFun y
Foundations.Logic.mem_allUpTo_succ:
/-- Membership in the next enumeration list, unfolded one level. -/
theorem mem_allUpTo_succ {φ : Formula} {n : Nat} : φ ∈ allUpTo (n + 1) ↔
    φ = bot ∨ (∃ k, k < n + 1 ∧ var k = φ) ∨
      ∃ a ∈ allUpTo n, ∃ b ∈ allUpTo n, φ ∈ [imp a b, conj a b, disj a b] := by
  rw [allUpTo]
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_range, List.mem_flatMap]
Foundations.Algebra.swap_mul_swap_c3:
/-- **Two transpositions make at most two 3-cycles.** -/
theorem swap_mul_swap_c3 {n : Nat} {a b c d : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    ∃ L : List (Perm (Fin n)), (∀ t, t ∈ L → IsC3 t) ∧ gprod L = swap a b * swap c d := by
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst hbc
    by_cases had : a = d
    · subst had; exact ⟨[], by simp, by rw [swap_comm b a, swap_mul_self]; rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨[c3 a b d], by simpa using ⟨a, b, d, hab, hcd, had, rfl⟩, Group.mul_one _⟩
  · by_cases hac : a = c
    · subst hac
      by_cases hbd : b = d
      · subst hbd; exact ⟨[], by simp, by rw [swap_mul_self]; rfl⟩
      · refine ⟨[c3 b a d], by simpa using ⟨b, a, d, Ne.symm hab, hcd, hbd, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show c3 b a d * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm a b]; rfl
    · by_cases hbd : b = d
      · subst hbd
        refine ⟨[c3 a b c], by simpa using ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show c3 a b c * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm c b]; rfl
      · by_cases had : a = d
        · subst had
          refine ⟨[c3 b a c], by simpa using ⟨b, a, c, Ne.symm hab, Ne.symm hcd, hbc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          show c3 b a c * 1 = _; rw [Group.mul_one, swap_comm a b, swap_comm c a]; rfl
        · refine ⟨[c3 a b c, c3 b c d], ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro t ht
            simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
            rcases ht with rfl | rfl
            · exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩
            · exact ⟨b, c, d, hbc, hcd, hbd, rfl⟩
          · show c3 a b c * (c3 b c d * 1) = _
            unfold c3
            rw [Group.mul_one, Group.mul_assoc, ← Group.mul_assoc (swap b c), swap_mul_self,
              Group.one_mul]

/-- Sums of definable functions are definable. -/
theorem DfnT.add {f g : (Nat → N.Dom) → N.Dom} (hf : N.DfnT f) (hg : N.DfnT g) :
    N.DfnT fun e => f e + g e := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hf; obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hg

Foundations.Categories.Topos:
/-- An **elementary topos**: a cartesian closed category with equalisers (hence all finite
limits) and a **subobject classifier** `true : 1 ⟶ Ω`: for every mono `m : U ⟶ X` there
is exactly one `χ : X ⟶ Ω` making `m` the pullback of `true` along `χ`. -/
class Topos (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] extends CartesianClosed C where
  /-- The equaliser object of `f, g`. -/
  eqObj : {X Y : C} → (X ⟶ Y) → (X ⟶ Y) → C
  /-- The equalising arrow. -/
  eqι : {X Y : C} → (f g : X ⟶ Y) → (eqObj f g ⟶ X)
  /-- It is an equaliser. -/
  isEq : ∀ {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y), IsEqualizer f g (eqObj f g) (eqι f g)
  /-- The object of truth values. -/
  Ω : C
  /-- The truth value "true". -/
  truth : one ⟶ Ω
  /-- The characteristic map of a subobject. -/
  classify : {U X : C} → (m : U ⟶ X) → Mono m → (X ⟶ Ω)
  /-- The subobject is the pullback of `true` along its characteristic map. -/
  classify_pullback : ∀ {U X : C} (m : U ⟶ X) (hm : Mono m),
    IsPullback (classify m hm) truth U m (terminal.lift U)
  /-- The characteristic map is unique. -/
  classify_uniq : ∀ {U X : C} (m : U ⟶ X) (hm : Mono m) (χ : X ⟶ Ω),
    IsPullback χ truth U m (terminal.lift U) → χ = classify m hm

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.total_pr:
/-- **The law of total probability** for a finite partition:
`P(A) = ∑ᵢ P(A ∩ Bᵢ)`, and `= ∑ᵢ P(A | Bᵢ) P(Bᵢ)` when every `Bᵢ` is possible. -/
theorem total_probability_partition {B : Nat → Event α} {n : Nat} (hB : P.IsPartition B n)
    (A : Event α) : P.prob A = sumN n fun i => P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ B i x) := by
  simp only [prob, sumN]
  rw [sumL_comm]
  refine sumL_congr fun x hx => ?_
  rw [ind_partition A x (hB x hx), sumN, ← sumL_mul_left]

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.outer:
/-- **Cutting a cover.** For a coverable `T` and any `c`:
`m*(T ∩ (−∞, c)) + m*(T ∩ (c, ∞)) ≤ m*(T)`. -/
theorem outer_cut {T : R → Prop} (hT : Coverable T) (c : R) :
    outer (fun x => T x ∧ x < c) + outer (fun x => T x ∧ c < x) ≤ outer T :=
  le_of_forall_eps fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨S, ⟨lo, hi, hlh, hcov, hS⟩, hSlt⟩ := outer_approx hT hε
    have h1 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ cutHi c (lo n) (hi n) - lo n := fun n => by
      have := (cut_spec (c := c) (hlh n)).1; grind
    have h2 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ hi n - cutLo c (lo n) (hi n) := fun n => by
      have := (cut_spec (c := c) (hlh n)).2.1; grind
    obtain ⟨s1, hs1, -⟩ := comparison h1 (fun n => by have := cut_spec (c := c) (hlh n); grind) hS
    obtain ⟨s2, hs2, -⟩ := comparison h2 (fun n => by have := cut_spec (c := c) (hlh n); grind) hS
    have e : s1 + s2 = S := (hs1.add hs2).unique (hS.congr fun n => (cut_spec (hlh n)).2.2.symm)
    have c1 : CoverSum (fun x => T x ∧ x < c) s1 :=
      ⟨lo, fun n => cutHi c (lo n) (hi n), fun n => (cut_spec (hlh n)).1, fun x ⟨hx, hxc⟩ => by
        obtain ⟨n, a, b⟩ := hcov x hx
        exact ⟨n, a, lt_cutHi b hxc⟩, hs1⟩
    have c2 : CoverSum (fun x => T x ∧ c < x) s2 :=
      ⟨fun n => cutLo c (lo n) (hi n), hi, fun n => (cut_spec (hlh n)).2.1, fun x ⟨hx, hxc⟩ => by
        obtain ⟨n, a, b⟩ := hcov x hx
        exact ⟨n, cutLo_lt a hxc, b⟩, hs2⟩
    have := outer_le c1; have := outer_le c2; grind

Foundations.Categories.IsPullback.unique:
/-- **Pullbacks are unique up to isomorphism.** -/
def uniqueIso (hP : IsPullback f g P p₁ p₂) (hQ : IsPullback f g Q q₁ q₂) : P ≅ Q where
  hom := hQ.lift p₁ p₂ hP.w
  inv := hP.lift q₁ q₂ hQ.w
  hom_inv_id := hP.hom_ext (by rw [assoc, hP.fac₁, hQ.fac₁, id_comp])
    (by rw [assoc, hP.fac₂, hQ.fac₂, id_comp])
  inv_hom_id := hQ.hom_ext (by rw [assoc, hQ.fac₁, hP.fac₁, id_comp])
    (by rw [assoc, hQ.fac₂, hP.fac₂, id_comp])

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.arith_cases:
/-- Case analysis over arithmetic formulas. -/
theorem Formula.arith_cases {P : Formula Arith → Prop} (hb : P bot)
    (he : ∀ t s, P (eq t s)) (hi : ∀ φ ψ, P (imp φ ψ)) (hc : ∀ φ ψ, P (conj φ ψ))
    (hd : ∀ φ ψ, P (disj φ ψ)) (ha : ∀ φ, P (all φ)) (hx : ∀ φ, P (ex φ)) : ∀ φ, P φ :=
  Formula.arith_induction hb he (fun φ ψ _ _ => hi φ ψ) (fun φ ψ _ _ => hc φ ψ)
    (fun φ ψ _ _ => hd φ ψ) (fun φ _ => ha φ) (fun φ _ => hx φ)

Foundations.Algebra.zagier_fixed_iff:
/-- **Zagier's involution has exactly one fixed point**, namely `(1, 1, (p - 1)/4)`. -/
theorem zagier_fixed_iff (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {t : Nat × Nat × Nat}
    (h : InS p t) : zagier t = t ↔ t = (1, 1, p / 4) := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz, hb1, hb2⟩ := h.facts hp h4
  have hS := h
  unfold InS at hS
  simp only at hS
  constructor
  · intro hfix
    by_cases h1 : x + z < y
    · rw [zagier_eq1 x y z h1] at hfix; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and] at hfix; omega
    · by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
      · rw [zagier_eq2 x y z h1 h2] at hfix
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hfix
        have hxy : y = x := by omega
        subst hxy
        -- Now `p = y (y + 4z)`, so `y ∣ p`.
        have hdvd : y ∣ p := ⟨y + 4 * z, by grind⟩
        rcases hp.2 y hdvd with h1' | h1'
        · subst h1'
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
          omega
        · exfalso
          have : y * y + 4 * y * z ≥ y * 1 + y * 4 := by
            have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left y (show 1 ≤ y by omega)
            have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left y (show 4 ≤ 4 * z by omega)
            grind
          omega
      · rw [zagier_eq3 x y z h1 h2] at hfix; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and] at hfix; omega
  · intro ht
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at ht
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := ht
    have hp5 : 5 ≤ p := by have := hp.1; omega
    rw [zagier_eq2 1 1 (p / 4) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega

  unfold rep; rw [this]

/-- Spans are unchanged by reindexing along `ofFin`. -/
theorem inSpan_ofFin {ι : Type w} [FiniteType ι] {u : ι → V} {x : V} :
    InSpan K (fun j : Fin (card ι) => u (ofFin j)) x ↔ InSpan K u x := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨c, hc⟩

  · intro ⟨c, hc⟩

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.linte:
/-- `∫ f` is at most any common bound of the integrals of simple functions below `f`. -/
theorem lintegral_le {f : α → R} {B : R} (h : ∀ l, IsSimple S l → Below l f → sint m l ≤ B) :
    lintegral m f ≤ B := by
  have hf : BddIntegral m f := ⟨B, h⟩
  unfold lintegral; rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hf)]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lub (LowerSum m f) (lowerSum_ne m f) (lowerSum_bdd m hf))).2

Foundations.Logic.FO.isModel_of_sat_PA:
/-- **A structure satisfying PA under one environment is a model of PA.** -/
theorem isModel_of_sat_PA {e₀ : Nat → M.Dom} (h : ∀ ψ, PA ψ → Sat M e₀ ψ) : IsModel M PA := by
  refine ⟨⟨e₀ 0⟩, fun ψ hψ e => ?_⟩
  cases hψ with
  | induction φ =>
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      exact sat_induction_of_closed φ B hB e₀ (h _ (PA.induction _)) e
  | succ_ne_zero =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [neg, Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.succ, Arith.zero]) (h _ PA.succ_ne_zero) e
  | succ_inj =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.succ]) (h _ PA.succ_inj) e
  | add_zero =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.add, Arith.zero, args₂]) (h _ PA.add_zero) e
  | add_succ =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.add, Arith.succ, args₂]) (h _ PA.add_succ) e
  | mul_zero =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.mul, Arith.zero, args₂]) (h _ PA.mul_zero) e
  | mul_succ =>
      exact sat_of_closed (fun n => by
        simp [Formula.Fresh, Term.Fresh, Arith.mul, Arith.add, Arith.succ, args₂])
        (h _ PA.mul_succ) e

/-- A common bound for finitely many monotone properties indexed by `j < m`. -/
theorem exists_bound_range (P : Nat → Nat → Prop) (hP : ∀ j x x', x ≤ x' → P j x → P j x') :
    ∀ m, (∀ j, j < m → ∃ x, P j x) → ∃ x, ∀ j, j < m → P j x
  | 0, _ => ⟨0, fun _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | m + 1, h => by
      obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := exists_bound_range P hP m fun j hj => h j (by omega)
      obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := h m (by omega)
      refine ⟨max x₁ x₂, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | rfl
      · exact hP j _ _ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) (hx₁ j hj)
      · exact hP j _ _ (Nat.le_max_right _ _) hx₂

/-- The `m`-th derivative in coefficient form: `k! · (Dᵐc)ₖ = (k + m)! · cₖ₊ₘ`. -/
theorem fact_mul_iterD (c : Nat → R) (m : Nat) :
    ∀ k, (fact k : R) * iterD m c k = (fact (k + m) : R) * c (k + m) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => intro k; rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro k
    show (fact k : R) * (((k : R) + 1) * iterD m c (k + 1)) = _
    have := ih (k + 1)
    rw [fact_succ'] at this
    rw [show k + (m + 1) = k + 1 + m by omega]
    grind

Foundations.Topology.Leibniz.integral_p:
/-- **Termwise integration**: `∫₀¹ p_N = S_N`. -/
theorem integral_p (N : Nat) : integral (p N) 0 1 = S N := by
  have hd : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → HasDerivAt
      (fun y => fsum (fun k => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1) * y ^ (2 * k + 1)) N) (p N t) t :=
    fun t _ _ => by
      refine HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (hasDerivAt_fsum _ _ N fun k _ =>
        (hasDerivAt_pow (2 * k) t).const_mul ((-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1))) ?_
      unfold p; apply fsum_congr; intro k _
      have : (0 : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
      have c : ((2 * k : Nat) : R) = 2 * (k : R) := by grind
      rw [c]; grind
  rw [integral_eq_sub (by grind) hd fun t _ _ => continuousAt_p N t]
  unfold S
  have h0 : fsum (fun k => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1) * (0 : R) ^ (2 * k + 1)) N = 0 :=
    fsum_zero' (f := fun (k : Nat) => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1) * (0 : R) ^ (2 * k + 1))
      (fun k => by show _ * ((0 : R) ^ (2 * k) * 0) = 0; grind) N
  rw [h0]
  rw [show (fun (k : Nat) => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1) * (1 : R) ^ (2 * k + 1)) =
    fun (k : Nat) => (-1 : R) ^ k / (2 * (k : R) + 1) from funext fun k => by rw [one_pow]; grind]
  grind

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.outer:
/-- **Countable subadditivity of Lebesgue outer measure.** (Left open in `OuterMeasure.lean`.)
If each `Aₙ` is coverable and `Σ m*(Aₙ) = s`, then `⋃ Aₙ` is coverable and `m*(⋃ Aₙ) ≤ s`. -/
theorem outer_iUnion_le {A : Nat → R → Prop} (hA : ∀ n, Coverable (A n)) {s : R}
    (hs : HasSum (fun n => outer (A n)) s) :
    Coverable (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) ∧ outer (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) ≤ s := by
  -- For each `ε`, merge covers of the `Aₙ` of lengths `< m*(Aₙ) + ε/2ⁿ⁺¹`.
  have key : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ S, CoverSum (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) S ∧ S ≤ s + ε := by
    intro ε hε
    have hc : ∀ n, ∃ p : (Nat → R) × (Nat → R) × R, (∀ k, p.1 k ≤ p.2.1 k) ∧
        (∀ x, A n x → ∃ k, p.1 k < x ∧ x < p.2.1 k) ∧ HasSum (fun k => p.2.1 k - p.1 k) p.2.2 ∧
        p.2.2 < outer (A n) + ε * (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) := fun n => by
      obtain ⟨t, ⟨lo, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩, ht⟩ := outer_approx (hA n) (eps_geom_pos hε n)
      exact ⟨(lo, hi, t), h1, h2, h3, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Classical.axiomOfChoice hc
    have hF : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (P i).2.1 j - (P i).1 j := fun i j => by have := (hP i).1 j; grind
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTle⟩ := comparison (fun n => hasSum_nonneg (hF n) (hP n).2.2.1)
      (fun n => Std.le_of_lt (hP n).2.2.2) (hs.add (hasSum_eps_geom ε))
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hSle⟩ := merge_hasSum hF (fun i => (hP i).2.2.1) hT
    refine ⟨S, ⟨fun k => (P (pairEnum k).1).1 (pairEnum k).2,
      fun k => (P (pairEnum k).1).2.1 (pairEnum k).2, fun k => (hP _).1 _, ?_, hS⟩, by grind⟩
    rintro x ⟨n, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hP n).2.1 x hn
    exact ⟨pairIndex (n, k), by simp only [pairEnum_surj]; exact hk⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, _⟩ := key 1 (by grind)
  exact ⟨⟨S, hS⟩, le_of_forall_eps fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hle⟩ := key ε hε; have := outer_le hS; grind⟩

Foundations.Sets.Comparability.maximal_t:
/-- A maximal partial injection is defined everywhere on `α` or hits everything in `β`. -/
theorem maximal_total {M : PInj α β} (hM : ∀ G, Le M G → G = M) :
    (∀ a, ∃ b, M.rel a b) ∨ (∀ b, ∃ a, M.rel a b) := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hn
  have ha : ∃ a, ∀ b, ¬ M.rel a b := Classical.byContradiction fun h =>
    hn (Or.inl fun a => Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨a, fun b hb => h' ⟨b, hb⟩⟩)
  have hb : ∃ b, ∀ a, ¬ M.rel a b := Classical.byContradiction fun h =>
    hn (Or.inr fun b => Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨b, fun a ha => h' ⟨a, ha⟩⟩)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := hb
  have heq := hM (M.add a₀ b₀ ha₀ hb₀) (fun a b h => Or.inl h)
  have : (M.add a₀ b₀ ha₀ hb₀).rel a₀ b₀ := Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [heq] at this
  exact ha₀ b₀ this
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.jordan:
/-- **Jordan's inequality**: `x ≤ (π/2) sin x` for `0 ≤ x ≤ π/2`. -/
theorem jordan {x : R} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ hpi) : x ≤ hpi * sin x := by
  have hp := hpi_pos
  have hpi_le : hpi ≤ pi := by unfold hpi; have := pi_pos; grind
  rcases (by grind : x = 0 ∨ x = hpi ∨ (0 < x ∧ x < hpi)) with e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩
  · rw [e, sin_zero]; grind
  · rw [e, sin_hpi]; grind
  · apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hneg
    let g : R → R := fun t => hpi * sin t - t
    let g' : R → R := fun t => hpi * cos t - 1
    have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t := fun t => by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_sin t).const_mul hpi).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)
      exact this
    obtain ⟨c₁, a1, a2, a3⟩ := mean_value (f := g) (f' := g') e1
      (fun t _ _ => (hd t).continuousAt) (fun t _ _ => hd t)
    obtain ⟨c₂, b1, b2, b3⟩ := mean_value (f := g) (f' := g') e2
      (fun t _ _ => (hd t).continuousAt) (fun t _ _ => hd t)
    have g0 : g 0 = 0 := by show hpi * sin 0 - 0 = 0; rw [sin_zero]; grind
    have gp : g hpi = 0 := by show hpi * sin hpi - hpi = 0; rw [sin_hpi]; grind
    have gx : g x < 0 := by show hpi * sin x - x < 0; grind
    rw [g0] at a3; rw [gp] at b3
    -- `g'(c₁) < 0 < g'(c₂)` but `g'` decreases.
    have k1 : g' c₁ < 0 := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
      have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ g' c₁) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ x - 0); grind
    have k2 : 0 < g' c₂ := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
      have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ -g' c₂) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ hpi - x); grind
    have k3 := cos_strictAnti (x := c₁) (y := c₂) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
    have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left k3 hp
    have : g' c₁ = hpi * cos c₁ - 1 := rfl
    have : g' c₂ = hpi * cos c₂ - 1 := rfl
    grind
