Foundations.Numbers.R.powErr_zero:
/-- The error term vanishes for `n = 0`. -/
theorem powErr_zero (x y : R) : powErr x y 0 = 0 := by
  unfold powErr; show y ^ 0 - x ^ 0 - ((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ 0 * (y - x) = 0; grind
Foundations.Combinatorics.InfOften.enum:
/-- An infinitely-often predicate can be enumerated by a strictly increasing sequence. -/
theorem InfOften.enum {P : Nat → Prop} (h : InfOften P) :
    ∃ g : Nat → Nat, (∀ i, P (g i)) ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → g i < g j := by
  let next : Nat → Nat := fun N => Classical.choose (h N)
  have hnext : ∀ N, N ≤ next N ∧ P (next N) := fun N => Classical.choose_spec (h N)
  let g : Nat → Nat := fun i => Nat.rec (next 0) (fun _ x => next (x + 1)) i
  have hg : ∀ i, g (i + 1) = next (g i + 1) := fun _ => rfl
  refine ⟨g, fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  · cases i with
    | zero => exact (hnext 0).2
    | succ i => rw [hg]; exact (hnext _).2
  · induction hij with
    | refl => rw [hg]; have := (hnext (g i + 1)).1; omega
    | @step m _ ih => rw [hg]; have := (hnext (g m + 1)).1; omega
Foundations.Topology.not_countable_union:
/-- **Baire, second form.** A non-empty complete metric space is not a countable union of
closed nowhere dense sets. -/
theorem not_countable_union_nowhereDense (hX : Complete X) (x₀ : X) {F : Nat → X → Prop}
    (hF : ∀ n, NowhereDenseClosed (F n)) : ¬ ∀ x, ∃ n, F n x := by
  intro hcov
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := baire hX (U := fun n x => ¬ F n x) (fun n => (hF n).1)
    (fun n x ε hε => by obtain ⟨y, h1, h2⟩ := (hF n).2 x ε hε; exact ⟨y, h2, h1⟩) x₀ 1 (by grind)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hcov y
  exact hy n hn
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.erase_subs:
/-- Erasure commutes with substitution (for a substitution tracked by `τ`). -/
theorem erase_subst {Γ Δ : List FTy} {A : FTy} (t : Tm Γ A) (σ : Sub Γ Δ) (τ : Nat → Term)
    (h : ∀ {B : FTy} (v : Mem B Γ), erase (σ v) = τ v.idx) :
    erase (subst σ t) = Foundations.Types.STLC.subst τ (erase t) := by
  induction t generalizing Δ τ with
  | var v => exact h v
  | lam t ih =>
    refine congrArg Term.lam (ih σ.lift _ fun v => ?_)
    cases v with
    | here => rfl
    | there w =>
      show erase (rename _ (σ w)) = Foundations.Types.STLC.rename Nat.succ (τ w.idx)
      rw [erase_rename (σ w) _ Nat.succ (fun _ => rfl), h w]
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    show Term.app _ _ = Term.app _ _
    rw [ih₁ σ τ h, ih₂ σ τ h]
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    show Term.pair _ _ = Term.pair _ _
    rw [ih₁ σ τ h, ih₂ σ τ h]
  | fst _ ih => exact congrArg Term.fst (ih σ τ h)
  | snd _ ih => exact congrArg Term.snd (ih σ τ h)
Foundations.Topology.Topology.continuous:

Foundations.Logic.FO.termModel:
/-- **The term model** of a maximal consistent Henkin theory: classes of terms modulo
provable equality, with function symbols acting syntactically and relations holding
exactly when the corresponding atomic formula is in `M`. -/
noncomputable def termModel : Structure L where
  Dom := Quotient (termSetoid hM)
  funcs := fun f a => Quotient.mk _ (.func f fun i => rep hM (a i))
  rels := fun R a => M (.rel R fun i => rep hM (a i))

Foundations.Algebra.eval_quinticPoly:

Foundations.Numbers.R.summable_of_bounde:
/-- **Bounded series of non-negative terms converge** (monotone convergence for series). -/
theorem summable_of_bounded {a : Nat → R} (hpos : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) {B : R}
    (hB : ∀ n, fsum a n ≤ B) : ∃ s, HasSum a s ∧ s ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := monotone_convergence (a := fsum a)
    (fun n => by rw [fsum_succ]; have := hpos n; grind) ⟨B, hB⟩
  exact ⟨s, hs, tendsto_le hs hB⟩

Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.extends_an:
/-- `Extends` is antisymmetric. -/
theorem extends_antisymm {W V : PWO α} (h₁ : Extends W V) (h₂ : Extends V W) : W = V := by
  have hdom : W.dom = V.dom := funext fun x => propext ⟨h₁.1 x, h₂.1 x⟩
  refine PWO.ext hdom (funext fun x => funext fun y => propext ?_)
  by_cases hy : W.dom y
  · exact (h₁.2 x y hy).symm
  · exact ⟨fun h => absurd (W.lt_dom x y h).2 hy,
      fun h => absurd (hdom ▸ (V.lt_dom x y h).2) hy⟩
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.recursion_theorem:
/-- **Dedekind's recursion theorem.** Let `a ∈ A` and let `g` map `A` into `A`.
Then there is exactly one function `F` from `ω` to `A` (a set of pairs) with
`F(∅) = a` and `F(succ n) = g(F(n))` for all `n ∈ ω`. -/
theorem recursion_theorem {A a : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) (g : ZFSet → ZFSet)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ A, g x ∈ A) :
    ∃ F, IsFunction F ω A ∧ app F ∅ = a ∧ (∀ n ∈ ω, app F (succ n) = g (app F n)) ∧
      ∀ G, IsFunction G ω A → app G ∅ = a → (∀ n ∈ ω, app G (succ n) = g (app G n)) →
        G = F := by
  have hF := recFun_isFunction ha hg
  have hcl := recFun_closed ha hg
  have h0 : app (recFun A a g) ∅ = a := app_eq hF hcl.1
  have hs : ∀ n ∈ ω, app (recFun A a g) (succ n) = g (app (recFun A a g) n) := fun n hn =>
    app_eq hF (hcl.2 n _ hn (app_spec hF hn))
  refine ⟨recFun A a g, hF, h0, hs, fun G hG hG0 hGs => function_ext hG hF ?_⟩
  refine omega_induction _ (hG0.trans h0.symm) fun n hn ih => ?_
  rw [hGs n hn, hs n hn, ih]

Foundations.Categories.typesColimitCocon:
/-- **The category of types has all small colimits**: the quotient of the disjoint sum is
a colimit of any small diagram of types. -/
def typesColimitCoconeIsColimit : IsColimit (typesColimitCocone F) where
  desc s := Quot.lift (fun p => s.ι p.1 p.2) (by
    rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨j, y⟩ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact (congrFun (s.w f) x).symm)

    | mk p => exact congrFun (hm p.1) p.2
Foundations.Bridges.ZModel:
/-- The ZF integers as a set-theoretic model of Part II's quotient type `Z`:
representatives `ω × ω`, relation `ZRel`, and encoding `(a, b) ↦ ⟪vn a, vn b⟫`. -/
noncomputable def ZModel : ZFModel (Nat × Nat) where
  S := prod ω ω
  R := ZRel
  enc p := npair p.1 p.2
  enc_mem p := mem_prod_omega.2 ⟨p.1, p.2, rfl⟩
  enc_surj p hp := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := mem_prod_omega.1 hp
    exact ⟨(a, b), rfl⟩
  rel_iff p q := by
    rw [zrel_iff, rel_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b, c, d, h₁, h₂, h⟩
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := npair_inj.1 h₁
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := npair_inj.1 h₂
      exact h
    · intro h
      exact ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl, rfl, h⟩
  rel_mem p q h := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, rfl, rfl, _⟩ := zrel_iff.1 h
    exact ⟨mem_prod_omega.2 ⟨a, b, rfl⟩, mem_prod_omega.2 ⟨c, d, rfl⟩⟩

Foundations.Topology.Stirling.exists_lim:
/-- **The sequence `dₙ` converges.** -/
theorem exists_lim : ∃ D, Tendsto s D := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := monotone_convergence (a := fun n => -s n) (fun n => by
    have := s_anti n; show -s n ≤ -s (n + 1); grind) ⟨-(s 0 - 1 / 4), fun n => by
      have := s_lower n; show -s n ≤ _; grind⟩
  refine ⟨-L, ?_⟩
  have := hL.const_mul (-1)

  exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by show -1 * -s n = s n; grind

Foundations.Topology.Ascoli.arzela_ascol:
/-- **Arzelà–Ascoli theorem.** A uniformly bounded, equicontinuous sequence of functions on
`[a, b]` has a subsequence converging uniformly on `[a, b]`. -/
theorem arzela_ascoli {fs : Nat → R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbdd : ∃ B, ∀ n x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → abs (fs n x) ≤ B)
    (heq : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ n x y, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → a ≤ y → y ≤ b →
      abs (x - y) < δ → abs (fs n x - fs n y) < ε) :
    ∃ φ : Nat → Nat, (∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) ∧ ∃ g : R → R,
      UnifOn (fun k => fs (φ k)) g (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd
  have hpt : ∀ k, a ≤ pt a b k ∧ pt a b k ≤ b := fun k => by
    have hq := Vitali.q_mem k; unfold Vitali.I at hq
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hq.2) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a)
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a) hq.1
    unfold pt; constructor <;> grind
  -- Strictly increasing index sequences.
  let S := {φ : Nat → Nat // ∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)}
  have step : ∀ (k : Nat) (φ : S), ∃ ψ : S, ∃ L, Tendsto (fun n => fs (φ.1 (ψ.1 n)) (pt a b k)) L :=
    fun k φ => by
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, L, hL⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (a := fun n => fs (φ.1 n) (pt a b k))
        ⟨B, fun n => hB _ _ (hpt k).1 (hpt k).2⟩
      exact ⟨⟨ψ, hψ⟩, L, hL⟩
  let nxt : Nat → S → S := fun k φ =>
    ⟨fun n => φ.1 ((step k φ).choose.1 n), fun n => smono_lt φ.2 ((step k φ).choose.2 n)⟩
  let Φ : Nat → S := fun k =>
    Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => S) ⟨fun n => n, fun n => Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩ (fun k φ => nxt k φ) k
  have hΦ : ∀ k, Φ (k + 1) = nxt k (Φ k) := fun _ => rfl
  -- `Φ (k+1)` converges at `pₖ`.
  have hconv : ∀ k, ∃ L, Tendsto (fun n => fs ((Φ (k + 1)).1 n) (pt a b k)) L := fun k => by
    rw [hΦ]; exact (step k (Φ k)).choose_spec
  -- Later sequences are subsequences of earlier ones.
  have hsub : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∃ σ : Nat → Nat, (∀ n, n ≤ σ n) ∧ ∀ n, (Φ j).1 n = (Φ i).1 (σ n) := by
    intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, j = i + d := ⟨j - i, by omega⟩
    induction d with
    | zero => exact ⟨fun n => n, fun n => Nat.le_refl n, fun n => rfl⟩
    | succ d ih =>
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ1, hσ2⟩ := ih (by omega)
      let ψ := (step (i + d) (Φ (i + d))).choose
      refine ⟨fun n => σ (ψ.1 n), fun n => Nat.le_trans (le_of_strictMono ψ.2 n) (hσ1 _),
        fun n => ?_⟩
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, hΦ]; exact hσ2 _
  -- The diagonal sequence.
  let D : Nat → Nat := fun n => (Φ n).1 n
  have hD : ∀ n, D n < D (n + 1) := fun n => by
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ1, hσ2⟩ := hsub n (n + 1) (by omega)
    show (Φ n).1 n < (Φ (n + 1)).1 (n + 1)
    rw [hσ2]; exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ((Φ n).2 n) (smono_le (Φ n).2 (hσ1 (n + 1)))
  -- The diagonal converges at every grid point, hence is Cauchy there.
  have hDc : ∀ k, ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ N, ∀ m m', N ≤ m → N ≤ m' →
      abs (fs (D m) (pt a b k) - fs (D m') (pt a b k)) < ε := fun k ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hconv k
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hL (ε / 2) (by grind)
    have key : ∀ m, max (k + 1) N ≤ m → abs (fs (D m) (pt a b k) - L) < ε / 2 := fun m hm => by
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ1, hσ2⟩ := hsub (k + 1) m (by omega)
      show abs (fs ((Φ m).1 m) (pt a b k) - L) < ε / 2
      rw [hσ2]; exact hN _ (Nat.le_trans (by omega) (hσ1 m))
    refine ⟨max (k + 1) N, fun m m' hm hm' => ?_⟩
    have k1 := key m hm; have k2 := key m' hm'
    rw [abs_sub_comm] at k2
    have := OF.abs_add (fs (D m) (pt a b k) - L) (L - fs (D m') (pt a b k))
    rw [show fs (D m) (pt a b k) - L + (L - fs (D m') (pt a b k)) =
      fs (D m) (pt a b k) - fs (D m') (pt a b k) by grind] at this
    grind
  -- Uniformly Cauchy on `[a, b]`.
  have hunifC : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ N, ∀ m m', N ≤ m → N ≤ m' → ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b →
      abs (fs (D m) x - fs (D m') x) < ε := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := heq (ε / 3) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := exists_div_lt (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a) hδ
    let K := (n₀ + 1) * (n₀ + 1)
    -- One `N` for all grid points of index `< K`.
    have hfin : ∀ K', ∃ N, ∀ k, k < K' → ∀ m m', N ≤ m → N ≤ m' →
        abs (fs (D m) (pt a b k) - fs (D m') (pt a b k)) < ε / 3 := by
      intro K'
      induction K' with
      | zero => exact ⟨0, fun k hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)⟩
      | succ K' ih =>
        obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hDc K' (ε / 3) (by grind)
        refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun k hk m m' hm hm' => ?_⟩
        rcases (by omega : k < K' ∨ k = K') with e | e
        · exact h₁ k e m m' (by omega) (by omega)
        · rw [e]; exact h₂ m m' (by omega) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hfin K
    refine ⟨N, fun m m' hm hm' x h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := grid_near hab h1 h2 n₀
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Vitali.tri_surj n₀ j hj
    have hkK : k < K := by
      have := tri_index k; rw [hk] at this; simp only at this
      have : n₀ * n₀ + j < (n₀ + 1) * (n₀ + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]; omega
      omega
    have hpk : pt a b k = a + (b - a) * ((j : R) / ((n₀ : R) + 1)) := by
      unfold pt Vitali.q; rw [hk]
    have hclose : abs (x - pt a b k) < δ := by
      rw [hpk]; exact Std.lt_of_le_of_lt hjx (hn₀ n₀ (Nat.le_refl _))
    have k1 := hδ' (D m) x (pt a b k) h1 h2 (hpt k).1 (hpt k).2 hclose
    have k2 := hδ' (D m') x (pt a b k) h1 h2 (hpt k).1 (hpt k).2 hclose
    have k3 := hN k hkK m m' hm hm'
    have := abs_sub_le3 (fs (D m) x) (fs (D m) (pt a b k)) (fs (D m') (pt a b k)) (fs (D m') x)
    rw [abs_sub_comm (fs (D m') (pt a b k)) (fs (D m') x)] at this
    grind
  -- The pointwise limits form the uniform limit.
  have hlim : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ∃ L, Tendsto (fun m => fs (D m) x) L := fun x h1 h2 =>
    cauchy_complete fun ε hε => by
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hunifC ε hε
      exact ⟨N, fun m m' hm hm' => hN m m' hm hm' x h1 h2⟩
  let g : R → R := fun x =>
    open Classical in if h : ∃ L, Tendsto (fun m => fs (D m) x) L then h.choose else 0
  have hg : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → Tendsto (fun m => fs (D m) x) (g x) := fun x h1 h2 => by
    have h := hlim x h1 h2
    show Tendsto _ (open Classical in if h : ∃ L, Tendsto (fun m => fs (D m) x) L then h.choose else 0)
    rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h)]; exact h.choose_spec
  refine ⟨D, hD, g, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hunifC (ε / 2) (by grind)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn x hx => ?_⟩
  -- Pass to the limit in `m` in `|f_{D n}(x) − f_{D m}(x)| < ε/2`.
  have : abs (fs (D n) x - g x) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hlt
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hg x hx.1 hx.2 (abs (fs (D n) x - g x) - ε / 2) (by grind)
    have k1 := hM (max M N) (by omega)
    have k2 := hN n (max M N) hn (by omega) x hx.1 hx.2
    have := OF.abs_add (fs (D n) x - fs (D (max M N)) x) (fs (D (max M N)) x - g x)
    rw [show fs (D n) x - fs (D (max M N)) x + (fs (D (max M N)) x - g x) = fs (D n) x - g x by
      grind] at this
    grind
  show abs (fs (D n) x - g x) < ε
  grind

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.level:
/-- The properties of the levels. -/
theorem levels_spec {f : α → R} (hf : Measurable S f) (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {δ : R} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (K : Nat) :
    (∀ l ∈ levels f δ K, S.M l.2.2) ∧ DisjOn (fun l => l.2.2) (levels f δ K) ∧
      (∀ x, UnionOf (fun l => l.2.2) (levels f δ K) x) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ levels f δ K, 0 ≤ l.1 ∧ l.2.1 = l.1 + δ ∧
        ∀ x, l.2.2 x → l.1 ≤ f x ∧ (f x < l.2.1 ∨ (K : R) * δ ≤ l.1)) := by
  have nn : ∀ j : Nat, (0 : R) ≤ (j : R) := fun j => OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have mono : ∀ i j : Nat, i + 1 ≤ j → ((i : R) + 1) * δ ≤ (j : R) * δ := fun i j h => by
    have : ((i + 1 : Nat) : R) ≤ (j : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ h
    exact OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by grind) (Std.le_of_lt hδ)
  refine ⟨fun l hl => ?_, ?_, fun x => ?_, fun l hl => ?_⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hl with hl | hl
    · obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hl; exact S.inter (hf.ge _) (hf.lt _)
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]; exact hf.ge _
  · refine List.pairwise_append.2 ⟨List.pairwise_map.2 (List.nodup_range.imp fun {i j} hij x h1 h2 =>
      ?_), List.pairwise_singleton _ _, fun a ha b hb x h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
      · have := mono i j h; grind
      · have := mono j i h; grind
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
      rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hb] at h2
      have := mono j K (List.mem_range.1 hj); grind
  · have key : ∀ K : Nat, (∃ j, j < K ∧ (j : R) * δ ≤ f x ∧ f x < ((j : R) + 1) * δ) ∨
        (K : R) * δ ≤ f x := by
      intro K
      induction K with
      | zero => right; have := hf0 x; show ((0 : Nat) : R) * δ ≤ f x; grind
      | succ K ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨j, hj, h⟩ | h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨j, by omega, h⟩
        · by_cases h' : ((K + 1 : Nat) : R) * δ ≤ f x
          · exact Or.inr h'
          · exact Or.inl ⟨K, by omega, h, by grind⟩
    rcases key K with ⟨j, hj, h⟩ | h
    · exact ⟨_, List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.2 ⟨j, List.mem_range.2 hj, rfl⟩), h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self _), h⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hl with hl | hl
    · obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hl
      exact ⟨OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (nn j) (Std.le_of_lt hδ), by grind,
        fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, Or.inl hx.2⟩⟩
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]
      exact ⟨OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (nn K) (Std.le_of_lt hδ), by grind,
        fun x hx => ⟨hx, Or.inr (Std.le_refl _)⟩⟩

Foundations.Categories.Lambek.sem_sound:
/-- **Soundness of reduction (Lambek)**: if `t` reduces to `t'` in one step, then `t` and
`t'` denote the same arrow in every cartesian closed category, under every interpretation
of the atomic types. Computation is invisible to the semantics: β-reduction *is*
equality of arrows. -/
theorem sem_sound {Γ : List FTy} {A : FTy} {t t' : Tm Γ A} (h : TStep t t') :
    semTm ι t = semTm ι t' := by
  induction h with
  | beta t u => exact sem_beta ι t u
  | fstPair a b => exact pair_fst _ _
  | sndPair a b => exact pair_snd _ _
  | appL u _ ih =>
    show pair _ _ ≫ eval = pair _ _ ≫ eval
    rw [ih]
  | appR t _ ih =>
    show pair _ _ ≫ eval = pair _ _ ≫ eval
    rw [ih]
  | lam _ ih =>
    show curry _ = curry _
    rw [ih]
  | pairL b _ ih =>
    show pair _ _ = pair _ _
    rw [ih]
  | pairR a _ ih =>
    show pair _ _ = pair _ _
    rw [ih]
  | fst _ ih =>
    show _ ≫ fst = _ ≫ fst
    rw [ih]
  | snd _ ih =>
    show _ ≫ snd = _ ≫ snd
    rw [ih]

  have : count (fun x => Q x ∧ P x) = count P :=
    count_congr fun x => ⟨fun hx => hx.2, fun hx => ⟨h x hx, hx⟩⟩

/-- A theory is **maximal consistent and Henkin** if it is consistent, decides every

structure MaximalHenkin (M : Theory L) : Prop where

Foundations.Geometry.div_mem_unit:
/-- A quotient `u / v` with `0 ≤ u ≤ v`, `0 < v` lies in the unit interval. -/
theorem div_mem_unit {u v : K} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hv : 0 < v) :
    0 ≤ u / v ∧ u / v ≤ 1 := by
  have hi : 0 < v⁻¹ := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hv
  have h1 := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hu (by grind : 0 ≤ v⁻¹)
  have h2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right huv (by grind : 0 ≤ v⁻¹)

Foundations.Algebra.cosetSetoid:
/-- The relation "`a` and `b` lie in the same left coset of `N`", i.e. `a⁻¹ * b ∈ N`. It is an
equivalence relation. -/
def cosetSetoid (N : Subgroup G) : Setoid G where
  r a b := a⁻¹ * b ∈ N
  iseqv := {
    refl := fun a => by show a⁻¹ * a ∈ N; rw [inv_mul_cancel]; exact N.one_mem
    symm := fun {a b} h => by
      show b⁻¹ * a ∈ N
      have := N.inv_mem h
      rwa [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] at this
    trans := fun {a b c} h1 h2 => by
      show a⁻¹ * c ∈ N
      have := N.mul_mem h1 h2
      rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left] at this }

    (h : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) : L ≤ M := by
  have := le_of_tendsto (hb.sub ha) (c := 0) fun n => by have := h n; grind
  grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.eval_mu_iff:
/-- Minimisation, unfolded. -/
theorem eval_mu_iff (f : Code) (xs : List Nat) (y : Nat) :
    Eval (.mu f) xs y ↔ Eval f (y :: xs) 0 ∧ ∀ m, m < y → ∃ w, Eval f (m :: xs) w ∧ ¬ w = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | mu ks h₀ hlt => exact ⟨h₀, fun m hm => ⟨ks m + 1, hlt m hm, by omega⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₀, hlt⟩
    refine .mu (fun m => if hm : m < y then Classical.choose (hlt m hm) - 1 else 0) h₀
      (fun m hm => ?_)
    simp only [hm, dite_true]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hlt m hm)
    rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.determination:
/-- **The determination lemma.** If `1 = λp + μq`, `p = λ + μγ`, `q = λγ + μ` with
`λ ≥ 0`, `μ > 0`, `γ > 1`, and the same holds for `λ', μ', γ'` with the *same* `p, q`,
then `λ = λ'` and `μ = μ'`. -/
theorem determination {p q l m g l' m' g' : R} (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hm : 0 < m) (hg : 1 < g)
    (hl' : 0 ≤ l') (hm' : 0 < m') (hg' : 1 < g')
    (e₁ : 1 = l * p + m * q) (e₂ : p = l + m * g) (e₃ : q = l * g + m)
    (e₁' : 1 = l' * p + m' * q) (e₂' : p = l' + m' * g') (e₃' : q = l' * g' + m') :
    l = l' ∧ m = m' := by
  -- `γ` solves `γ² − 2pqγ + p² + q² − 1 = 0`
  have hl1 : l * (1 - g * g) = p - q * g := by rw [e₂, e₃]; grind
  have hm1 : m * (1 - g * g) = q - p * g := by rw [e₂, e₃]; grind
  have hl1' : l' * (1 - g' * g') = p - q * g' := by rw [e₂', e₃']; grind
  have hm1' : m' * (1 - g' * g') = q - p * g' := by rw [e₂', e₃']; grind
  have quad : g * g - 2 * p * q * g + p * p + q * q - 1 = 0 := by
    have k₀ : (1 - g * g) = (l * p + m * q) * (1 - g * g) := by rw [← e₁]; grind
    have k₁ : p * (l * (1 - g * g)) = p * (p - q * g) := by rw [hl1]
    have k₂ : q * (m * (1 - g * g)) = q * (q - p * g) := by rw [hm1]
    grind
  have quad' : g' * g' - 2 * p * q * g' + p * p + q * q - 1 = 0 := by
    have k₀ : (1 - g' * g') = (l' * p + m' * q) * (1 - g' * g') := by rw [← e₁']; grind
    have k₁ : p * (l' * (1 - g' * g')) = p * (p - q * g') := by rw [hl1']
    have k₂ : q * (m' * (1 - g' * g')) = q * (q - p * g') := by rw [hm1']
    grind
  -- and it is the larger root: `γ − pq = λμ(γ² − 1) ≥ 0`
  have ge : g - p * q = l * m * (g * g - 1) := by
    have e1s : 1 = l * (l + m * g) + m * (l * g + m) := by rw [e₂, e₃] at e₁; exact e₁
    have k : g = (l * (l + m * g) + m * (l * g + m)) * g := by rw [← e1s]; grind
    rw [e₂, e₃]
    grind
  have ge' : g' - p * q = l' * m' * (g' * g' - 1) := by
    have e1s : 1 = l' * (l' + m' * g') + m' * (l' * g' + m') := by rw [e₂', e₃'] at e₁'; exact e₁'
    have k : g' = (l' * (l' + m' * g') + m' * (l' * g' + m')) * g' := by rw [← e1s]; grind
    rw [e₂', e₃']
    grind
  have ge0 := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hl (Std.le_of_lt hm))
    (by have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hg (by grind : (0 : R) < g); grind :
      (0 : R) ≤ g * g - 1)
  have ge0' := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hl' (Std.le_of_lt hm'))
    (by have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hg' (by grind : (0 : R) < g'); grind :
      (0 : R) ≤ g' * g' - 1)
  have hgg : g = g' := by
    have hprod : (g - g') * (g + g' - 2 * p * q) = 0 := by grind
    by_cases h : g - g' = 0
    · grind
    · have : g + g' - 2 * p * q = 0 := by grind
      grind
  subst hgg
  have hne : 1 - g * g ≠ 0 := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hg (by grind : (0 : R) < g); grind
  have hl2 : l * (1 - g * g) = l' * (1 - g * g) := by rw [hl1, hl1']
  have hm2 : m * (1 - g * g) = m' * (1 - g * g) := by rw [hm1, hm1']
  exact ⟨by grind, by grind⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.lt_trichotomy:
/-- Any two reals are comparable: `x < y`, `x = y` or `y < x`. -/
theorem lt_trichotomy (x y : R) : x < y ∨ x = y ∨ y < x := by
  rcases trichotomy (y - x) with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by grind))
  · right; right
    have e : -(y - x) = x - y := by grind
    rw [lt_def, ← e]; exact h

Foundations.Algebra.rpow_ne_one_of_lt:
/-- A `p`-th root of unity `ζ ≠ 1` (`p` prime) satisfies `ζ^k ≠ 1` for `0 < k < p`: its order
is exactly `p`. -/
theorem rpow_ne_one_of_lt {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) {ζ : F} (hζp : rpow ζ p = 1) (hζ1 : ζ ≠ 1)
    {k : Nat} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hkp : k < p) : rpow ζ k ≠ 1 := by
  intro hk
  have hg := rpow_gcd_eq_one hk hζp
  rcases hp.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right k p) with h1 | h1
  · rw [h1, rpow_one'] at hg; exact hζ1 hg
  · have := Nat.gcd_le_left p hk0; omega
Foundations.Algebra.prodCommRing:
/-- **Product ring.** `R × S` is a commutative ring under componentwise operations. -/
instance prodCommRing {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] : CommRing (R × S) where
  add a b := (a.1 + b.1, a.2 + b.2)
  mul a b := (a.1 * b.1, a.2 * b.2)
  neg a := (-a.1, -a.2)
  zero := (0, 0)
  one := (1, 1)
  add_assoc _ _ _ := Prod.ext (Ring.add_assoc _ _ _) (Ring.add_assoc _ _ _)
  add_comm _ _ := Prod.ext (Ring.add_comm _ _) (Ring.add_comm _ _)
  zero_add _ := Prod.ext (Ring.zero_add _) (Ring.zero_add _)
  neg_add_cancel _ := Prod.ext (Ring.neg_add_cancel _) (Ring.neg_add_cancel _)
  mul_assoc _ _ _ := Prod.ext (Ring.mul_assoc _ _ _) (Ring.mul_assoc _ _ _)
  one_mul _ := Prod.ext (Ring.one_mul _) (Ring.one_mul _)
  mul_one _ := Prod.ext (Ring.mul_one _) (Ring.mul_one _)
  left_distrib _ _ _ := Prod.ext (Ring.left_distrib _ _ _) (Ring.left_distrib _ _ _)
  right_distrib _ _ _ := Prod.ext (Ring.right_distrib _ _ _) (Ring.right_distrib _ _ _)
  mul_comm _ _ := Prod.ext (CommRing.mul_comm _ _) (CommRing.mul_comm _ _)

/-- Division by a positive number preserves a non-strict upper bound. -/
theorem div_le_of_le_mul {x a d : R} (hd : 0 < d) (h : a ≤ x * d) : a / d ≤ x := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hn
  have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by grind : x < a / d) hd
  have e : a / d * d = a := by grind
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.RingHom:
/-- **Ring homomorphism.** A map between rings preserving addition, multiplication and `1`. -/
structure RingHom (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [Ring R] [Ring S] where
  /-- The underlying function. -/
  toFun : R → S
  /-- Preserves addition. -/
  map_add : ∀ a b, toFun (a + b) = toFun a + toFun b
  /-- Preserves multiplication. -/
  map_mul : ∀ a b, toFun (a * b) = toFun a * toFun b
  /-- Preserves the identity. -/
  map_one : toFun 1 = 1
Foundations.Types.STLC.nn_lem:
/-- But the **double negation of excluded middle** is provable, by the term
`λk. k (inr (λa. k (inl a)))`: intuitionistic logic cannot refute excluded middle. -/
theorem nn_lem (A : Formula) :
    HasType [] (lam (app (var 0) (inr (lam (app (var 1) (inl (var 0)))))))
      (neg (neg (.sum A (neg A)))) :=
  .lam (.app (.var rfl) (.inr (.lam (.app (.var rfl) (.inl (.var rfl))))))

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Outer:
/-- **The key estimate.** For disjoint measurable `Eₙ` with union `U` and any test set `T`:
the series `Σ ν(T ∩ Eₙ)` converges to some `s` with `s + ν(T ∖ U) ≤ ν(T)` and `ν(T ∩ U) ≤ s`. -/
theorem disjoint_estimate {E : Nat → α → Prop} (hE : ∀ n, o.IsMeasurable (E n)) (hd : Disjoint E)
    (T : α → Prop) : ∃ s, HasSum (fun n => o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ E n x)) s ∧
      s + o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ ¬ ∃ n, E n x) ≤ o.ν T ∧ o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ ∃ n, E n x) ≤ s := by
  -- `ν(T ∩ (E₀ ∪ ⋯ ∪ Eₙ₋₁)) = Σ_{k<n} ν(T ∩ Eₖ)`.
  have hfin : ∀ n, o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ partialUnion E n x) =
      fsum (fun k => o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ E k x)) n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [fsum_zero, ← o.empty]; exact o.congr fun x => ⟨fun ⟨_, k, hk, _⟩ => by omega,
        False.elim⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [fsum_succ, ← ih, hE n (fun x => T x ∧ partialUnion E (n + 1) x)]
      rw [o.congr (A := fun x => (T x ∧ partialUnion E (n + 1) x) ∧ E n x)
        (B := fun x => T x ∧ E n x) (fun x => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩,
          fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, n, by omega, h.2⟩, h.2⟩⟩)]
      rw [o.congr (A := fun x => (T x ∧ partialUnion E (n + 1) x) ∧ ¬ E n x)
        (B := fun x => T x ∧ partialUnion E n x) (fun x => ⟨fun ⟨⟨h1, k, hk, h2⟩, h3⟩ =>
          ⟨h1, k, by
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k n with h | h
            · exact h
            · exact absurd (show k = n by omega ▸ h2) h3, h2⟩,
          fun ⟨h1, k, hk, h2⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, k, by omega, h2⟩, fun h3 => hd k n (by omega) x h2 h3⟩⟩)]
      grind
  -- The partial sums are bounded by `ν(T) − ν(T ∖ U)`.
  have hbd : ∀ n, fsum (fun k => o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ E k x)) n ≤
      o.ν T - o.ν (fun x => T x ∧ ¬ ∃ n, E n x) := by
    intro n
    have h1 := isMeasurable_partialUnion o hE n T
    have h2 := o.mono (fun x => T x ∧ ¬ ∃ n, E n x) (fun x => T x ∧ ¬ partialUnion E n x)
      fun x ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, fun ⟨k, _, hk⟩ => h2 ⟨k, hk⟩⟩
    rw [hfin n] at h1; grind
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsle⟩ := summable_of_bounded (fun n => o.nonneg _) hbd
  refine ⟨s, hs, by grind, ?_⟩
  have := o.subadd (fun n x => T x ∧ E n x) s hs
  rwa [o.congr (A := fun x => ∃ n, T x ∧ E n x) (B := fun x => T x ∧ ∃ n, E n x)
    (fun x => ⟨fun ⟨n, h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, n, h2⟩, fun ⟨h1, n, h2⟩ => ⟨n, h1, h2⟩⟩)] at this

/-- A theory is **consistent** if it does not derive `⊥`. -/
def Consistent (Γ : Theory) : Prop := ¬ (Γ ⊢ bot)
Foundations.Algebra.rsum:
/-- The sum `t 0 + ⋯ + t (n - 1)` in a commutative ring. -/
def rsum (t : Nat → R) : Nat → R
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => rsum t n + t n
Foundations.Algebra.adj_of_not_alg:
/-- For non-algebraic `x`, `adj K x = K`. -/
theorem adj_of_not_alg {K : Subfield ℂ} {x : ℂ} (h : ¬ IsAlgebraic K x) : adj K x = K := by
  unfold adj; exact dite_eq_right h
Foundations.Logic.Sequent.leftPremises:
/-- The premises of the **left rule** for a formula `A`, as a list of pairs
`(L, R)`: each pair stands for the premise `L ++ Γ ⊢ R ++ Δ` of a conclusion
`Γ ⊢ Δ` with `A ∈ Γ`. The value is `none` when there is no left rule (atoms).
`⊥` has a left rule with *no* premises. -/
def leftPremises : Formula → Option (List (List Formula × List Formula))
  | bot => some []
  | var _ => none
  | imp A B => some [([], [A]), ([B], [])]
  | conj A B => some [([A, B], [])]
  | disj A B => some [([A], []), ([B], [])]
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.linte:
/-- **The Lebesgue integral.** `∫ f dμ` is the supremum of the integrals of the simple functions
below `f` (and `0` if they are unbounded). -/
noncomputable def lintegral (f : α → R) : R :=
  open Classical in
  if h : BddIntegral m f then
    Classical.choose (exists_lub (LowerSum m f) (lowerSum_ne m f) (lowerSum_bdd m h))
  else 0
Foundations.Topology.Topology.prod:
/-- The **product topology** on `X × Y`: a set is open if around each of its points it contains an
open "box" `U × V`. -/
def prod (τ : Topology X) (σ : Topology Y) : Topology (X × Y) where
  IsOpen W := ∀ p, W p → ∃ U V, τ.IsOpen U ∧ σ.IsOpen V ∧ U p.1 ∧ V p.2 ∧
    ∀ q : X × Y, U q.1 → V q.2 → W q
  isOpen_univ := fun _ _ => ⟨_, _, τ.isOpen_univ, σ.isOpen_univ, trivial, trivial, fun _ _ _ => trivial⟩
  isOpen_inter W W' hW hW' p hp := by
    obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩ := hW p hp.1
    obtain ⟨U', V', hU', hV', h1', h2', h'⟩ := hW' p hp.2
    exact ⟨_, _, τ.isOpen_inter U U' hU hU', σ.isOpen_inter V V' hV hV', ⟨h1, h1'⟩, ⟨h2, h2'⟩,
      fun q hq1 hq2 => ⟨h q hq1.1 hq2.1, h' q hq1.2 hq2.2⟩⟩
  isOpen_sUnion S hS p := fun ⟨W, hW, hp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩ := hS W hW p hp
    exact ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, fun q hq1 hq2 => ⟨W, hW, h q hq1 hq2⟩⟩
Foundations.Numbers.C.CTendsto.of_nrm_su:
/-- If `‖sₙ − tₙ‖ → 0` and `tₙ → L`, then `sₙ → L`. -/
theorem CTendsto.of_nrm_sub {s t : Nat → C} {L : C} (ht : CTendsto t L)
    (h : Tendsto (fun n => nrm (s n - t n)) 0) : CTendsto s L := by
  have hre : Tendsto (fun n => (s n - t n).re) 0 := tendsto_of_abs_le h fun n => by
    rw [show (s n - t n).re - 0 = (s n - t n).re by grind]; exact abs_re_le _
  have him : Tendsto (fun n => (s n - t n).im) 0 := tendsto_of_abs_le h fun n => by
    rw [show (s n - t n).im - 0 = (s n - t n).im by grind]; exact abs_im_le _
  constructor
  · have := hre.add ht.1
    rw [show (0 : R) + L.re = L.re by grind] at this
    exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
      show (s n + -t n).re + (t n).re = (s n).re; simp only [add_re, neg_re]; grind
  · have := him.add ht.2
    rw [show (0 : R) + L.im = L.im by grind] at this
    exact this.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
      show (s n + -t n).im + (t n).im = (s n).im; simp only [add_im, neg_im]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.fracSetoid:
/-- Fractions are equivalent when they cross-multiply to the same integer:
`n/d ~ n'/d'` iff `n · d' = n' · d`. This is an equivalence relation. -/
instance fracSetoid : Setoid Frac where
  r p q := p.num * q.den = q.num * p.den
  iseqv := {
    refl := fun _ => rfl
    symm := fun h => h.symm
    trans := fun {p q r} h₁ h₂ => by
      apply int_cancel_pos q.den_pos
      have h₁ : p.num * q.den = q.num * p.den := h₁
      have h₂ : q.num * r.den = r.num * q.den := h₂
      grind }
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.WFRel.rank_below:
/-- Below `a`, ranks in the initial segment agree with ranks in the whole order. -/
theorem WFRel.rank_below (W : WFRel α) (a : α) :
    ∀ b, W.R b a → rank (W.below a).R (W.below a).wf b = rank W.R W.wf b := by
  intro b
  refine W.wf.induction (C := fun b => W.R b a →
    rank (W.below a).R (W.below a).wf b = rank W.R W.wf b) b (fun b ih hb => ?_)
  apply ext
  intro z
  rw [mem_rank, mem_rank]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c, hc.1, ih c hc.1 (W.trans _ _ _ hc.1 hb)⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c, ⟨hc, hb⟩, (ih c hc (W.trans _ _ _ hc hb)).symm⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Associated.symm:
/-- Associatedness is symmetric. -/
theorem Associated.symm {a b : R} (h : Associated a b) : Associated b a := by
  obtain ⟨u, ⟨v, huv⟩, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨v, ⟨u, by rw [CommRing.mul_comm, huv]⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Ring.mul_assoc, huv, Ring.mul_one]
Foundations.Logic.FO.funcCode:
/-- Codes of applications of the function symbols, given the codes of the arguments. -/
def funcCode : {n : Nat} → ArithFunc n → (Fin n → Nat) → Nat
  | _, .zero, _ => pair 1 0
  | _, .succ, c => pair 2 (c 0)
  | _, .add, c => pair 3 (pair (c 0) (c 1))
  | _, .mul, c => pair 4 (pair (c 0) (c 1))
Foundations.Numbers.R.Fine.le:
/-- Fine partitions go from left to right. -/
theorem Fine.le {A B δ a b : R} {l : List (R × R)} (h : Fine A B δ a l b) : a ≤ b := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => have : a = b := h; grind
  | cons p l ih => obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p; have := ih h.2.2.2.2.2; have := h.1; grind

/-- The monic form: coefficients `A, B, D ∈ K` with `α³ + A α² + B α + D = 0`, and the same
cubic has no root in `K`. -/
theorem CubicRoot.monic (C : CubicRoot K α) : ∃ A B D, A ∈ K ∧ B ∈ K ∧ D ∈ K ∧
    α * α * α + A * (α * α) + B * α + D = 0 ∧
    ∀ x, x ∈ K → x * x * x + A * (x * x) + B * x + D ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde⟩ := K.inv_mem C.hd C.d_ne
  refine ⟨C.a * e, C.b * e, C.c * e, K.mul_mem C.ha he, K.mul_mem C.hb he, K.mul_mem C.hc he,
    ?_, fun x hx h => C.no_root x hx ?_⟩
  · have := C.root; grind
  · grind

/-- **Bridge theorem (ℕ).** The equivalence `N ≃ Nat` sends `0` to `0`, successor to `+1`,
and preserves addition, multiplication and order. Hence the home-made natural numbers and Lean's
`Nat` are the same structure, and we may use `Nat` from now on. -/

    equivNat.toFun zero = 0 ∧
    (∀ n, equivNat.toFun (succ n) = equivNat.toFun n + 1) ∧
    (∀ a b, equivNat.toFun (a + b) = equivNat.toFun a + equivNat.toFun b) ∧
    (∀ a b, equivNat.toFun (a * b) = equivNat.toFun a * equivNat.toFun b) ∧

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.key4:
/-- **The key identity** `6 B_{n+1} + 2(n+1)² C_{n+1} = (n+1)(2n+1) Cₙ`. -/
theorem key4 (j : Nat) :
    6 * B (j + 1) + 2 * ((j : R) + 1) * ((j : R) + 1) * C (j + 1) =
      ((j : R) + 1) * (2 * (j : R) + 1) * C j := by
  have hab := Std.le_of_lt hpi_pos
  let n1 : R := (j : R) + 1
  let g : R → R := fun x => 6 * (x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
    (2 * n1 * n1 * (x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
      (-(n1 * (2 * (j : R) + 1))) * (x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j)))
  let F : R → R := fun x => 2 * (x * x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
    n1 * (x * x * (x * x) * (sin x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1)))
  have hd : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ hpi → HasDerivAt F (g t) t := fun t _ _ => by
    have hA := (((((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (hasDerivAt_id t)).mul (hasDerivAt_id t)).mul
      (hasDerivAt_cos_pow (2 * j + 1) t)).const_mul 2)
    have hB := (((((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (hasDerivAt_id t)).mul ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul
      (hasDerivAt_id t))).mul ((hasDerivAt_sin t).mul (hasDerivAt_cos_pow (2 * j) t))).const_mul n1)
    refine HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (hA.add hB) ?_
    have p1 : cos t ^ (2 * j + 1) = cos t ^ (2 * j) * cos t := rfl
    have p2 : cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) = cos t ^ (2 * j) * cos t * cos t := rfl
    have py := sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
    have c1 : ((2 * j + 1 : Nat) : R) = 2 * (j : R) + 1 := by grind
    have c2 : ((2 * j : Nat) : R) = 2 * (j : R) := by grind
    show _ = 6 * (t * t * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
      (2 * n1 * n1 * (t * t * (t * t) * cos t ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
        (-(n1 * (2 * (j : R) + 1))) * (t * t * (t * t) * cos t ^ (2 * j)))
    rw [p1, p2, c1, c2]
    have ss : sin t * sin t = 1 - cos t * cos t := by grind
    generalize cos t ^ (2 * j) = Cc
    show _ = _ + (2 * ((j : R) + 1) * ((j : R) + 1) * _ + -(((j : R) + 1) * _) * _)
    show _ + ((j : R) + 1) * _ = _
    grind
  have c3 : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) t := continuousAt_x2cos _
  have c4 : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) t :=
    continuousAt_x4cos _
  have c5 : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt (fun x => x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j)) t := continuousAt_x4cos _
  have hgc : ∀ t, R.ContinuousAt g t := fun t =>
    continuousAt_add (continuousAt_cmul _ (c3 t))
      (continuousAt_add (continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t)) (continuousAt_cmul _ (c5 t)))
  have h1 := integral_eq_sub hab hd fun t _ _ => hgc t
  rw [integral_add' hab (fun t => continuousAt_cmul _ (c3 t)) (fun t => continuousAt_add
      (continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t)) (continuousAt_cmul _ (c5 t))),
    integral_add' hab (fun t => continuousAt_cmul _ (c4 t)) (fun t => continuousAt_cmul _ (c5 t)),
    integral_const_mul' _ hab c3, integral_const_mul' _ hab c4, integral_const_mul' _ hab c5] at h1
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by show 2 * (0 * 0 * 0 * _) + n1 * (0 * 0 * (0 * 0) * _) = 0; grind
  have hFp : F hpi = 0 := by
    show 2 * (hpi * hpi * hpi * cos hpi ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) +
      n1 * (hpi * hpi * (hpi * hpi) * (sin hpi * cos hpi ^ (2 * j + 1))) = 0
    rw [cos_hpi]
    have : (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1) = 0 := by show (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1) * 0 = 0; grind
    have : (0 : R) ^ (2 * j + 1) = 0 := by show (0 : R) ^ (2 * j) * 0 = 0; grind
    grind
  rw [hF0, hFp] at h1
  have eB : B (j + 1) = integral (fun x => x * x * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) 0 hpi := by
    unfold B; rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have eC : C (j + 1) = integral (fun x => x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j + 1 + 1)) 0 hpi := by
    unfold C; rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by omega]
  have eC' : C j = integral (fun x => x * x * (x * x) * cos x ^ (2 * j)) 0 hpi := rfl
  rw [← eB, ← eC, ← eC'] at h1
  show _ = n1 * _ * _
  grind

/-- **Completeness for finitely many premises (Kalmár's method).** If `φ` follows

Foundations.Logic.HAxiom:
/-- The axiom schemes of our Hilbert system. -/
inductive HAxiom : Formula → Prop where
  /-- Scheme K: `φ → (ψ → φ)`. -/
  | k (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp φ (imp ψ φ))
  /-- Scheme S: `(φ → ψ → χ) → (φ → ψ) → φ → χ`. -/
  | s (φ ψ χ) : HAxiom (imp (imp φ (imp ψ χ)) (imp (imp φ ψ) (imp φ χ)))
  /-- Double-negation elimination: `¬¬φ → φ`. -/
  | dne (φ) : HAxiom (imp (neg (neg φ)) φ)
  /-- `φ ∧ ψ → φ`. -/
  | conjE₁ (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp (conj φ ψ) φ)
  /-- `φ ∧ ψ → ψ`. -/
  | conjE₂ (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp (conj φ ψ) ψ)
  /-- `φ → ψ → φ ∧ ψ`. -/
  | conjI (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp φ (imp ψ (conj φ ψ)))
  /-- `φ → φ ∨ ψ`. -/
  | disjI₁ (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp φ (disj φ ψ))
  /-- `ψ → φ ∨ ψ`. -/
  | disjI₂ (φ ψ) : HAxiom (imp ψ (disj φ ψ))
  /-- `(φ → χ) → (ψ → χ) → (φ ∨ ψ → χ)`. -/
  | disjE (φ ψ χ) : HAxiom (imp (imp φ χ) (imp (imp ψ χ) (imp (disj φ ψ) χ)))

Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.extend:
/-- The enlarged partial squaring: old pairs as before, new pairs sent injectively
into the new points `B = g(A)`. -/
noncomputable def extend (he : Function.Injective e) (hg : Function.Injective g) : PSq e where
  dom := dom' M g
  rel p c := M.rel p c ∨ (NewPair M g p ∧ c = (g (pairCode M g p)).1)
  rel_dom p c := by
    rintro (h | ⟨hp, rfl⟩)
    · have := M.rel_dom p c h
      exact ⟨Or.inl this.1, Or.inl this.2.1, Or.inl this.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
  func p c c' := by
    rintro (h | ⟨hp, rfl⟩) (h' | ⟨hp', rfl⟩)
    · exact M.func _ _ _ h h'
    · exact absurd ⟨(M.rel_dom _ _ h).1, (M.rel_dom _ _ h).2.1⟩ hp'.2.2
    · exact absurd ⟨(M.rel_dom _ _ h').1, (M.rel_dom _ _ h').2.1⟩ hp.2.2
    · rfl
  inj p p' c := by
    rintro (h | ⟨hp, hc⟩) (h' | ⟨hp', hc'⟩)
    · exact M.inj _ _ _ h h'
    · exact absurd ((M.rel_dom _ _ h).2.2) (hc' ▸ (g _).2)
    · exact absurd ((M.rel_dom _ _ h').2.2) (hc ▸ (g _).2)
    · rw [hc] at hc'
      exact pairCode_inj M g he hp hp' (hg (Subtype.ext hc'))
  total x y hx hy := by
    by_cases hold : M.dom x ∧ M.dom y
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := M.total x y hold.1 hold.2
      exact ⟨c, Or.inl hc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Or.inr ⟨⟨hx, hy, hold⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  base n := Or.inl (M.base n)
Foundations.Numbers.Arith.euclid_lemma:
/-- **Euclid's lemma.** If a prime `p` divides a product `a·b`, it divides `a` or `b`. -/
theorem euclid_lemma {p a b : Nat} (hp : Prime p) (h : p ∣ a * b) : p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b := by
  by_cases ha : p ∣ a
  · exact Or.inl ha
  · right
    -- `gcd p a` divides `p`, and is not `p` (else `p ∣ a`), so it is `1`.
    have hg : gcd p a = 1 := by
      rcases hp.2 _ (gcd_dvd p a).1 with h1 | h1
      · exact h1
      · exact absurd (h1 ▸ (gcd_dvd p a).2) ha
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := bezout p a
    rw [hg] at hxy
    -- Then `b = p·b·x + (a·b)·y` is divisible by `p`.
    have hb : (b : Int) = p * (b * x) + (a * b : Nat) * y := by
      push_cast
      have hxy' : (1 : Int) = p * x + a * y := by exact_mod_cast hxy
      grind
    have hpab : (p : Int) ∣ ((a * b : Nat) : Int) := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 h
    have : (p : Int) ∣ (b : Int) := by
      rw [hb]
      exact Int.dvd_add (Int.dvd_mul_right _ _) (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hpab)
    exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.1 this
Foundations.Algebra.even_transpositions_:
/-- A product of an even number of transpositions is a product of 3-cycles. -/
theorem even_transpositions_c3 {n : Nat} :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (L : List (Perm (Fin n))), L.length = 2 * k → (∀ t, t ∈ L → IsTransposition t) →
      ∃ M : List (Perm (Fin n)), (∀ t, t ∈ M → IsC3 t) ∧ gprod M = gprod L := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro L hL _; exact ⟨[], by simp, by rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hL]⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro L hL hT
    match L, hL with
    | t1 :: t2 :: L', hL =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hT t1 List.mem_cons_self
      obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, rfl⟩ := hT t2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)
      obtain ⟨M1, hM1, h1⟩ := swap_mul_swap_c3 hab hcd
      obtain ⟨M2, hM2, h2⟩ := ih L' (by simp at hL; omega)
        (fun t ht => hT t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht)))
      refine ⟨M1 ++ M2, fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases List.mem_append.1 ht with h | h
        · exact hM1 t h
        · exact hM2 t h
      · rw [gprod_append, h1, h2]
        show swap a b * swap c d * gprod L' = swap a b * (swap c d * gprod L')
        rw [Group.mul_assoc]

Foundations.Logic.FO.rosser_incompletene:
/-- **The Gödel–Rosser incompleteness theorem.** Let `T` be a theory of arithmetic
which proves all axioms of `Q`, is computably enumerable (some code halts exactly on
the Gödel numbers of its theorems), and is **consistent**. Then `T` is incomplete:
some sentence is neither provable nor refutable in `T`. -/
theorem rosser_incompleteness {T : Theory Arith} (hQ : ∀ ψ, Q ψ → T ⊢₁ ψ)
    (hce : ∃ c : Code, ∀ φ : Formula Arith, Halts c [fcode φ] ↔ T ⊢₁ φ) (hcon : ¬ T ⊢₁ bot) :
    ∃ σ : Formula Arith, IsSentence σ ∧ ¬ T ⊢₁ σ ∧ ¬ T ⊢₁ neg σ := by
  obtain ⟨cT, hcT⟩ := hce
  let K : Nat := encode cT
  -- "proof of `R(e)` (resp. `¬R(e)`) found at stage `t`"
  let t₁ : Nat → Bool := fun q => kleeneT K (encList [rcode (fst q)]) (snd q)
  let t₂ : Nat → Bool := fun q => kleeneT K (encList [nrcode (fst q)]) (snd q)
  have ht₁ : CompB t₁ := CompB.step3 kleeneT_comp (Comp.const K)
    (encList_single_comp (rcode_comp (Comp.fst Comp.id))) (Comp.snd Comp.id)
  have ht₂ : CompB t₂ := CompB.step3 kleeneT_comp (Comp.const K)
    (encList_single_comp (nrcode_comp (Comp.fst Comp.id))) (Comp.snd Comp.id)
  obtain ⟨cs, hcs⟩ := search (CompB.or ht₁ ht₂)
  obtain ⟨co, hco⟩ := Comp.cond ht₁ (Comp.const 1) (Comp.const 0)
  -- the program `d`
  let d : Code := .comp co (vec1 (pairOf (.proj 0) cs))
  have hd : ∀ n t, Eval cs [n] t → Eval d [n] (bif t₁ (pair n t) then 1 else 0) :=
    fun n t ht => eval_comp1 (eval_pairOf .proj ht) (hco _)
  let g := encode d
  let σ := rosserSent g
  have hT₁ : ∀ t, t₁ (pair g t) = true → T ⊢₁ σ := by
    intro t ht
    rw [← hcT, ← rcode_spec, halts_iff_kleeneT]
    exact ⟨t, by simpa [t₁] using ht⟩
  have hT₂ : ∀ t, t₂ (pair g t) = true → T ⊢₁ neg σ := by
    intro t ht
    rw [← hcT, ← nrcode_spec, halts_iff_kleeneT]
    exact ⟨t, by simpa [t₂] using ht⟩
  have key : (T ⊢₁ σ ∨ T ⊢₁ neg σ) → T ⊢₁ bot := by
    intro h
    have hex : ∃ t, (t₁ (pair g t) || t₂ (pair g t)) = true := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · rw [← hcT, ← rcode_spec, halts_iff_kleeneT] at h
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
        have h' : t₁ (pair g t) = true := by simpa [t₁] using ht
        exact ⟨t, by rw [h']; rfl⟩
      · rw [← hcT, ← nrcode_spec, halts_iff_kleeneT] at h
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
        have h' : t₂ (pair g t) = true := by simpa [t₂] using ht
        exact ⟨t, by rw [h', Bool.or_true]⟩
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmin⟩ := exists_least hex
    have hs : Eval cs [g] t₀ := (hcs g t₀).2 ⟨by simpa using ht₀, fun m hm => by
      simpa using hmin m hm⟩
    have hdg := hd g t₀ hs
    cases h₁ : t₁ (pair g t₀) with
    | true =>
        rw [h₁] at hdg
        have hphi : phi g g 1 := (phi_encode d g 1).2 hdg
        exact Proves.impE (proves_of_Q_proves hQ (Q_refutes_rosser hphi)) (hT₁ t₀ h₁)
    | false =>
        rw [h₁] at hdg
        have h₂ : t₂ (pair g t₀) = true := by simpa [h₁] using ht₀
        have hphi : phi g g 0 := (phi_encode d g 0).2 hdg
        exact Proves.impE (hT₂ t₀ h₂) (proves_of_Q_proves hQ (Q_proves_rosser hphi))
  exact ⟨σ, rosserSent_sentence g, fun h => hcon (key (Or.inl h)), fun h => hcon (key (Or.inr h))⟩
Foundations.Types.STLC.progress:
/-- **Progress.** A closed well-typed term is a value or can take a step. -/
theorem progress {t : Term} {A : Ty} (ht : HasType [] t A) : IsValue t ∨ ∃ t', Step t t' := by
  generalize hΓ : ([] : Ctx) = Γ at ht
  induction ht with
  | var hn => subst hΓ; simp at hn
  | lam _ _ => exact Or.inl trivial
  | pair _ _ _ _ => exact Or.inl trivial
  | inl _ _ => exact Or.inl trivial
  | inr _ _ => exact Or.inl trivial
  | @app Γ t u A B h₁ _ ih₁ _ =>
    rcases ih₁ hΓ with hv | ⟨t', ht'⟩
    · cases h₁ <;> simp [IsValue] at hv
      exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.beta _ _⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.appL ht'⟩
  | fst h ih =>
    rcases ih hΓ with hv | ⟨t', ht'⟩
    · cases h <;> simp [IsValue] at hv
      exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.fstPair _ _⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.fst ht'⟩
  | snd h ih =>
    rcases ih hΓ with hv | ⟨t', ht'⟩
    · cases h <;> simp [IsValue] at hv
      exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.sndPair _ _⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.snd ht'⟩
  | case h _ _ ih _ _ =>
    rcases ih hΓ with hv | ⟨t', ht'⟩
    · cases h <;> simp [IsValue] at hv
      · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.caseInl _ _ _⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.caseInr _ _ _⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.case₀ ht'⟩
  | absurd h ih =>
    rcases ih hΓ with hv | ⟨t', ht'⟩
    · cases h <;> simp [IsValue] at hv
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, Step.absurd ht'⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_powErr_div_le:
/-- Termwise estimate: `|E (n+2) / (n+2)!| ≤ |y − x|²/2 · Mⁿ/n!` when `|x|, |y| ≤ M`. -/
theorem abs_powErr_div_le {x y M : R} (hx : abs x ≤ M) (hy : abs y ≤ M) (n : Nat) :
    abs (powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R)) ≤
      abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2 * expTerm M n := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm 2 n]
  have hF : (fact (n + 2) : R) = ((n : R) + 2) * ((n : R) + 1) * (fact n : R) := by
    rw [fact_succ', fact_succ']; grind
  have hFp := fact_pos' (n + 2)
  rw [abs_div_pos hFp]
  have k := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_powErr_le hx hy n)
    (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hFp))
  have := fact_pos' n
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  unfold expTerm
  rw [hF] at k ⊢
  have hP := OrderedRing.mul_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 2)
    (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1)) (fact_pos' n)
  have i1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show ((n : R) + 2) * ((n : R) + 1) * (fact n : R) ≠ 0 by grind)
  have i2 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show (fact n : R) ≠ 0 by grind)
  have e : ((n : R) + 2) * ((n : R) + 1) / 2 * M ^ n * (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x)) *
      (((n : R) + 2) * ((n : R) + 1) * (fact n : R))⁻¹ =
      abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2 * (M ^ n / (fact n : R)) := by grind
  rw [e] at k
  exact k

Foundations.NumberTheory.le_bprod_of_pow:
/-- **Bounding a number by its prime-power divisors.** Suppose every prime factor of `m > 0`
is below `B`, and every prime power `pᵉ` dividing `m` is at most `f(p)`, where all `f(i) ≥ 1`.
Then `m ≤ ∏_{i<B} f(i)`. (Split off the full power of one prime factor and recurse.) -/
theorem le_bprod_of_pow_dvd {B : Nat} : ∀ (m : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat), 0 < m → (∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) →
    (∀ p e, Prime p → p ^ e ∣ m → p ^ e ≤ f p) → (∀ p, Prime p → p ∣ m → p < B) →
    m ≤ bprod f B := by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro f hm hf hpow hB
    by_cases h1 : m = 1
    · subst h1; exact bprod_pos (fun i => hf i) B
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := exists_prime_dvd (n := m) (by omega)
      have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.1
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := vp_spec hp1 hm
      have he : 1 ≤ vp p m := (pow_dvd_iff_le_vp hp1 hm).1 (by simpa using hpm)
      have hr0 : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact hpr (Nat.dvd_zero p))
      have hpe : 2 ≤ p ^ vp p m := by
        have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < p by omega) he
        simp at this; omega
      have hrm : r < m := by
        have : 2 * r ≤ p ^ vp p m * r := Nat.mul_le_mul_right r hpe
        omega
      have hrdvd : r ∣ m := ⟨p ^ vp p m, by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact hr⟩
      have hrle := ih r hrm (fun i => if i = p then 1 else f i) hr0
        (fun i => by split <;> simp [hf i])
        (fun q k hq hqk => by
          by_cases hqp : q = p
          · subst hqp
            simp only [↓reduceIte]
            rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
            · subst hk; simp
            · exfalso; apply hpr
              exact Nat.dvd_trans (by simpa using Nat.pow_dvd_pow q hk) hqk
          · simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte]
            exact hpow q k hq (Nat.dvd_trans hqk hrdvd))
        (fun q hq hqr => hB q hq (Nat.dvd_trans hqr hrdvd))
      have hpf := hpow p (vp p m) hp ⟨r, hr⟩
      rw [bprod_update f (hB p hp hpm)]
      calc m = p ^ vp p m * r := hr
        _ ≤ f p * bprod (fun i => if i = p then 1 else f i) B := Nat.mul_le_mul hpf hrle
Foundations.Sets.Comparability.PInj.add:
/-- Adding a new pair `(a₀, b₀)`, with `a₀` outside the domain and `b₀` outside
the range, to a partial injection. -/
def PInj.add (F : PInj α β) (a₀ : α) (b₀ : β) (ha : ∀ b, ¬ F.rel a₀ b)
    (hb : ∀ a, ¬ F.rel a b₀) : PInj α β where
  rel a b := F.rel a b ∨ (a = a₀ ∧ b = b₀)
  func a b b' := by
    rintro (h | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩) (h' | ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩)
    · exact F.func _ _ _ h h'
    · subst h₁'; exact absurd h (ha _)
    · subst h₁; exact absurd h' (ha _)
    · rw [h₂, h₂']
  inj a a' b := by
    rintro (h | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩) (h' | ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩)
    · exact F.inj _ _ _ h h'
    · subst h₂'; exact absurd h (hb _)
    · subst h₂; exact absurd h' (hb _)
    · rw [h₁, h₁']

Foundations.Algebra.galRep_injective:
/-- **The representation is faithful.** An automorphism fixing every root is the identity. -/
theorem galRep_injective : ∀ σ τ, galRep σ = galRep τ → σ = τ := by
  intro σ τ h
  have hfix : ∀ i, (τ⁻¹ * σ).toFun (rootL i) = rootL i := by
    intro i
    rw [FieldAut.mul_apply, permOf_spec σ i]
    show τ.invFun (rootL (galRep σ i)) = rootL i
    rw [h]
    change τ.invFun (rootL (permOf τ i)) = rootL i
    rw [← permOf_spec τ i]; exact τ.left_inv _
  -- the fixed field of `τ⁻¹ σ` contains `ℚ` and every root, hence all of `L`
  let ρ := τ⁻¹ * σ
  have hL := L_le (M := fixedField L (fun φ => φ = ρ)) (le_fixedField Qc_le_L _)
    (fun i => ⟨qβ_mem i, fun φ hφ => by rw [hφ]; exact hfix i⟩)
  have hρ : ρ = 1 := FieldAut.ext fun x => by
    obtain ⟨_, hx⟩ := hL x.1 x.2
    exact hx ρ rfl
  calc σ = τ * (τ⁻¹ * σ) := by rw [← Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_cancel, Group.one_mul]
    _ = τ := by rw [show τ⁻¹ * σ = 1 from hρ, Group.mul_one]
Foundations.Logic.FO.tsubStep:
/-- One step of term substitution; the parameter is `⟨mode, ⟨t, d⟩⟩`. -/
def tsubStep (q : Nat) : Nat :=
  bif fst (cvN q) == 0 then tvar (fst (cvP q)) (fst (snd (cvP q))) (snd (snd (cvP q))) (snd (cvN q))
  else bif fst (cvN q) == 2 then pair 2 (cvRec q (snd (cvN q)))
  else bif fst (cvN q) == 3 || fst (cvN q) == 4 then
    pair (fst (cvN q)) (pair (cvRec q (fst (snd (cvN q)))) (cvRec q (snd (snd (cvN q)))))
  else cvN q

Foundations.Types.Lambda.Par.subst:
/-- **Substitution lemma for parallel reduction.** -/
theorem Par.subst {t t' : Term} (h : Par t t') :
    ∀ σ τ, (∀ n, Par (σ n) (τ n)) → Par (subst σ t) (subst τ t') := by
  have hup : ∀ σ τ : Nat → Term, (∀ n, Par (σ n) (τ n)) → ∀ n, Par (up σ n) (up τ n) := by
    intro σ τ hστ n
    cases n with
    | zero => exact Par.var 0
    | succ n => exact (hστ n).rename _
  induction h with
  | var n => intro σ τ h; exact h n
  | app _ _ iht ihu => intro σ τ h; exact Par.app (iht σ τ h) (ihu σ τ h)
  | lam _ ih => intro σ τ h; exact Par.lam (ih _ _ (hup σ τ h))
  | beta _ _ iht ihu =>
    intro σ τ h
    rw [subst_inst]
    exact Par.beta (iht _ _ (hup σ τ h)) (ihu σ τ h)

Foundations.Bridges.zfProd_isProduct:
/-- **The Kuratowski product is a categorical product** in `ZFCat`. -/
noncomputable def zfProd_isProduct (X Y : ZFCat) :
    IsProduct X Y (zfProd X Y) (zfFst X Y) (zfSnd X Y) where
  lift f g := zfPair f g
  fac₁ f g := zf_hom_ext fun w hw => by
    rw [app_comp _ _ hw, app_zfPair f g hw,
      app_zfFst (kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨app_mem f.2 hw, app_mem g.2 hw⟩), pfst_kpair]
  fac₂ f g := zf_hom_ext fun w hw => by
    rw [app_comp _ _ hw, app_zfPair f g hw,
      app_zfSnd (kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨app_mem f.2 hw, app_mem g.2 hw⟩), psnd_kpair]
  uniq f g h h₁ h₂ := zf_hom_ext fun w hw => by
    rw [app_zfPair f g hw]
    have hm : app h.1 w ∈ prod X.set Y.set := app_mem h.2 hw
    have e₁ : app (h ≫ zfFst X Y).1 w = app f.1 w := by rw [h₁]
    have e₂ : app (h ≫ zfSnd X Y).1 w = app g.1 w := by rw [h₂]
    rw [app_comp _ _ hw, app_zfFst hm] at e₁
    rw [app_comp _ _ hw, app_zfSnd hm] at e₂
    rw [eq_kpair_of_mem_prod hm, e₁, e₂]

Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_rsum_sub_rsum_:
/-- **Comparison lemma.** If `|f s − f s'| ≤ ε` whenever `s, s' ∈ [A, B]` are within `2δ`, then
the Riemann sums over any two `δ`-fine partitions of `[a, b]` differ by at most `ε (b − a)`.
Proof: walk along both partitions simultaneously, each time cutting off the shorter of the two
first pieces. -/
theorem abs_rsum_sub_rsum_le {f : R → R} {A B δ ε : R}
    (hf : ∀ s s', A ≤ s → s ≤ B → A ≤ s' → s' ≤ B → abs (s - s') < 2 * δ →
      abs (f s - f s') ≤ ε) :
    ∀ n : Nat, ∀ (a b : R) (P Q : List (R × R)), P.length + Q.length ≤ n →
      Fine A B δ a P b → Fine A B δ a Q b → abs (rsum f a P - rsum f a Q) ≤ ε * (b - a) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro a b P Q hlen hP hQ
    cases P with
    | cons _ _ => simp at hlen
    | nil =>
      cases Q with
      | cons _ _ => simp at hlen
      | nil =>
        have : a = b := hP; subst this
        show abs ((0 : R) - 0) ≤ ε * (a - a); rw [show (0 : R) - 0 = 0 by grind, abs_zero]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a b P Q hlen hP hQ
    match P, Q, hlen with
    | [], Q, _ =>
      have : a = b := hP; subst this
      rw [rsum_fine_self f hQ]
      show abs ((0 : R) - 0) ≤ ε * (a - a); rw [show (0 : R) - 0 = 0 by grind, abs_zero]; grind
    | (s, p) :: P', [], _ =>
      have : a = b := hQ; subst this
      rw [rsum_fine_self f hP]
      show abs ((0 : R) - 0) ≤ ε * (a - a); rw [show (0 : R) - 0 = 0 by grind, abs_zero]; grind
    | (s, p) :: P', (t, q) :: Q', hlen =>
      obtain ⟨hap, hsA, hsB, hs1, hs2, hP'⟩ := hP
      obtain ⟨haq, htA, htB, ht1, ht2, hQ'⟩ := hQ
      have hst : abs (f s - f t) ≤ ε := hf s t hsA hsB htA htB (abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩)
      have hlen' : P'.length + Q'.length + 2 ≤ n + 1 := by simp at hlen; omega
      rcases (by grind : p ≤ q ∨ q ≤ p) with hpq | hqp
      · -- Cut the second partition at `p`.
        have hQ'' : Fine A B δ p ((t, q) :: Q') b := ⟨hpq, htA, htB, by grind, ht2, hQ'⟩
        have k := ih p b P' ((t, q) :: Q') (by simp; omega) hP' hQ''
        have hpb := hP'.le
        show abs (f s * (p - a) + rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - a) + rsum f q Q')) ≤ ε * (b - a)
        have e : rsum f p ((t, q) :: Q') = f t * (q - p) + rsum f q Q' := rfl
        rw [e] at k
        have k2 : abs ((f s - f t) * (p - a)) ≤ ε * (p - a) := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ p - a)]
          exact OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hst (by grind)
        have k3 := abs_add ((f s - f t) * (p - a)) (rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - p) + rsum f q Q'))
        rw [show (f s - f t) * (p - a) + (rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - p) + rsum f q Q')) =
          f s * (p - a) + rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - a) + rsum f q Q') by grind] at k3
        grind
      · -- Cut the first partition at `q`.
        have hP'' : Fine A B δ q ((s, p) :: P') b := ⟨hqp, hsA, hsB, by grind, hs2, hP'⟩
        have k := ih q b ((s, p) :: P') Q' (by simp; omega) hP'' hQ'
        have hqb := hQ'.le
        show abs (f s * (p - a) + rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - a) + rsum f q Q')) ≤ ε * (b - a)
        have e : rsum f q ((s, p) :: P') = f s * (p - q) + rsum f p P' := rfl
        rw [e] at k
        have k2 : abs ((f s - f t) * (q - a)) ≤ ε * (q - a) := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ q - a)]
          exact OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hst (by grind)
        have k3 := abs_add ((f s - f t) * (q - a)) (f s * (p - q) + rsum f p P' - rsum f q Q')
        rw [show (f s - f t) * (q - a) + (f s * (p - q) + rsum f p P' - rsum f q Q') =
          f s * (p - a) + rsum f p P' - (f t * (q - a) + rsum f q Q') by grind] at k3
        grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.chooseSubseq_spec:
/-- The chosen indices increase and the chosen terms are within `1/(k+1)` of `L`. -/
theorem chooseSubseq_spec (a : Nat → R) (L : R)
    (h : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ abs (a n - L) < ε) (k : Nat) :
    abs (a (chooseSubseq a L h k) - L) < 1 / ((k : R) + 1) ∧
      chooseSubseq a L h k < chooseSubseq a L h (k + 1) := by
  constructor
  · cases k with
    | zero => exact (Classical.choose_spec (h (1 / ((0 : Nat) + 1)) (eps_pos 0) 0)).2
    | succ k => exact (Classical.choose_spec (h _ (eps_pos (k + 1)) (chooseSubseq a L h k + 1))).2
  · have := (Classical.choose_spec (h _ (eps_pos (k + 1)) (chooseSubseq a L h k + 1))).1
    show chooseSubseq a L h k < Classical.choose _
    omega
Foundations.Bridges.zfOmega_isNNO:
/-- **ω is a natural numbers object in `ZFCat`.** For every `x : {∅} ⟶ X` and `f : X ⟶ X`
there is exactly one `h : ω ⟶ X` with `h(∅) = x` and `h(n+1) = f(h(n))`. This is Part I's
recursion theorem, recast as a universal property. -/
noncomputable def zfOmega_isNNO : IsNNO zfOne zfOmega zfZero zfSucc where
  ind x f := zfRec x f
  ind_zero x f := zf_hom_ext fun a ha => by
    obtain rfl := mem_singleton.1 ha
    rw [app_comp _ _ ha, app_zfZero, show (∅ : ZFSet) = vn 0 from rfl, app_zfRec]
    rfl
  ind_succ x f := zf_hom_ext fun a ha => by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_omega.1 ha
    rw [app_comp _ _ ha, app_comp _ _ ha, app_zfSucc ha, ← vn_succ, app_zfRec, app_zfRec]
    rfl
  uniq x f h h₀ h₁ := zf_hom_ext fun a ha => by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_omega.1 ha
    rw [app_zfRec]
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      have : app (zfZero ≫ h).1 ∅ = app x.1 ∅ := by rw [h₀]
      exact (congrArg (app h.1) app_zfZero.symm).trans
        ((app_comp zfZero h (mem_singleton.2 rfl)).symm.trans this)
    | succ k ih =>
      have : app (zfSucc ≫ h).1 (vn k) = app (h ≫ f).1 (vn k) := by rw [h₁]
      exact (congrArg (app h.1) (app_zfSucc (vn_mem_omega k)).symm).trans
        ((app_comp zfSucc h (vn_mem_omega k)).symm.trans (this.trans
          ((app_comp h f (vn_mem_omega k)).trans (congrArg (app f.1) (ih (vn_mem_omega k))))))

/-- **Inclusion–exclusion**: `P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)`. -/
theorem prob_or (A B : Event α) :
    P.prob (fun x => A x ∨ B x) = P.prob A + P.prob B - P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ B x) := by
  simp only [prob]
  rw [← sumL_add, ← sumL_sub]

permutation group: `G ≃* (image of the left regular representation)`. -/

Foundations.Categories.homPreservesLimit:
/-- **Hom-functors preserve limits.** For a limit cone `c` of `K : J ⥤ C` and any object
`A`, the arrows `A ⟶ c.pt` form a limit of the diagram of types `j ↦ (A ⟶ K j)`: an arrow
into a limit is the same thing as a compatible family of arrows into the diagram. -/
def homPreservesLimit (A : C) {K : J ⥤ C} {c : Cone K} (hc : IsLimit c) :
    IsLimit (c.map (homFunctor A)) where
  lift s := fun x => hc.lift ⟨A, fun j => s.π j x, fun f => congrFun (s.w f) x⟩
  fac _ j := funext fun _ => hc.fac _ j
  uniq s m hm := funext fun x =>
    hc.uniq ⟨A, fun j => s.π j x, fun f => congrFun (s.w f) x⟩ (m x) fun j => congrFun (hm j) x
Foundations.Logic.Gentzen.reduction_term:
/-- **Termination of ordinal-decreasing reduction.** If a reduction procedure maps
objects to objects with strictly smaller ordinal (below ε₀) as long as some
condition `Reducible` holds, then iterating it from any start reaches, after finitely
many steps, an object that is no longer reducible. -/
theorem reduction_terminates {D : Type} (Reducible : D → Prop) (step : D → D) (o : D → ON)
    (hNF : ∀ d, NF (o d)) (hstep : ∀ d, Reducible d → lt (o (step d)) (o d)) (d : D) :
    ∃ k, ¬ Reducible (Nat.repeat step k d) := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hall
  have hall' : ∀ k, Reducible (Nat.repeat step k d) := fun k =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun h => hall ⟨k, h⟩
  exact no_infinite_descent (fun k => o (Nat.repeat step k d))
    (fun k => ⟨hNF _, hstep _ (hall' k)⟩)

Foundations.Algebra.dedekind:
/-- **Dedekind's lemma on the independence of characters.** Pairwise distinct maps
`χ₁, …, χₙ : F → F` into a field that are multiplicative (`χ(xy) = χ(x)χ(y)`, `χ(1) = 1`) are
linearly independent over `F`: if `∑ cᵢ χᵢ(x) = 0` for all `x`, then every `cᵢ = 0`. -/
theorem dedekind {F : Type u} [CommRing F] (hF : IsField F) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (χ : Fin n → F → F), (∀ i x y, χ i (x * y) = χ i x * χ i y) →
      (∀ i, χ i 1 = 1) → (∀ i j, χ i = χ j → i = j) → ∀ c : Fin n → F,
      (∀ x, isum (fun i => c i * χ i x) = 0) → ∀ i, c i = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _ _ _ _ _ _ i; exact absurd i.isLt (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro χ hmul hone hdist c hrel
    have htail : ∀ j : Fin m, c j.succ = 0 := by
      intro j
      have hne : χ j.succ ≠ χ 0 := fun h => absurd (hdist _ _ h) (Fin.succ_ne_zero j)
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, χ j.succ y ≠ χ 0 y := Classical.byContradiction fun hno =>
        hne (funext fun y => Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno ⟨y, h⟩)
      have hrel' : ∀ x, isum (fun i : Fin m => (c i.succ * (χ i.succ y + -χ 0 y)) * χ i.succ x) = 0 := by
        intro x
        have h1 : c 0 * χ 0 (x * y) + isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * χ i.succ (x * y)) = 0 := by
          have := hrel (x * y); rw [isum_fin_succ] at this; exact this
        have h2 : c 0 * χ 0 x + isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * χ i.succ x) = 0 := by
          have := hrel x; rw [isum_fin_succ] at this; exact this
        simp only [hmul] at h1
        have e : isum (fun i : Fin m => (c i.succ * (χ i.succ y + -χ 0 y)) * χ i.succ x) =
            isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * (χ i.succ x * χ i.succ y)) +
              -(isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * χ i.succ x) * χ 0 y) := by
          rw [isum_mul_right, ← isum_neg, ← isum_add]
          congr 1; funext i; grind
        rw [e]
        grind
      have := ih (fun i => χ i.succ) (fun i => hmul i.succ) (fun i => hone i.succ)
        (fun i j h => Fin.succ_inj.1 (hdist _ _ h)) _ hrel' j
      rcases hF.isDomain.2 _ _ this with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h) hy
    have ht : isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * χ i.succ 1) = 0 :=
      isum_eq_zero fun i => by rw [htail i, Ring.zero_mul]
    have hc0 : c 0 = 0 := by
      have e : c 0 * χ 0 1 + isum (fun i : Fin m => c i.succ * χ i.succ 1) = 0 := by
        have := hrel 1; rw [isum_fin_succ] at this; exact this
      rw [ht, hone] at e; grind
    intro i
    cases i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact hc0
    | succ j => exact htail j

/-- **Gentzen's Hauptsatz (cut elimination).** Every sequent derivable in `LK`, with
cut and the structural rules, has a cut-free derivation. -/
theorem cut_elimination {Γ Δ : List Formula} (h : LK Γ Δ) : CutFree Γ Δ := by
  induction h with
  | ax h₁ h₂ => exact .ax h₁ h₂
  | left hA hps _ ih => exact .left hA hps ih
  | right hA hps _ ih => exact .right hA hps ih
  | weak _ hΓ hΔ ih => exact ih.weaken hΓ hΔ

/-- **Every complex number has an `n`-th root** (`n ≥ 1`), by the fundamental theorem of
algebra applied to `x^n - c`. -/
theorem exists_rpow_eq (c : ℂ) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ y : ℂ, rpow y n = c := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hc : coeff (binomial c k) (k + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [coeff_binomial]; exact fun h => C.isField.1 h.symm
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := C.fta' (binomial c k) (by omega) hc
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  rw [eval_binomial] at hy
  grind

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.ordinal_trichotom:
/-- **Trichotomy for ordinals.** For ordinals `x` and `y`: `x ∈ y`, `x = y`, or `y ∈ x`.
Proved by a double ∈-induction. -/
theorem ordinal_trichotomy {x y : ZFSet} (hx : IsOrdinal x) (hy : IsOrdinal y) :
    x ∈ y ∨ x = y ∨ y ∈ x := by
  have key : ∀ x, IsOrdinal x → ∀ y, IsOrdinal y → x ∈ y ∨ x = y ∨ y ∈ x := by
    refine mem_induction _ (fun x ihx hx => ?_)
    refine mem_induction _ (fun y ihy hy => ?_)
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have hxy : x ∉ y := fun h => hne (Or.inl h)
    have hyx : y ∉ x := fun h => hne (Or.inr (Or.inr h))
    apply hne
    refine Or.inr (Or.inl (ext fun z => ⟨fun hz => ?_, fun hz => ?_⟩))
    · -- `z ∈ x`: compare `z` with `y` using the outer hypothesis
      rcases ihx z hz (hx.mem hz) y hy with h | rfl | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd hz hyx
      · exact absurd (hx.mem_trans h hz) hyx
    · -- `z ∈ y`: compare `x` with `z` using the inner hypothesis
      rcases ihy z hz (hy.mem hz) with h | rfl | h
      · exact absurd (hy.mem_trans h hz) hxy
      · exact absurd hz hxy
      · exact h
  exact key x hx y hy

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.integ:
/-- `∫ c · 1_A = c μ(A)` for every real `c`. -/
theorem integral_ind {A : α → Prop} (hA : S.M A) (c : R) :
    Integrable m (fun x => c * ind A x) ∧ integral m (fun x => c * ind A x) = c * m.μ A := by
  have h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ind A x := fun x => by unfold ind; split <;> grind
  obtain ⟨h1, e1⟩ := lintegral_ind m hA
  have hi := (integrable_iff_of_nonneg m h0).1.2 h1
  have := hi.const_mul m c
  rw [(integrable_iff_of_nonneg m h0).2, e1] at this; exact this
Foundations.Topology.rsum_congr_on:
/-- Riemann sums only see the values on `[a, b]`. -/
theorem rsum_congr_on {f g : R → R} {a b : R} (h : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x = g x) :
    ∀ (l : List (R × R)) (a' : R), a ≤ a' → IsTagged a' l b → rsum f a' l = rsum g a' l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ _ _; rfl
  | cons p l ih =>
    intro a' ha hl
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hl
    have := h3.le
    show f t * (x - a') + rsum f x l = g t * (x - a') + rsum g x l
    rw [h t (by grind) (by grind), ih x (by grind) h3]

  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases a with _ | _ | a <;> rcases b with _ | _ | b <;> simp_all [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.succ_mul] <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl

Foundations.Algebra.Necklace.const_of_fi:
/-- A necklace fixed by rotation is constant. -/
theorem Necklace.const_of_fixed {m : Nat} (x : Necklace G (m + 1))
    (hx : (ZMod.gen : ZMod (m + 1)) • x = x) : ∀ i, x i = x 0 := by
  have step : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), x (i + Fin.ofNat (m + 1) 1) = x i :=
    fun i => congrFun hx i
  intro ⟨k, hk⟩
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← ih (by omega), ← step ⟨k, by omega⟩]
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 1),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk]

Foundations.Topology.Vitali.InvariantMea:
/-- **Monotonicity**: a subset of `[0, 1)` has measure at most `1`. -/
theorem le_one {U : R → Prop} (hU : ∀ x, U x → I x) : M.μ U ≤ 1 := by
  let A : Nat → R → Prop := fun n x => (n = 0 ∧ U x) ∨ (n = 1 ∧ I x ∧ ¬ U x)
  have h := M.additive A (fun n x h => by rcases h with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h, _⟩; exact hU x h; exact h)
    (fun m n x hmn h1 h2 => by rcases h1 with ⟨rfl, h1⟩ | ⟨rfl, -, h1⟩ <;>
      rcases h2 with ⟨rfl, h2⟩ | ⟨rfl, -, h2⟩ <;> first | exact hmn rfl | exact h1 h2 | exact h2 h1)
  have e : (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) = I := funext fun x => propext
    ⟨fun ⟨n, h⟩ => by rcases h with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h, _⟩; exact hU x h; exact h,
     fun hx => by by_cases hu : U x
                  · exact ⟨0, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hu⟩⟩
                  · exact ⟨1, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hx, hu⟩⟩⟩
  rw [e, M.unit] at h
  have hz : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → M.μ (A k) = 0 := fun k hk => by
    have : A k = fun _ => False := funext fun x => propext
      ⟨fun h => by rcases h with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> omega, fun h => h.elim⟩
    rw [this, M.empty]
  have h2 := h.unique (hasSum_of_zero hz)
  have e0 : A 0 = U := funext fun x => propext
    ⟨fun h => by rcases h with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩; exact h; omega, fun h => Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩⟩
  rw [fsum_succ, fsum_succ, fsum_zero, e0] at h2
  have := M.nonneg (A 1)
  grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.isTermC_iff:
/-- **The term test is correct.** -/
theorem isTermC_iff (n : Nat) : isTermC n = 1 ↔ ∃ t, tcode t = n := by
  constructor
  · induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | _ n ih =>
      intro h
      obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b, n = pair a b := ⟨fst n, snd n, (pair_fst_snd n).symm⟩
      rw [isTermC_unfold] at h
      simp only [isTermStep, cvN, cvRec, fst_pair, snd_pair] at h
      by_cases ha0 : a = 0
      · subst ha0; exact ⟨v b, rfl⟩
      by_cases ha1 : a = 1
      · subst ha1
        by_cases hb : b = 0
        · subst hb; exact ⟨zero, rfl⟩
        · simp [hb] at h
      by_cases ha2 : a = 2
      · subst ha2
        simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true] at h
        rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (lt_pair_of_pos (by omega))] at h
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih b (lt_pair_of_pos (by omega)) h
        exact ⟨succ t, by rw [tcode_succ, ht]⟩
      by_cases ha34 : a = 3 ∨ a = 4
      · obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, rfl⟩ : ∃ b₁ b₂, b = pair b₁ b₂ := ⟨fst b, snd b, (pair_fst_snd b).symm⟩
        have hpos : 0 < a := by omega
        have h' : histGet (covHist isTermStep 0 (pair a (pair b₁ b₂))) (pair a (pair b₁ b₂)) b₁ *
            histGet (covHist isTermStep 0 (pair a (pair b₁ b₂))) (pair a (pair b₁ b₂)) b₂ = 1 := by
          have e0 : (a == 0) = false := by simp [ha0]
          have e1 : (a == 1) = false := by simp [ha1]
          have e2 : (a == 2) = false := by simp [ha2]
          have e34 : (a == 3 || a == 4) = true := by simp [ha34]
          simpa [e0, e1, e2, e34] using h
        rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged hpos),
          histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged hpos)] at h'
        obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mul_eq_one_iff'.1 h'
        obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := ih b₁ (fst_lt_tagged hpos) h₁
        obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := ih b₂ (snd_lt_tagged hpos) h₂
        rcases ha34 with rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨add t₁ t₂, by rw [tcode_add, ht₁, ht₂]⟩
        · exact ⟨mul t₁ t₂, by rw [tcode_mul, ht₁, ht₂]⟩
      · have e0 : (a == 0) = false := by simp [ha0]
        have e1 : (a == 1) = false := by simp [ha1]
        have e2 : (a == 2) = false := by simp [ha2]
        have e34 : (a == 3 || a == 4) = false := by simp only [Bool.or_eq_false_iff, beq_eq_false_iff_ne]; omega
        simp [e0, e1, e2, e34] at h
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    induction t using Term.arith_induction with
    | hv n =>
        rw [isTermC_unfold]
        simp only [isTermStep, cvN, tcode_var, fst_pair, snd_pair, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.cond_true]
    | hz =>
        have key : ∀ b, isTermC (pair 1 b) = (bif b == 0 then 1 else 0) := by
          intro b; rw [isTermC_unfold]
          simp only [isTermStep, cvN, fst_pair, snd_pair, Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true]
        rw [tcode_zero, key]; rfl
    | hs t ih =>
        rw [isTermC_unfold]
        simp only [isTermStep, cvN, cvRec, tcode_succ, fst_pair, snd_pair]
        simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true]
        rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (lt_pair_of_pos (by omega))]; exact ih
    | ha t s iht ihs =>
        rw [isTermC_unfold]
        simp only [isTermStep, cvN, cvRec, tcode_add, fst_pair, snd_pair]
        simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or]
        rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
          histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
        exact mul_eq_one_iff'.2 ⟨iht, ihs⟩
    | hm t s iht ihs =>
        rw [isTermC_unfold]
        simp only [isTermStep, cvN, cvRec, tcode_mul, fst_pair, snd_pair]
        simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or,
          Bool.or_true]
        rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
          histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
        exact mul_eq_one_iff'.2 ⟨iht, ihs⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Perm.swap:
/-- A **transposition** on a type with decidable equality: `swap a b` exchanges `a` and `b` and fixes everything else. -/
def swap [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) : Perm α where
  toFun x := if x = a then b else if x = b then a else x
  invFun x := if x = a then b else if x = b then a else x
  left_inv x := by by_cases h1 : x = a <;> by_cases h2 : x = b <;> simp_all
  right_inv x := by by_cases h1 : x = a <;> by_cases h2 : x = b <;> simp_all

  have : 1 - dot a a = 1 - n2 a := by unfold dot n2; grind
  rw [this]
  have : 1 - n2 a ≠ 0 := by grind
  grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.Comp.ncode:
/-- Numerals have computable Gödel numbers. -/
theorem Comp.ncode : Comp FO.ncode := by
  have := Comp.natRec (b := fun _ => pair 1 0) (s := fun q => pair 2 (snd (snd q)))
    (Comp.const _) (Comp.pair (Comp.const 2) (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id))) Comp.id
  have key : ∀ p k, natRec (fun _ => pair 1 0) (fun q => pair 2 (snd (snd q))) p k = FO.ncode k := by
    intro p k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simp only [natRec, snd_pair, ih]; rfl
  exact Comp.congr this fun n => key n n

      (Formula.ex (Formula.eq (Arith.add (Arith.add (v 5) (numeral 1)) (v 0))
        (Arith.add (numeral 1) (Arith.mul (Arith.add (v 4) (numeral 1)) (v 3)))))),

Foundations.Logic.HDerives.deduction:
/-- **Deduction theorem** (Herbrand, 1930). If `ψ` is derivable from `Γ ∪ {φ}` in the
Hilbert system then `φ → ψ` is derivable from `Γ`. -/
theorem deduction {Γ : Theory} {φ ψ : Formula} (h : insert Γ φ ⊢ₕ ψ) : Γ ⊢ₕ imp φ ψ := by
  induction h with
  | @hyp χ hχ =>
      rcases hχ with rfl | hχ
      · exact identity Γ _
      · exact mp (ax (.k χ φ)) (hyp hχ)
  | @ax χ hχ => exact mp (ax (.k χ φ)) (ax hχ)
  | @mp χ θ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact mp (mp (ax (.s φ χ θ)) ih₁) ih₂

Foundations.Logic.FO.fcode:
/-- **Gödel number of a formula.** -/
def fcode : Formula Arith → Nat
  | .bot => pair 0 0
  | .eq t s => pair 1 (pair (tcode t) (tcode s))
  | .rel R _ => (R : Empty).elim
  | .imp φ ψ => pair 2 (pair (fcode φ) (fcode ψ))
  | .conj φ ψ => pair 3 (pair (fcode φ) (fcode ψ))
  | .disj φ ψ => pair 4 (pair (fcode φ) (fcode ψ))
  | .all φ => pair 5 (fcode φ)
  | .ex φ => pair 6 (fcode φ)

Foundations.Logic.Formula.eval_congr:
/-- **Coincidence lemma.** Two valuations agreeing on the atoms of `φ` give `φ` the
same truth value: the meaning of a formula depends only on its own atoms. -/
theorem eval_congr {v w : Valuation} :
    ∀ φ : Formula, (∀ a ∈ atoms φ, v a = w a) → eval v φ = eval w φ
  | bot, _ => rfl
  | var n, h => by simp [eval, h n (by simp [atoms])]
  | imp φ ψ, h => by
      simp only [eval]
      rw [eval_congr φ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha])),
          eval_congr ψ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha]))]
  | conj φ ψ, h => by
      simp only [eval]
      rw [eval_congr φ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha])),
          eval_congr ψ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha]))]
  | disj φ ψ, h => by
      simp only [eval]
      rw [eval_congr φ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha])),
          eval_congr ψ (fun a ha => h a (by simp [atoms, ha]))]

  cases h : cmp x y
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (eq_of_cmp_eq h))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by simp [lt, cmp_swap x y, h, Ordering.swap]))

def kleeneT (e xs t : Nat) : Bool :=
  tvalid evalRule t == 1 && fst (troot t) == e && fst (snd (troot t)) == xs

  | 0, h => by simp [allUpTo] at h; simp [allUpTo, h]
  | n + 1, h => by
      rw [mem_allUpTo_succ] at h ⊢
      rcases h with h | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, by omega, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, allUpTo_succ ha, b, allUpTo_succ hb, h⟩)

Foundations.Algebra.steinitz:
/-- **Steinitz exchange lemma.** If an independent family `u` lies in the span of a family
`w`, then `u` has at most as many members as `w`. -/
theorem steinitz (hF : IsField K) {ι : Type w} {κ : Type w} [FiniteType ι] [FiniteType κ]
    (u : ι → V) (w' : κ → V) (hu : LinIndep K u) (hw : ∀ i, InSpan K w' (u i)) :
    card ι ≤ card κ := by
  apply Nat.le_of_not_lt
  intro hlt
  let a : ι → κ → K := fun i => Classical.choose (hw i)
  have ha : ∀ i, u i = isum (fun k => a i k • w' k) := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hw i)
  let A : Fin (card κ) → Fin (card ι) → K := fun r j => a (ofFin j) (ofFin r)
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨j0, hj0⟩, hx⟩ := exists_nontrivial_solution hF _ _ A hlt
  let c : ι → K := fun i => x (toFin i)
  have hsum : isum (fun i => c i • u i) = 0 := by
    have step : ∀ i, c i • u i = isum (fun k => (c i * a i k) • w' k) := by
      intro i; rw [ha i, smul_isum]; congr 1; funext k; rw [mul_smul]
    rw [show (fun i => c i • u i) = fun i => isum (fun k => (c i * a i k) • w' k) from funext step,
      isum_comm]
    apply isum_eq_zero
    intro k
    rw [← isum_smul]
    have hinner : isum (fun i => c i * a i k) = 0 := by
      rw [← isum_comp_bij ofFin ofFin_bij.1 ofFin_bij.2]
      have := hx (toFin k)
      rw [← this]
      congr 1; funext j
      show x (toFin (ofFin j)) * a (ofFin j) k = a (ofFin j) (ofFin (toFin k)) * x j
      rw [toFin_ofFin, ofFin_toFin, CommRing.mul_comm]
    rw [hinner, zero_smul]
  have := hu c hsum (ofFin j0)
  apply hj0
  rw [← this]; show x j0 = x (toFin (ofFin j0)); rw [toFin_ofFin]
Foundations.Sets.sum_equinum_of_le:
/-- If `α` is infinite and `β` is no larger, then `α ⊕ β ≃ α`. -/
theorem sum_equinum_of_le {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (h : IsInfinite α) (hβ : CardLE β α) :
    Equinum (α ⊕ β) α := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hβ
  obtain ⟨d, hd, _⟩ := add_self_equinum h
  let F : α ⊕ β → α := fun
    | .inl a => d (.inl a)
    | .inr b => d (.inr (k b))
  have hF : Function.Injective F := by
    intro s t hst
    cases s <;> cases t <;> simp only [F] at hst <;> have := hd hst
    · rw [Sum.inl.inj this]
    · cases this
    · cases this
    · rw [hk (Sum.inr.inj this)]
  exact schroeder_bernstein (f := F) (g := Sum.inl) hF (fun a b h => Sum.inl.inj h)
