Foundations.Numbers.R.integrable_of_cont:
/-- **Continuous functions are integrable.** A function continuous at every point of `[a, b]`
has a Riemann integral over `[a, b]`. -/
theorem integrable_of_continuous {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) : ∃ I, HasIntegral f a b I := by
  -- Uniform continuity, packaged for the comparison lemma.
  have huc : ∀ η : R, 0 < η → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (P Q : List (R × R)),
      IsTagged a P b → MeshLt δ a P → IsTagged a Q b → MeshLt δ a Q →
      abs (rsum f a P - rsum f a Q) ≤ η := fun η hη => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := uniform_continuous hf (div_pos hη (by grind : 0 < b - a + 1))
    refine ⟨δ / 2, by grind, fun P Q hP hmP hQ hmQ => ?_⟩
    have k := abs_rsum_sub_rsum_le (f := f) (A := a) (B := b) (δ := δ / 2)
      (fun s s' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 => Std.le_of_lt (hδf s s' h1 h2 h3 h4 (by grind)))
      _ a b P Q (Nat.le_refl _) (fine_of_isTagged (Std.le_refl a) (Std.le_refl b) hP hmP)
      (fine_of_isTagged (Std.le_refl a) (Std.le_refl b) hQ hmQ)
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : b - a ≤ b - a + 1)
      (Std.le_of_lt (div_pos hη (by grind : 0 < b - a + 1)))
    have e : η / (b - a + 1) * (b - a + 1) = η := by grind
    grind
  -- The Riemann sums of the uniform partitions form a Cauchy sequence.
  let h : Nat → R := fun n => (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)
  have hh : ∀ n, 0 ≤ h n := fun n => by
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    show 0 ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (by grind)))
  let P : Nat → List (R × R) := fun n => unif a (h n) (n + 1)
  have hP : ∀ n, IsTagged a (P n) b := fun n => by
    have := unif_isTagged (hh n) (n + 1) a; rw [unif_end] at this; exact this
  let S : Nat → R := fun n => rsum f a (P n)
  have hfine : ∀ δ : R, 0 < δ → ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → MeshLt δ a (P n) := fun δ hδ => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_div_lt (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a) hδ
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn => unif_meshLt (hN n hn) _ a⟩
  have hS : IsCauchySeq S := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := huc (ε / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hfine δ hδ
    exact ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => by
      have := hδ' (P m) (P n) (hP m) (hN m hm) (hP n) (hN n hn); grind⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := cauchy_complete hS
  -- Its limit is the integral.
  refine ⟨I, hab, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := huc (ε / 2) (by grind)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun l hl hm => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hfine δ hδ
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hI (ε / 2) (by grind)
  have k1 := hδ' l (P (max N₁ N₂)) hl hm (hP _) (hN₁ _ (by omega))
  have k2 := hN₂ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)
  have k3 := abs_add (rsum f a l - S (max N₁ N₂)) (S (max N₁ N₂) - I)
  rw [show rsum f a l - S (max N₁ N₂) + (S (max N₁ N₂) - I) = rsum f a l - I by grind] at k3
  grind

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.fsum_:
/-- A single spike: `Σ_{j<M} [j = q] c = c` if `q < M`. -/
theorem fsum_spike (c : R) (q : Nat) : ∀ M, q < M → fsum (fun j => if j = q then c else 0) M = c
  | 0, h => by omega
  | M + 1, h => by
    rw [fsum_succ]
    by_cases e : M = q
    · subst e
      have : fsum (fun j => if j = M then c else 0) M = 0 := by
        have := fsum_congr (n := M) (a := fun j => if j = M then c else 0) (b := fun _ => 0)
          fun k hk => by simp; omega
        rw [this]; clear this
        induction M with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ M ih => rw [fsum_succ, ih (by omega)]; grind
      rw [this, Outer.ite_pos' rfl]; grind
    · rw [fsum_spike c q M (by omega), Outer.ite_neg' e]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.nodup_flatMap:
/-- A `flatMap` of repetition-free, pairwise disjoint blocks indexed by a repetition-free
list is repetition-free. -/
theorem nodup_flatMap {β : Type _} {l : List α} {f : α → List β} (h1 : l.Nodup)
    (h2 : ∀ a, (f a).Nodup) (h3 : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → ∀ x, x ∈ f a → x ∉ f b) :
    (l.flatMap f).Nodup := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at h1
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨h2 a, ih h1.2, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hy
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hyb⟩ := hy
    have hab : a ≠ b := fun e => h1.1 (e ▸ hb)
    exact h3 a b hab x hx (hxy ▸ hyb)
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.unique_fa:
/-- **Unique factorisation in `F[x]`.** Over a field, every non-zero non-unit polynomial is a
product of irreducible polynomials, uniquely up to order and constant factors. -/
theorem unique_factorization (hF : IsField F) (p : Polynomial F) (hp0 : p ≠ 0)
    (hpu : ¬ IsUnit p) :
    (∃ L : List (Polynomial F), (∀ q, q ∈ L → Irreducible q) ∧ lprod L = p) ∧
    ∀ L M : List (Polynomial F), (∀ q, q ∈ L → Irreducible q) → (∀ q, q ∈ M → Irreducible q) →
      lprod L = p → lprod M = p → ∀ x, countAssoc x L = countAssoc x M :=
  ⟨exists_factorization hF _ p rfl hp0 hpu, fun L M hL hM h1 h2 x =>
    (polynomial_isPID hF).factorization_unique L M 1 hL hM ⟨1, Ring.mul_one 1⟩
      (by rw [h1, h2, Ring.one_mul]) x⟩
Foundations.Algebra.IsPrimeElt.irreducib:
/-- **Prime elements are irreducible** in an integral domain. -/
theorem IsPrimeElt.irreducible (hD : IsDomain R) {p : R} (hp : IsPrimeElt p) : Irreducible p := by
  refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, fun a b hab => ?_⟩
  rcases hp.2.2 a b ⟨1, by rw [Ring.mul_one, hab]⟩ with ⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨c, hc⟩
  · right
    refine ⟨c, hD.mul_left_cancel hp.1 ?_⟩
    calc p * (b * c) = (p * c) * b := by ac_rfl
      _ = p * 1 := by rw [← hc, ← hab, Ring.mul_one]
  · left
    refine ⟨c, hD.mul_left_cancel hp.1 ?_⟩
    calc p * (a * c) = a * (p * c) := by ac_rfl
      _ = p * 1 := by rw [← hc, ← hab, Ring.mul_one]

Foundations.Logic.FO.decidable_represent:
/-- **Representability of decidable sets in `Q`.** If a code `c` computes the
characteristic function of `p : ℕ → Bool`, there is a formula `R(x)` with only the
free variable `x`, such that `Q ⊢ R(n̄)` when `p n` and `Q ⊢ ¬R(n̄)` otherwise. -/
theorem decidable_representable {p : Nat → Bool} {c : Code} (hc : ∀ n, Eval c [n] (p n).toNat) :
    ∃ R : Formula Arith, (∀ x, 1 ≤ x → R.Fresh x) ∧ ∀ n,
      (p n = true → Q ⊢₁ R.inst (numeral n)) ∧ (p n = false → Q ⊢₁ neg (R.inst (numeral n))) := by
  have hdisj : ∀ n w u, holds (outF c 1) w n → holds (outF c 0) u n → False := by
    intro n w u h₁ h₀
    rw [holds_outF] at h₁ h₀
    exact absurd (Eval.det h₁.sound h₀.sound) (by omega)
  refine ⟨sepF (outF c 1) (outF c 0), sepF_fresh (outF_fresh c 1) (outF_fresh c 0), fun n => ?_⟩
  have hs := rosser_sep (outF_D0 c 1) (outF_D0 c 0) hdisj n
  constructor
  · intro hp
    refine hs.1 ?_
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := EvalB.complete (hc n)
    exact ⟨w, (holds_outF ..).2 (by simpa [hp] using hw)⟩
  · intro hp
    refine hs.2 ?_
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := EvalB.complete (hc n)
    exact ⟨w, (holds_outF ..).2 (by simpa [hp] using hw)⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Perm.ext:
/-- Two permutations with the same values are equal (the inverse is then determined). -/
theorem ext {σ τ : Perm α} (h : ∀ x, σ x = τ x) : σ = τ := by
  cases σ with
  | mk f g l r =>
    cases τ with
    | mk f' g' l' r' =>
      have hf : f = f' := funext h
      subst hf
      have hg : g = g' := funext fun x => by
        have := l (g' x); rw [r' x] at this; exact this
      subst hg; rfl
Foundations.Logic.FO.provH_D3:
/-- **Condition (D3) for `provH`.** `PA ⊢ □φ → □□φ`. -/
theorem provH_D3 (φ : Formula Arith) : PA ⊢₁ imp (box provH φ) (box provH (box provH φ)) :=
  PA_proves_of_models fun N e => by
    simp only [Sat, sat_box_provH]
    intro h
    -- necessitation: `□φ ⊢ accF(⌜φ⌝)` as a line
    have h₁ : ProvM ((fcode (box accF φ) : Nat) : N.Dom) := by
      rw [← necFun_fcode]; exact provM_nec (nec_natCast _) h
    -- the axiom line `accF(⌜φ⌝) → provH(⌜φ⌝)`
    have h₂ : ProvM ((fcode (imp (box accF φ) (box provH φ)) : Nat) : N.Dom) :=
      provM_of_acc (acc_of_halts ((searchPA_spec _).2 ⟨_, rfl, accF_imp_provH φ⟩))
    -- modus ponens
    exact provM_mp (mpm_natCast _ _) h₂ h₁

  have e : (fun x => pp (- -f x)) = fun x => pp (f x) := funext fun x => by rw [show - -f x = f x by grind]

  unfold integral; rw [e]; grind

Foundations.Combinatorics.le_findGreates:
/-- ... and is at least every value satisfying `P`. -/
theorem le_findGreatest {P : Nat → Prop} : ∀ n m, m ≤ n → P m → m ≤ findGreatest P n
  | 0, m, h, _ => h
  | n + 1, m, h₁, hm => by
      simp only [findGreatest]
      split
      · exact h₁
      · next h =>
          refine le_findGreatest n m ?_ hm
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (n + 1) with h' | h'
          · omega
          · exact absurd (show m = n + 1 by omega ▸ hm) h

/-- **Extending a monotone subsequence.** -/
theorem monoEnd_extend (htrans : ∀ x y z, r x y → r y z → r x z) {i j k : Nat} (_hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (h : MonoEnd r a i k) (hij : i < j) (hr : r (a i) (a j)) : MonoEnd r a j (k + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmono⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun p => if p < k then s p else j, by simp, fun p q hpq hq => ?_⟩
  by_cases hqk : q < k
  · simp only [hqk, show p < k by omega, ite_true]; exact hmono p q hpq hqk
  · simp only [hqk, show p < k by omega, ite_true, ite_false]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := monoEnd_le hs hmono p (by omega)
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂
    · rw [h₂]; exact hr
    · exact htrans _ _ _ h₂ hr

Foundations.Logic.Derives.toLK:
/-- **From natural deduction to LK.** If `φ` is derivable from premises `Γ` and all
of these premises are listed in `L`, then `L ⊢ φ` is derivable in `LK`. Each
elimination rule becomes a cut against a left rule. -/
theorem _root_.Foundations.Logic.Derives.toLK {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) :
    ∀ L : List Formula, (∀ ψ, Γ ψ → ψ ∈ L) → LK L [φ] := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact fun L hL => LK.ax (hL _ hφ) (by simp)
  | @impI Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      have := ih (φ :: L) (by intro χ hχ; rcases hχ with rfl | hχ <;> simp [hL _, *])
      exact LK.impR (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp) (LK.weak this (by grind) (by grind))
  | @impE Γ φ ψ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro L hL
      refine LK.cut (imp φ ψ) (LK.weak (ih₁ L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) ?_
      exact LK.impL (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp)
        (LK.weak (ih₂ L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) (LK.ax (A := ψ) (by simp) (by simp))
  | @conjI Γ φ ψ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro L hL
      exact LK.conjR (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp)
        (LK.weak (ih₁ L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) (LK.weak (ih₂ L hL) (by grind) (by grind))
  | @conjE₁ Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      refine LK.cut (conj φ ψ) (LK.weak (ih L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) ?_
      exact LK.conjL (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp) (LK.ax (A := φ) (by simp) (by simp))
  | @conjE₂ Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      refine LK.cut (conj φ ψ) (LK.weak (ih L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) ?_
      exact LK.conjL (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp) (LK.ax (A := ψ) (by simp) (by simp))
  | @disjI₁ Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      exact LK.disjR (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp) (LK.weak (ih L hL) (by grind) (by grind))
  | @disjI₂ Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      exact LK.disjR (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp) (LK.weak (ih L hL) (by grind) (by grind))
  | @disjE Γ φ ψ χ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      intro L hL
      have h₂ := ih₂ (φ :: L) (by intro θ hθ; rcases hθ with rfl | hθ <;> simp [hL _, *])
      have h₃ := ih₃ (ψ :: L) (by intro θ hθ; rcases hθ with rfl | hθ <;> simp [hL _, *])
      refine LK.cut (disj φ ψ) (LK.weak (ih₁ L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) ?_
      exact LK.disjL (A := φ) (B := ψ) (by simp)
        (LK.weak h₂ (by grind) (by grind)) (LK.weak h₃ (by grind) (by grind))
  | @botE Γ φ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      exact LK.cut bot (LK.weak (ih L hL) (by grind) (by grind)) (LK.botL (by simp))
  | @raa Γ φ _ ih =>
      intro L hL
      have h₁ := ih (neg φ :: L) (by intro θ hθ; rcases hθ with rfl | hθ <;> simp [hL _, *])
      -- `L ⊢ ¬φ, φ`
      have h₂ : LK L [neg φ, φ] :=
        LK.impR (A := φ) (B := bot) (by simp [neg]) (LK.ax (A := φ) (by simp) (by simp))
      refine LK.cut (neg φ) h₂ ?_
      exact LK.cut bot (LK.weak h₁ (by grind) (by grind)) (LK.botL (by simp))

Foundations.Algebra.c3_mem_derivedSeries:
/-- **Every term of the derived series of `Sₙ` (`n ≥ 5`) contains every 3-cycle.** -/
theorem c3_mem_derivedSeries {n : Nat} (hn : 5 ≤ n) :
    ∀ k (a b c : Fin n), a ≠ b → b ≠ c → a ≠ c → c3 a b c ∈ derivedSeries (Perm (Fin n)) k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _ _ _ _ _ _; trivial
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a b c hab hbc hac
    have hv : ∀ {x y : Fin n}, x.val ≠ y.val → x ≠ y := fun h e => h (congrArg Fin.val e)
    have hv' : ∀ {x y : Fin n}, x ≠ y → x.val ≠ y.val := fun h e => h (Fin.ext e)
    obtain ⟨d, hd4, hda, hdb, hdc⟩ := avoid3 a.val b.val c.val
    obtain ⟨e, he5, hea, heb, hec, hed⟩ := avoid4 a.val b.val c.val d
    let D : Fin n := ⟨d, by omega⟩
    let E : Fin n := ⟨e, by omega⟩
    have hdE : D ≠ E := hv (show d ≠ e from Ne.symm hed)
    rw [c3_eq_commutator hab hac (hv (Ne.symm hda)) (hv (Ne.symm hea)) hbc
      (hv (Ne.symm hdb)) (hv (Ne.symm heb)) (hv (Ne.symm hdc)) (hv (Ne.symm hec)) hdE]
    exact Closure.of ⟨_, _, ih a b D hab (hv (Ne.symm hdb)) (hv (Ne.symm hda)),
      ih a c E hac (hv (Ne.symm hec)) (hv (Ne.symm hea)), rfl⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.sepF_fresh:
/-- The separation formula has free variable `0` only, if `A` and `B` have free
variables among `0, 1`. -/
theorem sepF_fresh {A B : Formula Arith} (hA : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → A.Fresh n)
    (hB : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → B.Fresh n) : ∀ x, 1 ≤ x → (sepF A B).Fresh x := by
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨fresh_substL hA (by simp) ?_, boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
    fresh_substL hB (by simp) ?_, trivial⟩
  · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> exact var_fresh (by omega)
  · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> exact var_fresh (by omega)
Foundations.Numbers.R.exp_add:
/-- **Functional equation of the exponential.** `exp (x + y) = exp x · exp y`. -/
theorem exp_add (x y : R) : exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y := by
  -- `g t = exp t · exp (c − t)` has derivative `0`, hence is constant.
  let c := x + y
  have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => exp t * exp (c - t))
      (exp t * exp (c - t) + exp t * (exp (c - t) * (0 - 1))) t := fun t =>
    (hasDerivAt_exp t).mul ((hasDerivAt_exp (c - t)).comp (f := fun t => c - t)
      ((hasDerivAt_const c t).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)))
  have := const_of_deriv_zero' hd (fun t => by grind) x 0
  rw [exp_zero, show c - x = y by grind, show c - 0 = x + y by grind] at this
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.genAut:
/-- **Embeddings of a stable tower are automorphisms.** An embedding `τ : gen ℚ m → ℂ` of a
stable field is (the restriction of) an automorphism of `gen ℚ m` over `ℚ`. -/
noncomputable def genAut {m : List ℂ} (hst : Stable (gen Qc m)) (τ : RingHom (gen Qc m) ℂ) :
    FieldAut Qc (gen Qc m) :=
  autOfRingHom C.isField (le_gen Qc m) (gen_finite Qc m)
    { toFun := fun y => ⟨τ.toFun y, hst τ y⟩
      map_add := fun a b => Subtype.ext (τ.map_add a b)
      map_mul := fun a b => Subtype.ext (τ.map_mul a b)
      map_one := Subtype.ext τ.map_one }
    (fun x hx => Subtype.ext (ringHom_fix_Qc τ x hx))

theorem sem_weaken {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (t : Tm Γ A) :
    semTm ι (rename (fun x => Mem.there (B := B) x) t) = fst ≫ semTm ι t := by

theorem bump_ne_zero (c : Nat) {n : Nat} (h : n ≠ 0) : bump c n ≠ 0 := by

Foundations.Topology.IsCompact.exists_ma:
/-- **A non-empty compact set of reals has a largest element.** -/
theorem IsCompact.exists_max {K : R → Prop} (hK : IsCompact (Topology.metric R) K)
    (hne : ∃ x, K x) : ∃ s, K s ∧ ∀ y, K y → y ≤ s := by
  -- Bounded above: cover by the open sets `(−∞, n)`.
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hK Nat (fun n y => y < (n : R)) (fun n y hy =>
      ⟨(n : R) - y, by grind, fun z hz => by have := (abs_lt.1 hz); grind⟩)
    (fun y _ => archimedean y)
  let M := l.foldr (fun b m => max ((fun k : Nat => k) b) m) 0
  have hbdd : ∀ y, K y → y ≤ (M : R) := fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hl y hy
    have := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le (R := R) n M (le_foldr_max (fun k => k) l hn)
    grind
  obtain ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩ := exists_lub K hne ⟨_, hbdd⟩
  refine ⟨s, ?_, hs1⟩
  -- If `s ∉ K`, the open sets `(−∞, s − 1/(n+1))` cover `K`, so `K` stays below some `s − 1/(N+1)`.
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hsK
  obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := hK Nat (fun n y => y < s - 1 / ((n : R) + 1)) (fun n y hy =>
      ⟨s - 1 / ((n : R) + 1) - y, by grind, fun z hz => by have := (abs_lt.1 hz); grind⟩)
    (fun y hy => by
      have hys : y < s := by
        rcases (by have := hs1 y hy; grind : y < s ∨ y = s) with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (h ▸ hy) hsK
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small (by grind : 0 < s - y)
      exact ⟨N, by have := hN N (Nat.le_refl N); grind⟩)
  let N := l'.foldr (fun b m => max ((fun k : Nat => k) b) m) 0
  have := hs2 (s - 1 / ((N : R) + 1)) fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hl' y hy
    have hnN := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le (R := R) n N (le_foldr_max (fun k => k) l' hn)
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    have := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1) (by grind : (n : R) + 1 ≤ (N : R) + 1)
    grind
  have := eps_pos N
  grind

Foundations.Logic.Computability.phi_enco:
/-- `φ_{⌜c⌝}` is the function computed by `c`. -/
theorem phi_encode (c : Code) (y n : Nat) : phi (encode c) y n ↔ Eval c [y] n := by
  unfold phi U
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v₀, v₁, h₀, h₁, h⟩ := eval_comp2_inv h
    cases h₀
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hs⟩ := eval_comp1_inv h₁
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hp⟩ := eval_comp2_inv hu
    cases ha; cases hb; cases hs
    rw [Eval.det hp (eval_pair _ _ [])] at h
    exact (eval_univ c [y] n).1 h
  · intro h
    exact eval_comp2 .proj (eval_succOf (eval_pairOf .proj .zero)) ((eval_univ c [y] n).2 h)
Foundations.Bridges.El_summary:
/-- **Summary: the members-functor from ZF to types.** `El : ZFCat ⥤ Type 1` is faithful
and full, is not essentially surjective, and sends `{∅}`, `X × Y` and `ω` to a terminal
object, a product and a natural numbers object. -/
theorem El_summary :
    (∀ {X Y : ZFCat} (F G : X ⟶ Y), El.map F = El.map G → F = G) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : ZFCat} (f : El.obj X ⟶ El.obj Y), ∃ F, El.map F = f) ∧
    (¬ ∃ X : ZFCat, Nonempty (El.obj X ≅ (ZFSet : Type 1))) ∧
    Nonempty (IsTerminal (C := Type 1) (El.obj zfOne)) ∧
    (∀ X Y : ZFCat, Nonempty (IsProduct (C := Type 1) (El.obj X) (El.obj Y)
      (El.obj (zfProd X Y)) (El.map (zfFst X Y)) (El.map (zfSnd X Y)))) ∧
    Nonempty (IsNNO (C := Type 1) (El.obj zfOne) (El.obj zfOmega) (El.map zfZero)
      (El.map zfSucc)) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => El_faithful h, El_full, El_not_essSurj, ⟨El_one_terminal⟩,
    fun X Y => ⟨El_preserves_product X Y⟩, ⟨El_omega_isNNO⟩⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.rC17:
/-- Rule 17 on codes: Leibniz's law. -/
def rC17 (q : Nat) : Bool :=
  qtag q == 17 && decide (1 < llen (qjs q)) && isFormulaC (fst (qdat q)) == 1 &&
    isTermC (fst (snd (qdat q))) == 1 &&
    isTermC (snd (snd (qdat q))) == 1 &&
    qprem q 0 == pj (qk q) (qD q) (pair 1 (snd (qdat q))) &&
    qprem q 1 == pj (qk q) (qD q) (instC (fst (qdat q)) (fst (snd (qdat q)))) &&
    instC (fst (qdat q)) (snd (snd (qdat q))) == qF q
Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_pser:
/-- **Termwise differentiation.** A power series `Σ cₙ xⁿ/n!` with `|cₙ| ≤ 1` is differentiable
everywhere, and its derivative is the power series with the shifted coefficients `cₙ₊₁`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_pser {c : Nat → R} (hc : ∀ n, abs (c n) ≤ 1) (x : R) :
    HasDerivAt (pser c) (pser (fun n => c (n + 1)) x) x := by
  let D := pser (fun n => c (n + 1)) x
  -- The termwise derivative `Σ cₙ n xⁿ⁻¹/n!` sums to `D`.
  have hD : HasSum (fun n => c n * derTerm x n) D := by
    apply hasSum_succ_iff.1
    have e0 : c 0 * derTerm x 0 = 0 := by
      unfold derTerm; show c 0 * (((0 : Nat) : R) * x ^ (0 - 1) / _) = 0; grind
    rw [e0, show D - 0 = D by grind]
    refine (hasSum_pser (fun n => hc (n + 1)) x).congr fun n => ?_
    unfold pterm derTerm expTerm
    rw [fact_succ', show n + 1 - 1 = n by omega]
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < (n : R) + 1) (fact_pos' n)
    have := fact_pos' n
    grind
  let M := abs x + 1
  have hE : 0 ≤ exp M := by
    have := one_add_le_exp (by have := abs_nonneg x; grind : 0 ≤ M)
    have := abs_nonneg x; grind
  refine hasDerivAt_of_quadratic (C := exp M / 2) (by grind) fun y hy => ?_
  have hx : abs x ≤ M := by grind
  have hyM : abs y ≤ M := by
    have := abs_add (y - x) x; rw [show y - x + x = y by grind] at this; grind
  -- The error series sums to `f y − f x − D (y − x)` …
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n => c n * (powErr x y n / (fact n : R)))
      (pser c y - pser c x - (y - x) * D) := by
    refine (((hasSum_pser hc y).sub (hasSum_pser hc x)).sub (hD.const_mul (y - x))).congr
      fun n => ?_
    unfold pterm expTerm derTerm powErr
    have := fact_pos' n
    grind
  -- … its first two terms vanish …
  have h2 : HasSum (fun n => c (2 + n) * (powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R)))
      (pser c y - pser c x - (y - x) * D) := by
    have := (hasSum_shift_iff (a := fun n => c n * (powErr x y n / (fact n : R))) 2).2 h1
    have e : fsum (fun n => c n * (powErr x y n / (fact n : R))) 2 = 0 := by
      rw [fsum_succ, fsum_succ, fsum_zero, powErr_zero, powErr_one]; grind
    rw [e, show pser c y - pser c x - (y - x) * D - 0 = pser c y - pser c x - (y - x) * D by
      grind] at this
    exact this
  -- … and the terms are dominated as for `exp`.
  have h3 : ∀ n, abs (c (2 + n) * (powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R))) ≤
      abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2 * expTerm M n := fun n => by
    rw [abs_mul]
    have k := abs_powErr_div_le hx hyM n
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc (2 + n)) (abs_nonneg
      (powErr x y (2 + n) / (fact (2 + n) : R)))
    grind
  have := abs_hasSum_le h3 h2 ((hasSum_exp M).const_mul (abs (y - x) * abs (y - x) / 2))
  rw [show pser c y - pser c x - (y - x) * D = pser c y - pser c x - D * (y - x) by grind] at this
  grind

  intro s t h

    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h'

  fun c => by

Foundations.Topology.not_isConnected_pun:
/-- `ℝ ∖ {0}` (as a subspace of `ℝ`) is **not connected**: negatives and positives separate it. -/
theorem not_isConnected_punctured :
    ¬ IsConnected (Topology.subspace (Topology.metric R) (fun x => x ≠ 0)) (fun _ => True) := by
  intro h
  apply h
  refine ⟨fun x => x.1 < 0, fun x => 0 < x.1,
    ⟨fun y => y < 0, fun y hy => ⟨-y, by grind, fun z hz => by have := abs_lt.1 hz; grind⟩,
      fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩,
    ⟨fun y => 0 < y, fun y hy => ⟨y, hy, fun z hz => by have := abs_lt.1 hz; grind⟩,
      fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩,
    fun x _ => by have := x.2; rcases (by grind : x.1 < 0 ∨ x.1 = 0 ∨ 0 < x.1) with h | h | h
                  · exact Or.inl h
                  · exact absurd h x.2
                  · exact Or.inr h,
    ⟨⟨-1, by grind⟩, trivial, by show (-1 : R) < 0; grind⟩,
    ⟨⟨1, by grind⟩, trivial, by show (0 : R) < 1; grind⟩, fun x _ h1 h2 => by grind⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.Fine:
/-- `Fine A B δ a l b`: a loosened notion of `δ`-fine tagged partition of `[a, b]`, used only in
the proof below. The tags lie in `[A, B]` and each piece `[xᵢ₋₁, xᵢ]` lies within `δ` of its
tag `tᵢ` (but the tag need not lie in the piece). Shrinking a piece keeps it fine. -/
def Fine (A B δ : R) : R → List (R × R) → R → Prop
  | a, [], b => a = b
  | a, (t, x) :: l, b => a ≤ x ∧ A ≤ t ∧ t ≤ B ∧ t - δ < a ∧ x < t + δ ∧ Fine A B δ x l b

/-- **Law of exponents.** `a ^ (m + n) = a ^ m * a ^ n`. -/

  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ, ih, pow_succ, mul_assoc]

Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.mem_listS:
/-- Membership in `listSubtype`. -/
theorem mem_listSubtype {γ : Type u} (P : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (l : List γ) (x : {x // P x}) :
    x ∈ listSubtype P l ↔ x.1 ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [listSubtype]
  | cons y l ih =>
    unfold listSubtype
    by_cases h : P y
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, List.mem_cons, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (h1 | h1)
        · left; rw [h1]
        · right; exact h1
      · rintro (h1 | h1)
        · left; exact Subtype.ext h1
        · right; exact h1
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, List.mem_cons, ih]
      constructor
      · intro h1; right; exact h1
      · rintro (h1 | h1)
        · exact absurd (h1 ▸ x.2) h
        · exact h1

/-- **The rationals are totally disconnected**: a set of rational numbers containing two distinct
points is not connected. -/
theorem rationals_totally_disconnected {A : R → Prop} (hA : ∀ x, A x → IsRational x)

Foundations.Logic.FO.coprime_moduli:
/-- The moduli `1 + (i + 1)·B` are pairwise coprime when every `1 ≤ k ≤ j - i`
divides `B`. -/
theorem coprime_moduli {B i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (hB : (j - i) ∣ B) :
    Nat.Coprime (1 + (i + 1) * B) (1 + (j + 1) * B) := by
  let g := Nat.gcd (1 + (i + 1) * B) (1 + (j + 1) * B)
  have hgi : g ∣ 1 + (i + 1) * B := Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have hgj : g ∣ 1 + (j + 1) * B := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  have hdiff : (1 + (j + 1) * B) - (1 + (i + 1) * B) = (j - i) * B := by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = i + k := ⟨j - i, by omega⟩
    have : (i + k + 1) * B = (i + 1) * B + k * B := by
      rw [show i + k + 1 = (i + 1) + k by omega, Nat.add_mul]
    rw [show i + k - i = k by omega]; omega
  have hg1 : g ∣ (j - i) * B := hdiff ▸ Nat.dvd_sub hgj hgi
  -- `g` is coprime to `B`
  have hgB : Nat.Coprime g B := by
    show Nat.gcd g B = 1
    have h1 : Nat.gcd g B ∣ 1 + (i + 1) * B := Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _) hgi
    have h2 : Nat.gcd g B ∣ (i + 1) * B := Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
    have : Nat.gcd g B ∣ 1 := by
      have := Nat.dvd_sub h1 h2
      rwa [show 1 + (i + 1) * B - (i + 1) * B = 1 by omega] at this
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one this
  have hg2 : g ∣ j - i := Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hgB hg1
  exact Nat.Coprime.eq_one_of_dvd hgB (Nat.dvd_trans hg2 hB)
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.sint_:
/-- A simple function below a constant `c` has integral at most `c · μ(α)`. -/
theorem sint_le_const {l : List (R × (α → Prop))} (hl : IsSimple S l) {c : R} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hb : Below l (fun _ => c)) : sint m l ≤ c * m.μ (fun _ => True) := by
  have h1 : sint m l ≤ lsum (fun p => c * m.μ p.2) l := lsum_le fun p hp => by
    by_cases hne : ∃ x, p.2 x
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
      exact OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb p hp x hx) (m.nonneg _ (hl.1 p hp).2)
    · have : m.μ p.2 = 0 := by rw [← m.empty]; exact m.congr fun x => ⟨fun h => hne ⟨x, h⟩, False.elim⟩
      rw [this]; grind
  rw [lsum_mul_left] at h1
  have := lsum_measure_le m (set := Prod.snd) (fun p hp => (hl.1 p hp).2) hl.2
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hc
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.tarski_undefinabili:
/-- **Tarski's undefinability theorem.** No formula `Tr(x)` (with only the free
variable `x`) defines arithmetical truth: there is no `Tr` such that, for every
sentence `σ`, `ℕ ⊨ Tr(⌜σ⌝)` iff `ℕ ⊨ σ`. -/
theorem tarski_undefinability :
    ¬ ∃ Tr : Formula Arith, (∀ x, 1 ≤ x → Tr.Fresh x) ∧
      ∀ σ : Formula Arith, IsSentence σ → ∀ e : Nat → Nat,
        (Sat stdModel e (Tr.inst (numeral (fcode σ))) ↔ Sat stdModel e σ) := by
  rintro ⟨Tr, hfresh, hTr⟩
  let L := diagSentence (neg Tr)
  have hL : IsSentence L := diagSentence_sentence fun x hx => ⟨hfresh x hx, trivial⟩
  have h₁ := sat_diagSentence stdModel_isQModel (neg Tr) (fun _ => 0)
  have h₂ := hTr L hL (fun _ => 0)
  rw [show (neg Tr).inst (numeral (fcode (diagSentence (neg Tr)))) =
    neg (Tr.inst (numeral (fcode (diagSentence (neg Tr))))) from rfl, sat_neg] at h₁
  -- `L ↔ ¬Tr(⌜L⌝) ↔ ¬L`
  have : Sat stdModel (fun _ => 0) L ↔ ¬ Sat stdModel (fun _ => 0) L := h₁.trans (not_congr h₂)
  by_cases h : Sat stdModel (fun _ => 0) L
  · exact this.1 h h
  · exact h (this.2 h)

/-- **Prime powers dividing `C(2n, n)` are at most `2n`.** If `p` is prime, `e ≥ 1` and
`pᵉ ∣ C(2n, n)`, then `pᵉ ≤ 2n`. -/
theorem pow_dvd_centralBinom_le {p n e : Nat} (hp : Prime p) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (h : p ^ e ∣ centralBinom n) : p ^ e ≤ 2 * n := by
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.1

  have hle := (pow_dvd_iff_le_vp hp1 (centralBinom_pos n)).1 h

Foundations.Numbers.R.intermediate_value:
/-- **Intermediate value theorem.** A function continuous on `[a, b]` with `f a ≤ 0 ≤ f b` has a
zero in `[a, b]`. -/
theorem intermediate_value {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) (ha : f a ≤ 0) (hb : 0 ≤ f b) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ b ∧ f c = 0 := by
  let S : R → Prop := fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧ f x ≤ 0
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_lub S ⟨a, by grind, hab, ha⟩ ⟨b, fun x hx => hx.2.1⟩
  have hac : a ≤ c := hc1 a ⟨by grind, hab, ha⟩
  have hcb : c ≤ b := hc2 b fun x hx => hx.2.1
  refine ⟨c, hac, hcb, ?_⟩
  rcases (by grind : f c < 0 ∨ f c = 0 ∨ 0 < f c) with h | h | h
  · -- Points slightly to the right of `c` still have `f < 0`.
    exfalso
    have hcb' : c < b := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'; have : c = b := by grind
      rw [this] at h; grind
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := hf c hac hcb (-f c) (by grind)
    have hy : ∃ y, c < y ∧ y ≤ b ∧ abs (y - c) < δ := by
      rcases (by grind : c + δ / 2 ≤ b ∨ b < c + δ / 2) with h' | h'
      · exact ⟨c + δ / 2, by grind, h', abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨b, hcb', Std.le_refl b, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2, hy3⟩ := hy
    have := abs_lt.1 (hδf y hy3)
    have := hc1 y ⟨by grind, hy2, by grind⟩
    grind
  · exact h
  · -- Points slightly to the left of `c` have `f > 0`, so `c − δ/2` is a smaller upper bound.
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := hf c hac hcb (f c) h
    have := hc2 (c - δ / 2) fun x ⟨hx1, hx2, hx3⟩ => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hlt
      have hxc := hc1 x ⟨hx1, hx2, hx3⟩
      have := abs_lt.1 (hδf x (abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩))
      grind
    grind

Foundations.Numbers.R.const_of_deriv_zer:
/-- **Zero derivative means constant.** A function whose derivative vanishes on `[a, b]` is
constant there. -/
theorem const_of_deriv_zero {f f' : R → R} {a b : R}
    (hd : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hz : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f' x = 0)
    {x y : R} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hay : a ≤ y) (hyb : y ≤ b) : f x = f y := by
  have k1 : ∀ {s t : R}, a ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ b → f s ≤ f t := fun h1 h2 h3 =>
    monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (f := f) hd (fun t h1 h2 => by rw [hz t h1 h2]; grind) h1 h2 h3
  have k2 : ∀ {s t : R}, a ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ b → -f s ≤ -f t := fun h1 h2 h3 =>
    monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (f := fun t => -f t) (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t h1 h2).neg)
      (fun t h1 h2 => by rw [hz t h1 h2]; grind) h1 h2 h3
  rcases (by grind : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x) with h | h
  · have := k1 hax h hyb; have := k2 hax h hyb; grind
  · have := k1 hay h hxb; have := k2 hay h hxb; grind

Foundations.Algebra.legendre_neg_one:
/-- **The first supplement**: `(-1/p) = (-1)^((p-1)/2)`, with `-1` represented by `p - 1`. -/
theorem legendre_neg_one (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) : legendre (p - 1) p = (-1) ^ half p := by
  have h3 := hp.1
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ p - 1 := fun h => by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; omega
  have hl := legendre_eq_of_pow hp hodd hnd
  rw [pred_pow_mod h3] at hl
  have hpow : ∀ n : Nat, (-1 : Int) ^ n = if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1 := by
    intro n; induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Int.pow_succ, ih]
      by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
      · rw [ite_true_of hn, ite_false_of (by omega)]; rfl
      · rw [ite_false_of hn, ite_true_of (by omega)]; rfl
  rw [hpow]
  by_cases hh : half p % 2 = 0
  · rw [ite_true_of hh]; exact hl.1 (by rw [ite_true_of hh])
  · rw [ite_false_of hh]; exact hl.2 (by rw [ite_false_of hh])
Foundations.Categories.Monad':
/-- A **monad** on `C`: an endofunctor `T` with unit `η_X : X ⟶ T X` and multiplication
`μ_X : T (T X) ⟶ T X`, both natural, such that `μ` is associative and `η` is a two-sided
unit for it. -/
structure Monad' (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] where
  /-- The underlying endofunctor. -/
  T : C ⥤ C
  /-- The unit. -/
  η : (X : C) → (X ⟶ T.obj X)
  /-- The multiplication. -/
  μ : (X : C) → (T.obj (T.obj X) ⟶ T.obj X)
  /-- Naturality of the unit. -/
  η_nat : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y), f ≫ η Y = η X ≫ T.map f
  /-- Naturality of the multiplication. -/
  μ_nat : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y), T.map (T.map f) ≫ μ Y = μ X ≫ T.map f
  /-- Associativity: the two ways of flattening `T T T X` agree. -/
  assoc : ∀ X : C, T.map (μ X) ≫ μ X = μ (T.obj X) ≫ μ X
  /-- Left unit law. -/
  left_unit : ∀ X : C, η (T.obj X) ≫ μ X = 𝟙 (T.obj X)
  /-- Right unit law. -/
  right_unit : ∀ X : C, T.map (η X) ≫ μ X = 𝟙 (T.obj X)

Foundations.Topology.dist_orbit_add:
/-- Far orbit points: `d(xₙ₊ₖ, xₙ) ≤ qⁿ d(x₁, x₀) (1 − qᵏ)/(1 − q)`. -/
theorem dist_orbit_add {f : X → X} {q : R} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hf : ∀ x y, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ q * dist x y) (x₀ : X) (n k : Nat) :
    dist (orbit f x₀ (n + k)) (orbit f x₀ n) ≤
      q ^ n * dist (orbit f x₀ 1) x₀ * ((1 - q ^ k) / (1 - q)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    show dist (orbit f x₀ n) (orbit f x₀ n) ≤ _ * ((1 - 1) / (1 - q))
    rw [dist_self]; grind
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 := dist_orbit_succ hq0 hf x₀ (n + k)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (orbit f x₀ (n + k + 1)) (orbit f x₀ (n + k)) (orbit f x₀ n)
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
    have e : q ^ (n + k) = q ^ n * q ^ k := R.pow_add' q n k
    have e2 : q ^ (k + 1) = q ^ k * q := pow_succ' q k
    have hne : 1 - q ≠ 0 := by grind
    rw [e] at h1
    rw [e2]
    have i1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel hne
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at ih ⊢
    clear hf
    generalize q ^ n = a at ih h1 ⊢
    generalize q ^ k = P at ih h1 ⊢
    generalize (1 - q)⁻¹ = J at ih i1 ⊢
    generalize dist (orbit f x₀ 1) x₀ = D at ih h1 ⊢
    have key : a * P * D + a * D * ((1 - P) * J) = a * D * ((1 - P * q) * J) := by grind
    grind
Foundations.Geometry.rat_not_continuous:
/-- **Continuity fails in `ℚ²`.** The points `(x, 0)` with `x ≥ 0`, `x² < 2` all
precede, as seen from the origin, the points `(y, 0)` with `y ≥ 0`, `y² > 2`; but no
rational point lies between the two families — the gap is at `√2`. -/
theorem rat_not_continuous :
    ¬ ∀ φ ψ : Pt Q → Prop, (∃ a, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → Pt.Bet a x y) →
      ∃ b, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → Pt.Bet x b y := by
  intro hcont
  let φ : Pt Q → Prop := fun p => p.y = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.x ∧ p.x * p.x < 2
  let ψ : Pt Q → Prop := fun p => p.y = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.x ∧ 2 < p.x * p.x
  have hlt : ∀ x y : Q, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y → x * x < 2 → 2 < y * y → x < y := by
    intro x y hx hy h₁ h₂
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hn
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : y ≤ x) hy
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by grind : y ≤ x) hx
    grind
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hcont φ ψ ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, fun x y hx hy => by
    obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    have := hlt _ _ hx1 hy1 hx2 hy2
    exact Pt.bet_of_line (o := ⟨0, 0⟩) (w := ⟨1, 0⟩) (α := 0) (β := x.x) (γ := y.x)
      ⟨by grind, by grind⟩ ⟨by grind, by grind⟩ ⟨by grind, by grind⟩ (Or.inl ⟨hx1, by grind⟩)⟩
  have hφ1 : φ ⟨1, 0⟩ := ⟨rfl, by grind, by grind⟩
  have hψ2 : ψ ⟨2, 0⟩ := ⟨rfl, by grind, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hby⟩ := bet_axis (by grind) (show Pt.Bet ⟨1, 0⟩ ⟨b.x, b.y⟩ ⟨2, 0⟩ from hb _ _ hφ1 hψ2)
  have hne : b.x * b.x ≠ 2 := fun h => Q.sqrt_two_irrational ⟨b.x, h⟩
  rcases Std.lt_trichotomy (b.x * b.x) 2 with hlt2 | heq | hgt2
  · obtain ⟨r', hr', hr'2⟩ := exists_above_of_sq_lt_two (by grind) hlt2
    have hφ' : φ ⟨r', 0⟩ := ⟨rfl, by grind, hr'2⟩
    obtain ⟨h₁, -, -⟩ := bet_axis (by have := hlt r' 2 (by grind) (by grind) hr'2 (by grind); grind)
      (show Pt.Bet ⟨r', 0⟩ ⟨b.x, b.y⟩ ⟨2, 0⟩ from hb _ _ hφ' hψ2)
    grind
  · exact hne heq
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'0, hr', hr'2⟩ := exists_below_of_sq_gt_two (by grind) hgt2
    have hψ' : ψ ⟨r', 0⟩ := ⟨rfl, by grind, hr'2⟩
    obtain ⟨-, h₂, -⟩ := bet_axis (by have := hlt 1 r' (by grind) (by grind) (by grind) hr'2; grind)
      (show Pt.Bet ⟨1, 0⟩ ⟨b.x, b.y⟩ ⟨r', 0⟩ from hb _ _ hφ1 hψ')
    grind

Foundations.Topology.continuousAt_iff_se:
/-- **ε-δ continuity ⇔ sequential continuity** (Heine). -/
theorem continuousAt_iff_seq (f : X → Y) (x : X) : ContinuousAt f x ↔ SeqContinuousAt f x := by
  constructor
  · intro hf s hs ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs δ hδ
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn => h _ (hN n hn)⟩
  · intro hf
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
    -- Otherwise some `ε` defeats every `δ = 1/(n+1)`.
    have : ∃ ε : R, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ n : Nat, ∃ y, dist y x < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ε ≤ dist (f y) (f x) := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'
      apply hno; intro ε hε
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h''
      apply h'; refine ⟨ε, hε, fun n => ?_⟩
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3
      exact h'' ⟨1 / ((n : R) + 1), eps_pos n, fun y hy => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h4; exact h3 ⟨y, hy, by grind⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hy⟩ := this
    let s : Nat → X := fun n => (hy n).choose
    have hs : ∀ n, dist (s n) x < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ ε ≤ dist (f (s n)) (f x) :=
      fun n => (hy n).choose_spec
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hf s (converges_of_dist_lt fun n => (hs n).1) ε hε
    have := hN N (Nat.le_refl N); have := (hs N).2; grind
Foundations.Logic.Derives.weaken:
/-- **Weakening.** Adding premises never destroys a derivation. -/
theorem weaken {Γ φ} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) : ∀ {Δ}, Γ.Subset Δ → Δ ⊢ φ := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hφ => exact fun hs => hyp (hs _ hφ)
  | impI _ ih => exact fun hs => impI (ih (insert_mono hs _))
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun hs => impE (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ hs)
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact fun hs => conjI (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ hs)
  | conjE₁ _ ih => exact fun hs => conjE₁ (ih hs)
  | conjE₂ _ ih => exact fun hs => conjE₂ (ih hs)
  | disjI₁ _ ih => exact fun hs => disjI₁ (ih hs)
  | disjI₂ _ ih => exact fun hs => disjI₂ (ih hs)
  | disjE _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      exact fun hs => disjE (ih₁ hs) (ih₂ (insert_mono hs _)) (ih₃ (insert_mono hs _))
  | botE _ ih => exact fun hs => botE (ih hs)
  | raa _ ih => exact fun hs => raa (ih (insert_mono hs _))

Foundations.Numbers.C.exp_add:
/-- **Functional equation of the complex exponential.** `exp (z + w) = exp z · exp w`. -/
theorem exp_add (z w : C) : exp (z + w) = exp z * exp w := by
  have hprod := (tendsto_exp z).mul (tendsto_exp w)
  -- `Pₙ(z + w)` differs from `Pₙ(z) Pₙ(w)` by `Tₙ(z, w)`, and `‖Tₙ(z, w)‖ ≤ Tₙ(‖z‖, ‖w‖) → 0`.
  have hbound : ∀ N, nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) ≤
      gsum (fun i => expTerm (nrm z) i * gsum (fun k => expTerm (nrm w) (N - i + k)) i) N := by
    intro N
    have hcp := gsum_exp_mul (α := C) cterm cterm_zero cterm_rec natCast_add_one_ne_zero z w N
    rw [hcp, show gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N +
      gsum (fun i => cterm z i * gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) N) =
      -gsum (fun i => cterm z i * gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) N by grind]
    have hneg : ∀ u : C, nrm (-u) = nrm u := fun u => by
      unfold nrm; rw [neg_re, neg_im, R.abs_neg, R.abs_neg]
    rw [hneg, gsum_eq_fsum]
    refine Std.le_trans (nrm_gsum_le _ N) (fsum_le_fsum (fun i => ?_) N)
    refine Std.le_trans (nrm_mul _ _) ?_
    have k1 := nrm_cterm_le z i
    have k2 : nrm (gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i) ≤
        gsum (fun k => expTerm (nrm w) (N - i + k)) i := by
      rw [gsum_eq_fsum]
      exact Std.le_trans (nrm_gsum_le _ i) (fsum_le_fsum (fun k => nrm_cterm_le w _) i)
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k1
      (nrm_nonneg (gsum (fun k => cterm w (N - i + k)) i))
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (expTerm_nonneg (nrm_nonneg z) i)
    grind
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun N => nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N -
      gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N)) 0 :=
    tendsto_of_abs_le (tendsto_exp_remainder (nrm z) (nrm w)) fun N => by
      rw [show nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) - 0 =
        nrm (gsum (cterm (z + w)) N - gsum (cterm z) N * gsum (cterm w) N) by grind,
        abs_of_nonneg (nrm_nonneg _)]
      exact hbound N
  exact (tendsto_exp (z + w)).unique (CTendsto.of_nrm_sub hprod hzero)

/-- **Brouwer's fixed-point theorem, dimension 1.** Every continuous map `f : [0, 1] → [0, 1]` has
a fixed point. -/
theorem brouwer_one_dim {f : R → R} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → R.ContinuousAt f x)
    (hmaps : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) : ∃ x, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 ∧ f x = x := by
  -- Apply the intermediate value theorem to `g x = x − f x`, with `g 0 ≤ 0 ≤ g 1`.
  obtain ⟨c, h0, h1, hc⟩ := intermediate_value_connected (f := fun x => x - f x) (a := 0) (b := 1)
    (v := 0) (by grind) (fun x h0 h1 => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_id x) (hf x h0 h1))
    (by have := hmaps 0 (Std.le_refl 0) (by grind); show 0 - f 0 ≤ 0; grind)
    (by have := hmaps 1 (by grind) (Std.le_refl 1); show 0 ≤ 1 - f 1; grind)
  exact ⟨c, h0, h1, by have : c - f c = 0 := hc; grind⟩
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.Var_sumN:
/-- **Bienaymé's identity**: the variance of a sum of pairwise uncorrelated random
variables is the sum of their variances. -/
theorem Var_sumN (n : Nat) (X : Nat → α → R) (h : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → P.Uncorr (X i) (X j)) :
    P.Var (fun x => sumN n fun i => X i x) = sumN n fun i => P.Var (X i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [sumN, List.range_zero, sumL_nil]
      rw [Var_eq]; simp only [E_const]; grind
  | succ n ih =>
      have hsplit : ∀ f : Nat → R, sumN (n + 1) f = sumN n f + f n := by
        intro f; simp only [sumN]; rw [List.range_succ, sumL_append]; simp; grind
      have : (fun x => sumN (n + 1) fun i => X i x) = fun x => (sumN n fun i => X i x) + X n x := by
        funext x; exact hsplit _
      rw [this, Var_add, ih fun i j hij hj => h i j hij (by omega), hsplit, Cov_sumN]
      have hz : (sumN n fun i => P.Cov (X i) (X n)) = 0 := by
        simp only [sumN]
        rw [sumL_congr (g := fun _ => 0) fun i hi => h i n (List.mem_range.1 hi) (by omega),
          sumL_zero]
      rw [hz]; grind

/-- Removing the index `j` from the selection. -/
theorem psum_remove (len : Nat → R) {P : Nat → Prop} {j N : Nat} (hj : j < N) (hP : P j) :
    psum len P N = psum len (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) N + len j ∧
      pcnt P N = pcnt (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) N + 1 := by
  induction N with
  | zero => omega
  | succ N ih =>
    show psum len P N + _ = psum len _ N + _ + len j ∧ pcnt P N + _ = pcnt _ N + _ + 1
    dsimp only
    by_cases e : j = N
    · subst e
      have h0 : ∀ M, M ≤ j → psum len (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) M = psum len P M ∧
          pcnt (fun k => P k ∧ k ≠ j) M = pcnt P M := by
        intro M hM
        induction M with
        | zero => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        | succ M ihM =>
          obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := ihM (by omega)
          show psum len _ M + _ = psum len P M + _ ∧ pcnt _ M + _ = pcnt P M + _
          dsimp only
          rw [a1, a2]
          by_cases hM' : P M
          · rw [ite_pos' ⟨hM', by omega⟩, ite_pos' hM', ite_pos' ⟨hM', by omega⟩, ite_pos' hM']
            exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          · rw [ite_neg' (fun h => hM' h.1), ite_neg' hM', ite_neg' (fun h => hM' h.1), ite_neg' hM']
            exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := h0 j (Nat.le_refl j)
      rw [b1, b2, ite_pos' hP, ite_pos' hP, ite_neg' (fun h => h.2 rfl), ite_neg' (fun h => h.2 rfl)]
      constructor <;> grind
    · obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := ih (by omega)
      rw [a1, a2]
      by_cases hN : P N
      · rw [ite_pos' hN, ite_pos' ⟨hN, fun h => e h.symm⟩, ite_pos' hN, ite_pos' ⟨hN, fun h => e h.symm⟩]
        constructor <;> grind
      · rw [ite_neg' hN, ite_neg' (fun h => hN h.1), ite_neg' hN, ite_neg' (fun h => hN h.1)]
        constructor <;> grind
Foundations.Logic.Computability.halting_:
/-- **Undecidability of the halting problem** (Turing 1936). There is no code `h`
that is total on (Gödel numbers of codes, inputs) and outputs `1` when `c` halts on
`x` and `0` when it does not. -/

    ¬ ∃ h : Code, ∀ (c : Code) (x : Nat),
      (Eval h [encode c, x] 0 ∨ Eval h [encode c, x] 1) ∧
      (Eval h [encode c, x] 1 ↔ Halts c [x]) := by

  · have := Eval.det h0 ((hh c x).2.2 hc); omega
  · rcases (hh c x).1 with h0 | h1
    · exact h0
    · exact absurd ((hh c x).2.1 h1) hc
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_sqrt_two:
/-- **Existence of √2.** There is a positive real number whose square is `2`. -/
theorem exists_sqrt_two : ∃ r : R, 0 < r ∧ r * r = 2 := by
  let P : Q → Prop := fun q => 2 ≤ q * q
  have hl : ¬ P 1 := by show ¬ (2 : Q) ≤ 1 * 1; grind
  have hu : P 2 := by show (2 : Q) ≤ 2 * 2; grind
  have hlu : (1 : Q) ≤ 2 := by grind
  let lo := Bisect.loSeq hl hu hlu
  let hi := Bisect.hiSeq hl hu hlu
  -- All left endpoints are at least `1`, all right endpoints at most `2`.
  have hbounds : ∀ n, 1 ≤ Bisect.lo P 1 2 n ∧ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n ≤ 2 ∧
      Bisect.lo P 1 2 n ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n ∧ Bisect.lo P 1 2 n * Bisect.lo P 1 2 n < 2 ∧
      2 ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n * Bisect.hi P 1 2 n := by
    intro n
    have h1 := Bisect.nested hl hu hlu (Nat.zero_le n)
    have h2 := Bisect.spec hl hu hlu n
    have e1 : Bisect.lo P 1 2 0 = 1 := rfl
    have e2 : Bisect.hi P 1 2 0 = 2 := rfl
    refine ⟨by grind, by grind, h2.2.2.1, ?_, h2.2.1⟩
    have := h2.1
    simp only [P] at this; grind
  refine ⟨mk hi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- `√2 ≥ 1 > 0`.
    have : ofQ 1 ≤ mk hi := le_of_eventually_le ⟨0, fun n _ => by
      have := hbounds n
      show 1 ≤ Bisect.hi P 1 2 n
      grind⟩
    have h1 : (0 : R) < ofQ 1 := ofQ_lt.2 (by grind)
    grind
  · -- `hiₙ² − 2` is squeezed between `0` and `4 (hiₙ − loₙ)`, which tends to `0`.
    rw [mk_mul, ofNat_def]
    show mk _ = mk (const 2)
    rw [mk_eq_mk]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Bisect.width_small hl hu hlu (ε := ε / 4) (by grind)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hb := hbounds n
    have hnest := Bisect.nested hl hu hlu hn
    have k : (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) * (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n + Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) ≤
        (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - Bisect.lo P 1 2 n) * 4 :=
      OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind) (by grind)
    show abs (Bisect.hi P 1 2 n * Bisect.hi P 1 2 n - 2) < ε
    apply abs_lt.2
    constructor <;> grind

Foundations.Logic.eliminate_rows:
/-- **Eliminating row hypotheses.** If `φ` is derivable from `Γ` together with the
row hypotheses for every valuation, it is derivable from `Γ` alone. Proved by
removing one atom at a time with the excluded middle. -/
theorem eliminate_rows {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} :
    ∀ L : List Nat, (∀ v, Γ.union (rowHyps v L) ⊢ φ) → Γ ⊢ φ
  | [], h => (h fun _ => false).weaken fun ψ hψ => by
      rcases hψ with hψ | ⟨p, hp, _⟩
      · exact hψ
      · simp at hp
  | p :: L, h => by
      apply eliminate_rows L
      intro v
      -- Merge the two rows differing only at `p`.
      have key : ∀ b : Bool, (Γ.union (rowHyps v L)).insert (signed b (var p)) ⊢ φ := by
        intro b
        refine (h (Valuation.update v p b)).weaken ?_
        rintro ψ (hψ | ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hψ)
        · by_cases hqp : q = p
          · subst hqp; left; simp [Valuation.update]
          · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
            · exact absurd rfl hqp
            · right; right; exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [Valuation.update, hqp]⟩
      exact Derives.byCases (key true) (key false)

/-- A type containing a copy of `ℕ` is Dedekind-infinite: shift the copy along. -/
theorem dedekindInfinite_of_nat_le {α : Sort u} (h : CardLE Nat α) : DedekindInfinite α := by
  classical

  have hfe : ∀ n, f (e n) = e (n + 1) := by

    rw [he (Classical.choose_spec hx)]
  refine ⟨f, fun x y hxy => ?_, fun hs => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hx : ∃ n, e n = x <;> by_cases hy : ∃ n, e n = y
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [hfe, hfe] at hxy
      rw [show m = n by have := he hxy; omega]
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [f, hy, ↓reduceDIte, hfe] at hxy
      exact absurd ⟨m + 1, hxy⟩ hy
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
      simp only [f, hx, ↓reduceDIte, hfe] at hxy
      exact absurd ⟨n + 1, hxy.symm⟩ hx
    · simpa only [f, hx, hy, ↓reduceDIte] using hxy
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs (e 0)
    by_cases hx' : ∃ n, e n = x
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx'
      rw [hfe] at hx
      exact absurd (he hx) (by omega)
    · simp only [f, hx', ↓reduceDIte] at hx
      exact hx' ⟨0, hx.symm⟩

/-- **Squeeze.** If `|aₙ − L| ≤ bₙ` and `bₙ → 0`, then `aₙ → L`. -/
theorem tendsto_of_abs_le {a b : Nat → R} {L : R} (hb : Tendsto b 0)
    (h : ∀ n, abs (a n - L) ≤ b n) : Tendsto a L := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hb ε hε
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have := abs_lt.1 (hN n hn)
  have := h n
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.EvalB.mono:
/-- Bounded evaluation is monotone in the bound. -/
theorem EvalB.mono {w w' : Nat} (hw : w ≤ w') :
    ∀ {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {y : Nat}, EvalB w c xs y → EvalB w' c xs y
  | .zero, _, _, h => h
  | .succ, _, _, h => h
  | .proj _, _, _, h => h
  | @Code.comp _ f gs, _, _, h => by
      obtain ⟨vs, hb, hg, hf⟩ := h
      exact ⟨vs, fun i => Nat.le_trans (hb i) hw, fun i => EvalB.mono hw (hg i), EvalB.mono hw hf⟩
  | .prec _ _, [], _, h => h.elim
  | .prec f g, m :: rest, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨A, hA, B, hB, ⟨⟨r, hr, e, hf⟩, hs⟩, hy⟩ := h
      refine ⟨A, by omega, B, by omega, ⟨⟨r, by omega, e, EvalB.mono hw hf⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, z, hz, e', hg⟩ := hs j hj
      exact ⟨u, by omega, z, by omega, e', EvalB.mono hw hg⟩
  | .mu f, xs, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨h₀, hlt⟩ := h
      refine ⟨EvalB.mono hw h₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz', hz0⟩ := hlt m hm
      exact ⟨z, by omega, EvalB.mono hw hz', hz0⟩

Foundations.Numbers.R.one_div_le_one_div:
/-- Taking reciprocals reverses the order of positive numbers. -/
theorem one_div_le_one_div {a b : R} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : 1 / b ≤ 1 / a := by
  have hb : 0 < b := by grind
  have i1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show a ≠ 0 by grind)
  have i2 := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show b ≠ 0 by grind)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab
    (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 ha))
      (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hb)))
  have e1 : a * (a⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = b⁻¹ := by rw [← Semiring.mul_assoc, i1, Semiring.one_mul]
  have e2 : b * (a⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = a⁻¹ := by
    rw [CommSemiring.mul_comm a⁻¹, ← Semiring.mul_assoc, i2, Semiring.one_mul]
  rw [e1, e2] at this
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Semiring.one_mul, Semiring.one_mul]
  exact this

/-- A strongly normalizing term has a normal form. The proof is constructive: at
each stage `step?` decides whether a further step is possible. -/
theorem SN.normalizes {t : Term} (h : SN t) : ∃ n, Red t n ∧ Normal n := by
  induction h with
  | intro t _ ih =>
    cases hs : step? t with
    | some t' =>
      have ht' := step?_sound _ _ hs
      obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ih t' ht'
      exact ⟨n, Star.head ht' hn, hn'⟩
    | none => exact ⟨t, Star.refl t, (normal_iff_step?_none t).2 hs⟩

theorem succT_red (n : Nat) : Red (app succT (num n)) (num (n + 1)) := by
  have h₁ : Step (app succT (num n))
      (tlam (lam (lam (app (var 1) (app (app (tapp (num n) (.tvar 0)) (var 1)) (var 0)))))) := by

Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_mvt_point:
/-- On each piece `[a, x]` the increment of `F` is a value of `F'` times the length (mean value
theorem, also for degenerate pieces). -/
theorem exists_mvt_point {F f : R → R} {a x : R} (hax : a ≤ x)
    (hd : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ x → HasDerivAt F (f t) t) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ x ∧ F x - F a = f c * (x - a) := by
  rcases (by grind : a = x ∨ a < x) with h | h
  · subst h; exact ⟨a, Std.le_refl a, Std.le_refl a, by grind⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, h1, h2, h3⟩ := mean_value (f' := f) h
      (fun t h1 h2 => (hd t h1 h2).continuousAt) (fun t h1 h2 => hd t (by grind) (by grind))
    exact ⟨c, by grind, by grind, h3⟩
Foundations.Algebra.Group:
/-- **Group.** A group is a type `G` with a multiplication, a distinguished element `1`
and an inversion `a ↦ a⁻¹`, such that multiplication is associative, `1` is a left
identity and `a⁻¹` is a left inverse of `a`. (The right-handed versions are theorems,
proved below.) -/
class Group (G : Type u) extends Mul G, One G, Inv G where
  /-- Multiplication is associative. -/
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : G, a * b * c = a * (b * c)
  /-- `1` is a left identity. -/
  one_mul : ∀ a : G, 1 * a = a
  /-- `a⁻¹` is a left inverse of `a`. -/
  inv_mul_cancel : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ * a = 1

  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show y + 1 ≤ V by omega) (show y + 1 ≤ V by omega)
  have : (y + 1) * (y + 1) = y * y + y + y + 1 := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ]; omega

/-- Riemann sums are additive in the function. -/
theorem rsum_add (f g : R → R) (a : R) (l : List (R × R)) :
    rsum (fun y => f y + g y) a l = rsum f a l + rsum g a l := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => show (0 : R) = 0 + 0; grind
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, x⟩ := p
    show (f t + g t) * (x - a) + rsum (fun y => f y + g y) x l =
      f t * (x - a) + rsum f x l + (g t * (x - a) + rsum g x l)
    rw [ih]; grind

Foundations.Algebra.exists_nontrivial_so:
/-- **Homogeneous systems with more unknowns than equations have non-zero solutions**
(Gaussian elimination). For an `m × n` system `∑ⱼ aᵢⱼ xⱼ = 0` over a field with `m < n`
there is a solution `x ≠ 0`. -/
theorem exists_nontrivial_solution {K : Type u} [CommRing K] (hF : IsField K) :
    ∀ (n m : Nat) (a : Fin m → Fin n → K), m < n →
      ∃ x : Fin n → K, (∃ j, x j ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ i, isum (fun j => a i j * x j) = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m _ h; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m a hmn
    by_cases hcol : ∀ i, a i 0 = 0
    · refine ⟨tcons 1 (fun _ => 0), ⟨0, fun h => hF.1 h.symm⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [isum_fin_succ]
      show a i 0 * 1 + isum (fun j : Fin k => a i j.succ * 0) = 0
      rw [hcol i, Ring.zero_mul, Ring.zero_add]
      exact isum_eq_zero fun j => Ring.mul_zero _
    · have : ∃ p, a p 0 ≠ 0 := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
        exact hcol fun i => Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno ⟨i, h⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := this
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hF.2 _ hp
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by have := p.isLt; omega⟩
      let a' : Fin m' → Fin k → K := fun i j =>
        a (skip p i) j.succ + -(a (skip p i) 0 * t) * a p j.succ
      obtain ⟨y, ⟨j0, hj0⟩, hy⟩ := ih m' a' (by omega)
      let S := isum (fun j : Fin k => a p j.succ * y j)
      refine ⟨tcons (-(t * S)) y, ⟨j0.succ, hj0⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [isum_fin_succ]
      show a i 0 * -(t * S) + isum (fun j : Fin k => a i j.succ * y j) = 0
      by_cases hip : i = p
      · subst hip
        rw [Ring.mul_neg, ← Ring.mul_assoc, ht, Ring.one_mul, Ring.neg_add_cancel]
      · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := skip_surj p i hip
        have h1 := hy i'
        have e : isum (fun j => a' i' j * y j) =
            isum (fun j : Fin k => a (skip p i') j.succ * y j) + -(a (skip p i') 0 * t) * S := by
          rw [isum_mul_left, ← isum_add]
          congr 1; funext j
          show (a (skip p i') j.succ + -(a (skip p i') 0 * t) * a p j.succ) * y j = _
          rw [Ring.right_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]
        rw [e] at h1
        rw [Ring.mul_neg, Ring.add_comm, ← h1, Ring.neg_mul, Ring.mul_assoc]

/-- A primality fact for integers: if a prime `p` divides `a * b` (in `ℤ`), it divides `a` or
`b`. -/
theorem int_prime_dvd_mul {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) {a b : Int} (h : (p : Int) ∣ a * b) :

  rw [Int.ofNat_dvd_left, Int.natAbs_mul] at h

  | 0, h => by
    simp only [fact] at h
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; have := hp.1; omega
  | k + 1, h => by
    simp only [fact] at h
    rcases euclid_lemma hp h with h | h
    · exact Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h
    · have := prime_le_of_dvd_fact hp h; omega

/-- Each `|a k|` with `k ≤ N` is bounded by `|a 0| + ⋯ + |a N|`. -/
theorem abs_le_sumAbs (a : Nat → Q) {k N : Nat} (h : k ≤ N) : abs (a k) ≤ sumAbs a N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => have : k = 0 := by omega
            subst this; exact Q.le_refl _
  | succ N ih =>
    have := abs_nonneg (a (N + 1))
    simp only [sumAbs]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ N
    · have := ih hk; grind
    · have : k = N + 1 := by omega
      subst this; have := sumAbs_nonneg a N; grind

Foundations.Numbers.Q.inv_inv:
/-- Inversion is an involution: `(x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x`. -/
theorem inv_inv (x : Q) : x⁻¹⁻¹ = x := by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero, inv_zero]
  · have h1 := mul_inv_cancel hx
    have hx' : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h2 := mul_inv_cancel hx'
    calc x⁻¹⁻¹ = (x * x⁻¹) * x⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [h1, one_mul]
      _ = x * (x⁻¹ * x⁻¹⁻¹) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = x := by rw [h2, mul_one]

/-- A list substitution into a formula whose free variables are among the first
`ts.length` avoids `y` if all the substituted terms do. -/
theorem fresh_substL {φ : Formula Arith} {m : Nat} (hφ : ∀ n, m ≤ n → φ.Fresh n)
    {ts : List (Term Arith)} (hlen : m ≤ ts.length) {y : Nat} (hts : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.Fresh y) :
    (substL ts φ).Fresh y := by
  refine Formula.fresh_subst_of φ fun n hn => ?_
  have : n < ts.length := Classical.byContradiction fun h => hn (hφ n (by omega))
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem this]
  exact hts _ (List.getElem_mem this)
Foundations.Numbers.R.iterD_nivenC_isInt:
/-- **All derivatives of `f` at `0` are integers.** -/
theorem iterD_nivenC_isInt {a b : R} (ha : IsInt a) (hb : IsInt b) (n m : Nat) :
    IsInt (iterD m (nivenC a b n) 0) := by
  have h := fact_mul_iterD (nivenC a b n) m 0
  rw [Nat.zero_add, show fact 0 = 1 from rfl] at h
  have e : iterD m (nivenC a b n) 0 = (fact m : R) * nivenC a b n m := by grind
  rw [e]; unfold nivenC
  by_cases hm : n ≤ m
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := fact_dvd_fact hm
    have : (fact m : R) = (fact n : R) * (r : R) := by rw [hr]; grind
    rw [this]
    have := fact_pos' n
    have e2 : (fact n : R) * (r : R) * (nivenH a b n m / (fact n : R)) = (r : R) * nivenH a b n m := by
      grind
    rw [e2]; exact (isInt_natCast r).mul (nivenH_isInt ha hb n m)
  · unfold nivenH; rw [show (if n ≤ m then linPow a b n (m - n) else 0) = 0 by split <;> first | omega | rfl]
    exact ⟨0, by grind⟩

theorem gaussMu_two {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) :

/-- Conversely, a set containing the limits of all its convergent sequences is closed. -/
theorem isClosed_of_seq {F : X → Prop}
    (h : ∀ (s : Nat → X) (L : X), (∀ n, F (s n)) → Converges s L → F L) : IsClosed F := by
  intro x hx
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
  have hpt : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ y, dist x y < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ F y := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h'
    exact hno ⟨1 / ((n : R) + 1), eps_pos n, fun y hy => fun hy' => h' ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩⟩
  let s : Nat → X := fun n => (hpt n).choose
  have hs : ∀ n, dist x (s n) < 1 / ((n : R) + 1) ∧ F (s n) := fun n => (hpt n).choose_spec
  exact hx (h s x (fun n => (hs n).2) (converges_of_dist_lt fun n => by
    rw [dist_comm]; exact (hs n).1))

Foundations.Numbers.C.exists_min_on_squa:
/-- **Two-dimensional extreme value theorem.** A non-negative function `g : ℂ → ℝ`, continuous
everywhere, attains its minimum on every closed square `|re z|, |im z| ≤ ρ`. -/
theorem exists_min_on_square {g : C → R} {ρ : R} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hg0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z)
    (hg : ∀ z₀, ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z, cabs (z - z₀) < δ → abs (g z - g z₀) < ε) :
    ∃ zs, InSq ρ zs ∧ ∀ z, InSq ρ z → g zs ≤ g z := by
  have h0 : InSq ρ 0 := ⟨by rw [zero_re, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ, by rw [zero_im, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ⟩
  -- The infimum `m` of `g` over the square.
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub (fun x => ∃ z, InSq ρ z ∧ x = -g z) ⟨_, 0, h0, rfl⟩
    ⟨0, fun x ⟨z, _, hx⟩ => by have := hg0 z; grind⟩
  have hm : ∀ z, InSq ρ z → -L ≤ g z := fun z hz => by have := hL1 _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; grind
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ z, InSq ρ z ∧ g z < -L + 1 / ((n : R) + 1) := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
    have := hL2 (L - 1 / ((n : R) + 1)) fun x ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨z, hz, by grind⟩
    have := eps_pos n; grind
  let zs : Nat → C := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hzs : ∀ n, InSq ρ (zs n) ∧ g (zs n) < -L + 1 / ((n : R) + 1) := fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  have bnd : ∀ n, abs (zs n).re ≤ ρ ∧ abs (zs n).im ≤ ρ := fun n => (hzs n).1
  -- Bolzano–Weierstrass twice.
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, x, hxlim⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (a := fun n => (zs n).re) ⟨ρ, fun n => (bnd n).1⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, y, hylim⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (a := fun k => (zs (φ k)).im)
    ⟨ρ, fun k => (bnd (φ k)).2⟩
  let χ : Nat → Nat := fun k => φ (ψ k)
  have hχ : ∀ k, χ k < χ (k + 1) := fun k => strictMono_lt hφ (hψ k)
  have hxlim' : Tendsto (fun k => (zs (χ k)).re) x := tendsto_subseq hxlim hψ
  let zstar : C := ⟨x, y⟩
  have hin : InSq ρ zstar := by
    constructor
    · show abs x ≤ ρ
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨le_of_tendsto hxlim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ k)).1).1,
        tendsto_le hxlim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ k)).1).2⟩
    · show abs y ≤ ρ
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨le_of_tendsto hylim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ (ψ k))).2).1,
        tendsto_le hylim fun k => (abs_le.1 (bnd (φ (ψ k))).2).2⟩
  -- By continuity, `g (zs (χ k)) → g z*`; by construction, `g (zs (χ k)) → m`.
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun k => g (zs (χ k))) (g zstar) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hg zstar ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hxlim' (δ / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hylim (δ / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun k hk => hδ' _ ?_⟩
    have k1 := hN₁ k (by omega)
    have k2 : abs ((zs (φ (ψ k))).im - y) < δ / 2 := hN₂ k (by omega)
    have := cabs_le_nrm (zs (χ k) - zstar)
    unfold nrm at this
    have e1 : (zs (χ k) - zstar).re = (zs (χ k)).re - x := by
      show (zs (χ k) + -zstar).re = _; simp only [add_re, neg_re]; grind
    have e2 : (zs (χ k) - zstar).im = (zs (χ k)).im - y := by
      show (zs (χ k) + -zstar).im = _; simp only [add_im, neg_im]; grind
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    have k1' : abs ((zs (χ k)).re - x) < δ / 2 := k1
    have k2' : abs ((zs (χ k)).im - y) < δ / 2 := k2
    grind
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k => g (zs (χ k))) (-L) := fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small hε
    refine ⟨N, fun k hk => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have := hm _ (hzs (χ k)).1; grind
    · have := (hzs (χ k)).2
      have := hN (χ k) (by have := le_of_strictMono hχ k; omega)
      grind
  have heq := tendsto_unique h1 h2
  exact ⟨zstar, hin, fun z hz => by rw [heq]; exact hm z hz⟩

/-- `len p = 0` iff `p = 0`. -/
theorem len_eq_zero {p : Polynomial R} : len p = 0 ↔ p = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h; have := degLT_len p; rw [h] at this; exact degLT_zero_iff.1 this
  · intro h; apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero; apply len_le; rw [h]; exact degLT_zero_iff.2 rfl
Foundations.Algebra.iprod_comp_bij:
/-- **Reindexing** a product along a bijection. -/
theorem iprod_comp_bij {ι : Type} [FiniteType ι] (e : ι → ι) (inj : ∀ a b, e a = e b → a = b)
    (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, e x = y) (f : ι → R) : iprod (fun i => f (e i)) = iprod f := by
  unfold iprod
  have hperm : ((elems : List ι).map e).Perm (elems : List ι) := by
    rw [List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (nodup_map_of_injective inj nodup) nodup]
    intro y
    simp only [List.mem_map, complete, true_and, iff_true]
    exact surj y
  rw [← lprod_perm (hperm.map f), List.map_map]; rfl
Foundations.Types.STLC.case_red:
/-- **Case analysis is reducible** when the scrutinee is reducible and both branches
are reducible under every reducible substitution. -/
theorem case_red {A B C : Ty} {t u₁ u₂ : Term} (ht : RED (.sum A B) t)
    (h₁ : ∀ a, RED A a → RED C (inst u₁ a)) (h₂ : ∀ b, RED B b → RED C (inst u₂ b)) :
    RED C (case t u₁ u₂) :=
  case_red_aux t ht.1 u₁ (SN.of_inst ((cr C).1 _ (h₁ _ (var_red A 0))))
    u₂ (SN.of_inst ((cr C).1 _ (h₂ _ (var_red B 0)))) ht h₁ h₂
Foundations.Logic.Computability.natRec:
/-- **Primitive recursion with a parameter.** `natRec b s n i` is defined by
`natRec b s n 0 = b n` and `natRec b s n (i + 1) = s ⟨n, ⟨i, natRec b s n i⟩⟩`. -/
def natRec (b s : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => b n
  | i + 1 => s (pair n (pair i (natRec b s n i)))
Foundations.Logic.FO.rC3:
/-- Rule 3 on codes: →-elimination. -/
def rC3 (q : Nat) : Bool :=
  qtag q == 3 && decide (1 < llen (qjs q)) &&
    qprem q 0 == pj (qk q) (qD q) (pair 2 (pair (qdat q) (qF q))) &&
    qprem q 1 == pj (qk q) (qD q) (qdat q)
Foundations.Algebra.cayley_finite:
/-- **Cayley's theorem for finite groups.** A finite group of order `n` embeds into the
symmetric group `Sₙ = Perm (Fin n)`: there is an injective homomorphism
`G →* Perm (Fin (card G))`. -/
theorem cayley_finite [FiniteType G] :
    ∃ f : G →* Perm (Fin (card G)), ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b := by
  let T := Perm.conjHom (toFin (α := G)) ofFin ofFin_toFin toFin_ofFin
  refine ⟨T.comp (leftRegular G), ?_⟩
  intro a b h
  exact leftRegular_injective a b
    (Perm.conjHom_injective _ _ ofFin_toFin toFin_ofFin _ _ h)
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.map_neg:
/-- An additive map preserves negation. -/
theorem map_neg (x : F) : ψ (-x) = -ψ x := by
  have := hadd x (-x); have := map_zero hadd; grind
Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.count_smul:
/-- Counting by fibres: for any part `Q` of the orbit of `x`, the number of `g` with
`g • x ∈ Q` is `|Q| · |Stab x|`. Proved by removing one point of `Q` at a time. -/
theorem count_smul_mem (x : X) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (Q : X → Prop), count Q = n → (∀ y, Q y → orbit G x y) →
      count (fun g : G => Q (g • x)) = n * count (· ∈ stabilizer G x) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Q hQ _
    rw [Nat.zero_mul, count_eq_zero]
    intro g hg
    exact count_eq_zero.1 hQ _ hg
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Q hQ hsub
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := count_pos.1 (by omega : 0 < count Q)
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hsub y hy
    have hsplit := count_split Q (· = h • x)
    rw [count_congr (P := fun z => Q z ∧ z = h • x) (Q := fun z => z = h • x)
      (fun z => ⟨fun hz => hz.2, fun hz => ⟨hz ▸ hy, hz⟩⟩), count_eq_self] at hsplit
    have hrest := ih (fun z => Q z ∧ ¬ z = h • x) (by omega) (fun z hz => hsub z hz.1)
    have hsplit' := count_split (fun g : G => Q (g • x)) (fun g => g • x = h • x)
    rw [count_congr (P := fun g : G => Q (g • x) ∧ g • x = h • x)
      (Q := fun g : G => g • x = h • x)
      (fun g => ⟨fun hg => hg.2, fun hg => ⟨hg ▸ hy, hg⟩⟩), count_fibre] at hsplit'
    rw [hsplit', hrest, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]
Foundations.Numbers.R.ofQ_sub:

Foundations.Categories.Lambek.Mem.lookup:
/-- The index of a variable points to its type in the erased context. -/
theorem Mem.lookup {A : FTy} {Γ : List FTy} (v : Mem A Γ) :
    (Γ.map FTy.toTy)[v.idx]? = some A.toTy := by

Foundations.Numbers.Q.le_antisymm:
/-- `≤` on the rationals is antisymmetric. -/
theorem le_antisymm {x y : Q} : x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y := by
  induction x using ind; induction y using ind
  simp only [mk_le, mk_eq_mk]; omega
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.arith_induc:
/-- **Induction over arithmetic formulas** (the language has no relation symbols
besides equality). -/
theorem Formula.arith_induction {P : Formula Arith → Prop} (hb : P bot)
    (he : ∀ t s, P (eq t s)) (hi : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (imp φ ψ))
    (hc : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (conj φ ψ)) (hd : ∀ φ ψ, P φ → P ψ → P (disj φ ψ))
    (ha : ∀ φ, P φ → P (all φ)) (hx : ∀ φ, P φ → P (ex φ)) : ∀ φ, P φ
  | .bot => hb
  | .eq t s => he t s
  | .rel R _ => (R : Empty).elim
  | .imp φ ψ => hi _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .conj φ ψ => hc _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .disj φ ψ => hd _ _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
      (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx ψ)
  | .all φ => ha _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
  | .ex φ => hx _ (Formula.arith_induction hb he hi hc hd ha hx φ)
Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.IsFixed:

def IsFixed (x : X) : Prop := ∀ g : G, g • x = x
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.subst_subst:
/-- **Composition of substitutions (formulas).** `φ[τ][σ] = φ[n ↦ (τ n)[σ]]`, also
under binders. -/
theorem subst_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (σ τ : Nat → Term L),
    (φ.subst τ).subst σ = φ.subst (fun n => (τ n).subst σ)
  | bot, _, _ => rfl
  | eq t s, σ, τ => by simp [subst, Term.subst_subst]
  | rel R ts, σ, τ => by simp [subst, Term.subst_subst]
  | imp φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, σ, τ => by simp [subst, subst_subst φ, subst_subst ψ]
  | all φ, σ, τ => by simp only [subst, subst_subst φ, Subst.lift_comp]
  | ex φ, σ, τ => by simp only [subst, subst_subst φ, Subst.lift_comp]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.regularity:
/-- **Regularity, in its classical form.** Every non-empty set `x` has an
∈-minimal member: some `y ∈ x` sharing no member with `x`. -/
theorem regularity (x : ZFSet) (hx : ∃ z, z ∈ x) : ∃ y ∈ x, ∀ z ∈ y, z ∉ x := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have key : ∀ y, y ∉ x := by
    refine mem_induction (fun y => y ∉ x) (fun y ih hy => hne ⟨y, hy, fun z hz hzx => ?_⟩)
    exact ih z hz hzx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
  exact key z hz
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.Var_samp:
/-- `Var(Sₙ) = n σ²`. -/
theorem Var_sampleSum (X : α → R) (n : Nat) : (P.pow n).Var (sampleSum X n) = n * P.Var X := by
  unfold sampleSum
  rw [Var_sumN _ n _ fun i j hij hj => uncorr_coord P X (by omega) hj (by omega), sumN,
    sumL_congr (g := fun _ => P.Var X) fun i hi => Var_coord P X (List.mem_range.1 hi)]
  exact sumN_const n _
Foundations.Numbers.gsum_mul_left:
/-- Constants factor out of sums. -/
theorem gsum_mul_left (c : α) (f : Nat → α) (n : Nat) :
    gsum (fun k => c * f k) n = c * gsum f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show (0 : α) = c * 0; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [gsum_succ, gsum_succ, ih]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_log:
/-- **The derivative of the logarithm.** `log' y = 1/y` for `y > 0`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_log {y : R} (hy : 0 < y) : HasDerivAt log (1 / y) y := fun ε hε => by
  -- The quadratic estimate `|exp k − 1 − k| ≤ C k²` with `C = exp 1 / 2`.
  let C := exp 1 / 2
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by have := exp_pos 1; grind
  have quad : ∀ k : R, abs k ≤ 1 → abs (exp k - 1 - k) ≤ C * (abs k * abs k) := fun k hk => by
    have := abs_exp_sub_le (x := 0) (y := k) (by rw [show k - 0 = k by grind]; exact hk)
    rw [exp_zero, abs_zero, show k - 0 = k by grind, show (0 : R) + 1 = 1 by grind] at this
    grind
  -- Choose how close `log z` must be to `log y`.
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁a, hη₁b⟩ := exists_pos_le_both (by grind : (0 : R) < 1)
    (div_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < 1) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηa, hηb⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hη₁
    (div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos hε hy) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := log_continuous hy hη
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hzpos, hk⟩ := hδ' z hz
  let k := log z - log y
  have hK := abs_nonneg k
  -- `z = y · exp k`.
  have hzk : z = y * exp k := by
    rw [show k = log z + -log y by grind, exp_add, ← exp_log hzpos]
    have := exp_mul_exp_neg (log y); rw [exp_log hy] at this; rw [log_exp]; grind
  have hq := quad k (by grind)
  clear quad hδ'
  -- `C |k| ≤ 1/2` and `C |k| ≤ ε y / 2`.
  have t1 : 2 * C + 1 ≠ 0 := by grind
  have c1 : C * abs k ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show abs k ≤ 1 / (2 * C + 1) by grind) hC
    have e : (2 * C + 1) * (1 / (2 * C + 1)) = 1 := by grind
    have := div_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < 1) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1)
    grind
  have c2 : C * abs k ≤ ε * y / 2 := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (show abs k ≤ ε * y / (2 * C + 1) by grind) hC
    have e : (2 * C + 1) * (ε * y / (2 * C + 1)) = ε * y := by grind
    have := div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos hε hy) (by grind : 0 < 2 * C + 1)
    grind
  -- `|z − y| = y |exp k − 1| ≥ y |k| / 2`.
  have hzy : abs (z - y) = y * abs (exp k - 1) := by
    rw [hzk, show y * exp k - y = y * (exp k - 1) by grind, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by grind)]
  have hlow : abs k / 2 ≤ abs (exp k - 1) := by
    have := abs_add (exp k - 1) (-(exp k - 1 - k))
    rw [abs_neg, show exp k - 1 + -(exp k - 1 - k) = k by grind] at this
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c1 hK
    grind
  -- The error is `|k − (exp k − 1)| ≤ C k² ≤ (ε y / 2) |k| ≤ ε |z − y|`.
  have herr : log z - log y - 1 / y * (z - y) = -(exp k - 1 - k) := by
    have e1 : z - y = y * (exp k - 1) := by rw [hzk]; grind
    have : y ≠ 0 := by grind
    show k - 1 / y * (z - y) = _
    rw [e1]; grind
  rw [herr, abs_neg]
  have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c2 hK
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hε) (Std.le_of_lt hy))
  rw [hzy]
  grind

theorem env3_numM {M : Structure Arith} (y x w : Nat) :

Foundations.Categories.IsLimit.uniqueIso:
/-- **Limits are unique up to isomorphism**: two limit cones of the same diagram have
isomorphic apexes. -/
def uniqueIso (hc : IsLimit c) (hd : IsLimit d) : c.pt ≅ d.pt where
  hom := hd.lift c
  inv := hc.lift d
  hom_inv_id := hc.hom_ext fun j => by rw [assoc, hc.fac, hd.fac, id_comp]
  inv_hom_id := hd.hom_ext fun j => by rw [assoc, hd.fac, hc.fac, id_comp]

Foundations.Logic.FO.betaB:
/-- The β-function as a bounded formula: `z = β(A, B, i)`, i.e.
`∃q ≤ A. A = q·(1 + (i + 1)·B) + z ∧ Sz ≤ 1 + (i + 1)·B`
(free variables `0 = z`, `1 = A`, `2 = B`, `3 = i`). -/

Foundations.Logic.FO.consistent_of_finit:
/-- A finitely satisfiable theory is consistent. -/
theorem consistent_of_finitely_sat {Γ : Theory L}
    (h : ∀ l : List (Formula L), (∀ ψ ∈ l, Γ ψ) →
      ∃ (M : Structure L) (e : Nat → M.Dom), ∀ ψ ∈ l, Sat M e ψ) : Consistent Γ := by
  intro hb
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := Proves.finite_premises (Γ₀ := empty) hb (fun ψ h => Or.inr h)
  obtain ⟨M, e, he⟩ := h l hl
  exact Proves.soundness hd M e (fun ψ hψ => by
    rcases hψ with h | h
    · exact h.elim
    · exact he ψ h)
Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves:
/-- **First-order natural deduction.** `Proves Γ φ` (written `Γ ⊢₁ φ`) means that `φ`
has a derivation from premises in `Γ`. -/
inductive Proves : Theory L → Formula L → Prop where
  /-- Hypothesis. -/
  | hyp {Γ φ} : Γ φ → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `→`-introduction. -/
  | impI {Γ φ ψ} : Proves (insert Γ φ) ψ → Proves Γ (imp φ ψ)
  /-- `→`-elimination (modus ponens). -/
  | impE {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (imp φ ψ) → Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- `∧`-introduction. -/
  | conjI {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ ψ → Proves Γ (conj φ ψ)
  /-- `∧`-elimination, left. -/
  | conjE₁ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (conj φ ψ) → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `∧`-elimination, right. -/
  | conjE₂ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ (conj φ ψ) → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- `∨`-introduction, left. -/
  | disjI₁ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ φ → Proves Γ (disj φ ψ)
  /-- `∨`-introduction, right. -/
  | disjI₂ {Γ φ ψ} : Proves Γ ψ → Proves Γ (disj φ ψ)
  /-- `∨`-elimination. -/
  | disjE {Γ φ ψ χ} : Proves Γ (disj φ ψ) → Proves (insert Γ φ) χ →
      Proves (insert Γ ψ) χ → Proves Γ χ
  /-- Ex falso quodlibet. -/
  | botE {Γ φ} : Proves Γ bot → Proves Γ φ
  /-- Reductio ad absurdum (classical). -/
  | raa {Γ φ} : Proves (insert Γ (neg φ)) bot → Proves Γ φ
  /-- `∀`-introduction: prove the body for a fresh variable (premises shifted). -/
  | allI {Γ φ} : Proves (shift Γ) φ → Proves Γ (all φ)
  /-- `∀`-elimination: instantiate at any term. -/
  | allE {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (all φ) → Proves Γ (φ.inst t)
  /-- `∃`-introduction: a witness term gives an existential. -/
  | exI {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (φ.inst t) → Proves Γ (ex φ)
  /-- `∃`-elimination: reason from a fresh witness to a conclusion not mentioning it. -/
  | exE {Γ : Theory L} {φ ψ : Formula L} : Proves Γ (ex φ) → Proves (insert (shift Γ) φ) ψ.shift → Proves Γ ψ
  /-- Reflexivity of equality. -/
  | refl {Γ} (t : Term L) : Proves Γ (eq t t)
  /-- Substitutivity of equals (Leibniz's law). -/
  | subst {Γ : Theory L} {φ : Formula L} {s t : Term L} : Proves Γ (eq s t) → Proves Γ (φ.inst s) → Proves Γ (φ.inst t)
Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.lnt:
/-- The `i`-th element is computable. -/
theorem lnth {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => Computability.lnth (f n) (g n) := by
  have := Comp.lhead (Comp.ldrop hf hg)
  exact Comp.congr this fun n => (lnth_eq_lhead_ldrop _ _).symm

/-- A type synonym for `G` on which `G` acts by conjugation. -/
def ConjAct (G : Type u) : Type u := G
Foundations.Topology.extreme_value_inter:
/-- **Extreme value theorem on `[a, b]`**, re-derived from Heine–Borel; this is exactly the
statement of `R.extreme_value` from `Numbers/Continuity`, now as a corollary of compactness. -/
theorem extreme_value_interval {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x ≤ f c := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := extreme_value_compact (heine_borel a b) ⟨a, Std.le_refl a, hab⟩
    (f := f) (fun x hx => hf x hx.1 hx.2)
  exact ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, fun x h1 h2 => h x ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.smul_mul:
/-- Scalars pull out of the left factor. -/
theorem smul_mul (c : R) (p q : List R) : Eqv (mul (smul c p) q) (smul c (mul p q)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro n; simp [mul, smul]
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro n
    show coeff (mul ((c * a) :: smul c p) q) n = _
    rw [coeff_smul, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, left_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [coeff_cons_zero, mul_zero]
    | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih k, coeff_smul]
Foundations.Algebra.permFun_injective:
/-- `π` is injective. -/
theorem permFun_injective (σ : FieldAut Qc L) : ∀ i j, permFun σ i = permFun σ j → i = j := by
  intro i j h
  have := congrArg qβ h
  rw [permFun_spec, permFun_spec] at this
  have e := σ.injective (Subtype.ext this)
  exact qβ_spec.1 i j (congrArg Subtype.val e)
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasDerivAt.lipschi:
/-- A differentiable function grows at most linearly near the point: `|f y − f x| ≤
(|d| + 1) |y − x|` for `y` near `x`. -/
theorem HasDerivAt.lipschitz {f : R → R} {d x : R} (h : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y, abs (y - x) < δ → abs (f y - f x) ≤ (abs d + 1) * abs (y - x) := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := h 1 (by grind)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := hδf y hy
  have k2 := abs_add (f y - f x - d * (y - x)) (d * (y - x))
  rw [show f y - f x - d * (y - x) + d * (y - x) = f y - f x by grind, abs_mul] at k2
  grind
