Foundations.Logic.Sequent.within_of_cutF:
/-- Auxiliary form of the subformula property, for an arbitrary end-sequent `E`. -/
theorem within_of_cutFree (E : List Formula) {Γ Δ} (h : CutFree Γ Δ) :
    (∀ B ∈ Γ ++ Δ, ∃ C ∈ E, B ∈ subformulas C) →
      Within (fun B => ∃ C ∈ E, B ∈ subformulas C) Γ Δ := by
  induction h with
  | ax h₁ h₂ => exact fun hS => .ax hS h₁ h₂
  | @left Γ Δ A ps hA hps _ ih =>
      intro hS
      refine .left hS hA hps (fun p hp => ih p hp ?_)
      intro B hB
      obtain ⟨C, hC, hAC⟩ := hS A (List.mem_append_left _ hA)
      simp only [List.mem_append] at hB
      rcases hB with (hB | hB) | (hB | hB)
      · exact ⟨C, hC, subformulas_trans (left_premise_sub hps hp (by simp [hB])) hAC⟩
      · exact hS B (by simp [hB])
      · exact ⟨C, hC, subformulas_trans (left_premise_sub hps hp (by simp [hB])) hAC⟩
      · exact hS B (by simp [hB])
  | @right Γ Δ A ps hA hps _ ih =>
      intro hS
      refine .right hS hA hps (fun p hp => ih p hp ?_)
      intro B hB
      obtain ⟨C, hC, hAC⟩ := hS A (List.mem_append_right _ hA)
      simp only [List.mem_append] at hB
      rcases hB with (hB | hB) | (hB | hB)
      · exact ⟨C, hC, subformulas_trans (right_premise_sub hps hp (by simp [hB])) hAC⟩
      · exact hS B (by simp [hB])
      · exact ⟨C, hC, subformulas_trans (right_premise_sub hps hp (by simp [hB])) hAC⟩
      · exact hS B (by simp [hB])

Foundations.Algebra.Subring:
/-- **Subring.** A subset of a ring containing `0` and `1` and closed under addition,
negation and multiplication. -/
structure Subring (S : Type v) [CommRing S] where
  /-- The elements of the subring. -/
  carrier : S → Prop
  /-- Contains `0`. -/
  zero_mem : carrier 0
  /-- Contains `1`. -/
  one_mem : carrier 1
  /-- Closed under addition. -/
  add_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a + b)
  /-- Closed under negation. -/
  neg_mem : ∀ {a}, carrier a → carrier (-a)
  /-- Closed under multiplication. -/
  mul_mem : ∀ {a b}, carrier a → carrier b → carrier (a * b)

/-- **The category of types is cartesian closed**: one-point type, cartesian product, and

instance typesCCC : CartesianClosed (Type u) where
  one := PUnit
  terminal := types_terminal
  prod X Y := X × Y
  fst := fun p => p.1
  snd := fun p => p.2

/-- **Uniformly definable properties are closed under substitution of uniformly
definable functions.** -/

    {σ : Nat → ∀ N : PAModel, (Nat → N.Dom) → N.Dom} (hσ : ∀ n, UDefT (σ n)) :
    UDef fun N e => P N (fun n => σ n N e) :=

    rw [sat_subst, hP.spec]

quantifiers in it. -/

  | rel _ _ => 0
  | imp φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | conj φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | disj φ ψ => size φ + size ψ + 1
  | all φ => size φ + 1
  | ex φ => size φ + 1

Foundations.Types.STLC.Ne:
/-- **Neutral derivations**: a chain of eliminations starting from a hypothesis
(the major premises run down the main branch). -/
inductive Ne : List Formula → Formula → Prop
  | hyp {Γ : List Formula} {n : Nat} {A : Formula} : Γ[n]? = some A → Ne Γ A
  | impE {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.arr A B) → Nf Γ A → Ne Γ B
  | andE₁ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.prod A B) → Ne Γ A
  | andE₂ {Γ : List Formula} {A B : Formula} : Ne Γ (.prod A B) → Ne Γ B
  | orE {Γ : List Formula} {A B C : Formula} :
      Ne Γ (.sum A B) → Nf (A :: Γ) C → Nf (B :: Γ) C → Ne Γ C
  | botE {Γ : List Formula} {C : Formula} : Ne Γ .bot → Ne Γ C

/-- An event splits along `B` and its complement. -/
theorem prob_split (A B : Event α) :
    P.prob A = P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ B x) + P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ ¬ B x) := by
  rw [← prob_or_disjoint P fun x h => h.2.2 h.1.2]
  exact prob_congr P fun x _ => ⟨fun ha => (Classical.em (B x)).elim (fun hb => Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩)
    fun hb => Or.inr ⟨ha, hb⟩, fun h => h.elim And.left And.left⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.provM_std_sound:
/-- **Soundness of `ProvM` in the standard model.** Every line of a justified sequence
is the Gödel number of a theorem of PA. -/
theorem provM_std_sound {x : Nat} (h : ProvM (N := stdPA) x) : ∃ φ, x = fcode φ ∧ PA ⊢₁ φ := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, n, hn, hall⟩ := h
  have key : ∀ k : Nat, k ≤ n → ∀ y : Nat, BetaM (N := stdPA) c d k y →
      ∃ φ, y = fcode φ ∧ PA ⊢₁ φ := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | _ k ih =>
      intro hk y hy
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hj⟩ := hall k (stdPA_le.2 hk)
      rw [betaM_unique hy hy']
      rcases hj with hacc | ⟨i, hi, j, hj, a, b, ha, hb, u, hu, hu'⟩ | ⟨i, hi, a, ha, hnec⟩
      · rw [AccM] at hacc
        exact (sat_accF_std y' _).1 hacc
      · have hi' := stdPA_lt.1 hi; have hj' := stdPA_lt.1 hj
        obtain ⟨φa, rfl, hφa⟩ := ih i hi' (by omega) a ha
        obtain ⟨φb, rfl, hφb⟩ := ih j hj' (by omega) b hb
        have e₁ := stdPA_pairM hu; have e₂ := stdPA_pairM hu'
        obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := fcode_tag_imp (Φ := φa) (by rw [e₂]; exact fst_pair _ _)
        have e₃ : pair 2 (pair (fcode A) (fcode B)) = pair 2 (pair (fcode φb) y') := by
          rw [← e₁]; exact e₂
        obtain ⟨-, e₄⟩ := pair_inj e₃
        obtain ⟨e₅, rfl⟩ := pair_inj e₄
        rw [fcode_inj e₅] at hφa
        exact ⟨B, rfl, Proves.impE hφa hφb⟩
      · have hi' := stdPA_lt.1 hi
        obtain ⟨φa, rfl, hφa⟩ := ih i hi' (by omega) a ha
        unfold NecM at hnec
        have hev : Eval necCode [fcode φa] y' := by
          have := (sat_evalSigma necCode y' (fcode φa)).1
          refine this ((sat_congr_fresh _ fun n hn => ?_).1 hnec)
          match n with
          | 0 => rfl
          | 1 => rfl
          | n + 2 => exact absurd (evalSigma_fresh _ (n + 2) (by omega)) hn
        rw [← Eval.det (necCode_spec (fcode φa)) hev, necFun_fcode]
        exact ⟨_, rfl, PA_proves_of_Q_proves
          (Q_proves_halts ((searchPA_spec _).2 ⟨φa, rfl, hφa⟩))⟩
  exact key n (Nat.le_refl n) x hn

/-- **Doubling the cube is impossible** (Wantzel, 1837). No number whose cube is `2` is

Foundations.Algebra.leftCoset_eq_or_disj:
/-- **Cosets partition the group.** Two left cosets either coincide or are disjoint. -/
theorem leftCoset_eq_or_disjoint (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G) :
    (∀ x, leftCoset a H x ↔ leftCoset b H x) ∨
    (∀ x, ¬ (leftCoset a H x ∧ leftCoset b H x)) := by
  by_cases hab : a⁻¹ * b ∈ H
  · left
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      show b⁻¹ * x ∈ H
      have : b⁻¹ * x = (a⁻¹ * b)⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * x) := by
        rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hab) hx
    · intro hx
      show a⁻¹ * x ∈ H
      have : a⁻¹ * x = (a⁻¹ * b) * (b⁻¹ * x) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem hab hx
  · right
    intro x ⟨ha, hb⟩
    apply hab
    have : a⁻¹ * b = (a⁻¹ * x) * (b⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    rw [this]; exact H.mul_mem ha (H.inv_mem hb)

Foundations.Topology.isConnected_univ_R:
/-- **The real line is connected.** -/
theorem isConnected_univ_R : IsConnected (Topology.metric R) (fun _ => True) := by
  rintro ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hcov, ⟨x, -, hxU⟩, ⟨y, -, hyV⟩, hdis⟩
  -- A separation of `ℝ` would separate the interval between `x` and `y`.
  have key : ∀ a b, U a → V b → a ≤ b → False := fun a b ha hb hab =>
    isConnected_interval a b ⟨U, V, hU, hV, fun z _ => hcov z trivial,
      ⟨a, ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab⟩, ha⟩, ⟨b, ⟨hab, Std.le_refl b⟩, hb⟩, fun z _ => hdis z trivial⟩
  rcases (by grind : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x) with h | h
  · exact key x y hxU hyV h
  · exact isConnected_interval y x ⟨V, U, hV, hU, fun z _ => (hcov z trivial).symm,
      ⟨y, ⟨Std.le_refl y, h⟩, hyV⟩, ⟨x, ⟨h, Std.le_refl x⟩, hxU⟩,

/-- Every `x ∈ [−1, 1]` is the cosine of an angle in `[0, π]`. -/
theorem exists_arccos {x : R} (h1 : -1 ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ 1) :
    ∃ θ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ pi ∧ cos θ = x := by
  obtain ⟨θ, h0, hπ, hθ⟩ := intermediate_value' (f := fun t => 0 - cos t) (a := 0) (b := pi)
    (v := -x) (Std.le_of_lt pi_pos)

    (by show 0 - cos 0 ≤ -x; rw [cos_zero]; grind)

Foundations.Algebra.quintic_not_solvable:
/-- **The insolvability of the quintic (Abel–Ruffini, Galois).** No complex root of
`x⁵ - 6x + 3` is expressible by radicals over `ℚ`: it lies in no tower
`ℚ ⊆ ℚ(x₁) ⊆ ⋯ ⊆ ℚ(x₁, …, xₘ) ⊆ ℂ` in which each `xᵢ` has a positive power in the field before it. -/
theorem quintic_not_solvable_by_radicals (β : ℂ) (hβ : eval β (quinticPoly ℂ) = 0) :
    ¬ ExpressibleByRadicals β :=
  fun hrad => quintic_galois_not_solvable (galois_criterion hβ hrad)
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_pos_le_both:
/-- Two positive numbers have a positive common lower bound. -/
theorem exists_pos_le_both {δ₁ δ₂ : R} (h₁ : 0 < δ₁) (h₂ : 0 < δ₂) :
    ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ δ₁ ∧ δ ≤ δ₂ := by
  rcases (by grind : δ₁ ≤ δ₂ ∨ δ₂ ≤ δ₁) with h | h
  · exact ⟨δ₁, h₁, by grind, h⟩
  · exact ⟨δ₂, h₂, h, by grind⟩

  refine .comp (vec2 v₀ v₁) (fun i => ?_) hf

    unionLt C x y ↔ W.lt x y := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨V, hV, hxy⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨W, hW, h⟩⟩
  rcases hC W V hW hV with h | h
  · exact (h.2 x y hy).1 hxy
  · exact (h.2 x y (V.lt_dom x y hxy).2).2 hxy

Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.UDef.nec:
/-- The necessitation clause is uniformly definable. -/
noncomputable def UDef.nec {f g : ∀ N : PAModel, (Nat → N.Dom) → N.Dom} (hf : UDefT f)
    (hg : UDefT g) : UDef fun N e => NecM (f N e) (g N e) :=
  ⟨(evalSigma necCode).subst (Env.cons hg.t (Env.cons hf.t fun _ => numeral 0)), fun N e => by
    rw [sat_subst, NecM]
    have : (fun n => (Env.cons hg.t (Env.cons hf.t fun _ => numeral 0) n).eval N.M e) =
        Env.cons (g N e) (Env.cons (f N e) fun _ => (0 : N.Dom)) := by
      funext n; match n with
      | 0 => exact hg.spec N e
      | 1 => exact hf.spec N e
      | n + 2 => exact eval_numeral_M e 0
    rw [this]⟩

/-- Ring homomorphisms preserve the images of integers. -/
theorem RingHom.map_intCast {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (σ : RingHom A B)
    (z : Int) : σ.toFun (Int.cast z) = (Int.cast z : B) := by
  show σ.toFun (icast z) = icast z
  match z with
  | .ofNat n => exact RingHom.map_ncast σ n
  | .negSucc n => show σ.toFun (-(ncast (n + 1))) = -(ncast (n + 1))
                  rw [σ.map_neg, RingHom.map_ncast]

Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ker:
/-- The **kernel** of `f`: the elements sent to the identity. It is a subgroup of the
domain. -/
def ker (f : G →* H) : Subgroup G where
  carrier x := f x = 1
  one_mem := f.map_one
  mul_mem := by intro a b ha hb; show f (a * b) = 1; rw [f.map_mul', ha, hb, one_mul]
  inv_mem := by intro a ha; show f a⁻¹ = 1; rw [f.map_inv, ha, inv_one]
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.canon_s:
/-- The canonical map preserves squares. -/
theorem canon_sq (x : F) : canon F G (x * x) = canon F G x * canon F G x := by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have h0 : 0 ≤ canon F G x := by
      have := (canon_le (G := G) 0 x).1 hx; rwa [canon_zero] at this
    exact canon_eq (sameCut_sq (archF (F := F)) (archG (G := G)) hx h0 (canon_spec x))
  · have hx' : 0 ≤ -x := by grind
    have h0 : 0 ≤ canon F G (-x) := by
      have := (canon_le (G := G) 0 (-x)).1 hx'; rwa [canon_zero] at this
    have := canon_eq (sameCut_sq (archF (F := F)) (archG (G := G)) hx' h0 (canon_spec (G := G) (-x)))
    have e : -x * -x = x * x := by grind
    rw [e, canon_neg] at this
    rw [this]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.fix_of_pow_fix:
/-- If `g⁵ = 1` and some power `gᵏ` with `0 < k < 5` fixes `x`, then `g` fixes `x`: since `5` is
prime, `g` is itself a power of `gᵏ`. -/
theorem fix_of_pow_fix {g : Perm α} (h5 : g ^ 5 = 1) {k : Nat} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k < 5)
    {x : α} (hx : (g ^ (k : Nat)) x = x) : g x = x := by
  have hiter : ∀ n : Nat, ((g ^ k) ^ n) x = x := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih => show ((g ^ k) ^ n) ((g ^ k) x) = x; rw [hx, ih]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, (k * n) % 5 = 1 := by
    match k, hk0, hk with
    | 1, _, _ => exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    | 2, _, _ => exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
    | 3, _, _ => exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
    | 4, _, _ => exact ⟨4, rfl⟩
  have := hiter n
  rw [← pow_mul, pow_mod_five h5, hn, pow_one] at this
  exact this
Foundations.Bridges.lean_int_in_sets:
/-- **Lean's `Int` inside the sets.** The composite `Int → Z → ℤ_ZF` is a bijection
onto the members of the set `ℤ`, preserving addition, negation, multiplication and
order. -/
theorem lean_int_in_sets :
    Bijective (fun i : Int => (⟨intToSet i, intToSet_mem i⟩ : {s : ZFSet // s ∈ ZInt})) ∧
    (∀ m n, intToSet (m + n) = zadd (intToSet m) (intToSet n)) ∧
    (∀ m, intToSet (-m) = zneg (intToSet m)) ∧
    (∀ m n, intToSet (m * n) = zmul (intToSet m) (intToSet n)) ∧
    (∀ m n, zle (intToSet m) (intToSet n) ↔ m ≤ n) :=
  ⟨⟨fun _ _ h => intToSet_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => let ⟨i, hi⟩ := intToSet_surj hx; ⟨i, Subtype.ext hi⟩⟩,
   intToSet_add, intToSet_neg, intToSet_mul, intToSet_le⟩

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Integ:
/-- **Subtraction.** `∫ (f − g) = ∫ f − ∫ g`. -/
theorem Integrable.sub {f g : α → R} (hf : Integrable m f) (hg : Integrable m g) :
    Integrable m (fun x => f x - g x) ∧
      integral m (fun x => f x - g x) = integral m f - integral m g := by
  obtain ⟨h1, e1⟩ := hg.negate m
  obtain ⟨h2, e2⟩ := hf.add m h1
  have e : (fun x => f x + -g x) = fun x => f x - g x := funext fun x => by grind
  rw [e] at h2 e2; rw [e2, e1]; exact ⟨h2, by grind⟩

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.lagrange:
/-- **Lagrange's identity** in the plane: `|u|²|v|² − (u·v)² = (u × v)²`, with `u = b − a`,
`v = c − b`. -/
theorem lagrange (a b c : Pt K) :
    d2 a b * d2 b c - dot a b c * dot a b c =
      ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)) *
      ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)) := by
  unfold d2 dot; grind

Foundations.Types.STLC.Ne.toTerm:
/-- **Normal proofs are normal terms** (neutral case): a neutral derivation is
decorated by a normal, neutral, well-typed term. -/
theorem Ne.toTerm {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} :
    Ne Γ A → ∃ t, HasType Γ t A ∧ Normal t ∧ Neutral t
  | .hyp h => ⟨.var _, .var h, ⟨fun x (hs : Step (.var _) x) => (by cases hs), trivial⟩⟩
  | .impE h₁ h₂ => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h₁
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hnu⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₂
    refine ⟨.app t u, .app ht hu, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | beta => exact hneu
    | appL h => exact hn _ h
    | appR h => exact hnu _ h
  | .andE₁ h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.fst t, .fst ht, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | fstPair => exact hneu
    | fst h => exact hn _ h
  | .andE₂ h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.snd t, .snd ht, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | sndPair => exact hneu
    | snd h => exact hn _ h
  | .orE h h₁ h₂ => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hneu⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁, hn₁⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₁
    obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂, hn₂⟩ := Nf.toTerm h₂
    refine ⟨.case t u₁ u₂, .case ht hu₁ hu₂, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | caseInl => exact hneu
    | caseInr => exact hneu
    | case₀ h => exact hn _ h
    | case₁ h => exact hn₁ _ h
    | case₂ h => exact hn₂ _ h
  | .botE h => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, _⟩ := Ne.toTerm h
    refine ⟨.absurd t, .absurd ht, fun x hx => ?_, trivial⟩
    cases hx with
    | absurd h => exact hn _ h

/-- Multiplying a strict inequality by a positive element preserves it. -/
theorem mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left {x y z : Q} : x < y → 0 < z → z * x < z * y := by
  induction x using ind with | h a b hb => ?_
  induction y using ind with | h c d hd => ?_
  induction z using ind with | h e f hf => ?_
  simp only [ofNat_def, mk_mul, mk_lt]
  intro h1 h2
  have h3 := Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (Int.mul_pos (by omega : 0 < e) hf)
  grind

  refine ⟨isDomain, fun z => (norm z).toNat, fun a b hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q, r, h, hr⟩ := div_small a b hb

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_pow:
/-- **Power rule.** `(yⁿ⁺¹)' = (n + 1) yⁿ`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_pow (n : Nat) (x : R) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => y ^ (n + 1)) (((n : R) + 1) * x ^ n) x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h := (hasDerivAt_id x).congr (g := fun y => y ^ (0 + 1)) (fun y => by
      show y = y ^ 0 * y; grind)
    have e : (1 : R) = (((0 : Nat) : R) + 1) * x ^ 0 := by grind
    exact e ▸ h
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := (ih.mul (hasDerivAt_id x)).congr (g := fun y => y ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (fun y => rfl)
    have e : ((n : R) + 1) * x ^ n * x + x ^ (n + 1) * 1 = (((n + 1 : Nat) : R) + 1) * x ^ (n + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ']; grind
    exact e ▸ h

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.lsum_:
/-- The Lebesgue integral of the uniform step function is a **Riemann sum**. -/
theorem lsum_upieces (f : R → R) {a b h : R} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (N : Nat) : ∀ y : R, a ≤ y →
    y + (N : R) * h ≤ b →
    lsum (fun p => p.1 * (lebesgue a b).μ p.2) (upieces f h y N) = rsum f y (unif y h N) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => intro y _ _; rfl
  | succ N ih =>
    intro y hy hb
    have hN : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hN hh
    show f y * (lebesgue a b).μ _ + lsum _ (upieces f h (y + h) N) = f y * (y + h - y) + _
    rw [ih (y + h) (by grind) (by grind), lebesgue_apply,
      outer_congr (B := fun z => y ≤ z ∧ z < y + h) fun z => by unfold Icc; grind,
      outer_Ico (by grind)]
Foundations.Types.Lambda.church_rosser:
/-- **The Church–Rosser theorem.** β-reduction is confluent: if `t ⟶* u` and
`t ⟶* v`, then `u` and `v` have a common reduct. -/
theorem church_rosser {t u v : Term} (hu : Red t u) (hv : Red t v) :
    ∃ w, Red u w ∧ Red v w := by
  have toPar : ∀ {a b}, Red a b → Star Par a b :=
    fun h => Star.flatten (fun _ _ h => Star.single h.par) h
  have ofPar : ∀ {a b}, Star Par a b → Red a b :=
    fun h => Star.flatten (fun _ _ h => h.red) h
  obtain ⟨w, h₁, h₂⟩ := Par.confluent (toPar hu) (toPar hv)
  exact ⟨w, ofPar h₁, ofPar h₂⟩

Foundations.Categories.IsColimit.uniqueI:

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Integ:
/-- **Additivity.** `f + g` is integrable and `∫ (f + g) = ∫ f + ∫ g`. -/
theorem Integrable.add {f g : α → R} (hf : Integrable m f) (hg : Integrable m g) :
    Integrable m (fun x => f x + g x) ∧
      integral m (fun x => f x + g x) = integral m f + integral m g := by
  obtain ⟨hP, eP⟩ := lintegral_add m hf.pos hg.pos
  obtain ⟨hN, eN⟩ := lintegral_add m hf.neg hg.neg
  have hi : Integrable m (fun x => f x + g x) :=
    ⟨(lintegral_mono m hP (hf.measurable.add hg.measurable).pp (fun x => pp_nonneg _) fun x => by
        have := le_pp (f x); have := le_pp (g x); have := pp_nonneg (f x)
        have := pp_nonneg (g x); unfold pp; split <;> grind).1,
      (lintegral_mono m hN (hf.measurable.add hg.measurable).neg.pp (fun x => pp_nonneg _)
        fun x => by
          have := le_pp (-f x); have := le_pp (-g x); have := pp_nonneg (-f x)
          have := pp_nonneg (-g x); unfold pp; split <;> grind).1⟩
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  -- `(f+g)⁺ + f⁻ + g⁻ = (f+g)⁻ + f⁺ + g⁺`.
  obtain ⟨h1, e1⟩ := lintegral_add m hi.pos hN
  obtain ⟨h2, e2⟩ := lintegral_add m hi.neg hP
  have e : (fun x => pp (f x + g x) + (pp (-f x) + pp (-g x))) =
      (fun x => pp (-(f x + g x)) + (pp (f x) + pp (g x))) := funext fun x => by
    have := pp_sub_pp (f x); have := pp_sub_pp (g x); have := pp_sub_pp (f x + g x); grind
  rw [e] at e1
  unfold integral
  rw [eP, eN] at *
  grind
Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.step:
/-- One bisection step on an interval `(l, u)`: keep the left half if the midpoint satisfies `P`,
otherwise keep the right half. -/
noncomputable def step (P : Q → Prop) (p : Q × Q) : Q × Q :=
  open Classical in
  if P ((p.1 + p.2) / 2) then (p.1, (p.1 + p.2) / 2) else ((p.1 + p.2) / 2, p.2)

Foundations.Probability.FinProb.decomp_v:
/-- **Decomposition along the values**: `X(x) = ∑_a a · 1[X = a](x)`. -/
theorem decomp_vals (X : α → R) (x : α) :
    ∀ V : List R, V.Nodup → X x ∈ V → sumL V (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) = X x := by
  intro V
  induction V with
  | nil => intro _ h; simp at h
  | cons b V ih =>
      intro hnd hmem
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnd
      simp only [sumL_cons]
      by_cases hb : X x = b
      · have hrest : sumL V (fun a => a * ind (fun y => X y = a) x) = 0 := by
          rw [← sumL_zero V]
          refine sumL_congr fun a ha => ?_
          have : ¬ X x = a := fun h => hnd.1 (hb ▸ h ▸ ha)
          simp [ind, this]; grind
        rw [hrest]; simp [ind, hb]; grind
      · have hx : X x ∈ V := (List.mem_cons.1 hmem).resolve_left hb
        rw [ih hnd.2 hx]; simp [ind, hb]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.tower_law:
/-- **The tower law.** For subfields `K ⊆ L ⊆ M` of a field `Ω` with `L` finite over `K` and
`M` finite over `L`, the extension `M / K` is finite and `[M : K] = [M : L] · [L : K]`. -/
theorem tower_law (hΩ : IsField Ω) {K L M : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L) (hLM : L.le M)
    (h1 : FiniteExt K L hKL) (h2 : FiniteExt L M hLM) :
    FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM) ∧
      deg K M (le_trans hKL hLM) = deg L M hLM * deg K L hKL := by
  have hFK := K.isField hΩ
  have hFL := L.isField hΩ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_basis hFK h1
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_basis hFL h2
  let a := deg K L hKL
  let b := deg L M hLM
  let g : Fin (dim K (L.over K hKL)) × Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → M.over K (le_trans hKL hLM) :=
    fun p => ⟨(e p.1).1 * (f p.2).1, M.mul_mem (hLM _ (e p.1).2) (f p.2).2⟩
  have hspan : Spans K g := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hf.2 ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
    have hd' : x.1 = isum (fun j => (d j).1 * (f j).1) := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hd; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    let c : Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → Fin (dim K (L.over K hKL)) → K := fun j =>
      Classical.choose (he.2 (⟨(d j).1, (d j).2⟩ : L.over K hKL))
    have hc : ∀ j, (d j).1 = isum (fun i => (c j i).1 * (e i).1) := by
      intro j
      have := congrArg Subtype.val
        (Classical.choose_spec (he.2 (⟨(d j).1, (d j).2⟩ : L.over K hKL)))
      rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    refine ⟨fun p => c p.2 p.1, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_isum, isum_prod, hd', isum_comm]
    congr 1; funext j
    rw [hc j, isum_mul_right]
    congr 1; funext i
    show (c j i).1 * (e i).1 * (f j).1 = (c j i).1 * ((e i).1 * (f j).1)
    rw [Ring.mul_assoc]
  have hind : LinIndep K g := by
    intro c hc
    have h0 : isum (fun p => (c p).1 * (g p).1) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hc; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
    rw [isum_prod, isum_comm] at h0
    -- The coefficient of `f j` over `L`.
    let d : Fin (dim L (M.over L hLM)) → L := fun j =>
      ⟨isum (fun i => (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1),
        (isum (fun i => c (i, j) • e i) : L.over K hKL).2 |> fun h => by
          rw [coe_isum] at h; exact h⟩
    have hdj : ∀ j, d j = 0 := by
      apply hf.1 d
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      show isum (fun j => isum (fun i => (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1) * (f j).1) = 0
      rw [← h0]
      congr 1; funext j
      rw [isum_mul_right]
      congr 1; funext i
      show (c (i, j)).1 * (e i).1 * (f j).1 = (c (i, j)).1 * ((e i).1 * (f j).1)
      rw [Ring.mul_assoc]
    intro p
    have := he.1 (fun i => c (i, p.2)) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_isum]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hdj p.2)) p.1
    exact this
  have hfin : FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM) := finDim_of_spans hspan
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have := card_eq_dim hFK hfin ⟨hind, hspan⟩
  rw [card_prod, card_fin, card_fin] at this
  show dim K (M.over K _) = dim L (M.over L hLM) * dim K (L.over K hKL)
  rw [← this, Nat.mul_comm]
Foundations.Algebra.Subgroup.Normal:
/-- **Normal subgroup.** A subgroup `N` is normal if it is closed under conjugation: whenever
`n ∈ N`, every conjugate `g * n * g⁻¹` is in `N`. -/
class Subgroup.Normal (N : Subgroup G) : Prop where
  /-- Closure under conjugation. -/

Foundations.Logic.Formula.atoms:
/-- The list of atoms occurring in a formula (possibly with repetitions). -/
def atoms : Formula → List Nat
  | bot => []
  | var n => [n]
  | imp φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
  | conj φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
  | disj φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
Foundations.Algebra.exists_pow_eq_one:
/-- **Some power of every element is the identity** in a finite group. The powers
`g⁰, g¹, …, g^|G|` are `|G| + 1` elements of a set of size `|G|`, so by the pigeonhole
principle two coincide, and then `g ^ (j - i) = 1`. -/
theorem exists_pow_eq_one (g : G) : ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ g ^ n = 1 := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hinj : ∀ i j : Nat, g ^ i = g ^ j → i = j := by
    intro i j h
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact absurd ⟨j - i, by omega, pow_sub_eq_one hlt h⟩ hno
    · exact heq
    · exact absurd ⟨i - j, by omega, pow_sub_eq_one hgt h.symm⟩ hno
  have hnd := nodup_map_of_injective hinj (List.nodup_range (n := card G + 1))
  have := length_le_card hnd
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
  omega

Foundations.Types.STLC.HasType.subst:
/-- **Substitution lemma.** Substituting well-typed terms for variables preserves typing. -/
theorem HasType.subst {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ {Δ : Ctx} (σ : Nat → Term), (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → HasType Δ (σ n) B) →
      HasType Δ (STLC.subst σ t) A := by
  have hup : ∀ {Γ Δ : Ctx} {A : Ty} (σ : Nat → Term),
      (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → HasType Δ (σ n) B) →
      ∀ n B, (A :: Γ)[n]? = some B → HasType (A :: Δ) (up σ n) B := by
    intro Γ Δ A σ hσ n B hn
    cases n with
    | zero => exact .var hn
    | succ n =>
      exact (hσ n B (by simpa using hn)).rename Nat.succ (fun m C hm => by simpa using hm)
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro Δ σ hσ; exact hσ _ _ hn
  | lam _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .lam (ih _ (hup σ hσ))
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .app (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .pair (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | fst _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .fst (ih σ hσ)
  | snd _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .snd (ih σ hσ)
  | inl _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .inl (ih σ hσ)
  | inr _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .inr (ih σ hσ)
  | case _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro Δ σ hσ; exact .case (ih σ hσ) (ih₁ _ (hup σ hσ)) (ih₂ _ (hup σ hσ))
  | absurd _ ih => intro Δ σ hσ; exact .absurd (ih σ hσ)
Foundations.Algebra.GaussInt.div_small:
/-- **Division with small remainder in `ℤ[i]`.** For `β ≠ 0` and any `α` there are `q`, `ρ`
with `α = qβ + ρ` and `N(ρ) < N(β)`. -/
theorem div_small (a b : GaussInt) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ q r : GaussInt, a = q * b + r ∧ norm r < norm b := by
  have hN : 0 < norm b := by
    have := norm_nonneg b
    have : norm b ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (norm_eq_zero.1 h)
    omega
  let N := norm b
  let u := a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im
  let v := a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hq1'⟩ := exists_round u N hN
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hq2'⟩ := exists_round v N hN
  let q : GaussInt := ⟨q1, q2⟩
  refine ⟨q, a + -(q * b), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ring.add_comm a, ← Ring.add_assoc, add_neg_cancel, Ring.zero_add]
  · -- `N(ρ) · N(β) = (u - q₁N)² + (v - q₂N)²`.
    have key : norm (a + -(q * b)) * N = (u - q1 * N) * (u - q1 * N) + (v - q2 * N) * (v - q2 * N) := by
      show norm (a + -(q * b)) * norm b = _
      unfold norm
      simp only [add_re, add_im, neg_re, neg_im, mul_re, mul_im]
      show _ = (a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im - q1 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) *
          (a.re * b.re + a.im * b.im - q1 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) +
        (a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im - q2 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im)) *
          (a.im * b.re - a.re * b.im - q2 * (b.re * b.re + b.im * b.im))
      grind
    have s1 := sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hq1 (Int.le_of_lt hq1')
    have s2 := sq_le_sq_of_abs_le hq2 (Int.le_of_lt hq2')
    have e1 : 2 * (u - q1 * N) * (2 * (u - q1 * N)) = 4 * ((u - q1 * N) * (u - q1 * N)) := by grind
    have e2 : 2 * (v - q2 * N) * (2 * (v - q2 * N)) = 4 * ((v - q2 * N) * (v - q2 * N)) := by grind
    have hlt : norm (a + -(q * b)) * N < N * N := by
      have hNN : 0 < N * N := Int.mul_pos hN hN
      omega
    exact Int.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hlt (Int.le_of_lt hN)

Foundations.Algebra.euler:
/-- **Euler's theorem.** If `a` is coprime to `n > 0`, then `a ^ φ(n) ≡ 1 (mod n)`. -/
theorem euler (n a : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : Nat.Coprime a n) : a ^ totient n % n = 1 % n := by
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  let u : ZModUnits n := ⟨Fin.ofNat n a, by rw [Fin.val_ofNat, coprime_mod_iff]; exact ha⟩
  have h := pow_card_eq_one u
  rw [card_zmodUnits] at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun v : ZModUnits n => v.1.val) h
  simp only [ZModUnits.val_pow, ZModUnits.val_one] at h'
  rw [Nat.pow_mod, ← h']
  rfl

Foundations.Numbers.OF.exists_rat_betwee:
/-- **Density of the rationals.** In an Archimedean ordered field, between any two elements
lies a rational. -/
theorem exists_rat_between (hA : Archimedean K) {a b : K} (h : a < b) :
    ∃ q : Q, a < ofRat q ∧ ofRat q < b := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hA (1 / (b - a))
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by grind
  have h1 : 1 < (n : K) * (b - a) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hn
    exact (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul _ _ hba).1 hn
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; exfalso; grind
    · exact h0
  have hnK : (0 : K) < (n : K) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos n hnpos
  have e := Ring.intCast_natCast (α := K) n
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_floor hA ((n : K) * a)
  refine ⟨Q.mk (m + 1) n (by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ofRat_mk]
    rw [← Field.IsOrdered.mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hnK]
    have : ((m + 1 : Int) : K) / ((n : Int) : K) * (n : K) = (m : K) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  · rw [ofRat_mk]
    rw [← Field.IsOrdered.mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hnK]
    have : ((m + 1 : Int) : K) / ((n : Int) : K) * (n : K) = (m : K) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind

/-- **The integral** `∫ₐᵇ f`: the Riemann integral of `f` over `[a, b]` if it exists. If it does

Foundations.Logic.Computability.evalStep:
/-- **One evaluation step**, checked on Gödel numbers. The argument packs the judgement
`x = ⟨c, ⟨xs, n⟩⟩`, a witness `w` and the coded list `js` of premises. The tag of `c`
selects the rule:
`0` zero, `1` successor, `2` projection, `3` composition (witness: the list of
intermediate values), `4` primitive recursion (witness: the previous value),
`5` minimisation (witness: the list of non-zero values minus one). -/
def evalStep (q : Nat) : Bool :=
  -- abbreviations: x = fst q, w = fst (snd q), js = snd (snd q)
  -- c = fst (fst q), xs = fst (snd (fst q)), n = snd (snd (fst q))
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 0 && snd (snd (fst q)) == 0) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 1 && snd (snd (fst q)) == lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) + 1) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 2 && snd (snd (fst q)) == lnth (fst (snd (fst q))) (snd (fst (fst q)))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 3 &&
    llen (fst (snd q)) == llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q)))) &&
    lnth (snd (snd q)) (llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q))))) ==
      judg (fst (snd (fst (fst q)))) (fst (snd q)) (snd (snd (fst q))) &&
    ballLt (fun r => lnth (snd (snd (fst r))) (snd r) ==
        judg (lnth (snd (snd (fst (fst (fst r))))) (snd r)) (fst (snd (fst (fst r))))
          (lnth (fst (snd (fst r))) (snd r)))
      q (llen (snd (snd (fst (fst q)))))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 4 && !(fst (snd (fst q)) == 0) &&
    ((lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) == 0 &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
        judg (fst (snd (fst (fst q)))) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q)))) (snd (snd (fst q)))) ||
     (!(lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) == 0) &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
        judg (fst (fst q)) (lcons (lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) - 1) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q)))))
          (fst (snd q)) &&
      lnth (snd (snd q)) 1 ==
        judg (snd (snd (fst (fst q))))
          (lcons (lhead (fst (snd (fst q))) - 1) (lcons (fst (snd q)) (ltail (fst (snd (fst q))))))
          (snd (snd (fst q)))))) ||
  (fst (fst (fst q)) == 5 &&
    lnth (snd (snd q)) 0 ==
      judg (snd (fst (fst q))) (lcons (snd (snd (fst q))) (fst (snd (fst q)))) 0 &&
    ballLt (fun r => lnth (snd (snd (fst r))) (snd r + 1) ==
        judg (snd (fst (fst (fst r)))) (lcons (snd r) (fst (snd (fst (fst r)))))
          (lnth (fst (snd (fst r))) (snd r) + 1))
      q (snd (snd (fst q))))
Foundations.Algebra.eval_Xpow_val:
/-- Values of powers in `Fin p`: evaluating `X^j` at `x` gives `x^j mod p`. -/
theorem eval_Xpow_val [NeZero p] (x : Fin p) (j : Nat) :
    (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.Xpow j)).val = x.val ^ j % p := by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    show (Polynomial.eval x 1).val = 1 % p
    rw [show Polynomial.eval x 1 = 1 from (Polynomial.evalHom x).map_one]
    exact Fin.val_ofNat p 1
  | succ j ih =>
    show (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.X * Polynomial.Xpow j)).val = _
    rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Fin.val_mul, ih, Nat.mul_mod_mod, Nat.pow_succ,
      Nat.mul_comm]

Foundations.Logic.FO.shiftedC_iff:
/-- The shifted-context test, decoded. -/
theorem shiftedC_iff {q c : Nat} {Δ : List (Formula Arith)} (hΔ : qD q = ccode Δ) :

  simp only [shiftedC, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, ballLt_iff, fst_pair, snd_pair, hΔ,
    llen_ccode]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlen, h⟩
    exact ccode_map_shift Δ c hlen fun i hi => h i hi
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨by simp [llen_ccode], fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rw [lnth_ccode _ _ (by simpa using hi), lnth_ccode _ _ hi]; simp [shiftC_fcode]

  obtain ⟨c, hc, hinf⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole 2 (fun i => (f i).toNat)
    (fun i => by cases f i <;> decide)
  refine ⟨c == 1, fun N => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := hinf N

Foundations.Algebra.legendre_cases:
/-- The Legendre symbol of a number prime to `p` is `±1`. -/
theorem legendre_cases (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) {a : Nat} (ha : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    (legendre a p = 1 ∧ a ^ half p % p = 1) ∨ (legendre a p = -1 ∧ a ^ half p % p = p - 1) := by
  classical
  have he := euler_criterion hp hodd ha
  have hl := legendre_eq_of_pow hp hodd ha
  by_cases hq : IsQR a p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he; exact Or.inl ⟨hl.1 he, he⟩
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte] at he; exact Or.inr ⟨hl.2 he, he⟩
Foundations.Algebra.commutator_fix_of_co:
/-- **Commuting on `x` makes the commutator fix `x`.** If `a⁻¹` and `b⁻¹` commute on `x`, then
`[a, b] = a b a⁻¹ b⁻¹` fixes `x`. -/
theorem commutator_fix_of_commute {F M : Subfield Ω} (a b : FieldAut F M) (x : M)
    (h : (a⁻¹).toFun ((b⁻¹).toFun x) = (b⁻¹).toFun ((a⁻¹).toFun x)) :
    (commutator a b).toFun x = x := by
  show a.toFun (b.toFun ((a⁻¹).toFun ((b⁻¹).toFun x))) = x
  rw [h]
  show a.toFun (b.toFun (b.invFun (a.invFun x))) = x
  rw [b.right_inv, a.right_inv]
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.A_rec:
/-- The Wallis recursion for `A`: `(2n + 2) A_{n+1} = (2n + 1) Aₙ`. -/
theorem A_rec (n : Nat) : (2 * (n : R) + 2) * A (n + 1) = (2 * (n : R) + 1) * A n := by
  have := I_rec (2 * n)
  unfold A; rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 by omega]
  have c : ((2 * n : Nat) : R) = 2 * (n : R) := by grind
  rw [c] at this; grind
Foundations.Algebra.Associated.trans:
/-- Associatedness is transitive. -/
theorem Associated.trans {a b c : R} (h1 : Associated a b) (h2 : Associated b c) :
    Associated a c := by
  obtain ⟨u, ⟨u', hu⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨v', hv⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨u * v, ⟨u' * v', ?_⟩, Ring.mul_assoc _ _ _⟩
  calc u * v * (u' * v') = (u * u') * (v * v') := by ac_rfl
    _ = 1 := by rw [hu, hv, Ring.mul_one]
Foundations.Algebra.rpow_mem:

  | n + 1 => M.mul_mem (rpow_mem hx n) hx
Foundations.Categories.map_flatten:
/-- Mapping commutes with flattening. -/
theorem map_flatten {X Y : Type u} (f : X → Y) (L : List (List X)) :
    List.map f L.flatten = (L.map (List.map f)).flatten := by
  induction L with

Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.sat_inducti:
/-- **The induction schema in a model of PA**, for the property defined by `φ` (with
parameters `e`). -/
theorem sat_induction (φ : Formula Arith) (e : Nat → N.Dom) (h0 : Sat N.M (Env.cons 0 e) φ)
    (hs : ∀ x, Sat N.M (Env.cons x e) φ → Sat N.M (Env.cons (x + 1) e) φ) :
    ∀ x, Sat N.M (Env.cons x e) φ := by
  have h := N.isModel.2 _ (PA.induction φ) e
  have hsub : ∀ x : N.Dom, (fun n => (succSubst n).eval N.M (Env.cons x e)) = Env.cons (x + 1) e := by
    intro x; funext n
    cases n with
    | zero => show ms N.M x = x + 1; exact ms_eq x
    | succ n => rfl
  simp only [Sat, sat_inst, sat_subst, hsub, eval_zero_M, mz_eq] at h
  exact h ⟨h0, hs⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.sigma:
/-- The three substitutions needed by the proof rules: `sigma 0 t` instantiates
index `0` by `t` (and lowers the others), `sigma 1 _` shifts all indices up, and
`sigma 2 _` (or larger) is the induction substitution `x ↦ Sx`. -/

/-- `listSubtype` of a repetition-free list is repetition-free. -/
theorem nodup_listSubtype {γ : Type u} (P : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (l : List γ) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    (listSubtype P l).Nodup := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons y l ih =>
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at hl
    unfold listSubtype
    by_cases h : P y
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]

/-- The derivative of `q` is `q'(x) = 5x⁴ - 6`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_quinticR (x : R) : HasDerivAt quinticR (5 * x ^ 4 - 6) x := by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_pow 4 x).sub ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul 6)).add (hasDerivAt_const 3 x)
  have e : (((4 : Nat) : R) + 1) * x ^ 4 - 6 * 1 + 0 = 5 * x ^ 4 - 6 := by grind

Foundations.Numbers.N.mul_right_cancel:
/-- **Cancellation for multiplication.** If `a * c = b * c` and `c ≠ 0` then `a = b`. -/
theorem mul_right_cancel {a b c : N} (hc : c ≠ zero) (h : a * c = b * c) : a = b := by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_mul] at h
    rcases mul_eq_zero h.symm with h' | h'
    · exact h'.symm
    · exact absurd h' hc
  | succ a ih =>
    cases b with
    | zero =>
      rw [zero_mul, succ_mul] at h
      exact absurd (add_eq_zero h).2 hc
    | succ b =>
      rw [succ_mul, succ_mul] at h
      rw [ih (add_right_cancel h)]

Foundations.Types.STLC.step?_complete:
/-- `step?` finds a reduct whenever there is one. -/
theorem step?_complete {t t' : Term} (h : Step t t') : (step? t).isSome := by
  induction h with
  | beta => simp [step?, lamBody, firstSome]
  | fstPair => simp [step?, pairFst, firstSome]
  | sndPair => simp [step?, pairSnd, firstSome]
  | caseInl => simp [step?, caseRedex, firstSome]
  | caseInr => simp [step?, caseRedex, firstSome]
  | appL _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih))
  | appR _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih))
  | lam _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | pairL _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih)
  | pairR _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | fst _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | snd _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)
  | inl _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | inr _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
  | case₀ _ ih => exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih))
  | case₁ _ ih =>
    exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_left (by simpa using ih)))
  | case₂ _ ih =>
    exact firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (firstSome_isSome_right (by simpa using ih)))
  | absurd _ ih => simpa [step?] using ih
Foundations.Numbers.R.nivenH_vanish:
/-- Niven's polynomial vanishes from degree `2n + 1` on. -/
theorem nivenH_vanish (a b : R) (n : Nat) : Vanish (nivenH a b n) (2 * n + 1) := fun k hk => by
  unfold nivenH; split
  · exact linPow_vanish a b n (k - n) (by omega)
  · rfl
Foundations.Numbers.R.pi_irrational:
/-- **π is irrational** (Lambert 1761; proof of Niven 1947). There are no integers `p` and
`q > 0` with `π = p / q`. -/
theorem pi_irrational : ¬ ∃ p : Int, ∃ q : Nat, 0 < q ∧ pi = (p : R) / (q : R) := by
  rintro ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩
  have hπ := pi_pos
  have hb : (0 : R) < (q : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ hq
  have hbP : (q : R) * pi = (p : R) := by rw [hpq]; grind
  have ha : (0 : R) < (p : R) := by rw [← hbP]; exact OrderedRing.mul_pos hb hπ
  -- Notation: `a = p`, `b = q`, and `n` so large that `π (π a)ⁿ / n! < 1`.
  generalize hA : (p : R) = a at ha hbP
  generalize hB : (q : R) = b at hb hbP
  have hai : IsInt a := ⟨p, hA.symm⟩
  have hbi : IsInt b := ⟨q, by rw [← hB]; exact (Ring.intCast_natCast q).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Nat, pi * expTerm (pi * a) n < 1 := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := tendsto_expTerm_zero (pi * a) (1 / pi) (div_pos (by grind) hπ)
    have := abs_lt.1 (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    have k := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind : expTerm (pi * a) N < 1 / pi) hπ
    have : pi * (1 / pi) = 1 := by grind
    grind
  let d := 2 * n + 1
  let c := nivenC a b n
  let f : R → R := fun x => poly c d x
  let h : R → R := fun x => f x * sin x
  have hfd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (poly (pderiv c) d x) x := fun x =>
    hasDerivAt_poly' (nivenC_vanish a b n) x
  have hcont : ∀ x, ContinuousAt h x := fun x => ((hfd x).mul (hasDerivAt_sin x)).continuousAt
  -- The integral `∫₀^π f sin` equals `F(π) + F(0) = 2 F(0)`, an even integer.
  let G : R → R := fun x => nivenF a b n 1 x * sin x - nivenF a b n 0 x * cos x
  have hG : ∀ x, HasDerivAt G (h x) x := fun x => by
    have := ((hasDerivAt_nivenF a b n 1 x).mul (hasDerivAt_sin x)).sub
      ((hasDerivAt_nivenF a b n 0 x).mul (hasDerivAt_cos x))
    have e : nivenF a b n (1 + 1) x * sin x + nivenF a b n 1 x * cos x -
        (nivenF a b n (0 + 1) x * cos x + nivenF a b n 0 x * -sin x) = h x := by
      have := nivenF_two_add a b n x
      show _ = poly c d x * sin x
      rw [← this]; grind
    rw [e] at this; exact this
  have hI : integral h 0 pi = G pi - G 0 :=
    integral_eq_sub (Std.le_of_lt hπ) (fun t _ _ => hG t) (fun t _ _ => hcont t)
  have hrefl := poly_reflect (nivenC_vanish a b n) pi (poly_nivenC_reflect hbP n)
  have hFπ : nivenF a b n 0 pi = nivenF a b n 0 0 := by
    unfold nivenF
    apply fsum_congr; intro j _
    have := hrefl (2 * j + 0) 0
    rw [show pi - 0 = pi by grind, Nat.add_zero, neg_one_pow_two_mul] at this
    rw [Nat.add_zero, this]; grind
  have hF0 : IsInt (nivenF a b n 0 0) := isInt_fsum (fun j => (isInt_neg_one_pow j).mul (by
    show IsInt (poly (iterD (2 * j + 0) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) 0)
    rw [poly_zero]; exact iterD_nivenC_isInt hai hbi n _)) (n + 1)
  have hIval : integral h 0 pi = 2 * nivenF a b n 0 0 := by
    rw [hI]; show nivenF a b n 1 pi * sin pi - nivenF a b n 0 pi * cos pi -
      (nivenF a b n 1 0 * sin 0 - nivenF a b n 0 0 * cos 0) = _
    rw [sin_pi, cos_pi, sin_zero, cos_zero, hFπ]; grind
  -- Pointwise bounds: `0 < f sin` on `(0, π)` and `f sin ≤ (π a)ⁿ / n!` on `[0, π]`.
  have hfval : ∀ x, f x = x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n / (fact n : R) := fun x => poly_nivenC a b x n
  have hfpos : ∀ x, 0 < x → x < pi → 0 < h x := fun x h0 h1 => by
    show 0 < f x * sin x
    rw [hfval]
    have k1 := pow_pos' h0 n
    have hbx : b * x < b * pi := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 hb
    have k2 := pow_pos' (by grind : 0 < a - b * x) n
    exact OrderedRing.mul_pos (div_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos k1 k2) (fact_pos' n))
      (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h0 h1)
  have hfle : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ pi → h x ≤ expTerm (pi * a) n := fun x h0 h1 => by
    show f x * sin x ≤ _
    rw [hfval]
    have hbx : b * x ≤ b * pi := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Std.le_of_lt hb)
    have hbx0 : 0 ≤ b * x := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hb) h0
    have k1 := pow_le_pow_left h0 h1 n
    have k2 := pow_le_pow_left (by grind : 0 ≤ a - b * x) (by grind : a - b * x ≤ a) n
    have p1 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg h0 n
    have p2 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (by grind : 0 ≤ a - b * x) n
    have p3 := pow_le_pow_left.pow_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hπ) n
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k1 p2
    have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 p3
    have hinv := Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (fact_pos' n))
    have k5 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Std.le_trans k3 k4) hinv
    have hfx : 0 ≤ x ^ n * (a - b * x) ^ n / (fact n : R) := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg p1 p2) hinv
    have k6 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sin_le_one x) hfx
    unfold expTerm
    rw [mul_pow']
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hfx k6 ⊢
    grind
  -- Lower bound: on `[π/4, 3π/4]` the integrand is at least its (positive) minimum.
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2, hmin⟩ := extreme_value (f := fun x => 0 - h x) (a := pi / 4)
    (b := 3 * pi / 4) (by grind) (fun x _ _ => continuousAt_sub (continuousAt_const 0 x) (hcont x))
  have hmin' : ∀ x, pi / 4 ≤ x → x ≤ 3 * pi / 4 → h m ≤ h x := fun x h1 h2 => by
    have : 0 - h x ≤ 0 - h m := hmin x h1 h2
    grind
  have hm0 : 0 < h m := hfpos m (by grind) (by grind)
  have hnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ pi → 0 ≤ h t := fun t h1 h2 => by
    rcases (by grind : t = 0 ∨ t = pi ∨ (0 < t ∧ t < pi)) with e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩
    · show 0 ≤ f t * sin t; rw [e, sin_zero]; grind
    · show 0 ≤ f t * sin t; rw [e, sin_pi]; grind
    · exact Std.le_of_lt (hfpos t e1 e2)
  have hc : ∀ u v : R, ∀ x, u ≤ x → x ≤ v → ContinuousAt h x := fun _ _ x _ _ => hcont x
  have I1 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind) (hasIntegral_const 0 (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ pi / 4))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ pi / 4) (hc 0 (pi / 4)))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hnn t h1 (by grind))
  have I2 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind)
    (hasIntegral_const (h m) (by grind : pi / 4 ≤ 3 * pi / 4))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : pi / 4 ≤ 3 * pi / 4) (hc (pi / 4) (3 * pi / 4)))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hmin' t h1 h2)
  have I3 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind) (hasIntegral_const 0 (by grind : 3 * pi / 4 ≤ pi))
    (hasIntegral_integral (by grind : 3 * pi / 4 ≤ pi) (hc (3 * pi / 4) pi))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hnn t (by grind) h2)
  have I4 := HasIntegral.mono (by grind)
    (hasIntegral_integral (Std.le_of_lt hπ) (hc 0 pi))
    (hasIntegral_const (expTerm (pi * a) n) (Std.le_of_lt hπ))
    (fun t h1 h2 => hfle t h1 h2)
  have A1 := integral_add_interval (f := h) (a := 0) (u := 3 * pi / 4) (v := pi) (by grind) (by grind)
    (hc 0 pi)
  have A2 := integral_add_interval (f := h) (a := 0) (u := pi / 4) (v := 3 * pi / 4) (by grind)
    (by grind) (hc 0 (3 * pi / 4))
  have hpos : 0 < integral h 0 pi := by
    have := OrderedRing.mul_pos hm0 (by grind : (0 : R) < 3 * pi / 4 - pi / 4)
    grind
  have hlt : integral h 0 pi < 1 := by grind
  -- So `2 F(0)` is an integer strictly between `0` and `1`.
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hF0
  rw [hIval, hz] at hpos hlt
  have z1 : ((0 : Int) : R) < ((2 * z : Int) : R) := by grind
  have z2 : ((2 * z : Int) : R) < ((1 : Int) : R) := by grind
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z1
  have := (intCast_lt (K := R)).1 z2
  omega

Foundations.Algebra.finDim_of_no_indep:
/-- **A bound on independent families gives finite dimension.** If no `n + 1` vectors are
linearly independent, then `V` is finite-dimensional of dimension at most `n`. -/
theorem finDim_of_no_indep (hF : IsField K) (n : Nat) (h : ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → V, LinIndep K u) :
    FinDim K V ∧ dim K V ≤ n := by
  have hex : ∃ m, ¬ ∃ u : Fin (m + 1) → V, LinIndep K u := ⟨n, h⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ := FiniteType.exists_least _ hex
  have hfam : ∃ u : Fin m → V, LinIndep K u := by
    rcases m with _ | k
    · exact ⟨fun i => absurd i.isLt (Nat.not_lt_zero _), linIndep_empty _⟩
    · exact Classical.byContradiction fun hno => hmin k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hno
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfam
  have hspan : Spans K u := fun x =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hx => hm ⟨_, linIndep_tcons hF hu hx⟩
  have hfin := finDim_of_spans hspan
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h1 := dim_le_card hF hfin hspan
  rw [card_fin] at h1
  have h2 : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => hmin n hlt h
  omega

Foundations.Combinatorics.ramsey_theorem:
/-- **The finite Ramsey theorem.** For all `s, t`, every symmetric 2-colouring of the
pairs of a set of `ramsey s t` vertices contains a red `s`-clique or a blue
`t`-clique. -/
theorem ramsey_theorem : ∀ s t, IsRamsey s t (ramsey s t)
  | 0, t => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_zero_left t
  | _ + 1, 0 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_zero_right _
  | 1, t + 1 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_one_left (t + 1)
  | s + 2, 1 => by rw [ramsey]; exact isRamsey_one_right (s + 2)
  | s + 2, t + 2 => by
      rw [ramsey]
      exact ramsey_step (ramsey_theorem (s + 1) (t + 2)) (ramsey_theorem (s + 2) (t + 1))
        (by have : 1 ≤ ramsey (s + 1) (t + 2) := ramsey_pos s (t + 1); omega)

  | one : Closure S 1
  | mul {x y : G} : Closure S x → Closure S y → Closure S (x * y)
  | inv {x : G} : Closure S x → Closure S x⁻¹

/-- `x ∈ gH` iff `x = g * h` for some `h ∈ H`. -/
theorem leftCoset_iff (g : G) (H : Subgroup G) (x : G) :
    leftCoset g H x ↔ ∃ h, h ∈ H ∧ g * h = x := by
  constructor
  · intro hx; exact ⟨g⁻¹ * x, hx, mul_inv_cancel_left g x⟩
  · intro ⟨h, hh, hx⟩
    show g⁻¹ * x ∈ H
    rw [← hx, inv_mul_cancel_left]; exact hh
Foundations.Algebra.fin_isField_iff_prim:
/-- **`ℤ/nℤ` is a field iff `n` is prime.** In `Fin n` (with arithmetic modulo `n`), every
non-zero element is invertible exactly when `n` is a prime number. For primes, the inverse
of `a` is `a ^ (p - 2)`, by Fermat's little theorem; for composite `n = d * e`, the
residue `d` is a zero divisor and cannot be invertible. -/
theorem fin_isField_iff_prime (n : Nat) [NeZero n] : IsField (Fin n) ↔ IsPrime n := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := NeZero.ne n
  have zero_val : ((0 : Fin n)).val = 0 := Fin.val_ofNat n 0 ▸ Nat.zero_mod n
  have one_val : ((1 : Fin n)).val = 1 % n := Fin.val_ofNat n 1
  constructor
  · intro ⟨h01, hinv⟩
    have h2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hlt
      have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
      apply h01
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [zero_val, one_val, hn1]
    refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
    intro d hd
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hd; exact hn0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd hd)
    have hdle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hd
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
    have hdn : d < n := by omega
    have he0 : 0 < e := by
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro h; rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at he; exact hn0 he
    have hen : e < n := by
      have : 2 * e ≤ d * e := Nat.mul_le_mul_right e hd2
      omega
    let a : Fin n := ⟨d, hdn⟩
    let x : Fin n := ⟨e, hen⟩
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; rw [zero_val] at this; exact hd0 this
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hinv a ha0
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_mul, zero_val]
      show e * d % n = 0
      rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← he, Nat.mod_self]
    have hx : x = 0 := by
      calc x = x * 1 := (Ring.mul_one x).symm
        _ = x * (a * b) := by rw [hb]
        _ = x * a * b := (Ring.mul_assoc x a b).symm
        _ = 0 * b := by rw [hxa]
        _ = 0 := Ring.zero_mul b
    have := congrArg Fin.val hx
    rw [zero_val] at this
    exact absurd this (by show e ≠ 0; omega)
  · intro hp
    have h2 := hp.1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      rw [zero_val, one_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at this
      exact absurd this (by omega)
    · intro a ha
      have ha0 : a.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply ha; apply Fin.ext; rw [h, zero_val]
      have hndvd : ¬ n ∣ a.val := fun h => ha0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h a.isLt)
      refine ⟨Fin.ofNat n (a.val ^ (n - 2)), ?_⟩
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_mul, Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mul_mod_mod, one_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
      have : a.val * a.val ^ (n - 2) = a.val ^ (n - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
      rw [this]
      exact fermat n a.val hp hndvd

Foundations.Bridges.El_preserves_product:
/-- **`El` preserves binary products**: the members of `X × Y`, with the projections,
form a product of the member types in the category of types. -/
noncomputable def El_preserves_product (X Y : ZFCat) :
    IsProduct (C := Type 1) (El.obj X) (El.obj Y) (El.obj (zfProd X Y))
      (El.map (zfFst X Y)) (El.map (zfSnd X Y)) where
  lift f g w := ⟨⟪(f w).1, (g w).1⟫, kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨(f w).2, (g w).2⟩⟩
  fac₁ f g := funext fun w => Subtype.ext
    ((app_zfFst (kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨(f w).2, (g w).2⟩)).trans (pfst_kpair _ _))
  fac₂ f g := funext fun w => Subtype.ext
    ((app_zfSnd (kpair_mem_prod.2 ⟨(f w).2, (g w).2⟩)).trans (psnd_kpair _ _))
  uniq f g h h₁ h₂ := funext fun w => Subtype.ext (by
    have hm : (h w).1 ∈ prod X.set Y.set := (h w).2
    have e₁ : app (zfFst X Y).1 (h w).1 = (f w).1 := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h₁ w)
    have e₂ : app (zfSnd X Y).1 (h w).1 = (g w).1 := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h₂ w)
    rw [app_zfFst hm] at e₁
    rw [app_zfSnd hm] at e₂
    exact (eq_kpair_of_mem_prod hm).trans (by rw [e₁, e₂]))
Foundations.NumberTheory.log_ineq_of_pow:
/-- From `aᵏ ≤ bˡ` in `ℕ` (with `a, b > 0`) to `k log a ≤ l log b` in `R`. -/
theorem log_ineq_of_pow_le {a b k l : Nat} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : a ^ k ≤ b ^ l) :
    (k : R) * R.log a ≤ (l : R) * R.log b := by
  have hcast : ((a ^ k : Nat) : R) ≤ ((b ^ l : Nat) : R) := natCast_le' h
  have ea : ((a ^ k : Nat) : R) = (a : R) ^ k := by grind
  have eb : ((b ^ l : Nat) : R) = (b : R) ^ l := by grind
  rw [ea, eb] at hcast
  obtain ⟨hpa, hla⟩ := pow_pos_and_log_pow (natCast_pos' ha) k
  obtain ⟨_, hlb⟩ := pow_pos_and_log_pow (natCast_pos' hb) l
  rw [← hla, ← hlb]
  exact log_le_log hpa hcast

/-- Finite sums are additive. -/
theorem fsum_add (a b : Nat → R) (n : Nat) :
    fsum (fun k => a k + b k) n = fsum a n + fsum b n := by
  induction n with

Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.code_inj:
/-- Coding is injective on `A ∪ B`. -/
theorem code_inj (he : Function.Injective e) {x y : α} (hx : dom' M g x) (hy : dom' M g y)
    (h : code M g x = code M g y) : x = y := by
  have hs := sigma_injective M he
  by_cases ax : M.dom x <;> by_cases ay : M.dom y
  · simp only [code, ax, ay, ↓reduceDIte] at h
    have := hs h
    simp only [Sum.inl.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
    exact this
  · have hy' := hy.resolve_left ay
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hy', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    exact absurd (hs h) (by intro h; cases h)
  · have hx' := hx.resolve_left ax
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hx', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    exact absurd (hs h) (by intro h; cases h)
  · have hx' := hx.resolve_left ax
    have hy' := hy.resolve_left ay
    simp only [code, ax, ay, hx', hy', ↓reduceDIte] at h
    have := hs h
    simp only [Sum.inr.injEq] at this
    rw [← Classical.choose_spec hx', ← Classical.choose_spec hy', this]
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.col_cross:
/-- In the Klein model, collinear points have vanishing cross product. -/
theorem Klein.col_cross {a b c : Klein.KPt} (h : kleinNeutral.Col a b c) :
    (b.1.x - a.1.x) * (c.1.y - a.1.y) - (b.1.y - a.1.y) * (c.1.x - a.1.x) = 0 := by
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · exact Pt.cross_of_bet h
  · have := Pt.cross_of_bet (show Pt.Bet b.1 c.1 a.1 from h); grind
  · have := Pt.cross_of_bet (show Pt.Bet c.1 a.1 b.1 from h); grind
Foundations.Sets.Zorn.succChain_super:
/-- If a chain has a strictly bigger chain, `succChain` produces one. -/
theorem succChain_super {c : α → Prop} (hc : IsChain r c) (h : ∃ d, SuperChain r c d) :

  have h' : ∃ d, IsChain r c ∧ SuperChain r c d := let ⟨d, hd⟩ := h; ⟨d, hc, hd⟩

  simp only [h', ↓reduceDIte]

Foundations.Types.STLC.rename:
/-- Renaming free variables. -/
def rename (ξ : Nat → Nat) : Term → Term
  | var n => var (ξ n)
  | app t u => app (rename ξ t) (rename ξ u)
  | lam t => lam (rename (upRen ξ) t)
  | pair a b => pair (rename ξ a) (rename ξ b)
  | fst t => fst (rename ξ t)
  | snd t => snd (rename ξ t)
  | inl t => inl (rename ξ t)
  | inr t => inr (rename ξ t)
  | case t u₁ u₂ => case (rename ξ t) (rename (upRen ξ) u₁) (rename (upRen ξ) u₂)
  | .absurd t => .absurd (rename ξ t)
Foundations.Algebra.InS.facts:
/-- Facts about points of Zagier's set when `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)` is prime: all coordinates are
positive, and the boundary cases `x = y - z` and `x = 2y` do not occur. -/
theorem InS.facts (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {x y z : Nat} (h : InS p (x, y, z)) :
    0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z ∧ x + z ≠ y ∧ x ≠ 2 * y := by
  unfold InS at h
  simp only at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hx; subst hx
    have : p = 4 * (y * z) := by grind
    omega
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hy; subst hy
    exact not_prime_square (x := x) (by rw [show x * x = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; intro hz; subst hz
    exact not_prime_square (x := x) (by rw [show x * x = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · intro hxy
    subst hxy
    exact not_prime_square (x := x + 2 * z) (by rw [show (x + 2 * z) * (x + 2 * z) = p by grind]; exact hp)
  · intro hx; subst hx
    have : p = 4 * (y * y + y * z) := by grind
    omega

Foundations.Algebra.linIndep_tcons:
/-- Adding a vector outside the span keeps a family independent. -/
theorem linIndep_tcons (hF : IsField K) {n : Nat} {u : Fin n → V} (hu : LinIndep K u) {x : V}
    (hx : ¬ InSpan K u x) : LinIndep K (tcons x u) := by
  intro c hc
  rw [isum_fin_succ] at hc
  have hc' : c 0 • x + isum (fun j : Fin n => c j.succ • u j) = 0 := hc
  have h0 : c 0 = 0 := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hF.2 _ hne
    apply hx
    refine ⟨fun j => -(t * c j.succ), ?_⟩
    have e := congrArg (fun z => t • z) (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero (Eq.trans (add_comm _ _) hc'))
    rw [← mul_smul, CommRing.mul_comm, ht, one_smul] at e
    rw [e, smul_neg, smul_isum, ← isum_neg]
    congr 1; funext j
    show -(t • c j.succ • u j) = (-(t * c j.succ)) • u j
    rw [neg_smul, mul_smul]
  have hrest := hu (fun j => c j.succ) (by rw [h0, zero_smul, zero_add] at hc'; exact hc')
  intro j
  cases j using Fin.cases with
  | zero => exact h0
  | succ j => exact hrest j

/-- The values of a 3-cycle. -/
theorem c3_apply {n : Nat} {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) (x : Fin n) :
    c3 a b c x = if x = a then b else if x = b then c else if x = c then a else x := by
  show swap a b (swap b c x) = _
  simp only [swap_apply]
  by_cases h1 : x = a
  · subst h1; simp [hab, hac]
  · by_cases h2 : x = b
    · subst h2; simp [Ne.symm hab, Ne.symm hbc, Ne.symm hac]
    · by_cases h3 : x = c
      · subst h3; simp [h1, h2]
      · simp [h1, h2, h3]

/-- Erasure commutes with renaming (for a renaming tracked by an index map `ξ`). -/
theorem erase_rename {Γ Δ : List FTy} {A : FTy} (t : Tm Γ A) (ρ : Ren Γ Δ) (ξ : Nat → Nat)
    (h : ∀ {B : FTy} (v : Mem B Γ), (ρ v).idx = ξ v.idx) :
    erase (rename ρ t) = Foundations.Types.STLC.rename ξ (erase t) := by
  induction t generalizing Δ ξ with
  | var v => exact congrArg Term.var (h v)
  | lam t ih =>
    refine congrArg Term.lam (ih ρ.lift _ fun v => ?_)
    cases v with
    | here => rfl
    | there w => exact congrArg (· + 1) (h w)
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    show Term.app _ _ = Term.app _ _
    rw [ih₁ ρ ξ h, ih₂ ρ ξ h]
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    show Term.pair _ _ = Term.pair _ _
    rw [ih₁ ρ ξ h, ih₂ ρ ξ h]
  | fst _ ih => exact congrArg Term.fst (ih ρ ξ h)
  | snd _ ih => exact congrArg Term.snd (ih ρ ξ h)

/-- Below a non-negative `r` with `r² < 2` there is room: some `r' > r` still has `r'² < 2`. -/
theorem exists_above_of_sq_lt_two {r : K} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : r * r < 2) :
    ∃ r', r < r' ∧ r' * r' < 2 := by
  have hd : (0 : K) < 2 * r + 3 := by grind
  have hd' : 2 * r + 3 ≠ 0 := by grind
  obtain ⟨δ0, δ1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := 2 - r * r) (v := 2 * r + 3) (by grind)
    (by have := sq_nonneg' r; grind) hd
  have hδ : (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3) * (2 * r + 3) = 2 - r * r := by grind
  have hδpos : 0 < (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3) := by
    rcases Std.le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 δ0 with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · rw [← h'] at hδ; grind
  have hsq := mul_le_of_le_one δ1 δ0
  refine ⟨r + (2 - r * r) / (2 * r + 3), by grind, ?_⟩
  grind

/-- **Extension along `K ⊆ K(x)`.** Every ring homomorphism `σ : K → ℂ` extends to

theorem extend_adj (K : Subfield ℂ) (x : ℂ) (σ : RingHom K ℂ) :
    ∃ τ : RingHom (adj K x) ℂ, ∀ y : K, τ.toFun ⟨y.1, le_adj K x _ y.2⟩ = σ.toFun y := by
  by_cases h : IsAlgebraic K x
  · obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_root_C C.isField K x h σ
    obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀, _, _⟩ := extend C.isField K x h σ δ hδ
    have hle : (adj K x).le (adjoin C.isField K x h) := by rw [adj_of_alg h]; exact le_refl _
    exact ⟨τ₀.comp (Subfield.inclusion hle), fun y => hτ₀ y⟩

Foundations.Algebra.legendre_two:
/-- **The second supplement** to quadratic reciprocity: `(2/p) = (-1)^((p²-1)/8)` for an odd
prime `p`. -/
theorem legendre_two {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) :
    legendre 2 p = (-1) ^ ((p * p - 1) / 8) := by
  have h2 := hp.1
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ 2 := fun h => by
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h
    omega
  rw [gauss_lemma hp hodd hnd, gaussMu_two hp hodd, neg_one_pow_int, neg_one_pow_int]
  -- Compare parities by the residue of `p` mod 8.
  have key : (half p - half p / 2) % 2 = (p * p - 1) / 8 % 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ m r, r < 8 ∧ p = 8 * m + r := ⟨p / 8, p % 8, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide), by omega⟩
    unfold half
    have hsq : (8 * m + r) * (8 * m + r) = 64 * (m * m) + 16 * (m * r) + r * r := by grind
    rw [hsq]
    have : r = 1 ∨ r = 3 ∨ r = 5 ∨ r = 7 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> omega
  rw [key]

/-- **Stirling's formula** (de Moivre and Stirling, 1730). `n! / (√(2πn) (n/e)ⁿ) → 1`. -/
theorem stirling : Tendsto (fun n => (fact (n + 1) : R) /
    (sqrt (2 * pi * ((n : R) + 1)) * (((n : R) + 1) / e) ^ (n + 1))) 1 := by

Foundations.Combinatorics.infOften_split:
/-- If `A` is infinite, then for any vertex `x` and colouring of the vertices, the
elements of `A` above `x` of one of the two colours form an infinite set. -/
theorem infOften_split {A : Nat → Prop} (hA : InfOften A) (x : Nat) (col : Nat → Bool) :
    InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = true) ∨
      InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = false) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  have bound : ∀ b : Bool, ¬ InfOften (fun y => A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = b) →
      ∃ N, ∀ y, N ≤ y → ¬ (A y ∧ x < y ∧ col y = b) := fun b hb =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hc => hb fun N =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hc' => hc ⟨N, fun y hy he => hc' ⟨y, hy, he⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := bound true fun h => hno (Or.inl h)
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := bound false fun h => hno (Or.inr h)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hAy⟩ := hA (max (max N₁ N₂) (x + 1))
  cases hc : col y
  · exact h₂ y (by omega) ⟨hAy, by omega, hc⟩
  · exact h₁ y (by omega) ⟨hAy, by omega, hc⟩

/-- (A5) **The five-segment axiom** in `K²`, via Stewart's relation. -/
theorem five_segment (a b c d a' b' c' d' : Pt K) (hab : a ≠ b) (h₁ : Bet a b c)
    (h₂ : Bet a' b' c') (e₁ : Cong a b a' b') (e₂ : Cong b c b' c') (e₃ : Cong a d a' d')
    (e₄ : Cong b d b' d') : Cong c d c' d' := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, hx, hy⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨s, s0, s1, hx', hy'⟩ := h₂
  unfold Cong at *
  have l₁ := d2_left hx hy
  have l₂ := d2_left hx' hy'
  have r₁ := d2_right hx hy
  have r₂ := d2_right hx' hy'
  have st₁ := stewart (d := d) hx hy
  have st₂ := stewart (d := d') hx' hy'
  have D0 := d2_nonneg a c
  have D0' := d2_nonneg a' c'
  -- the "geometric mean" `t (1−t) |ac|²` is determined by `|ab|²` and `|bc|²`
  have p0 : 0 ≤ t * (1 - t) * d2 a c :=
    OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t0 (by grind)) D0
  have p0' : 0 ≤ s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c' :=
    OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg s0 (by grind)) D0'
  have psq : (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) =
      (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') := by
    have e : (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) = d2 a b * d2 b c := by
      rw [l₁, r₁]; grind
    have e' : (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') = d2 a' b' * d2 b' c' := by
      rw [l₂, r₂]; grind
    rw [e, e', e₁, e₂]
  have peq := eq_of_sq_eq p0 p0' psq
  -- hence `|ac|² = |a'c'|²`
  have hD : d2 a c = d2 a' c' := by
    have u : d2 a c = d2 a b + 2 * (t * (1 - t) * d2 a c) + d2 b c := by rw [l₁, r₁]; grind
    have u' : d2 a' c' = d2 a' b' + 2 * (s * (1 - s) * d2 a' c') + d2 b' c' := by
      rw [l₂, r₂]; grind
    rw [u, u', e₁, e₂, peq]
  -- and `t = s`
  have hab' : 0 < d2 a b := d2_pos hab
  have hDpos : d2 a c ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at l₁; grind
  have hts : t = s := by
    apply eq_of_sq_eq t0 s0
    have : t * t * d2 a c = s * s * d2 a c := by rw [← l₁, e₁, l₂, hD]
    grind
  subst hts
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at l₁; grind
  have key : t * d2 c d = t * d2 c' d' := by grind
  grind

Foundations.NumberTheory.not_dvd_central:
/-- **Erdős's key observation.** For `n ≥ 3`, a prime `p` with `2n/3 < p ≤ n` does not divide
`C(2n, n)`: it occurs exactly twice in `(2n)!` and once in each factor `n!`. -/
theorem not_dvd_centralBinom {p n : Nat} (hp : Prime p) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hpn : p ≤ n)
    (h3 : 2 * n < 3 * p) : ¬ p ∣ centralBinom n := by
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.1
  have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by omega
  have hsq : 2 * n < p ^ 2 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_two]; have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p hp3; omega
  have h1 := vp_centralBinom hp hsq
  have ppos : 0 < p := by omega
  have hd1 : n / p = 1 := by
    have a := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le ppos).2 (show 1 * p ≤ n by omega)
    have b := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul ppos).2 (show n < 2 * p by omega)
    omega
  have hd2 : 2 * n / p = 2 := by
    have a := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le ppos).2 (show 2 * p ≤ 2 * n by omega)
    have b := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul ppos).2 (show 2 * n < 3 * p by omega)
    omega
  have hd3 : n / p ^ 2 = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hd4 : 2 * n / p ^ 2 = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hsq
  simp only [legendreSum, Nat.zero_add, Nat.pow_one, hd1, hd2, hd3, hd4] at h1
  have hv : vp p (centralBinom n) = 0 := by omega
  intro hdvd
  have := (pow_dvd_iff_le_vp (e := 1) hp1 (centralBinom_pos n)).1 (by simpa using hdvd)
  omega
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR_mul:
/-- `ofR` carries multiplication of reals to multiplication of cuts. -/
theorem ofR_mul (x y : R) : ofR (x * y) = ofR x * ofR y := by
  show ofR (x * y) = mul (ofR x) (ofR y)
  unfold mul
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x <;> by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg x).2 hx), ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg y).2 hy)]
    exact ofR_mul_nonneg hx hy
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg x).2 hx), ite_eq_right (fun h => hy ((ofR_nonneg y).1 h))]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg hx (by grind)]
    show _ = -ofR _
    rw [← ofR_neg]; congr 1; grind
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hx ((ofR_nonneg x).1 h)), ite_eq_left ((ofR_nonneg y).2 hy)]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg (by grind) hy]
    show _ = -ofR _
    rw [← ofR_neg]; congr 1; grind
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hx ((ofR_nonneg x).1 h)),
      ite_eq_right (fun h => hy ((ofR_nonneg y).1 h))]
    rw [← ofR_neg, ← ofR_neg, ← ofR_mul_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)]
    congr 1; grind

Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.space_inv:
/-- **Inverses.** Every non-zero element of the space has an inverse in the space:
multiplication by it is an injective linear map of a `3`-dimensional space, hence onto. -/
theorem CubicRoot.space_inv (hΩ : IsField Ω) (C : CubicRoot K α) {β : Ω} (hβ : C.space.carrier β) (hβ0 : β ≠ 0) :
    ∃ γ, C.space.carrier γ ∧ β * γ = 1 := by
  have hF := K.isField hΩ
  obtain ⟨hfin, hdim⟩ := C.dim_space hΩ
  let f : Fin 3 → C.space := fun i => ⟨β * (C.basis i).1, C.space_mul hβ (C.basis i).2⟩
  have hind : LinIndep K f := by
    intro c hc
    apply (C.isBasis hΩ).1 c
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    rw [coe_isum] at h ⊢
    have e : isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) = β * isum (fun i => (c i • C.basis i).1) := by
      rw [isum_mul_left]; congr 1; funext i
      show (c i).1 * (β * (C.basis i).1) = β * ((c i).1 * (C.basis i).1)
      grind
    rw [e] at h
    rcases hΩ.isDomain.2 _ _ h with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 hβ0
    · exact h1
  have hspan := spans_of_card_eq_dim hF hfin hind (by rw [card_fin, hdim])
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan ⟨1, (C.basis 0).2⟩
  refine ⟨(isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).1, (isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).2, ?_⟩
  have h : (1 : Ω) = isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hc; rw [coe_isum] at this; exact this
  calc β * (isum (fun i => c i • C.basis i)).1 = isum (fun i => (c i • f i).1) := by
        rw [coe_isum, isum_mul_left]; congr 1; funext i
        show β * ((c i).1 * (C.basis i).1) = (c i).1 * (β * (C.basis i).1)
        grind
    _ = 1 := h.symm

Foundations.NumberTheory.bprod_le_pow:
/-- If the factors are at most `c` and equal `1` beyond `a`, the product is at most `c^(a+1)`. -/
theorem bprod_le_pow {g : Nat → Nat} {a c : Nat} (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h1 : ∀ i, a < i → g i = 1)
    (hle : ∀ i, g i ≤ c) (B : Nat) : bprod g B ≤ c ^ (a + 1) := by
  have key : ∀ B, bprod g B ≤ c ^ (min B (a + 1)) := by
    intro B
    induction B with
    | zero => simp [bprod]
    | succ B ih =>
      simp only [bprod]
      by_cases hB : B ≤ a
      · rw [show min (B + 1) (a + 1) = min B (a + 1) + 1 by omega, Nat.pow_succ]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul ih (hle B)
      · rw [h1 B (by omega), Nat.mul_one, show min (B + 1) (a + 1) = min B (a + 1) by omega]
        exact ih
  exact Nat.le_trans (key B) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hc (by omega))
Foundations.Algebra.foldFin_bij:
/-- **The folded residues are a rearrangement of `1, …, (p-1)/2`**: `foldFin` is a bijection. -/
theorem foldFin_bij :
    (∀ j k, foldFin hp hodd ha j = foldFin hp hodd ha k → j = k) ∧
    (∀ y, ∃ x, foldFin hp hodd ha x = y) := by
  have inj : ∀ j k, foldFin hp hodd ha j = foldFin hp hodd ha k → j = k := by
    intro j k h
    have e := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [foldFin] at e
    have := fold_bounds hp hodd ha j.isLt
    have := fold_bounds hp hodd ha k.isLt
    exact Fin.ext (fold_inj hp hodd ha j.isLt k.isLt (by omega))
  exact ⟨inj, surjective_of_injective _ inj⟩

  rel a b := ∃ F, C F ∧ F.rel a b
  func a b b' := by
    rintro ⟨F, hF, h⟩ ⟨G, hG, h'⟩
    rcases hC F G hF hG with hle | hle
    · exact G.func a b b' (hle a b h) h'

Foundations.Sets.koenig:
/-- **Kőnig's theorem.** If `κ i < μ i` for every index `i`, then
`Σ i, κ i < Π i, μ i`: the sum injects into the product, but not conversely. -/
theorem koenig {ι : Type u} {κ μ : ι → Type v} (h : ∀ i, CardLT (κ i) (μ i)) :
    CardLT (Σ i, κ i) (∀ i, μ i) := by
  classical
  -- injections `gᵢ : κ i → μ i`, and points `yᵢ` they miss
  have hg : ∀ i, ∃ g : κ i → μ i, Function.Injective g := fun i => (h i).1
  let g : ∀ i, κ i → μ i := fun i => Classical.choose (hg i)
  have ginj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (g i) := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hg i)
  have hy : ∀ i, ∃ y : μ i, ∀ x, g i x ≠ y := fun i =>
    Classical.byContradiction fun hn => not_surjective_of_cardLT (h i) ⟨g i, fun y =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun hy => hn ⟨y, fun x hx => hy ⟨x, hx⟩⟩⟩
  let y : ∀ i, μ i := fun i => Classical.choose (hy i)
  have hymiss : ∀ i x, g i x ≠ y i := fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hy i)
  refine ⟨?_, fun hle => ?_⟩
  · -- `⟨i, x⟩ ↦` the function equal to `gᵢ x` at `i` and to `y` elsewhere
    let F : (Σ i, κ i) → ∀ j, μ j := fun s j => if h : s.1 = j then h ▸ g s.1 s.2 else y j
    refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨i', x'⟩ hF
    have hi := congrFun hF i
    by_cases hii : i' = i
    · subst hii
      simp only [F, ↓reduceDIte] at hi
      rw [ginj _ hi]
    · simp only [F, hii, ↓reduceDIte] at hi
      exact absurd hi (hymiss i x)
  · -- an injection back would give a surjection, contradicting the surjection form
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hle
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_surjective_of_injective he y
    exact koenig_surj (fun i => not_surjective_of_cardLT (h i)) ⟨F, hF⟩

Foundations.Topology.Ascoli.grid_near:
/-- **The grid is a finite `δ`-net**: every `x ∈ [a, b]` lies within `(b − a)/(n + 1)` of a grid
point `a + (b − a)·m/(n + 1)` with `m ≤ n`. -/
theorem grid_near {a b x : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (h1 : a ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ b) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ m, m ≤ n ∧ abs (x - (a + (b - a) * ((m : R) / ((n : R) + 1)))) ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := by
  have hn := Vitali.succ_pos n
  let u : Nat → R := fun j => a + (b - a) * ((j : R) / ((n : R) + 1))
  have hstep : ∀ j : Nat, u (j + 1) = u j + (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := fun j => by
    show a + (b - a) * (((j + 1 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = _
    have : ((j + 1 : Nat) : R) = (j : R) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; show _ = a + (b - a) * ((j : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) + _; grind
  have hend : u (n + 1) = b := by
    show a + (b - a) * (((n + 1 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = b
    have : ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) = (n : R) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  have hd : 0 ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hn))
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := nat_least (fun j => x ≤ u (j + 1)) ⟨n, by rw [hend]; exact h2⟩
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    exact hmin n (by omega) (by rw [hend]; exact h2)
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have : u 0 = a := by show a + (b - a) * (((0 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = a; grind
      show -((b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)) ≤ x - u 0; grind
    · have := hstep 0
      have : u 0 = a := by show a + (b - a) * (((0 : Nat) : R) / ((n : R) + 1)) = a; grind
      show x - u 0 ≤ _; grind
  | succ i =>
    have hi := hmin i (by omega)
    have := hstep (i + 1)
    refine ⟨i + 1, hjn, abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · show -((b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)) ≤ x - u (i + 1); grind
    · show x - u (i + 1) ≤ _; grind

/-- **Non-negative integrable functions.** For `f ≥ 0`, integrability in the two senses agree and
`∫ f = ∫ f dμ` (the integral of a non-negative function). -/
theorem integrable_iff_of_nonneg {f : α → R} (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (Integrable m f ↔ LIntegrable m f) ∧ integral m f = lintegral m f := by
  have e1 : (fun x => pp (f x)) = f := funext fun x => pp_of_nonneg (h0 x)
  have e2 : (fun x => pp (-f x)) = fun _ => 0 := funext fun x => pp_of_nonpos (by have := h0 x; grind)
  refine ⟨⟨fun h => by have := h.pos; rwa [e1] at this,
    fun h => ⟨by rw [e1]; exact h, by rw [e2]; exact (lintegral_zero m).1⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold integral; rw [e1, e2, (lintegral_zero m).2]; grind

instance toCommRing (A : Subring S) : CommRing A where
  add a b := ⟨a.1 + b.1, A.add_mem a.2 b.2⟩
  mul a b := ⟨a.1 * b.1, A.mul_mem a.2 b.2⟩
  neg a := ⟨-a.1, A.neg_mem a.2⟩
  zero := ⟨0, A.zero_mem⟩
  one := ⟨1, A.one_mem⟩
  add_assoc a b c := Subtype.ext (Ring.add_assoc a.1 b.1 c.1)
  add_comm a b := Subtype.ext (Ring.add_comm a.1 b.1)
  zero_add a := Subtype.ext (Ring.zero_add a.1)
  neg_add_cancel a := Subtype.ext (Ring.neg_add_cancel a.1)
  mul_assoc a b c := Subtype.ext (Ring.mul_assoc a.1 b.1 c.1)
  one_mul a := Subtype.ext (Ring.one_mul a.1)
  mul_one a := Subtype.ext (Ring.mul_one a.1)
  left_distrib a b c := Subtype.ext (Ring.left_distrib a.1 b.1 c.1)

Foundations.Algebra.QuotientRing.lift:
/-- **Universal property of the quotient ring.** A ring homomorphism vanishing on `I`
factors through `R ⧸ I`. -/
def lift (f : RingHom R S) (hf : ∀ x, x ∈ I → f.toFun x = 0) : RingHom (QuotientRing I) S where
  toFun := Quotient.lift f.toFun (fun a b (h : -a + b ∈ I) => by
    have := hf _ h
    rw [f.map_add, f.map_neg] at this
    have h2 := congrArg (f.toFun a + ·) this
    simp only [add_neg_cancel_left, add_zero] at h2
    exact h2.symm)
  map_add a b := by
    induction a using Quotient.ind; induction b using Quotient.ind
    exact f.map_add _ _
  map_mul a b := by
    induction a using Quotient.ind; induction b using Quotient.ind
    exact f.map_mul _ _
  map_one := f.map_one

  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy s s' with hs | rfl | hs

Foundations.Numbers.R.bolzano_weierstras:
/-- **Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem.** Every bounded sequence of reals has a convergent
subsequence. -/
theorem bolzano_weierstrass {a : Nat → R} (hbdd : ∃ B, ∀ n, abs (a n) ≤ B) :
    ∃ φ : Nat → Nat, (∀ k, φ k < φ (k + 1)) ∧ ∃ L, Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k)) L := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd
  -- `S` = the values exceeded by the sequence infinitely often; `L = sup S` (the limsup).
  let S : R → Prop := fun x => ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ x ≤ a n
  have hS : S (-B) := fun N => ⟨N, Nat.le_refl _, by have := abs_le.1 (hB N); grind⟩
  have hSb : ∀ x, S x → x ≤ B := fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := hx 0; have := abs_le.1 (hB n); grind
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub S ⟨_, hS⟩ ⟨B, hSb⟩
  refine ⟨_, (exists_subseq_tendsto (L := L) ?_).choose_spec.1,
    L, (exists_subseq_tendsto (L := L) ?_).choose_spec.2⟩ <;>
  · intro ε hε N
    -- Some value above `L − ε` is exceeded infinitely often...
    have h1 : ∃ x, S x ∧ L - ε < x := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
      have := hL2 (L - ε) fun x hx => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨x, hx, by grind⟩
      grind
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxL⟩ := h1
    -- ...while `L + ε/2` is exceeded only finitely often.
    have h2 : ∃ N₀, ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → a n < L + ε / 2 := by
      have : ¬ S (L + ε / 2) := fun h => by have := hL1 _ h; grind
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno; apply this; intro M
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hM
      exact hno ⟨M, fun n hn => by
        apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hM ⟨n, hn, by grind⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h2
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩ := hx (max N N₀)
    exact ⟨n, by omega, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by have := hN₀ n (by omega); grind⟩⟩

Foundations.Types.SystemF.step?_sound:
/-- `step?` only returns genuine reducts. -/
theorem step?_sound : ∀ (t t' : Term), step? t = some t' → Step t t' := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | var n => intro t' h; simp [step?] at h
  | app t u iht ihu =>
    intro x h
    simp only [step?] at h
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
      cases t <;> simp [lamBody] at hs
      subst hs
      exact Step.beta _ _
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.appL (iht _ ht)
    · obtain ⟨u', hu, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.appR (ihu _ hu)
  | lam t ih =>
    intro x h
    obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.lam (ih _ ht)
  | tlam t ih =>
    intro x h
    obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.tlam (ih _ ht)
  | tapp t B ih =>
    intro x h
    simp only [step?] at h
    rcases firstSome_eq_some h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
      cases t <;> simp [tlamBody] at hs
      subst hs
      exact Step.tbeta _ _
    · obtain ⟨t', ht, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h; exact Step.tapp (ih _ ht)
