Foundations.Algebra.parity_mul:
/-- **The parity is a homomorphism**: `parity (στ) = parity σ + parity τ`. -/
theorem parity_mul {n : Nat} (σ τ : Perm (Fin n)) : parity (σ * τ) = parity σ + parity τ := by
  -- `f x y` is symmetric for distinct `x`, `y`.
  let f : Fin n → Fin n → Bool := fun x y => inv (σ x) (σ y) + inv x y
  have hf : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → f x y = f y x := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hσ : σ x ≠ σ y := fun h => hxy (σ.injective h)
    show inv (σ x) (σ y) + inv x y = inv (σ y) (σ x) + inv y x
    rw [inv_swap hσ, inv_swap hxy]
    cases inv (σ x) (σ y) <;> cases inv x y <;> rfl
  -- `τ` permutes the pairs.
  have hne : ∀ p : Pairs n, τ p.1.1 ≠ τ p.1.2 := fun p h =>
    absurd (τ.injective h ▸ p.2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  let φ : Pairs n → Pairs n := fun p =>
    if h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2 then ⟨(τ p.1.1, τ p.1.2), h⟩
    else ⟨(τ p.1.2, τ p.1.1), by
      have := hne p
      have hv : (τ p.1.1).val ≠ (τ p.1.2).val := fun e => this (Fin.ext e)
      show (τ p.1.2).val < (τ p.1.1).val
      have : ¬ (τ p.1.1).val < (τ p.1.2).val := h
      omega⟩
  have hφ : ∀ p, f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) = f (φ p).1.1 (φ p).1.2 := by
    intro p
    by_cases h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2
    · simp only [φ, h, ↓reduceDIte]
    · simp only [φ, h, ↓reduceDIte]; exact hf _ _ (hne p)
  have hφ_val : ∀ p, ((φ p).1.1 = τ p.1.1 ∧ (φ p).1.2 = τ p.1.2) ∨
      ((φ p).1.1 = τ p.1.2 ∧ (φ p).1.2 = τ p.1.1) := by
    intro p
    by_cases h : τ p.1.1 < τ p.1.2
    · left; simp [φ, h]
    · right; simp [φ, h]
  have lt_asymm : ∀ {a b : Fin n}, a < b → b < a → False := fun h1 h2 =>
    absurd (Nat.lt_trans h1 h2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  have hinj : ∀ p q, φ p = φ q → p = q := by
    intro p q hpq
    have e1 : (φ p).1.1 = (φ q).1.1 := by rw [hpq]
    have e2 : (φ p).1.2 = (φ q).1.2 := by rw [hpq]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases hφ_val p with ⟨a1, a2⟩ | ⟨a1, a2⟩ <;> rcases hφ_val q with ⟨b1, b2⟩ | ⟨b1, b2⟩
    · exact Prod.ext (τ.injective (by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])) (τ.injective (by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2]))
    · have h1 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.1 = τ q.1.2 by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])
      have h2 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.2 = τ q.1.1 by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])
      exact absurd (h1 ▸ h2 ▸ p.2) (fun h => lt_asymm h q.2)
    · have h1 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.2 = τ q.1.1 by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1])
      have h2 := τ.injective (show τ p.1.1 = τ q.1.2 by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])
      exact absurd (h1 ▸ h2 ▸ p.2) (fun h => lt_asymm h q.2)
    · exact Prod.ext (τ.injective (by rw [← a2, ← b2, e2])) (τ.injective (by rw [← a1, ← b1, e1]))
  have hsurj : ∀ q, ∃ p, φ p = q := by
    intro q
    let x := τ.invFun q.1.1
    let y := τ.invFun q.1.2
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun h => absurd (by
      have := congrArg τ.toFun h; simp only [x, y] at this
      rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv] at this; exact this ▸ q.2) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
    have hv : x.val ≠ y.val := fun e => hxy (Fin.ext e)
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hv with hl | hl
    · refine ⟨⟨(x, y), hl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hlt : τ x < τ y := by
        show (τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.1)) < τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.2)
        rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv]; exact q.2
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [φ, hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact Prod.ext (τ.right_inv _) (τ.right_inv _)
    · refine ⟨⟨(y, x), hl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hlt : ¬ τ y < τ x := by
        show ¬ (τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.2)) < τ.toFun (τ.invFun q.1.1)
        rw [τ.right_inv, τ.right_inv]; exact fun h => lt_asymm h q.2
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [φ, hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact Prod.ext (τ.right_inv _) (τ.right_inv _)
  -- Assemble.
  have step : ∀ p : Pairs n, inv ((σ * τ) p.1.1) ((σ * τ) p.1.2) =
      f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) + inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) := by
    intro p
    show inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) = (inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) + inv _ _) + inv _ _
    cases inv (σ (τ p.1.1)) (σ (τ p.1.2)) <;> cases inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) <;> rfl
  have hfp : ∀ p : Pairs n, f p.1.1 p.1.2 = inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) := by
    intro p
    show inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) + decide (p.1.2 < p.1.1) = _
    have : ¬ p.1.2 < p.1.1 := fun h => lt_asymm h p.2
    simp only [this, decide_false]
    cases inv (σ p.1.1) (σ p.1.2) <;> rfl
  unfold parity
  rw [show (fun p : Pairs n => inv ((σ * τ) p.1.1) ((σ * τ) p.1.2)) =
      fun p => f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) + inv (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2) from funext step, isum_add]
  congr 1
  rw [show (fun p : Pairs n => f (τ p.1.1) (τ p.1.2)) = fun p => f (φ p).1.1 (φ p).1.2 from
    funext hφ, isum_comp_bij φ hinj hsurj (fun p => f p.1.1 p.1.2)]
  exact congrArg isum (funext hfp)

/-- `m*([0, 1)) = 1`: removing the point `1` from `[0, 1]` costs nothing. -/
theorem outer_I : outer I = 1 := by
  have h01 := outer_interval (show (0 : R) ≤ 1 by grind)
  apply Std.le_antisymm
  · have := outer_mono (coverable_of_bdd (A := fun x => 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1) (a := 0) (b := 1)
      fun _ h => h) (A := I) fun x h => ⟨h.1, Std.le_of_lt h.2⟩
    grind
  · have hu := outer_union_le' (coverable_of_bdd (A := I) (a := 0) (b := 1)
      fun x h => ⟨h.1, Std.le_of_lt h.2⟩)
      (coverable_of_bdd (A := fun x => x = 1) (a := 1) (b := 1) fun x h => by grind)
    have := outer_mono hu.1 (A := fun x => 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1) fun x ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
      rcases (by grind : x < 1 ∨ x = 1) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr h
    rw [outer_point] at hu
    grind
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.cond:
/-- **Conditional probability** `P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)`. -/
noncomputable def cond (A B : Event α) : R := P.prob (fun x => A x ∧ B x) / P.prob B
Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.space:
/-- The `K`-subspace `{u + v α + w α²}` spanned by `1, α, α²`. -/
def CubicRoot.space (_C : CubicRoot K α) : KSubspace K where
  carrier x := ∃ u v w, u ∈ K ∧ v ∈ K ∧ w ∈ K ∧ x = u + v * α + w * (α * α)
  zero_mem := ⟨0, 0, 0, K.zero_mem, K.zero_mem, K.zero_mem, by grind⟩
  add_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩ ⟨u', v', w', hu', hv', hw', hy⟩
    exact ⟨u + u', v + v', w + w', K.add_mem hu hu', K.add_mem hv hv', K.add_mem hw hw',
      by rw [hx, hy]; grind⟩
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩
    exact ⟨-u, -v, -w, K.neg_mem hu, K.neg_mem hv, K.neg_mem hw, by rw [hx]; grind⟩
  smul_mem := by
    intro k x hk ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩
    exact ⟨k * u, k * v, k * w, K.mul_mem hk hu, K.mul_mem hk hv, K.mul_mem hk hw,
      by rw [hx]; grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Z.comm_ring:
/-- **ℤ is a commutative ring.** The integers satisfy all the axioms of a commutative ring
with `0 ≠ 1`. -/
theorem comm_ring :
    (∀ x y z : Z, x + y + z = x + (y + z)) ∧ (∀ x y : Z, x + y = y + x) ∧
    (∀ x : Z, x + 0 = x) ∧ (∀ x : Z, -x + x = 0) ∧
    (∀ x y z : Z, x * y * z = x * (y * z)) ∧ (∀ x y : Z, x * y = y * x) ∧
    (∀ x : Z, x * 1 = x) ∧ (∀ x y z : Z, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z) ∧ (0 : Z) ≠ 1 :=
  ⟨add_assoc, add_comm, add_zero, neg_add_cancel, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_one, mul_add,
    zero_ne_one⟩
Foundations.NumberTheory.bprod:
/-- The finite product `∏_{i < B} f(i)`. -/
def bprod (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | B + 1 => bprod f B * f B
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.arith_bridge:
/-- **Arithmetic bridge.** Under `vn : Nat → ω`, zero, successor, addition and
multiplication of Lean's natural numbers correspond exactly to `∅`, `succ`, `+ω`
and `*ω`, which were defined purely set-theoretically by the recursion theorem. -/
theorem arith_bridge :
    vn 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ n, vn (n + 1) = succ (vn n)) ∧
      (∀ m n, vn (m + n) = vn m +ω vn n) ∧ (∀ m n, vn (m * n) = vn m *ω vn n) :=
  ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl, vn_add, vn_mul⟩
Foundations.Combinatorics.pair_code_inj:
/-- Decoding a pair from `x·n + y`. -/
theorem pair_code_inj {n x y x' y' : Nat} (hy : y < n) (hy' : y' < n)
    (h : x * n + y = x' * n + y') : x = x' ∧ y = y' := by
  have hn : 0 < n := by omega
  have h₁ : (y + x * n) / n = (y' + x' * n) / n := by rw [Nat.add_comm y, Nat.add_comm y', h]
  rw [Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hn, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hn, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hy,
    Nat.div_eq_of_lt hy'] at h₁
  simp at h₁
  subst h₁
  exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩
Foundations.Logic.Sequent.CutFree.conjR:
/-- `∧`-right: from `Γ ⊢ A, Δ` and `Γ ⊢ B, Δ` infer `Γ ⊢ Δ` when `A ∧ B ∈ Δ`. -/
theorem conjR {Γ Δ A B} (h : conj A B ∈ Δ) (h₁ : CutFree Γ (A :: Δ))
    (h₂ : CutFree Γ (B :: Δ)) : CutFree Γ Δ :=
  right h rfl (by simp [h₁, h₂])
Foundations.NumberTheory.pow_primeCount_:
/-- `k^π(n) ≤ k^(k+1) · 4ⁿ` for `k ≥ 1`. -/
theorem pow_primeCount_le (k n : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : k ^ primeCount n ≤ k ^ (k + 1) * 4 ^ n := by
  have hc := countBelow_le Prime k (n + 1)
  calc k ^ primeCount n
      ≤ k ^ (countBelow (fun i => Prime i ∧ k < i) (n + 1) + (k + 1)) :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right hk (by unfold primeCount; omega)
    _ = k ^ (k + 1) * k ^ countBelow (fun i => Prime i ∧ k < i) (n + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_comm]
    _ ≤ k ^ (k + 1) * 4 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (pow_count_le_four_pow k n)
Foundations.Algebra.res_pos:
/-- For `k < (p-1)/2` the residue of `(k+1)·a` is non-zero. -/
theorem res_pos {k : Nat} (hk : k < half p) : 0 < res a p k := by
  have ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := half_spec hp hodd
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  intro h
  rcases hp.dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h) with hd | hd
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
  · exact ha hd
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.cover:
/-- Subsets of `[a, b]` are coverable. -/
theorem coverable_inter (A : R → Prop) (a b : R) : Coverable (fun x => A x ∧ Icc a b x) :=
  coverable_of_bdd fun _ h => h.2
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.sint_:
/-- The integral of a refinement: `Σ_p Σ_q c p q · μ(p.2 ∩ set q)`. -/
theorem sint_refine {β : Type} (m : Measure S) (l₁ : List (R × (α → Prop))) (l₂ : List β)
    (set : β → α → Prop) (c : R × (α → Prop) → β → R) :
    sint m (MeasureTheory.refine l₁ l₂ set c) =
      lsum (fun p => lsum (fun q => c p q * m.μ (fun x => p.2 x ∧ set q x)) l₂) l₁ := by
  unfold sint MeasureTheory.refine; rw [lsum_flatMap]
  exact lsum_congr fun p _ => by rw [lsum_map]
Foundations.Algebra.ZMod.cyclic:
/-- **`ℤ/nℤ` is cyclic**: every element is a power of the generator `1`. -/
theorem cyclic (a : ZMod n) : ∃ k : Nat, gen ^ k = a := by
  refine ⟨(val a).val, ?_⟩
  apply Fin.ext
  show (val (gen ^ (val a).val : ZMod n)).val = (val a).val
  rw [pow_gen, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val a).isLt]
Foundations.Algebra.conv_top:
/-- The top coefficient of a product of polynomials of degrees at most `d` and `5 - d`. -/
theorem conv_top {G H : Nat → Int} {d : Nat} (hd : d ≤ 5) (hG : SuppLE G d) (hH : SuppLE H (5 - d)) :
    conv G H 5 = G d * H (5 - d) := by
  unfold conv
  apply zsum_single _ 6 (by omega)
  intro k hk hkd
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hkd with h | h
  · rw [hH (5 - k) (by omega), Int.mul_zero]
  · rw [hG k h, Int.zero_mul]
Foundations.Logic.FO.Term.subst_congr_fr:
/-- Substitutions agreeing away from a fresh variable act identically on a term. -/
theorem subst_congr_fresh {x : Nat} {σ τ : Nat → Term L} (h : ∀ n, n ≠ x → σ n = τ n) :
    ∀ t : Term L, t.Fresh x → t.subst σ = t.subst τ
  | var n, hf => h n hf
  | func f ts, hf => by
      simp only [subst]; congr; funext i; exact subst_congr_fresh h (ts i) (hf i)
Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.countP_sp:
/-- A list fact: counting `p` splits into counting `p ∧ q` and `p ∧ ¬q`. -/
theorem countP_split {γ : Type u} (p q : γ → Bool) (l : List γ) :
    l.countP p = l.countP (fun x => p x && q x) + l.countP (fun x => p x && !q x) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    cases hp : p x <;> cases hq : q x <;> simp <;> omega
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Sigma:
/-- The union of `A, B, ∅, ∅, …` is `A ∪ B`. -/
theorem iUnion_seq2 {α : Type} (A B : α → Prop) :
    (fun x => ∃ n, seq2 A B n x) = (fun x => A x ∨ B x) :=
  set_ext fun x => ⟨fun ⟨n, h⟩ => by
    match n, h with
    | 0, h => exact Or.inl h
    | 1, h => exact Or.inr h, fun h => h.elim (fun h => ⟨0, h⟩) (fun h => ⟨1, h⟩)⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.canon_s:
/-- `x` and its image under the canonical map have the same cut. -/
theorem canon_spec (x : F) : SameCut x (canon F G x) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_sameCut (G := G) CompleteOrderedField.lub (archF (F := F)) x)
Foundations.Algebra.Hom.map_inv:
/-- **Homomorphisms preserve inverses.** -/
theorem map_inv (f : G →* H) (a : G) : f a⁻¹ = (f a)⁻¹ := by
  symm
  apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one
  rw [← f.map_mul', mul_inv_cancel, f.map_one]
Foundations.Numbers.R.eps_small:
/-- `1/(k+1)` is eventually below any `ε > 0`. -/
theorem eps_small {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N : Nat, ∀ k : Nat, N ≤ k → 1 / ((k : R) + 1) < ε := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := archimedean (1 / ε)
  refine ⟨N, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hk' : (N : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ hk
  have h0 : (0 : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hpos : (0 : R) < (k : R) + 1 := by grind
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv] at hN
  have h1 : 1 < (N : R) * ε := (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul 1 (N : R) hε).1 hN
  have h2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by grind : (N : R) ≤ (k : R) + 1)
    (Std.le_of_lt hε)
  exact (Field.IsOrdered.mul_inv_lt_iff_lt_mul 1 ε hpos).2 (by grind)
Foundations.Types.STLC.no_closed_lem_ter:
/-- Equivalently: the type `A + (A → ⊥)` has no closed inhabitant. -/
theorem no_closed_lem_term (k : Nat) : ¬ ∃ t, HasType [] t (.sum (.atom k) (neg (.atom k))) :=
  fun ⟨_, h⟩ => lem_unprovable k h.toND
Foundations.Algebra.Stable:
/-- A subfield `M ⊆ ℂ` is **stable** if every embedding `M → ℂ` maps `M` into itself. -/
def Stable (M : Subfield ℂ) : Prop := ∀ (τ : RingHom M ℂ) (y : M), τ.toFun y ∈ M
Foundations.NumberTheory.legendre':
/-- **Legendre's formula**, standard form: `vₚ(n!) = Σ_{k=1}^{n} ⌊n/pᵏ⌋`. -/
theorem legendre' {p : Nat} (hp : Prime p) (n : Nat) : vp p (fact n) = legendreSum p n n :=
  legendre hp n n (lt_pow_self hp.1 n)
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.lsum_:
/-- Sums are additive. -/
theorem lsum_add (F G : β → R) (l : List β) :
    lsum (fun b => F b + G b) l = lsum F l + lsum G l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => show (0 : R) = 0 + 0; grind
  | cons b l ih => show _ + lsum _ l = (F b + lsum F l) + (G b + lsum G l); rw [ih]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.Cut.neg:
/-- Negation of a cut: `{q | q < r for some r with −r ∉ A}`. -/
def neg (A : Cut) : Cut where
  lower q := ∃ r, q < r ∧ ¬ A.lower (-r)
  nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := A.bounded
    exact ⟨-a₀ - 1, -a₀, by grind, by rw [show -(-a₀) = a₀ by grind]; exact ha₀⟩
  bounded := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.nonempty
    refine ⟨-a, fun ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ => hnr (A.down ha (by grind))⟩
  down := fun ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ h' => ⟨r, by grind, hnr⟩
  open_ := fun {q} ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ => ⟨(q + r) / 2, by grind, r, by grind, hnr⟩
Foundations.Categories.CartesianClosed.c:
/-- `curry` of `(g × 𝟙) ≫ eval` is `g` (the η-law). -/
theorem curry_eval_eta {X A B : C} (g : X ⟶ exp A B) : curry (pair (fst ≫ g) snd ≫ eval) = g :=
  (curry_uniq _ g rfl).symm
Foundations.Numbers.R.expTerm_rec:
/-- `(n + 1) · xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)! = x · xⁿ/n!`. -/
theorem expTerm_rec (x : R) (n : Nat) : ((n : R) + 1) * expTerm x (n + 1) = x * expTerm x n := by
  rw [expTerm_succ]
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  grind
Foundations.Types.Star.single:
/-- A single step is a reduction sequence. -/
theorem single {a b : α} (h : R a b) : Star R a b := tail (refl a) h
Foundations.Bridges.peanoToOmega_eq:
/-- The recursive translation agrees with going through `Nat`. -/
theorem peanoToOmega_eq (n : N) : peanoToOmega n = toOmega (N.toNat n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [peanoToOmega, N.toNat, ih]; rfl
Foundations.Logic.Computability.exists_l:
/-- Existence of a least witness (a constructive-enough form of well-ordering). -/
theorem exists_least {p : Nat → Prop} (h : ∃ t, p t) : ∃ t, p t ∧ ∀ m, m < t → ¬ p m := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
  induction t using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ t ih =>
      by_cases hm : ∃ m, m < t ∧ p m
      · obtain ⟨m, hmt, hpm⟩ := hm; exact ih m hmt hpm
      · exact ⟨t, ht, fun m hmt hpm => hm ⟨m, hmt, hpm⟩⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Q.mk_lt:
/-- Computation rule: the strict order on representatives. -/
@[simp] theorem mk_lt (a b c d : Int) (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d) :
    mk a b hb < mk c d hd ↔ a * d < c * b := by
  show (_ ∧ ¬ _) ↔ _
  simp only [mk_le]; omega
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.TStep.eras:
/-- **Intrinsic reduction is Part V reduction**: every step of intrinsic terms erases to a
step of Part V's reduction relation. -/
theorem TStep.erase {Γ : List FTy} {A : FTy} {t t' : Tm Γ A} (h : TStep t t') :
    Step (Lambek.erase t) (Lambek.erase t') := by
  induction h with
  | beta t u =>
    show Step (.app (.lam _) _) _
    rw [erase_inst]; exact .beta _ _
  | fstPair a b => exact .fstPair _ _
  | sndPair a b => exact .sndPair _ _
  | appL _ _ ih => exact .appL ih
  | appR _ _ ih => exact .appR ih
  | lam _ ih => exact .lam ih
  | pairL _ _ ih => exact .pairL ih
  | pairR _ _ ih => exact .pairR ih
  | fst _ ih => exact .fst ih
  | snd _ ih => exact .snd ih
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.zero_le':
/-- `0 ≤ x`. -/
theorem zero_le' (x : N.Dom) : 0 ≤ x := ⟨x, zero_add' x⟩
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.sem_eta:
/-- **Soundness of η**: `⟦λx. t x⟧ = ⟦t⟧` (where `t` is weakened past `x`). -/
theorem sem_eta {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (t : Tm Γ (.arr A B)) :
    semTm ι (.lam (.app (rename (fun x => Mem.there x) t) (.var .here))) = semTm ι t := by
  show curry (pair _ snd ≫ eval) = _
  rw [sem_weaken]
  exact curry_eval_eta _
Foundations.Topology.Cantor.C_uncountabl:
/-- **The Cantor set is uncountable**: no sequence of reals lists all of its points. -/
theorem C_uncountable (s : Nat → R) : ∃ x, C x ∧ ∀ n, x ≠ s n := by
  -- Cantor's diagonal argument on the digit sequences.
  let code : Nat → Nat → Bool := fun n =>
    open Classical in if h : ∃ b, val b = s n then h.choose else fun _ => false
  let d : Nat → Bool := fun n => !(code n n)
  refine ⟨val d, val_mem_C d, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hex : ∃ b, val b = s n := ⟨d, hn⟩
  have hc : code n = hex.choose := by
    show (open Classical in if h : ∃ b, val b = s n then h.choose else fun _ => false) = _
    rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hex)]
  have hval : val (code n) = val d := by rw [hc, hex.choose_spec, hn]
  apply val_injective n (code n) d _ hval
  show code n n ≠ !(code n n)
  cases code n n <;> decide
Foundations.Numbers.R.IsLocalMax:
/-- `f` has a **local maximum** at `c`: `f y ≤ f c` for all `y` near `c`. -/
def IsLocalMax (f : R → R) (c : R) : Prop := ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y, abs (y - c) < δ → f y ≤ f c
Foundations.Bridges.Omega.toNat_toOmega:
/-- `toNat` on the numeral `vn n` returns `n`. -/
theorem toNat_toOmega (n : Nat) : toNat (toOmega n) = n :=
  vn_injective (val_eq (toOmega n)).symm
Foundations.Algebra.qβn_root:
/-- Each `qβn n` is a root. -/
theorem qβn_root (n : Nat) : eval (qβn n) (quinticPoly ℂ) = 0 := by
  unfold qβn; split
  · exact qβ_spec.2.1 _
  · exact qβ_spec.2.1 _
Foundations.Numbers.R.tendsto_expTerm_ze:
/-- The terms of the exponential series tend to `0`. -/
theorem tendsto_expTerm_zero (x : R) : Tendsto (expTerm x) 0 := by
  have h := ((hasSum_exp x : Tendsto _ _).shift 1).sub (hasSum_exp x : Tendsto _ _)
  rw [show exp x - exp x = 0 by grind] at h
  exact h.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by
    show fsum (expTerm x) (1 + n) - fsum (expTerm x) n = expTerm x n
    rw [Nat.add_comm, fsum_succ]; grind
Foundations.Geometry.euclid_not_provable:
/-- **Euclid's axiom is not a theorem of neutral geometry**: it does not hold in every
model of the other axioms. -/
theorem euclid_not_provable : ¬ ∀ (P : Type) (N : NeutralPlane P), EuclidAxiom N :=
  fun h => klein_not_euclid (h _ kleinNeutral)
Foundations.Numbers.R.tendsto_le:
/-- Limits preserve non-strict upper bounds. -/
theorem tendsto_le {a : Nat → R} {L c : R} (h : Tendsto a L) (hc : ∀ n, a n ≤ c) : L ≤ c := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hlt
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h (L - c) (by grind)
  have := abs_lt.1 (hN N (Nat.le_refl _)); have := hc N; grind
Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.sumAbs_nonneg:
/-- The sum of absolute values is non-negative. -/
theorem sumAbs_nonneg (a : Nat → Q) (N : Nat) : 0 ≤ sumAbs a N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact abs_nonneg _
  | succ N ih => have := abs_nonneg (a (N + 1)); simp only [sumAbs]; grind
Foundations.Algebra.IsDomain:
/-- **Integral domain.** A commutative ring in which `0 ≠ 1` and a product vanishes only if
one factor does. -/
def IsDomain (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : Prop :=
  (0 : R) ≠ 1 ∧ ∀ a b : R, a * b = 0 → a = 0 ∨ b = 0
Foundations.Sets.Equinum:
/-- `α` and `β` are **equinumerous** when there is a bijection `α → β`. -/
def Equinum (α : Sort _) (β : Sort _) : Prop := ∃ f : α → β, Bijective f
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.cop_mul:
/-- Coprimality is multiplicative. -/
theorem cop_mul {P Q m : N.Dom} (h₁ : Cop P m) (h₂ : Cop Q m) : Cop (P * Q) m := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx⟩ := h₁; obtain ⟨x', y', hx'⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨x * x', m * y * y' + y + y', by grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.C.one_mul:
/-- One is a left identity. -/
theorem one_mul (x : C) : 1 * x = x := by cpx
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.const_:
/-- **Linearity II.** `∫ c f = c ∫ f`. -/
theorem HasIntegral.const_mul (c : R) {f : R → R} {a b I : R} (hf : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral (fun y => c * f y) a b (c * I) := ⟨hf.1, fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := exists_mul_le c (by grind : 0 < ε / 2)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf.2 η hη
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun l hl hm => ?_⟩
  rw [rsum_const_mul, show c * rsum f a l - c * I = c * (rsum f a l - I) by grind, abs_mul]
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt (h l hl hm)) (abs_nonneg c)
  grind⟩
Foundations.Types.SystemF.Normal:
/-- A term is **normal** when no reduction step applies. -/
def Normal (t : Term) : Prop := ∀ t', ¬ Step t t'
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.provHDef:
/-- The uniform definition of `ProvM`. -/
noncomputable def provHDef : UDef fun N e => ProvM (N := N) (e 0) := by
  unfold ProvM LineOK MPM PairM; udfn
Foundations.Algebra.KummerStep.rpow_mem:
/-- In a radical step, `x^p` lies in `K`. -/
theorem KummerStep.rpow_mem {K : Subfield Ω} {x : Ω} {p : Nat} (h : KummerStep K x p) :
    rpow x p ∈ K := by
  rcases h.2 with h1 | ⟨_, h2⟩
  · rw [h1]; exact K.one_mem
  · exact h2
Foundations.Numbers.Arith.gcd_dvd:
/-- The gcd divides both arguments. -/
theorem gcd_dvd (a b : Nat) : gcd a b ∣ a ∧ gcd a b ∣ b := by
  induction a, b using gcd.induct with
  | case1 a => rw [gcd_zero]; exact ⟨Nat.dvd_refl a, Nat.dvd_zero a⟩
  | case2 a b ih =>
    rw [gcd_succ]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨?_, h1⟩
    have := Nat.mod_add_div a (b + 1)
    have h3 := Nat.dvd_add h2 (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd h1 (a / (b + 1)))
    rwa [this] at h3

Foundations.Combinatorics.pigeonhole:
/-- **The finite pigeonhole principle.** If `m` points are mapped into `k < m` holes
(values `< k`), two distinct points have the same image. -/
theorem pigeonhole : ∀ (k m : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat), (∀ i, i < m → f i < k) → k < m →
    ∃ i j, i < j ∧ j < m ∧ f i = f j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro m f hf hm; exact absurd (hf 0 hm) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m f hf hm
    by_cases hk : ∃ i, i < m ∧ f i = k
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := hk
      by_cases h2 : ∃ j, j < m ∧ j ≠ i ∧ f j = k
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, hfj⟩ := h2
        rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hji with h | h
        · exact ⟨j, i, h, hi, by rw [hfi, hfj]⟩
        · exact ⟨i, j, h, hj, by rw [hfi, hfj]⟩
      · -- remove the point `i`; all other values are `< k`
        let g : Nat → Nat := fun p => f (if p < i then p else p + 1)
        have hg : ∀ p, p < m - 1 → g p < k := by
          intro p hp
          have hne : (if p < i then p else p + 1) ≠ i := by split <;> omega
          have hlt : (if p < i then p else p + 1) < m := by split <;> omega
          have h₁ := hf _ hlt
          have h₂ : f (if p < i then p else p + 1) ≠ k := fun h => h2 ⟨_, hlt, hne, h⟩
          show f _ < k
          omega
        obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, hq, he⟩ := ih (m - 1) g hg (by omega)
        refine ⟨if p < i then p else p + 1, if q < i then q else q + 1, ?_, ?_, he⟩
        · split <;> split <;> omega
        · split <;> omega
    · have hf' : ∀ i, i < m → f i < k := by
        intro i hi
        have := hf i hi
        have : f i ≠ k := fun h => hk ⟨i, hi, h⟩
        omega
      exact ih m f hf' (by omega)

/-- **Additivity of the Lebesgue integral.** For integrable `f, g ≥ 0`, `f + g` is integrable and

theorem lintegral_add {f g : α → R} (hf : LIntegrable m f) (hg : LIntegrable m g) :

Foundations.Categories.lawvere_fixed_poi:
/-- **Lawvere's fixed-point theorem.** Let `A × A` be a product (projections `p₁, p₂`)
and `φ : A × A ⟶ B` be point-surjective with respect to `T`-points: for every
`g : A ⟶ B` there is `a : T ⟶ A` with `φ ∘ ⟨a, x⟩ = g ∘ x` for all `x : T ⟶ A`. Then every
`t : B ⟶ B` has a fixed `T`-point `b : T ⟶ B`, `b ≫ t = b`. -/
theorem lawvere_fixed_point {A B AA T : C} {p₁ p₂ : AA ⟶ A} (hP : IsProduct A A AA p₁ p₂)
    (φ : AA ⟶ B)
    (hφ : ∀ g : A ⟶ B, ∃ a : T ⟶ A, ∀ x : T ⟶ A, hP.lift a x ≫ φ = x ≫ g)
    (t : B ⟶ B) : ∃ b : T ⟶ B, b ≫ t = b := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hφ (hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) ≫ φ ≫ t)
  refine ⟨hP.lift a a ≫ φ, ?_⟩
  have h₁ := ha a
  have h₂ : a ≫ hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) = hP.lift a a := by rw [hP.comp_lift, comp_id]
  calc (hP.lift a a ≫ φ) ≫ t = (a ≫ hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A)) ≫ φ ≫ t := by rw [h₂, assoc]
    _ = a ≫ (hP.lift (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) ≫ φ ≫ t) := by rw [assoc]
    _ = hP.lift a a ≫ φ := h₁.symm

Foundations.Algebra.IsEuclidean.isPID:
/-- **Every Euclidean domain is a principal ideal domain.** An ideal is generated by any of
its non-zero elements of least size. -/
theorem IsEuclidean.isPID {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (hE : IsEuclidean R) : IsPID R := by
  obtain ⟨hD, size, hdiv⟩ := hE
  refine ⟨hD, fun I => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : ∀ x, x ∈ I → x = 0
  · refine ⟨0, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ⟨0, by rw [hz x hx, mul_zero]⟩, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hc, zero_mul]; exact I.zero_mem
  · have hex : ∃ n, ∃ x, x ∈ I ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ size x = n := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hno
      exact hz fun x hx => Classical.byContradiction fun hne => hno ⟨_, x, hx, hne, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨g, hgI, hg0, hgn⟩, hmin⟩ := FiniteType.exists_least _ hex
    refine ⟨g, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := hdiv x g hg0
      have hrI : r ∈ I := by
        have : r = x + -(q * g) := by rw [hqr, Ring.add_comm (q * g), Ring.add_assoc,
          add_neg_cancel, add_zero]
        rw [this]; exact I.add_mem hx (I.neg_mem (I.mul_mem q hgI))
      rcases hr with hr | hr
      · exact ⟨q, by rw [hqr, hr, add_zero, CommRing.mul_comm]⟩
      · by_cases hr0 : r = 0
        · exact ⟨q, by rw [hqr, hr0, add_zero, CommRing.mul_comm]⟩
        · exact absurd ⟨r, hrI, hr0, rfl⟩ (hmin _ (hgn ▸ hr))
    · rw [hc]; exact I.mul_mem_right c hgI
Foundations.Logic.Computability.encode_i:
/-- **The Gödel numbering is injective**: distinct codes have distinct numbers. -/
theorem encode_inj : ∀ {c c' : Code}, encode c = encode c' → c = c' := by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | rfl | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega)
  | succ => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | rfl | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega)
  | proj i => intro c' h; cases c' <;> simp only [encode] at h <;>
      first | (have := (pair_inj h).1; omega) | (rw [(pair_inj h).2])
  | @comp k f gs ihf ihg =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | @comp k' f' gs' =>
          simp only [encode] at h
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := pair_inj (pair_inj h).2
          have hf := ihf h₁
          have hl := encList_inj h₂
          have hk : k = k' := by simpa using congrArg List.length hl
          subst hk hf
          have : gs = gs' := funext fun i => ihg i (by
            have := congrArg (fun l => l[i.val]?) hl
            simpa using this)
          rw [this]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega
  | prec f g ihf ihg =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | prec f' g' =>
          simp only [encode] at h
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := pair_inj (pair_inj h).2
          rw [ihf h₁, ihg h₂]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega
  | mu f ih =>
      intro c' h
      cases c' with
      | mu f' => simp only [encode] at h; rw [ih (pair_inj h).2]
      | _ => simp only [encode] at h; have := (pair_inj h).1; omega

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Eval:
/-- **Big-step evaluation.** `Eval c xs n` means: run on the argument list `xs`, the
algorithm `c` halts with output `n`. Non-termination is the absence of any `n`. -/
inductive Eval : Code → List Nat → Nat → Prop where
  /-- `zero` outputs `0`. -/
  | zero {xs} : Eval .zero xs 0
  /-- `succ` outputs the first argument plus one. -/
  | succ {xs} : Eval .succ xs (xs.headD 0 + 1)
  /-- `proj i` outputs the `i`-th argument. -/
  | proj {i xs} : Eval (.proj i) xs (xs.getD i 0)
  /-- Composition: if each `gs i` outputs `vs i`, and `f` outputs `n` on these values,
  the composite outputs `n`. -/
  | comp {k : Nat} {f : Code} {gs : Fin k → Code} {xs : List Nat} {n : Nat}
      (vs : Fin k → Nat) : (∀ i, Eval (gs i) xs (vs i)) → Eval f (List.ofFn vs) n →
      Eval (.comp f gs) xs n
  /-- Primitive recursion, base case. -/
  | prec_zero {f g xs n} : Eval f xs n → Eval (.prec f g) (0 :: xs) n
  /-- Primitive recursion, step case. -/
  | prec_succ {f g m xs r n} : Eval (.prec f g) (m :: xs) r → Eval g (m :: r :: xs) n →
      Eval (.prec f g) ((m + 1) :: xs) n
  /-- Minimisation: `f(n, x⃗) = 0`, and `f(m, x⃗)` is defined and non-zero for all `m < n`
  (the values `ks m + 1` witness this). -/
  | mu {f xs n} (ks : Nat → Nat) : Eval f (n :: xs) 0 →
      (∀ m, m < n → Eval f (m :: xs) (ks m + 1)) → Eval (.mu f) xs n
Foundations.Topology.Stirling.exp_ineq2:
/-- `u (2 + 4eᵘ) ≤ (eᵘ − 1)(5 + eᵘ)` for `u ≥ 0` (equivalently
`log(1+x) ≤ x(6+x)/(6+4x)`). -/
theorem exp_ineq2 {u : R} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : u * (2 + 4 * exp u) ≤ (exp u - 1) * (5 + exp u) := by
  -- `m''(v) = 4eᵛ(eᵛ − 1 − v) ≥ 0`.
  have hj : ∀ v, HasDerivAt (fun v => 2 * (exp v * exp v) - 2 - 4 * (v * exp v))
      (4 * (exp v * exp v) - 4 * exp v - 4 * (v * exp v)) v := fun v =>
    HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (((((hasDerivAt_exp v).mul (hasDerivAt_exp v)).const_mul 2).sub
      (hasDerivAt_const 2 v)).sub (((hasDerivAt_id v).mul (hasDerivAt_exp v)).const_mul 4)) (by grind)
  have jpos : ∀ v, 0 ≤ v → 0 ≤ 2 * (exp v * exp v) - 2 - 4 * (v * exp v) := fun v hv => by
    have := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (a := 0) (b := v) (fun t _ _ => hj t)
      (fun t h0 _ => by
        have := one_add_le_exp h0
        have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt (exp_pos t)) (by grind : 0 ≤ exp t - 1 - t)
        grind) (Std.le_refl 0) hv (Std.le_refl v)
    rw [exp_zero] at this; grind
  have hk : ∀ v, HasDerivAt (fun v => (exp v - 1) * (5 + exp v) - v * (2 + 4 * exp v))
      (2 * (exp v * exp v) - 2 - 4 * (v * exp v)) v := fun v =>
    HasDerivAt.congr_deriv ((((hasDerivAt_exp v).sub (hasDerivAt_const 1 v)).mul
      ((hasDerivAt_const 5 v).add (hasDerivAt_exp v))).sub ((hasDerivAt_id v).mul
      ((hasDerivAt_const 2 v).add ((hasDerivAt_exp v).const_mul 4)))) (by grind)
  have := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (a := 0) (b := u) (fun t _ _ => hk t)
    (fun t h0 _ => jpos t h0) (Std.le_refl 0) hu (Std.le_refl u)
  rw [exp_zero] at this; grind

/-- A permutation of a finite type built from an injective map (whose inverse is chosen using
surjectivity). -/
noncomputable def permOfInjective {n : Nat} (f : Fin n → Fin n)
    (hf : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b) : Perm (Fin n) where
  toFun := f

  left_inv x := hf _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (FiniteType.surjective_of_injective f hf (f x)))

Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.seq_exists:
/-- **Gödel's β-lemma inside a model of PA.** Let `R(i, y)` be definable (with
parameters `p`), and suppose that for every `i < L` there is some `y ≤ B` with
`R(i, y)`. Then there are `c ≥ K` and `d` such that, for every `i < L`, the `i`-th
entry of the β-sequence coded by `(c, d)` satisfies `R(i, ·)`. -/
theorem seq_exists {R : N.Dom → N.Dom → (Nat → N.Dom) → Prop}
    (hR : N.Dfn fun e => R (e 0) (e 1) (fun n => e (n + 2)))
    (p : Nat → N.Dom) (L B K : N.Dom) (hex : ∀ i, i < L → ∃ y, y ≤ B ∧ R i y p) :
    ∃ c d, K ≤ c ∧ ∀ i, i < L → ∃ y, BetaM c d i y ∧ R i y p := by
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩ := exists_common_multiple L
  -- the common modulus parameter `d`
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : N.Dom, d = (d₀ + 1) * (B + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hBd : B < d := ⟨d₀ * (B + 1), by grind⟩
  have hdiv : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ L → ∃ t, d = k * (t + 1) := by
    intro k hk hkL
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd₀ k hk hkL
    rcases zero_or_succ t with rfl | ⟨t', rfl⟩
    · exact absurd (by grind : d₀ + 1 = 0) (succ_ne_zero' d₀)
    · exact ⟨t' * (B + 1) + B, by grind⟩
  -- coprimality of the moduli below `L`
  have hcop : ∀ i j, i < j → j < L → Cop (1 + (i + 1) * d) (1 + (j + 1) * d) := by
    intro i j hij hjL
    obtain ⟨δ, rfl⟩ := exists_of_lt hij
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdiv (δ + 1) ⟨δ, by grind⟩
      (le_trans' ⟨i, by grind⟩ (le_of_lt' hjL))
    exact cop_moduli (e := t) ht
  -- the inductive invariant, for `k ≤ L`
  let Q : N.Dom → Prop := fun k => k ≤ L → ∃ c P : N.Dom, (∃ P₀, P = P₀ + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ t, P = (1 + (i + 1) * d) * t) ∧
      (∀ j, j < L → k ≤ j → Cop P (1 + (j + 1) * d)) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ y, BetaM c d i y ∧ R i y p)
  have hQ0 : Q 0 := fun _ =>
    ⟨0, 1, ⟨0, by grind⟩, fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_zero' i),
      fun j _ _ => cop_one _, fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_zero' i)⟩
  have hQs : ∀ k, Q k → Q (k + 1) := by
    intro k ih hk
    have hkL : k < L := hk
    obtain ⟨c, P, hP0, hP, hPc, hc⟩ := ih (le_of_lt' hkL)
    obtain ⟨yk, hykB, hRk⟩ := hex k hkL
    obtain ⟨x, y', hxy⟩ := hPc k hkL (le_refl' k)
    have hyk : yk < 1 + (k + 1) * d := by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hykB; obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBd
      exact ⟨a + b + 1 + k * d, by grind⟩
    refine ⟨c + P * x * (yk + (k + 1) * d * c), P * (1 + (k + 1) * d), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨P₀, rfl⟩ := hP0; exact ⟨P₀ * (1 + (k + 1) * d) + (k + 1) * d, by grind⟩
    · intro i hi
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (lt_succ_iff'.1 hi) with rfl | hi'
      · exact ⟨P, by grind⟩
      · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hP i hi'; exact ⟨t * (1 + (k + 1) * d), by grind⟩
    · intro j hj hkj
      exact cop_mul (hPc j hj (le_of_lt' hkj)) (hcop k j hkj hj)
    · intro i hi
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (lt_succ_iff'.1 hi) with rfl | hi'
      · exact ⟨yk, ⟨c + y' * (yk + (i + 1) * d * c), by grind, hyk⟩, hRk⟩
      · obtain ⟨y, ⟨q, hq, hy⟩, hRy⟩ := hc i hi'
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hP i hi'
        exact ⟨y, ⟨q + t * x * (yk + (k + 1) * d * c), by grind, hy⟩, hRy⟩
  have hdfn : N.Dfn fun e => (fun k e => k ≤ e 0 → ∃ c P : N.Dom, (∃ P₀, P = P₀ + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ t, P = (1 + (i + 1) * e 1) * t) ∧
      (∀ j, j < e 0 → k ≤ j → ∃ x y, P * x = (1 + (j + 1) * e 1) * y + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ y, BetaM c (e 1) i y ∧ R i y (fun n => e (n + 2))))
      (e 0) (fun n => e (n + 1)) := by
    dfn
    exact Dfn.app3 hR (DfnT.var _) (DfnT.var _) (fun n => DfnT.var _)
  have key : ∃ c P : N.Dom, (∃ P₀, P = P₀ + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < L → ∃ t, P = (1 + (i + 1) * d) * t) ∧
      (∀ j, j < L → L ≤ j → Cop P (1 + (j + 1) * d)) ∧
      (∀ i, i < L → ∃ y, BetaM c d i y ∧ R i y p) := induction (P := fun k e => k ≤ e 0 → ∃ c P : N.Dom, (∃ P₀, P = P₀ + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ t, P = (1 + (i + 1) * e 1) * t) ∧
      (∀ j, j < e 0 → k ≤ j → ∃ x y, P * x = (1 + (j + 1) * e 1) * y + 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → ∃ y, BetaM c (e 1) i y ∧ R i y (fun n => e (n + 2))))
    hdfn (Env.cons L (Env.cons d p)) hQ0 hQs L (le_refl' L)
  obtain ⟨c, P, ⟨P₀, rfl⟩, hP, -, hc⟩ := key
  refine ⟨c + (P₀ + 1) * K, d, ⟨c + P₀ * K, by grind⟩, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨q, hq, hy⟩, hR⟩ := hc i hi
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hP i hi
  exact ⟨y, ⟨q + t * K, by grind, hy⟩, hR⟩
Foundations.Categories.Cone:
/-- A **cone** over a diagram `F : J ⥤ C`: an apex `pt` with an arrow to every vertex
`F j`, making all triangles over arrows of `J` commute. -/
structure Cone (F : J ⥤ C) where
  /-- The apex of the cone. -/
  pt : C
  /-- The leg of the cone at `j`. -/
  π : (j : J) → (pt ⟶ F.obj j)
  /-- The triangles commute: `π_i ≫ F f = π_j`. -/
  w : ∀ {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j), π i ≫ F.map f = π j

/-- Counting elements of a subtype `{x // R x}` satisfying `P` is the same as counting
elements `x` of the ambient type that satisfy `R` and (then) `P`. -/
theorem count_subtype {α : Type u} [FiniteType α] (R : α → Prop) (P : {x // R x} → Prop) :
    count (fun x => ∃ h : R x, P ⟨x, h⟩) = count P := by
  rw [← card_subtype, ← card_subtype, ← count_true, ← count_true]
  exact count_comp_bij (α := {y : {x // R x} // P y}) (β := {x // ∃ h : R x, P ⟨x, h⟩})
    (fun y => ⟨y.1.1, y.1.2, y.2⟩)
    (fun a b h => by
      have e := congrArg (fun z : {x // ∃ h : R x, P ⟨x, h⟩} => z.1) h
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext e))
    (fun ⟨x, h, hp⟩ => ⟨⟨⟨x, h⟩, hp⟩, rfl⟩) (fun _ => True) |>.symm

    intro t h
    induction h with
    | refl => rfl
    | tail _ hs ih => subst ih; exact Omega_step hs

Foundations.Probability.div_le_of_le_mul:
/-- Dividing an inequality `a ≤ b · c` by `c > 0`. -/
theorem div_le_of_le_mul {a b c : R} (hc : 0 < c) (h : a ≤ b * c) : a / c ≤ b := by
  have hi : 0 ≤ 1 / c := Std.le_of_lt (OF.div_pos (by grind) hc)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hi
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h => by grind
  have e1 : 1 / c * (b * c) = b := by grind
  have e2 : 1 / c * a = a / c := by grind
  rw [e1, e2] at this; exact this

Foundations.Algebra.int_exists_factoriza:
/-- **Existence of factorisations in `ℤ`** (fundamental theorem of arithmetic, existence
half). Every non-zero non-unit integer is a product of irreducibles. -/
theorem int_exists_factorization :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (a : Int), a.natAbs = n → a ≠ 0 → ¬ IsUnit a →
      ∃ L : List Int, (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) ∧ lprod L = a := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro a han ha0 hau
    by_cases hirr : Irreducible a
    · exact ⟨[a], fun p hp => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hp]; exact hirr,
        show a * 1 = a from Int.mul_one a⟩
    · have : ∃ b c, a = b * c ∧ ¬ IsUnit b ∧ ¬ IsUnit c := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hno
        apply hirr
        refine ⟨ha0, hau, fun b c hbc => ?_⟩
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hbc'
        exact hno ⟨b, c, hbc, fun h => hbc' (Or.inl h), fun h => hbc' (Or.inr h)⟩
      obtain ⟨b, c, rfl, hb, hc⟩ := this
      have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ha0; rw [h]; exact Int.zero_mul c
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ha0; rw [h]; exact Int.mul_zero b
      have hb2 : 2 ≤ b.natAbs := by
        have h1 : b.natAbs ≠ 1 := fun e => hb ((int_isUnit_iff b).2 e)
        have h2 : b.natAbs ≠ 0 := fun e => hb0 (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.1 e)
        omega
      have hc2 : 2 ≤ c.natAbs := by
        have h1 : c.natAbs ≠ 1 := fun e => hc ((int_isUnit_iff c).2 e)
        have h2 : c.natAbs ≠ 0 := fun e => hc0 (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.1 e)
        omega
      have hmul : (b * c).natAbs = b.natAbs * c.natAbs := Int.natAbs_mul b c
      have hbl : b.natAbs < n := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b.natAbs hc2; omega
      have hcl : c.natAbs < n := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c.natAbs hb2; omega
      obtain ⟨L1, hL1, hp1⟩ := ih _ hbl b rfl hb0 hb
      obtain ⟨L2, hL2, hp2⟩ := ih _ hcl c rfl hc0 hc
      refine ⟨L1 ++ L2, fun p hp => ?_, by rw [lprod_append, hp1, hp2]⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with h | h
      · exact hL1 p h
      · exact hL2 p h

Foundations.Logic.FO.rosser_sep:
/-- **The Rosser separation lemma.** Let `A(w, x)` and `B(w, x)` be bounded formulas
such that for no `n` both `∃w A(w, n)` and `∃w B(w, n)` hold in `ℕ`. Then `Q` proves
`Sep(n̄)` whenever `∃w A(w, n)` is true, and refutes it whenever `∃w B(w, n)` is true. -/
theorem rosser_sep {A B : Formula Arith} (hA : D0 A) (hB : D0 B)
    (hdisj : ∀ n w u, holds A w n → holds B u n → False) (n : Nat) :
    ((∃ w, holds A w n) → Q ⊢₁ (sepF A B).inst (numeral n)) ∧
    ((∃ w, holds B w n) → Q ⊢₁ neg ((sepF A B).inst (numeral n))) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine Q_proves_of_models fun M e hM => ?_
    rw [sat_inst, eval_numeral_M, sat_sepF]
    refine ⟨numM M w, ?_, fun u hu hBu => ?_⟩
    · rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hA]; exact hw
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mle_numM_iff hM _ _).1 hu
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hB] at hBu
      exact hdisj n w i hw hBu
  · rintro ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩
    refine Q_proves_of_models fun M e hM => ?_
    rw [sat_neg, sat_inst, eval_numeral_M, sat_sepF]
    rintro ⟨w, hAw, hBw⟩
    rcases mle_numM_or hM w w₁ with h | h
    · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := (mle_numM_iff hM _ _).1 h
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hA] at hAw
      exact hdisj n i w₁ hAw hw₁
    · refine hBw _ h ?_
      rw [penv_numM, D0.absolute hM hB]; exact hw₁
Foundations.Sets.SquareAbsorb.basePSq:
/-- The starting partial squaring: the copy of `ℕ`, squared by Cantor's pairing function. -/
def basePSq (he : Function.Injective e) : PSq e where
  dom x := ∃ n, e n = x
  rel p c := ∃ m n, p = (e m, e n) ∧ c = e (cantorPair (m, n))
  rel_dom p c := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
  func p c c' := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨m', n', hp, rfl⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hp
    rw [he hp.1, he hp.2]
  inj p p' c := by
    rintro ⟨m, n, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨m', n', rfl, hc⟩
    have := cantorPair_injective (he hc)
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
    rw [this.1, this.2]
  total x y := by
    rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, m, n, rfl, rfl⟩
  base n := ⟨n, rfl⟩

Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.add:
/-- The termwise sum of two Cauchy sequences is Cauchy. -/
def add (a b : CauSeq) : CauSeq where
  seq n := a n + b n
  isCauchy ε hε := by
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := a.isCauchy (ε / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := b.isCauchy (ε / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun m n hm hn => ?_⟩
    have := h₁ m n (by omega) (by omega)
    have := h₂ m n (by omega) (by omega)
    have := abs_add (a m - a n) (b m - b n)
    have e : a m - a n + (b m - b n) = a m + b m - (a n + b n) := by grind
    rw [e] at this
    grind

/-- **Extreme value theorem** (from compactness). A real function continuous at every point of a
non-empty compact set attains a maximum on it. -/
theorem extreme_value_compact {K : X → Prop} (hK : IsCompact (Topology.metric X) K)
    (hne : ∃ x, K x) {f : X → R} (hf : ∀ x, K x → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ c, K c ∧ ∀ x, K x → f x ≤ f c := by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, hs⟩ := (hK.image_of_continuousAt hf).exists_max
    (by obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne; exact ⟨f x, x, hx, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨c, hc, fun x hx => hs _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

Foundations.Logic.Sequent.inv_left:
/-- **Inversion of the left rules.** If `X, Γ ⊢ Δ` is cut-free derivable, then so is
each premise of the left rule for `X`, with `X` itself removed. -/
theorem inv_left {X : Formula} {qs q} (hqs : leftPremises X = some qs) (hq : q ∈ qs)
    {Γ Δ} (h : CutFree Γ Δ) :
    ∀ {Γ' Δ'}, Γ ⊆ X :: Γ' → Δ ⊆ Δ' → CutFree (q.1 ++ Γ') (q.2 ++ Δ') := by
  induction h with
  | @ax Γ Δ A h₁ h₂ =>
      intro Γ' Δ' hΓ hΔ
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 (hΓ h₁) with rfl | h
      · exact close_left (hΔ h₂) hqs hq
      · exact .ax (A := A) (List.mem_append_right _ h) (List.mem_append_right _ (hΔ h₂))
  | @left Γ Δ A ps hA hps _ ih =>
      intro Γ' Δ' hΓ hΔ
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 (hΓ hA) with rfl | hA'
      · obtain rfl : qs = ps := Option.some.inj (hqs.symm.trans hps)
        exact (@ih q hq (q.1 ++ Γ') (q.2 ++ Δ') (by grind) (by grind)).weaken
          (by grind) (by grind)
      · refine .left (A := A) (List.mem_append_right _ hA') hps (fun p hp => ?_)
        exact (@ih p hp (p.1 ++ Γ') (p.2 ++ Δ') (by grind) (by grind)).weaken
          (by grind) (by grind)
  | @right Γ Δ A ps hA hps _ ih =>
      intro Γ' Δ' hΓ hΔ
      refine .right (A := A) (List.mem_append_right _ (hΔ hA)) hps (fun p hp => ?_)
      exact (@ih p hp (p.1 ++ Γ') (p.2 ++ Δ') (by grind) (by grind)).weaken
        (by grind) (by grind)

Foundations.Topology.Wallis.partial_sum:
/-- **Telescoping**: `Σ_{k<N} 1/(k+1)² = 2 B₀/A₀ − 2 B_N/A_N`. -/
theorem partial_sum (N : Nat) :
    fsum (fun k => 1 / (((k : R) + 1) * ((k : R) + 1))) N = 2 * (B 0 / A 0) - 2 * (B N / A N) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => rw [fsum_zero]; grind
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [fsum_succ, ih]
    have k := key N
    have r := A_rec N
    have p1 := A_pos N; have p2 := A_pos (N + 1)
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    generalize A N = a at *
    generalize A (N + 1) = a' at *
    generalize B N = b at *
    generalize B (N + 1) = b' at *
    generalize B 0 / A 0 = s at *
    generalize (N : R) = n at *
    -- `1/(n+1)² = 2b/a − 2b'/a'`.
    have hP : (n + 1) * (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1) (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1); grind
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by grind
    have ha' : a' ≠ 0 := by grind
    have hY : (n + 1) * (n + 1) * a' ≠ 0 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1)
        (by grind : (0 : R) < n + 1)) p2; grind
    have f1 : 2 * (b / a) = (2 * b) / a := by rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    have r' := congrArg (· * (b * (n + 1))) r
    have k' := congrArg (· * a) k
    have f2 : (2 * b) / a = (a' + 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of ha hY (by grind)
    have f3 : 1 / ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) = a' / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of hP hY (by grind)
    have f4 : b' / a' = ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') :=
      div_eq_div_of ha' hY (by grind)
    have f5 : a' / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') + 2 * (((n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a'))
        = (a' + 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1) * b') / ((n + 1) * (n + 1) * a') := by
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    rw [← f3, ← f4] at f5
    have e : 1 / ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) = 2 * (b / a) - 2 * (b' / a') := by
      rw [f1, f2, ← f5]; grind
    rw [e]; grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.hasDerivAt_exp:
/-- **`exp` is its own derivative**: `exp' = exp`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_exp (x : R) : HasDerivAt exp (exp x) x := by
  have hE : 0 ≤ exp (abs x + 1) := by
    have := one_add_le_exp (by have := abs_nonneg x; grind : 0 ≤ abs x + 1)
    have := abs_nonneg x; grind
  refine hasDerivAt_of_quadratic (C := exp (abs x + 1) / 2) (by grind) fun y hy => ?_
  have k := abs_exp_sub_le (x := x) (y := y) hy
  rw [show exp y - exp x - (y - x) * exp x = exp y - exp x - exp x * (y - x) by grind] at k
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.fresh_subst:
/-- If every substituted term avoids `x`, so does the result of substitution. -/
theorem fresh_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) {x : Nat} {σ : Nat → Term L},
    (∀ n, (σ n).Fresh x) → (φ.subst σ).Fresh x
  | bot, _, _, _ => trivial
  | eq t s, _, _, h => ⟨Term.fresh_subst h t, Term.fresh_subst h s⟩
  | rel _ ts, _, _, h => fun i => Term.fresh_subst h (ts i)
  | imp φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | conj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | disj φ ψ, _, _, h => ⟨fresh_subst φ h, fresh_subst ψ h⟩
  | all φ, x, σ, h | ex φ, x, σ, h => by
      refine fresh_subst φ (x := x + 1) (fun n => ?_)
      cases n with
      | zero => simp only [Subst.lift, Term.Fresh]; omega
      | succ n => exact Term.fresh_rename_succ _ (h n)

Foundations.Categories.CartesianClosed.c:
/-- **Naturality of currying**: `curry ((g × 𝟙) ≫ f) = g ≫ curry f`. -/
theorem curry_natural {X' X A B : C} (g : X' ⟶ X) (f : prod X A ⟶ B) :
    curry (pair (fst ≫ g) snd ≫ f) = g ≫ curry f :=
  (curry_uniq _ _ (by

  induction q with
  | nil => intro n; cases n <;> simp [mul, add, smul]
  | cons b q ih =>

Foundations.Topology.isCompact_prod:
/-- **Tychonoff's theorem for two factors.** The product `K × L` of compact sets is compact in the
product topology. -/
theorem isCompact_prod {τ : Topology X} {σ : Topology Y} {K : X → Prop} {L : Y → Prop}
    (hK : IsCompact τ K) (hL : IsCompact σ L) :
    IsCompact (Topology.prod τ σ) (fun p => K p.1 ∧ L p.2) := by
  intro ι W hW hcov
  -- Boxes around every point of `K × L`, each inside some `W i`.
  have hbox : ∀ x : {x // K x}, ∀ y : {y // L y}, ∃ i : ι, ∃ U V, τ.IsOpen U ∧ σ.IsOpen V ∧
      U x.1 ∧ V y.1 ∧ ∀ q : X × Y, U q.1 → V q.2 → W i q := fun x y => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov (x.1, y.1) ⟨x.2, y.2⟩
    obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩ := hW i _ hi
    exact ⟨i, U, V, hU, hV, h1, h2, h⟩
  let idx : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → ι := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose
  let BU : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → X → Prop := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose
  let BV : {x // K x} → {y // L y} → Y → Prop := fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
  have hB : ∀ x y, τ.IsOpen (BU x y) ∧ σ.IsOpen (BV x y) ∧ BU x y x.1 ∧ BV x y y.1 ∧
      ∀ q : X × Y, BU x y q.1 → BV x y q.2 → W (idx x y) q :=
    fun x y => (hbox x y).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  -- For each `x`, finitely many boxes cover the slice `{x} × L`.
  have hslice : ∀ x : {x // K x}, ∃ ly : List {y // L y}, ∀ y, L y → ∃ y', y' ∈ ly ∧ BV x y' y :=
    fun x => hL {y // L y} (BV x) (fun y => (hB x y).2.1)
      (fun y hy => ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, (hB x ⟨y, hy⟩).2.2.2.1⟩)
  let ly : {x // K x} → List {y // L y} := fun x => (hslice x).choose
  have hly : ∀ x y, L y → ∃ y', y' ∈ ly x ∧ BV x y' y := fun x => (hslice x).choose_spec
  -- The tubes `Uₓ × L` with `Uₓ = ⋂_{y ∈ ly x} BU x y`; finitely many cover `K × L`.
  let T : {x // K x} → X → Prop := fun x z => ∀ y, y ∈ ly x → BU x y z
  obtain ⟨lx, hlx⟩ := hK {x // K x} T
    (fun x => isOpen_list_inter τ (BU x) (fun y => (hB x y).1) (ly x))
    (fun z hz => ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, fun y _ => (hB ⟨z, hz⟩ y).2.2.1⟩)
  refine ⟨lx.flatMap (fun x => (ly x).map (idx x)), fun p hp => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hTx⟩ := hlx p.1 hp.1
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hVy⟩ := hly x p.2 hp.2
  exact ⟨idx x y, List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨x, hx, List.mem_map.2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩,
    (hB x y).2.2.2.2 p (hTx y hy) hVy⟩

    (hfin : FiniteExt K M (le_trans hKL hLM)) : FiniteExt L M hLM := by
  obtain ⟨n, w, hw⟩ := hfin
  refine ⟨n, fun i => ⟨(w i).1, (w i).2⟩, fun x => ?_⟩

/-- Removing one entry `p` from a square sum. -/
theorem sq_remove (F : Nat → Nat → R) {p : Nat × Nat} {M : Nat} (h1 : p.1 < M) (h2 : p.2 < M) :
    sq F M = sq (fun i j => if i = p.1 ∧ j = p.2 then 0 else F i j) M + F p.1 p.2 := by
  unfold sq
  have e : ∀ i, fsum (F i) M = fsum (fun j => if i = p.1 ∧ j = p.2 then 0 else F i j) M +
      (if i = p.1 then F p.1 p.2 else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = p.1
    · rw [Outer.ite_pos' hi, ← fsum_spike (F p.1 p.2) p.2 M h2, ← fsum_add]
      exact fsum_congr fun j _ => by by_cases hj : j = p.2 <;> simp [hj, hi] <;> grind
    · rw [Outer.ite_neg' hi]
      have : fsum (fun j => if i = p.1 ∧ j = p.2 then 0 else F i j) M = fsum (F i) M :=
        fsum_congr fun j _ => by simp [hi]
      rw [this]; grind
  rw [fsum_congr (n := M) (b := fun i => fsum (fun j => if i = p.1 ∧ j = p.2 then 0 else F i j) M +
      (if i = p.1 then F p.1 p.2 else 0)) fun i _ => e i, fsum_add, fsum_spike _ _ M h1]

Foundations.Categories.Equivalence.unitI:
/-- The unit, packaged as a natural isomorphism `𝟭 ≅ F ⋙ G`. -/
def unitIso (e : Equivalence C D) : NatIso (Functor.id C) (e.functor.comp e.inverse) where
  hom := ⟨fun X => (e.unit X).hom, fun f => e.unit_nat f⟩
  inv := ⟨fun X => (e.unit X).inv, fun {X X'} f => by
    show e.inverse.map (e.functor.map f) ≫ (e.unit X').inv = (e.unit X).inv ≫ f
    rw [← Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc (e.unit X) (e.inverse.map (e.functor.map f) ≫ _),
      ← assoc (e.unit X).hom, ← e.unit_nat f, assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, comp_id]⟩
  hom_inv_id X := (e.unit X).hom_inv_id
  inv_hom_id X := (e.unit X).inv_hom_id
Foundations.Sets.WellOrdering.well_order:
/-- **Zermelo's well-ordering theorem.** Every type `α` carries a well-ordering:
a strict total order `lt` in which every non-empty part has a least element.
Proved from Zorn's lemma. -/
theorem well_ordering_theorem (α : Type u) :
    ∃ lt : α → α → Prop, (∀ x, ¬ lt x x) ∧ (∀ x y z, lt x y → lt y z → lt x z) ∧
      (∀ x y, lt x y ∨ x = y ∨ lt y x) ∧
      (∀ S : α → Prop, (∃ x, S x) → ∃ m, S m ∧ ∀ y, S y → ¬ lt y m) := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Zorn.zorn (r := @Extends α) extends_refl (fun _ _ _ => extends_trans)
    (fun _ _ => extends_antisymm)
    (fun C hC => ⟨unionPWO C hC, fun _ hW => extends_unionPWO C hC hW⟩)
  have hall : ∀ a, M.dom a := fun a => Classical.byContradiction fun ha => by
    have heq := hM _ (extends_append M a ha)
    have : (M.append a ha).dom a := Or.inr rfl
    rw [heq] at this
    exact ha this
  refine ⟨M.lt, M.irrefl, M.trans, fun x y => M.total x y (hall x) (hall y), fun S ⟨x, hx⟩ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hSm, _, hmin⟩ := M.wf S ⟨x, hx, hall x⟩
  exact ⟨m, hSm, fun y hy => hmin y hy (hall y)⟩
Foundations.Algebra.cauchy:
/-- **Cauchy's theorem.** If a prime `p` divides the order of a finite group `G`, then `G`
has an element of order exactly `p`. -/
theorem cauchy {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hdvd : p ∣ card G) : ∃ g : G, orderOf g = p := by
  have hp2 := hp.1
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, p = m + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
  -- The fixed-point congruence for the rotation action.
  have hcong := MulAction.count_fixed_mod (G := ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1)) hp
    (k := 1) (by rw [ZMod.card, Nat.pow_one])
  rw [card_mcKaySet] at hcong
  have h0 : card G ^ m % (m + 1) = 0 := by
    apply Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, m = j + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd hdvd _
  rw [h0] at hcong
  -- The constant necklace `(1, …, 1)` is a fixed point.
  let one : McKaySet G (m + 1) := ⟨fun _ => 1, by rw [tprod_const, one_pow]⟩
  have hone : MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) one := fun k => Subtype.ext rfl
  -- Hence there are at least `p` fixed points, and one of them is not `(1, …, 1)`.
  have hpos : 0 < count (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1))) :=
    count_pos.2 ⟨one, hone⟩
  have hge : m + 1 ≤ count (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1))) :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd hpos (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hcong)
  have hsplit := count_split (MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) (X := McKaySet G (m + 1)))
    (· = one)
  have hle : count (fun x : McKaySet G (m + 1) =>
      MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) x ∧ x = one) ≤ 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_trans (count_mono fun _ h => h.2) (Nat.le_of_eq (count_eq_self one))
  obtain ⟨x, hxfix, hxne⟩ := count_pos.1 (by omega :
    0 < count (fun x : McKaySet G (m + 1) => MulAction.IsFixed (ZMod (m + 1)) x ∧ ¬ x = one))
  -- That fixed point is a constant necklace `(g, …, g)` with `g ≠ 1` and `g ^ p = 1`.
  have hconst := Necklace.const_of_fixed x.1 (congrArg Subtype.val (hxfix ZMod.gen))
  refine ⟨x.1 0, ?_⟩
  have hx1 : x.1 = fun _ => x.1 0 := funext hconst
  have hpow : x.1 0 ^ (m + 1) = 1 := by
    have := x.2
    rw [hx1, tprod_const] at this
    exact this
  have hne1 : x.1 0 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hxne
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hx1, h]
  rcases hp.2 _ ((pow_eq_one_iff_dvd _ _).1 hpow) with h | h
  · exfalso; apply hne1
    have := pow_orderOf (x.1 0)
    rwa [h, pow_one] at this
  · exact h

Foundations.Categories.Equivalence:
/-- An **equivalence of categories**: functors `F : C ⥤ D` and `G : D ⥤ C` together with
natural isomorphisms `X ≅ G (F X)` (the unit) and `F (G Y) ≅ Y` (the counit). (We list the
components and their naturality directly; `unitIso` and `counitIso` below repackage them
as natural isomorphisms `𝟭 ≅ F ⋙ G` and `G ⋙ F ≅ 𝟭`.) -/
structure Equivalence (C : Type u₁) [Category.{v₁} C] (D : Type u₂) [Category.{v₂} D] where
  /-- The forward functor. -/
  functor : C ⥤ D
  /-- The functor back. -/
  inverse : D ⥤ C
  /-- The unit isomorphisms `X ≅ G (F X)`. -/
  unit : (X : C) → (X ≅ inverse.obj (functor.obj X))
  /-- The counit isomorphisms `F (G Y) ≅ Y`. -/
  counit : (Y : D) → (functor.obj (inverse.obj Y) ≅ Y)
  /-- Naturality of the unit. -/
  unit_nat : ∀ {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X'),
    f ≫ (unit X').hom = (unit X).hom ≫ inverse.map (functor.map f)
  /-- Naturality of the counit. -/
  counit_nat : ∀ {Y Y' : D} (g : Y ⟶ Y'),
    functor.map (inverse.map g) ≫ (counit Y').hom = (counit Y).hom ≫ g

Foundations.Logic.FO.Formula.sat_subst:
/-- **Substitution lemma.** `M, e ⊨ φ[σ]` iff `M, (n ↦ ⟦σ n⟧ₑ) ⊨ φ`: syntactic
substitution corresponds exactly to semantic re-assignment of variables. -/
theorem sat_subst : ∀ (φ : Formula L) (e : Nat → M.Dom) (σ : Nat → Term L),
    Sat M e (φ.subst σ) ↔ Sat M (fun n => (σ n).eval M e) φ
  | bot, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | eq t s, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, Term.eval_subst]
  | rel R ts, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, Term.eval_subst]
  | imp φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | conj φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | disj φ ψ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, sat_subst ψ]
  | all φ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, lift_eval]
  | ex φ, e, σ => by simp only [subst, Sat, sat_subst φ, lift_eval]
Foundations.Logic.Formula.truthTable_iff:
/-- **Correctness of truth tables.** The truth-table procedure returns `true`
exactly when the formula is a tautology. -/
theorem truthTable_iff (φ : Formula) : truthTable φ = true ↔ Tautology φ := by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hagree⟩ := Valuation.exists_row v (atoms φ)
    have hw' : eval w φ = true := by
      simp only [truthTable, List.all_eq_true] at h
      exact h w hw
    rw [← hw']
    exact eval_congr φ (fun a ha => (hagree a ha).symm)
  · intro h
    simp only [truthTable, List.all_eq_true]
    exact fun v _ => h v

/-- **Goodstein's theorem** (Goodstein 1944). Every Goodstein sequence eventually
reaches `0`. (By Kirby–Paris 1982 this is not provable in Peano arithmetic; our proof

theorem goodstein_terminates (n : Nat) : ∃ k, goodstein n k = 0 := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have h : ∀ k, goodstein n k ≠ 0 := fun k hk => hne ⟨k, hk⟩

Foundations.Algebra.kummer_commute:
/-- **Kummer radicals.** Let `K ⊆ M` contain a `p`-th root of unity `ζ ≠ 1` (`p` prime), and let
`x ∈ M` with `x^p ∈ K`. Any two automorphisms of `M` fixing `K` commute on `x`: each multiplies
`x` by a power of `ζ`. -/
theorem kummer_commute {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) {F M K : Subfield Ω} (hKM : K.le M) {ζ : Ω}
    (hζK : ζ ∈ K) (hζp : rpow ζ p = 1) (hζ1 : ζ ≠ 1) (x : M) (hxK : rpow x.1 p ∈ K)
    (a b : FieldAut F M) (ha : a.Fixes K) (hb : b.Fixes K) :
    a.toFun (b.toFun x) = b.toFun (a.toFun x) := by
  by_cases h0 : x.1 = 0
  · have : x = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
    rw [this, b.map_zero, a.map_zero, b.map_zero]
  · let Z : M := ⟨ζ, hKM _ hζK⟩
    have hmul : ∀ c : FieldAut F M, c.Fixes K → ∃ k, c.toFun x = rpow Z k * x := by
      intro c hc
      have e : rpow (c.toFun x) p = rpow x p := by
        rw [← FieldAut.map_rpow]
        exact hc _ (by rw [Subfield.coe_rpow]; exact hxK)
      have e' : rpow (c.toFun x).1 p = rpow x.1 p := by
        rw [← Subfield.coe_rpow, ← Subfield.coe_rpow, e]
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := eq_mul_of_rpow_eq hΩ hp hζp hζ1 h0 e'
      exact ⟨k, Subtype.ext (by rw [Subfield.coe_mul, Subfield.coe_rpow]; exact hk)⟩
    have hZa : a.toFun Z = Z := ha Z hζK
    have hZb : b.toFun Z = Z := hb Z hζK
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmul a ha
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmul b hb
    rw [hj, a.map_mul, FieldAut.map_rpow, hZa, hi, b.map_mul, FieldAut.map_rpow, hZb, hj]
    ac_rfl
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.n2_lt_of_bet:
/-- **Convexity of the disc**: a point between two points of the disc lies in the disc. -/
theorem n2_lt_of_bet {a b c : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hc : n2 c < 1) (h : Pt.Bet a b c) :
    n2 b < 1 := by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, t1, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  have ex : b.x = (1 - t) * a.x + t * c.x := by grind
  have ey : b.y = (1 - t) * a.y + t * c.y := by grind
  have e : n2 b = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * n2 a + 2 * (t * (1 - t)) * dot a c + t * t * n2 c := by
    unfold n2 dot; rw [ex, ey]; grind
  have htt : 0 ≤ t * (1 - t) := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t0 (by grind)
  have hd := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (two_dot_le a c) htt
  have k₁ := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt ha) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 - t)
  -- `|b|² ≤ (1−t)|a|² + t|c|² < 1`
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst ht; grind
  · have tpos : 0 < t := by grind
    have k₃ := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc tpos
    grind

Foundations.Numbers.Bisect.spec:
/-- The bisection invariant: `P` fails at each left end, holds at each right end, the intervals
are ordered, and the `n`-th interval has length `(u − l)/2ⁿ`. -/
theorem spec (n : Nat) :
    ¬ P (lo P l u n) ∧ P (hi P l u n) ∧ lo P l u n ≤ hi P l u n ∧
      (hi P l u n - lo P l u n) * 2 ^ n = u - l := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have : (2 : Q) ^ 0 = 1 := rfl
    exact ⟨hl, hu, hlu, by simp only [hi, lo, pair]; grind⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, _, _, k6⟩ := step_spec h1 h2 h3
    have : (2 : Q) ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n * 2 := rfl
    refine ⟨k1, k2, k3, ?_⟩
    show ((step P (pair P l u n)).2 - (step P (pair P l u n)).1) * 2 ^ (n + 1) = u - l
    simp only [hi, lo] at h4
    grind
Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.mul_top:
/-- **Top coefficients multiply** (list version). If `p` vanishes from index `s + 1` on and
`q` from index `t + 1` on, then the coefficient of `p·q` at `s + t` is `pₛ·qₜ`, and `p·q`
vanishes from index `s + t + 1` on. -/
theorem mul_top (q : List R) (t : Nat) (hq : ∀ n, t + 1 ≤ n → coeff q n = 0) :
    ∀ (p : List R) (s : Nat), (∀ n, s + 1 ≤ n → coeff p n = 0) →
      coeff (mul p q) (s + t) = coeff p s * coeff q t ∧
      ∀ n, s + t + 1 ≤ n → coeff (mul p q) n = 0 := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro s _
    exact ⟨by rw [show mul [] q = [] from rfl, coeff_nil, coeff_nil, zero_mul], fun n _ => rfl⟩
  | cons a p ih =>
    intro s hp
    cases s with
    | zero =>
      have hp0 : Eqv p [] := fun n => hp (n + 1) (by omega)
      have key : ∀ n, coeff (mul (a :: p) q) n = a * coeff q n := by
        intro n
        rw [coeff_mul_cons]
        cases n with
        | zero => rw [coeff_cons_zero, add_zero]
        | succ k => rw [coeff_cons_succ, coeff_mul_of_eqv_nil hp0, add_zero]
      refine ⟨by rw [Nat.zero_add, key]; rfl, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      rw [key, hq n (by omega), mul_zero]
    | succ s =>
      have hp' : ∀ n, s + 1 ≤ n → coeff p n = 0 := fun n hn => hp (n + 1) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih s hp'
      refine ⟨?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      · rw [show s + 1 + t = (s + t) + 1 by omega, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_cons_succ, ih1,
          hq _ (by omega), mul_zero, Ring.zero_add]
        rfl
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [coeff_mul_cons, coeff_cons_succ, ih2 k (by omega), hq _ (by omega), mul_zero,
          add_zero]
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.mul_assoc':
/-- Multiplication is associative. -/
theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : N.Dom) : x * y * z = x * (y * z) := by
  refine induction (P := fun z e => e 0 * e 1 * z = e 0 * (e 1 * z)) (by dfn)
    (Env.cons x fun _ => y) ?_ ?_ z
  · show x * y * 0 = x * (y * 0); rw [mul_zero', mul_zero', mul_zero']
  · intro z (ih : x * y * z = x * (y * z)); show x * y * (z + 1) = x * (y * (z + 1)); rw [mul_succ', mul_succ', ih, left_distrib']

Foundations.Logic.Derives.finite_premise:
/-- **Finiteness of derivations.** Any derivation from `Γ` uses only finitely many
premises: there is a finite list `L` of premises of `Γ` with `L ⊢ φ`. -/
theorem finite_premises {Γ φ} (h : Γ ⊢ φ) :
    ∃ L : List Formula, (∀ ψ ∈ L, Γ ψ) ∧ ofList L ⊢ φ := by
  -- Helper: discharge a hypothesis `θ` from a finite list of premises of `insert Γ θ`.
  have drop : ∀ {Γ : Theory} {θ : Formula} (L : List Formula), (∀ ψ ∈ L, insert Γ θ ψ) →
      (∀ ψ ∈ L.filter (· ≠ θ), Γ ψ) ∧ (ofList L).Subset (insert (ofList (L.filter (· ≠ θ))) θ) := by
    intro Γ θ L hL
    constructor
    · intro ψ hψ
      simp only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at hψ
      rcases hL ψ hψ.1 with h | h
      · exact absurd h hψ.2
      · exact h
    · intro ψ hψ
      by_cases e : ψ = θ
      · exact Or.inl e
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [ofList, List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hψ, e⟩)
  have sub_append_l : ∀ L₁ L₂ : List Formula, (ofList L₁).Subset (ofList (L₁ ++ L₂)) :=
    fun L₁ L₂ ψ hψ => List.mem_append_left L₂ hψ
  have sub_append_r : ∀ L₁ L₂ : List Formula, (ofList L₂).Subset (ofList (L₁ ++ L₂)) :=
    fun L₁ L₂ ψ hψ => List.mem_append_right L₁ hψ
  have all_append : ∀ {Γ : Theory} (L₁ L₂ : List Formula), (∀ ψ ∈ L₁, Γ ψ) →
      (∀ ψ ∈ L₂, Γ ψ) → ∀ ψ ∈ L₁ ++ L₂, Γ ψ := by
    intro Γ L₁ L₂ h₁ h₂ ψ hψ
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hψ with h | h
    · exact h₁ ψ h
    · exact h₂ ψ h
  induction h with
  | @hyp Γ φ hφ => exact ⟨[φ], by simpa using hφ, hyp (by simp [ofList])⟩
  | @impI Γ φ ψ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := drop L hL
      exact ⟨_, h₁, impI (hd.weaken h₂)⟩
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      exact ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, all_append _ _ hL₁ hL₂,
        impE (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken (sub_append_r _ _))⟩
  | conjI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      exact ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, all_append _ _ hL₁ hL₂,
        conjI (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken (sub_append_r _ _))⟩
  | conjE₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, conjE₁ hd⟩
  | conjE₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, conjE₂ hd⟩
  | disjI₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, disjI₁ hd⟩
  | disjI₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, disjI₂ hd⟩
  | @disjE Γ φ ψ χ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
      obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, hd₁⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, hd₂⟩ := ih₂
      obtain ⟨L₃, hL₃, hd₃⟩ := ih₃
      obtain ⟨h₂a, h₂b⟩ := drop L₂ hL₂
      obtain ⟨h₃a, h₃b⟩ := drop L₃ hL₃
      refine ⟨L₁ ++ (L₂.filter (· ≠ φ) ++ L₃.filter (· ≠ ψ)),
        all_append _ _ hL₁ (all_append _ _ h₂a h₃a), ?_⟩
      refine disjE (hd₁.weaken (sub_append_l _ _)) (hd₂.weaken ?_) (hd₃.weaken ?_)
      · exact h₂b.trans (insert_mono ((sub_append_l _ _).trans (sub_append_r _ _)) _)
      · exact h₃b.trans (insert_mono ((sub_append_r _ _).trans (sub_append_r _ _)) _)
  | botE _ ih => obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih; exact ⟨L, hL, botE hd⟩
  | @raa Γ φ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨L, hL, hd⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := drop L hL
      exact ⟨_, h₁, raa (hd.weaken h₂)⟩

/-- The census of tuples has no repetitions. -/
theorem nodup_tuples (L : List α) (hL : L.Nodup) : ∀ n, (tuples L n).Nodup

      obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := hx'
      exact hab (congrFun hg 0).symm

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.ofR:
/-- The cut of a Cauchy real `x`: the rationals below `x`. -/
def ofR (x : R) : Cut where
  lower q := R.ofQ q < x
  nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := R.archimedean (-x)
    refine ⟨-(n : Q) - 1, ?_⟩
    have : R.ofQ (-(n : Q) - 1) = -(n : R) - 1 := rfl
    rw [this]; grind
  bounded := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := R.archimedean x
    exact ⟨n, by have : R.ofQ (n : Q) = (n : R) := rfl
                 rw [this]; grind⟩
  down h h' := by have := R.ofQ_lt.2 h'; grind

Foundations.Combinatorics.infinite_pigeo:
/-- **The infinite pigeonhole principle.** If infinitely many points are mapped into
finitely many holes (values `< k`), some hole receives infinitely many points. -/
theorem infinite_pigeonhole (k : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, f i < k) :
    ∃ c, c < k ∧ InfOften fun i => f i = c := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  -- every value `c < k` stops occurring beyond some bound; take a common bound
  have hbound : ∀ k', k' ≤ k → ∃ N, ∀ i, N ≤ i → k' ≤ f i := by
    intro k'
    induction k' with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩
    | succ k' ih =>
      intro hk'
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hnot : ¬ InfOften fun i => f i = k' := fun h => hno ⟨k', by omega, h⟩
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ : ∃ N₂, ∀ i, N₂ ≤ i → f i ≠ k' :=
        Classical.byContradiction fun hc => hnot fun N =>
          Classical.byContradiction fun hc' => hc ⟨N, fun i hi he => hc' ⟨i, hi, he⟩⟩
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      have h₁ := hN₁ i (by omega)
      have h₂ := hN₂ i (by omega)
      omega
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hbound k (Nat.le_refl _)
  have := hN N (Nat.le_refl _)
  have := hf N
  omega
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.ch_mul:
/-- Clearing the denominators of `ch`: `s_x s_z ch(x, z) = 1 − x·z`. -/
theorem ch_mul {x z : Pt R} (hx : n2 x < 1) (hz : n2 z < 1) : s x * s z * ch x z = 1 - dot x z := by
  obtain ⟨sx, -⟩ := s_spec hx
  obtain ⟨sz, -⟩ := s_spec hz
  have : s x * s z ≠ 0 := by have := OrderedRing.mul_pos sx sz; grind
  unfold ch
  grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.abs_pow:
/-- `|xⁿ| = |x|ⁿ`. -/
theorem abs_pow (x : R) (n : Nat) : abs (x ^ n) = abs x ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show abs (1 : R) = 1; exact abs_of_nonneg (by grind)

Foundations.Logic.Computability.CompB.ba:
/-- **Closure under bounded quantification.** -/
theorem CompB.ballLt {q : Nat → Bool} {m : Nat → Nat} (hq : CompB q) (hm : Comp m) :
    CompB fun n => Computability.ballLt q n (m n) := by
  have := Comp.natRec (Comp.const 1)
    (Comp.mul (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id))
      (Comp.comp hq (Comp.pair (Comp.fst Comp.id) (Comp.fst (Comp.snd Comp.id))))) hm
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  generalize m n = k
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [Computability.natRec, fst_pair, snd_pair, ih, Computability.ballLt]
      cases Computability.ballLt q n k <;> cases q (pair n k) <;> rfl

Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ON.acc_oadd:
/-- **The key lemma**: if `a` and `b` are accessible and `ω^a + b` is normal, then
`ω^a + b` is accessible. -/
theorem acc_oadd {a : ON} (ha : Acc R a) : ∀ {b}, Acc R b → NF (oadd a b) → Acc R (oadd a b) := by
  induction ha with
  | intro a _ iha =>
    intro b hb
    induction hb with
    | intro b hbacc ihb =>
      intro _
      -- every normal `y < ω^a + b` is accessible, by structural induction on `y`
      have key : ∀ y, NF y → lt y (oadd a b) → Acc R y := by
        intro y
        induction y with
        | zero => intro _ _; exact acc_zero
        | oadd a' b' _ ihb' =>
            intro hy hlt
            cases hy with
            | oadd ha' hb' hcond =>
              rcases lt_oadd.1 hlt with h | ⟨rfl, h⟩
              · -- leading exponent smaller
                have hb'acc : Acc R b' := by
                  refine ihb' hb' ?_
                  cases b' with
                  | zero => exact zero_lt_oadd _ _
                  | oadd a'' c =>
                      refine lt_oadd.2 (Or.inl ?_)
                      rcases le_of_not_lt (hcond a'' c rfl) with rfl | h'
                      · exact h
                      · exact lt_trans h' h
                exact iha a' ⟨ha', h⟩ hb'acc (NF.oadd ha' hb' hcond)
              · -- same exponent, smaller remainder
                exact ihb b' ⟨hb', h⟩ (NF.oadd ha' hb' hcond)
      exact ⟨_, fun y ⟨hy, hlt⟩ => key y hy hlt⟩

/-- **A monoid is a category with one object**: the arrows `⋆ ⟶ ⋆` are the elements, and
composition is multiplication (`f ≫ g = g * f`, as for composing functions). -/
instance SingleObj.category (M : Type u) [Monoid' M] : Category.{u} (SingleObj M) where
  Hom _ _ := M
  id _ := (1 : M)
  comp f g := (g * f : M)

  comp_id f := Monoid'.one_mul f
  assoc f g h := (Monoid'.mul_assoc h g f).symm

Foundations.Logic.FO.tsub_tcode:
/-- Correctness of `tsub`. -/
theorem tsub_tcode (mode : Nat) (t : Term Arith) (d : Nat) :
    ∀ s : Term Arith, tsub (pair mode (pair (tcode t) d)) (tcode s) =
      tcode (s.subst (liftN d (sigma mode t))) := by
  intro s
  induction s using Term.arith_induction with
  | hv n => simp [tsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, tsubStep, Term.subst, tvar_spec]
  | hz => simp [tsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, tsubStep]
  | hs t ih =>
      simp only [tsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, tsubStep, tcode_succ, fst_pair, snd_pair, succ_subst]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (lt_pair_of_pos (by omega))]; exact congrArg _ ih
  | ha t s iht ihs =>
      simp only [tsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, tsubStep, tcode_add, fst_pair, snd_pair, add_subst]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
      exact pair_congr3 (iht) (ihs)
  | hm t s iht ihs =>
      simp only [tsub, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, tsubStep, tcode_mul, fst_pair, snd_pair, mul_subst]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
      exact pair_congr3 (iht) (ihs)

Foundations.Categories.faithful_of_unit:
/-- If `X ≅ G (F X)` naturally, then `F` is faithful: `f` can be recovered from
`G (F f)` by conjugating with the isomorphisms. -/
theorem faithful_of_unit {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (η : (X : C) → (X ≅ G.obj (F.obj X)))
    (nat : ∀ {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X'), f ≫ (η X').hom = (η X).hom ≫ G.map (F.map f)) :
    Faithful F := by
  constructor
  intro X Y f g h
  have key : ∀ k : X ⟶ Y, k = (η X).hom ≫ G.map (F.map k) ≫ (η Y).inv := fun k => by
    rw [← assoc, ← nat k, assoc, (η Y).hom_inv_id, comp_id]
  rw [key f, key g, h]
Foundations.Numbers.R.nivenF_two_add:
/-- **`F'' + F = f`**: the alternating sum telescopes, and `f⁽²ⁿ⁺²⁾ = 0`. -/
theorem nivenF_two_add (a b : R) (n : Nat) (x : R) :
    nivenF a b n 2 x + nivenF a b n 0 x = poly (nivenC a b n) (2 * n + 1) x := by
  let u : Nat → R := fun j => (-1) ^ j * poly (iterD (2 * j) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x
  have h := fsum_telescope u (n + 1)
  have hz : u (n + 1) = 0 := by
    show (-1) ^ (n + 1) * poly (iterD (2 * (n + 1)) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x = 0
    unfold poly
    rw [fsum_zero' fun k => by
      rw [iterD_eq_zero (nivenC_vanish a b n) (by omega : 2 * n + 1 ≤ k + 2 * (n + 1))]; grind]
    grind
  have h0 : u 0 = poly (nivenC a b n) (2 * n + 1) x := by
    show (-1) ^ 0 * poly (iterD (2 * 0) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x = _
    show 1 * poly (nivenC a b n) (2 * n + 1) x = _; grind
  rw [hz, h0, show ∀ t : R, t - 0 = t from fun t => by grind] at h
  rw [← h]
  unfold nivenF
  rw [← fsum_add]
  apply fsum_congr
  intro j _
  show (-1) ^ j * poly (iterD (2 * j + 2) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x +
    (-1) ^ j * poly (iterD (2 * j + 0) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x =
    (-1) ^ j * poly (iterD (2 * j) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x -
    (-1) ^ (j + 1) * poly (iterD (2 * (j + 1)) (nivenC a b n)) (2 * n + 1) x
  rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 2 by omega, Nat.add_zero, pow_succ']
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.avoid4:
/-- Among `0, …, 4` some number avoids four given numbers. -/
theorem avoid4 (a b c d : Nat) : ∃ e, e < 5 ∧ e ≠ a ∧ e ≠ b ∧ e ≠ c ∧ e ≠ d :=
  if h : 0 ≠ a ∧ 0 ≠ b ∧ 0 ≠ c ∧ 0 ≠ d then ⟨0, by omega, h⟩
  else if h : 1 ≠ a ∧ 1 ≠ b ∧ 1 ≠ c ∧ 1 ≠ d then ⟨1, by omega, h⟩
  else if h : 2 ≠ a ∧ 2 ≠ b ∧ 2 ≠ c ∧ 2 ≠ d then ⟨2, by omega, h⟩
  else if h : 3 ≠ a ∧ 3 ≠ b ∧ 3 ≠ c ∧ 3 ≠ d then ⟨3, by omega, h⟩
  else ⟨4, by omega, by omega⟩
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Measu:
/-- **Measure.** (Finite.) A function `μ` on sets, non-negative on measurable sets, with
`μ ∅ = 0`, and **countably additive**: for pairwise disjoint measurable `A₀, A₁, …` the series
`Σ μ(Aₙ)` converges to `μ(⋃ Aₙ)`. Values lie in `R`, so all our measures are finite. -/
structure Measure {α : Type} (S : SigmaAlgebra α) where
  /-- The measure of a set. -/
  μ : (α → Prop) → R
  /-- Measures are non-negative. -/
  nonneg : ∀ A, S.M A → 0 ≤ μ A
  /-- The empty set has measure `0`. -/
  empty : μ (fun _ => False) = 0
  /-- Countable additivity. -/
  additive : ∀ A : Nat → α → Prop, (∀ n, S.M (A n)) →
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ x, A i x → A j x → False) →
    HasSum (fun n => μ (A n)) (μ (fun x => ∃ n, A n x))

Foundations.NumberTheory.pow_dvd_iff_le_:
/-- **Characterisation of `vₚ`.** For `m > 0`: `pᵉ ∣ m ↔ e ≤ vₚ(m)`. -/
theorem pow_dvd_iff_le_vp {p m e : Nat} (hp : 1 < p) (hm : 0 < m) : p ^ e ∣ m ↔ e ≤ vp p m := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := vp_spec hp hm
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hlt
    have h1 : p ^ (vp p m + 1) ∣ m := Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) h
    have h2 : p ^ vp p m * p ∣ p ^ vp p m * r := by rw [← Nat.pow_succ, ← hr]; exact h1
    exact hpr (Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (Nat.pow_pos (show 0 < p by omega)) h2)
  · intro h
    exact Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p h) ⟨r, hr⟩
Foundations.Algebra.ZMod.pow_gen:
/-- In `ℤ/nℤ`, the `k`-th "power" of the generator is the residue `k mod n`. -/
theorem pow_gen (k : Nat) : (val (gen ^ k : ZMod n)).val = k % n := by
  induction k with
  | zero => show (0 : Fin n).val = 0 % n; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Group.pow_succ, val_mul, ih]
    show (k % n + (Fin.ofNat n 1).val) % n = (k + 1) % n
    simp only [Fin.val_ofNat]
    rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.add_mod]

Foundations.Bridges.intuitionistic_to_cl:
/-- **Every intuitionistic derivation is a classical derivation.** If `A` is derivable
from `Γ` in Part V's intuitionistic natural deduction, then its translation is
derivable from the translated hypotheses in Part III's classical natural deduction. -/
theorem intuitionistic_to_classical {Γ : List Ty} {A : Ty} (h : ND Γ A) :
    Logic.Derives (Logic.Theory.ofList (Γ.map toClassical)) (toClassical A) := by
  have cons_sub : ∀ (B : Ty) (L : List Ty),
      (Logic.Theory.ofList ((B :: L).map toClassical)).Subset
        (Logic.Theory.insert (Logic.Theory.ofList (L.map toClassical)) (toClassical B)) := by
    intro B L ψ hψ
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hψ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  induction h with
  | hyp hn =>
    exact Logic.Derives.hyp (List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_of_getElem? hn))
  | impI _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.impI (ih.weaken (cons_sub _ _))
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact Logic.Derives.impE ih₁ ih₂
  | andI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact Logic.Derives.conjI ih₁ ih₂
  | andE₁ _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.conjE₁ ih
  | andE₂ _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.conjE₂ ih
  | orI₁ _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.disjI₁ ih
  | orI₂ _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.disjI₂ ih
  | orE _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    exact Logic.Derives.disjE ih (ih₁.weaken (cons_sub _ _)) (ih₂.weaken (cons_sub _ _))
  | botE _ ih => exact Logic.Derives.botE ih
Foundations.Types.SystemF.HasType.tyRena:
/-- Typing is preserved by renaming type variables (in the context, term and type). -/
theorem HasType.tyRename {Γ : List Ty} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ ξ, HasType (Γ.map (Ty.rename ξ)) (Term.tyRename ξ t) (A.rename ξ) := by
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro ξ; exact .var (by simp [hn])
  | lam _ ih => intro ξ; exact .lam (ih ξ)
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro ξ; exact .app (ih₁ ξ) (ih₂ ξ)
  | @tlam Γ t A _ ih =>
    intro ξ
    have := ih (Ty.upRen ξ)
    rw [List.map_map, Ty.rename_shift, ← List.map_map] at this
    exact .tlam this
  | tapp _ ih =>
    intro ξ
    rw [Ty.rename_inst]
    exact .tapp (ih ξ)
