Foundations.Algebra.Constructible.mem_to:
/-- **Wantzel's lemma.** Every constructible number lies in a tower of quadratic extensions
of `ℚ`. -/
theorem Constructible.mem_tower {x : Ω} (h : Constructible hΩ hc x) :
    ∃ F, IsQuadTower hΩ hc F ∧ x ∈ F := by
  induction h with
  | rat hx => exact ⟨_, IsQuadTower.base, hx⟩
  | add _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    obtain ⟨F₁, h₁, hx⟩ := ih1
    obtain ⟨F₂, h₂, hy⟩ := ih2
    obtain ⟨F₃, h₃, h13, h23⟩ := h₁.common hΩ hc h₂
    exact ⟨F₃, h₃, F₃.add_mem (h13 _ hx) (h23 _ hy)⟩
  | neg _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hx⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨F, hF, F.neg_mem hx⟩
  | mul _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    obtain ⟨F₁, h₁, hx⟩ := ih1
    obtain ⟨F₂, h₂, hy⟩ := ih2
    obtain ⟨F₃, h₃, h13, h23⟩ := h₁.common hΩ hc h₂
    exact ⟨F₃, h₃, F₃.mul_mem (h13 _ hx) (h23 _ hy)⟩
  | @inv x y _ hxy ih =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hx⟩ := ih
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hΩ.1; rw [← hxy, h, Ring.zero_mul]
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hxy'⟩ := F.inv_mem hx hx0
    have : y = y' := by
      calc y = y * (x * y') := by rw [hxy', Ring.mul_one]
        _ = (x * y) * y' := by grind
        _ = y' := by rw [hxy, Ring.one_mul]
    exact ⟨F, hF, this ▸ hy'⟩
  | @sqrt x y _ hyx ih =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hx⟩ := ih
    have hs : y * y ∈ F := hyx ▸ hx
    exact ⟨_, IsQuadTower.step y hs hF, mem_adjoinSqrt_self hΩ F y hs⟩
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.recFun_isFunction:
/-- `recFun` is a function from `ω` to `A`. -/
theorem recFun_isFunction (ha : a ∈ A) (hg : ∀ x ∈ A, g x ∈ A) :
    IsFunction (recFun A a g) ω A := by
  have hcl := recFun_closed ha hg
  refine ⟨recFun_subset, omega_induction _ ?_ ?_⟩
  · -- base case: the only value at `∅` is `a`
    refine ⟨a, hcl.1, fun b hb => Classical.byContradiction fun hba => ?_⟩
    refine not_mem_recFun_of_closed ⟨?_, ?_⟩ hb
    · refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hcl.1, fun h => hba ?_⟩
      exact (kpair_inj.1 (mem_singleton.1 h)).2.symm
    · intro n y hn hny
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hcl.2 n y hn (mem_sdiff.1 hny).1, fun h => ?_⟩
      exact succ_ne_empty n (kpair_inj.1 (mem_singleton.1 h)).1
  · -- successor case: the only value at `succ n` is `g y`, where `y` is the value at `n`
    rintro n hn ⟨y, hy, huniq⟩
    refine ⟨g y, hcl.2 n y hn hy, fun c hc => Classical.byContradiction fun hcy => ?_⟩
    refine not_mem_recFun_of_closed ⟨?_, ?_⟩ hc
    · refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hcl.1, fun h => ?_⟩
      exact succ_ne_empty n (kpair_inj.1 (mem_singleton.1 h)).1.symm
    · intro m z hm hmz
      have hmzF := (mem_sdiff.1 hmz).1
      refine mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hcl.2 m z hm hmzF, fun h => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hmn, hzc⟩ := kpair_inj.1 (mem_singleton.1 h)
      have hmn' : m = n := succ_injective hmn
      subst hmn'
      rw [huniq z hmzF] at hzc
      exact hcy hzc.symm

Foundations.Numbers.C.fta:
/-- **The fundamental theorem of algebra.** Every non-constant polynomial with complex
coefficients has a complex root: if some coefficient of `t` is non-zero, the polynomial
`c₀ + z · t(z)` (coefficient list `c₀ :: t`) vanishes somewhere. -/
theorem fta (c : C) (t : List C) (ht : NonZero t) : ∃ z, peval (c :: t) z = 0 := by
  let g : C → R := fun z => cabs (peval (c :: t) z)
  have hpev : ∀ z, peval (c :: t) z = c + z * peval t z := fun _ => rfl
  -- Far out, `|p(z)| ≥ |z t(z)| − |c|` is large.
  have hfar : ∀ B : R, ∃ ρ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ ∀ z, ρ ≤ cabs z → B ≤ g z := fun B => by
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, h⟩ := growth t ht (B + cabs c)
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have k := h z hz
    have k1 := cabs_add (c + z * peval t z) (-c)
    rw [show c + z * peval t z + -c = z * peval t z by grind, cabs_neg] at k1
    show B ≤ cabs (peval (c :: t) z); rw [hpev]; grind
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρ'⟩ := hfar (g 0)
  -- The minimum on the square is a global minimum.
  obtain ⟨zs, hzs, hmin⟩ := exists_min_on_square (g := g) hρ (fun z => cabs_nonneg _)
    (fun z₀ => continuous_cabs_peval (c :: t) z₀)
  have h0 : InSq ρ 0 := ⟨by rw [zero_re, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ, by rw [zero_im, R.abs_zero]; exact hρ⟩
  have hglob : ∀ z, g zs ≤ g z := fun z => by
    by_cases hz : InSq ρ z
    · exact hmin z hz
    · have : ρ ≤ cabs z := by
        unfold InSq at hz
        have := abs_re_le_cabs z; have := abs_im_le_cabs z
        rcases (by grind : ρ < abs z.re ∨ ρ < abs z.im) with h | h <;> grind
      have := hρ' z this; have := hmin 0 h0; grind
  refine ⟨zs, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  -- Expand `p` around `zs`: `p(zs + w) = q(w)`.
  have hq := peval_pshift zs (c :: t)
  generalize hQ : pshift zs (c :: t) = q at hq
  cases q with
  | nil =>
    have := hq 0; rw [show zs + 0 = zs by grind] at this; exact hne this.symm
  | cons b₀ tq =>
    have hb₀ : b₀ = peval (c :: t) zs := by
      have := hq 0; rw [show zs + 0 = zs by grind] at this
      rw [← this]; show b₀ = b₀ + 0 * peval tq 0; grind
    -- `q` is not constant, because `p` is not.
    have htq : NonZero tq := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
      obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, h₂⟩ := hfar (cabs b₀ + 1)
      have k := h₂ (ofReal ρ₂) (by rw [cabs_ofReal hρ₂]; exact Std.le_refl _)
      have := hq (ofReal ρ₂ - zs)
      rw [show zs + (ofReal ρ₂ - zs) = ofReal ρ₂ by grind] at this
      have hv : peval (b₀ :: tq) (ofReal ρ₂ - zs) = b₀ := by
        show b₀ + _ * peval tq _ = b₀; rw [peval_of_not_nonZero hno]; grind
      rw [hv] at this
      have : g (ofReal ρ₂) = cabs b₀ := by show cabs (peval (c :: t) _) = _; rw [← this]
      grind
    obtain ⟨j, b, rest, hb, hdec⟩ := exists_lowest tq htq
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := dalembert (b₀ := b₀) (b := b) (k := j + 1)
      (by rw [hb₀]; exact hne) hb (by omega) (fun w => peval rest w)
      (fun w hw => cabs_peval_le rest hw)
    have := hq w
    have e : peval (b₀ :: tq) w = b₀ + w ^ (j + 1) * (b + w * peval rest w) := by
      show b₀ + w * peval tq w = _; rw [hdec]; show _ = b₀ + w ^ j * w * _; grind
    rw [e] at this
    rw [this, hb₀] at hw
    have := hglob (zs + w)
    exact absurd hw (by show ¬ (g (zs + w) < g zs); grind)
Foundations.Logic.Valuation.exists_row:
/-- **Truth tables are exhaustive.** For any valuation `v` and list of atoms `l`
there is a row of the truth table for `l` agreeing with `v` on every atom of `l`. -/
theorem exists_row (v : Valuation) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, ∃ w ∈ rows l, ∀ a ∈ l, w a = v a
  | [] => ⟨fun _ => false, by simp [rows], by simp⟩
  | a :: l => by
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hagree⟩ := exists_row v l
      refine ⟨update w a (v a), ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [rows, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
        refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
        cases v a <;> simp
      · intro b hb
        simp only [update]
        by_cases hba : b = a
        · simp [hba]
        · simp only [hba, ite_false]
          simp only [List.mem_cons, hba, false_or] at hb
          exact hagree b hb

Foundations.Geometry.Klein.s_spec:
/-- Inside the disc, `s a` is the positive square root of `1 − |a|²`. -/
theorem s_spec {a : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) : 0 < s a ∧ s a * s a = 1 - n2 a := by
  have h : 0 ≤ 1 - n2 a := by grind
  have hs : s a = Classical.choose (R.exists_sqrt h) := by unfold s; simp [h]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (R.exists_sqrt h)
  rw [← hs] at h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨?_, h₂⟩
  rcases Std.le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h₁ with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · rw [← h'] at h₂; grind

/-- **Hall's condition** for the subfamily `J`: every subfamily `I ⊆ J` has at least
`|I|` elements in its union. -/
def HallCond (J : Nat → Prop) (A : Nat → Nat → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ I : Nat → Prop, (∀ i, i < N → I i → J i) → cnt I N ≤ cnt (union N A I) M

/-- Left cancellation: `a * b = a * c` implies `b = c`. -/
theorem mul_left_cancel {a b c : G} (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c := by
  calc b = a⁻¹ * (a * b) := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (a * c) := by rw [h]
    _ = c := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]

Foundations.Algebra.RingHom.map_isum:
/-- Ring homomorphisms preserve finite sums over finite types. -/
theorem RingHom.map_isum {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (σ : RingHom A B)
    {ι : Type w} [FiniteType ι] (f : ι → A) : σ.toFun (isum f) = isum (fun i => σ.toFun (f i)) := by
  unfold isum
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => exact σ.map_zero
  | cons a l ih =>
    show σ.toFun (f a + lsum (l.map f)) = σ.toFun (f a) + lsum (l.map fun i => σ.toFun (f i))
    rw [σ.map_add, ih]

/-- **Membership is well defined on equivalence classes**: replacing either side
by an equivalent pre-set does not change whether membership holds. -/
theorem mem_congr {x x' y y' : PSet} (hx : Equiv x x') (hy : Equiv y y') :
    x ∈ y ↔ x' ∈ y' :=
  ⟨fun h => mem_of_equiv_right hy (mem_of_equiv_left hx h),
   fun h => mem_of_equiv_right hy.symm (mem_of_equiv_left hx.symm h)⟩
Foundations.Geometry.exists_below_of_sq_:
/-- Above a positive `r` with `r² > 2` there is room: some `0 < r' < r` still has
`r'² > 2`. -/
theorem exists_below_of_sq_gt_two {r : K} (hr : 0 < r) (h : 2 < r * r) :
    ∃ r', 0 < r' ∧ r' < r ∧ 2 < r' * r' := by
  have hr' : 2 * r ≠ 0 := by grind
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, δ = (r * r - 2) / (2 * r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e : δ * (2 * r) = r * r - 2 := by rw [hδ]; grind
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    rw [hδ, Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind) (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (by grind))
  have hδr : δ < r := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hn
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : r ≤ δ) (by grind : (0 : K) ≤ r)
    grind
  have hsq := OrderedRing.mul_pos hδpos hδpos
  exact ⟨r - δ, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.isQModel_of_sat:
/-- A structure satisfying the axioms of `Q` (under some environment) is a model of
`Q` in the sense of `IsQModel` (the axioms are closed). -/
theorem isQModel_of_sat {e : Nat → M.Dom} (h : ∀ ψ, Q ψ → Sat M e ψ) : IsQModel M where
  succ_ne_zero := fun x => by have := h _ Q.succ_ne_zero x; simpa [Sat, Env.cons, neg] using this
  succ_inj := fun x y => by have := h _ Q.succ_inj x y; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
  zero_or_succ := fun x => by have := h _ Q.zero_or_succ x; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
  add_zero := fun x => by have := h _ Q.add_zero x; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
  add_succ := fun x y => by have := h _ Q.add_succ x y; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
  mul_zero := fun x => by have := h _ Q.mul_zero x; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
  mul_succ := fun x y => by have := h _ Q.mul_succ x y; simpa [Sat, Env.cons] using this
Foundations.Algebra.galois_fixedField:
/-- **The fixed field of the Galois group is the base field.** If `L/K` is Galois, then the
elements of `L` fixed by every automorphism in `Aut(L/K)` are exactly the elements of `K`. -/
theorem galois_fixedField (hΩ : IsField Ω) {K L : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L)
    (hG : IsGalois K L hKL) : ∀ x, x ∈ fixedField L (fun _ : FieldAut K L => True) → x ∈ K := by
  obtain ⟨hfin, n, σ, hdist, hall, hn⟩ := hG
  have hone : ∃ i, σ i = 1 := hall 1
  have hmul : ∀ i j, ∃ k, σ k = σ i * σ j := fun i j => hall _
  obtain ⟨hfinF, hdeg⟩ := artin σ hΩ hdist hone hmul
  have hKF : K.le (famFix σ) := le_fixedField hKL _
  have hle := le_of_deg_eq hΩ hKF (famFix_le σ) hKL hfin hfinF (by rw [hdeg, hn])
  intro x ⟨hx, hfx⟩
  exact hle x ⟨hx, fun τ _ => hfx τ trivial⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.Structure:
/-- **First-order structure** for a signature `L`: a domain together with
interpretations of the function and relation symbols. (The domain is not required
to be non-empty here. Satisfaction and semantic consequence are always relative to an
environment, which supplies elements; the notion of being a *model* (`IsModel`)
explicitly demands a non-empty domain.) -/
structure Structure (L : Signature) where
  /-- The domain of individuals. -/
  Dom : Type
  /-- Interpretation of each `n`-ary function symbol as an `n`-ary function. -/
  funcs : {n : Nat} → L.Func n → (Fin n → Dom) → Dom
  /-- Interpretation of each `n`-ary relation symbol as an `n`-ary relation. -/
  rels : {n : Nat} → L.Rel n → (Fin n → Dom) → Prop

theorem halts_iff_kleeneT (c : Code) (m : Nat) :

    exact ⟨t, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨traceOut t, (kleene_normal_form c [m] _).2 ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩

Foundations.Logic.FO.extendH_decides:
/-- Each processed formula was either accepted with its witnesses, or rejected
because it is inconsistent with part of the result. -/
theorem extendH_decides : ∀ (l A : List (Formula L)) (ψ : Formula L), ψ ∈ l →
    ∃ A' : List (Formula L), (∀ χ ∈ A', χ ∈ extendH hΓ₀ A l) ∧
      ((∀ χ ∈ henkinAdd hΓ₀ A' ψ, χ ∈ extendH hΓ₀ A l) ∨
        ¬ Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A'))))
  | [], _, _, h => by simp at h
  | θ :: l, A, ψ, h => by
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · refine ⟨A, fun χ hχ => ?_, ?_⟩
        · unfold extendH; split
          · exact subset_extendH hΓ₀ l _ χ (List.mem_append_right _ hχ)
          · exact subset_extendH hΓ₀ l _ χ hχ
        · unfold extendH
          by_cases hc : Consistent (union Γ₀ (ofList (ψ :: A)))
          · left; intro χ hχ; simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte]
            exact subset_extendH hΓ₀ l _ χ (List.mem_append_left _ hχ)
          · right; exact hc
      · unfold extendH
        exact extendH_decides l _ ψ h
Foundations.Numbers.nat_to_real_embeddin:
/-- **The chain ℕ ⊂ ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ.** The composite embedding of the natural numbers into the reals
is injective and preserves addition and multiplication. -/
theorem nat_to_real_embedding :
    let ι : Nat → R := fun n => R.ofQ (zToQ (natToZ n))
    (∀ a b, ι (a + b) = ι a + ι b) ∧ (∀ a b, ι (a * b) = ι a * ι b) ∧
    (∀ a b, ι a = ι b → a = b) := by
  intro ι
  obtain ⟨_, _, hz1, hz2, _, hz3⟩ := natToZ_embedding
  obtain ⟨_, _, hq1, hq2, _, hq3⟩ := zToQ_embedding
  obtain ⟨_, _, hr1, hr2, _, hr3⟩ := ofQ_embedding
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_, fun a b h => hz3 _ _ (hq3 _ _ (hr3 _ _ h))⟩
  · show R.ofQ (zToQ (natToZ (a + b))) = _
    rw [hz1, hq1, hr1]
  · show R.ofQ (zToQ (natToZ (a * b))) = _
    rw [hz2, hq2, hr2]
Foundations.Algebra.dim_le_card:
/-- A spanning family has at least `dim K V` members. -/
theorem dim_le_card (hF : IsField K) (hfin : FinDim K V) {ι : Type w} [FiniteType ι]
    {u : ι → V} (hu : Spans K u) : dim K V ≤ card ι := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, _⟩ := exists_basis hF hfin
  have := steinitz hF b (fun j : Fin (card ι) => u (ofFin j)) hb
    (fun i => inSpan_ofFin.2 (hu (b i)))
  rwa [card_fin, card_fin] at this

  have hn : normSq z ≠ 0 := fun h => hz (normSq_eq_zero h)

Foundations.Algebra.Iso.trans:
/-- Composition of isomorphisms. -/
def trans (e : G ≃* H) (e' : H ≃* K) : G ≃* K :=
  { Hom.comp e'.toHom e.toHom with
    invFun := fun z => e.invFun (e'.invFun z)
    left_inv := fun x => by
      show e.invFun (e'.invFun (e'.toFun (e.toFun x))) = x
      rw [e'.left_inv, e.left_inv]
    right_inv := fun z => by
      show e'.toFun (e.toFun (e.invFun (e'.invFun z))) = z
      rw [e.right_inv, e'.right_inv] }

Foundations.Numbers.R.ftc2:
/-- **Fundamental theorem of calculus, part II.** If `F' = f` on `[a, b]` and `f` has integral
`I` over `[a, b]`, then `I = F b − F a`. -/
theorem ftc2 {F f : R → R} {a b I : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hd : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ b → HasDerivAt F (f t) t) (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    I = F b - F a := by
  apply eq_of_abs_lt_all
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hI.2 ε hε
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hm⟩ := exists_tagged hab hδ
  obtain ⟨l', hl', hm', hsum⟩ := exists_telescoping_tags l a hl hd
  have := h l' hl' (hm' δ hm)
  rw [hsum, abs_sub_comm] at this
  exact this
Foundations.Numbers.R.arccos_spec:
/-- `arccos x ∈ [0, π]` and `cos (arccos x) = x` for `x ∈ [−1, 1]`. -/
theorem arccos_spec {x : R} (h1 : -1 ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ arccos x ∧ arccos x ≤ pi ∧ cos (arccos x) = x := by
  unfold arccos
  rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true ⟨h1, h2⟩)]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_arccos h1 h2)

      z.eval stdModel e = gbeta (A.eval stdModel e) (B.eval stdModel e) (i.eval stdModel e) := by

Foundations.Types.Lambda.cons:

Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.replacement_rel:
/-- **Replacement for functional relations.** If a relation `R` assigns to each
member of `s` exactly one set, then the collection of all assigned sets is a set.
This is the textbook form of the replacement schema. -/
theorem replacement_rel (R : ZFSet → ZFSet → Prop) (s : ZFSet)
    (hR : ∀ z ∈ s, ∃ y, R z y ∧ ∀ y', R z y' → y' = y) :
    ∃ t : ZFSet, ∀ y, y ∈ t ↔ ∃ z ∈ s, R z y := by
  classical
  let f : ZFSet → ZFSet := fun z => if h : z ∈ s then Classical.choose (hR z h) else ∅
  refine ⟨image f s, fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    simp only [f, hz, dite_true]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hR z hz)).1
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    simp only [f, hz, dite_true]
    exact ((Classical.choose_spec (hR z hz)).2 y hzy).symm
Foundations.Logic.FO.Comp.shiftNC:
/-- Iterated shifting on codes is computable. -/
theorem Comp.shiftNC {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => FO.shiftNC (f n) (g n) := by
  have := Comp.natRec hg (Comp.shiftC (Comp.snd (Comp.snd Comp.id))) hf
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  unfold FO.shiftNC
  generalize f n = k
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [natRec, snd_pair] at ih ⊢; rw [ih]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.exists_wellOrdere:
/-- **Hartogs' theorem, type form.** For every type `α` there is a well-ordered type
(a strict, total, well-founded order) that does not inject into `α`. -/
theorem exists_wellOrdered_not_le (α : Type) :
    ∃ (H : Type 1) (lt : H → H → Prop), (∀ x y z, lt x y → lt y z → lt x z) ∧
      (∀ x y, lt x y ∨ x = y ∨ lt y x) ∧ WellFounded lt ∧ ¬ CardLE H α := by
  refine ⟨{z // z ∈ hartogs α}, fun x y => x.1 ∈ y.1, fun x y z hxy hyz => ?_,
    fun x y => ?_, ?_, hartogs_not_injective α⟩
  · exact ((hartogs_isOrdinal α).mem z.2).mem_trans hxy hyz
  · rcases ordinal_trichotomy ((hartogs_isOrdinal α).mem x.2) ((hartogs_isOrdinal α).mem y.2)
      with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  · have key : ∀ z : ZFSet, ∀ hz : z ∈ hartogs α,
        Acc (fun x y : {z // z ∈ hartogs α} => x.1 ∈ y.1) ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
      mem_induction _ (fun z ih hz => ⟨_, fun y hy => ih y.1 hy y.2⟩)
    exact ⟨fun x => key x.1 x.2⟩

/-- `k` existential quantifiers, each bounded by the variable that has index `wi`
just outside the block. -/
def bexN : Nat → Nat → Formula Arith → Formula Arith

Foundations.Sets.lt_powerType:
/-- **α < 𝒫(α).** Every type injects into its power type `α → Prop`
(via `a ↦ {a}`), but no function from `α → Prop` back into `α` is injective. -/
theorem lt_powerType (α : Type _) :
    (∃ f : α → (α → Prop), Function.Injective f) ∧ ¬ ∃ g : (α → Prop) → α, Function.Injective g := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun a x => x = a, fun a b h => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have := congrFun h a
    simp only [eq_iff_iff, true_iff] at this
    exact this.symm ▸ rfl
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_surjective_of_injective hg (fun _ => False)
    exact cantor_type ⟨f, hf⟩

Foundations.Numbers.Cut.le_total:
/-- The order on cuts is linear (this uses classical logic). -/
theorem le_total (A B : Cut) : A ≤ B ∨ B ≤ A := by
  by_cases h : A ≤ B
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    have : ∃ q, A.lower q ∧ ¬ B.lower q := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
      exact h fun q hq => Classical.byContradiction fun hb => hno ⟨q, hq, hb⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqA, hqB⟩ := this
    intro b hb
    exact A.down hqA (lt_of_mem hb hqB)

/-- Good nodes are nodes. -/

Foundations.Logic.completeness:
/-- **Completeness theorem** (strong form, for arbitrary sets of premises).
If `φ` is a semantic consequence of `Γ`, then `φ` is derivable from `Γ` in natural
deduction: `Γ ⊨ φ → Γ ⊢ φ`. -/
theorem completeness {Γ : Theory} {φ : Formula} (h : Γ ⊨ φ) : Γ ⊢ φ := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hn => ?_
  have hc : Consistent (insert Γ (neg φ)) := fun hb => hn (Derives.raa hb)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := satisfiable_of_consistent hc
  have h₁ := h v (fun ψ hψ => hv ψ (Or.inr hψ))
  have h₂ := hv (neg φ) (Or.inl rfl)
  simp [h₁] at h₂

Foundations.Numbers.R.cos_neg_sin_neg:
/-- **Cosine is even, sine is odd**: `cos (−x) = cos x`, `sin (−x) = −sin x`. -/
theorem cos_neg_sin_neg (x : R) : cos (-x) = cos x ∧ sin (-x) = -sin x := by
  have h1 := sin_add x (-x)
  have h2 := cos_add x (-x)
  rw [show x + -x = 0 by grind, sin_zero] at h1
  rw [show x + -x = 0 by grind, cos_zero] at h2
  have h3 := sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
  -- Solve the linear system `sin x · c + cos x · s = 0`, `cos x · c − sin x · s = 1`.
  generalize cos (-x) = c at h1 h2 ⊢
  generalize sin (-x) = s at h1 h2 ⊢
  constructor
  · have : c = c * (sin x * sin x + cos x * cos x) := by rw [h3]; grind
    grind
  · have : s = s * (sin x * sin x + cos x * cos x) := by rw [h3]; grind
    grind

/-- **Addition bridge.** `vn (m + n) = vn m +ω vn n`. -/
theorem vn_add (m n : Nat) : vn (m + n) = vn m +ω vn n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (addω_zero (vn_mem_omega m)).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, vn_succ, vn_succ, addω_succ (vn_mem_omega m) (vn_mem_omega n), ih]
Foundations.Numbers.R.continuousAt_sub:
/-- The difference of continuous functions is continuous. -/
theorem continuousAt_sub {f g : R → R} {x : R} (hf : ContinuousAt f x) (hg : ContinuousAt g x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => f y - g y) x := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg (ε / 2) (by grind)
  have hδ : ∃ δ : R, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ δ₁ ∧ δ ≤ δ₂ := by
    rcases (by grind : δ₁ ≤ δ₂ ∨ δ₂ ≤ δ₁) with h | h
    · exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, by grind, h⟩
    · exact ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := hδ
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ y (by grind)
  have k2 := h₂ y (by grind)
  have k3 := abs_add (f y - f x) (-(g y - g x))
  have e1 : f y - f x + -(g y - g x) = f y - g y - (f x - g x) := by grind
  have e2 : abs (-(g y - g x)) = abs (g y - g x) := by
    rw [show -(g y - g x) = g x - g y by grind, abs_sub_comm]
  rw [e1, e2] at k3
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.rolle_quinticR:
/-- Rolle's theorem for `q`: between two distinct roots lies a zero of `q'`. -/
theorem rolle_quinticR {a b : R} (hab : a < b) (ha : quinticR a = 0) (hb : quinticR b = 0) :
    ∃ c, a < c ∧ c < b ∧ 5 * c ^ 4 - 6 = 0 :=
  rolle (f' := fun x => 5 * x ^ 4 - 6) hab (fun x _ _ => continuousAt_quinticR x)
    (fun x _ _ => hasDerivAt_quinticR x) (by rw [ha, hb])

Foundations.NumberTheory.legendreSum_two:
/-- Each Legendre summand of `C(2n, n)` is `0` or `1`, and is `0` once `pᵏ > 2n`; so the
partial sums `D` satisfy `D ≤ K` and `p^D ≤ 2n` (unless `D = 0`). -/
theorem legendreSum_two_mul {p n : Nat} (hp : 1 < p) : ∀ K, ∃ D,
    legendreSum p (2 * n) K = 2 * legendreSum p n K + D ∧ D ≤ K ∧ (D = 0 ∨ p ^ D ≤ 2 * n) := by
  intro K
  induction K with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl, Nat.le_refl 0, Or.inl rfl⟩
  | succ K ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hDK, hDp⟩ := ih
    simp only [legendreSum]
    have hq : 0 < p ^ (K + 1) := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    rcases two_mul_div (n := n) hq with h | h
    · exact ⟨D, by rw [hD, h]; omega, by omega, hDp⟩
    · refine ⟨D + 1, by rw [hD, h]; omega, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩
      have hle : p ^ (K + 1) ≤ 2 * n := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hgt
        rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at h
        omega
      exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)) hle

Foundations.Algebra.card_primeSubfield:
/-- **The prime field has exactly `p` elements**: the residues `0, 1, …, p-1` give distinct
elements, and every multiple of `1` is one of them. -/
theorem card_primeSubfield : card {x // x ∈ primeSubfield hF hp} = p := by
  let e : Fin p → {x // x ∈ primeSubfield hF hp} := fun k => ⟨ncast k.val, k.val, rfl⟩
  have hmod : ∀ k, (ncast k : F) = ncast (k % p) := by
    intro k
    have := ncast_add (R := F) (k % p) (p * (k / p))
    rw [Nat.mod_add_div, ncast_mul, hp.2, Ring.zero_mul, Ring.add_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hinj : ∀ a b, e a = e b → a = b := by
    intro a b hab
    have h : (ncast a.val : F) = ncast b.val := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    apply Fin.ext
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · have e1 := ncast_add (R := F) a.val (b.val - a.val)
      rw [show a.val + (b.val - a.val) = b.val by omega, ← h] at e1
      exact hmin (b.val - a.val) (by omega) ⟨by omega, by grind⟩
    · have e1 := ncast_add (R := F) b.val (a.val - b.val)
      rw [show b.val + (a.val - b.val) = a.val by omega, h] at e1
      exact hmin (a.val - b.val) (by omega) ⟨by omega, by grind⟩
  have hsurj : ∀ y, ∃ k, e k = y := by
    intro ⟨y, k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨⟨k % p, Nat.mod_lt _ hp.1⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    show (ncast (k % p) : F) = y
    rw [hk]; exact (hmod k).symm
  have := count_comp_bij e hinj hsurj (fun _ => True)
  rw [count_true, count_true, card_fin] at this
  exact this.symm

Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.count_pos:
/-- A count is positive exactly when something satisfies the property. -/
theorem count_pos {P : α → Prop} : 0 < count P ↔ ∃ x, P x := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have : count P = 0 := count_eq_zero.2 fun x hx => hne ⟨x, hx⟩
    omega
  · intro ⟨x, hx⟩
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro h
    exact count_eq_zero.1 h x hx
Foundations.NumberTheory.choose_mul_fact:
/-- **The factorial formula for binomial coefficients.** `C(a + b, a) · a! · b! = (a + b)!`. -/
theorem choose_mul_fact : ∀ n a b, a + b = n → choose n a * fact a * fact b = fact n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro a b h; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by omega
            rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a b h
    cases a with
    | zero => obtain rfl : b = n + 1 := by omega
              simp [choose_zero_right, fact]
    | succ a =>
      cases b with
      | zero => obtain rfl : a = n := by omega
                simp [choose_self, fact]
      | succ b =>
        have h1 := ih a (b + 1) (by omega)
        have h2 := ih (a + 1) b (by omega)
        rw [choose_succ_succ]
        simp only [fact] at h1 h2 ⊢
        have hn : n + 1 = (a + 1) + (b + 1) := by omega
        rw [hn]
        grind

/-- **Bernoulli's theorem**: the relative frequency of success deviates from `p` by at
least `ε` with probability at most `p(1 − p)/(nε²)`. -/
theorem bernoulli_theorem {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ((bernoulli p h₀ h₁).pow n).prob (fun t => ε ≤ OF.abs (sampleSum success n t / n - p)) ≤
      p * (1 - p) / (n * (ε * ε)) := by
  have := (bernoulli p h₀ h₁).weak_law success hn hε
  rwa [E_success, Var_success] at this

Foundations.Types.STLC.HasType:
/-- The **typing judgement** `Γ ⊢ t : A`. -/
inductive HasType : Ctx → Term → Ty → Prop
  | var {Γ : Ctx} {n : Nat} {A : Ty} : Γ[n]? = some A → HasType Γ (var n) A
  | lam {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} : HasType (A :: Γ) t B → HasType Γ (lam t) (.arr A B)
  | app {Γ : Ctx} {t u : Term} {A B : Ty} :
      HasType Γ t (.arr A B) → HasType Γ u A → HasType Γ (app t u) B
  | pair {Γ : Ctx} {a b : Term} {A B : Ty} :
      HasType Γ a A → HasType Γ b B → HasType Γ (pair a b) (.prod A B)
  | fst {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} : HasType Γ t (.prod A B) → HasType Γ (fst t) A
  | snd {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} : HasType Γ t (.prod A B) → HasType Γ (snd t) B
  | inl {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} : HasType Γ t A → HasType Γ (inl t) (.sum A B)
  | inr {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} : HasType Γ t B → HasType Γ (inr t) (.sum A B)
  | case {Γ : Ctx} {t u₁ u₂ : Term} {A B C : Ty} :
      HasType Γ t (.sum A B) → HasType (A :: Γ) u₁ C → HasType (B :: Γ) u₂ C →
      HasType Γ (case t u₁ u₂) C
  | absurd {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {C : Ty} : HasType Γ t .bot → HasType Γ (absurd t) C

/-- `a < b`, as the formula `∃d. a + S d = b` (free variables `0 = a`, `1 = b`). -/

Foundations.Logic.Computability.search:
/-- **Unbounded search.** For a computable test `p`, there is a code which on input `n`
returns the *least* `t` with `p ⟨n, t⟩`, and diverges if there is none. -/
theorem search {p : Nat → Bool} (hp : CompB p) :
    ∃ c : Code, ∀ n t, Eval c [n] t ↔ p (pair n t) = true ∧ ∀ m, m < t → p (pair n m) = false := by
  obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ := CompB.not hp
  -- body on `[t, n]`: `1 - p ⟨n, t⟩`
  let body : Code := .comp cp (vec1 (pairOf (.proj 1) (.proj 0)))
  have hbody : ∀ n t, Eval body (t :: [n]) (!p (pair n t)).toNat := fun n t =>
    eval_comp1 (eval_pairOf .proj .proj) (hcp _)
  refine ⟨.mu body, fun n t => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
  · cases h with
    | mu ks h₀ hlt =>
        have e₀ := Eval.det h₀ (hbody n t)
        refine ⟨?_, fun m hm => ?_⟩
        · cases hpt : p (pair n t)
          · rw [hpt] at e₀; simp at e₀
          · rfl
        · have e := Eval.det (hlt m hm) (hbody n m)
          cases hpm : p (pair n m)
          · rfl
          · rw [hpm] at e; simp at e
  · refine .mu (fun _ => 0) ?_ (fun m hm => ?_)
    · have := hbody n t; rwa [h₁] at this
    · have := hbody n m; rwa [h₂ m hm] at this

Foundations.Logic.FO.trename_tcode:
/-- Correctness of `trename`. -/
theorem trename_tcode (d : Nat) : ∀ t : Term Arith, trename d (tcode t) = tcode (t.rename (· + d)) := by
  intro t
  induction t using Term.arith_induction with
  | hv n => simp [trename, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, trenameStep, Term.rename]
  | hz => simp [trename, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, trenameStep]
  | hs t ih =>
      simp only [trename, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, trenameStep, tcode_succ, fst_pair, snd_pair, succ_rename]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (lt_pair_of_pos (by omega))]; exact congrArg _ ih
  | ha t s iht ihs =>
      simp only [trename, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, trenameStep, tcode_add, fst_pair, snd_pair, add_rename]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
      exact pair_congr3 (iht) (ihs)
  | hm t s iht ihs =>
      simp only [trename, covRec_unfold, cvN, cvP, cvRec, trenameStep, tcode_mul, fst_pair, snd_pair, mul_rename]
      simp only [Nat.reduceBEq, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.or_false, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_true]
      rw [histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (fst_lt_tagged (by omega)),
        histGet_covHist _ _ _ _ (snd_lt_tagged (by omega))]
      exact pair_congr3 (iht) (ihs)

Foundations.Probability.natCast_le:
/-- The cast `ℕ → R` is monotone. -/
theorem natCast_le {n m : Nat} (h : n ≤ m) : (n : R) ≤ m := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  have : ((n + k : Nat) : R) = n + k := by grind
  have : (0 : R) ≤ k := by grind
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.gauss_descent:
/-- **Gauss's lemma** (by descent). If `m · F = G · H` for a positive integer `m` and integer
polynomials `G, H` with `deg G ≤ d`, `deg H ≤ e`, then `F = G' · H'` for integer polynomials with
`deg G' ≤ d`, `deg H' ≤ e`. -/
theorem gauss_descent (F : Nat → Int) (d e : Nat) :
    ∀ (m : Nat) (G H : Nat → Int), 0 < m → (∀ n, (m : Int) * F n = conv G H n) →
      SuppLE G d → SuppLE H e →
      ∃ G' H' : Nat → Int, (∀ n, F n = conv G' H' n) ∧ SuppLE G' d ∧ SuppLE H' e := by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro G H hm hF hG hH
    by_cases h1 : m = 1
    · subst h1; exact ⟨G, H, fun n => by rw [← hF n]; simp, hG, hH⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := exists_prime_factor (m := m) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := hpm
    have hp0 : 0 < p := by have := hp.1; omega
    have hm' : 0 < m' := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hm
    have hlt : m' < p * m' := by
      have := hp.1
      calc m' = 1 * m' := (Nat.one_mul m').symm
        _ < p * m' := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by omega) hm'
    -- `p` divides every coefficient of `G` or every coefficient of `H`
    have hall : (∀ k, (p : Int) ∣ G k) ∨ (∀ k, (p : Int) ∣ H k) := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno
      have hG' : ∃ i, ¬ (p : Int) ∣ G i :=
        Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno (Or.inl fun k =>
          Classical.byContradiction fun hk => h ⟨k, hk⟩)
      have hH' : ∃ j, ¬ (p : Int) ∣ H j :=
        Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno (Or.inr fun k =>
          Classical.byContradiction fun hk => h ⟨k, hk⟩)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := not_dvd_conv hp hG' hH'
      apply hn; rw [← hF n, Int.natCast_mul, Int.mul_assoc]
      exact Int.dvd_mul_right _ _
    have hpz : (p : Int) ≠ 0 := by omega
    rcases hall with hdiv | hdiv
    · let G' : Nat → Int := fun k => G k / p
      have hGG : ∀ k, G k = p * G' k := fun k => (Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (hdiv k)).symm
      refine ih m' hlt G' H hm' (fun n => ?_) (fun k hk => ?_) hH
      · apply Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpz
        have e1 : (p : Int) * conv G' H n = conv G H n := by
          unfold conv; rw [mul_zsum]
          exact zsum_congr _ fun k _ => by rw [hGG k, Int.mul_assoc]
        rw [e1, ← hF n, Int.natCast_mul, Int.mul_assoc]
      · show G k / p = 0; rw [hG k hk]; exact Int.zero_ediv _
    · let H' : Nat → Int := fun k => H k / p
      have hHH : ∀ k, H k = p * H' k := fun k => (Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (hdiv k)).symm
      refine ih m' hlt G H' hm' (fun n => ?_) hG (fun k hk => ?_)
      · apply Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpz
        have e1 : (p : Int) * conv G H' n = conv G H n := by
          unfold conv; rw [mul_zsum]
          exact zsum_congr _ fun k _ => by rw [hHH (n - k)]; ac_rfl
        rw [e1, ← hF n, Int.natCast_mul, Int.mul_assoc]
      · show H k / p = 0; rw [hH k hk]; exact Int.zero_ediv _

Foundations.Numbers.R.linPow:
/-- The coefficients of `(a − b x)ʲ`. -/
def linPow (a b : R) : Nat → Nat → R
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | j + 1, 0 => a * linPow a b j 0
  | j + 1, k + 1 => a * linPow a b j (k + 1) - b * linPow a b j k

Foundations.Categories.no_point_surjecti:
/-- **Contrapositive form (the diagonal argument).** If some `t : B ⟶ B` has no fixed
`T`-point, then no `φ : A × A ⟶ B` is point-surjective. -/
theorem no_point_surjective {A B AA T : C} {p₁ p₂ : AA ⟶ A} (hP : IsProduct A A AA p₁ p₂)
    (t : B ⟶ B) (ht : ∀ b : T ⟶ B, b ≫ t ≠ b) (φ : AA ⟶ B) :
    ¬ ∀ g : A ⟶ B, ∃ a : T ⟶ A, ∀ x : T ⟶ A, hP.lift a x ≫ φ = x ≫ g := fun hφ =>
  let ⟨b, hb⟩ := lawvere_fixed_point hP φ hφ t
  ht b hb

theorem image_insert (Γ : Theory L) (φ : Formula L) (σ : Nat → Term L) :
    ((insert Γ φ).image σ).Subset (insert (Γ.image σ) (φ.subst σ)) := by
  rintro _ ⟨χ, hχ | hχ, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [hχ])
  · exact Or.inr ⟨χ, hχ, rfl⟩
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.prob_mon:
/-- **Monotonicity**: `A ⊆ B` implies `P(A) ≤ P(B)`. -/
theorem prob_mono {A B : Event α} (h : ∀ x, A x → B x) : P.prob A ≤ P.prob B := by
  refine sumL_le fun x _ => OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (P.w_nonneg x)
  by_cases ha : A x
  · simp [ind, ha, h x ha]
  · exact (show ind A x = 0 by simp [ind, ha]) ▸ ind_nonneg B x
Foundations.Algebra.le_normalizer:
/-- `H ⊆ N(H)`. -/
theorem le_normalizer (H : Subgroup G) {g : G} (hg : g ∈ H) : g ∈ normalizer H := by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro hh; exact H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hg) hh) hg
  · intro hh
    have := H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hg hh) (H.inv_mem hg)
    have e : g * (g⁻¹ * h * g) * g⁻¹ = h := by
      simp only [Group.mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    rw [e] at this; exact this
Foundations.Topology.CFun.le_supDist:
/-- Every value `|f(x) − g(x)|` is at most the sup distance. -/
theorem le_supDist (f g : CFun a b) (x : R) : abs (f.1 x - g.1 x) ≤ supDist f g :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lub (fun t => ∃ x, t = abs (f.1 x - g.1 x)) ⟨_, 0, rfl⟩
    (by obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := bounded f g; exact ⟨M, fun t ⟨x, hx⟩ => hx ▸ hM x⟩))).1 _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
Foundations.Categories.Faithful:

structure Faithful (F : C ⥤ D) : Prop where

  map_injective : ∀ {X Y : C} {f g : X ⟶ Y}, F.map f = F.map g → f = g
Foundations.Geometry.Pt.lower_dim:
/-- (A8) **Lower dimension** in `K²`: `(0,0)`, `(1,0)`, `(0,1)` are not collinear. -/
theorem lower_dim : ∃ a b c : Pt K, ¬ Bet a b c ∧ ¬ Bet b c a ∧ ¬ Bet c a b := by
  refine ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

Foundations.Types.STLC.Step:
/-- **One-step reduction**: the β-rule for functions, the projection rules for
pairs, the case rules for sums — anywhere inside a term. -/
inductive Step : Term → Term → Prop
  | beta (t u : Term) : Step (app (lam t) u) (inst t u)
  | fstPair (a b : Term) : Step (fst (pair a b)) a
  | sndPair (a b : Term) : Step (snd (pair a b)) b
  | caseInl (t u₁ u₂ : Term) : Step (case (inl t) u₁ u₂) (inst u₁ t)
  | caseInr (t u₁ u₂ : Term) : Step (case (inr t) u₁ u₂) (inst u₂ t)
  | appL {t t' u : Term} : Step t t' → Step (app t u) (app t' u)
  | appR {t u u' : Term} : Step u u' → Step (app t u) (app t u')
  | lam {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (lam t) (lam t')
  | pairL {a a' b : Term} : Step a a' → Step (pair a b) (pair a' b)
  | pairR {a b b' : Term} : Step b b' → Step (pair a b) (pair a b')
  | fst {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (fst t) (fst t')
  | snd {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (snd t) (snd t')
  | inl {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (inl t) (inl t')
  | inr {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (inr t) (inr t')
  | case₀ {t t' u₁ u₂ : Term} : Step t t' → Step (case t u₁ u₂) (case t' u₁ u₂)
  | case₁ {t u₁ u₁' u₂ : Term} : Step u₁ u₁' → Step (case t u₁ u₂) (case t u₁' u₂)
  | case₂ {t u₁ u₂ u₂' : Term} : Step u₂ u₂' → Step (case t u₁ u₂) (case t u₁ u₂')
  | absurd {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (absurd t) (absurd t')
Foundations.Types.STLC.subst_subst:
/-- Substitutions compose. -/
theorem subst_subst (t : Term) : ∀ τ σ, subst τ (subst σ t) = subst (subst τ ∘ σ) t := by
  induction t <;> intros <;> simp only [subst, up_comp, *] <;> rfl
Foundations.Combinatorics.cnt_congr:
/-- Counting respects equivalence. -/
theorem cnt_congr {P Q : Nat → Prop} (n : Nat) (h : ∀ x, x < n → (P x ↔ Q x)) :
    cnt P n = cnt Q n :=
  Nat.le_antisymm (cnt_mono n fun x hx => (h x hx).1) (cnt_mono n fun x hx => (h x hx).2)
Foundations.Algebra.Ideal.bot:
/-- The **zero ideal** `{0}`. -/
def bot : Ideal R where
  carrier x := x = 0
  zero_mem := rfl
  add_mem := by intro a b ha hb; show a + b = 0; rw [ha, hb, add_zero]
  neg_mem := by intro a ha; show -a = 0; rw [ha, neg_zero]
  mul_mem := by intro r a ha; show r * a = 0; rw [ha, mul_zero]
Foundations.Algebra.Ideal.setoid:
/-- Congruence modulo an ideal: `a ≡ b (mod I)` iff `-a + b ∈ I`. An equivalence relation. -/
def Ideal.setoid : Setoid R where
  r a b := -a + b ∈ I
  iseqv := {
    refl := fun a => by show -a + a ∈ I; rw [neg_add_cancel]; exact I.zero_mem
    symm := fun {a b} h => by
      show -b + a ∈ I
      have := I.neg_mem h
      rwa [neg_add, neg_neg, Ring.add_comm] at this
    trans := fun {a b c} h1 h2 => by
      show -a + c ∈ I
      have := I.add_mem h1 h2
      rwa [Ring.add_assoc, add_neg_cancel_left] at this }
Foundations.Bridges.ZFHom.comp:
/-- Composition of set-theoretic functions ("first `F`, then `G`"). -/
noncomputable def ZFHom.comp {X Y Z : ZFSet} (F : ZFHom X Y) (G : ZFHom Y Z) : ZFHom X Z :=
  ⟨graphOf X Z (fun a => app G.1 (app F.1 a)),
    graphOf_isFunction fun _ ha => app_mem G.2 (app_mem F.2 ha)⟩
Foundations.Geometry.Pt.cauchy_schwarz:
/-- **The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality** in the plane: `(a − b)·(c − b) ≤ |ab| · |bc|`. -/
theorem cauchy_schwarz (a b c : Pt R) : dot a b c ≤ dist a b * dist b c := by
  apply le_of_sq_le (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (dist_nonneg a b) (dist_nonneg b c))
  have hl := lagrange a b c
  have hs := sq_nonneg' ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x))
  have e : dist a b * dist b c * (dist a b * dist b c) = d2 a b * d2 b c := by
    rw [← dist_mul_self a b, ← dist_mul_self b c]; grind
  grind
Foundations.Logic.Entails.mono:
/-- Semantic consequence is monotone: more premises, more consequences. -/
theorem Entails.mono {Γ Δ : Theory} {φ : Formula} (h : Γ ⊨ φ) (hsub : Γ.Subset Δ) :
    Δ ⊨ φ :=
  fun v hv => h v (fun ψ hψ => hv ψ (hsub ψ hψ))

  ⟨fun ⟨i⟩ => ⟨i.hom.down, i.inv.down⟩,
   fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => ⟨⟨⟨h₁⟩, ⟨h₂⟩, PreCat.hom_eq _ _, PreCat.hom_eq _ _⟩⟩⟩

Foundations.Categories.NatIso.app:

Foundations.Categories.types_equalizer:
/-- **The subtype `{x | f x = g x}` is an equaliser** in the category of types. -/
def types_equalizer {X Y : Type u} (f g : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsEqualizer f g {x : X // f x = g x} (fun x => x.1) where
  w := funext fun x => x.2
  lift k hk := fun w => ⟨k w, congrFun hk w⟩
  fac _ _ := rfl

Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.equiv_trans:
/-- Equivalence of Cauchy sequences is transitive (an `ε/2` argument). -/
theorem equiv_trans {a b c : CauSeq} (h₁ : Equiv a b) (h₂ : Equiv b c) : Equiv a c :=
  fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := h₁ (ε / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := h₂ (ε / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have := h₁ n (by omega)
    have := h₂ n (by omega)
    have := abs_add (a n - b n) (b n - c n)
    have e : a n - b n + (b n - c n) = a n - c n := by grind
    rw [e] at this
    grind

/-- The members of `ω × ω` are exactly the pairs `npair a b`. -/

Foundations.Algebra.KSubspace.coe_isum:
/-- Values of finite sums: the value of `∑ xᵢ` is `∑ (value of xᵢ)`. -/
theorem coe_isum (S : KSubspace K) {ι : Type v} [FiniteType ι] (f : ι → S) :
    (isum f).1 = isum (fun i => (f i).1) := by
  unfold isum
  induction (elems : List ι) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    show (f a).1 + (lsum (l.map f)).1 = (f a).1 + lsum (l.map fun i => (f i).1)
    rw [ih]
Foundations.Logic.Formula:
/-- **Propositional formulas.** The syntax trees of propositional logic over the
atoms `var 0, var 1, …`, built from falsum, implication, conjunction and disjunction. -/
inductive Formula : Type where
  /-- Falsum `⊥`, the absurd proposition. -/
  | bot : Formula
  /-- The `n`-th propositional variable (atom). -/
  | var : Nat → Formula
  /-- Implication `φ → ψ`. -/
  | imp : Formula → Formula → Formula
  /-- Conjunction `φ ∧ ψ`. -/
  | conj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  /-- Disjunction `φ ∨ ψ`. -/
  | disj : Formula → Formula → Formula
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
Foundations.Categories.freeForgetAdjunct:
/-- **The free monoid is left adjoint to the forgetful functor**: monoid homomorphisms
`List α ⟶ M` correspond to functions `α → M`. -/
def freeForgetAdjunction : Adjunction MonCat.free.{u} MonCat.forget.{u} where
  homEquiv α M :=
    { toFun := fun (φ : MonHom (List α) M.carrier) => fun a => φ.toFun [a]
      invFun := fun (g : α → M.carrier) => (extendHom M g : MonHom (List α) M.carrier)
      left_inv := fun (φ : MonHom (List α) M.carrier) => MonHom.ext fun (l : List α) => by
        induction l with
        | nil => exact φ.map_one.symm
        | cons a l ih =>
          show φ.toFun [a] * listProd (l.map fun a => φ.toFun [a]) = φ.toFun (a :: l)
          have := φ.map_mul [a] l
          change φ.toFun ([a] ++ l) = _ at this
          rw [List.singleton_append] at this
          rw [this]
          exact congrArg _ ih
      right_inv := fun (g : α → M.carrier) => funext fun a => Monoid'.mul_one (M := M.carrier) (g a) }
  natural_left _ _ := rfl
  natural_right _ _ := rfl

  | refl => exact hy

Foundations.Geometry.no_equilateral_rat:
/-- **Euclid I.1 fails in the rational plane.** No point with rational coordinates is
at (squared) distance `1` from both `(0, 0)` and `(1, 0)`: the two circles of Euclid's
construction do not meet in `ℚ²`. -/
theorem no_equilateral_rat :
    ¬ ∃ c : Pt Q, Pt.d2 ⟨0, 0⟩ c = 1 ∧ Pt.d2 ⟨1, 0⟩ c = 1 := by
  rintro ⟨c, h₁, h₂⟩
  unfold Pt.d2 at h₁ h₂
  dsimp only at h₁ h₂
  have hx : c.x = 1 / 2 := by grind
  exact sqrt_three_irrational ⟨2 * c.y, by rw [hx] at h₁; grind⟩
Foundations.Numbers.OF.ofRat:
/-- **The canonical embedding of ℚ into an ordered field**: the fraction `n/d` goes to
`(n·1)/(d·1)`. It does not depend on the representing fraction. -/
def ofRat : Q → K :=
  Quotient.lift (fun p : Frac => (p.num : K) / (p.den : K)) (fun p q h => by
    have h : p.num * q.den = q.num * p.den := h
    have hp := intCast_pos (K := K) p.den_pos
    have hq := intCast_pos (K := K) q.den_pos
    have := congrArg (fun z : Int => (z : K)) h
    grind)
Foundations.Algebra.clear_denominators:
/-- Clearing the denominators of a polynomial over `ℚ` of degree at most `d`: there are `N > 0` and
an integer sequence `G` supported in `[0, d]` with `N · gₖ = Gₖ` for all `k`. -/
theorem clear_denominators (g : Polynomial (ratField hΩ hc)) {d : Nat} (hg : DegLT g (d + 1)) :
    ∃ N : Int, 0 < N ∧ ∃ G : Nat → Int, SuppLE G d ∧
      ∀ k, (Int.cast N : Ω) * (coeff g k).1 = Int.cast (G k) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hk⟩ := common_denominator hΩ hc (coeff g) (d + 1)
  have hall : ∀ k, ∃ a : Int, (Int.cast N : Ω) * (coeff g k).1 = Int.cast a ∧ (d < k → a = 0) := by
    intro k
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (d + 1) with h | h
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hk k h; exact ⟨a, ha, fun h' => absurd h' (by omega)⟩
    · refine ⟨0, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      rw [hg k h, icast_zero']; exact Ring.mul_zero _
  refine ⟨N, hN, fun k => Classical.choose (hall k), fun k hk => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (hall k)).2 hk
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (hall k)).1
Foundations.Combinatorics.hall_aux:
/-- **Hall's theorem for subfamilies**, by strong induction on `|J|`. -/
theorem hall_aux : ∀ k (J : Nat → Prop) (A : Nat → Nat → Prop), cnt J N = k →
    HallCond N M J A → ∃ f, SDR N M J A f := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro J A hk hHall
  by_cases hcrit : ∃ I : Nat → Prop, (∀ i, i < N → I i → J i) ∧ (∃ i, i < N ∧ I i) ∧
      (∃ i, i < N ∧ J i ∧ ¬ I i) ∧ cnt (union N A I) M ≤ cnt I N
  · -- a critical subfamily `I`
    obtain ⟨I, hIJ, hIne, hIprop, hIcrit⟩ := hcrit
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := ih (cnt I N) (hk ▸ cnt_lt N hIJ hIprop) I A rfl
      fun I' hI' => hHall I' fun i hi h => hIJ i hi (hI' i hi h)
    let K : Nat → Prop := fun i => J i ∧ ¬ I i
    let A' : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun i x => A i x ∧ ¬ union N A I x
    have hKlt : cnt K N < k := by
      rw [← hk]
      refine cnt_lt N (fun i _ h => h.1) ?_
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hIi⟩ := hIne
      exact ⟨i, hi, hIJ i hi hIi, fun h => h.2 hIi⟩
    have hHallK : HallCond N M K A' := by
      intro L hLK
      have hLI := hHall (fun i => L i ∨ I i) fun i hi h => h.elim (fun h => (hLK i hi h).1) (hIJ i hi)
      rw [cnt_or_disjoint N fun i hi h => (hLK i hi h.1).2 h.2] at hLI
      -- `⋃(L ∪ I) = (⋃'L) ⊔ ⋃I`
      have hU : cnt (union N A fun i => L i ∨ I i) M =
          cnt (union N A' L) M + cnt (union N A I) M := by
        rw [← cnt_or_disjoint M fun x _ h => by
          obtain ⟨i, _, _, _, hx⟩ := h.1; exact hx h.2]
        refine cnt_congr M fun x _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rintro ⟨i, hi, hLIi, hAx⟩
          by_cases hx : union N A I x
          · exact Or.inr hx
          · rcases hLIi with hL | hI
            · exact Or.inl ⟨i, hi, hL, hAx, hx⟩
            · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, hI, hAx⟩
        · rintro (⟨i, hi, hL, hAx, _⟩ | ⟨i, hi, hI, hAx⟩)
          · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inl hL, hAx⟩
          · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr hI, hAx⟩
      omega
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := ih (cnt K N) hKlt K A' rfl hHallK
    refine ⟨fun i => if I i then f₁ i else f₂ i, fun i hi hJ => ?_, fun i j hi hj hJi hJj hij => ?_⟩
    · by_cases hI : I i
      · simp only [hI, ite_true]; exact hf₁.1 i hi hI
      · simp only [hI, ite_false]
        obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, -⟩ := hf₂.1 i hi ⟨hJ, hI⟩
        exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    · by_cases hIi : I i <;> by_cases hIj : I j <;> simp only [hIi, hIj, ite_true, ite_false]
      · exact hf₁.2 i j hi hj hIi hIj hij
      · intro he
        exact (hf₂.1 j hj ⟨hJj, hIj⟩).2.2 (he ▸ ⟨i, hi, hIi, (hf₁.1 i hi hIi).2⟩)
      · intro he
        exact (hf₂.1 i hi ⟨hJi, hIi⟩).2.2 (he ▸ ⟨j, hj, hIj, (hf₁.1 j hj hIj).2⟩)
      · exact hf₂.2 i j hi hj ⟨hJi, hIi⟩ ⟨hJj, hIj⟩ hij
  · -- every proper non-empty subfamily has a surplus
    by_cases hJne : ∃ i₀, i₀ < N ∧ J i₀
    · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hJi₀⟩ := hJne
      -- an element of `A i₀`
      obtain ⟨x, hxM, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x < M ∧ A i₀ x := by
        have h := hHall (fun i => i = i₀) fun i _ h => h ▸ hJi₀
        have h1 := cnt_pos (P := fun i => i = i₀) N ⟨i₀, hi₀, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hx, i, _, rfl, hAx⟩ := exists_of_cnt_pos M (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h)
        exact ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩
      let J' : Nat → Prop := fun i => J i ∧ i ≠ i₀
      let A' : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun i y => A i y ∧ y ≠ x
      have hJ'lt : cnt J' N < k := by
        rw [← hk]; exact cnt_lt N (fun i _ h => h.1) ⟨i₀, hi₀, hJi₀, fun h => h.2 rfl⟩
      have hHall' : HallCond N M J' A' := by
        intro L hLJ
        by_cases hLne : ∃ i, i < N ∧ L i
        · have hsurplus : cnt L N < cnt (union N A L) M := by
            refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => hcrit ⟨L, fun i hi h => (hLJ i hi h).1, hLne,
              ⟨i₀, hi₀, hJi₀, fun h => (hLJ i₀ hi₀ h).2 rfl⟩, hle⟩
          have hrem := cnt_remove (union N A L) x M
          have heq : cnt (fun y => union N A L y ∧ y ≠ x) M = cnt (union N A' L) M :=
            cnt_congr M fun y _ => ⟨fun ⟨⟨i, hi, hL, hA⟩, hne⟩ => ⟨i, hi, hL, hA, hne⟩,
              fun ⟨i, hi, hL, hA, hne⟩ => ⟨⟨i, hi, hL, hA⟩, hne⟩⟩
          omega
        · rw [cnt_eq_zero N fun i hi h => hLne ⟨i, hi, h⟩]; exact Nat.zero_le _
      obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := ih (cnt J' N) hJ'lt J' A' rfl hHall'
      refine ⟨fun i => if i = i₀ then x else f' i, fun i hi hJ => ?_,
        fun i j hi hj hJi hJj hij => ?_⟩
      · by_cases h : i = i₀
        · subst h; simp [hxM, hx]
        · simp only [h, ite_false]
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, -⟩ := hf'.1 i hi ⟨hJ, h⟩
          exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      · by_cases hi₀' : i = i₀ <;> by_cases hj₀' : j = i₀ <;>
          simp only [hi₀', hj₀', ite_true, ite_false]
        · exact absurd (hi₀'.trans hj₀'.symm) hij
        · exact fun he => (hf'.1 j hj ⟨hJj, hj₀'⟩).2.2 he.symm
        · exact fun he => (hf'.1 i hi ⟨hJi, hi₀'⟩).2.2 he
        · exact hf'.2 i j hi hj ⟨hJi, hi₀'⟩ ⟨hJj, hj₀'⟩ hij
    · exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun i hi hJ => absurd ⟨i, hi, hJ⟩ hJne,
        fun i _ hi _ hJ => absurd ⟨i, hi, hJ⟩ hJne⟩

/-- Evaluation respects equivalence of lists. -/
theorem evalList_congr (x : R) {p q : List R} (h : Eqv p q) : evalList x p = evalList x q := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => rw [evalList_of_eqv_nil x (fun k => (h k).symm)]; rfl
  | cons a p ih =>
    cases q with
    | nil => exact evalList_of_eqv_nil x h

Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.isBasis:
/-- `1, α, α²` is a basis of the space. -/
theorem CubicRoot.isBasis (hΩ : IsField Ω) (C : CubicRoot K α) : IsBasis K C.basis := by
  constructor
  · intro c hc
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    rw [coe_isum, isum_fin3] at h
    have h' : (c 0).1 + (c 1).1 * α + (c 2).1 * (α * α) = 0 := by
      have e : (c 0).1 * 1 + (c 1).1 * α + (c 2).1 * (α * α) = 0 := h
      grind
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := C.indep hΩ (c 0).2 (c 1).2 (c 2).2 h'
    intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => exact e0
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => exact e1
    | ⟨2, _⟩ => exact e2
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, hx⟩ := x.2
    refine ⟨fun i => if i.val = 0 then ⟨u, hu⟩ else if i.val = 1 then ⟨v, hv⟩ else ⟨w, hw⟩,
      Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_isum, isum_fin3]
    show x.1 = u * 1 + v * α + w * (α * α)
    rw [hx]; grind

Foundations.Combinatorics.findGreatest_s:
/-- `findGreatest` satisfies `P` if some value `≥ 1` up to `n` does... -/
theorem findGreatest_spec {P : Nat → Prop} : ∀ n m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ n → P m → P (findGreatest P n)
  | 0, m, h₁, h₂, _ => absurd h₂ (by omega)
  | n + 1, m, h₁, h₂, hm => by
      simp only [findGreatest]
      split
      · assumption
      · next h =>
          refine findGreatest_spec n m h₁ ?_ hm
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (n + 1) with h' | h'
          · omega
          · exact absurd (show m = n + 1 by omega ▸ hm) h
termination_by n => n
Foundations.Combinatorics.cnt_eq_le_one:
/-- A single point has count at most `1`. -/
theorem cnt_eq_le_one (a : Nat) : ∀ n, cnt (fun x => x = a) n ≤ 1
  | 0 => Nat.zero_le _

Foundations.Numbers.R.Tendsto.mul:
/-- **Limit of a product** is the product of the limits. -/
theorem Tendsto.mul {a b : Nat → R} {L M : R} (ha : Tendsto a L) (hb : Tendsto b M) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a n * b n) (L * M) := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := cauchy_bounded ha.isCauchySeq
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := Std.le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB 0)
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁c⟩ := exists_mul_le B (by grind : 0 < ε / 3)
  obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂, hη₂c⟩ := exists_mul_le M (by grind : 0 < ε / 3)
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := hb η₁ hη₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := ha η₂ hη₂
  refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hB0] at hη₁c
  have k1 := abs_mul_le (hB n) (Std.le_of_lt (h₁ n (by omega)))
  have k2 := abs_mul_le (Std.le_refl (abs M)) (Std.le_of_lt (h₂ n (by omega)))
  have k3 := abs_add (a n * (b n - M)) (M * (a n - L))
  rw [show a n * (b n - M) + M * (a n - L) = a n * b n - L * M by grind] at k3
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.chinese_remainder_ex:
/-- **Chinese remainder theorem, elementary form.** If `m` and `n` are coprime, then for any
residues `a < m` and `b < n` there is a unique `x < mn` with `x ≡ a (mod m)` and
`x ≡ b (mod n)`. -/
theorem chinese_remainder_exists_unique (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (a b : Nat) (ha : a < m)
    (hb : b < n) : ∃ x, x < m * n ∧ x % m = a ∧ x % n = b ∧
      ∀ y, y < m * n → y % m = a → y % n = b → y = x := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surjective_of_injective_card _ (crtHom_injective m n h)
    (by rw [card_prod, card_fin, card_fin, card_fin]) (⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩)
  have h1 := congrArg (fun p : Fin m × Fin n => p.1.val) hx
  have h2 := congrArg (fun p : Fin m × Fin n => p.2.val) hx
  simp only [crtHom, fin_ofNat_val] at h1 h2
  refine ⟨x.val, x.isLt, h1, h2, fun y hy hya hyb => ?_⟩
  have := crtHom_injective m n h ⟨y, hy⟩ x (by
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Fin.ext
    · show y % m = x.val % m; rw [hya, h1]
    · show y % n = x.val % n; rw [hyb, h2])
  exact congrArg Fin.val this

/-- Finite unions of measurable sets are measurable. -/
theorem measurable_unionOf {set : β → α → Prop} {l : List β} (h : ∀ b ∈ l, S.M (set b)) :
    S.M (UnionOf set l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact S.congr S.empty fun x => ⟨False.elim, fun ⟨_, hb, _⟩ => by cases hb⟩
  | cons b l ih =>
    exact S.congr (S.union (h b List.mem_cons_self) (ih fun c hc => h c (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc)))
      fun x => ⟨fun hx => hx.elim (fun hx => ⟨b, List.mem_cons_self, hx⟩)
        (fun ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ => ⟨c, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc, hx⟩),
        fun ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ => by
          rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
          · exact Or.inl hx
          · exact Or.inr ⟨c, hc, hx⟩⟩
Foundations.Algebra.ringHom_fix_ratField:
/-- Ring homomorphisms from a subfield containing `ℚ` into the ambient field fix the
rationals. -/
theorem ringHom_fix_ratField' {Ω : Type u} [CommRing Ω] (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hc : CharZero Ω)
    {F : Subfield Ω} (τ : RingHom F Ω) (x : F) (hx : x.1 ∈ ratField hΩ hc) : τ.toFun x = x.1 := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := hx
  have e : x * Int.cast b = Int.cast a := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [Subfield.coe_mul, Subfield.coe_intCast, Subfield.coe_intCast]; exact hab)
  have e' : τ.toFun x * Int.cast b = Int.cast a := by
    rw [← RingHom.map_intCast τ b, ← τ.map_mul, e, RingHom.map_intCast]
  have hb' : (Int.cast b : Ω) ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (hc b h)
  have : (τ.toFun x + -x.1) * Int.cast b = 0 := by grind
  rcases hΩ.isDomain.2 _ _ this with h | h
  · grind
  · exact absurd h hb'

Foundations.Logic.FO.EvalB.complete:
/-- **Every computation is bounded.** -/
theorem EvalB.complete : ∀ {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {y : Nat}, Eval c xs y → ∃ w, EvalB w c xs y
  | .zero, _, _, h => ⟨0, by cases h; rfl⟩
  | .succ, _, _, h => ⟨0, by cases h; rfl⟩
  | .proj _, _, _, h => ⟨0, by cases h; rfl⟩
  | @Code.comp k f gs, xs, y, h => by
      cases h with
      | comp vs hg hf =>
          obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ := fin_eventually (fun i x => vs i ≤ x ∧ EvalB x (gs i) xs (vs i))
            fun i => by
              obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := EvalB.complete (hg i)
              exact ⟨max w (vs i), fun x hx =>
                ⟨by omega, EvalB.mono (by omega) hw⟩⟩
          obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂⟩ := EvalB.complete hf
          refine ⟨max w₁ w₂, vs, fun i => (hw₁ _ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) i).1,
            fun i => (hw₁ _ (Nat.le_max_left _ _) i).2, EvalB.mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _) hw₂⟩
  | .prec _ _, [], _, h => by cases h
  | .prec f g, m :: rest, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨A, B, hf, hs, rfl⟩ := (eval_prec_iff_beta f g rest m y).1 h
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ := EvalB.complete hf
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂⟩ := exists_bound_range (fun j x => EvalB x g (j :: gbeta A B j :: rest)
          (gbeta A B (j + 1))) (fun j x x' hx h => EvalB.mono hx h) m
        fun j hj => EvalB.complete (hs j hj)
      have hβ : ∀ j, gbeta A B j ≤ A := fun j => Nat.mod_le _ _
      let W := max (max A B) (max w₁ w₂)
      refine ⟨W, A, by omega, B, by omega, ⟨⟨_, by have := hβ 0; omega, rfl,
        EvalB.mono (by omega) hw₁⟩, fun j hj => ⟨_, by have := hβ j; omega, _,
          by have := hβ (j + 1); omega, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, EvalB.mono (by omega) (hw₂ j hj)⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  | .mu f, xs, y, h => by
      obtain ⟨h₀, hlt⟩ := (eval_mu_iff f xs y).1 h
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ := EvalB.complete h₀
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂⟩ := exists_bound_range
          (fun m x => ∃ z, z ≤ x ∧ EvalB x f (m :: xs) z ∧ ¬ z = 0)
          (fun j x x' hx ⟨z, hz, hz', hz0⟩ => ⟨z, by omega, EvalB.mono hx hz', hz0⟩) y
        fun m hm => by
          obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hlt m hm
          obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := EvalB.complete hz
          exact ⟨max w z, z, by omega, EvalB.mono (by omega) hw, hz0⟩
      refine ⟨max w₁ w₂, EvalB.mono (by omega) hw₁, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz', hz0⟩ := hw₂ m hm
      exact ⟨z, by omega, EvalB.mono (by omega) hz', hz0⟩

/-- **Transitivity.** -/

  | _, _, zero, _, h => absurd h (not_lt_zero _)
  | _, zero, _, h, _ => absurd h (not_lt_zero _)

/-- **Strengthened enumerability of PA's theorems.** A code that halts on `x` exactly
when `x` is the Gödel number of a theorem of PA (and on nothing else). -/
theorem PA_theorems_ce' : ∃ c : Code, ∀ x, Halts c [x] ↔ ∃ φ, x = fcode φ ∧ PA ⊢₁ φ := by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := ce_derivable paRule paRule_comp

Foundations.Numbers.R.iterD_eq_zero:
/-- Derivatives of order beyond the degree vanish. -/
theorem iterD_eq_zero {c : Nat → R} {d : Nat} (hc : Vanish c d) {m k : Nat} (h : d ≤ k + m) :
    iterD m c k = 0 := by
  have := fact_mul_iterD c m k
  rw [hc (k + m) h] at this
  have := fact_pos' k
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
  have := OrderedRing.mul_pos this (by
    rcases (by grind : iterD m c k < 0 ∨ 0 < iterD m c k) with h' | h'
    · exfalso
      have := OrderedRing.mul_pos (fact_pos' k) (by grind : 0 < -iterD m c k); grind
    · exact h')
  grind
Foundations.Bridges.peanoNatIso_eq:
/-- **The categorical and the concrete bridge coincide.** Part VII's comparison
isomorphism `peanoNatIso : N ≅ Nat`, obtained abstractly from the universal property
of natural numbers objects (`IsNNO.uniqueIso`), is — as a function — exactly Part
II's hand-written translation `N.toNat`, and its inverse is `N.ofNat`. -/
theorem peanoNatIso_eq :
    (peanoNatIso.hom : N → Nat) = N.toNat ∧ (peanoNatIso.inv : Nat → N) = N.ofNat := by
  have hhom : (peanoNatIso.hom : N → Nat) = N.toNat := by
    symm
    exact IsNNO.uniqueIso_unique peanoNNO natNNO (N.toNat : N ⟶ Nat) rfl rfl
  refine ⟨hhom, ?_⟩
  have h := peanoNatIso.inv_hom_id
  funext n
  have : peanoNatIso.hom (peanoNatIso.inv n) = n := congrFun h n
  rw [hhom] at this
  calc peanoNatIso.inv n = N.ofNat (N.toNat (peanoNatIso.inv n)) :=
        (N.equivNat.left_inv _).symm
    _ = N.ofNat n := by rw [this]

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.bet_of_line:
/-- **Points on a line**: if `a, b, c` are `o + α w`, `o + β w`, `o + γ w` and `β`
lies between `α` and `γ`, then `B a b c`. -/
theorem bet_of_line {a b c o w : Pt K} {α β γ : K}
    (ha : a.x = o.x + α * w.x ∧ a.y = o.y + α * w.y)
    (hb : b.x = o.x + β * w.x ∧ b.y = o.y + β * w.y)
    (hc : c.x = o.x + γ * w.x ∧ c.y = o.y + γ * w.y)
    (h : (α ≤ β ∧ β ≤ γ) ∨ (γ ≤ β ∧ β ≤ α)) : Bet a b c := by
  by_cases hαγ : α = γ
  · refine ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind
  · rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    · obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := β - α) (v := γ - α) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
      refine ⟨(β - α) / (γ - α), t0, t1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : γ - α ≠ 0 := by grind
        grind
      · have : γ - α ≠ 0 := by grind
        grind
    · obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := α - β) (v := α - γ) (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)
      refine ⟨(α - β) / (α - γ), t0, t1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : α - γ ≠ 0 := by grind
        grind
      · have : α - γ ≠ 0 := by grind
        grind
Foundations.Logic.Computability.Comp.ite:
/-- **Definition by cases** on whether a computable function vanishes. -/
theorem Comp.ite0 {c f g : Nat → Nat} (hc : Comp c) (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) :
    Comp fun n => if c n = 0 then f n else g n := by

Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.exists_:
/-- In a complete field, every element of an Archimedean field has a counterpart with the same
cut: the least upper bound of the rationals below it. -/
theorem exists_sameCut (hG : LUBProperty G) (hF : Archimedean F) (a : F) :
    ∃ b : G, SameCut a b := by
  have hAG := archimedean_of_lub hG
  let S : G → Prop := fun g => ∃ q : Q, g = ofRat q ∧ ofRat q < a
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hF (-a)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hF a
  have hne : ∃ g, S g := ⟨ofRat (-(n : Q)), -(n : Q), rfl, by
    rw [ofRat_neg, ofRat_natCast]; grind⟩
  have hbdd : ∃ M, ∀ g, S g → g ≤ M := ⟨ofRat (m : Q), fun g ⟨q, hg, hq⟩ => by
    rw [hg]
    have : q < (m : Q) := (ofRat_lt (K := F)).1 (by rw [ofRat_natCast]; grind)
    exact Std.le_of_lt ((ofRat_lt (K := G)).2 this)⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := hG S hne hbdd
  refine ⟨L, fun q => ⟨fun hq => ?_, fun hq => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2⟩ := exists_rat_between hF hq
    have := hL1 _ ⟨r, rfl, hr2⟩
    have := (ofRat_lt (K := G)).2 ((ofRat_lt (K := F)).1 hr1)
    grind
  · -- `ofRat q` is not an upper bound of `S`, so some member exceeds it.
    have : ¬ ∀ g, S g → g ≤ ofRat q := fun h' => by have := hL2 _ h'; grind
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hno
    apply this
    rintro g ⟨r, rfl, hr⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hc
    have := (ofRat_lt (K := F)).2 ((ofRat_lt (K := G)).1 (by grind : ofRat q < ofRat (K := G) r))
    exact hno (by grind)
Foundations.Algebra.MulAction.count_fixe:
/-- **The fixed-point congruence (class equation modulo `p`).** If a group of order `p ^ k`
(with `p` prime) acts on a finite set `X`, then the number of fixed points is congruent to
`|X|` modulo `p`. More generally this holds for every invariant subset `P` of `X`. Proof:
peel off one non-trivial orbit at a time; each has size a multiple of `p`. -/
theorem count_fixed_mod_of_invariant {p k : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hG : card G = p ^ k) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (P : X → Prop), count P = n → (∀ (g : G) y, P y → P (g • y)) →
      count (fun y => P y ∧ IsFixed G y) % p = n % p := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro P hn hinv
    by_cases hall : ∀ y, P y → IsFixed G y
    · rw [← hn]
      congr 1
      exact count_congr fun y => ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, hall y h⟩⟩
    · have : ∃ y, P y ∧ ¬ IsFixed G y := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hno
        exact hall fun y hy => Classical.byContradiction fun hf => hno ⟨y, hy, hf⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hny⟩ := this
      -- The orbit of `y` lies in `P`, has size divisible by `p`, and contains no fixed point.
      have hOP : ∀ z, orbit G y z → P z := by
        intro z ⟨g, hg⟩; rw [← hg]; exact hinv g y hy
      have hOdvd : p ∣ count (orbit G y) := by
        apply hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (k := k)
        · rw [← hG]; exact count_orbit_dvd y
        · have := one_lt_count_orbit hny; omega
      have hsplit := count_split P (orbit G y)
      rw [count_congr (P := fun z => P z ∧ orbit G y z) (Q := orbit G y)
        (fun z => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hOP z h, h⟩⟩)] at hsplit
      have hpos : 0 < count (orbit G y) := count_pos.2 ⟨y, mem_orbit_self (G := G) y⟩
      have hinv' : ∀ (g : G) z, (P z ∧ ¬ orbit G y z) → (P (g • z) ∧ ¬ orbit G y (g • z)) := by
        intro g z ⟨hz, hno⟩
        refine ⟨hinv g z hz, fun ho => hno ?_⟩
        have := orbit_smul ho g⁻¹
        rwa [inv_smul_smul] at this
      have hrest := ih _ (by omega) _ rfl hinv'
      have hfix : count (fun z => P z ∧ IsFixed G z) =
          count (fun z => (P z ∧ ¬ orbit G y z) ∧ IsFixed G z) := by
        apply count_congr
        intro z
        constructor
        · intro ⟨hz, hf⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hz, fun ho => hny (fixed_of_orbit_fixed ho hf)⟩, hf⟩
        · intro ⟨⟨hz, _⟩, hf⟩; exact ⟨hz, hf⟩
      rw [hfix, hrest, ← hn, hsplit, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hOdvd, Nat.zero_add,
        Nat.mod_mod]

/-- Ring homomorphisms preserve finite sums. -/

  | 0 => φ.map_zero

Foundations.Types.STLC.dne_unprovable:
/-- **Intuitionistic logic does not prove double-negation elimination** `¬¬A → A`.
A normal proof would derive `A` from `¬¬A` by eliminations, which forces a proof of
`¬A` from `¬¬A` — impossible, since making `A` true makes `¬¬A` true and `¬A`
false. (Here cut elimination and truth tables work together.) -/
theorem dne_unprovable (k : Nat) : ¬ ND [] (.arr (neg (neg (.atom k))) (.atom k)) := by
  intro h
  cases cut_elimination h with
  | ne h => exact no_closed_ne h
  | impI h =>
    cases h with
    | ne h =>
      rcases ne_dne_ctx' h rfl with he | hnd
      · cases he
      · exact hnd.sound (fun _ => true) (fun B hB => by
          simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hB
          subst hB
          exact fun hna => hna rfl) rfl

/-- **Provability in a model of PA is closed under modus ponens.** -/
theorem provM_mp {a b y : N.Dom} (hmp : MPM a b y) (ha : ProvM a) (hb : ProvM b) : ProvM y := by
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, n₁, e₁, v₁⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, n₂, e₂, v₂⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨c, d, hA, hB, hv, hval⟩ := concat_valid v₁ v₂ y
  refine ⟨c, d, _, hv, hval ⟨y, hv, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨n₁, ⟨n₂ + 1, by grind⟩, n₁ + 1 + n₂,
    ⟨0, by grind⟩, a, b, hA n₁ a (le_refl' _) e₁, hB n₂ b (le_refl' _) e₂, hmp⟩)⟩⟩

Foundations.Categories.Adjunction.toMona:
/-- **Every adjunction yields a monad**: `T = G ∘ F`, with the unit of the adjunction as
unit and `μ = G ε F` as multiplication. The monad laws follow from the triangle
identities and the naturality of the counit. -/
def toMonad : Monad' C where
  T := F.comp G
  η X := adj.η' X
  μ X := G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X))
  η_nat f := adj.η'_nat f
  μ_nat {X Y} f := by
    show G.map (F.map (G.map (F.map f))) ≫ G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj Y)) =
      G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X)) ≫ G.map (F.map f)
    rw [← G.map_comp, ← G.map_comp, adj.ε'_nat]
  assoc X := by
    show G.map (F.map (G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X)))) ≫ G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X)) =
      G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj (G.obj (F.obj X)))) ≫ G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X))
    rw [← G.map_comp, ← G.map_comp, adj.ε'_nat]
  left_unit X := adj.right_triangle (F.obj X)
  right_unit X := by
    show G.map (F.map (adj.η' X)) ≫ G.map (adj.ε' (F.obj X)) = 𝟙 (G.obj (F.obj X))
    rw [← G.map_comp]
    have := adj.left_triangle X
    change F.map (adj.η' X) ≫ adj.ε' (F.obj X) = 𝟙 (F.obj X) at this
    rw [this, G.map_id]

/-- Every group acts on the left cosets of any subgroup: `g • (xH) = (gx)H`. -/
instance cosetAction (H : Subgroup G) : MulAction G (G ⧸ H) where
  smul g := Quotient.lift (fun x => mk H (g * x)) (fun a b (hab : a⁻¹ * b ∈ H) => by
    apply mk_eq_mk.2
    rw [mul_inv_rev, Group.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left]; exact hab)
  one_smul q := by
    induction q using QuotientGroup.ind with
    | h a => exact congrArg (mk H) (Group.one_mul a)
  mul_smul g h q := by
    induction q using QuotientGroup.ind with
    | h a => exact congrArg (mk H) (Group.mul_assoc g h a)

/-- **Every term is eventually listed.** -/
theorem exists_mem_termsUpTo : ∀ t : Term L, ∃ k, t ∈ termsUpTo L k
  | .var i => ⟨i + 2, mem_termsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inl ⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩)⟩
  | .func (n := n) f ts => by
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := fin_eventually (fun i k => ts i ∈ termsUpTo L k) (fun i => by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_mem_termsUpTo (ts i)
        exact ⟨k, fun x hx => termsUpTo_mono hx hk⟩)
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := funcCode_surj n f
      refine ⟨max K (j + 1) + 1, mem_termsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inr ⟨j, by omega, ?_⟩)⟩

theorem moves_all {g : Perm (Fin 5)} (h5 : g ^ 5 = 1) (h1 : g ≠ 1) (a : Fin 5) : g a ≠ a := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, g x ≠ x := Classical.byContradiction fun hno =>
    h1 (ext fun y => Classical.byContradiction fun hy => hno ⟨y, hy⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := orbit_all h5 hx a
  intro h
  rw [← perm_pow_comm_apply] at h
  exact hx ((g ^ i.val).injective h)

Foundations.Types.SystemF.Term.tySubst_s:
/-- **Type substitution of a term substitution**:
`(t σ) τ = (t τ) (σ τ)`. -/
theorem tySubst_subst (t : Term) :
    ∀ τ σ, tySubst τ (subst σ t) = subst (tySubst τ ∘ σ) (tySubst τ t) := by
  induction t with
  | var n => intros; rfl
  | app t u iht ihu => intros; simp only [subst, tySubst, iht, ihu]
  | lam t ih =>
    intro τ σ
    simp only [subst, tySubst, ih]
    congr 2
    funext n
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => simp only [Function.comp, up, rename_tySubst]
  | tlam t ih =>
    intro τ σ
    simp only [subst, tySubst, ih]
    congr 2
    funext n
    exact tySubst_up_succ _ _
  | tapp t B ih => intros; simp only [subst, tySubst, ih]

Foundations.Categories.typesClassifyPull:
/-- The image of an injection is the pullback of `True` along its characteristic
predicate. -/
noncomputable def typesClassifyPullback {U X : Type} (m : U ⟶ X) (hm : Mono m) :
    IsPullback (C := Type) (typesClassify m) (fun _ : PUnit => True) U m (fun _ => PUnit.unit) where
  w := funext fun u => eq_true ⟨u, rfl⟩
  lift k₁ _ hk := fun w =>
    Classical.choose (of_eq_true (congrFun hk w : (∃ u, m u = k₁ w) = True))
  fac₁ k₁ _ hk := funext fun w =>
    Classical.choose_spec (of_eq_true (congrFun hk w : (∃ u, m u = k₁ w) = True))
  fac₂ _ _ _ := rfl
  uniq k₁ _ hk h h₁ _ := funext fun w => types_mono_injective hm _ _ (by
    have e₁ := congrFun h₁ w
    have e₂ := Classical.choose_spec (of_eq_true (congrFun hk w : (∃ u, m u = k₁ w) = True))
    exact e₁.trans e₂.symm)

  intro s hs
  induction hs with
  | intro s _ ihs =>
    intro u hu₀
    induction hu₀ with
    | intro u huacc ihu =>
      intro hu h
      refine (cr B).2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | beta => exact h u hu

        | lam hx =>
          exact ihs _ hx u (SN.intro huacc) hu
            (fun v hv => (cr B).2.1 _ _ (h v hv) (hx.subst _))

theorem abs_hasSum_le {a b : Nat → R} {s t : R} (hab : ∀ n, abs (a n) ≤ b n) (ha : HasSum a s)

  have k : ∀ n, abs (fsum a n) ≤ fsum b n := fun n =>

/-- **The Hilbert–Bernays–Löb derivability conditions** for the formula `P` over the
theory `T`. -/
structure Derivability (T : Theory Arith) (P : Formula Arith) : Prop where
  /-- (D1) Provable formulas are provably provable. -/
  d1 : ∀ φ, T ⊢₁ φ → T ⊢₁ box P φ
  /-- (D2) Provability is closed under modus ponens, provably. -/
  d2 : ∀ φ ψ, T ⊢₁ imp (box P (imp φ ψ)) (imp (box P φ) (box P ψ))
  /-- (D3) Provable formulas are provably provably provable (formalised D1). -/
  d3 : ∀ φ, T ⊢₁ imp (box P φ) (box P (box P φ))

/-- **Algebraic over a smaller field means algebraic over a larger one.** -/
theorem IsAlgebraic.mono {K K' : Subfield ℂ} (h : K.le K') {x : ℂ} (hx : IsAlgebraic K x) :
    IsAlgebraic K' x := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨mapPoly (Subfield.inclusion h) q, fun h0 => hq0 (Polynomial.ext fun n => ?_), ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun r => coeff r n) h0
    simp only [coeff_mapPoly] at this
    have h1 : ((Subfield.inclusion h).toFun (coeff q n)).1 = (coeff (0 : Polynomial K') n).1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val this
    exact Subtype.ext h1
  · show eval x (mapPoly K'.incl (mapPoly _ q)) = 0
    rw [mapPoly_mapPoly]; exact hq
Foundations.Algebra.adjoin_finite:
/-- **`F(γ)` is a finite extension of `F`**, spanned by `1, γ, …, γ^{N-1}` where `N` is the degree
of the minimal polynomial. -/
theorem adjoin_finite : FiniteExt F (adjoin hΩ F γ hγ) (le_adjoin hΩ F γ hγ) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := exists_minpoly F γ hΩ hγ
  let A := adjoin hΩ F γ hγ
  let u : Fin (natDegree m) → A.over F (le_adjoin hΩ F γ hγ) := fun i =>
    ⟨rpow γ i.val, rpow_mem (mem_adjoin_self hΩ F γ hγ) i.val⟩
  refine ⟨natDegree m, u, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := x.2
  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := div_mod (F.isField hΩ) p m hm0
  have hrd : DegLT r (natDegree m) := by
    by_cases hr0 : r = 0
    · rw [hr0]; intro n _; exact coeff_zero n
    · rcases hr with h | h
      · exact absurd h hr0
      · exact (degLT_natDegree hr0).mono (by omega)
  have hpr : aeval F γ p = aeval F γ r := by
    rw [hqr, aeval_add, aeval_mul, (hm m).2 ⟨1, (Ring.mul_one m).symm⟩, Ring.mul_zero,
      Ring.zero_add]
  refine ⟨fun i => coeff r i.val, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [KSubspace.coe_isum]
  show x.1 = isum (fun i : Fin (natDegree m) => (coeff r i.val).1 * rpow γ i.val)
  rw [isum_fin_eq_rsum (natDegree m) (fun k => (coeff r k).1 * rpow γ k), ← hp, hpr]
  unfold aeval
  rw [eval_eq_rsum' γ _ (N := natDegree m) (fun n hn => by rw [coeff_mapPoly, hrd n hn]; rfl)]
  exact rsum_congr _ fun k _ => by rw [coeff_mapPoly]; rfl

/-- **Naturality of the Yoneda bijection in `A`**: for `f : A ⟶ B`,
`yoneda (Hom(f, −) ≫ α) = F(f)(yoneda α)`. -/
theorem yoneda_natural_A (F : C ⥤ Type v) {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (α : NatTrans (homFunctor A) F) :
    (yoneda F B).toFun ((homPre f).vcomp α) = F.map f ((yoneda F A).toFun α) := by
  change α.app B (f ≫ 𝟙 B) = F.map f (α.app A (𝟙 A))
  rw [comp_id]
  exact app_eq_map α f

/-- **Limits are unique** in a metric space. -/
theorem Converges.unique {s : Nat → X} {L M : X} (hL : Converges s L) (hM : Converges s M) :
    L = M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
  have hpos : 0 < dist L M := by
    rcases (by have := dist_nonneg L M; grind : dist L M = 0 ∨ 0 < dist L M) with h | h
    · exact absurd (eq_of_dist_eq_zero h) hne
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := hL (dist L M / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hM (dist L M / 2) (by grind)
  have k1 := h₁ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)
  have k2 := h₂ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)
  have := dist_triangle L (s (max N₁ N₂)) M
  have := dist_comm L (s (max N₁ N₂)); grind
Foundations.Bridges.reals_in_sets:
/-- **The real numbers live in the set-theoretic universe.** The map from Part II's
real numbers `R` (Cauchy sequences of rationals up to equivalence) to the ZF set `ℝ`
of Dedekind cuts of the ZF rationals, sending `x` to the set of ZF rationals below it,
is a bijection onto the members of `ℝ`; it turns the order of reals into inclusion of
sets and addition into the set-theoretic addition `radd`. The same holds, directly,
for Part II's Dedekind cuts. -/
theorem reals_in_sets :
    Bijective (fun x : R => (⟨realToSet x, cutToSet_mem _⟩ : {A : ZFSet // A ∈ RSet})) ∧
    (∀ x y : R, x ≤ y ↔ realToSet x ⊆ realToSet y) ∧
    (∀ x y : R, realToSet (x + y) = radd (realToSet x) (realToSet y)) ∧
    Bijective cutBij.toFun ∧
    (∀ C D : Cut, C ≤ D ↔ cutToSet C ⊆ cutToSet D) := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x y h => ?_, fun A => ?_⟩, fun x y => ?_, fun x y => ?_, cutBij.bijective,
    cutToSet_le⟩
  · have := cutBij.injective h
    exact Cut.ofR_inj this
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := cutBij.bijective.2 A
    refine ⟨Cut.toR C, ?_⟩
    rw [← hC]
    show (⟨cutToSet (Cut.ofR (Cut.toR C)), _⟩ : {A : ZFSet // A ∈ RSet}) = _
    simp only [Cut.ofR_toR]
    rfl
  · rw [Cut.ofR_le, cutToSet_le]; rfl
  · rw [realToSet, Cut.ofR_add, cutToSet_add]; rfl
Foundations.Logic.FO.grb_fresh:
/-- **The bounded graph formula `grb c a` has its free variables among `0, …, a + 1`.** -/
theorem grb_fresh : ∀ (c : Code) (a x : Nat), a + 1 < x → (grb c a).Fresh x
  | .zero, a, x, h => ⟨var_fresh (by omega), zero_fresh x⟩
  | .succ, a, x, h => by
      refine ⟨var_fresh (by omega), fun _ => ?_⟩
      split
      · exact zero_fresh x
      · exact var_fresh (by omega)
  | .proj i, a, x, h => by
      refine ⟨var_fresh (by omega), ?_⟩
      split
      · exact var_fresh (by omega)
      · exact zero_fresh x
  | @Code.comp k f gs, a, x, h => by
      simp only [grb]
      refine bexN_fresh _ k (a + 1) x (by omega) ⟨(fresh_conjL _ _).2 fun φ hφ => ?_, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hφ
        refine Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_
        have hn' : n ≤ a + 1 :=
          Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh (gs i) a n (by omega))
        cases n with
        | zero => exact var_fresh (by have := i.isLt; omega)
        | succ j => exact var_fresh (by omega)
      · refine Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_
        have hn' : n ≤ k + 1 := Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh f k n (by omega))
        cases n with
        | zero => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | succ j =>
            refine var_fresh ?_
            split <;> omega
  | .prec f g, 0, x, h => trivial
  | .prec f g, a + 1, x, h => by
      have bt : ∀ y, 4 < y → ∀ t ∈ [v 0, v 2, v 1, zero], Term.Fresh y t := by
        intro y hy t ht
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
        rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> first | exact zero_fresh _ | exact var_fresh (by omega)
      refine ⟨boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega), boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
        ⟨⟨boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega), fresh_substL betaB_fresh (by simp) (bt _ (by omega)),
          Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_⟩,
         boundSF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega), boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
         boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
         ⟨fresh_substL betaB_fresh (by simp) ?_, fresh_substL betaB_fresh (by simp) ?_⟩,
         Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_⟩, fresh_substL betaB_fresh (by simp) ?_⟩
      · have hn' : n ≤ a + 1 := Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh f a n (by omega))
        cases n with
        | zero => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | succ j => exact var_fresh (by omega)
      · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
        rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact var_fresh (by omega)
      · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
        rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact var_fresh (by omega)
        · exact var_fresh (by omega)
        · exact var_fresh (by omega)
        · exact (fresh_succ _ _).2 (var_fresh (by omega))
      · have hn' : n ≤ a + 3 :=
          Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh g (a + 2) n (by omega))
        match n, hn' with
        | 0, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | 1, _ => exact var_fresh (by simp [precIdx])
        | 2, _ => exact var_fresh (by simp [precIdx])
        | j + 3, _ => exact var_fresh (by simp [precIdx]; omega)
      · intro t ht; simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at ht
        rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact var_fresh (by omega)
  | .mu f, a, x, h => by
      refine ⟨Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_, boundSF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega),
        boundF_var_fresh (by omega) (by omega), Formula.fresh_subst_of _ fun n hn => ?_,
        ⟨var_fresh (by omega), zero_fresh _⟩, trivial⟩
      · have hn' : n ≤ a + 2 :=
          Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh f (a + 1) n (by omega))
        match n, hn' with
        | 0, _ => exact zero_fresh _
        | 1, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | j + 2, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
      · have hn' : n ≤ a + 2 :=
          Classical.byContradiction fun h' => hn (grb_fresh f (a + 1) n (by omega))
        match n, hn' with
        | 0, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | 1, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
        | j + 2, _ => exact var_fresh (by omega)
