Foundations.Categories.Lambek.TStep:
/-- **One-step reduction** of intrinsic terms: β for functions, projections of pairs, and
congruence under every constructor. -/
inductive TStep : {Γ : List FTy} → {A : FTy} → Tm Γ A → Tm Γ A → Prop where
  /-- `(λx. t) u ⟶ t[u/x]`. -/
  | beta {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (t : Tm (A :: Γ) B) (u : Tm Γ A) :
      TStep (.app (.lam t) u) (inst t u)
  /-- `π₁ ⟨a, b⟩ ⟶ a`. -/
  | fstPair {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (a : Tm Γ A) (b : Tm Γ B) : TStep (.fst (.pair a b)) a
  /-- `π₂ ⟨a, b⟩ ⟶ b`. -/
  | sndPair {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (a : Tm Γ A) (b : Tm Γ B) : TStep (.snd (.pair a b)) b
  /-- Reduce the function of an application. -/
  | appL {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} {t t' : Tm Γ (.arr A B)} (u : Tm Γ A) :
      TStep t t' → TStep (.app t u) (.app t' u)
  /-- Reduce the argument of an application. -/
  | appR {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (t : Tm Γ (.arr A B)) {u u' : Tm Γ A} :
      TStep u u' → TStep (.app t u) (.app t u')
  /-- Reduce under a λ. -/
  | lam {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} {t t' : Tm (A :: Γ) B} : TStep t t' → TStep (.lam t) (.lam t')
  /-- Reduce the first component of a pair. -/
  | pairL {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} {a a' : Tm Γ A} (b : Tm Γ B) :
      TStep a a' → TStep (.pair a b) (.pair a' b)
  /-- Reduce the second component of a pair. -/
  | pairR {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} (a : Tm Γ A) {b b' : Tm Γ B} :
      TStep b b' → TStep (.pair a b) (.pair a b')
  /-- Reduce under a first projection. -/
  | fst {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} {t t' : Tm Γ (.prod A B)} : TStep t t' → TStep (.fst t) (.fst t')
  /-- Reduce under a second projection. -/
  | snd {Γ : List FTy} {A B : FTy} {t t' : Tm Γ (.prod A B)} : TStep t t' → TStep (.snd t) (.snd t')

/-- Genuine tagged partitions of mesh `< δ` inside `[A, B]` are fine. -/

Foundations.Algebra.A5_simple:
/-- **`A₅` is simple** (Galois, 1832): the alternating group on five letters has no normal
subgroups other than `1` and itself. -/
theorem A5_simple : IsSimpleGroup (alternating 5) := by
  have h01 : (0 : Fin 5) ≠ 1 := by decide
  have h12 : (1 : Fin 5) ≠ 2 := by decide
  have h02 : (0 : Fin 5) ≠ 2 := by decide
  refine ⟨⟨⟨c3 0 1 2, mem_alternating.2 (parity_c3 h01 h12)⟩, fun h =>
    c3_ne_one h01 h12 h02 (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  let N' := Subgroup.map (Hom.subtype (alternating 5)) N
  have hNA : ∀ x, x ∈ N' → x ∈ alternating 5 := by
    intro x ⟨x', _, hx'⟩; rw [← hx']; exact x'.2
  have hnorm : ∀ g, g ∈ alternating 5 → ∀ x, x ∈ N' → g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ N' := by
    intro g hg x ⟨x', hx'N, hx'⟩
    exact ⟨⟨g, hg⟩ * x' * ⟨g, hg⟩⁻¹, hN.conj_mem x' hx'N _, by rw [← hx']; rfl⟩
  rcases A5_normal_trivial_or_top N' hNA hnorm with h | h
  · left; intro x hx; exact Subtype.ext (h x.1 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · right; intro x
    obtain ⟨x', hx'N, hx'⟩ := h x.1 x.2
    have : x' = x := Subtype.ext hx'
    rw [← this]; exact hx'N

  exact ⟨a' * b', by
    calc a * b * (a' * b') = (a * a') * (b * b') := by ac_rfl
      _ = 1 := by rw [ha', hb', Ring.mul_one]⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.eval_termEnv:
/-- In the term model, every term denotes its own class. -/
theorem eval_termEnv : ∀ t : Term L, t.eval (termModel hM) (termEnv hM) = Quotient.mk _ t
  | .var _ => rfl
  | .func f ts => by
      simp only [Term.eval]
      have ih : (fun i => (ts i).eval (termModel hM) (termEnv hM)) =
          fun i => Quotient.mk (termSetoid hM) (ts i) := funext fun i => eval_termEnv (ts i)
      rw [ih]
      exact Quotient.sound (hM.closed (Proves.func_congr f fun i => .hyp (rep_mk hM (ts i))))
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.stewart_ch:
/-- **Linearity along a chord**: if `b = a + t (c − a)` then for every `z` in the disc,
`s_b · ch(b, z) = (1 − t) s_a · ch(a, z) + t s_c · ch(c, z)`. -/
theorem stewart_ch {a b c z : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) (hc : n2 c < 1)
    (hz : n2 z < 1) {t : R} (hx : b.x - a.x = t * (c.x - a.x)) (hy : b.y - a.y = t * (c.y - a.y)) :
    s b * ch b z = (1 - t) * s a * ch a z + t * s c * ch c z := by
  obtain ⟨sa, -⟩ := s_spec ha
  obtain ⟨sb, -⟩ := s_spec hb
  obtain ⟨sc, -⟩ := s_spec hc
  obtain ⟨sz, -⟩ := s_spec hz
  have ex : b.x = a.x + t * (c.x - a.x) := by grind
  have ey : b.y = a.y + t * (c.y - a.y) := by grind
  have ha' := ch_mul ha hz
  have hb' := ch_mul hb hz
  have hc' := ch_mul hc hz
  have lin : 1 - dot b z = (1 - t) * (1 - dot a z) + t * (1 - dot c z) := by
    unfold dot; rw [ex, ey]; grind
  have key : s z * (s b * ch b z) = s z * ((1 - t) * s a * ch a z + t * s c * ch c z) := by
    grind
  have : s z ≠ 0 := by grind
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.mem_alternating:
/-- Membership in `Aₙ` means being even. -/
theorem mem_alternating {n : Nat} {σ : Perm (Fin n)} : σ ∈ alternating n ↔ parity σ = false :=
  sgn_eq_one_iff σ
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.transfinite_induc:
/-- **Transfinite induction (zero / successor / limit form).** A property that
holds of `∅`, passes from `β` to `succ β`, and passes to each limit ordinal from
all smaller ordinals, holds of every ordinal. -/
theorem transfinite_induction₃ (P : ZFSet → Prop) (h0 : P ∅)
    (hs : ∀ β, IsOrdinal β → P β → P (succ β))
    (hl : ∀ α, IsLimitOrdinal α → (∀ β ∈ α, P β) → P α) : ∀ α, IsOrdinal α → P α := by
  refine transfinite_induction P fun α hα ih => ?_
  rcases ordinal_cases hα with rfl | ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩ | hlim
  · exact h0
  · exact hs β hβ (ih β (mem_succ_self β))
  · exact hl α hlim ih
Foundations.Logic.Computability.mulCode:
/-- **Multiplication is computable**: `mul(a, b) = a * b`, by recursion on `a`. -/

Foundations.Categories.subsingleton_of_s:
/-- **Fixed points are unavoidable**: if some type `A` surjects onto `A → B`, then every
function on `B` has a fixed point — so `B` has at most one element. -/
theorem subsingleton_of_surjective {A B : Type u} (f : A → A → B) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (b₁ b₂ : B) : b₁ = b₂ := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  open Classical in
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := lawvere_types f hf (fun b => if b = b₁ then b₂ else b₁)
  by_cases h : b = b₁
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hb; exact hne hb.symm
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte] at hb; exact h hb.symm
Foundations.Geometry.Klein.n2_nonneg:
/-- Squared norms are non-negative. -/

Foundations.Numbers.R.hasSum_succ_iff:
/-- Dropping the first term: `Σ aₙ = s` iff `Σ aₙ₊₁ = s − a₀`. -/
theorem hasSum_succ_iff {a : Nat → R} {s : R} :
    HasSum (fun n => a (n + 1)) (s - a 0) ↔ HasSum a s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := (Tendsto.add (tendsto_const (a 0)) h).congr_eventually 0 (b := fun n => fsum a (n + 1))
      (fun n _ => (fsum_succ' a n).symm)
    rw [show a 0 + (s - a 0) = s by grind] at h2
    exact Tendsto.of_shift 1 (h2.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => by rw [Nat.add_comm])
  · intro h
    have h2 := (Tendsto.sub (h.shift 1) (tendsto_const (a 0)))
    refine h2.congr_eventually 0 fun n _ => ?_
    show fsum a (1 + n) - a 0 = fsum (fun k => a (k + 1)) n
    rw [Nat.add_comm 1 n, fsum_succ']; grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.substL_subst:

  rw [substL, substL, subst_subst]
  refine subst_ext φ fun n => ?_
  by_cases h : n < ts.length
  · simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h]
  · simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h]

  | succ n =>

/-- **Cancellation for addition.** If `a + c = b + c` then `a = b`. -/

  induction c with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ c ih => exact ih (succ_inj (by simpa using h))
Foundations.Numbers.R.lt_asymm:

Foundations.Algebra.fundamental_theorem_:
/-- **The fundamental theorem of arithmetic.** Every non-zero non-unit integer is a product
of irreducible integers, and any two such factorisations agree up to order and signs. -/
theorem fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic (a : Int) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hau : ¬ IsUnit a) :
    (∃ L : List Int, (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) ∧ lprod L = a) ∧
    ∀ L M : List Int, (∀ p, p ∈ L → Irreducible p) → (∀ q, q ∈ M → Irreducible q) →
      lprod L = a → lprod M = a → ∀ x, countAssoc x L = countAssoc x M :=
  ⟨int_exists_factorization _ a rfl ha0 hau, fun L M hL hM h1 h2 x =>
    int_isPID.factorization_unique L M 1 hL hM ⟨1, rfl⟩ (by rw [h1, h2]; exact (Int.one_mul a).symm) x⟩
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.semCtx:
/-- **Contexts are products**: `⟦A₁, …, Aₙ⟧ = (⋯(1 × ⟦Aₙ⟧) × ⋯) × ⟦A₁⟧` (the most recent
variable on the right). -/

  | [] => one
  | A :: Γ => prod (semCtx Γ) (semTy ι A)
Foundations.Numbers.R.approx:
/-- **Approximation.** A Cauchy sequence approximates the real number it defines: for every
rational `ε > 0`, eventually `aₙ − ε ≤ [a] ≤ aₙ + ε`. -/
theorem approx (a : CauSeq) {ε : Q} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ofQ (a n) - ofQ ε ≤ mk a ∧ mk a ≤ ofQ (a n) + ofQ ε := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := a.isCauchy ε hε
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← ofQ_sub]
    exact le_of_eventually_le ⟨N, fun k hk => by
      have := abs_lt.1 (hN k n hk hn); simp only [const_apply]; grind⟩
  · rw [← ofQ_add]
    exact le_of_eventually_le ⟨N, fun k hk => by
      have := abs_lt.1 (hN k n hk hn); simp only [const_apply]; grind⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.le_refl':
/-- `x ≤ x`. -/
theorem le_refl' (x : N.Dom) : x ≤ x := ⟨0, add_zero' x⟩
Foundations.Numbers.C.exists_pow_eq:
/-- **`k`-th roots.** For every complex `u` and `k ≥ 1` there is `ω` with `ωᵏ = u`. -/
theorem exists_pow_eq (u : C) {k : Nat} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : ∃ ω : C, ω ^ k = u := by
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hu]; show (0 : C) ^ j * 0 = 0; grind
  · obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_polar hu
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs⟩ := exists_nth_root (cabs_nonneg u) hk
    refine ⟨ofReal s * cis (θ / (k : R)), ?_⟩
    have hk' : (0 : R) < (k : R) := OrderedRing.pos_natCast_of_pos _ (by omega)
    rw [mul_pow, ofReal_pow, cis_pow, hs, show (k : R) * (θ / (k : R)) = θ by grind]
    exact hθ.symm
Foundations.Types.SystemF.Term:
/-- **Terms of System F**: variables, application, abstraction, type abstraction
`Λ. t`, and type application `t [B]`. -/
inductive Term where
  /-- A term variable. -/
  | var (n : Nat)
  /-- Application. -/
  | app (t u : Term)
  /-- Abstraction (binds term variable `0`). -/
  | lam (t : Term)
  /-- Type abstraction `Λ. t` (binds type variable `0`). -/
  | tlam (t : Term)
  /-- Type application `t [B]`. -/
  | tapp (t : Term) (B : Ty)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
Foundations.Combinatorics.cnt_remove_eq:
/-- Removing a point of `Q` lowers the count by exactly `1`. -/
theorem cnt_remove_eq {Q : Nat → Prop} {a m : Nat} (hQa : Q a) (ha : a < m) :
    cnt Q m = cnt (fun x => Q x ∧ x ≠ a) m + 1 := by
  rw [← cnt_point m ha, ← cnt_or_disjoint m fun x _ h => h.1.2 h.2]
  exact cnt_congr m fun x _ => ⟨fun hq => (Classical.em (x = a)).elim Or.inr
    fun h => Or.inl ⟨hq, h⟩, fun h => h.elim And.left fun h => h ▸ hQa⟩

Foundations.Algebra.Ideal.adjoin:
/-- The ideal generated by `I` together with one more element `a`:
`I + (a) = {i + r * a | i ∈ I, r ∈ R}`. -/
def adjoin (I : Ideal R) (a : R) : Ideal R where
  carrier x := ∃ i r, i ∈ I ∧ x = i + r * a
  zero_mem := ⟨0, 0, I.zero_mem, by rw [zero_mul, add_zero]⟩
  add_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨i, r, hi, hx⟩ ⟨j, s, hj, hy⟩
    refine ⟨i + j, r + s, I.add_mem hi hj, ?_⟩
    rw [hx, hy, right_distrib]; ac_rfl
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨i, r, hi, hx⟩
    exact ⟨-i, -r, I.neg_mem hi, by rw [hx, neg_add, neg_mul]⟩
  mul_mem := by
    intro s x ⟨i, r, hi, hx⟩
    exact ⟨s * i, s * r, I.mul_mem s hi, by rw [hx, left_distrib, Ring.mul_assoc]⟩

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Measu:
/-- **Sums of measurable functions are measurable.**
`{c < f + g} = ⋃_q {q < f} ∩ {c − q < g}` over the rationals `q`. -/
theorem add (hf : Measurable S f) (hg : Measurable S g) : Measurable S (fun x => f x + g x) :=
  fun c => S.congr (S.iUnion _ fun k => S.inter (hf (ratEnum k)) (hg (c - ratEnum k))) fun x => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩; grind
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := ratEnum_dense (by grind : c - g x < f x)
      exact ⟨k, hk2, by grind⟩
Foundations.Topology.Vitali.tri_le:
/-- Along the walk, `m ≤ n`. -/
theorem tri_le (k : Nat) : (tri k).2 ≤ (tri k).1 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | succ k ih =>
    show (if (tri k).2 < (tri k).1 then ((tri k).1, (tri k).2 + 1) else ((tri k).1 + 1, 0)).2 ≤
      (if (tri k).2 < (tri k).1 then ((tri k).1, (tri k).2 + 1) else ((tri k).1 + 1, 0)).1
    split <;> simp <;> omega

  unfold Indep at *
  have hs := prob_split P A B
  rw [prob_not]

Foundations.Algebra.ncast:
/-- The image of a natural number in a ring: `n ↦ 1 + ⋯ + 1`. -/
def ncast : Nat → R
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => ncast (n + 1) + 1
Foundations.Logic.FO.pairAt_tri:
/-- Position `tri s + a` of the enumeration is the pair `(a, s - a)`. -/
theorem pairAt_tri : ∀ s a, a ≤ s → pairAt (tri s + a) = (a, s - a) := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | zero => intro a ha; have : a = 0 := by omega
            subst this; rfl
  | succ s ih =>
      intro a ha
      induction a with
      | zero =>
          show pairAt (tri s + s + 1) = (0, s + 1)
          simp only [pairAt, ih s (Nat.le_refl s)]; simp
      | succ a iha =>
          rw [show tri (s + 1) + (a + 1) = (tri (s + 1) + a) + 1 by omega]
          simp only [pairAt, iha (by omega)]
          have hne : ¬ (s + 1 - a = 0) := by omega
          simp only [hne, ite_false]
          rw [Nat.sub_sub]
Foundations.Logic.FO.witnesses_cases:
/-- `witnesses` is either empty, or the single witness instance of an existential. -/
theorem witnesses_cases (A : List (Formula L)) (ψ : Formula L) :
    witnesses hΓ₀ A ψ = [] ∨
      ∃ φ, ψ = ex φ ∧ witnesses hΓ₀ A ψ = [φ.inst (.var (freshVar hΓ₀ A ψ))] := by
  cases ψ <;> simp [witnesses]
Foundations.NumberTheory.bprod_congr:
/-- Products only depend on the factors below the bound. -/
theorem bprod_congr {f g : Nat → Nat} : ∀ {B}, (∀ i, i < B → f i = g i) → bprod f B = bprod g B
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | B + 1, h => by
    simp only [bprod]
    rw [bprod_congr (fun i hi => h i (by omega)), h B (by omega)]
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.mulω_zero:

theorem mulω_zero {m : ZFSet} (hm : m ∈ ω) : m *ω ∅ = ∅ :=
  recFun_zero empty_mem_omega (addω_maps_omega hm)
Foundations.NumberTheory.prime_dvd_bprod:
/-- A prime dividing a product divides one of the factors. -/
theorem prime_dvd_bprod {q : Nat} (hq : Prime q) {f : Nat → Nat} :
    ∀ {B}, q ∣ bprod f B → ∃ i, i < B ∧ q ∣ f i
  | 0, h => by
    simp only [bprod] at h
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; have := hq.1; omega
  | B + 1, h => by
    simp only [bprod] at h
    rcases euclid_lemma hq h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hd⟩ := prime_dvd_bprod hq h
      exact ⟨i, by omega, hd⟩
    · exact ⟨B, by omega, h⟩
Foundations.Topology.continuous_tfae:
/-- **Three equivalent definitions of continuity**: ε-δ, sequential, and open preimages. -/
theorem continuous_tfae (f : X → Y) :
    (Continuous f ↔ ∀ x, SeqContinuousAt f x) ∧
    (Continuous f ↔ ∀ V : Y → Prop, IsOpen V → IsOpen (fun x => V (f x))) :=
  ⟨⟨fun h x => (continuousAt_iff_seq f x).1 (h x), fun h x => (continuousAt_iff_seq f x).2 (h x)⟩,
    continuous_iff_isOpen_preimage f⟩
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.IsSim:
/-- The refinement is simple. -/
theorem IsSimple.refine {β : Type} {l₁ : List (R × (α → Prop))} (hl : IsSimple S l₁) {l₂ : List β}
    {set : β → α → Prop} (hm : ∀ q ∈ l₂, S.M (set q)) (hd : DisjOn set l₂)
    {c : R × (α → Prop) → β → R} (hc : ∀ p ∈ l₁, ∀ q ∈ l₂, 0 ≤ c p q) :
    IsSimple S (MeasureTheory.refine l₁ l₂ set c) := by
  refine ⟨fun r hr => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hr⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hr
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
    exact ⟨hc p hp q hq, S.inter (hl.1 p hp).2 (hm q hq)⟩
  · refine List.pairwise_flatMap.2 ⟨fun p _ => List.pairwise_map.2 (hd.imp fun h x h1 h2 =>
      h x h1.2 h2.2), hl.2.imp fun h r hr r' hr' x h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
    obtain ⟨q', _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr'
    exact h x h1.1 h2.1
Foundations.Algebra.QuotientGroup.isoOfS:
/-- **The isomorphism principle.** If `f : G →* K` is surjective and its kernel is exactly
`N`, then `f` induces an isomorphism `G ⧸ N ≃* K`. All three isomorphism theorems are
instances of this. -/
noncomputable def isoOfSurjective {K : Type v} [Group K] (f : G →* K)
    (hker : ∀ x, x ∈ N ↔ f x = 1) (surj : ∀ y, ∃ x, f x = y) : G ⧸ N ≃* K :=
  Iso.ofBijective (lift f fun x hx => (hker x).1 hx)
    (by
      intro p q
      induction p using Quotient.ind
      induction q using Quotient.ind
      intro h
      apply Quotient.sound
      show _ ∈ N
      rw [hker, f.map_mul', f.map_inv, inv_mul_eq_one]
      exact h)
    (fun y => by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := surj y
      exact ⟨mk N x, hx⟩)
Foundations.Numbers.N.succ_mul:
/-- A successor on the left of a product. -/
@[simp] theorem succ_mul (n m : N) : succ n * m = n * m + m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [mul_succ, ih, add_succ, add_assoc]
    rw [add_comm m n]
Foundations.Topology.picard_lindelof:
/-- **Picard–Lindelöf theorem.** Let `F` be jointly continuous and Lipschitz in `y` with constant
`L`. Then for every initial value `y(t₀) = y₀` there is `h > 0` and a solution `y` of
`y' = F(t, y)` on `[t₀, t₀ + h]` (differentiable inside, continuous everywhere), and every other
solution coincides with it on `[t₀, t₀ + h]`. -/
theorem picard_lindelof (hF : JointCont F) {L : R} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L)
    (hL : ∀ t y z, abs (F t y - F t z) ≤ L * abs (y - z)) (t₀ y₀ : R) :
    ∃ h : R, 0 < h ∧ ∃ y : R → R, y t₀ = y₀ ∧ (∀ t, R.ContinuousAt y t) ∧
      (∀ t, t₀ < t → t < t₀ + h → HasDerivAt y (F t (y t)) t) ∧
      ∀ z : R → R, z t₀ = y₀ → (∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → t ≤ t₀ + h → R.ContinuousAt z t) →
        (∀ t, t₀ < t → t < t₀ + h → HasDerivAt z (F t (z t)) t) →
        ∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → t ≤ t₀ + h → z t = y t := by
  let h : R := 1 / (2 * (L + 1))
  have hh : 0 < h := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
  have hLh : L * h ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have : (2 * (L + 1)) * h = 1 := by grind
    grind
  let b := t₀ + h
  have hab : t₀ ≤ b := by grind
  haveI : LeFact t₀ b := ⟨hab⟩
  -- The integral operator on `C[t₀, b]`.
  have hφ : ∀ y : CFun t₀ b, ∀ s, R.ContinuousAt (fun s => F s (y.1 s)) s :=
    fun y => hF.comp y.2.2
  let Tf : CFun t₀ b → R → R := fun y t => y₀ + integral (fun s => F s (y.1 s)) t₀ (clamp t₀ b t)
  have hTc : ∀ y t, R.ContinuousAt (Tf y) t := fun y t ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := bound_on hab fun s _ _ => hφ y s
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := Std.le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM t₀ (Std.le_refl _) hab)
    refine ⟨ε / (M + 1), div_pos hε (by grind), fun t' ht' => ?_⟩
    have m := clamp_mem hab t; have m' := clamp_mem hab t'
    have k := integral_lipschitz (hφ y) hM m.1 m.2 m'.1 m'.2
    have k2 := abs_clamp_sub_le hab t' t
    show abs (y₀ + _ - (y₀ + _)) < ε
    rw [show ∀ p q : R, y₀ + p - (y₀ + q) = p - q from fun p q => by grind]
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hM0
    have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht' (by grind : 0 < M + 1)
    have e : (M + 1) * (ε / (M + 1)) = ε := by grind
    have k5 : M * abs (t' - t) ≤ (M + 1) * abs (t' - t) := by have := abs_nonneg (t' - t); grind
    exact Std.lt_of_le_of_lt (Std.le_trans k (Std.le_trans k3 k5)) (by rw [← e]; exact k4)
  let T : CFun t₀ b → CFun t₀ b := fun y => ⟨Tf y, fun x => by
    show y₀ + _ = y₀ + _; rw [clamp_clamp hab], hTc y⟩
  -- `T` is a contraction with constant `1/2`.
  have hcontr : ∀ y z, dist (T y) (T z) ≤ 1 / 2 * dist y z := fun y z => by
    apply CFun.supDist_le
    intro t
    have m := clamp_mem hab t
    have hd : 0 ≤ dist y z := dist_nonneg y z
    change abs ((y₀ + integral (fun s => F s (y.1 s)) t₀ (clamp t₀ b t)) -
      (y₀ + integral (fun s => F s (z.1 s)) t₀ (clamp t₀ b t))) ≤ _
    generalize clamp t₀ b t = c at m ⊢
    have hy := hasIntegral_integral m.1 fun x _ _ => hφ y x
    have hz := hasIntegral_integral m.1 fun x _ _ => hφ z x
    have k := (hy.add (hz.const_mul (-1))).abs_sub_le (c := 0) (ε := L * dist y z) m.1
      fun s _ _ => by
        have k1 := hL s (y.1 s) (z.1 s)
        have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (CFun.le_supDist y z s) hL0
        have e : CFun.supDist y z = dist y z := rfl
        rw [e] at k2
        rw [show F s (y.1 s) + -1 * F s (z.1 s) - 0 = F s (y.1 s) - F s (z.1 s) by grind]
        exact Std.le_trans k1 k2
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : c - t₀ ≤ h)
      (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hL0 hd)
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLh hd
    have e : L * dist y z * h = L * h * dist y z := by grind
    grind
  let y0c : CFun t₀ b := ⟨fun _ => y₀, fun _ => rfl, fun x => continuousAt_const y₀ x⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -⟩ := banach_fixed_point (CFun.complete (a := t₀) (b := b)) (q := 1 / 2)
    (by grind) (by grind) hcontr y0c
  have hfix : ∀ t, y.1 t = y₀ + integral (fun s => F s (y.1 s)) t₀ (clamp t₀ b t) :=
    fun t => (congrArg (fun w : CFun t₀ b => w.1 t) hy).symm
  -- The fixed point solves the differential equation.
  have hY0 : y.1 t₀ = y₀ := by
    rw [hfix, clamp_of_mem hab (Std.le_refl _) hab, integral_self (hφ y)]; grind
  have hYd : ∀ t, t₀ < t → t < b → HasDerivAt y.1 (F t (y.1 t)) t := fun t ht1 ht2 => by
    have hI := ftc1 (f := fun s => F s (y.1 s)) (a := t₀) (b := b) (fun x _ _ => hφ y x) ht1 ht2
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun v => y₀ + integral (fun s => F s (y.1 s)) t₀ v)
        (0 + F t (y.1 t)) t := (hasDerivAt_const y₀ t).add hI
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := nhds_of_interior ht1 ht2
    have h3 := HasDerivAt.congr_nhds (g := y.1) h2 hδ fun v hv => by
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hδ' v hv
      show y.1 v = y₀ + _
      rw [hfix, clamp_of_mem hab (Std.le_of_lt a1) (Std.le_of_lt a2)]
    rw [show (0 : R) + F t (y.1 t) = F t (y.1 t) by grind] at h3
    exact h3
  refine ⟨h, hh, y.1, hY0, y.2.2, hYd, fun z hz0 hzc hzd => ?_⟩
  -- Uniqueness: the difference `w` of two solutions satisfies `|w'| ≤ L |w|`.
  let w : R → R := fun t => z t - y.1 t
  have hwc : ∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → t ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt w t := fun t h1 h2 =>
    continuousAt_sub (hzc t h1 h2) (y.2.2 t)
  have hwd : ∀ t, t₀ < t → t < b → HasDerivAt w (F t (z t) - F t (y.1 t)) t := fun t h1 h2 =>
    (hzd t h1 h2).sub (hYd t h1 h2)
  obtain ⟨Mw, hMw⟩ := bound_on hab hwc
  obtain ⟨B, hB1, hB2⟩ := exists_lub (fun s => ∃ t, t₀ ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧ s = abs (w t))
    ⟨_, t₀, Std.le_refl _, hab, rfl⟩ ⟨Mw, fun s ⟨t, h1, h2, hs⟩ => hs ▸ hMw t h1 h2⟩
  have hwB : ∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → t ≤ b → abs (w t) ≤ B := fun t h1 h2 => hB1 _ ⟨t, h1, h2, rfl⟩
  have hw0 : w t₀ = 0 := by show z t₀ - y.1 t₀ = 0; rw [hz0, hY0]; grind
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by have := hwB t₀ (Std.le_refl _) hab; have := abs_nonneg (w t₀); grind
  have half : ∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → t ≤ b → abs (w t) ≤ B / 2 := fun t h1 h2 => by
    rcases (by grind : t = t₀ ∨ t₀ < t) with e | e
    · rw [e, hw0, R.abs_zero]; grind
    · obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := mean_value (f := w) (f' := fun c => F c (z c) - F c (y.1 c)) e
        (fun s s1 s2 => hwc s s1 (by grind)) (fun s s1 s2 => hwd s s1 (by grind))
      rw [hw0] at hc3
      have k1 := hL c (z c) (y.1 c)
      have k2 := hwB c (by grind) (by grind)
      have hwt : abs (w t) = abs (F c (z c) - F c (y.1 c)) * (t - t₀) := by
        rw [show w t = w t - 0 by grind, hc3, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ t - t₀)]
      have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hL0
      have k4 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Std.le_trans k1 (by
        show L * abs (z c - y.1 c) ≤ L * B; exact k3)) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ t - t₀)
      have k5 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : t - t₀ ≤ h)
        (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hL0 hB0)
      have k6 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLh hB0
      grind
  have hBle : B ≤ B / 2 := hB2 _ fun s ⟨t, h1, h2, hs⟩ => hs ▸ half t h1 h2
  intro t h1 h2
  have := hwB t h1 h2
  have := eq_zero_of_abs_le (x := w t) (by grind)
  show z t = y.1 t
  grind
Foundations.Sets.nat_le_of_dedekindInfin:
/-- A Dedekind-infinite type contains a copy of `ℕ` (no choice of sequence needed:
the orbit of a missed point). -/
theorem nat_le_of_dedekindInfinite {α : Sort u} (h : DedekindInfinite α) : CardLE Nat α := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hns⟩ := h
  have : ∃ a, ∀ x, f x ≠ a := Classical.byContradiction fun hn =>
    hns fun a => Classical.byContradiction fun ha => hn ⟨a, fun x hx => ha ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
  exact ⟨orbit f a, orbit_injective hf ha⟩
Foundations.Numbers.R.add_lt_add_iff:
/-- The strict order is compatible with addition. -/
theorem add_lt_add_iff {a b : R} (c : R) : a < b ↔ a + c < b + c := by
  simp only [lt_def]
  have e : b + c - (a + c) = b - a := by grind
  rw [e]
Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.count_con:
/-- Counting depends only on which elements satisfy the property. -/
theorem count_congr {P Q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P x ↔ Q x) : count P = count Q := by
  have : P = Q := funext fun x => propext (h x)
  rw [this]
Foundations.Algebra.Group.selfAction:
/-- **Every group acts on itself** by left multiplication, `g • x = g * x` (the action behind
Cayley's theorem). -/
instance Group.selfAction (G : Type u) [Group G] : MulAction G G where
  smul g x := g * x
  one_smul := Group.one_mul
  mul_smul := Group.mul_assoc
Foundations.Categories.kleisli_option_co:
/-- In the Kleisli category of the option monad, composition is composition of partial
functions: `g` is applied only if `f` was defined. -/
theorem kleisli_option_comp {X Y Z : Type u} (f : X → Option Y) (g : Y → Option Z) (x : X) :
    (show X → Option Z from
      @Category.comp (Kleisli optionMonad.{u}) _ ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩ ⟨Z⟩ f g) x =
      (match f x with | none => none | some y => g y) := by
  show optionJoin (Option.map g (f x)) = _
  cases f x <;> rfl
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.recFun:
/-- Dedekind's function: the pairs in `ω × A` belonging to every closed set. -/
noncomputable def recFun (A a : ZFSet) (g : ZFSet → ZFSet) : ZFSet :=
  sep (fun z => ∀ R, RecClosed a g R → z ∈ R) (prod ω A)
Foundations.Sets.ZFSet.mk_out:
/-- The chosen presentation presents the set it was chosen for. -/
@[simp] theorem mk_out (s : ZFSet) : mk s.out = s :=
  Classical.choose_spec (Quotient.exists_rep s)
Foundations.Logic.subset_extend:
/-- Extending only adds formulas. -/
theorem subset_extend : ∀ (l : List Formula) (Δ : Theory), Δ.Subset (extend Δ l)
  | [], _ => Subset.refl _
  | φ :: l, Δ => by
      unfold extend
      split
      · exact (subset_insert Δ φ).trans (subset_extend l _)
      · exact subset_extend l _
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.archF:
/-- A complete ordered field is Archimedean. -/
theorem archF : Archimedean F := archimedean_of_lub CompleteOrderedField.lub
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.lebes:
/-- **The Lebesgue σ-algebra.** -/
def lebesgueSigma : SigmaAlgebra R where
  M := LebesgueMeasurable
  empty a b := (nu a b).sigma.empty
  compl A h a b := (nu a b).sigma.compl A (h a b)
  iUnion A h a b := (nu a b).sigma.iUnion A fun n => h n a b
Foundations.Probability.FinProb.markov:
/-- **Markov's inequality.** For a non-negative random variable `X` and `a > 0`,
`P(X ≥ a) ≤ E[X] / a`. -/
theorem markov {X : α → R} (hX : ∀ x ∈ P.pts, 0 ≤ X x) {a : R} (ha : 0 < a) :
    P.prob (fun x => a ≤ X x) ≤ P.E X / a := by
  refine le_div_of_mul_le ha ?_
  rw [prob_eq_E, ← E_smul]
  refine P.E_mono fun x hx => ?_
  rcases ind_cases (fun y => a ≤ X y) x with ⟨h, h'⟩ | ⟨_, h'⟩ <;> rw [h']
  · grind
  · have := hX x hx; grind
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.outer:
/-- `m*([t, u)) = u − t`. -/
theorem outer_Ico {t u : R} (htu : t ≤ u) : outer (fun z => t ≤ z ∧ z < u) = u - t := by
  have h := outer_interval htu
  apply Std.le_antisymm
  · have := outer_mono (coverable_of_bdd (A := fun z => t ≤ z ∧ z ≤ u) (a := t) (b := u)
      fun _ h => h) (A := fun z => t ≤ z ∧ z < u) fun z h => ⟨h.1, Std.le_of_lt h.2⟩
    grind
  · have hu := outer_union_le' (coverable_of_bdd (A := fun z => t ≤ z ∧ z < u) (a := t) (b := u)
      fun z h => ⟨h.1, Std.le_of_lt h.2⟩)
      (coverable_of_bdd (A := fun z => z = u) (a := u) (b := u) fun z h => by grind)
    have := outer_mono hu.1 (A := fun z => t ≤ z ∧ z ≤ u) fun z ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
      rcases (by grind : z < u ∨ z = u) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr h
    rw [outer_point] at hu
    grind
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Integ:
/-- An integrable non-negative function is integrable in the sense of `LIntegrable`. -/
theorem Integrable.lintegrable {f : α → R} (hf : Integrable m f) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    LIntegrable m f := ((integrable_iff_of_nonneg m h0).1.1 hf)
Foundations.Combinatorics.clique_cons:
/-- Adding a vertex `v` joined in colour `b` to all of a clique of colour `b`. -/
theorem clique_cons {c : Nat → Nat → Bool} (hc : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x) {b : Bool} {v : Nat}
    {S : List Nat} (hS : Clique c b S) (hv : ∀ y ∈ S, c v y = b) : Clique c b (v :: S) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx hy
  rcases hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases hy with rfl | hy
  · exact absurd rfl hxy
  · exact hv y hy
  · rw [hc]; exact hv x hx
  · exact hS x hx y hy hxy
Foundations.Algebra.quintic_galois_not_s:
/-- **The Galois group of `x⁵ - 6x + 3` over `ℚ` is not solvable.** The group `Aut(L/ℚ)` of
automorphisms of the splitting field `L = ℚ(β₀, …, β₄) ⊆ ℂ` maps onto `S₅`, which is not
solvable. (Combined with Galois's criterion in `QuinticNotRadical.lean`, this shows the roots of
`x⁵ - 6x + 3` cannot be expressed by radicals.) -/
theorem quintic_galois_not_solvable : ¬ IsSolvable (FieldAut Qc L) :=
  not_solvable_of_surjective_S5 galRep galRep_surjective
Foundations.Numbers.R.pow_le_pow_left:
/-- Powers are monotone on `[0, ∞)`. -/
theorem pow_le_pow_left {a b : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : Nat) : a ^ n ≤ b ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => show (1 : R) ≤ 1; grind
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ']
    have hb : 0 ≤ b ^ n := Std.le_trans (pow_nonneg ha n) ih
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih ha
    have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hb
    grind
where
  /-- Powers of a non-negative number are non-negative. -/
  pow_nonneg {a : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (n : Nat) : 0 ≤ a ^ n := by
    induction n with
    | zero => show (0 : R) ≤ 1; grind
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ']; exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg ih ha
Foundations.Numbers.R.mk_eq_mk:
/-- Two Cauchy sequences define the same real number iff they are equivalent. -/
theorem mk_eq_mk {a b : CauSeq} : mk a = mk b ↔ a ≈ b :=
  ⟨fun h => Quotient.exact h, fun h => Quotient.sound h⟩
Foundations.Bridges.natOf_vn:
/-- `natOf (vn k) = k`. -/
theorem natOf_vn (k : Nat) : natOf (vn k) = k := by
  have h : ∃ j, vn k = vn j := ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [natOf, h, dite_true]
  exact (vn_injective (Classical.choose_spec h)).symm
Foundations.Types.SystemF.Term.tySubst_c:
/-- Instantiating a type-shifted term gives it back. -/
theorem tySubst_cons_tyRename_succ (B : Ty) (s : Term) :
    tySubst (Ty.cons B Ty.tvar) (tyRename Nat.succ s) = s := by
  rw [tySubst_tyRename]
  exact tySubst_tvar s
Foundations.Logic.stage_mono:
/-- The stages form an increasing chain. -/
theorem stage_mono (Γ : Theory) {m n : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : (stage Γ m).Subset (stage Γ n) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Subset.refl _
  | step _ ih => exact ih.trans (subset_extend _ _)
Foundations.Numbers.Q.le:
/-- Order: `a/b ≤ c/d` iff `a·d ≤ c·b` (denominators being positive). -/
def le : Q → Q → Prop :=
  Quotient.lift₂ (fun p q => p.num * q.den ≤ q.num * p.den)
    (fun p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ h₁ h₂ => by
      simp only [frac_rel_iff] at *
      apply propext
      have k1 := int_le_cancel_pos (x := p₁.num * q₁.den) (y := q₁.num * p₁.den)
        (Int.mul_pos p₂.den_pos q₂.den_pos)
      have k2 := int_le_cancel_pos (x := p₂.num * q₂.den) (y := q₂.num * p₂.den)
        (Int.mul_pos p₁.den_pos q₁.den_pos)
      rw [← k1, ← k2]
      have e1 : p₁.num * q₁.den * (p₂.den * q₂.den) = p₂.num * q₂.den * (p₁.den * q₁.den) := by
        grind
      have e2 : q₁.num * p₁.den * (p₂.den * q₂.den) = q₂.num * p₂.den * (p₁.den * q₁.den) := by
        grind
      rw [e1, e2])
Foundations.Bridges.toClassical_toIntuit:
/-- The translations are mutually inverse (one direction). -/
@[simp] theorem toClassical_toIntuitionistic (φ : Logic.Formula) :
    toClassical (toIntuitionistic φ) = φ := by
  induction φ <;> simp_all [toClassical, toIntuitionistic]
Foundations.Logic.FO.beta_lemma:
/-- **Gödel's β-lemma.** Every finite sequence `r 0, …, r m` of numbers is coded by two
numbers `A, B`: `β(A, B, j) = r j` for all `j ≤ m`. -/
theorem beta_lemma (m : Nat) (r : Nat → Nat) : ∃ A B, ∀ j, j ≤ m → gbeta A B j = r j := by
  let M := m + 1 + sumUpTo r m
  let B := fact M
  let d : Nat → Nat := fun i => 1 + (i + 1) * B
  have hMB : M ≤ B := self_le_fact M

  refine ⟨A, B, fun j hj => ?_⟩

    have h1 := le_sumUpTo r m j hj
    have h2 : B ≤ (j + 1) * B := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos j)

Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_first_zero_:
/-- **Cosine has a first positive zero** `p ∈ (0, 2]`: `cos p = 0`, and `cos x > 0` for
`0 ≤ x < p`. It is the supremum of the points up to which cosine stays positive. -/
theorem exists_first_zero_cos :
    ∃ p, 0 < p ∧ p ≤ 2 ∧ cos p = 0 ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x < p → 0 < cos x := by
  let G : R → Prop := fun x => 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ x → 0 < cos t
  have hG0 : G 0 := ⟨Std.le_refl 0, by grind, fun t h1 h2 => by
    have : t = 0 := by grind
    rw [this, cos_zero]; grind⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2⟩ := exists_lub G ⟨0, hG0⟩ ⟨2, fun x hx => hx.2.1⟩
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := hp1 0 hG0
  have hp2' : p ≤ 2 := hp2 2 fun x hx => hx.2.1
  -- Below `p`, cosine is positive.
  have hbelow : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x < p → 0 < cos x := fun x hx hxp => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hneg
    have : p ≤ x := hp2 x fun g hg => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hgx
      have := hg.2.2 x hx (by grind); grind
    grind
  have hcos : cos p = 0 := by
    rcases (by grind : cos p < 0 ∨ cos p = 0 ∨ 0 < cos p) with h | h | h
    · -- Then cosine is negative slightly to the left of `p`, contradicting `hbelow`.
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := continuousAt_cos p (-cos p) (by grind)
      have hp : 0 < p := by
        rcases (by grind : p = 0 ∨ 0 < p) with h' | h'
        · rw [h', cos_zero] at h; grind
        · exact h'
      obtain ⟨x, hx0, hxp, hxd⟩ : ∃ x, 0 ≤ x ∧ x < p ∧ abs (x - p) < δ := by
        rcases (by grind : p - δ / 2 < 0 ∨ 0 ≤ p - δ / 2) with h' | h'
        · exact ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, hp, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨p - δ / 2, h', by grind, abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩⟩
      have := abs_lt.1 (hδ' x hxd)
      have := hbelow x hx0 hxp
      grind
    · exact h
    · -- Then cosine stays positive slightly beyond `p`, contradicting `p = sup G`.
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := continuousAt_cos p (cos p) h
      have hp2'' : p < 2 := by
        rcases (by grind : p = 2 ∨ p < 2) with h' | h'
        · rw [h'] at h; have := cos_two_neg; grind
        · exact h'
      obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2, hq3⟩ : ∃ q, p < q ∧ q ≤ 2 ∧ q ≤ p + δ / 2 := by
        rcases (by grind : p + δ / 2 ≤ 2 ∨ 2 < p + δ / 2) with h' | h'
        · exact ⟨p + δ / 2, by grind, h', Std.le_refl _⟩
        · exact ⟨2, hp2'', Std.le_refl 2, Std.le_of_lt h'⟩
      have hGq : G q := ⟨by grind, hq2, fun t ht1 ht2 => by
        rcases (by grind : t < p ∨ p ≤ t) with h' | h'
        · exact hbelow t ht1 h'
        · have := abs_lt.1 (hδ' t (abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩)); grind⟩
      have := hp1 q hGq
      grind
  have hp : 0 < p := by
    rcases (by grind : p = 0 ∨ 0 < p) with h' | h'
    · rw [h', cos_zero] at hcos; grind
    · exact h'
  exact ⟨p, hp, hp2', hcos, hbelow⟩

Foundations.Geometry.Pt.continuity_of_lu:
/-- (A11) **Continuity** holds in `K²` whenever `K` has the least-upper-bound property:
the points of `φ` and `ψ` lie on a ray from `a`, and the supremum of the parameters
of the `φ`-points gives the separating point. -/
theorem continuity_of_lub (hL : Foundations.Numbers.OF.LUBProperty K) (φ ψ : Pt K → Prop)
    (h : ∃ a, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → Bet a x y) : ∃ b, ∀ x y, φ x → ψ y → Bet x b y := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  by_cases hψ : ∃ y0, ψ y0
  case neg => exact ⟨a, fun x y _ hy => absurd ⟨y, hy⟩ hψ⟩
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := hψ
  by_cases hφ : ∃ x1, φ x1 ∧ x1 ≠ a
  case neg =>
    refine ⟨a, fun x y hx _ => ?_⟩
    have : x = a := Classical.byContradiction fun hne => hφ ⟨x, hx, hne⟩
    subst this
    exact ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨x1, hx1, hx1a⟩ := hφ
  have hya : y0 ≠ a := by
    intro e
    subst e
    exact hx1a (bet_identity _ _ (ha x1 y0 hx1 hy0)).symm
  obtain ⟨wx, hwx⟩ : ∃ wx, wx = y0.x - a.x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨wy, hwy⟩ : ∃ wy, wy = y0.y - a.y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw : ¬ (wx = 0 ∧ wy = 0) := fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => hya (ext' (by grind) (by grind))
  have uniq : ∀ t t' : K, t * wx = t' * wx → t * wy = t' * wy → t = t' := by
    intro t t' h₁ h₂
    by_cases hx : wx = 0
    · have : wy ≠ 0 := fun h' => hw ⟨hx, h'⟩
      grind
    · grind
  obtain ⟨t1, t10, t11, e1, e2⟩ := ha x1 y0 hx1 hy0
  have ht1 : t1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hx1a (ext' (by grind) (by grind))
  -- every `ψ`-point lies on the ray from `a` through `y0`
  have hray : ∀ y, ψ y → ∃ s, 0 ≤ s ∧ y.x - a.x = s * wx ∧ y.y - a.y = s * wy := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨l, l0, l1, f1, f2⟩ := ha x1 y hx1 hy
    have hl : l ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hx1a (ext' (by grind) (by grind))
    obtain ⟨d0, -⟩ : 0 ≤ (t1 / l) ∧ True := by
      refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg t10
        (by have := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (by grind : 0 < l); grind)
    exact ⟨t1 / l, d0, by grind, by grind⟩
  -- parameters of `φ`-points are at most those of `ψ`-points
  have hle : ∀ x y t s, φ x → ψ y → x.x - a.x = t * wx → x.y - a.y = t * wy →
      y.x - a.x = s * wx → y.y - a.y = s * wy → 0 ≤ s → t ≤ s := by
    intro x y t s hx hy g1 g2 g3 g4 hs
    obtain ⟨m, _, m1, k1, k2⟩ := ha x y hx hy
    have : t = m * s := uniq _ _ (by grind) (by grind)
    have := mul_le_of_le_one m1 hs
    grind
  let T : K → Prop := fun t => ∃ x, φ x ∧ x.x - a.x = t * wx ∧ x.y - a.y = t * wy
  obtain ⟨L, hLub, hLleast⟩ := hL T ⟨t1, x1, hx1, by grind, by grind⟩
    ⟨1, fun t ⟨x, hx, g1, g2⟩ => hle x y0 t 1 hx hy0 g1 g2 (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a.x + L * wx, a.y + L * wy⟩, fun x y hx hy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, _, _, g1, g2⟩ := ha x y0 hx hy0
  have htL : t ≤ L := hLub t ⟨x, hx, by grind, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, g3, g4⟩ := hray y hy
  have hLs : L ≤ s := hLleast s fun t' ⟨x', hx', k1, k2⟩ => hle x' y t' s hx' hy k1 k2 g3 g4 hs0
  exact bet_of_line (o := a) (w := ⟨wx, wy⟩) (α := t) (β := L) (γ := s)
    ⟨by grind, by grind⟩ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨by grind, by grind⟩ (Or.inl ⟨htL, hLs⟩)

/-- (A7) **Pasch's axiom** in `K²`: the cevians `bp` and `aq` of triangle `abc` meet,
at an explicitly computed point. -/
theorem pasch (a b c p q : Pt K) (h₁ : Bet a p c) (h₂ : Bet b q c) :
    ∃ x, Bet p x b ∧ Bet q x a := by
  obtain ⟨s, s0, s1, hpx, hpy⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨r, r0, r1, hqx, hqy⟩ := h₂
  have hrs : s * r ≤ r := mul_le_of_le_one s1 r0
  have hsr : r * s ≤ s := mul_le_of_le_one r1 s0
  by_cases hD : r + s - r * s = 0
  · have hs : s = 0 := by grind
    have hr : r = 0 := by grind
    refine ⟨a, ⟨0, Std.le_refl 0, by grind, by grind, by grind⟩,
      ⟨1, by grind, Std.le_refl 1, by grind, by grind⟩⟩
  · have hDpos : 0 < r + s - r * s := by grind
    obtain ⟨l0, l1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := s - r * s) (v := r + s - r * s) (by grind) (by grind) hDpos
    obtain ⟨m0, m1⟩ := div_mem_unit (u := r - r * s) (v := r + s - r * s) (by grind) (by grind) hDpos
    refine ⟨⟨p.x + (s - r * s) / (r + s - r * s) * (b.x - p.x),
        p.y + (s - r * s) / (r + s - r * s) * (b.y - p.y)⟩,
      ⟨(s - r * s) / (r + s - r * s), l0, l1, ?_, ?_⟩,
      ⟨(r - r * s) / (r + s - r * s), m0, m1, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> dsimp only <;> grind

/-- **The rationals are dense.** Between two reals lies some `ratEnum k`. -/
theorem ratEnum_dense {x y : R} (h : x < y) : ∃ k, x < ratEnum k ∧ ratEnum k < y := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small (by grind : (0 : R) < y - x)
  have hN := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
  have h0 : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hd : (0 : R) < (N : R) + 1 := by grind
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_floor (K := R) archimedean (x * ((N : R) + 1))
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := intEnum_surj (m + 1)
  refine ⟨pairIndex (i, N), ?_⟩
  unfold ratEnum; rw [pairEnum_surj]; simp only; rw [hi]
  have e : (((m + 1 : Int)) : R) = (m : R) + 1 := by
    have := Ring.intCast_add (α := R) m 1; rw [this, Ring.intCast_one]
  rw [e]
  constructor
  · exact lt_div_of_mul_lt hd (by grind)
  · have h1 : ((m : R) + 1) / ((N : R) + 1) ≤ x + 1 / ((N : R) + 1) := by
      apply div_le_of_le_mul hd
      have e2 : (x + 1 / ((N : R) + 1)) * ((N : R) + 1) = x * ((N : R) + 1) + 1 := by grind
      grind
    grind

Foundations.Types.SystemF.red_cand:
/-- **Every interpretation is a candidate**: `⟦A⟧ρ` satisfies CR1–CR3. -/
theorem red_cand (A : Ty) : ∀ ρ,
    (∀ t, RED ρ A t → SN t) ∧ (∀ t t', RED ρ A t → Step t t' → RED ρ A t') ∧
    (∀ t, Neutral t → (∀ t', Step t t' → RED ρ A t') → RED ρ A t) := by
  induction A with
  | tvar n => intro ρ; exact ⟨(ρ n).cr1, (ρ n).cr2, (ρ n).cr3⟩
  | arr A B ihA ihB =>
    intro ρ
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, a₃⟩ := ihA ρ
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, b₃⟩ := ihB ρ
    have hv : RED ρ A (var 0) := a₃ (var 0) trivial (fun _ h => by cases h)
    refine ⟨fun t h => ?_, fun t t' h hs u hu => b₂ _ _ (h u hu) (Step.appL hs),
      fun t hn h u hu => ?_⟩
    · exact SN.of_map (fun t => app t (var 0)) (fun _ _ => Step.appL) (b₁ _ (h _ hv))
    · have hsn := a₁ u hu
      revert hu
      induction hsn with
      | intro u _ ih =>
        intro hu
        refine b₃ _ (by exact trivial) ?_
        intro x hx
        cases hx with
        | beta => exact hn.elim
        | appL hx => exact h _ hx u hu
        | appR hx => exact ih _ hx (a₂ _ _ hu hx)
  | all A ih =>
    intro ρ
    refine ⟨fun t h => ?_, fun t t' h hs B C => (ih _).2.1 _ _ (h B C) (Step.tapp hs),
      fun t hn h B C => ?_⟩
    · exact SN.of_map (fun t => tapp t (.tvar 0)) (fun _ _ => Step.tapp)
        ((ih (extend snCand ρ)).1 _ (h (.tvar 0) snCand))
    · refine (ih (extend C ρ)).2.2 _ (by exact trivial) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | tbeta => exact hn.elim
      | tapp hx => exact h _ hx B C

/-- **Infinitude of primes** (Euclid). For every `n` there is a prime `p ≥ n`. -/
theorem exists_prime_ge (n : Nat) : ∃ p, n ≤ p ∧ Prime p := by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ fact n + 1 := by have := fact_pos n; omega
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := exists_prime_dvd h2
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hp⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hlt
  have h1 : p ∣ fact n := dvd_fact (by have := hp.1; omega) (by omega)
  have : p ∣ 1 := by
    have := Nat.dvd_sub hpd h1
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) this
  have := hp.1
  omega

Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.lebes:
/-- **The Lebesgue integral of a continuous function equals its Riemann integral.** If `f` is
continuous on `[a, b]` with Riemann integral `I`, then `f` (extended by `0`) is integrable for
Lebesgue measure `λ_{a,b}` and `∫ f dλ = I`. -/
theorem lebesgue_eq_riemann {f : R → R} {a b I : R}
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    Integrable (lebesgue a b) (restr f a b) ∧ integral (lebesgue a b) (restr f a b) = I := by
  have hab := hI.le
  let L := lebesgue a b
  have hFm := measurable_restr hf
  -- Boundedness and integrability.
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ := bounded_above hf
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := bounded_above (f := fun x => -f x) fun x h1 h2 ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf x h1 h2 ε hε
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => by rw [show -f y - -f x = -(f y - f x) by grind, abs_neg]; exact h y hy⟩
  have hM : ∀ x, abs (restr f a b x) ≤ pp M1 + pp M2 := fun x => by
    have := le_pp M1; have := le_pp M2; have := pp_nonneg M1; have := pp_nonneg M2
    unfold restr; split
    · rename_i h; have := hM1 x h.1 h.2; have := hM2 x h.1 h.2; exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
    · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  have hFi : Integrable L (restr f a b) := Integrable.of_dominated L hFm
    (lintegral_const L (show 0 ≤ pp M1 + pp M2 by have := pp_nonneg M1; have := pp_nonneg M2; grind)).1 hM
  refine ⟨hFi, ?_⟩
  have hLab : L.μ (Icc a b) = b - a := lebesgue_Icc (Std.le_refl a) hab (Std.le_refl b)
  -- For every `ε`, the two integrals are within `ε (b − a + 1)` of each other.
  have key : ∀ ε : R, 0 < ε → abs (integral L (restr f a b) - I) ≤ ε * (b - a + 1) := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := uniform_continuous hf hε
    obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hδ'I⟩ := hI.2 ε hε
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hη1, hη2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ hδ'
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_div_lt (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a) hη
    let h := (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)
    have hlt := hn n (Nat.le_refl n)
    have hh : 0 ≤ h := by
      have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
      rcases (by grind : a = b ∨ a < b) with e | e
      · show 0 ≤ (b - a) / ((n : R) + 1); rw [e, show b - b = 0 by grind]; grind
      · exact Std.le_of_lt (lt_div_of_mul_lt (by grind) (by grind))
    have hend := unif_end a b n
    -- The Riemann sum over the uniform partition.
    have hR : abs (rsum f a (unif a h (n + 1)) - I) < ε := by
      have ht := unif_isTagged hh (n + 1) a; rw [hend] at ht
      exact hδ'I _ ht (unif_meshLt (by grind) (n + 1) a)
    -- The step function: uniform pieces, plus the point `b`.
    let l := upieces f h a (n + 1) ++ [(f b, fun z => z = b)]
    obtain ⟨u1, u2, u3⟩ := upieces_spec f hh (n + 1) a
    have hlm : ∀ p ∈ l, LebesgueMeasurable p.2 := fun p hp => by
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with hp | hp
      · obtain ⟨t, _, _, _, a4⟩ := u1 p hp
        exact lebesgueSigma.congr (measurable_Ico t (t + h)) fun z => (a4 z).symm
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hp]
        exact lebesgueSigma.congr (measurable_Icc b b) fun z => by unfold Icc; grind
    have hld : DisjOn Prod.snd l := List.pairwise_append.2 ⟨u2, List.pairwise_singleton _ _,
      fun p hp q hq z h1 h2 => by
        rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hq] at h2
        obtain ⟨t, _, _, a3, a4⟩ := u1 p hp
        have := (a4 z).1 h1; grind⟩
    obtain ⟨hsi, hsv⟩ := integral_step L hlm
    have hsv' : integral L (step l) = rsum f a (unif a h (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hsv, lsum_append, lsum_upieces f hh (n + 1) a (Std.le_refl a) (by grind)]
      have : L.μ (fun z => z = b) = 0 := by
        show outer _ = 0
        rw [outer_congr (B := fun z => z = b) fun z => by unfold Icc; grind, outer_point]
      show _ + (f b * L.μ (fun z => z = b) + 0) = _
      rw [this]; grind
    -- Pointwise, `|f − s| ≤ ε · 1_{[a,b]}`.
    have hpt : ∀ z, abs (restr f a b z - step l z) ≤ ε * ind (Icc a b) z := fun z => by
      by_cases hz : Icc a b z
      · rw [ind_pos hz]
        have e1 : restr f a b z = f z := by unfold restr; simp [hz]
        rcases (by have := hz.2; grind : z < b ∨ z = b) with hzb | hzb
        · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpz⟩ := u3 z hz.1 (by grind)
          obtain ⟨t, a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := u1 p hp
          rw [e1, step_eval hld (List.mem_append_left _ hp) hpz, a1]
          have := (a4 z).1 hpz
          have : h < δ := by grind
          rw [show ε * 1 = ε by grind]
          exact Std.le_of_lt (hδf z t hz.1 hz.2 (by grind) (by grind)
            (abs_lt.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩))
        · rw [e1, step_eval hld (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)) hzb, hzb]
          rw [show f b - f b = 0 by grind, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_refl 0)]; grind
      · rw [ind_neg hz]
        have e1 : restr f a b z = 0 := by unfold restr; simp [hz]
        have e2 : step l z = 0 := step_eval.step_eval_zero fun p hp hpz => by
          rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with hp | hp
          · obtain ⟨t, _, a2, a3, a4⟩ := u1 p hp
            have := (a4 z).1 hpz; apply hz; unfold Icc; grind
          · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hp] at hpz; apply hz; unfold Icc; grind
        rw [e1, e2, show (0 : R) - 0 = 0 by grind, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_refl 0)]; grind
    obtain ⟨hεi, hεv⟩ := integral_ind L (measurable_Icc a b) ε
    obtain ⟨hd1, ed1⟩ := hFi.sub L hsi
    obtain ⟨hd2, ed2⟩ := hsi.sub L hFi
    have i1 := integral_mono L hd1 hεi fun z => (abs_le.1 (hpt z)).2
    have i2 := integral_mono L hd2 hεi fun z => by have := abs_le.1 (hpt z); grind
    rw [ed1, hεv, hLab, hsv'] at i1; rw [ed2, hεv, hLab, hsv'] at i2
    have := abs_lt.1 hR
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  -- Hence the two integrals agree.
  apply eq_of_abs_lt_all; intro ε hε
  have hpos : 0 < b - a + 1 := by grind
  have := key (ε / (2 * (b - a + 1))) (div_pos hε (by grind))
  have e : ε / (2 * (b - a + 1)) * (b - a + 1) = ε / 2 := by grind
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.CubicRoot.space_mul:
/-- The space `{u + v α + w α²}` is closed under multiplication. -/
theorem CubicRoot.space_mul (C : CubicRoot K α) {x y : Ω} (hx : C.space.carrier x) (hy : C.space.carrier y) :
    C.space.carrier (x * y) := by
  obtain ⟨A, B, D, hA, hB, hD, hmon, _⟩ := C.monic
  obtain ⟨u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨u', v', w', hu', hv', hw', rfl⟩ := hy
  let p0 := u * u'
  let p1 := u * v' + v * u'
  let p2 := u * w' + v * v' + w * u'
  let p3 := v * w' + w * v'
  let p4 := w * w'
  have h0 : p0 ∈ K := K.mul_mem hu hu'
  have h1 : p1 ∈ K := K.add_mem (K.mul_mem hu hv') (K.mul_mem hv hu')
  have h2 : p2 ∈ K := K.add_mem (K.add_mem (K.mul_mem hu hw') (K.mul_mem hv hv')) (K.mul_mem hw hu')
  have h3 : p3 ∈ K := K.add_mem (K.mul_mem hv hw') (K.mul_mem hw hv')
  have h4 : p4 ∈ K := K.mul_mem hw hw'
  refine ⟨p0 + -(p3 * D) + p4 * (A * D), p1 + -(p3 * B) + p4 * (A * B + -D),
    p2 + -(p3 * A) + p4 * (A * A + -B),
    K.add_mem (K.add_mem h0 (K.neg_mem (K.mul_mem h3 hD))) (K.mul_mem h4 (K.mul_mem hA hD)),
    K.add_mem (K.add_mem h1 (K.neg_mem (K.mul_mem h3 hB)))
      (K.mul_mem h4 (K.add_mem (K.mul_mem hA hB) (K.neg_mem hD))),
    K.add_mem (K.add_mem h2 (K.neg_mem (K.mul_mem h3 hA)))
      (K.mul_mem h4 (K.add_mem (K.mul_mem hA hA) (K.neg_mem hB))), ?_⟩
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.surjectiv:
/-- **In a finite world, injections are surjections.** An injective map from a finite type
to itself hits every element (this fails for infinite sets — Galileo's and Dedekind's
observation that ℕ is equinumerous with a proper part of itself). -/
theorem surjective_of_injective (f : α → α) (inj : ∀ a b, f a = f b → a = b) :
    ∀ y, ∃ x, f x = y := by
  have hL := nodup_map_of_injective inj (nodup (α := α))
  have hc : count (fun y => y ∈ (elems : List α).map f) = card α := by
    rw [count_eq_length hL (fun _ => Iff.rfl), List.length_map]; rfl
  intro y
  have := count_eq_card.1 hc y
  rw [List.mem_map] at this
  obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := this
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩
Foundations.Algebra.parity_swap:
/-- **A transposition is odd.** Every transposition `(a b)` with `a ≠ b` is conjugate to
`(0 1)`, so it has parity `true` (sign `-1`). -/
theorem parity_swap {n : Nat} {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) : parity (swap a b) = true := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by
    have := a.isLt; have := b.isLt
    have : a.val ≠ b.val := fun e => hab (Fin.ext e)
    omega⟩
  -- A permutation `π` with `π 0 = a`, `π 1 = b`.
  let ρ1 := swap (0 : Fin (m + 2)) a
  let b1 := ρ1 b
  have hb1 : b1 ≠ 0 := fun h => by
    apply hab; apply ρ1.injective
    show swap 0 a a = swap 0 a b; rw [swap_apply_right]; exact h.symm
  let ρ2 := swap (1 : Fin (m + 2)) b1
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := fun e => by
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    rw [Fin.val_one, show (0 : Fin (m + 2)).val = 0 from rfl] at this
    exact absurd this (by omega)
  let ρ := ρ2 * ρ1
  have hρa : ρ a = 0 := by
    show swap 1 b1 (swap 0 a a) = 0
    rw [swap_apply_right]; exact swap_apply_of_ne (Ne.symm h10) (Ne.symm hb1)
  have hρb : ρ b = 1 := by show swap 1 b1 b1 = 1; exact swap_apply_right _ _
  have hconj := conj_swap ρ a b
  rw [hρa, hρb] at hconj
  rw [← parity_conj ρ, hconj, parity_swap01]

Foundations.Algebra.C.charZero:
/-- **`ℂ` has characteristic zero.** -/
theorem C.charZero : CharZero C := by
  intro z hz
  change (icast z : C) = 0 at hz
  match z, hz with
  | .ofNat 0, _ => rfl
  | .ofNat (n + 1), hz => exact absurd hz (C.ncast_succ_ne_zero n)
  | .negSucc n, hz =>
    change -(ncast (n + 1) : C) = 0 at hz
    exact absurd (by rw [← Ring.neg_neg (ncast (n + 1) : C), hz, Ring.neg_zero]) (C.ncast_succ_ne_zero n)
Foundations.Numbers.categoricity:
/-- **Categoricity of the real numbers.** Any two complete ordered fields are isomorphic, and the
isomorphism is unique: there is an order- and field-preserving bijection between them, and any two
such bijections agree. -/
theorem categoricity :
    Nonempty (OrderedFieldIso F G) ∧
      ∀ e₁ e₂ : OrderedFieldIso F G, ∀ x, e₁.toFun x = e₂.toFun x := by
  refine ⟨⟨canonIso F G⟩, ?_⟩
  -- Every isomorphism sends `1` to `1`, hence agrees with the canonical map.
  have key : ∀ e : OrderedFieldIso F G, ∀ x, e.toFun x = canon F G x := by
    intro e x
    have hone : e.toFun 1 = 1 := by
      have := e.map_mul 1 (e.invFun 1)
      rw [show (1 : F) * e.invFun 1 = e.invFun 1 by grind, e.right_inv] at this; grind
    exact (canon_eq (sameCut_of_hom e.map_add e.map_mul hone e.map_le x)).symm
  intro e₁ e₂ x
  rw [key e₁, key e₂]

Foundations.Types.SystemF.tlam_red_aux:
/-- The core of `tlam_red`, by induction on strong normalization. -/
theorem tlam_red_aux {ρ : Nat → Cand} {A : Ty} : ∀ s, SN s →
    (∀ (B : Ty) (C : Cand), RED (extend C ρ) A (tyInst s B)) →
    ∀ (B : Ty) (C : Cand), RED (extend C ρ) A (tapp (tlam s) B) := by
  intro s hs

  | intro s _ ih =>
    intro h B C
    refine (interp (extend C ρ) A).cr3 _ (by exact trivial) ?_

    cases hx with
    | tbeta => exact h B C

Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.mul_top:
/-- **Top coefficients multiply.** If `deg p ≤ s` and `deg q ≤ t`, then the coefficient of
`p * q` at `s + t` is `pₛ · qₜ`, and `deg (p * q) ≤ s + t`. -/
theorem mul_top {p q : Polynomial R} {s t : Nat} (hp : DegLT p (s + 1)) (hq : DegLT q (t + 1)) :
    coeff (p * q) (s + t) = coeff p s * coeff q t ∧ DegLT (p * q) (s + t + 1) := by
  induction p using Quotient.ind with
  | _ lp =>
  induction q using Quotient.ind with
  | _ lq =>
  exact PolyList.mul_top lq t hq lp s hp

/-- **`Var X = E[X²] − (E X)²`.** -/
theorem Var_eq (X : α → R) : P.Var X = P.E (fun x => X x * X x) - P.E X * P.E X := by
  unfold Var
  have : (fun x => (X x - P.E X) * (X x - P.E X)) =
      fun x => (X x * X x - (2 * P.E X) * X x) + P.E X * P.E X := by funext x; grind

Foundations.Sets.card_comparable:
/-- **Comparability of cardinals.** For any two types `α` and `β`, one injects
into the other. Proved from Zorn's lemma via a maximal partial injection. -/
theorem card_comparable (α : Type u) (β : Type v) : CardLE α β ∨ CardLE β α := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Comparability.exists_maximal (α := α) (β := β)
  rcases Comparability.maximal_total hM with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (injective_of_rel M.rel M.inj h)
  · exact Or.inr (injective_of_rel (fun b a => M.rel a b) (fun b b' a h₁ h₂ => M.func a b b' h₁ h₂) h)

/-- Every real number is an integer multiple of `π` plus a remainder in `[0, π)`. -/
theorem exists_int_mul_pi (x : R) : ∃ m : Int, (m : R) * pi ≤ x ∧ x < (m : R) * pi + pi := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_floor (K := R) archimedean (x / pi)
  have hp := pi_pos
  have e : x / pi * pi = x := by grind
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩

  · have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm2 hp; grind
Foundations.Numbers.C.exists_exp:
/-- The complex exponential series converges. -/
theorem exists_exp (z : C) : ∃ L, CTendsto (fun N => gsum (cterm z) N) L := by
  have hre : ∃ s, HasSum (fun n => (cterm z n).re) s := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := comparison (fun n => abs_nonneg _)
      (fun n => Std.le_trans (abs_re_le _) (nrm_cterm_le z n)) (hasSum_exp (nrm z))
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := summable_of_abs ht
    exact ⟨s, hs⟩
  have him : ∃ s, HasSum (fun n => (cterm z n).im) s := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := comparison (fun n => abs_nonneg _)
      (fun n => Std.le_trans (abs_im_le _) (nrm_cterm_le z n)) (hasSum_exp (nrm z))
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := summable_of_abs ht
    exact ⟨s, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hre
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := him
  exact ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ha.congr_eventually 0 fun N _ => (gsum_re _ N).symm,
    hb.congr_eventually 0 fun N _ => (gsum_im _ N).symm⟩

Foundations.Topology.intermediate_value_:
/-- **Intermediate value theorem** (from connectedness). A function continuous on `[a, b]` takes
every value between `f a` and `f b` — the statement of `R.intermediate_value'` from
`Numbers/Continuity`, now a corollary of the connectedness of `[a, b]`. -/
theorem intermediate_value_connected {f : R → R} {a b v : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt f x) (ha : f a ≤ v) (hb : v ≤ f b) :
    ∃ c, a ≤ c ∧ c ≤ b ∧ f c = v := by
  have hcon := (isConnected_interval a b).image_of_continuousAt (f := f)
    (fun x hx => hf x hx.1 hx.2)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcv⟩ := hcon.mem_of_between ⟨a, ⟨Std.le_refl a, hab⟩, rfl⟩
    ⟨b, ⟨hab, Std.le_refl b⟩, rfl⟩ ha hb
  exact ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, hcv⟩
Foundations.Bridges.omega_nat_unique:
/-- **Dedekind categoricity for ω.** Any map `ω → Nat` sending `∅` to `0` and
commuting with successor *is* `Omega.toNat`: the bridge is not a choice but forced. -/
theorem omega_nat_unique (f : Omega → Nat) (h0 : f Omega.zero = 0)
    (hs : ∀ x, f (Omega.succ x) = f x + 1) : f = omegaNat.toFun := by
  funext x
  rw [← Omega.toOmega_toNat x]
  show f (toOmega _) = Omega.toNat (toOmega _)
  rw [Omega.toNat_toOmega]
  induction Omega.toNat x with
  | zero => exact h0
  | succ n ih => rw [toOmega_succ, hs, ih]

/-- **Computably enumerable predicates.** If `p` is a computable test, then some code
halts on `n` exactly when a witness `t` with `p ⟨n, t⟩` exists. -/
theorem ce_of_search {p : Nat → Bool} (hp : CompB p) :
    ∃ c : Code, ∀ n, Halts c [n] ↔ ∃ t, p (pair n t) = true := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := search hp
  refine ⟨c, fun n => ⟨fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => ⟨t, ((hc n t).1 ht).1⟩, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmin⟩ := exists_least h
  exact ⟨t, (hc n t).2 ⟨ht, fun m hm => by simpa using hmin m hm⟩⟩

Foundations.Algebra.common_denominator:
/-- **Common denominators.** Finitely many elements of `ℚ` become integers after
multiplication by a suitable positive integer. -/
theorem common_denominator (c : Nat → (ratField hΩ hc)) :
    ∀ n, ∃ N : Int, 0 < N ∧ ∀ k, k < n → ∃ a : Int, (Int.cast N : Ω) * (c k).1 = Int.cast a := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, by decide, fun k hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hk⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := (c n).2
    -- make the denominator positive
    obtain ⟨a', b', hb', hab'⟩ : ∃ a' b' : Int, 0 < b' ∧ (c n).1 * Int.cast b' = (Int.cast a' : Ω) := by
      rcases Int.lt_or_gt_of_ne hb with h | h
      · refine ⟨-a, -b, by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_neg, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_neg, ← hab]; grind
      · exact ⟨a, b, h, hab⟩
    refine ⟨N * b', Int.mul_pos hN hb', fun k hkn => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k n with hlt | hge
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hk k hlt
      refine ⟨e * b', ?_⟩
      rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← he]; grind
    · have : k = n := by omega
      subst this
      refine ⟨N * a', ?_⟩
      rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← hab']; grind

Foundations.Bridges.peano_omega_iso:
/-- **N and ω are isomorphic structures.** The translation `N → ω` is a bijection
preserving zero, successor, addition, multiplication and order (Peano `≤` becomes
inclusion of sets). -/
theorem peano_omega_iso :
    Bijective peanoOmega.toFun ∧
    peanoOmega.toFun N.zero = Omega.zero ∧
    (∀ n, peanoOmega.toFun (N.succ n) = Omega.succ (peanoOmega.toFun n)) ∧
    (∀ a b, peanoOmega.toFun (a + b) = Omega.add (peanoOmega.toFun a) (peanoOmega.toFun b)) ∧
    (∀ a b, peanoOmega.toFun (a * b) = Omega.mul (peanoOmega.toFun a) (peanoOmega.toFun b)) ∧
    (∀ a b, a ≤ b ↔ Omega.le (peanoOmega.toFun a) (peanoOmega.toFun b)) := by
  refine ⟨peanoOmega.bijective, rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_, fun a b => ?_⟩
  · show peanoToOmega (a + b) = Omega.add (peanoToOmega a) (peanoToOmega b)
    rw [peanoToOmega_eq, peanoToOmega_eq, peanoToOmega_eq, N.toNat_add, toOmega_add]
  · show peanoToOmega (a * b) = Omega.mul (peanoToOmega a) (peanoToOmega b)
    rw [peanoToOmega_eq, peanoToOmega_eq, peanoToOmega_eq, N.toNat_mul, toOmega_mul]
  · show _ ↔ Omega.le (peanoToOmega a) (peanoToOmega b)
    rw [peanoToOmega_eq, peanoToOmega_eq, ← toOmega_le, N.toNat_le]
Foundations.Numbers.CauSeq.bounded:
/-- **Cauchy sequences are bounded.** There is a positive rational `B` with `|aₙ| < B` for all
`n`. -/
theorem bounded (a : CauSeq) : ∃ B : Q, 0 < B ∧ ∀ n, abs (a n) < B := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := a.isCauchy 1 (by grind)
  refine ⟨sumAbs a N + 1, by have := sumAbs_nonneg a N; grind, fun n => ?_⟩
  by_cases hn : n ≤ N
  · have := abs_le_sumAbs a hn; grind
  · have h1 := hN n N (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
    have h2 := abs_le_sumAbs a (Nat.le_refl N)
    have h3 := abs_add (a n - a N) (a N)
    have e : a n - a N + a N = a n := by grind
    rw [e] at h3
    grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.concat_exis:
/-- **Concatenation of β-coded sequences inside a model of PA.** Given codes of
sequences of lengths `n₁ + 1` and `n₂ + 1` (with arbitrary, possibly non-standard,
`n₁, n₂`) and an element `v`, there is a code (with `c` as large as desired) of the
sequence obtained by writing the two after each other and appending `v`. -/
theorem concat_exists (c₁ d₁ n₁ c₂ d₂ n₂ v K : N.Dom) : ∃ c d, K ≤ c ∧
    (∀ i y, i ≤ n₁ → BetaM c₁ d₁ i y → BetaM c d i y) ∧
    (∀ i y, i ≤ n₂ → BetaM c₂ d₂ i y → BetaM c d (n₁ + 1 + i) y) ∧
    BetaM c d (n₁ + n₂ + 2) v := by
  let p : Nat → N.Dom := Env.cons n₁ (Env.cons c₁ (Env.cons d₁ (Env.cons n₂ (Env.cons c₂
    (Env.cons d₂ (fun _ => v))))))
  have hR : N.Dfn fun e => (fun i y (p : Nat → N.Dom) =>
      ConcatR (p 0) (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (p 4) (p 5) (p 6) i y) (e 0) (e 1) (fun n => e (n + 2)) := by
    unfold ConcatR; dfn
  have hex : ∀ i, i < n₁ + n₂ + 3 → ∃ y, y ≤ c₁ + c₂ + v ∧ ConcatR n₁ c₁ d₁ n₂ c₂ d₂ v i y := by
    intro i hi
    rcases le_or_lt' n₁ i with h | h
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := betaM_exists c₁ d₁ i
      exact ⟨y, le_trans' (betaM_le hy) ⟨c₂ + v, by grind⟩, Or.inl ⟨h, hy⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := exists_of_lt h
      rcases le_or_lt' n₂ j with hj | hj
      · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := betaM_exists c₂ d₂ j
        exact ⟨y, le_trans' (betaM_le hy) ⟨c₁ + v, by grind⟩,
          Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, by grind, hj, hy⟩)⟩
      · obtain ⟨δ, rfl⟩ := exists_of_lt hj
        rcases zero_or_succ δ with rfl | ⟨δ', rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨v, ⟨c₁ + c₂, by grind⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by grind, rfl⟩)⟩
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hi
          exact add_succ_ne_self (n₁ + n₂ + 3) (δ' + z) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨c, d, hK, hc⟩ := seq_exists (R := fun i y (p : Nat → N.Dom) =>
      ConcatR (p 0) (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (p 4) (p 5) (p 6) i y) hR p (n₁ + n₂ + 3) (c₁ + c₂ + v) K hex
  have hc' : ∀ i, i < n₁ + n₂ + 3 → ∃ y, BetaM c d i y ∧ ConcatR n₁ c₁ d₁ n₂ c₂ d₂ v i y := hc
  refine ⟨c, d, hK, fun i y hi hy => ?_, fun i y hi hy => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', hR'⟩ := hc' i (lt_of_le_of_lt' hi ⟨n₂ + 2, by grind⟩)
    rcases hR' with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨j, rfl, -, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    · rwa [betaM_unique hy h]
    · exact absurd hi (not_succ_add_le _ _)
    · exact absurd hi (not_succ_add_le n₁ (n₂ + 1) |> fun h h' => h (by
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h'; exact ⟨z, by grind⟩))
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', hR'⟩ := hc' (n₁ + 1 + i) (by obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hi; exact ⟨z + 1, by grind⟩)
    rcases hR' with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨j, hj, -, h⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_succ_add_le _ _)
    · have : i = j := add_right_cancel' (by grind : i + (n₁ + 1) = j + (n₁ + 1))
      subst this; rwa [betaM_unique hy h]
    · have : i = n₂ + 1 := add_right_cancel' (by grind : i + (n₁ + 1) = n₂ + 1 + (n₁ + 1))
      subst this; exact absurd hi (not_succ_add_le n₂ 0 |> fun h h' => h (by
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h'; exact ⟨z, by grind⟩))
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', hR'⟩ := hc' (n₁ + n₂ + 2) ⟨0, by grind⟩
    rcases hR' with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨j, hj, hjn, -⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_succ_add_le n₁ (n₂ + 1) |> fun h h' => h (by
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h'; exact ⟨z, by grind⟩))
    · have : j = n₂ + 1 := add_right_cancel' (by grind : j + (n₁ + 1) = n₂ + 1 + (n₁ + 1))
      subst this; exact absurd hjn (not_succ_add_le n₂ 0 |> fun h h' => h (by
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h'; exact ⟨z, by grind⟩))
    · exact hy'

Foundations.Logic.FO.sat_bexN:
/-- Meaning of `bexN` in `ℕ`. -/
theorem sat_bexN (φ : Formula Arith) :
    ∀ (k wi : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat), Sat stdModel e (bexN k wi φ) ↔
      ∃ e' : Nat → Nat, (∀ n, e' (n + k) = e n) ∧ (∀ i, i < k → e' i ≤ e wi) ∧ Sat stdModel e' φ
  | 0, wi, e => by
      simp only [bexN, Nat.add_zero]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨e, fun _ => rfl, fun _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _), h⟩,
        fun ⟨e', he', _, h⟩ => by rwa [show e = e' from funext fun n => (he' n).symm]⟩
  | k + 1, wi, e => by
      simp only [bexN, Sat, sat_boundF_std, eval_var_M]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, h⟩
        obtain ⟨e', he', hb, h⟩ := (sat_bexN φ k (wi + 1) _).1 h
        refine ⟨e', fun n => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, h⟩
        · rw [show n + (k + 1) = (n + 1) + k by omega, he' (n + 1)]; rfl
        · rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hi with hi | rfl
          · exact hb i hi
          · have := he' 0; simp only [Nat.zero_add] at this; rw [this]; exact hx
      · rintro ⟨e', he', hb, h⟩
        refine ⟨e' k, hb k (by omega), (sat_bexN φ k (wi + 1) _).2 ⟨e', fun n => ?_,
          fun i hi => hb i (by omega), h⟩⟩
        cases n with
        | zero => simp [Env.cons]
        | succ m =>
            show e' (m + 1 + k) = e m
            rw [show m + 1 + k = m + (k + 1) by omega]; exact he' m

Foundations.Types.SystemF.HasType.rename:
/-- Typing is preserved by renaming term variables. -/
theorem HasType.rename {Γ : List Ty} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ {Δ : List Ty} (ξ : Nat → Nat), (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → Δ[ξ n]? = some B) →
      HasType Δ (Term.rename ξ t) A := by
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro Δ ξ hξ; exact .var (hξ _ _ hn)
  | lam _ ih =>
    intro Δ ξ hξ
    refine .lam (ih _ fun n B hn => ?_)
    cases n with
    | zero => exact hn
    | succ n => simpa [Ty.upRen] using hξ n B (by simpa using hn)
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro Δ ξ hξ; exact .app (ih₁ ξ hξ) (ih₂ ξ hξ)
  | tlam _ ih =>
    intro Δ ξ hξ
    refine .tlam (ih ξ fun n B hn => ?_)
    simp only [List.getElem?_map, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at hn ⊢
    obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, rfl⟩ := hn
    exact ⟨B₀, hξ n B₀ hB₀, rfl⟩
  | tapp _ ih => intro Δ ξ hξ; exact .tapp (ih ξ hξ)

Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.isUnit_of:
/-- A non-zero polynomial of degree `0` over a field is a unit. -/
theorem isUnit_of_natDegree_zero (hF : IsField F) {p : Polynomial F} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (h0 : natDegree p = 0) : IsUnit p := by
  have hpC : p = C (coeff p 0) := ext fun n => by
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => rw [degLT_natDegree hp _ (by omega), coeff_C_succ]
  have hc : coeff p 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hp; rw [hpC, h, C_zero]
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hF.2 _ hc
  exact ⟨C d, by rw [hpC, ← C_mul, hd, C_one]⟩
Foundations.Bridges.ZFModel.lift2_enc:
/-- If a set operation `op` mirrors a type-level operation `f` on representatives, and
`f` respects `≈`, then the lifted operation computes classes correctly:
`cls a ⊕ cls b = cls (f a b)`. -/
theorem lift2_enc (op : ZFSet → ZFSet → ZFSet) (f : α → α → α)
    (hf : ∀ a a' b b', a ≈ a' → b ≈ b' → f a b ≈ f a' b')
    (hop : ∀ a b, op (M.enc a) (M.enc b) = M.enc (f a b)) (a b : α) :
    M.lift2 op (M.cls (M.enc a)) (M.cls (M.enc b)) = M.cls (M.enc (f a b)) := by
  apply ext
  intro r
  simp only [lift2, mem_sep, mem_cls]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, p, ⟨hp, hap⟩, q, ⟨hq, hbq⟩, hpq⟩
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := M.enc_surj p hp
    obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := M.enc_surj q hq
    rw [hop] at hpq
    have := (M.rel_iff _ _).2 (hf a a' b b' ((M.rel_iff _ _).1 hap) ((M.rel_iff _ _).1 hbq))
    exact ⟨hr, M.R_trans this hpq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hr, h⟩
    refine ⟨hr, M.enc a, ⟨M.enc_mem a, M.R_refl (M.enc_mem a)⟩, M.enc b,
      ⟨M.enc_mem b, M.R_refl (M.enc_mem b)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hop]
    exact h
Foundations.Types.STLC.ND.toTerm:
/-- **Proofs are terms**: every natural deduction derivation can be decorated with
a λ-term. -/
theorem ND.toTerm {Γ : List Formula} {A : Formula} (h : ND Γ A) : ∃ t, HasType Γ t A := by
  induction h with
  | hyp hn => exact ⟨_, .var hn⟩
  | impI _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .lam ht⟩
  | impE _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih₁; obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih₂; exact ⟨_, .app ht hu⟩
  | andI _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih₁; obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih₂; exact ⟨_, .pair ht hu⟩
  | andE₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .fst ht⟩
  | andE₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .snd ht⟩
  | orI₁ _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .inl ht⟩
  | orI₂ _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .inr ht⟩
  | orE _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := ih₁; obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩ := ih₂
    exact ⟨_, .case ht hu₁ hu₂⟩
  | botE _ ih => obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, .absurd ht⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.Proves.rel_congr:
/-- **Congruence for relation symbols.** Provably equal arguments give provably
equivalent atomic formulas. -/
theorem rel_congr {Γ : Theory L} {n : Nat} (R : L.Rel n) {ts ts' : Fin n → Term L}
    (h : ∀ i, Γ ⊢₁ eq (ts i) (ts' i)) (h₀ : Γ ⊢₁ rel R ts) : Γ ⊢₁ rel R ts' := by
  refine replace_args (fun us => rel R us) ?_ h h₀
  intro us k
  refine ⟨rel R fun i => if i = k then .var 0 else (us i).rename Nat.succ, fun w => ?_⟩
  simp only [inst, Formula.subst]
  rw [← inst_args us k w]

/-- `K(α)` lies in every subfield containing `K` and `α`. -/
theorem CubicRoot.field_le (hΩ : IsField Ω) (C : CubicRoot K α) {F : Subfield Ω} (hKF : K.le F) (hαF : α ∈ F) : (C.field hΩ).le F := by

Foundations.Topology.integral_unif_limit:
/-- **Integral of a uniform limit.** If continuous functions `fₙ` converge uniformly to `g` on
`[a, b]`, then `g` is integrable and `∫ₐᵇ fₙ → ∫ₐᵇ g`. -/
theorem integral_unif_limit {fs : Nat → R → R} {g : R → R} {a b : R} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ n x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → R.ContinuousAt (fs n) x)
    (hu : UnifOn fs g (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b)) :
    HasIntegral g a b (integral g a b) ∧ Tendsto (fun n => integral (fs n) a b) (integral g a b) := by
  have hg := hu.contOn fun n => contOn_of_continuousAt fun x hx => hf n x hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨J, hJ'⟩ := integrable_of_continuous hab fun x _ _ => continuousAt_comp_clamp hab hg x
  have hJ : HasIntegral g a b J := HasIntegral.congr_on hJ' fun x h1 h2 => by rw [clamp_of_mem hab h1 h2]
  rw [hJ.integral_eq hab]
  refine ⟨hJ, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu (ε / (b - a + 1)) (div_pos hε (by grind))
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hI := hasIntegral_integral hab fun x h1 h2 => hf n x h1 h2
  have hD := hI.add (hJ.const_mul (-1))
  have k := hD.abs_sub_le (c := 0) (ε := ε / (b - a + 1)) hab fun t h1 h2 => by
    have := hN n hn t ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [show fs n t + -1 * g t - 0 = fs n t - g t by grind]; exact Std.le_of_lt this
  rw [show integral (fs n) a b + -1 * J - 0 * (b - a) = integral (fs n) a b - J by grind] at k
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : b - a ≤ b - a + 1)
    (Std.le_of_lt (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < b - a + 1)))
  have e : ε / (b - a + 1) * (b - a + 1) = ε := by grind
  have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind : b - a < b - a + 1)
    (div_pos hε (by grind : 0 < b - a + 1))
  grind

Foundations.Algebra.PolyList.mul_add_lef:
/-- Right distributivity. -/
theorem mul_add_left (p q r : List R) : Eqv (mul (add p q) r) (add (mul p r) (mul q r)) := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => intro n; simp [mul, add]
  | cons a p ih =>
    cases q with
    | nil => intro n; simp [mul, add, add_zero]
    | cons b q =>
      intro n
      show coeff (mul ((a + b) :: add p q) r) n = _
      rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, coeff_mul_cons, right_distrib]
      cases n with
      | zero => simp only [coeff_cons_zero, add_zero]
      | succ k => simp only [coeff_cons_succ]; rw [ih q k, coeff_add]; ac_rfl

Foundations.Topology.Topology.subspace:
/-- The **subspace topology** on a subset `A ⊆ X` (as the subtype `{x // A x}`): the open sets
are the traces `U ∩ A` of open sets `U` of `X`. -/
def subspace (τ : Topology X) (A : X → Prop) : Topology {x // A x} where
  IsOpen V := ∃ U, τ.IsOpen U ∧ ∀ x : {x // A x}, V x ↔ U x.1
  isOpen_univ := ⟨_, τ.isOpen_univ, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  isOpen_inter V W := fun ⟨U, hU, h⟩ ⟨U', hU', h'⟩ =>
    ⟨_, τ.isOpen_inter U U' hU hU', fun x => by show V x ∧ W x ↔ _; rw [h x, h' x]⟩
  isOpen_sUnion S hS := by
    refine ⟨fun y => ∃ U, (τ.IsOpen U ∧ ∃ V, S V ∧ ∀ x : {x // A x}, V x ↔ U x.1) ∧ U y,
      τ.isOpen_sUnion _ fun U h => h.1, fun x => ⟨fun ⟨V, hV, hx⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨U, ⟨hU, V, hV, h⟩, hx⟩ =>
        ⟨V, hV, (h x).2 hx⟩⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, h⟩ := hS V hV
    exact ⟨U, ⟨hU, V, hV, h⟩, (h x).1 hx⟩
Foundations.Logic.FO.termModel_countable:
/-- **The term model is countable** (for a countable language): there is a surjection
from `ℕ` onto its domain. -/
theorem termModel_countable [Signature.Countable L] :
    ∃ f : Nat → (termModel hM).Dom, ∀ x, ∃ n, f n = x := by
  refine ⟨fun m => match (termsUpTo L (pairAt m).1)[(pairAt m).2]? with
    | some t => Quotient.mk _ t
    | none => Quotient.mk _ (.var 0), fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep x
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_mem_termsUpTo t
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjt⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hk
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := pairAt_surj k j
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  simp only [hm, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, hjt]
  rfl

Foundations.Algebra.iprod_const_fin:
/-- The product of a constant over `Fin n` is its `n`-th power. -/
theorem iprod_const_fin (n : Nat) (c : R) : iprod (fun _ : Fin n => c) = rpow c n := by
  unfold iprod
  have : ∀ l : List (Fin n), lprod (l.map (fun _ => c)) = rpow c l.length := by
    intro l; induction l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ l ih =>
      show c * lprod (l.map _) = rpow c l.length * c
      rw [ih]; exact CommRing.mul_comm _ _
  rw [this]; show rpow c (List.finRange n).length = _; rw [List.length_finRange]

Foundations.Logic.FO.sepF:
/-- The **Rosser separation formula** `∃w (A(w, x) ∧ ∀u ≤ w ¬B(u, x))` for formulas `A`,
`B` with free variables `0 = w`, `1 = x` (free variable of the result: `0 = x`). -/
def sepF (A B : Formula Arith) : Formula Arith :=
  ex (conj (substL [v 0, v 1] A) (all (imp (boundF (v 0)) (neg (substL [v 0, v 2] B)))))
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.semTm:
/-- **Terms are arrows**: the interpretation of `Γ ⊢ t : A` as an arrow `⟦Γ⟧ ⟶ ⟦A⟧`.
Abstraction is currying, application is pairing followed by evaluation. -/
def semTm : {Γ : List FTy} → {A : FTy} → Tm Γ A → (semCtx ι Γ ⟶ semTy ι A)
  | _, _, .var v => semVar ι v
  | _, _, .lam t => curry (semTm t)
  | _, _, .app t u => pair (semTm t) (semTm u) ≫ eval
  | _, _, .pair a b => pair (semTm a) (semTm b)
  | _, _, .fst t => semTm t ≫ fst
  | _, _, .snd t => semTm t ≫ snd

Foundations.Logic.FO.exists_mem_formsUpT:
/-- **Every formula is eventually listed.** -/
theorem exists_mem_formsUpTo : ∀ φ : Formula L, ∃ k, φ ∈ formsUpTo L k
  | .bot => ⟨1, mem_formsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩
  | .eq s t => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := exists_mem_termsUpTo s
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := exists_mem_termsUpTo t
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂ + 1, mem_formsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl
        ⟨s, termsUpTo_mono (by omega) h₁, t, termsUpTo_mono (by omega) h₂, rfl⟩))⟩
  | .rel (n := n) R ts => by
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := fin_eventually (fun i k => ts i ∈ termsUpTo L k) (fun i => by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_mem_termsUpTo (ts i)
        exact ⟨k, fun x hx => termsUpTo_mono hx hk⟩)
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := relCode_surj n R
      refine ⟨max K (j + 1) + 1, mem_formsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
        ⟨j, by omega, ?_⟩)))⟩
      rw [hj]
      simp only [symbolAtoms, List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨ts, mem_tuples.2 fun i => hK _ (by omega) i, rfl⟩
  | .imp a b | .conj a b | .disj a b => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo a
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo b
      exact ⟨max k₁ k₂ + 1, mem_formsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
        ⟨a, formsUpTo_mono (by omega) h₁, b, formsUpTo_mono (by omega) h₂, by simp⟩))))⟩
  | .all a | .ex a => by
      obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := exists_mem_formsUpTo a
      exact ⟨k + 1, mem_formsUpTo_succ.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, h, by simp⟩))))⟩

Foundations.Algebra.quadratic_reciprocit:
/-- **The law of quadratic reciprocity** (Gauss's *theorema aureum*). For distinct odd primes `p`
and `q`, `(q/p) · (p/q) = (-1)^(((p-1)/2) · ((q-1)/2))`. -/
theorem quadratic_reciprocity {p q : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) (hq : IsPrime q) (hpo : p % 2 = 1)
    (hqo : q % 2 = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    legendre q p * legendre p q = (-1) ^ (half p * half q) := by
  have hpq' : ¬ p ∣ q := fun h => by
    rcases hq.2 p h with h1 | h1
    · have := hp.1; omega
    · exact hpq h1
  have hqp' : ¬ q ∣ p := fun h => by
    rcases hp.2 q h with h1 | h1
    · have := hq.1; omega
    · exact hpq h1.symm
  rw [gauss_lemma hp hpo hpq', gauss_lemma hq hqo hqp', ← Int.pow_add]
  have e1 := floorSum_parity hp hpo hpq' hqo
  have e2 := floorSum_parity hq hqo hqp' hpo
  have e3 : floorSum q p + floorSum p q = ((half p * half q : Nat) : Int) := by
    rw [floorSum_add hp hq hpo hqo hpq]; push_cast; rfl
  rw [neg_one_pow_int, neg_one_pow_int]
  generalize half p * half q = N at e3 ⊢
  have hpar : (gaussMu q p + gaussMu p q) % 2 = N % 2 := by
    have : ((gaussMu q p + gaussMu p q : Nat) : Int) % 2 = (N : Int) % 2 := by
      push_cast; omega
    omega
  rw [hpar]

/-- Addition respects equivalence. -/
theorem add_equiv {a b a' b' : CauSeq} (h₁ : a ≈ a') (h₂ : b ≈ b') : add a b ≈ add a' b' :=
  fun ε hε => by
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := h₁ (ε / 2) (by grind)
    obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := h₂ (ε / 2) (by grind)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have := h₁ n (by omega)
    have := h₂ n (by omega)
    have := abs_add (a n - a' n) (b n - b' n)
    have e : a n - a' n + (b n - b' n) = add a b n - add a' b' n := by simp; grind
    rw [e] at this
    grind

/-- **`R[x]` is an integral domain when `R` is**, and degrees add:
`deg (p q) = deg p + deg q` with leading coefficient `lc p · lc q`. -/
theorem mul_ne_zero_of_domain (hD : IsDomain R) {p q : Polynomial R} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    p * q ≠ 0 ∧ coeff (p * q) (natDegree p + natDegree q) = leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q := by
  obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := mul_top (degLT_natDegree hp) (degLT_natDegree hq)
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, h1⟩
  rw [h, coeff_zero] at h1

/-- A corollary: for every prime `p` the next prime is less than `2p` — more precisely, there is
a prime `q` with `p < q < 2p`. -/
theorem exists_prime_between_p_two_p {p : Nat} (hp : Prime p) : ∃ q, Prime q ∧ p < q ∧ q < 2 * p := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, h1, h2⟩ := bertrand p (by have := hp.1; omega)
  refine ⟨q, hq, h1, ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (2 * p) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have hq2 : q = 2 * p := by omega
    rcases hq.2 2 ⟨p, hq2⟩ with h' | h' <;> have := hp.1 <;> omega
Foundations.Categories.IsLimit.ofIso:
/-- Transport of a limit along an isomorphism of apexes: if `c` is a limit and
`i : X ≅ c.pt`, the cone with apex `X` and legs `i.hom ≫ π_j` is again a limit. -/
def ofIso (hc : IsLimit c) {X : C} (i : X ≅ c.pt) :
    IsLimit (⟨X, fun j => i.hom ≫ c.π j, fun f => by rw [assoc, c.w]⟩ : Cone F) where
  lift s := hc.lift s ≫ i.inv
  fac s j := by
    show (hc.lift s ≫ i.inv) ≫ (i.hom ≫ c.π j) = s.π j
    rw [assoc, ← assoc i.inv, i.inv_hom_id, id_comp, hc.fac]
  uniq s m hm := by
    have : m ≫ i.hom = hc.lift s := hc.uniq s _ fun j => by rw [assoc]; exact hm j
    rw [← this, assoc, i.hom_inv_id, comp_id]
