Foundations.Numbers.R.ratio_test:
/-- **Ratio test.** If from some index `N` on `|aₙ₊₁| ≤ q |aₙ|` with `0 ≤ q < 1`, then `Σ |aₙ|`
converges (and hence so does `Σ aₙ`). -/
theorem ratio_test {a : Nat → R} {q : R} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : Nat)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → abs (a (n + 1)) ≤ q * abs (a n)) :
    ∃ t, HasSum (fun n => abs (a n)) t := by
  -- The tail from `N` on is dominated by the geometric series `|a_N| · Σ qᵏ`.
  have hdom : ∀ k, abs (a (N + k)) ≤ abs (a N) * q ^ k := fun k => by
    induction k with
    | zero => show abs (a (N + 0)) ≤ abs (a N) * 1; grind
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ']
      have := h (N + k) (by omega)
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hq0
      grind
  have hgeo := (hasSum_geometric (r := q) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1)).const_mul
    (abs (a N))
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := comparison (a := fun k => abs (a (N + k))) (fun k => abs_nonneg _) hdom hgeo
  refine ⟨s + fsum (fun n => abs (a n)) N, ?_⟩
  apply (hasSum_shift_iff N).1
  rw [show s + fsum (fun n => abs (a n)) N - fsum (fun n => abs (a n)) N = s by grind]
  exact hs

Foundations.NumberTheory.primorial_split:
/-- Splitting the primorial: `(2m+1)# = (m+1)# · ∏_{m+1 < p ≤ 2m+1} p`. -/
theorem primorial_split (m : Nat) :
    primorial (2 * m + 1) = primorial (m + 1) *
      bprod (fun i => if Prime i ∧ m + 1 < i then i else 1) (2 * m + 2) := by
  unfold primorial
  let f1 : Nat → Nat := fun i => if Prime i ∧ i ≤ m + 1 then i else 1
  have hsplit : bprod (fun i => if Prime i then i else 1) (2 * m + 1 + 1) =
      bprod (fun i => f1 i * (if Prime i ∧ m + 1 < i then i else 1)) (2 * m + 2) := by
    apply bprod_congr
    intro i _
    by_cases hp : Prime i <;> by_cases hi : i ≤ m + 1 <;> by_cases hi2 : m + 1 < i <;>
      simp [f1, hp, hi, hi2] <;> omega
  rw [hsplit, bprod_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [bprod_eq_of_one (A := m + 2) (fun i hi => by simp only [f1]; split <;> omega) (by omega)]
  apply bprod_congr
  intro i hi
  by_cases hp : Prime i <;> simp [f1, hp] <;> omega
Foundations.Numbers.R.exists_tagged:
/-- **Fine tagged partitions exist**: for `a ≤ b` and `δ > 0` there is a tagged partition of
`[a, b]` with all pieces shorter than `δ`. -/
theorem exists_tagged {a b δ : R} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ l, IsTagged a l b ∧ MeshLt δ a l := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_div_lt (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ b - a) hδ
  have hh : (0 : R) ≤ (b - a) / ((N : R) + 1) := by
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (N : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 (by grind)))
  have := unif_isTagged hh (N + 1) a
  rw [unif_end] at this
  exact ⟨_, this, unif_meshLt (hN N (Nat.le_refl N)) _ a⟩

Foundations.Logic.Computability.Eval.det:
/-- **Determinism.** A computation has at most one result. -/
theorem Eval.det {c : Code} {xs : List Nat} {n : Nat} (h : Eval c xs n) :
    ∀ {m}, Eval c xs m → n = m := by
  induction h with
  | zero => intro m h; cases h; rfl
  | succ => intro m h; cases h; rfl
  | proj => intro m h; cases h; rfl
  | comp vs _ _ ihg ihf =>
      intro m h
      cases h with
      | comp vs' hg' hf' =>
          have : vs = vs' := funext fun i => ihg i (hg' i)
          subst this
          exact ihf hf'
  | prec_zero _ ih => intro m h; cases h with | prec_zero h' => exact ih h'
  | prec_succ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      intro m h
      cases h with
      | prec_succ h₁ h₂ =>
          have := ih₁ h₁
          subst this
          exact ih₂ h₂
  | @mu f xs n ks _ _ ih₀ ihlt =>
      intro m h
      cases h with
      | mu ks' h₀' hlt' =>
          rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy n m with hnm | rfl | hmn
          · exact absurd (ih₀ (hlt' n hnm)) (by omega)
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (ihlt m hmn h₀') (by omega)

    · exact le_refl' _
    · exact le_of_lt' h'
  · intro h h'; exact lt_irrefl' _ (lt_of_le_of_lt' h h')

/-- A point that is not fixed has at least two points in its orbit. -/
theorem one_lt_count_orbit {x : X} (hx : ¬ IsFixed G x) : 1 < count (orbit G x) := by
  have : ∃ g : G, g • x ≠ x := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hno
    exact hx fun g => Classical.byContradiction fun hg => hno ⟨g, hg⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := this
  have h1 := count_split (orbit G x) (· = x)
  have h2 : count (fun y => orbit G x y ∧ y = x) = 1 := by
    rw [← count_eq_self x]
    exact count_congr fun y => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h ▸ mem_orbit_self (G := G) x, h⟩⟩
  have h3 : 0 < count (fun y => orbit G x y ∧ ¬ y = x) := count_pos.2 ⟨g • x, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hg⟩
  omega

Foundations.Topology.IsOpen:
/-- A set `U` is **open** if around each of its points it contains a ball. -/
def IsOpen (U : X → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x, U x → ∃ ε : R, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ y, dist x y < ε → U y
Foundations.Categories.groups_product:
/-- **The direct product is a product** in the category of groups. -/
def groups_product (G H : GroupCat.{u}) :
    IsProduct G H (GroupCat.mk (G.carrier × H.carrier)) (fstHom G.carrier H.carrier)
      (sndHom G.carrier H.carrier) where
  lift f g := (⟨fun w => (f.toFun w, g.toFun w), fun a b => by
    show (f.toFun (a * b), g.toFun (a * b)) = (f.toFun a * f.toFun b, g.toFun a * g.toFun b)
    rw [f.map_mul, g.map_mul]⟩ : Foundations.Algebra.Hom _ (G.carrier × H.carrier))
  fac₁ _ _ := Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ext fun _ => rfl
  fac₂ _ _ := Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ext fun _ => rfl
  uniq f g h h₁ h₂ := Foundations.Algebra.Hom.ext fun w => by
    subst h₁ h₂
    rfl
Foundations.Logic.FO.dvd_fact:
/-- Every `1 ≤ k ≤ n` divides `n!`. -/
theorem dvd_fact : ∀ {k n : Nat}, 0 < k → k ≤ n → k ∣ fact n
  | _, 0, hk, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | k, n + 1, hk, h => by
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h) with h' | rfl
      · exact Nat.dvd_trans (dvd_fact hk (by omega)) (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
      · exact Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.intEn:
/-- An enumeration of the integers: `0, −1, 1, −2, 2, …`. -/
def intEnum (k : Nat) : Int := if k % 2 = 0 then (k / 2 : Nat) else -((k / 2 : Nat) : Int) - 1
Foundations.Numbers.R.fsum_zero':
/-- A sum of zeros is zero. -/
theorem fsum_zero' {f : Nat → R} (h : ∀ k, f k = 0) (n : Nat) : fsum f n = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [fsum_succ, ih, h n]; grind
Foundations.Types.SystemF.SN.step:
/-- Reducts of strongly normalizing terms are strongly normalizing. -/
theorem SN.step {t t' : Term} (h : SN t) (hs : Step t t') : SN t' := Acc.inv h hs
Foundations.Algebra.FiniteType.exists_le:
/-- **Least-number principle.** If some natural number has property `P`, there is a least
one. -/
theorem exists_least (P : Nat → Prop) (h : ∃ n, P n) :
    ∃ n, P n ∧ ∀ m, m < n → ¬ P m := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases hmin : ∀ m, m < n → ¬ P m
    · exact ⟨n, hn, hmin⟩
    · apply Classical.byContradiction
      intro hno
      apply hmin
      intro m hm hPm
      exact hno (ih m hm hPm)
Foundations.Topology.IsConnected.image:
/-- **The continuous image of a connected set is connected.** -/
theorem IsConnected.image {τ : Topology X} {σ : Topology Y} {A : X → Prop}
    (hA : IsConnected τ A) {f : X → Y} (hf : Topology.Continuous τ σ f) :
    IsConnected σ (fun y => ∃ x, A x ∧ f x = y) := by
  rintro ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hcov, ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hxU⟩, ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hyV⟩, hdis⟩
  exact hA ⟨_, _, hf U hU, hf V hV, fun z hz => hcov _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, ⟨x, hx, hxU⟩, ⟨y, hy, hyV⟩,
    fun z hz h1 h2 => hdis _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ h1 h2⟩
Foundations.NumberTheory.primeCount:
/-- The **prime counting function** `π(n)`: the number of primes `p ≤ n`. -/
def primeCount (n : Nat) : Nat := countBelow Prime (n + 1)
Foundations.Logic.FO.PA_sound:
/-- **Every theorem of PA is true in ℕ.** If PA derives `φ`, then `φ` holds in the
standard model under every assignment. -/
theorem PA_sound {φ : Formula Arith} (h : PA ⊢₁ φ) (e : Nat → Nat) : Sat stdModel e φ :=
  Proves.soundness h stdModel e (fun ψ hψ => stdModel_isModel.2 ψ hψ e)
Foundations.Logic.FO.witnesses:
/-- The witness formulas to be added along with `ψ`: `φ(y)` with `y` fresh if `ψ` is
`∃x φ(x)`, and nothing otherwise. -/
noncomputable def witnesses (A : List (Formula L)) : Formula L → List (Formula L)
  | ex φ => [φ.inst (.var (freshVar hΓ₀ A (ex φ)))]
  | _ => []
Foundations.Probability.sq_le_sq_of_le_a:
/-- `ε ≤ |d|` with `ε ≥ 0` gives `ε² ≤ d²`. -/
theorem sq_le_sq_of_le_abs {e d : R} (he : 0 ≤ e) (h : e ≤ OF.abs d) : e * e ≤ d * d := by
  have := mul_self_le_mul_self he h
  rcases OF.abs_cases d with ⟨_, h'⟩ | ⟨_, h'⟩ <;> rw [h'] at this <;> grind
Foundations.Bridges.Z_ofInt_le:
/-- `ofInt` preserves and reflects the order. -/
theorem Z_ofInt_le (m n : Int) : Z.ofInt m ≤ Z.ofInt n ↔ m ≤ n := by
  rw [Z.toInt_le, Z_toInt_ofInt, Z_toInt_ofInt]
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.vital:
/-- **The Vitali set is not Lebesgue measurable.** Otherwise its countably many disjoint
translates `V + q (mod 1)`, all of the same measure, would fill `[0, 1)`, which has measure `1` —
impossible whether that common measure is zero or positive. -/
theorem vitali_not_measurable : ¬ LebesgueMeasurable V := by
  intro hV
  let L := lebesgue 0 1
  have hVI : ∀ x, V x → I x := fun x h => h.1
  have hsubI : ∀ {A : R → Prop}, (∀ x, A x → I x) → L.μ A = outer A := fun {A} h =>
    outer_congr fun x => ⟨fun h => h.1, fun hx => ⟨hx, (h x hx).1, Std.le_of_lt (h x hx).2⟩⟩
  have hmeas : ∀ r, LebesgueMeasurable (shift V r) := fun r =>
    lebesgueSigma.congr (lebesgueSigma.inter measurable_I
      (lebesgueSigma.union (hV.translate r) (lebesgueSigma.congr (hV.translate (r - 1))
        fun x => by rw [show x - (r - 1) = x - r + 1 by grind])))
      fun x => Iff.rfl
  have hsh : ∀ r, I r → L.μ (shift V r) = outer V := fun r hr => by
    rw [hsubI fun x h => h.1, outer_shift hV hr]
  have hI : L.μ I = 1 := by rw [hsubI fun x h => h, outer_I]
  rcases (by have := outer_nonneg V; grind : outer V = 0 ∨ 0 < outer V) with h0 | hpos
  · -- Countably many translates of measure `0` would fill `[0, 1)`.
    let A : Nat → R → Prop := fun n x => (∀ k, k < n → q k ≠ q n) ∧ shift V (q n) x
    have hA : ∀ n, LebesgueMeasurable (A n) := fun n => by
      by_cases hn : ∀ k, k < n → q k ≠ q n
      · exact lebesgueSigma.congr (hmeas (q n)) fun x => ⟨fun h => ⟨hn, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
      · exact lebesgueSigma.congr lebesgueSigma.empty fun x => ⟨False.elim, fun h => hn h.1⟩
    have h := L.additive A hA (fun m n hmn x h1 h2 => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hmn with hlt | hlt
      · exact shift_disjoint (q_mem m) (q_mem n) (h2.1 m hlt) (q_rel m n) h1.2 h2.2
      · exact shift_disjoint (q_mem m) (q_mem n) (fun e => h1.1 n hlt e.symm) (q_rel m n)
          h1.2 h2.2)
    have e : (fun x => ∃ n, A n x) = I := funext fun x => propext
      ⟨fun ⟨n, h⟩ => h.2.1, fun hx => by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := shift_cover hx
        obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hmin⟩ := nat_least (fun j => q j = q k) ⟨k, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨k₀, fun j hj e => hmin j hj (e.trans hk₀), hk₀ ▸ hk⟩⟩
    rw [e, hI] at h
    have hz : ∀ n, L.μ (A n) = 0 := fun n => by
      by_cases hn : ∀ k, k < n → q k ≠ q n
      · have : A n = shift V (q n) := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hn, h⟩⟩
        rw [this, hsh _ (q_mem n), h0]
      · have : A n = fun _ => False := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => hn h.1, fun h => h.elim⟩
        rw [this, L.empty]
    have := h.unique (InvariantMeasure.hasSum_of_zero (m := 0) fun k _ => hz k)
    rw [fsum_zero] at this; grind
  · -- Finitely many disjoint translates would already have total measure `> 1`.
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := archimedean (1 / outer V)
    have hmV : 1 < (m : R) * outer V := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm hpos
      have : 1 / outer V * outer V = 1 := by grind
      grind
    let r : Nat → R := fun k => (k : R) / ((m : R) + 1)
    have hr : ∀ k, k < m → I (r k) := fun k hk => frac_mem (by omega)
    have hrinj : ∀ j k, r j = r k → j = k := fun j k e => by
      have hm := succ_pos m
      have : (j : R) = (k : R) := by
        have : (j : R) = r j * ((m : R) + 1) := by show _ = _ / _ * _; grind
        rw [this, e]; show _ / _ * _ = _; grind
      exact Nat.le_antisymm (OrderedRing.le_of_natCast_le_natCast (R := R) _ _ (by grind))
        (OrderedRing.le_of_natCast_le_natCast (R := R) _ _ (by grind))
    let A : Nat → R → Prop := fun k x => k < m ∧ shift V (r k) x
    have hA : ∀ k, LebesgueMeasurable (A k) := fun k => by
      by_cases hk : k < m
      · exact lebesgueSigma.congr (hmeas (r k)) fun x => ⟨fun h => ⟨hk, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
      · exact lebesgueSigma.congr lebesgueSigma.empty fun x => ⟨False.elim, fun h => hk h.1⟩
    have h := L.additive A hA (fun j k hjk x h1 h2 =>
      shift_disjoint (hr j h1.1) (hr k h2.1) (fun e => hjk (hrinj j k e))
        (rel_trans (rel_frac_zero j m) (rel_symm (rel_frac_zero k m))) h1.2 h2.2)
    have hz : ∀ k, m ≤ k → L.μ (A k) = 0 := fun k hk => by
      have : A k = fun _ => False := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => by omega, fun h => h.elim⟩
      rw [this, L.empty]
    have hsum := h.unique (InvariantMeasure.hasSum_of_zero hz)
    have hval : ∀ j, j ≤ m → fsum (fun k => L.μ (A k)) j = (j : R) * outer V := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro _; rw [fsum_zero]; grind
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hj
        have : A j = shift V (r j) := funext fun x => propext ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨by omega, h⟩⟩
        rw [fsum_succ, ih (by omega), this, hsh _ (hr j (by omega))]; grind
    rw [hval m (Nat.le_refl m)] at hsum
    have := L.mono (lebesgueSigma.iUnion A hA) measurable_I fun x ⟨n, h⟩ => h.2.1
    grind
Foundations.Numbers.Q.inv_one:
/-- The inverse of one is one. -/
theorem inv_one : (1 : Q)⁻¹ = 1 := by
  simp only [ofNat_def, mk_inv, invFrac]; rfl
Foundations.Algebra.Polynomial.Xpow:
/-- The monomial `X ^ j`. -/
def Xpow : Nat → Polynomial R
  | 0 => 1
  | j + 1 => X * Xpow j
Foundations.Numbers.R.pi:
/-- **The number π**, defined as twice the first positive zero of cosine. -/
noncomputable def pi : R := 2 * Classical.choose exists_first_zero_cos
Foundations.Logic.kalmar_completeness:
/-- **Weak completeness (Kalmár).** Every tautology is derivable from no premises. -/
theorem kalmar_completeness {φ : Formula} (h : φ.Tautology) : Theory.empty ⊢ φ := by
  apply eliminate_rows (atoms φ)
  intro v
  have := kalmar_lemma v (atoms φ) φ (fun _ ha => ha)
  rw [h v] at this
  exact this.weaken fun ψ hψ => Or.inr hψ
Foundations.Bridges.cutToSet_setToCut:
/-- Reading a set-theoretic real back and forth returns it. -/
theorem cutToSet_setToCut (A : ZFSet) (hA : A ∈ RSet) : cutToSet (setToCut A hA) = A := by
  apply ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := qToSet_surj (cutToSet_subset _ hx)
    exact qToSet_mem_cutToSet.1 hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := qToSet_surj ((mem_RSet.1 hA).1 hx)
    exact qToSet_mem_cutToSet.2 hx
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Tends:
/-- A subsequence (with indices `φ k ≥ k`) of a convergent sequence converges to the same limit. -/
theorem Tendsto.comp_ge {a : Nat → R} {L : R} (h : Tendsto a L) {φ : Nat → Nat}
    (hφ : ∀ k, k ≤ φ k) : Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k)) L := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h ε hε
  exact ⟨N, fun k hk => hN (φ k) (Nat.le_trans hk (hφ k))⟩
Foundations.Numbers.Z.zero_def:
/-- Zero, unfolded to a representative. -/
@[simp] theorem zero_def : (0 : Z) = mk 0 0 := rfl
Foundations.Types.SystemF.tlam_red:
/-- **Type abstraction is reducible** when every instance of its body is
reducible, for every candidate. -/
theorem tlam_red {ρ : Nat → Cand} {A : Ty} {s : Term}
    (h : ∀ (B : Ty) (C : Cand), RED (extend C ρ) A (tyInst s B)) : RED ρ (.all A) (tlam s) :=
  tlam_red_aux s (SN.of_tyInst ((interp (extend snCand ρ) A).cr1 _ (h (.tvar 0) snCand))) h
Foundations.Topology.MeasureTheory.Lebes:
/-- A measurable set splits any bounded test set additively. -/
theorem LebesgueMeasurable.split {E T : R → Prop} (hE : LebesgueMeasurable E) {a b : R}
    (hT : ∀ x, T x → Icc a b x) :
    outer T = outer (fun x => T x ∧ E x) + outer (fun x => T x ∧ ¬ E x) := by
  have h := hE a b T
  simp only [nu] at h
  rw [outer_congr (A := fun x => T x ∧ Icc a b x) (B := T) fun x => ⟨fun h => h.1,
    fun h => ⟨h, hT x h⟩⟩] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1 <;> exact outer_congr fun x => ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, hT x h.1⟩⟩
Foundations.Numbers.C.mul_assoc:
/-- Multiplication is associative. -/
theorem mul_assoc (x y z : C) : x * y * z = x * (y * z) := by cpx
Foundations.Numbers.R.eps_pos:
/-- `1/(k+1) > 0`. -/
theorem eps_pos (k : Nat) : (0 : R) < 1 / ((k : R) + 1) :=
  div_pos (by grind) (by have : (0 : R) ≤ (k : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg; grind)
Foundations.Numbers.C.conj_add:
/-- Conjugation preserves addition. -/
theorem conj_add (z w : C) : conj (z + w) = conj z + conj w := by cpx
Foundations.Algebra.InS:
/-- Membership in Zagier's set: `x² + 4yz = p`. -/
def InS (t : Nat × Nat × Nat) : Prop := t.1 * t.1 + 4 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = p
Foundations.Numbers.C.peval_of_not_nonZe:
/-- A list of zeros evaluates to `0`. -/
theorem peval_of_not_nonZero {l : List C} (h : ¬ NonZero l) (z : C) : peval l z = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne; exact h ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self, hne⟩
    have hl : ¬ NonZero l := fun ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ => h ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb, hb0⟩
    show a + z * peval l z = 0; rw [ih hl, ha]; grind
Foundations.Topology.JointCont.comp:
/-- Composing a jointly continuous `F` with a continuous `y` gives a continuous `s ↦ F(s, y(s))`. -/
theorem JointCont.comp (hF : JointCont F) {y : R → R} (hy : ∀ s, R.ContinuousAt y s) (s : R) :
    R.ContinuousAt (fun s => F s (y s)) s := fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, k⟩ := hF s (y s) ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', k'⟩ := hy s δ hδ
  obtain ⟨η, hη, e1, e2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ hδ'
  exact ⟨η, hη, fun t ht => k t (y t) (by grind) (k' t (by grind))⟩
Foundations.Categories.Kleisli.category:
/-- **The Kleisli category** of a monad `M`: arrows `X ⟶ Y` are arrows `X ⟶ T Y` of `C`
("effectful maps"), composed by `f ≫ T g ≫ μ` and with the unit `η` as identities. -/
instance Kleisli.category (M : Monad' C) : Category.{v} (Kleisli M) where
  Hom X Y := X.of ⟶ M.T.obj Y.of
  id X := M.η X.of
  comp f g := f ≫ M.T.map g ≫ M.μ _
  id_comp f := by
    show M.η _ ≫ M.T.map f ≫ M.μ _ = f
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← M.η_nat, Category.assoc, M.left_unit, comp_id]
  comp_id f := by
    show f ≫ M.T.map (M.η _) ≫ M.μ _ = f
    rw [M.right_unit, comp_id]
  assoc f g h := by
    show (f ≫ M.T.map g ≫ M.μ _) ≫ M.T.map h ≫ M.μ _ =
      f ≫ M.T.map (g ≫ M.T.map h ≫ M.μ _) ≫ M.μ _
    simp only [M.T.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    rw [M.assoc, ← Category.assoc (M.T.map (M.T.map h)), M.μ_nat h, Category.assoc]
Foundations.Bridges.ZFModel.R_trans:
/-- `R` is transitive. -/
theorem R_trans {p q r : ZFSet} (h₁ : M.R p q) (h₂ : M.R q r) : M.R p r := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := M.enc_surj p (M.rel_mem p q h₁).1
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := M.enc_surj q (M.rel_mem _ q h₁).2
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := M.enc_surj r (M.rel_mem _ r h₂).2
  exact (M.rel_iff a c).2 (Setoid.trans ((M.rel_iff a b).1 h₁) ((M.rel_iff b c).1 h₂))
Foundations.Numbers.N.zero_le:
/-- Zero is below everything. -/
theorem zero_le (a : N) : zero ≤ a := ⟨a, zero_add a⟩
Foundations.Algebra.le_adjoin:
/-- `F ⊆ F(γ)`. -/
theorem le_adjoin : F.le (adjoin hΩ F γ hγ) := fun x hx => ⟨C ⟨x, hx⟩, aeval_C F γ _⟩
Foundations.Algebra.galImage_transitive:
/-- **The image acts transitively on the roots.** -/
theorem galImage_transitive (j : Fin 5) : ∃ g : galImage, g • (0 : Fin 5) = j := by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_aut_root j
  refine ⟨⟨galRep σ, σ, trivial, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply qβ_spec.1
  show qβ (permFun σ 0) = qβ j
  rw [permFun_spec]; exact hσ
Foundations.Topology.Outer.coverSum_le:
/-- **Upper bound.** `[a, b]` has covers of total length `b − a + ε` for every `ε > 0`. -/
theorem coverSum_le (a b : R) {ε : R} (hε : 0 < ε) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    CoverSum (fun x => a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) (b - a + ε) := by
  let lo : Nat → R := fun n => if n = 0 then a - ε / 2 else 0
  let hi : Nat → R := fun n => if n = 0 then b + ε / 2 else 0
  refine ⟨lo, hi, fun n => ?_, fun x hx => ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · show (if n = 0 then a - ε / 2 else 0) ≤ (if n = 0 then b + ε / 2 else 0); split <;> grind
  · show (if 0 = 0 then a - ε / 2 else 0) < x; rw [ite_pos' rfl]; grind
  · show x < (if 0 = 0 then b + ε / 2 else 0); rw [ite_pos' rfl]; grind
  · have h := Vitali.InvariantMeasure.hasSum_of_zero (b := fun n => hi n - lo n) (m := 1)
      fun k hk => by show (if k = 0 then b + ε / 2 else 0) - (if k = 0 then a - ε / 2 else 0) = 0
                     rw [ite_neg' (by omega), ite_neg' (by omega)]; grind
    have e : fsum (fun n => hi n - lo n) 1 = b - a + ε := by
      show 0 + ((if 0 = 0 then b + ε / 2 else 0) - (if 0 = 0 then a - ε / 2 else 0)) = _
      rw [ite_pos' rfl, ite_pos' rfl]; grind
    rw [e] at h; exact h
Foundations.Numbers.R.unif_end:
/-- Writing `b = a + (n+1) · ((b − a)/(n+1))`. -/
theorem unif_end (a b : R) (n : Nat) :
    a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) * ((b - a) / ((n : R) + 1)) = b := by
  have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  grind
Foundations.Numbers.Categoricity.sq_aux:
/-- One half of `sameCut_sq`, using approximation of squares by rational squares. -/
theorem sq_aux (hF : Archimedean F) {a : F} {b : G} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : SameCut a b) (q : Q) (hq : ofRat q < a * a) : ofRat q < b * b := by
  by_cases hq0 : (0 : F) ≤ ofRat q
  · have hapos : 0 < a := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
      have : a = 0 := by grind
      rw [this] at hq; grind
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := exists_rat_sq_between hF hapos hq0 hq
    have hrb := (h r).1 hr2
    have hr0 : (0 : G) < ofRat r := by
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := F) (p := 0) (q := r)).1 (by rw [ofRat_zero]; exact hr1)
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := G) (p := 0) (q := r)).2 this
      rwa [ofRat_zero] at this
    have hqr : q < r * r := by
      rw [← ofRat_lt (K := F), ofRat_mul]; exact hr3
    have hqr' : ofRat (K := G) q < ofRat r * ofRat r := by
      rw [← ofRat_mul]; exact (ofRat_lt (K := G)).2 hqr
    have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Std.le_of_lt hrb) (Std.le_of_lt hr0)
    have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hrb (by grind : (0 : G) < b)
    grind
  · have h1 : ofRat (K := G) q < 0 := by
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := F) (p := q) (q := 0)).1 (by rw [ofRat_zero]; grind)
      have := (ofRat_lt (K := G) (p := q) (q := 0)).2 this
      rwa [ofRat_zero] at this
    have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hb hb
    grind
Foundations.Numbers.R.bounded_above:
/-- A continuous function on `[a, b]` is bounded above. -/
theorem bounded_above {f : R → R} {a b : R} (hf : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ∃ M, ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → f x ≤ M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hx : ∀ n : Nat, ∃ x, (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b) ∧ (n : R) < f x := fun n => by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h
    exact hno ⟨n, fun x h1 h2 => by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h3; exact h ⟨x, ⟨h1, h2⟩, by grind⟩⟩
  let xs : Nat → R := fun n => (hx n).choose
  have hxs : ∀ n, (a ≤ xs n ∧ xs n ≤ b) ∧ (n : R) < f (xs n) := fun n => (hx n).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, L, hL⟩ := bolzano_weierstrass (bounded_of_mem fun n => (hxs n).1)
  have haL : a ≤ L := le_of_tendsto hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.1
  have hLb : L ≤ b := tendsto_le hL fun k => (hxs (φ k)).1.2
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := tendsto_comp (hf L haL hLb) hL 1 (by grind)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := archimedean (f L + 1)
  let k := max N m
  have k1 := abs_lt.1 (hN k (by omega))
  have k2 := (hxs (φ k)).2
  have k3 : (m : R) ≤ (φ k : R) :=
    OrderedRing.natCast_le_natCast_of_le _ _ (by have := le_of_strictMono hφ k; omega)
  simp only at k1
  grind
Foundations.Algebra.S5_generated_of_tran:
/-- **`S₅` is generated by any transposition and any element of order `5`.** A subgroup `H` of
`S₅` containing a transposition `(a b)` and an element `g` with `g⁵ = 1`, `g ≠ 1` (that is, a
5-cycle) contains every permutation of five letters. -/
theorem S5_generated_of_transposition (H : Subgroup (Perm (Fin 5))) {a b : Fin 5} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ht : swap a b ∈ H) {g : Perm (Fin 5)} (hg : g ∈ H) (h5 : g ^ 5 = 1) (h1 : g ≠ 1) :
    ∀ σ, σ ∈ H := by
  -- a power `h = gᵏ` sends `a` to `b`
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := orbit_all h5 (moves_all h5 h1 a) b
  let h := g ^ k.val
  have hH : h ∈ H := H.pow_mem hg _
  have hh5 : h ^ 5 = 1 := by
    show (g ^ k.val) ^ 5 = 1
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul, h5, one_pow]
  have hha : h a ≠ a := by
    show (g ^ k.val) a ≠ a; rw [hk]; exact fun e => hab e.symm
  -- the relabelling `π i = hⁱ a`
  let π := permOfInjective (orbitMap h a) (orbitMap_injective hh5 hha)
  have hπ : ∀ i, π i = (h ^ i.val) a := fun _ => rfl
  have hπ0 : π 0 = a := rfl
  have hπ1 : π 1 = b := by rw [hπ]; show (g ^ k.val * 1) a = b; rw [Group.mul_one]; exact hk
  -- conjugation by `π` normalises the generators
  have hc : π * c5 * π⁻¹ = h := by
    apply ext; intro y
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := FiniteType.surjective_of_injective _ (fun _ _ e => π.injective e) y
    rw [Group.mul_assoc, mul_apply, mul_apply, Perm.inv_apply_self, c5_apply, hπ, hπ]
    show (h ^ ((i.val + 1) % 5)) a = h ((h ^ i.val) a)
    rw [← pow_mod_five hh5, ← perm_pow_comm_apply]; rfl
  have hs : π * swap 0 1 * π⁻¹ = swap a b := by rw [conj_swap, hπ0, hπ1]
  -- the conjugate subgroup contains the normalised generators
  let K : Subgroup (Perm (Fin 5)) :=
    { carrier := fun σ => π * σ * π⁻¹ ∈ H
      one_mem := by
        show π * 1 * π⁻¹ ∈ H
        rw [Group.mul_one, Group.mul_inv_cancel]; exact H.one_mem
      mul_mem := fun {σ τ} hσ hτ => by
        show π * (σ * τ) * π⁻¹ ∈ H
        have e : π * (σ * τ) * π⁻¹ = (π * σ * π⁻¹) * (π * τ * π⁻¹) := by
          simp only [Group.mul_assoc, Group.inv_mul_cancel_left]
        rw [e]; exact H.mul_mem hσ hτ
      inv_mem := fun {σ} hσ => by
        show π * σ⁻¹ * π⁻¹ ∈ H
        have e : π * σ⁻¹ * π⁻¹ = (π * σ * π⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
          simp only [Group.mul_inv_rev, Group.inv_inv, Group.mul_assoc]
        rw [e]; exact H.inv_mem hσ }
  have hall := S5_generated K (show π * swap 0 1 * π⁻¹ ∈ H by rw [hs]; exact ht)
    (show π * c5 * π⁻¹ ∈ H by rw [hc]; exact hH)
  intro σ
  have := hall (π⁻¹ * σ * π)
  have e : π * (π⁻¹ * σ * π) * π⁻¹ = σ := by
    simp only [Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_cancel_left, Group.mul_inv_cancel, Group.mul_one]
  have h' : π * (π⁻¹ * σ * π) * π⁻¹ ∈ H := this
  rw [e] at h'; exact h'

/-- Primality is decidable: it suffices to test the divisors `d ≤ p`. (A naive but honest
procedure; the kernel can run it on numbers in the thousands.) -/
instance decPrime : DecidablePred Prime := fun p =>
  decidable_of_iff (2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ d, d < p + 1 → d ∣ p → d = 1 ∨ d = p) (by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h2, h⟩
      exact ⟨h2, fun d hd => h d (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd)) hd⟩
    · rintro ⟨h2, h⟩
      exact ⟨h2, fun d _ hd => h d hd⟩)

Foundations.Logic.Computability.kleene_n:
/-- **Kleene's normal form theorem.** A code `c` outputs `n` on `xs` iff there is a
computation trace `t` satisfying the (computable) T-predicate whose recorded output is
`n`. Hence every partial recursive function has the form `out(μt. T(e, x⃗, t))`. -/
theorem kleene_normal_form (c : Code) (xs : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    Eval c xs n ↔ ∃ t, kleeneT (encode c) (encList xs) t = true ∧ traceOut t = n := by
  rw [eval_iff_derivable, derivable_iff_exists_tree]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, hv, hr⟩
    refine ⟨t, by simp [kleeneT, hv, hr, judg], by simp [traceOut, hr, judg]⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, hT, rfl⟩
    simp only [kleeneT, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hT
    obtain ⟨⟨hv, h₁⟩, h₂⟩ := hT
    exact ⟨t, hv, by rw [troot_eq t, h₁, h₂]⟩

/-- **Continuity ⇔ preimages of open sets are open.** -/
theorem continuous_iff_isOpen_preimage (f : X → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ V : Y → Prop, IsOpen V → IsOpen (fun x => V (f x)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf V hV x hx
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, h⟩ := hV (f x) hx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hf x ε hε
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => h _ (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hδ' y (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hy))⟩
  · intro hf x ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf (ball (f x) ε) (isOpen_ball _ _) x (by
      show dist (f x) (f x) < ε; rw [dist_self]; exact hε)
    exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => by
      have := h y (by rw [dist_comm]; exact hy); unfold ball at this; rw [dist_comm]; exact this⟩

/-- A finite list of formulas has a common bound beyond which all variables are fresh. -/
theorem eventually_fresh_list : ∀ l : List (Formula L), ∃ k, ∀ x, k ≤ x → ∀ φ ∈ l, φ.Fresh x
  | [] => ⟨0, fun _ _ _ h => by simp at h⟩
  | φ :: l => by
      obtain ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ := eventually_fresh φ
      obtain ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ := eventually_fresh_list l
      refine ⟨max k₁ k₂, fun x hx ψ hψ => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hψ with rfl | hψ
      · exact h₁ x (by omega)
      · exact h₂ x (by omega) ψ hψ

/-- The invariant is at least `1`, with equality only for equal points. -/
theorem one_le_inv {a b : Pt R} (ha : n2 a < 1) (hb : n2 b < 1) : 1 ≤ inv a b := by
  have hk := key_ineq a b
  have hd := Pt.d2_nonneg a b
  have hpos : 0 < (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b) := OrderedRing.mul_pos (by grind) (by grind)
  have := OrderedRing.mul_nonneg hd (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 1 - n2 b)
  unfold inv
  have hne : (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b) ≠ 0 := by grind
  have e : (1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) / ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) - 1 =
      ((1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) - (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) / ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) := by
    grind
  have : 0 ≤ ((1 - dot a b) * (1 - dot a b) - (1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) /
      ((1 - n2 a) * (1 - n2 b)) := by
    rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind) (by have := Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 hpos; grind)
  grind
Foundations.Categories.Equivalence.ofFul:
/-- **A fully faithful, essentially surjective functor is an equivalence** (using the axiom
of choice to pick the inverse on objects). -/
noncomputable def Equivalence.ofFullyFaithfulEssSurj : Equivalence C D where
  functor := F
  inverse := invFunctor F hfull hfaith hess
  unit X := unitAt F hfull hfaith hess X
  counit Y := essIso F hess Y
  unit_nat {X X'} f := hfaith.map_injective (by
    change F.map (f ≫ hfull.preimage (essIso F hess (F.obj X')).inv) =
      F.map (hfull.preimage (essIso F hess (F.obj X)).inv ≫ hfull.preimage
        ((essIso F hess (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map f ≫ (essIso F hess (F.obj X')).inv))
    rw [F.map_comp, F.map_comp, hfull.map_preimage, hfull.map_preimage, hfull.map_preimage,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
  counit_nat {Y Y'} g := by
    change F.map (hfull.preimage ((essIso F hess Y).hom ≫ g ≫ (essIso F hess Y').inv)) ≫ _ = _ ≫ g
    rw [hfull.map_preimage, assoc, assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, comp_id]

Foundations.Algebra.rpow_injective_of_lt:
/-- **Distinct powers.** For a primitive `p`-th root of unity `ζ`, the powers
`ζ⁰, ζ¹, …, ζ^{p-1}` are pairwise distinct. -/
theorem rpow_injective_of_lt {p : Nat} (hp : IsPrime p) {ζ : F} (hζp : rpow ζ p = 1) (hζ1 : ζ ≠ 1)
    {i j : Nat} (hi : i < p) (hj : j < p) (h : rpow ζ i = rpow ζ j) : i = j := by
  have hD := hF.isDomain
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0] at hζp
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.1; omega⟩
    rw [hq, zero_rpow_succ] at hζp; exact hD.1 hζp
  have key : ∀ a b, a < b → b < p → rpow ζ a = rpow ζ b → False := by
    intro a b hab hb e
    have e2 : rpow ζ b = rpow ζ a * rpow ζ (b - a) := by rw [← rpow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [e2] at e
    have : rpow ζ a * (rpow ζ (b - a) + -1) = 0 := by grind
    rcases hD.2 _ _ this with h0 | h0
    · exact hζ0 (eq_zero_of_rpow_eq_zero hD h0)
    · exact rpow_ne_one_of_lt hp hζp hζ1 (k := b - a) (by omega) (by omega) (by grind)
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with h' | h' | h'
  · exact (key i j h' hj h).elim
  · exact h'
  · exact (key j i h' hi h.symm).elim

Foundations.Algebra.preimage:
/-- **Preimage of a subfield** under an embedding `τ : N → ℂ`: the elements of `N` that `τ`
sends into `M`. It is a subfield of `ℂ`. -/
def preimage {N : Subfield ℂ} (τ : RingHom N ℂ) (M : Subfield ℂ) : Subfield ℂ where
  carrier y := ∃ h : y ∈ N, τ.toFun ⟨y, h⟩ ∈ M
  zero_mem := ⟨N.zero_mem, by show τ.toFun 0 ∈ M; rw [τ.map_zero]; exact M.zero_mem⟩
  one_mem := ⟨N.one_mem, by show τ.toFun 1 ∈ M; rw [τ.map_one]; exact M.one_mem⟩
  add_mem := fun ⟨ha, ha'⟩ ⟨hb, hb'⟩ => ⟨N.add_mem ha hb, by
    show τ.toFun (⟨_, ha⟩ + ⟨_, hb⟩) ∈ M; rw [τ.map_add]; exact M.add_mem ha' hb'⟩
  neg_mem := fun ⟨ha, ha'⟩ => ⟨N.neg_mem ha, by
    show τ.toFun (-⟨_, ha⟩) ∈ M; rw [τ.map_neg]; exact M.neg_mem ha'⟩
  mul_mem := fun ⟨ha, ha'⟩ ⟨hb, hb'⟩ => ⟨N.mul_mem ha hb, by
    show τ.toFun (⟨_, ha⟩ * ⟨_, hb⟩) ∈ M; rw [τ.map_mul]; exact M.mul_mem ha' hb'⟩
  inv_mem := by
    intro a ⟨ha, ha'⟩ ha0
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := N.inv_mem ha ha0
    refine ⟨b, ⟨hb, ?_⟩, hab⟩
    have h1 : τ.toFun ⟨a, ha⟩ * τ.toFun ⟨b, hb⟩ = 1 := by
      rw [← τ.map_mul]
      have : (⟨a, ha⟩ : N) * ⟨b, hb⟩ = 1 := Subtype.ext hab
      rw [this, τ.map_one]
    have hne : τ.toFun ⟨a, ha⟩ ≠ 0 := fun h => by
      rw [h, Ring.zero_mul] at h1; exact C.isField.1 h1
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw1⟩ := M.inv_mem ha' hne
    have : τ.toFun ⟨b, hb⟩ = w := by
      calc τ.toFun ⟨b, hb⟩ = τ.toFun ⟨b, hb⟩ * (τ.toFun ⟨a, ha⟩ * w) := by rw [hw1, Ring.mul_one]
        _ = (τ.toFun ⟨a, ha⟩ * τ.toFun ⟨b, hb⟩) * w := by ac_rfl
        _ = w := by rw [h1, Ring.one_mul]
    rw [this]; exact hw

Foundations.Algebra.inv_swap:
/-- For distinct `a`, `b`, exactly one of `(a, b)` and `(b, a)` is out of order. -/
theorem inv_swap {n : Nat} {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) : inv b a = !inv a b := by
  have hv : a.val ≠ b.val := fun e => h (Fin.ext e)
  unfold inv
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hv with hl | hl
  · have h1 : a < b := hl
    have h2 : ¬ b < a := fun e => absurd (show b.val < a.val from e) (by omega)
    simp [h1, h2]
  · have h1 : b < a := hl
    have h2 : ¬ a < b := fun e => absurd (show a.val < b.val from e) (by omega)
    simp [h1, h2]
/-- **Limits are unique in Hausdorff spaces.** -/
theorem Converges.unique {τ : Topology X} (hτ : IsHausdorff τ) {s : Nat → X} {L M : X}
    (hL : Converges τ s L) (hM : Converges τ s M) : L = M := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hLU, hMV, hd⟩ := hτ L M hne
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := hL U hU hLU
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := hM V hV hMV
  exact hd _ (h₁ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega)) (h₂ (max N₁ N₂) (by omega))
Foundations.Logic.FO.eval_iff_exists_grb:
/-- **The graph of every partial recursive function is Σ₁**: `c` outputs `y` on `x⃗`
iff the bounded formula `grb c a` holds for some bound `w`. -/
theorem eval_iff_exists_grb (c : Code) (a : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat) :
    Eval c (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1)) (e 0) ↔
      ∃ w, Sat stdModel (fun n => if n = a + 1 then w else e n) (grb c a) := by
  rw [eval_iff_exists_evalB]
  refine exists_congr fun w => ?_
  rw [sat_grb]
  simp only [ite_true, show ∀ i : Nat, i + 1 = a + 1 ↔ i = a from fun i => by omega]
  have : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => (if (i : Nat) = a then w else e (i + 1))) =
      List.ofFn fun i : Fin a => e (i + 1) := by
    congr 1; funext i; simp [Nat.ne_of_lt i.isLt]
  rw [this]; simp
Foundations.Types.SystemF.num_apply:
/-- Instantiating a numeral and feeding it `f` and `x`: `n̄ [A] f x ⟶* fⁿ x`. -/
theorem num_apply (n : Nat) (A : Ty) (f x : Term) :
    Red (app (app (tapp (num n) A) f) x) (iterApp f x n) := by
  have h₁ : Step (tapp (num n) A) (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) := by
    have := Step.tbeta (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) A
    unfold num
    simpa [tyInst, tySubst, tySubst_iterApp] using this
  have h₂ : Step (app (lam (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n))) f)
      (lam (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n)) := by
    have := Step.beta (lam (iterApp (var 1) (var 0) n)) f
    simpa [inst, subst, subst_iterApp, up, cons] using this
  have h₃ : Step (app (lam (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n)) x) (iterApp f x n) := by
    have := Step.beta (iterApp (rename Nat.succ f) (var 0) n) x
    simpa [inst, subst_iterApp, subst, cons, subst_cons_rename_succ] using this
  exact ((Star.single (Step.appL (Step.appL h₁))).tail (Step.appL h₂)).tail h₃

/-- Powers of `-1` in `ℤ` depend only on the parity of the exponent. -/
theorem neg_one_pow_int (n : Nat) : (-1 : Int) ^ n = if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Int.pow_succ, ih]
    by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
    · rw [ite_true_of hn, ite_false_of (by omega)]; rfl
    · rw [ite_false_of hn, ite_true_of (by omega)]; rfl

Foundations.NumberTheory.bertrand_small:
/-- **Bertrand's postulate for `1 ≤ n < 1152`**: each interval `(n, 2n]` contains one of the
primes `2, 3, 5, 7, 13, 23, 43, 83, 163, 317, 631, 1259`. -/
theorem bertrand_small {n : Nat} (h1 : 1 ≤ n) (h2 : n < 1152) :
    ∃ p, Prime p ∧ n < p ∧ p ≤ 2 * n := by
  obtain ⟨p2, p3, p5, p7, p13, p23, p43, p83, p163, p317, p631, p1259⟩ := bertrand_chain_prime
  by_cases c : n < 2;   · exact ⟨2, p2, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 3;   · exact ⟨3, p3, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 5;   · exact ⟨5, p5, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 7;   · exact ⟨7, p7, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 13;  · exact ⟨13, p13, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 23;  · exact ⟨23, p23, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 43;  · exact ⟨43, p43, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 83;  · exact ⟨83, p83, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 163; · exact ⟨163, p163, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 317; · exact ⟨317, p317, by omega, by omega⟩
  by_cases c : n < 631; · exact ⟨631, p631, by omega, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨1259, p1259, by omega, by omega⟩
Foundations.Logic.Ordinals.ord_bump:
/-- **Bumping the base does not change the ordinal.** The hereditary base-`(c+3)`
representation of `bump c n` is the hereditary base-`(c+2)` representation of `n`. -/
theorem ord_bump (c : Nat) : ∀ n, ord (c + 1) (bump c n) = ord c n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
  have hb : 2 ≤ c + 2 := by omega
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn; rw [bump_zero, ord_zero, ord_zero]
  have he₁ := pow_lg_le hb n (by omega)
  have he₂ := lt_pow_lg hb n
  have hpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := lg (c + 2) n) (show 0 < c + 2 by omega)
  have hr : n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n < (c + 1) * (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_succ] at he₂
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]; omega
  have hR := (bump_main c (lg (c + 2) n)).2 _ (c + 1) hr (by omega)
  have hm := bump_pos c hn
  have hYpos := Nat.pow_pos (n := bump c (lg (c + 2) n)) (show 0 < c + 3 by omega)
  have hlg : lg (c + 1 + 2) (bump c n) = bump c (lg (c + 2) n) := by
    refine lg_eq_of (by omega) (by rw [hm]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _) ?_
    rw [hm]
    show _ < (c + 3) ^ (bump c (lg (c + 2) n) + 1)
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
    have := mul_add_three ((c + 3) ^ bump c (lg (c + 2) n)) c
    omega
  have hbn : bump c n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [ord_pos (c + 1) hbn, hlg, ord_pos c hn]
  have hsub : bump c n - (c + 1 + 2) ^ bump c (lg (c + 2) n) =
      bump c (n - (c + 2) ^ lg (c + 2) n) := by
    rw [hm]; show (c + 3) ^ _ + _ - (c + 3) ^ _ = _; omega
  rw [hsub, ih _ (lg_lt hb hn), ih _ (by omega)]

Foundations.Numbers.Arith.mem_of_dvd_pro:
/-- A prime dividing a product of primes is one of them. -/
theorem mem_of_dvd_prod {p : Nat} (hp : Prime p) :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, (∀ q ∈ l, Prime q) → p ∣ prod l → p ∈ l
  | [], _, h => by
    simp only [prod] at h
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; have := hp.1; omega
  | q :: l, hl, h => by
    simp only [prod] at h
    rcases euclid_lemma hp h with h' | h'
    · rcases (hl q (List.mem_cons_self ..)).2 p h' with h'' | h''
      · have := hp.1; omega
      · rw [h'']; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (mem_of_dvd_prod hp (fun r hr => hl r (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr)) h')
Foundations.Algebra.not_constructible_of:
/-- **Roots of rational cubics without rational roots are not constructible.** If `α` is a
root of a cubic over `ℚ` with no rational root, then `[ℚ(α) : ℚ] = 3`, which cannot divide the
degree `2^k` of a quadratic tower containing `α`. -/
theorem not_constructible_of_cubic {α : Ω} (C : CubicRoot (ratField hΩ hc) α) :
    ¬ Constructible hΩ hc α := by
  intro hα
  obtain ⟨F, hT, hαF⟩ := hα.mem_tower
  obtain ⟨h, hfin, k, hk⟩ := hT.deg_pow_two
  let L := C.field hΩ
  have hLF : L.le F := C.field_le hΩ h hαF
  obtain ⟨hfinL, hdegL⟩ := C.deg_field hΩ
  have hfin2 := finiteExt_of_tower (C.le_field hΩ) hLF hfin
  obtain ⟨_, htower⟩ := tower_law hΩ (C.le_field hΩ) hLF hfinL hfin2
  have : deg _ F h = deg L F hLF * 3 := by rw [← hdegL]; exact htower
  apply three_not_dvd_pow_two k
  rw [← hk, this]
  exact Nat.dvd_mul_left 3 _

Foundations.Logic.MaximalConsistent.trut:
/-- **Truth lemma.** Under the valuation determined by a maximal consistent theory
`M`, a formula is true exactly when it belongs to `M`. -/
theorem truth : ∀ φ : Formula, φ.eval (valuation M) = true ↔ M φ
  | bot => by simp only [eval]; exact ⟨nofun, fun h => absurd (Derives.hyp h) hM.1⟩
  | var n => by simp [eval, valuation]
  | imp a b => by
      have ia := truth a
      have ib := truth b
      simp only [eval, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true']
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · have : ¬ M a := fun h' => by rw [← ia] at h'; simp_all
          exact hM.closed (Derives.imp_of_neg (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff a).2 this)))
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.imp_of_right (.hyp (ib.1 h)))
      · intro h
        by_cases ha : M a
        · exact Or.inr (ib.2 (hM.closed (Derives.impE (.hyp h) (.hyp ha))))
        · left
          cases e : eval (valuation M) a
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (ia.1 e) ha
  | conj a b => by
      simp only [eval, Bool.and_eq_true, truth a, truth b]
      exact ⟨fun h => hM.closed (Derives.conjI (.hyp h.1) (.hyp h.2)),
        fun h => ⟨hM.closed (Derives.conjE₁ (.hyp h)), hM.closed (Derives.conjE₂ (.hyp h))⟩⟩
  | disj a b => by
      simp only [eval, Bool.or_eq_true, truth a, truth b]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.disjI₁ (.hyp h))
        · exact hM.closed (Derives.disjI₂ (.hyp h))
      · intro h
        refine Classical.byContradiction fun hc => ?_
        simp only [not_or] at hc
        exact (hM.neg_iff _).1 (hM.closed (Derives.neg_disj
          (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff a).2 hc.1)) (.hyp ((hM.neg_iff b).2 hc.2)))) h

/-- Every `k` with `1 ≤ k ≤ n` divides `n!`. -/
theorem dvd_fact {k n : Nat} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (h2 : k ≤ n) : k ∣ fact n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [fact]
    by_cases hk : k = n + 1
    · rw [hk]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
    · exact Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd (ih (by omega)) _

/-- Changing finitely many terms does not affect convergence: if `a` and `b` agree from some
index on, they have the same limits. -/
theorem Tendsto.congr_eventually {a b : Nat → R} {L : R} (h : Tendsto a L) (N : Nat)

Foundations.Algebra.ratField:
/-- **The prime field** `ℚ ⊆ Ω` of a field of characteristic zero: the quotients `a / b` of
integers with `b ≠ 0`. -/
def ratField (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hc : CharZero Ω) : Subfield Ω where
  carrier x := ∃ a b : Int, b ≠ 0 ∧ x * (Int.cast (b) : Ω) = (Int.cast (a) : Ω)
  zero_mem := ⟨0, 1, by decide, by grind⟩
  one_mem := ⟨1, 1, by decide, by grind⟩
  add_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, hy⟩
    refine ⟨a * d + c * b, b * d, Int.mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_add, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul,
      Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← hx, ← hy]
    grind
  neg_mem := by
    intro x ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩
    refine ⟨-a, b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_neg, ← hx]; grind
  mul_mem := by
    intro x y ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, hy⟩
    refine ⟨a * c, b * d, Int.mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
    rw [Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, Lean.Grind.Ring.intCast_mul, ← hx, ← hy]
    grind
  inv_mem := by
    intro x ⟨a, b, hb, hx⟩ hx0
    have hb' : (Int.cast (b) : Ω) ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (hc b h)
    have ha : (Int.cast (a) : Ω) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hx
      rcases hΩ.isDomain.2 _ _ hx with h1 | h1
      · exact hx0 h1
      · exact hb' h1
    have ha' : a ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (by rw [h]; grind)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hΩ.2 _ ha
    refine ⟨(Int.cast (b) : Ω) * t, ⟨b, a, ha', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · grind
    · grind

/-- A property holds of everything exactly when its count is the cardinality. -/
theorem count_eq_card {P : α → Prop} : count P = card α ↔ ∀ x, P x := by
  have h := count_add_count_not P
  constructor
  · intro hc x
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hx
    have : count (fun x => ¬ P x) = 0 := by omega
    exact count_eq_zero.1 this x hx
  · intro hall

    omega
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.trichotomy:
/-- **Trichotomy**: the order of a model of PA is linear. -/
theorem trichotomy (x y : N.Dom) : x < y ∨ x = y ∨ y < x := by
  refine induction (P := fun x e => x < e 0 ∨ x = e 0 ∨ e 0 < x) (by dfn) (fun _ => y) ?_ ?_ x
  · show 0 < y ∨ 0 = y ∨ y < 0
    rcases zero_or_succ y with rfl | ⟨w, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨w, by grind⟩
  · intro x ih
    show x + 1 < y ∨ x + 1 = y ∨ y < x + 1
    rcases ih with h | rfl | h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (lt_iff_succ_le.1 h) with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
      · exact Or.inl h'
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (lt_succ_self' _))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (lt_succ_iff'.2 (le_of_lt' h)))

Foundations.Numbers.Q.sqrt_two_irrationa:
/-- **Irrationality of √2.** There is no rational number whose square is `2`. -/
theorem sqrt_two_irrational : ¬ ∃ q : Q, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  induction q using ind with | h n d hd => ?_
  simp only [mk_mul, ofNat_def, mk_eq_mk] at hq
  have hq' : n * n = 2 * (d * d) := by grind
  have h1 : (n * n).natAbs = (2 * (d * d)).natAbs := by rw [hq']
  simp only [Int.natAbs_mul] at h1
  exact nat_sq_ne_two_sq d.natAbs (by omega) n.natAbs h1
Foundations.Numbers.R.HasIntegral.add:
/-- **Linearity I.** `∫ (f + g) = ∫ f + ∫ g`. -/
theorem HasIntegral.add {f g : R → R} {a b I J : R} (hf : HasIntegral f a b I)
    (hg : HasIntegral g a b J) : HasIntegral (fun y => f y + g y) a b (I + J) := ⟨hf.1, fun ε hε => by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg.2 (ε / 2) (by grind)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ1, hδ2⟩ := exists_pos_le_both hδ₁ hδ₂
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun l hl hm => ?_⟩
  have k1 := h₁ l hl (hm.mono hδ1)
  have k2 := h₂ l hl (hm.mono hδ2)
  rw [rsum_add]
  have k3 := abs_add (rsum f a l - I) (rsum g a l - J)
  rw [show rsum f a l - I + (rsum g a l - J) = rsum f a l + rsum g a l - (I + J) by grind] at k3
  grind⟩

/-- **Upper bound** `C(2n, n) ≤ 4ⁿ`. -/
theorem centralBinom_le_four_pow (n : Nat) : centralBinom n ≤ 4 ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n ih =>
    calc centralBinom (n + 1) ≤ 4 * centralBinom n := centralBinom_succ_le n
      _ ≤ 4 * 4 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 ih

Foundations.Algebra.ringHom_surjective_o:
/-- **An injective endomorphism of a finite extension is onto.** If `τ : L → L` is a ring
homomorphism fixing `K` and `[L : K]` is finite, every element of `L` is a value of `τ`. -/
theorem ringHom_surjective_of_finite {K L : Subfield Ω} (hKL : K.le L)
    (hfin : FiniteExt K L hKL) (τ : RingHom L L) (hfix : ∀ x : L, x.1 ∈ K → τ.toFun x = x) :
    ∀ y : L, ∃ x, τ.toFun x = y := by
  have hFK := K.isField hΩ
  have hFL := L.isField hΩ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_basis hFK hfin
  let V := L.over K hKL
  let eL : Fin (dim K V) → L := fun i => ⟨(e i).1, (e i).2⟩
  let f : Fin (dim K V) → V := fun i => ⟨(τ.toFun (eL i)).1, (τ.toFun (eL i)).2⟩
  let cL : (Fin (dim K V) → K) → Fin (dim K V) → L := fun c i => ⟨(c i).1, hKL _ (c i).2⟩
  -- `τ` commutes with `K`-linear combinations
  have hcomb : ∀ c : Fin (dim K V) → K,
      τ.toFun (isum (fun i => cL c i * eL i)) = isum (fun i => cL c i * τ.toFun (eL i)) := by
    intro c
    rw [RingHom.map_isum]
    congr 1; funext i
    rw [τ.map_mul, hfix (cL c i) (c i).2]
  have hval : ∀ (c : Fin (dim K V) → K) (v : Fin (dim K V) → L),
      (isum (fun i => cL c i * v i)).1 = isum (fun i => (c i).1 * (v i).1) := by
    intro c v; rw [Subfield.coe_isum]; rfl
  have hind : LinIndep K f := by
    intro c hc
    apply he.1 c
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    rw [KSubspace.coe_isum] at h1 ⊢
    have h2 : (τ.toFun (isum (fun i => cL c i * eL i))).1 = 0 := by
      rw [hcomb, hval]; exact h1
    have h3 : τ.toFun (isum (fun i => cL c i * eL i)) = 0 := Subtype.ext h2
    have h4 := RingHom.eq_zero_of_isField hFL hFL.1 τ h3
    have h5 := congrArg Subtype.val h4
    rw [hval] at h5
    exact h5
  have hspan := spans_of_card_eq_dim hFK hfin hind (card_fin _)
  intro y
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan ⟨y.1, y.2⟩
  refine ⟨isum (fun i => cL c i * eL i), Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [hcomb, hval]
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
  rw [KSubspace.coe_isum] at this
  exact this.symm

Foundations.NumberTheory.primeCount_mono:
/-- `π` is monotone. -/
theorem primeCount_mono {m n : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : primeCount m ≤ primeCount n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => obtain rfl : m = 0 := by omega
            exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hm : m = n + 1
    · rw [hm]; exact Nat.le_refl _
    · have := ih (by omega)
      rw [primeCount_succ]
      omega
Foundations.Algebra.artin:
/-- **Artin's theorem.** For a finite group `H` of `n` automorphisms of `L`, the extension
`L / Fix(H)` is finite of degree exactly `n`. -/
theorem artin (hΩ : IsField Ω) (hdist : ∀ i j, σ i = σ j → i = j) (hone : ∃ i, σ i = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ i j, ∃ k, σ k = σ i * σ j) :
    FiniteExt (famFix σ) L (famFix_le σ) ∧ deg (famFix σ) L (famFix_le σ) = n := by
  let F := famFix σ
  have hFF := F.isField hΩ
  have hnone : ¬ ∃ u : Fin (n + 1) → L.over F (famFix_le σ), LinIndep F u := by
    intro ⟨u, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨c, ⟨j0, hj0⟩, hcF, hc⟩ :=
      artin_dependent σ hΩ hdist hone hmul (fun j => (⟨(u j).1, (u j).2⟩ : L)) (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have := hu (fun j => ⟨(c j).1, hcF j⟩) (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [KSubspace.coe_isum]
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
      rw [Subfield.coe_isum] at this
      exact this) j0
    exact hj0 (Subtype.ext (show (c j0).1 = (0 : L).1 from congrArg (fun z : {x // x ∈ famFix σ} => z.1) this))
  obtain ⟨hfin, hle⟩ := finDim_of_no_indep hFF n hnone
  refine ⟨hfin, Nat.le_antisymm hle ?_⟩
  exact card_aut_le hΩ (famFix_le σ) hfin (famOver σ) (fun i j h => hdist i j
    (FieldAut.ext fun x => congrArg (fun τ : FieldAut F L => τ.toFun x) h))

/-- The ordinals in `ℵ(α)` are exactly the ordinals that inject into `α`. -/
theorem mem_hartogs_iff {o : ZFSet} (ho : IsOrdinal o) :
    o ∈ hartogs α ↔ ∃ f : {z // z ∈ o} → α, Function.Injective f := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨f, hf⟩ => mem_hartogs_of_injective ho hf⟩
  obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ := mem_ofFamily.1 h
  have hpt : ∀ z : {z // z ∈ W.otype}, ∃ a, W.dom a ∧ z.1 = rank W.R W.wf a :=
    fun z => WFRel.mem_otype.1 z.2
  refine ⟨fun z => Classical.choose (hpt z), fun z z' hzz' => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [(Classical.choose_spec (hpt z)).2, (Classical.choose_spec (hpt z')).2]
  simp only at hzz'
  rw [hzz']

theorem neutral_of_sum {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A B : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t (.sum A B))
    (hl : ∀ a, t ≠ inl a) (hr : ∀ a, t ≠ inr a) : Neutral t := by
  cases t with
  | inl a => exact absurd rfl (hl a)
  | inr a => exact absurd rfl (hr a)

  | pair => cases h

Foundations.Sets.Equinum.symm:
/-- Equinumerosity is symmetric (the inverse of a bijection is chosen pointwise). -/
theorem Equinum.symm {α β : Sort _} : Equinum α β → Equinum β α := by
  rintro ⟨f, hfi, hfs⟩
  let g : β → α := fun b => Classical.choose (hfs b)
  have hg : ∀ b, f (g b) = b := fun b => Classical.choose_spec (hfs b)
  refine ⟨g, fun b b' h => ?_, fun a => ⟨f a, hfi (hg (f a))⟩⟩
  rw [← hg b, ← hg b', h]

Foundations.Logic.Computability.CompB.eq:
/-- **Equality** of computable functions is a computable test. -/
theorem eq {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Comp f) (hg : Comp g) : CompB fun n => f n == g n := by
  have := Comp.ite0 (Comp.add (Comp.sub hf hg) (Comp.sub hg hf)) (Comp.const 1) (Comp.const 0)
  refine Comp.congr this fun n => ?_
  try dsimp only
  by_cases h : f n = g n
  · simp [h]
  · have : (f n == g n) = false := by simpa using h
    rw [this]; simp; omega

/-- An element of an Archimedean field is determined by its cut. -/
theorem sameCut_unique (hG : Archimedean G) {a : F} {b b' : G} (h : SameCut a b)
    (h' : SameCut a b') : b = b' := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  rcases (by grind : b < b' ∨ b' < b) with hlt | hlt
  · obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2⟩ := exists_rat_between hG hlt
    have := (h r).1 ((h' r).2 hr2); grind

    have := (h' r).1 ((h r).2 hr2); grind

Foundations.Topology.Stirling.step_bound:
/-- **The one-step bounds** `0 ≤ dₘ − d_{m+1} ≤ 1/(4m(m+1))` for `m ≥ 1`, in multiplied-out form. -/
theorem step_bounds (n : Nat) :
    0 ≤ d (n + 1) - d (n + 2) ∧
      4 * ((n : R) + 1) * ((n : R) + 2) * (d (n + 1) - d (n + 2)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hn0 : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  generalize hm : (n : R) + 1 = m
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by grind
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by grind
  have c1 : ((n + 1 : Nat) : R) = m := by rw [← hm]; grind
  have c2 : ((n + 2 : Nat) : R) = m + 1 := by rw [← hm]; grind
  have hF : (fact (n + 2) : R) = (m + 1) * (fact (n + 1) : R) := by
    rw [fact_succ' (n + 1), c1]
  have hlogF : log (fact (n + 2) : R) = log (m + 1) + log (fact (n + 1) : R) := by
    rw [hF]; exact log_mul (by grind) (fact_pos' _)
  -- `dₘ − d_{m+1} = (m + ½) u − 1` with `u = log(m+1) − log m`.
  have hdiff : d (n + 1) - d (n + 2) = (m + 1 / 2) * (log (m + 1) - log m) - 1 := by
    unfold d; rw [c1, c2, hlogF]; grind
  rw [show (n : R) + 2 = m + 1 by rw [← hm]; grind, hdiff]
  generalize hu : log (m + 1) - log m = u
  -- `eᵘ = (m + 1)/m`, so with `w = 1/m`: `eᵘ = 1 + w`, `m w = 1`.
  have hmw : m * (1 / m) = 1 := by grind
  generalize hw : 1 / m = w at hmw
  have heu : exp u = 1 + w := by
    rw [← hu, show log (m + 1) - log m = log (m + 1) + -log m by grind, exp_add,
      exp_log (by grind)]
    have := exp_mul_exp_neg (log m); rw [exp_log hmpos] at this
    have e2 : exp (-log m) = w := by
      have := cancel_left (u := m) (by grind) (show m * exp (-log m) = m * w by grind); exact this
    rw [e2]; grind
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by
    rw [← hu]
    have := log_strictMono hmpos (by grind : m < m + 1); grind
  have i1 := exp_ineq1 hu0
  have i2 := exp_ineq2 hu0
  rw [heu] at i1 i2
  constructor
  · -- `2w ≤ u(2 + w)`, times `m`: `2 ≤ u(2m + 1)`.
    have k := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left i1 (Std.le_of_lt hmpos)
    have e := congrArg (· * u) hmw
    grind
  · -- `u(6 + 4w) ≤ w(6 + w)`, times `m²`: `u m (6m + 4) ≤ 6m + 1`.
    have k := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left i2
      (Std.le_of_lt (OrderedRing.mul_pos hmpos hmpos))
    have e1 := congrArg (· * (u * m)) hmw
    have e2 := congrArg (· * m) hmw
    have e3 := congrArg (· * (m * w)) hmw
    have k2 : u * m * (6 * m + 4) ≤ 6 * m + 1 := by grind
    -- Then `(6m+4) · [4m(m+1)((m+½)u − 1) − 1] ≤ 0`.
    have k3 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 (OrderedRing.mul_nonneg (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 2 * (m + 1)) (by grind : (0 : R) ≤ 2 * m + 1))
    have k4 : (6 * m + 4) * (4 * m * (m + 1) * ((m + 1 / 2) * u - 1)) ≤ (6 * m + 4) * 1 := by
      grind
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
    have := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by grind : (1 : R) < 4 * m * (m + 1) *
      ((m + 1 / 2) * u - 1)) (by grind : (0 : R) < 6 * m + 4)
    grind

/-- **Congruence for function symbols.** Provably equal arguments give provably
equal values. -/
theorem func_congr {Γ : Theory L} {n : Nat} (f : L.Func n) {ts ts' : Fin n → Term L}
    (h : ∀ i, Γ ⊢₁ eq (ts i) (ts' i)) : Γ ⊢₁ eq (.func f ts) (.func f ts') := by

  refine ⟨eq ((Term.func f ts).rename Nat.succ)
    (.func f fun i => if i = k then .var 0 else (us i).rename Nat.succ), fun w => ?_⟩

  rw [← inst_args us k w]; rfl

Foundations.Algebra.neg_one_qr_iff:
/-- **Fermat's criterion for `-1`.** `-1` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `p` exactly
when `p ≡ 1 (mod 4)`. -/
theorem neg_one_qr_iff (hp : IsPrime p) (hodd : p % 2 = 1) : IsQR (p - 1) p ↔ p % 4 = 1 := by
  classical
  have h3 := hp.1
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ p - 1 := fun h => by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; omega
  have he := euler_criterion hp hodd hnd
  rw [pred_pow_mod h3] at he
  have hh : half p % 2 = 0 ↔ p % 4 = 1 := by unfold half; omega
  by_cases hq : IsQR (p - 1) p
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, true_iff] at he ⊢
    apply hh.1
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne; rw [ite_false_of hne] at he; omega
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, false_iff] at he ⊢
    intro h4; rw [ite_true_of (hh.2 h4)] at he; omega

Foundations.Numbers.R.sin_eq_zero_iff:
/-- **Zeros of sine.** `sin x = 0` if and only if `x = kπ` for an integer `k`. -/
theorem sin_eq_zero_iff (x : R) : sin x = 0 ↔ ∃ k : Int, x = (k : R) * pi := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ := exists_int_mul_pi x
    have hy : sin (x - (m : R) * pi) = 0 := by
      rw [← sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero _ m, show x - (m : R) * pi + (m : R) * pi = x by grind]
      exact h
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hne
    have := sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (x := x - (m : R) * pi) (by grind) (by grind)
    grind
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have := (sin_add_int_mul_pi_eq_zero 0 k).2 sin_zero
    rw [show (0 : R) + (k : R) * pi = (k : R) * pi by grind] at this
    exact this

Foundations.Categories.Cocone:
/-- A **cocone** under a diagram `F : J ⥤ C`: an apex `pt` with an arrow from every
vertex `F j`, making all triangles commute. -/
structure Cocone (F : J ⥤ C) where
  /-- The apex of the cocone. -/
  pt : C
  /-- The leg of the cocone at `j`. -/
  ι : (j : J) → (F.obj j ⟶ pt)
  /-- The triangles commute: `F f ≫ ι_j = ι_i`. -/
  w : ∀ {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j), F.map f ≫ ι j = ι i
Foundations.Types.Lambda.Step:
/-- **One-step β-reduction**, anywhere inside a term. -/
inductive Step : Term → Term → Prop
  /-- The β-rule `(λ. t) u ⟶ t[u]`. -/
  | beta (t u : Term) : Step (app (lam t) u) (inst t u)
  /-- Reduce in the function part. -/
  | appL {t t' u : Term} : Step t t' → Step (app t u) (app t' u)
  /-- Reduce in the argument. -/
  | appR {t u u' : Term} : Step u u' → Step (app t u) (app t u')
  /-- Reduce under a binder. -/
  | lam {t t' : Term} : Step t t' → Step (lam t) (lam t')

Foundations.Algebra.RingHom.injective_if:
/-- A ring homomorphism is injective iff its kernel is `{0}`. -/
theorem injective_iff_ker {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (f : RingHom R S) :
    (∀ a b, f.toFun a = f.toFun b → a = b) ↔ (∀ x, f.toFun x = 0 → x = 0) := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx; exact h x 0 (by rw [hx, f.map_zero])
  · intro h a b hab
    have : f.toFun (-a + b) = 0 := by rw [f.map_add, f.map_neg, hab, neg_add_cancel]
    have h0 := h _ this
    have := congrArg (a + ·) h0
    simp only [add_neg_cancel_left, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm

/-- A relation that is functional and total on `α` and injective yields an
injection `α → β` (choosing the value at each point). -/
theorem injective_of_rel {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop)

Foundations.Logic.kalmar_lemma:
/-- **Kalmár's lemma.** If the atoms of `φ` lie in `L`, then the row hypotheses for
`v` derive `φ` or `¬φ`, according to whether `φ` is true or false under `v`. -/
theorem kalmar_lemma (v : Valuation) (L : List Nat) :
    ∀ φ : Formula, (∀ a ∈ atoms φ, a ∈ L) → rowHyps v L ⊢ signed (eval v φ) φ
  | bot, _ => Derives.neg_bot _
  | var p, h => Derives.hyp ⟨p, h p (by simp [atoms]), rfl⟩
  | imp a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.imp_of_neg ha
      · exact Derives.imp_of_right hb
      · exact Derives.neg_imp ha hb
      · exact Derives.imp_of_right hb
  | conj a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₁ ha
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₁ ha
      · exact Derives.neg_conj₂ hb
      · exact Derives.conjI ha hb
  | disj a b, h => by
      have ha := kalmar_lemma v L a (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      have hb := kalmar_lemma v L b (fun x hx => h x (by simp [atoms, hx]))
      cases ea : eval v a <;> cases eb : eval v b <;>
        simp only [ea, eb, signed] at ha hb <;> simp only [eval, ea, eb, signed]
      · exact Derives.neg_disj ha hb
      · exact Derives.disjI₂ hb
      · exact Derives.disjI₁ ha
      · exact Derives.disjI₁ ha

Foundations.Algebra.pow_ne_one_of_lt_ord:
/-- No smaller positive power of `g` is the identity. -/
theorem pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf (g : G) {m : Nat} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < orderOf g) :
    g ^ m ≠ 1 :=

Foundations.Types.STLC.fundamental:
/-- **The fundamental lemma of logical relations.** A well-typed term with
reducible terms substituted for its free variables is reducible. -/
theorem fundamental {Γ : Ctx} {t : Term} {A : Ty} (h : HasType Γ t A) :
    ∀ σ, (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → RED B (σ n)) → RED A (subst σ t) := by
  have hcons : ∀ {Γ : Ctx} {A : Ty} {σ : Nat → Term} {u : Term},
      (∀ n B, Γ[n]? = some B → RED B (σ n)) → RED A u →
      ∀ n B, (A :: Γ)[n]? = some B → RED B (cons u σ n) := by
    intro Γ A σ u hσ hu n B hn
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at hn; subst hn; exact hu
    | succ n => exact hσ n B (by simpa using hn)
  induction h with
  | var hn => intro σ hσ; exact hσ _ _ hn
  | lam _ ih =>
    intro σ hσ
    exact lam_red fun u hu => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih _ (hcons hσ hu)
  | app _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ hσ; exact ih₁ σ hσ _ (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro σ hσ; exact pair_red (ih₁ σ hσ) (ih₂ σ hσ)
  | fst _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact (ih σ hσ).1
  | snd _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact (ih σ hσ).2
  | inl _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact inl_red (ih σ hσ)
  | inr _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact inr_red (ih σ hσ)
  | case _ _ _ ih ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro σ hσ
    exact case_red (ih σ hσ)
      (fun a ha => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih₁ _ (hcons hσ ha))
      (fun b hb => by rw [inst_up]; exact ih₂ _ (hcons hσ hb))
  | absurd _ ih => intro σ hσ; exact absurd_red (ih σ hσ)

/-- Extensional equivalence is transitive. -/
theorem Equiv.trans {x y z : PSet} : Equiv x y → Equiv y z → Equiv x z := by
  induction x generalizing y z with
  | mk α A ih =>
    cases y with
    | mk β B =>
      cases z with
      | mk γ C =>
        intro hxy hyz
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := equiv_iff.1 hxy
        obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := equiv_iff.1 hyz
        refine equiv_iff.2 ⟨fun a => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h1 a
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h3 b
          exact ⟨c, ih a hb hc⟩
        · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h4 c
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h2 b
          exact ⟨a, ih a ha hb⟩
Foundations.Topology.Wallis.wallis:
/-- **The Wallis product** (Wallis 1656). `Π_{n ≥ 1} (2n)²/((2n − 1)(2n + 1)) = π/2`: the partial
products converge to `π/2`. -/
theorem wallis : Tendsto wp (pi / 2) := by
  have hb : ∀ n : Nat, abs (wp n - hpi) ≤ hpi * (1 / ((n : R) + 1)) := fun n => by
    rw [wp_eq]
    have r := I_rec (2 * n)
    have a1 := I_anti (2 * n); have a2 := I_anti (2 * n + 1)
    have p1 := I_pos (2 * n); have p3 := I_pos (2 * n + 2)
    have c1 : ((2 * n : Nat) : R) = 2 * (n : R) := by grind
    rw [c1] at r
    rw [show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * n + 2 by omega] at a2
    have hp := hpi_pos
    have : (0 : R) ≤ (n : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
    generalize I (2 * n) = a at *
    generalize I (2 * n + 1) = b at *
    generalize I (2 * n + 2) = c at *
    generalize (n : R) = N at *
    -- `(2N+1)/(2N+2) · a = c ≤ b ≤ a`.
    have hrb : b / a ≤ 1 := by
      have := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a1 (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 p1))
      rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv]; grind
    have hrl : 1 - 1 / (N + 1) ≤ b / a := by
      have hc : c = (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) * a := by grind
      have k : (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) ≤ b / a := by
        have k1 := OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show c ≤ b from a2)
          (Std.le_of_lt (Field.IsOrdered.inv_pos_iff.2 p1))
        have ia := Field.mul_inv_cancel (show a ≠ 0 by grind)
        have e : c * a⁻¹ = (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) := by
          rw [hc, Semiring.mul_assoc, ia, Semiring.mul_one]
        rw [e] at k1
        rw [Field.div_eq_mul_inv b]; exact k1
      have : 1 - 1 / (N + 1) ≤ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) := by
        have e : (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 2) = 1 - 1 / (2 * N + 2) := by grind
        rw [e]
        have := one_div_le_one_div (by grind : 0 < N + 1) (by grind : N + 1 ≤ 2 * N + 2)
        grind
      grind
    have e : hpi * b / a - hpi = hpi * (b / a - 1) := by grind
    rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Std.le_of_lt hp)]
    apply OrderedRing.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Std.le_of_lt hp)
    have : 0 < 1 / (N + 1) := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by grind, by grind⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eps_small (div_pos hε hpi_pos)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have k := hN n hn
  have k2 := OrderedRing.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left k hpi_pos
  have e : hpi * (ε / hpi) = ε := by have := hpi_pos; grind
  show abs (wp n - pi / 2) < ε
  have := hb n
  unfold hpi at *
  grind

/-- **The Goodstein sequence** of `n`: start with `n`; at step `k` (current base
`k + 2`) bump the base to `k + 3` and subtract `1`. -/
def goodstein (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => n
  | k + 1 => bump k (goodstein n k) - 1

/-- `sbMap` is surjective. -/
theorem sbMap_surjective (hg : Function.Injective g) : Function.Surjective (sbMap f g) := by
  intro b
  by_cases hb : InC f g (g b)
  · -- `g b` is in `InC`; it is not a base point, so it is `g (f a)` with `a ∈ InC`
    have key : ∀ x, InC f g x → x = g b → ∃ a, InC f g a ∧ f a = b := by
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | base x hn => intro hx; exact absurd ⟨b, hx.symm⟩ hn
      | step a ha => intro hx; exact ⟨a, ha, hg hx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := key (g b) hb rfl
    exact ⟨a, sbMap_of_inC f g ha⟩
  · exact ⟨g b, hg (g_sbMap_of_not f g hb)⟩

/-- **Term substitutions compose.** -/
theorem subst_subst (t : Term) : ∀ τ σ, subst τ (subst σ t) = subst (subst τ ∘ σ) t := by
  induction t with
  | var n => intros; rfl
  | app t u iht ihu => intros; simp only [subst, iht, ihu]
  | lam t ih => intro τ σ; simp only [subst, ih, up_comp]
  | tlam t ih =>
    intro τ σ
    simp only [subst, ih]
    congr 2
    funext n
    exact (tyRename_subst _ _ _).symm
  | tapp t B ih => intros; simp only [subst, ih]
Foundations.Topology.Vitali.shift_disjoi:
/-- **Translates of `V` by distinct related amounts are disjoint.** -/
theorem shift_disjoint {r s : R} (hr : I r) (hs : I s) (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrel : Rel r s) {x : R}
    (h1 : shift V r x) (h2 : shift V s x) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a, n, hrel⟩ := hrel
  have hn := succ_pos n
  have hlem : ∀ v w : R, V v → V w → ∀ e : Int, v - w = (s - r) + (e : R) → False := by
    intro v w hv hw e he
    have hvw : v = w := V_unique hv hw ⟨-a + e * ((n : Int) + 1), n, by
      have := Ring.intCast_natCast (α := R) n
      have : (((-a + e * ((n : Int) + 1)) : Int) : R) = -(a : R) + (e : R) * ((n : R) + 1) := by
        grind
      rw [this, he]; grind⟩
    have hv := hv.1; have hw := hw.1
    unfold I at hr hs hv hw
    have h1' : (-2 : R) < (e : R) := by grind
    have h2' : (e : R) < (2 : R) := by grind
    have k1 := (intCast_lt (K := R) (a := -2) (b := e)).1 (by grind)
    have k2 := (intCast_lt (K := R) (a := e) (b := 2)).1 (by grind)
    have : e = -1 ∨ e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> grind
  obtain ⟨_, h1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := h2
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 <;> rcases h2 with h2 | h2
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 0 (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 (-1) (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 1 (by grind)
  · exact hlem _ _ h1 h2 0 (by grind)
Foundations.Combinatorics.erdos_szekeres:
/-- **The Erdős–Szekeres theorem.** Among the first `n² + 1` terms `a 0, …, a (n²)` of a
sequence of pairwise distinct natural numbers there is a strictly increasing or a
strictly decreasing subsequence of length `n + 1`. -/
theorem erdos_szekeres (a : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hinj : ∀ i j, i < j → j ≤ n * n → a i ≠ a j) :
    HasMono (· < ·) a n (n * n) ∨ HasMono (· > ·) a n (n * n) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  simp only [not_or] at hno
  obtain ⟨hinc, hdec⟩ := hno
  let N := n * n
  -- the labels
  let inc : Nat → Nat := fun i => findGreatest (MonoEnd (· < ·) a i) n
  let dec : Nat → Nat := fun i => findGreatest (MonoEnd (· > ·) a i) n
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
    · exact absurd ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ _ => by simp [h], fun p q hpq hq => by omega⟩ hinc
    · exact h
  have inc_spec : ∀ i, MonoEnd (· < ·) a i (inc i) :=
    fun i => findGreatest_spec n 1 (by omega) hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have dec_spec : ∀ i, MonoEnd (· > ·) a i (dec i) :=
    fun i => findGreatest_spec n 1 (by omega) hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have inc_pos : ∀ i, 1 ≤ inc i := fun i => le_findGreatest n 1 hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have dec_pos : ∀ i, 1 ≤ dec i := fun i => le_findGreatest n 1 hn (monoEnd_one _ a i)
  have inc_le : ∀ i, inc i ≤ n := fun i => findGreatest_le _ n
  have dec_le : ∀ i, dec i ≤ n := fun i => findGreatest_le _ n
  -- two positions with the same label
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hj, he⟩ := pigeonhole (n * n) (n * n + 1)
    (fun i => (inc i - 1) * n + (dec i - 1))
    (fun i _ => by
      have h₁ := inc_le i; have h₂ := dec_le i; have h₃ := inc_pos i; have h₄ := dec_pos i
      have : (inc i - 1) * n ≤ (n - 1) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (by omega)
      have : (n - 1) * n + n = n * n := by
        rw [← Nat.succ_mul, show (n - 1).succ = n by omega]
      omega)
    (by omega)
  obtain ⟨hI, hD⟩ := pair_code_inj (by have := dec_le i; have := dec_pos i; omega)
    (by have := dec_le j; have := dec_pos j; omega) he
  have hI' : inc i = inc j := by have := inc_pos i; have := inc_pos j; omega
  have hD' : dec i = dec j := by have := dec_pos i; have := dec_pos j; omega
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne (hinj i j hij (by omega)) with h | h
  · have hext := monoEnd_extend (r := fun x y => x < y) (fun x y z => Nat.lt_trans) (inc_pos i) (inc_spec i) hij h
    have := le_findGreatest n _ (monoEnd_bound hinc (by omega) hext) hext
    show False
    have : inc i + 1 ≤ inc j := this
    omega
  · have hext := monoEnd_extend (r := fun x y => x > y) (fun x y z h₁ h₂ => Nat.lt_trans h₂ h₁) (dec_pos i) (dec_spec i)
      hij h
    have := le_findGreatest n _ (monoEnd_bound hdec (by omega) hext) hext
    have : dec i + 1 ≤ dec j := this
    omega

/-- A structure satisfying all universal closures of PA axioms under a single
environment is a model of PA (under every environment), by the coincidence lemma. -/
theorem isModel_of_PAClosure {M : Structure Arith} {e₀ : Nat → M.Dom}
    (h : ∀ χ, PAClosure χ → Sat M e₀ χ) : IsModel M PA := by
  refine ⟨⟨e₀ 0⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ e
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := eventually_fresh ψ
  let e' : Nat → M.Dom := fun n => if n < B then e n else e₀ (n - B)
  have h₁ := (sat_allN ψ B e₀).1 (h _ ⟨ψ, B, hψ, rfl⟩) e' fun n => by
    simp only [e', show ¬ (n + B < B) by omega, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  refine (sat_congr_fresh ψ fun n hn => ?_).1 h₁
  have : n < B := Classical.byContradiction fun hn' => hn (hB n (by omega))
  simp only [e', this, ite_true]

/-- **The law of total probability** (two cases):

theorem total_probability {A B : Event α} (hB : P.prob B ≠ 0) (hB' : P.prob (fun x => ¬ B x) ≠ 0) :

/-- **Zagier's map is an involution** on `S`. -/
theorem zagier_zagier (hp : IsPrime p) (h4 : p % 4 = 1) {t : Nat × Nat × Nat} (h : InS p t) :
    zagier (zagier t) = t := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz, _, _⟩ := h.facts hp h4
  by_cases h1 : x + z < y
  · rw [zagier_eq1 x y z h1, zagier_eq3 (x + 2 * z) z (y - x - z) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega
  · by_cases h2 : x < 2 * y
    · rw [zagier_eq2 x y z h1 h2, zagier_eq2 (2 * y - x) y (x + z - y) (by omega) (by omega)]
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, and_true, true_and]; omega
    · rw [zagier_eq3 x y z h1 h2, zagier_eq1 (x - 2 * y) (x + z - y) y (by omega)]

/-- Every cut is the cut of some Cauchy real (the supremum of its lower part). -/
theorem exists_real (A : Cut) : ∃ x : R, ∀ q, A.lower q ↔ R.ofQ q < x := by
  let S : R → Prop := fun y => ∃ q, A.lower q ∧ y = R.ofQ q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.nonempty
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := A.bounded
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := R.exists_lub S ⟨_, a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨R.ofQ b, fun y ⟨q, hq, hy⟩ => by
    rw [hy]; exact Std.le_of_lt (R.ofQ_lt.2 (lt_of_mem hq hb))⟩
  refine ⟨L, fun q => ⟨fun hq => ?_, fun hq => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hAr⟩ := A.open_ hq
    have := hL1 _ ⟨r, hAr, rfl⟩
    have := R.ofQ_lt.2 hr
    grind
  · have : ¬ ∀ y, S y → y ≤ R.ofQ q := fun h => by have := hL2 _ h; grind
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hno
    apply this
    rintro y ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hc
    exact hno (A.down hr (R.ofQ_lt.1 (by grind)))
Foundations.Topology.sum_k_bern:
/-- `Σ_k k · C(n, k) xᵏ (1 − x)ⁿ⁻ᵏ = n x` (here `n = m + 2`). -/
theorem sum_k_bern (m : Nat) (x : R) :
    R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * bern (m + 2) k x) (m + 3) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : R) * x := by
  unfold bern
  have e : R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * ((fact (m + 2) : R) * (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 2 - k))))
      (m + 3) = (fact (m + 2) : R) *
        R.fsum (fun k => (k : R) * (expTerm x k * expTerm (1 - x) (m + 1 + 1 - k))) (m + 1 + 2) := by
    rw [← fsum_const_mul]; apply fsum_congr; intro k _; grind
  rw [e, moment1, show x + (1 - x) = 1 by grind, expTerm_one, fact_succ', fact_succ']
  have hm0 : (0 : R) ≤ (m : R) := OrderedRing.natCast_nonneg
  have hpos := OrderedRing.mul_pos (show (0 : R) < (m : R) + 1 by grind) (fact_pos' m)
  grind
Foundations.Numbers.N.le_antisymm:
/-- `≤` is antisymmetric. -/
theorem le_antisymm {a b : N} (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : b ≤ a) : a = b := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h₂
  rw [add_assoc] at hj
  have := (add_eq_zero (add_self_eq hj)).1
  subst this; rfl
Foundations.Numbers.C.normSq_exp_I_mul:
/-- **`|exp (iθ)| = 1`**: the points `exp (iθ)` lie on the unit circle. -/
theorem normSq_exp_I_mul (θ : R) : normSq (exp (I * ofReal θ)) = 1 := by
  rw [exp_I_mul]
  show (cos θ + (0 * sin θ - 1 * 0)) * (cos θ + (0 * sin θ - 1 * 0)) +
    (0 + (0 * 0 + 1 * sin θ)) * (0 + (0 * 0 + 1 * sin θ)) = 1
  have := sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ; grind

Foundations.Logic.FO.exists_add_mul_mod:
/-- **Solving a linear congruence.** If `P` and `d` are coprime, then `a + t·P` can be
made congruent to any `r` modulo `d`. -/
theorem exists_add_mul_mod {P d : Nat} (hcop : Nat.Coprime P d) (hd : 0 < d) (a r : Nat) :
    ∃ t, (a + t * P) % d = r % d := by
  obtain ⟨x, y, h⟩ := bezout P d
  rw [hcop] at h
  let T : Int := ((r : Int) - a) * x
  have hnn : 0 ≤ T % d := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by omega)
  refine ⟨(T % d).toNat, mod_eq_of_int_dvd ⟨-((r : Int) - a) * y - (T / d) * P, ?_⟩⟩
  have ht : (((T % d).toNat : Nat) : Int) = T % d := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn
  have hdef : T % d = T - d * (T / d) := Int.emod_def T d
  push_cast
  rw [ht, hdef]
  have hx : x * P = 1 - y * d := by simp at h; omega
  show (a : Int) + (((r : Int) - a) * x - d * (T / d)) * P - r = _
  grind
Foundations.Logic.FO.PAModel.UDef.and:

Foundations.Combinatorics.good_child:
/-- **The key step**: a good node of a finitely branching tree has a good child. -/
theorem good_child (hT : IsTree T) (hfb : FinBranching T) {l : List Nat} (hl : Good T l) :
    ∃ a, Good T (l ++ [a]) := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hno => ?_
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hfb l
  -- every child `a < B` has a depth beyond which it has no extensions
  have hbad : ∀ a, ∃ n, ¬ ∃ m, T (l ++ [a] ++ m) ∧ m.length = n := by
    intro a
    refine Classical.byContradiction fun h => hno ⟨a, fun n => ?_⟩
    exact Classical.byContradiction fun h' => h ⟨n, h'⟩
  -- a common depth for all children `a < B`
  have hcommon : ∀ k, ∃ N, ∀ a, a < k → ∀ m, T (l ++ [a] ++ m) → m.length < N := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, fun a ha => absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hbad k
      refine ⟨max N₁ n, fun a ha m hm => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 ha with ha | rfl
      · have := hN₁ a ha m hm; omega
      · refine Classical.byContradiction fun hlt => hn ?_
        exact ext_shorter hT hm (by omega)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcommon B
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hml⟩ := hl (N + 1)
  match m, hml with
  | a :: m', hml =>
    have hchild : T (l ++ [a]) := hT _ m' (by simpa using hm)
    have := hN a (hB a hchild) m' (by simpa using hm)
    simp at hml; omega

Foundations.Sets.PSet.mem_iff:

Foundations.Topology.IsPolyFn.comp:
/-- Composition of polynomials is a polynomial. -/
theorem comp {p q : R → R} (hp : IsPolyFn p) (hq : IsPolyFn q) : IsPolyFn (fun x => p (q x)) := by
  induction hp with
  | const c => exact const c
  | id => exact hq
  | add _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact add ih1 ih2
  | mul _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact mul ih1 ih2
Foundations.Algebra.card_le_dim:
/-- An independent family has at most `dim K V` members. -/
theorem card_le_dim (hF : IsField K) (hfin : FinDim K V) {ι : Type w} [FiniteType ι]
    {u : ι → V} (hu : LinIndep K u) : card ι ≤ dim K V := by
  obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := exists_basis hF hfin
  have := steinitz hF (fun j : Fin (card ι) => u (ofFin j)) b (linIndep_ofFin hu) (fun i => hb _)
  rwa [card_fin, card_fin] at this
Foundations.Numbers.R.monotone_convergen:
/-- **Monotone convergence theorem.** An increasing sequence of reals that is bounded above
converges. -/
theorem monotone_convergence {a : Nat → R} (hmono : ∀ n, a n ≤ a (n + 1))
    (hbdd : ∃ B, ∀ n, a n ≤ B) : ∃ L, Tendsto a L := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := exists_lub (fun x => ∃ n, x = a n) ⟨_, 0, rfl⟩
    (by obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd; exact ⟨B, fun x ⟨n, hn⟩ => hn ▸ hB n⟩)
  refine ⟨L, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  have : ¬ ∀ x, (∃ n, x = a n) → x ≤ L - ε := fun h => by have := hL2 _ h; grind
  have : ∃ N, L - ε < a N := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hno; apply this
    rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    apply Classical.byContradiction; intro h; exact hno ⟨n, by grind⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := this
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => abs_lt.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := mono_le hmono hn; grind
  · have := hL1 _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; grind
Foundations.Categories.Lambek.Sub:
/-- A **substitution** from `Γ` to `Δ`: a term in context `Δ` for every variable of `Γ`. -/
